### [1] [The Score Is Not the Structure: Brain Alignment and Cross-Lingual Transfer](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03827)
*Saman Rahbar*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文对两种常用的"对应性得分"（模型-大脑相似度、跨语言迁移）进行审计，发现：(1)CKA 对齐得分的大部分提升（约83-92%）可通过打乱目标重现，仅5-13%是脑特异的；(2)跨语言探针迁移梯度中，4/17语言的探针本身处于随机水平，导致64/272对用失效工具测量；且272对应被视为17种语言为统计单位。两种对应性均未带来下游或因果收益。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在"模型与大脑共享结构"或"跨语言共享子空间"的研究中，研究者惯以相似度分数作为证据。但该分数在对应结构缺失或测量工具失效时会显示什么数值？这是一个应优先回答的方法论问题——即在进行任何"对应性是否有功能性价值"的推论前，需先审计分数本身的可靠性、工具的可比性以及统计单位的正确性。

Method: 提出三步审计框架：(1)内容消融——将目标（fMRI反应/语言方向）打乱或替换为噪声以去除对应性而保留形式/统计量；(2)工具检查——验证测量工具（如探针）在被比较轴上的可靠性是否一致；(3)推断检查——以正确的实体（如语言而非配对）为单位进行置换检验。研究1使用XGLM-1.7B在17种语言上拟合L2逻辑回归探针并测试跨语言迁移与激活引导（+6.21 nats基线确认）；研究2微调Pythia（160M/410M/1.4B）以CKA为目标对齐Pereira fMRI的秩128表征，并在BLiMP上测试下游效果。

Result: 研究1（跨语言）：迁移准确率随类型学距离衰减（r=-0.66, R²=0.43），但探针自身准确率也随距离衰减（r=-0.74），4种语言（Hindi、Urdu、Turkish、Arabic）处于随机水平；以语言为单位置换时校正后的引导效应不显著（r=-0.22, p=0.155），而以272对为单位则p=0.0006。研究2（脑对齐）：CKA从0.10提升至0.34（上限0.54），但打乱/随机目标仍达0.31，脑特异增量仅+0.028至+0.068（5-13%上限）；且脑对齐在BLiMP上从未显著高于基线。秩k目标与n句的真实-打乱CKA≈k/n（秩32/64/128/256对应0.05/0.10/0.20/0.41）。

Conclusion: 对应性得分在两种设置中均未如其表面所示。污染量与目标信号共变而非独立，故在散点图中表现为更强效应而非噪声。两项审计廉价易行（脑研究只需一行代码检查基线，跨语言研究只需增加一列报告探针内部准确率），应作为对应性研究报告的标准组成部分。其核心建议是：在问"对应性是否有用"之前，先问"若无对应性，该得分还剩多少"。

Abstract: Researchers often support the claim that a model shares structure with the brain, or across languages, by reporting a similarity score. We ask what such a score reads when the shared structure is absent, or when the tool that measures it does not work. We check two settings, and in both the score is not what it appears. First, a probe trained to tell grammatical from ungrammatical sentences in one language transfers worse to more distant languages, the usual evidence for shared structure. But the probe itself gets worse along the same axis: in four of seventeen languages it performs at chance, so 64 of 272 language pairs are scored with a tool that does not work. Dropping those languages halves the strength of the relationship, but they are also the most distant, and this design cannot separate the two effects. Counting matters too: the same data give p = 0.0006 when the 272 pairs are treated as independent and p = 0.155 when the seventeen languages are, which is the correct unit. Second, training a language model to match human brain responses raises its similarity score from 0.10 to 0.34, against a ceiling of 0.54. A model trained on a target whose correspondence to the brain was destroyed still scores 0.31, so only 0.028 to 0.068 of the rise is specific to the brain. With no model at all, a destroyed target already sits at 0.204 from the real one, a floor that tracks the target's rank divided by the number of sentences. Finally, steering a language along its own direction works (+6.2 over a random direction in sixteen of seventeen languages) yet shows no effect that varies with language distance. Before asking whether a correspondence helps, ask how much of the score would survive without it.

</details>


### [2] [SYNLAT: Syntax-Aligned Text-Latent Compression for Chain-of-Thought Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03839)
*Yifeng Zhao,Hongjun Yu,Shibo Wang,Yunjiao Zhou,Zixiao Zhu,Zhipeng Ning,Kezhi Mao,Junlang Qian*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: SynLat是一个面向长思维链压缩的文本-潜变量混合框架，通过将压缩边界对齐到句法结构（SAU）来在有限token预算下保留答案关键信息。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长CoT推理输出成本高；现有方法以token、5-token窗口或step作为压缩单元，会切断短语/公式/局部推导等连贯片段，或将需要不同压缩决策的内容绑定在一起，导致高压缩率下逻辑保真度下降。需要一种既保持局部关系完整、又允许差异化压缩决策的边界划分方式。

Method: 1）将参考CoT按句按句法成分树解析，展平为有序、不重叠的Syntax-Aligned Units（SAU），长度上限 Lmax；2）离线Teacher在给定参考答案 y* 下，按渐进式替换性顺序为各SAU分配 KEEP/LATENT 动作（LOW⊆MEDIUM⊆HIGH）；3）用SpanBERT+IncrementalPCA+球面k-means在任务无关语料上构建共享离散码本，LATENT单元映射到最近的码本符号 <LAT_k>；4）两阶段Plan-then-Generate训练：Stage I预测序列化SAU-动作规划，Stage II去除参考trace，只用 (q, c) 生成混合CoT与最终答案；推理时Student仅接收问题与压缩等级。

Result: 在Qwen3-8B/14B两个规模、Standard-CoT（MATH-500、StrategyQA）与Long-CoT（OlympiadBench、WorldTree V2、ProofWriter）三组、三个压缩等级下，12个任务组聚合中SynLat匹配或超过最强基线，11个严格领先；Qwen3-8B/14B在MEDIUM下整体提升3.6/2.6分，HIGH下提升7.0/5.5分，Long-CoT组在高压缩下优势更大。SAU在≈44% CR下保留NONE精度的94.0%，优于5-token（91.4%）、5-token+Guard（92.2%）与step（89.6%）；答案条件规划在MEDIUM/HIGH下分别保留94.0%/89.3%，优于无答案基线（92.0%/86.2%）。

Conclusion: CoT压缩本质是有限表征保真度的分配问题；将压缩边界对齐到trace特有的句法结构（SAU），并通过答案条件规划+Student迁移，能在匹配输出预算下显著提升最终答案精度，长推理任务收益尤为明显。

Abstract: Long chain-of-thought (CoT) traces impose substantial output-token costs. Under constrained budgets, compression must preserve answer-critical information, making boundary placement central. Token-level and fixed-length boundaries can fragment coherent spans such as phrases, formulas, and local derivations, whereas step-level boundaries can bind content requiring different compression actions. We introduce SynLat, a text-latent CoT framework that aligns compression boundaries with syntactic structure through non-overlapping Syntax-Aligned Units (SAUs). An answer-conditioned Teacher constructs progressive KEEP/LATENT targets for a single compression-conditioned Student, which generates mixed reasoning from only the question and requested compression level at inference. Across two Qwen3 Student scales, Standard-CoT and Long-CoT groups, and three compression levels, SynLat matches or exceeds the strongest evaluated baseline in all 12 task-group aggregates and strictly leads in 11 under the reported achieved-CR selection protocol. Overall gains reach 3.6/2.6 points at MEDIUM and 7.0/5.5 points at HIGH for Qwen3-8B/14B, with larger advantages under stronger compression, particularly on Long-CoT groups.

</details>


### [3] [A Step Towards Forgetting: Optimiser History and the Loss of Answer Mass](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03940)
*Valeria Ruscio,Seth Nabarro,Keiran Thompson*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文研究了Adam优化器在语言模型持续微调中导致遗忘的机制。将旧任务损失分解为"混淆"（在旧答案间的判别性下降）和"泄漏"（旧答案集概率质量下降），发现答案质量一致下降而判别性常改善。通过分解Adam更新为历史通道和当前梯度通道，发现累积的历史梯度倾向于促进泄漏，而当前梯度倾向于恢复答案质量。历史梯度中造成损害的主要来自较早的新任务梯度；历史对旧任务的影响变化主要由其相对于旧任务梯度的方向决定。匹配范数的动量重置实验证实存储的历史影响保留性。最后沿有限更新路径的积分表明大多数大的损失增加已被初始投影捕获，但沿历史的曲率在某些事件中放大了损害。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在持续学习中，模型在新任务微调时可能遗忘已学知识。已有研究关注参数约束（如EWC）、梯度投影（如OGD）和记忆回放等方法保护旧任务，但优化器内部动量历史如何具体导致遗忘的机制尚不清楚。理解这一点有助于设计更好的优化策略以缓解灾难性遗忘。

Method: 1. 损失分解：将旧任务NLL分解为confusion（在旧答案集内的条件分布）和leakage（旧答案集外的概率质量）。2. 优化器分解：将Adam更新分解为history通道（来自累积一阶矩）和current通道（来自当前梯度）。3. 投影分析：计算各通道对两种损失分量的局部投影。4. 年龄分析：按梯度年龄（1-4、5-16、17+步）分解历史贡献。5. 方向分解：用三恒等式分离方向、梯度范数、通道范数对投影变化的贡献。6. 干预实验：重置一阶矩同时匹配初始位移范数，测试立即和长期效果。7. 有限路径积分：用基本微积分定理沿实际位移积分，分离历史、当前和混合曲率贡献。实验涵盖Pythia-410M、SmolLM2-135M、Qwen3-0.6B等模型在SST-2→AG News等序列任务上的表现。

Result: 1. 答案质量一致下降：18个轨迹中泄漏全部增加，而16个轨迹的混淆下降。2. 通道对立：13次回放中历史和当前梯度对泄漏的累积投影符号相反（H_ℓ>0, C_ℓ<0）。3. 年龄分层：5-16和17+步的较老新任务梯度累积投影为正，而1-4步的最近梯度投影为负，继承的任务A矩贡献很小。4. 方向主导：方向变化占历史投影绝对贡献变化的77-84%。5. 干预效果：块匹配重置在32步延续中改善了所有6个Adam轨迹的最终旧任务损失（Pythia改善0.127 nats，主要通过恢复泄漏）。6. 有限路径：19个大的总损失增加中17个为一阶主导，2个被曲率放大；在放大案例中，历史-历史曲率为正且超过混合保护项。7. 预测性：前一更新的投影和验证损失变化是有效的预警信号。

Conclusion: 优化器的记忆（动量历史）可通过累积较老的新任务梯度系统性地侵蚀已学行为，即使当前梯度局部地保护旧行为。答案质量的丧失主要由历史梯度的方向随时间变化驱动。简单干预（重置动量）可在匹配初始位移范数后改善保留性。有限步曲率在多数情况下不主导，但在历史方向不利时可能放大损害。这些发现将优化器的内部状态与持续学习中的遗忘现象建立了直接联系，提示可通过控制梯度年龄或方向来设计更鲁棒的训练策略。

Abstract: During fine-tuning, a language model can assign less probability to previously learned answers even when the current gradient acts to preserve that probability. With momentum, each update also carries gradients computed at earlier model states, and these stored contributions can push the model in the opposite direction. We investigate how this optimiser memory contributes to forgetting by separating old-task loss into confusion among its answers and leakage of probability outside the answer set. Across three language-model families, answer mass consistently declines while discrimination among old answers usually improves: the model becomes less likely to produce answers that it can still distinguish correctly. Decomposing Adam updates reveals opposing contributions to this loss of answer mass. Over training, accumulated history favours leakage, while the current gradient opposes it. Resolving history by age shows that the harmful contributions come mainly from older gradients of the new task, whereas recent gradients tend to protect the old answers. Changes in history's effect are dominated by its orientation relative to the old-task gradient. Interventions that reset momentum while matching the initial update norm establish that stored history affects retention, with state-dependent immediate effects and lower final old-task loss over longer Adam continuations, mainly through recovered answer mass. Finally, integration along finite updates shows that most sampled large loss increases are captured by local projections, while curvature along history amplifies some events. Together, these findings reveal how an optimiser's memory can erode learned behaviour even as its current gradient acts to preserve it.

</details>


### [4] [Representational Control over Self-Report & Behavior Coherence in LLM Risk-Taking](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.04125)
*Rafal Kocielnik,Peiyang Song,Pengrui Han,Myrl G. Marmarelis,Ramit Debnath,Dean Mobbs,R. Michael Alvarez*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该论文通过激活引导（activation steering）方法，在四个开源大语言模型（Qwen2.5-7B、Llama-3.1-8B、OLMo-3-7B、Ministral-3-8B）上系统研究了风险承担（risk-taking）这一构念中自报（self-report）与行为（behavior）之间的表征关系。研究使用了9种引导向量提取方法（涵盖任务指令、模型自身选择、风险特质描述、大五人格描述四大类）、2个行为任务（CCT、BART）和2个心理测量工具（BFI-44、DOSPERT）。结果表明：表征层面的解离（dissociation）与先前的黑箱观察一致——来自特质描述的方向只能移动自报，来自模型自身选择的方向只能移动行为，仅任务指令能同时触及两者（但其行为效应主要由措辞/数量线索驱动，去除后仅保留32%）。两个通道主要由近正交的方向控制，但通过方向组合可同时或反向驱动两个通道，实现一致或反一致状态。该研究将自报-行为关系从黑箱观察推进到可被检查和控制的表征层面。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 动机：先前研究通过黑箱提示发现了LLM自报与行为之间的选择性不一致（即"解离"），但这究竟是提示伪影还是内部表征的真实情况尚不清楚。理解这一关系对于LLM作为决策代理的安全审计至关重要——如果自报不能反映行为，那么基于自报的审计方法将失去基础。论文旨在从内部表征层面诊断这一解离现象，并探索表征层面的干预能否控制两者的耦合。

Method: 方法：(1) 使用激活引导（activation steering）在残差流中注入向量，对同一内部干预在自报和行为两种情境下进行测量；(2) 提取9种引导向量，覆盖四种监督来源家族——任务指令（Task-Command/Task-Intent）、模型自身选择（Choice-Contrast/Choice-Probe）、风险特质描述（Risk-Domains/Thrill-Seeking/Risk-Persona）、大五人格描述（OCEAN-Profile/OCEAN-Composed），外加随机方向对照；(4) 在四个开源LLM、两个行为任务（CCT哥伦比亚卡片任务、BART气球类比风险任务）、两个心理测量工具（BFI-44、DOSPERT）上进行评估；(5) 通过几何分析（|cos|、家族块结构、排列检验）和去除干预（方向移除 vs 路线移除）诊断解离；(6) 通过向量组合实验测试能否实现一致或反一致状态。

Result: 结果：(1) RQ1：特质描述方向可移动自报但不移动行为（40个行为单元中无一通过控制），模型自身选择方向可移动行为但几乎不影响自报，仅任务指令能同时触及两者但效果较弱；(2) RQ2：两个通道由近正交的方向控制（家族对解释60%的|cos|变异），任务指令的行为效应中68%依赖于数量线索（去除后仅保留32%[18,47]），自报家族共享部分表征成分；(3) RQ3：对齐组合在91%的情况下产生一致状态，反向对齐组合在69-89%的情况下产生反一致状态（即报告的风险与执行的风险方向相反），但存在模型依赖的阻力（与行为方向的自报溢出相关）。

Conclusion: 结论：自报-行为之间的解离是表征层面的事实，而非提示伪影。两个通道由近正交的方向控制，几乎没有单一方向能可靠地同时移动两者。任务指令表面上的双重通道效应主要由措辞线索驱动。向量组合可以迫使模型进入自报与行为一致或反一致的状态，自报至多是行为的弱且易被篡改的信号。这推动了"机制知情的（mechanistically informed）行为审计"的发展——不仅要测试自报和行为是否一致，还要检验其是否有表征层面的因果基础。

Abstract: Self-report is an appealing low-cost probe of an LLM's dispositions, but recent work finds only selective agreement between what models report and how they behave. Prior accounts establish these patterns by prompting black-box LLMs, leaving open whether the gap is a prompting artefact or a fact about how the underlying constructs are represented internally. We investigate risk-taking, a consequential dimension of agentic decision-making, using activation steering to measure self-report and behavior under the same internal intervention. We survey nine steering-vector extraction methods spanning task-specific directives, the model's own task behavior, and dispositional descriptions at two granularities, evaluated on two behavioral tasks and two psychometric instruments across four open-weight LLMs. We find that (1) a shared internal intervention does not ensure shared responsiveness: directions built from trait descriptions move self-report but leave behavior at chance, directions built from the model's own task choices do the reverse, and only task-specific directives reach both, weakly. (2) Diagnosis dissolves that exception: removing surface confounders leaves the directives only 32% of their behavioral effect. The two channels are otherwise steered by near-orthogonal directions, each channel reachable by several independent constructions. (3) An intervention composing one behavior-moving and one self-report-moving direction moves both together; flipping one sign sets them in opposition, with reported and enacted risk pointing in opposite directions on 69-89% of flipped compositions in all models. These findings move the self-report-behavior relationship from a black-box observation to a representational one that can be inspected and controlled, motivating representational checks alongside behavioral evaluation.

</details>


### [5] [PB-GRPO: Learning Socially Adaptive LLM Agents from Persona-Driven Simulation with Preference-Batched GRPO](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.04132)
*Jingquan Wang,Jun Yin,Xu Han,Yongsheng Mei,Jie Hao,Bin Guo*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: PB-GRPO 是一种基于偏好分桶的多轮强化学习后训练算法，通过在偏好一致的用户群体内进行优势归一化，学习具有社会适应性的 LLM 智能体。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 LLM 在社交场景中往往只关注"正确性"而非"社交胜任力"。真实多轮交互数据稀缺，用户偏好是隐式的（latent），且不同用户偏好具有异质性（preference heterogeneity），导致 vanilla GRPO 的逐 prompt 归一化噪声大、REINFORCE++ 的全局归一化又混淆了不相容的偏好类型，难以稳定优化。

Method: 1) 构建个性化数据驱动的社交模拟环境（个性化库 + LLM 用户模拟器 + 用户满意度评分系统 [0,1]）。2) 提出 PB-GRPO：将 128 个个性化数据组织成 32 个偏好一致的分桶 ℬ₁,…,ℬₖ，在每个桶内估计标准化共享偏差（prompt-local 中心化 + 桶内共享尺度 σₖ），从而在偏好一致的群体内做优势归一化。3) 以 Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct 为基础策略，Claude Sonnet 4 作为用户模拟器和判官，对话级满意度作为奖励进行多轮强化学习后训练。

Abstract: Building LLMs that behave well socially, not merely correctly, requires Building LLMs that behave well socially, not merely correctly, requires more than producing locally helpful responses. Compared to vanilla GRPO, PB-GRPO computes advantages using a normalization estimated across a bucket of users with similar preferences, stabilizing training across a diverse social population. Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出Sentinel，一种基于轨迹分类器的置信度层，用于临床text-to-SQL的ReAct智能体。Sentinel通过在执行前、执行中和交付时三个检查点分析智能体的推理轨迹、SQL执行结果和输出，使用Chow规则在EHRSQL可靠性评分(RS)下优化决策，显著提升低风险场景下的可靠性，并在高风险场景下自动放弃交付，同时减少计算开销。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM智能体在临床text-to-SQL应用中自主推理多步但无法判断自身输出是否可信。高风险医疗场景下，错误代价极高，且错误的推理轨迹本身就是资源浪费（消耗计算预算却产出需丢弃的结果）。LLM的自我评估置信度往往校准不佳，且思维链可能不能真实反映最终答案的推理依据，因此需要一个不依赖智能体自身判断、基于外部可观察信号的置信度估计器。

Method: Sentinel包含两个ModernBERT-base文本分类器头：(1)可答性头(answerability head)从问题s₀开始估计问题可回答的概率，驱动执行前退出门(gate)拒绝不可回答的问题；(2)正确性头(correctness head)对轨迹前缀估计最终交付正确答案的概率，经isotonic回归校准后，用于：(a)早停(early exit)——置信度低于停阈值s_λ时中途停止；(b)交付时的Chow规则——当校准正确性估计≥τ_λ=λ/(1+λ)时才交付。三种干预点：退出门(θ阈值)、中途早停(s_λ)、交付时扣留(τ_λ)。所有阈值在calibration pool上冻结，held-out pool仅评估一次。

Result: 在EHRSQL基准上测试5个智能体模型(GPT-4o、GPT-4o-mini、Llama-3.1-8B、Qwen2.5-Coder-7B、Phi-4-mini)。低风险(λ=1)下，GPT-4o的RS从+0.08升至+0.24，交付答案准确率从54%升至69%(覆盖率从84%降至55%)，4个智能体的提升显著高于始终拒绝基线(+0.03)。高风险(λ=4,9)下系统自动几乎完全放弃交付，与始终拒绝持平，而未监控智能体得分-3.02(GPT-4o)。Chow交付规则贡献了几乎所有增益(门控仅+0.01至+0.14)。可监控性AUROC：Phi-4-mini 0.921最高(因其失败最外显)，GPT-4o 0.762最低(失败与成功难以区分)。早停在GPT-4o上节省13%(λ=1)至42%(λ=4/9)的智能体步骤，对应节省16%/47%/47%的生成token和29分钟至1.5小时总时间。

Conclusion: Sentinel证明了可靠性不必内嵌于智能体内部，可在外部附加。两个小文本分类器读取智能体转录本，配合基于效用的阈值，在低风险下提升5个text-to-SQL智能体的可靠性，在高风险下自动识别何时不应交付答案，且智能体本身完全未被修改。信号来源于轨迹(执行错误率、空结果率、错误引用等)而非问题本身或智能体的自我报告置信度——可监控性追踪的是失败的可读性而非智能体的能力。局限包括：依赖LLM judge的语义正确性标签、单一基准(EHRSQL/MIMIC-III)、每个新智能体需重新收集轨迹训练监控器，以及未来智能体失败可能更"安静"而使信号减弱。

Abstract: LLM agents for clinical text-to-SQL applications reason autonomously over multiple steps but cannot assess whether their own reasoning or outputs can be trusted. In high leverage applications such as healthcare, this presents a critical risk where system mistakes can be costly. These reliability failures are also resource failures: an incorrect reasoning trajectory spends computation budget on outputs that must be discarded. Abstract: Reinforcement fine-tuning (RFT) is increasingly used in applications where large language models (LLMs) interact with humans and other agents. However, RFT is particularly effective at improving social reading, including tasks that require agents to infer hidden roles from public discussion, update beliefs over time and predict other agents' future decisions. We further show that RFT can also improve social influence, including tasks that require agents to steer votes, team approvals and collective decisions, although these gains depend more strongly on behaviourally specific rewards and structured interaction settings. These learned behaviours also receive more favourable human evaluations of strategic competence, persuasiveness and social usefulness. Together, these results enrich our understanding of how RFT changes LLMs' social behaviour and provide a step toward a behavioural learning theory for machine social intelligence.

Abstract: Generating multiple-choice questions is increasingly scalable, but establishing their assessment quality remains difficult. We distinguish surface checks from content-sensitive judgments and map a 19-criterion rubric to detection methods and reported evidence. High label-level accuracy often coexists with weak positive case detection, while rubric definitions and reference standards vary.   <summary>Details</summary>

Abstract: Glitch tokens are anomalous vocabulary entries that can cause large language models (LLMs) to produce outputs inconsistent with their inputs. Existing repair methods require access to model internals, making them impractical for frozen checkpoints. An empirical study on BPE merge-rule deletion reveals that (1)deleting a glitch token's merge rule can fix a substantial fraction of failures, yet disrupting normal tokens sharing intermediate merge nodes causes the overall glitch rate to rise, and (2)different decomposition granularities yield non-monotonic fix rates while collateral damage on normal tokens grows monotonically. Motivated by these findings, we propose GlitchPatch, a repair framework for frozen language models based on local retokenization, consisting of two stages: the offline stage uses Behavioral Path Optimization (BPO) to find the behaviorally optimal replacement token sequence for each glitch token and compiles validated replacements into a rule table; the online stage substitutes only the IDs of matched glitch tokens in the canonical token sequence, with no modification to model parameters or internal states. Experiments on ten models spanning six tokenizer families show that GlitchPatch achieves an 85.10% mean fix rate, outperforming the strongest baseline by 14.37 percentage points, and reduces the average glitch rate from 14.88% to 2.27%. GlitchPatch achieves a 0.00% RR in full-vocabulary evaluation and leaves rule-unmatched inputs unchanged by design. We further evaluate the practical impact of repair from the perspectives of time cost, language understanding, and capability, supporting its deployment feasibility. We hope this work provides a practical option for improving tokenizer reliability.

  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自回归 LLM 解码受限于注意力机制的内存与计算开销。现有稀疏注意力方法虽减少了概率-值乘法的成本，但使查询-键（QK）乘法成为新瓶颈。论文观察到 Key 头数量可以被削减以加速 QK 步骤，而保留更多 Value 头仅带来极小的额外解码开销，从而在稀疏解码场景下存在显著的头数不对称性。

Method: 1. Atop-N 注意力：使用每 n=32 步校准一次的概率空间阈值，通过并行比较操作识别超过阈值的注意力条目，避免昂贵的全排序；同时在 logit 空间施加 softmax 加速。

3. GQA→SAGA 转换：(a) 基于注意力 logit 重建误差构建加权完全图，通过最小权完美匹配选择配对策略（闭式解），并对 Q/V/O 投影施加诱导排列；(b) 短时知识蒸馏（KL 散度 + 硬标签 CE，约 23K 步）恢复质量。

Result: - 在 Llama 3.2-1B (h_k: 8→4) 与 Qwen2.5-1.5B (h_k: 2→1) 上，128K 上下文下 SAGA+Atop-N 实现 2.1–2.6× 端到端解码加速，超越全注意力 GQA 基线。

TL;DR: 本文揭示了测试时训练（TTT）中自生成反馈的内在不稳定性。当模型从自身输出学习时，$M_0 \xrightarrow{\text{generate}} x_t \xrightarrow{\text{learn}} M_t \xrightarrow{\text{generate}} x_{t+1}$ 形成闭环，导致长序列中独立真实文本预测性能显著下降。通过三个匹配对照实验（Fixed Generation、Recorded Replay、Paired One-Update）进行因果分解，定位故障源于反馈环路而非生成内容本身或参数漂移。提出 Settlement 机制：在提交更新前在独立真实文本上验证候选状态，保留真实文本适应能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长上下文语言模型中的测试时训练（TTT）利用快速权重存储信息，但当模型从自身输出学习时，每个更新既改变后续生成内容又改变后续训练目标，形成反馈环路。这种自生成反馈在长序列（128K tokens）中导致独立真实文本预测性能急剧恶化，跨 TTT-E3E（125M/760M/3B）及 Qwen3-4B + Adam 均观察到该现象，亟需系统性诊断与解决方案。

Method: 采用三组匹配对照实验进行因果分解：（1）Fixed Generation — 切断反馈（冻结生成器但保留学习），消除98%+损伤；（2）Recorded Replay — 在相同退化文本上分离注意力读取与权重写入的代价；（3）Paired One-Update — 从相同状态分支，比较保留/丢弃单次更新的影响。此外，引入 Settlement 机制：创建临时候选状态 $W+\delta$ 在独立真实文本 $q$ 上评估 $A(\delta;W,q) = L(q;W) - L(q;W+\delta)$，仅当 $A \geq 0$ 时提交。梯度余弦与一阶预测可作为预筛选信号。

Result: 闭环自生成写入使独立真实文本 NLL 在 125M/760M/3B 模型上分别恶化 3.01/6.00/0.40 nats（Double Loop），Qwen3-4B+Adam (10⁻⁴) 恶化 1.231 nats。Fixed Generation 消除 98.3%/98.8% 损伤。损伤高度集中：72个配对中仅12例（来自4/24源序列）超过0.5 nats，少数轨迹驱动大部分失败。梯度冲突信号与实际伤害高度相关（$\rho$ 达 -0.788/+0.794）。Settlement 在 125M/760M 上将终验差距降至 0.07/-0.02 nats，同时保留真实文本适应（接受89/113真实候选，NLL 改善0.0534 nats）。WebShop 任务成功率从 Closed Loop 的 0.1053 提升至 Settlement 的 0.1853（固定生成为0.1800），ALFWorld 未见任务成功率从27.6%-59.5%（Closed Loop）恢复至88.1%-94.0%。

Conclusion: TTT 中的自生成反馈是性能崩溃的因果根源，而非生成内容或参数漂移所致。损伤通过少数"污染"源序列放大，而非均匀恶化。源适应（降低源 NLL）不能保证迁移到独立证据。解决方案需基于独立真实文本验证完整候选状态（包括合并的并行更新），而非仅依赖来源标签或重复惩罚。Settlement 在模型预测任务（WebShop）和代理任务（ALFWorld）中均有效，为 TTT 在长序列与代理场景的安全部署提供了实用准则。

Abstract: Test-time training (TTT) lets a model store information in its weights during inference. When the model learns from its own output, however, each update also changes the model that generates the next training example. Across 128K-token streams, retaining generated-text updates worsens prediction on independent human-written text with three TTT-E2E model configurations (labeled 125M, 760M, and 3B). Recorded Replay separates the loss caused by reading degraded text from the additional loss stored by updating on it. A paired one-update comparison then shows the local conflict: an update predicts its source better but new real text worse. This cost grows after Closed Loop adaptation, with a few trajectories accounting for most large failures. Finally, Settlement evaluates the candidate state on independent real text before commitment. It leaves mean endpoint gaps of 0.07 and -0.02 nats at 125M and 760M while retaining real-text adaptation. These results motivate checking prediction on independent evidence before retaining an update.

</details>

JSON结构探针显示方向反转：AVOID合规性最高（20.6% vs POS 13.1%）。7. 人类验证显示所有形式均获≥90%的精确字数判定，但模型行为差异显著。

  <summary>Details</summary>

The results motivate task-specific evaluation of cultural-domain applications rather than reliance on aggregate knowledge scores. Abstract: Domain adaptation aims to turn a general-purpose large language model (LLM) into an expert for a target domain. These limitations motivate RL-only adaptation. However, pure on-policy RL suffers from a cold-start problem, while mixed-policy RL still falls short: informative tokens in teacher outputs are learned too slowly in early training, and stale teacher outputs can hinder later improvement. To address them, we propose One-stage Policy Optimization (OnePO), which treats teacher outputs as transient guidance for policy improvement. *Tamara Czinczoll,Julie Kallini,Gerard de Melo,Chen Shani*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出了LightMTP（轻量级潜在多Token预测），一种参数高效的预训练目标。它通过一个小型MLP头从模型自身的中间层隐状态预测未来位置的隐状态，无需词表投影或外部辅助模型，仅增加最多1%的参数即可在保留通用语言建模性能的同时显著提升规划、代码生成和推理能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准下一Token预测（NTP）只对紧邻的下一Token提供显式监督信号，可能导致模型过度利用局部模式而忽略更长程结构。现有MTP方法要么引入大量额外参数，要么依赖外部辅助模型（如反向语言模型、自编码器）来提供未来Token的编码，存在效率与依赖性问题。此外，在小于3B参数规模下，token级MTP往往损害通用语言建模性能。

Method: LightMTP在共享Transformer主干上附加一个小型MLP头 g_φ，读取第L层隐状态 h_t^L，预测未来k步位置在某一中间层l的stop-gradient隐状态 h_{t+k}^l。提出两种变体：(1) LightMTP-S（单目标）仅预测k步后的单一隐状态；(2) LightMTP-C（拼接目标）通过单一头部调用同时预测k个未来位置的隐状态（拼接输出后切片）。采用余弦损失函数，并通过可选的方差正则化（VarReg）防止目标层表示坍缩为单一方向。训练时头部在推理阶段丢弃，不改变推理路径。

Result: 在1.4–1.5B参数规模下，LightMTP仅增加≤1%参数（LightMTP-S为0.3%，LightMTP-C为0.9%）。在通用语言建模基准（FineWeb-Edu、LAMBADA、CORE）上几乎无退化（部分情况下甚至优于NTP），而token级MTP基线（Meta、Meta-L、DeepSeek）则一致退化。在Countdown规划任务上，两种LightMTP变体均显著优于NTP（提升最高达10点），且LightMTP-S以仅1.2M参数逼近Meta-L使用75M参数的最佳成绩。在GSM8K推理和MBPP代码生成上，LightMTP遵循输出格式更稳定、结构错误更少。提出的"预测代价"指标显示LightMTP变体在预测未来Token与保留NTP性能之间取得最佳平衡。

Conclusion: LightMTP是首个无需外部辅助模型、参数开销极小（≤1%）的潜在多Token预测方法，在小规模模型（<3B）上同时实现了更强的未来Token预测能力和更优的规划/推理/代码生成性能，同时不损害通用语言建模能力，是token级MTP的实际可行替代方案。

Abstract: Next-token prediction (NTP) is the standard pretraining objective for large language models, yet it provides an explicit training signal only for the immediate next token, which can lead models to exploit local patterns instead of capturing longer-range structure and ideas. Multi-token prediction (MTP) addresses this by training models to predict several future tokens. However, existing MTP methods often introduce a large number of new parameters with limited improvements in downstream performance. Latent MTP approaches address this efficiency issue by encoding future tokens into a vector representation. However, these approaches usually rely on external helper models for future token encoding. We propose LightMTP, a lightweight, i.e., parameter-efficient, latent MTP approach that bootstraps the future token representations from the model's own hidden states. Our two LightMTP variants extend supervision to more future tokens without requiring the additional computational overhead of conventional MTP nor the external supervision latent MTP normally relies on. LightMTP adds at most 1% extra parameters, retains better performance on general language modeling benchmarks, and achieves similar gains in planning, coding, and reasoning.

### [28] [Cross-Lingual Transferability of Training Data Extraction Attacks to Recover Memorized PII](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06093)

TL;DR: 该论文研究了大型语言模型(LLMs)在跨语言场景下对训练数据提取(TDE)攻击的脆弱性。研究发现,即使PII仅以英文形式存在于训练数据中,通过意大利语、西班牙语、法语和德语等非英语提示也能成功提取这些信息。多语言模型的跨语言泄露更显著,这是由中间层中形成的"跨语言桥梁"所驱动,这种桥梁与内容保真度相关联。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有研究通常将模型记忆视为单语言现象,假设攻击者使用与被记忆内容相同的语言进行查询。然而,对于大规模部署的多语言LLMs,这一假设存在重大盲点。如果用某语言记忆的数据能被另一种语言提示提取,则仅评估源语言的隐私保护会系统性低估真实风险。论文旨在探究TDE攻击是否能跨语言迁移及其背后的机制。

Method: 研究构建了包含邮件地址、电话号码和Twitter用户名三种PII类型的多领域数据集,基于Pile-CC的英文样本翻译为法语、德语、意大利语和西班牙语。实验测试了七种模型(英语中心型:GPT-Neo 1.3B/2.7B、GPT-J 6B;多语言型:Llama 3.2 1B/3B、Qwen2.5 3B/7B)。方法包括:1)对200个翻译样本进行网络存在性检查以确认翻译内容未出现在训练集中;3)使用严格翻译、英文释义和目标语言释义三种变体来分离语言变化和措辞保真度的影响;4)通过提取每层隐藏状态的余弦相似度来分析表征层面的"跨语言桥梁"。

Result: 主要结果包括:1)网络检查证实翻译内容在训练前不存在于互联网上;2)TDE攻击在所有测试的七种模型和四种非英语语言中均能成功迁移,多语言模型保留高达89.8%的Twitter用户名泄露率,69.2%的邮件地址泄露率;3)严格翻译比释义更有效,英文释义又比跨语言释义更有效;5)余弦相似度分析显示表征层面的"跨语言桥梁"位于Transformer的中间层,最强对齐出现在中间层;4)跨语言泄露强度与模型的多语言训练程度成正比,与参数量无关;6)德语电话号码是例外情况,可能是由于翻译质量或德语的语言特殊性导致。

Conclusion: 论文首次直接证明了从英文训练数据记忆的PII可通过其他语言表述的攻击进行恢复。这种迁移由真正的"内容锚定跨语言桥梁"驱动,其强度与模型的多语言训练程度成正比,而非与参数量成正比。该研究揭示了现代LLMs的基本安全缺陷,呼吁采用更具鲁棒性的、语言无关的隐私保护策略,提示从业者单语言隐私评估对多语言模型而言并不足够,提示隐私评估、审计和缓解措施应被视为固有的跨语言问题。研究还提出未来工作方向,包括将该方法扩展到低资源语言和类型学上不同的语言,以及对越狱攻击进行类似的分析。

Abstract: The robustness of Personally Identifiable Information (PII) protection in Large Language Models (LLMs) is a critical concern, yet the risks associated with cross-lingual data extraction remain under-explored. This study evaluates the vulnerability of English-centric and multilingual models to Training Data Extraction (TDE) attacks when prompted in non-English languages. We construct a multi-domain PII dataset comprising social media handles, email addresses, and phone numbers and translate the attack contexts into Italian, Spanish, French, and German. Our results show that TDE attacks against both English-centric and multilingual models transfer to different languages: the attacks are successful on translated prompts, even though only the original English prompt might have been included in the pre-training data. A web-presence check on a sample of the translations confirms that they are not available online. The share of English leaks recovered in other languages grows with the multilingual capability of the model, and it drops sharply when the original wording is lost, even without a change of language. This suggests that native multilingual pre-training facilitates the emergence of latent cross-linguistic bridges that simplify the retrieval of personally identifiable information (PII). We analyze the activations of multilingual large language models (LLMs) and find that different translations of the same prompt are bridged in similar representations, with the strongest alignment in the middle layers. Our results highlight a fundamental security gap in modern LLMs, necessitating more robust, language-agnostic sanitization strategies for future model alignment.

  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有研究表明LLM的隐藏激活包含响应正确性信息，可用于成本感知的模型路由。然而先前工作主要在英语输入上验证，未明确这些探针在跨语言场景下的可靠性，以及其估计值是否足够可比以支持多语言路由。

3. 对每个模型-问题-语言组合采样5次响应，提取残差流激活
4. 训练逐层岭回归探针，对比(a)仅英语监督、(b)等预算池化多语言监督、(c)同语言Oracle参考
5. 通过判别力（AUROC）、校准（ECE、Brier、NLL）和路由效用三个递进维度评估
6. 采用Encoder-Target Decoupled（ETD）路由框架，Qwen3-4B作为共享编码器

Result: 1. 跨语言判别力：英语训练的探针迁移到非英语语言后保留较好的判别力（平均AUROC 0.697），池化多语言监督进一步提升至0.724
2. 校准能力：英语训练探针迁移后校准显著退化（ECE比Oracle差197%），池化监督将ECE降低38-69%，Brier分数从0.171降至0.154
3. 路由效果：池化路由器达到86.6%测试成功率，比gpt-oss-high基线节省13%成本；锚点匹配设置下节省22.9%成本

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM作为辅导教师存在"协助困境"（Assistance Dilemma）：倾向于直接给出答案而非引导学生思考。现有基于RL的方法（如TutorRL）在原题上测试学生，并需要手动调节泄漏惩罚以平衡学习收益，存在优化方向矛盾的问题。本文旨在设计一种无需精细调节惩罚项即可让RL奖励天然倾向于"教学而非告知"的训练范式。

Abstract: A model under pushback can correct itself, capitulate, or hold, and one flip rate counts a correction and a capitulation alike. TL;DR: 本文分析循环-注意力混合语言模型中两条记忆通路（注意力层与循环层）的使用不平衡问题，发现标准监督微调（SFT）会进一步加剧模型对注意力通路的依赖，而忽视循环通路。为此提出一种辅助损失，通过在前向传播中屏蔽注意力对过去上下文的访问，迫使信息仅通过循环状态传播，从而促使模型更均衡地利用两条记忆通路。该方法在问答和智能体任务上均带来显著性能提升，并在多种架构间具有泛化性。

  <summary>Details</summary>

Abstract: Recurrent-attention hybrid language models (LMs), which interleave attention and recurrent layers, are increasingly used to combine the efficiency of the recurrent layers with the strong performance of attention layers. However, we observe that simply having access to both pathways does not mean that hybrid LMs are effectively using them. We find that they rely substantially more on attention than on the recurrent state. Standard supervised fine-tuning improves overall performance but does not improve how the two memory pathways are coordinated: the model becomes more reliant on information propagated by attention layers, while its use of information propagated by recurrent layers remains limited. To encourage better coordination between the two memory pathways, we add an auxiliary loss that limits attention's access to earlier context while the recurrent state propagates through the full sequence. This objective encourages the model to retain and use information through the recurrent pathway alongside attention. It improves overall performance, with particularly strong gains on tasks involving longer contexts or requiring information aggregation, consistent with the strengths of recurrent layers observed in analysis. Crucially, this imbalance and the benefit of our auxiliary loss generalize: they apply to multiple recurrent-attention LMs in question-answering and agentic tasks, as well as to attention-based LMs that combine different forms of memory. Together, our findings show that simply providing multiple memory pathways does not ensure their effective use, and that targeted supervision is needed to better coordinate them.

Abstract: While modern AI detectors identify who wrote the words, emerging policies on AI use increasingly hinge on a different question: who came up with the ideas?   <summary>Details</summary>

On Online Mind2Web, without training an agent on the benchmark, translating the certified question bank improves a live-web agent in zero-shot evaluation.   <summary>Details</summary>

Result: 在五个多模态智能体记忆基准（Mem-Gallery、WorldMemArena、H2HMem、MemEye、MemLens）上的实验表明，MemPilot在不同优化偏好下均实现了有利的性能-成本-延迟权衡。偏好扫描产生的前沿比现有权衡感知基线更宽。MemPilot-Perf在两个答案模型下均取得最佳L-J分数；MemPilot-Bal提供平衡的操作点；MemPilot-Cost以更大质量牺牲换取更低资源消耗。消融实验验证了LLM/VLM委托、边际效用、检索-指令解耦和目标优势解耦四个核心组件的必要性，且与不同上游记忆库（默认LLMLingua-2、SimpleMem、A-MEM）兼容。

Conclusion: MemPilot提供了一个系统性的偏好感知运行时记忆编排框架，联合控制记忆访问、查询特定整理、异构模型委托和视觉证据使用，无需依赖固定的处理流水线或预算层级。通过引入目标维度优势解耦和基于前缀的边际效用估计，实现了在竞争目标下的稳定多目标优化。该工作推动了智能体记忆系统从纯性能优化向资源感知运行时适应的转变。

Abstract: Memory has become integral to the LLM agent ecosystem, supporting information retention and reuse across interactions. However, most existing agent memory systems construct memory in a query-agnostic manner, which can incur unnecessary preprocessing cost and discard details that later prove essential. Recent studies have begun shifting memory processing toward runtime adaptation, but typically specialize in particular operations or fixed processing schemes, leaving flexible control over performance, cost, and latency largely underexplored. To address this challenge, we present \textbf{MemPilot}, a flexible framework that orchestrates on-demand memory curation under different performance--cost--latency preferences. Specifically, we optimize a multi-step LLM policy via reinforcement learning to iteratively choose between retrieving from query-agnostic memory and delegating query-specific curation of raw multimodal history to heterogeneous LLMs and VLMs. The policy jointly controls evidence amount, curation instructions, model selection, and visual access, enabling fine-grained allocation of runtime computation. To optimize this policy under competing objectives, we adapt objective-wise advantage decoupling by separately estimating each objective's advantage before aggregation. <details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基准测试排名中方法论关注几乎全部集中于系统输出端，而参考答案被视为数据集的固定属性。然而参考答案本身是标注流程的产物——不同的冲突解决规则会产生不同的参考答案，如果得分对该选择敏感，则榜单排名反映的不仅是系统能力，也是标注流程的属性。作者旨在揭示并量化这一参考敏感性。

  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前语言模型在长文本读取上存在三大结构性限制：（1）注意力成本随输入长度呈二次增长；（2）受限于上下文窗口长度；（3）即使在窗口内，准确性也会随输入长度增加而下降。现有三种应对方案（扩展窗口、读取更少内容、分块读取）各有局限：扩展窗口保持二次成本和单次读取的整体内存；预选内容（如检索器）可能遗漏关键证据；分块读取丢失跨块信息或依赖有损摘要链。核心动机在于：当长文本读取本质上是关于有限答案集的决策时，可以将其分解。

Method: Periscope 将文本分为 N 个块（每块 c 个 token），排列在 K×K 网格上（K=⌈√N⌉）。对每个答案类别进行 2K 次探测：K 个局部探测读取 K 个连续块的序列，K 个跨步探测每隔 K 个块采样整个文本。每个探测通过单次前向传播在第一个答案 token 处读取 log-odds。答案得分由最佳局部得分与最佳跨步得分相加组成。每个块通过其所在局部和跨步跨度的得分获得证据图 M[i,j]，无需额外调用。该图支持四种固定读出：（1）排序（对文档相关性）；（2）直接回答（无额外调用）；（3）定位（峰值即证据块）；（4）选定读取（读取图中得分最高的 K 个块进行二次调用）。

Result: 在 LongBench v2 上，仅读取 Periscope 排名最高的 K 个块（约 9k token），即匹配 Qwen3.5-4B 在 32k 到 1M 各种窗口下的最佳窗口读取（41.9%），且 KV 缓存仅为单次读取的三到五分之一。在 InfiniteBench En.MC（上下文长度中位数 150k token）上，27B 模型的直接读出比最佳窗口读取（262k）领先 5 个百分点。在 BRIGHT 长文档检索中，仅使用相关性读出即获得六种方法中最佳的 NDCG@10（0.493）。27B 模型可在单张 A100 80GB GPU 上读取 4.5M token 上下文，而单次读取需要 296GB 缓存。消融实验表明跨步探测贡献了全局视图，加入后 BRIGHT NDCG@10 从 .551 提升至 .637。与 Chain of Agents 相比，Periscope 准确率高 10 个点，延迟仅为三分之一。限制：对开域输出不适用，多文档 QA 落后于窗口读取，低于成本交叉点时计算量大于单次读取。

Conclusion: Periscope 证明了当长文本读取本质上是决策时，可以对其进行分解。通过 2K 次有界、独立的局部和跨步探测，使用窗口为 W 的冻结模型即可读取长达 W²/c 的文本，且每次调用缓存仅为单个探测大小。证据图作为副产品出现，无需额外计算，并支持排序、回答、定位和短读取四种固定读出。核心结论是：长文本读取的硬件需求由模型权重而非文本长度决定——只要模型能装入 GPU，即可读取远超该 GPU 单次缓存容量的文本。

Abstract: A language model reads long text in one quadratic forward pass, stops at the context window, and loses accuracy with length before reaching it. We ask whether the read can be factorized when deciding over a finite set: which document is relevant, which option is supported, which passage is the evidence. Periscope, a training-free inference method, arranges the $N$ chunks of a text on a $K{\times}K$ grid with $K{=}\lceil\sqrt{N}\rceil$ and asks a frozen model the same question about $K$ local spans of consecutive chunks and $K$ strided spans that sample the whole text, reading the log-odds of every answer at one token. Each answer takes its best local and strided score, and scoring every chunk by its two spans gives an evidence map at no further cost, whose peak is the chunk behind the answer. Every probe is about $\sqrt{sc}$ tokens for a text of $s$ tokens and chunk size $c$, so a window of $W$ tokens reaches $W^{2}/c$ tokens at $s^{1.5}$ cost. The map replaces the long read. On LongBench v2, reading only the $K$ chunks the map ranks highest, 9k tokens, matches the same model's best window read across windows from 32k to 1M tokens, and on InfiniteBench, where the median context is 150k tokens, it leads the best window read by 5 points. The same map ranks BRIGHT's long-document corpora with the best NDCG@10 of six methods. Each call caches only one probe, so a 27B model reads 4.5M-token contexts on one 80GB GPU, where a single pass would need 296GB of cache. A long read then needs a GPU that holds the model, not one that holds the text.

We find that models often process semantically equivalent inputs substantially differently, affecting both learning and generalization. Overall, our results show that auxiliary supervision in model-compatible representations can enable effective adaptation in structured domains.

Result: 在9个模型的720个案例上有限差分验证的坐标方向一致率达98.0%；21个模型上的ablate/steer/swap干预能按预测方向改变目标token概率；Joint模块DV-Complexity与48模型基准能力排名Spearman相关系数为0.904，且在完全基准暴露后排名基本保持稳定。

Abstract: Understanding parameter functions helps elucidate the internal mechanisms of large language models (LLMs). However, how to connect parameters from different modules to verifiable output effects and further characterize the relationship between their functional organization and model capability remains to be explored. At the model level, the joint-parameter score of DV-Complexity achieves a Spearman correlation of 0.904 with benchmark-based capability rankings across 48 language models. Together, these results provide intervention-based evidence for DV-Lens interpretations and reveal an association between DV-Complexity and model capability.

  <summary>Details</summary>

Result: 主要结果:(1) H1确认——所有检测器迁移间隙≥0.15 AUROC,跨语言尤其差(归因一致性降至0.48);(2) H2a被证伪——种子重复分解显示>80%不稳定性源自随机种子而非分布偏移(移位可归因IVR仅0.050-0.074,远低于预设的0.25);(3) H3/H4未被支持——SIFT单种子MFS 0.72 vs基线0.67(优势0.05),但四检测器集成达0.71(优势缩至0.01, p=0.21),且需要51%弃权率;(4) 跨模型迁移层级:族内>跨族开源>开源到API;(5) 多模型训练(3-4个模型)将迁移AUROC从0.58提升至0.65;(6) 因果分解:约50%优势来自集成,37.5%来自不变性训练,仅12.5%来自架构创新。

Conclusion: 本文核心定位为"审计审计者"框架而非突破性检测器:真正障碍是检测器方差而非分布偏移。诚实结论是SIFT展示了不变性训练可降低随机不稳定性,但在匹配覆盖度下与简单多种子集成无统计差异。实践建议:执行种子重复分析、集成3-4个种子、采用多模型训练、视判定为暂定直至二阶鲁棒性得到验证。语义和词汇变化(而非表面特征如长度)是检测器不稳定的主要驱动因素。

Abstract: Chain-of-Thought (CoT) faithfulness detectors are widely used to audit reasoning models, yet a detector is itself a predictor whose verdicts are treated as stable properties. We ask whether a detector is faithful to itself under distribution shift. We formalize meta-faithfulness as an invariance principle: a valid detector must return identical verdicts on traces that differ only by transformations preserving ground-truth faithfulness. We prove three results: (i) no detector using only intervention-response profiles can separate faithful from epiphenomenal mechanisms with identical signatures; (ii) any detector relying on shift-sensitive features violates invariance at a rate independent of its in-distribution accuracy; (iii) an asymptotic certified selective-risk guarantee enables confident abstention. We operationalize the principle in FaithShift, a stress-test protocol spanning ten shift axes, and propose SIFT, a hidden-state trajectory detector trained with cross-environment invariance objectives and certified abstention. Across 14,996 traces, four domains, and eight models, three findings emerge. First, transfer collapse is real: all existing detectors show gaps $\geq 0.15$ AUROC. Second, the dominant bottleneck is sampling stochasticity, not shift: over 80% of detector instability stems from random seed variation, falsifying our preregistered prediction that shift-attributable violations exceed 0.25. Third, SIFT cuts invariance violations by 64% over the best single-seed baseline, but a four-seed ensemble of any detector narrows the margin to 0.01 (indistinguishable at matched coverage, $p=0.21$), and SIFT needs a 51% abstention rate. Cross-model transfer degrades from within-family to cross-family to open-weight-to-API, partly closed by multi-model training. We offer a framework for auditing auditors: the real barrier is detector variance, not distribution shift.

Abstract: Increasing architectural complexity is often assumed to improve health misinformation detection, yet reported gains are difficult to interpret when studies use different corpora, preprocessing pipelines, data splits, and leakage controls. ### [50] [vMF Sentence LDA: A Spherical Topic Model over Sentence Embeddings](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05095)
*Ryotaro Kobayashi,Yuri Murayama,Kiyoshi Izumi*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出 vMF Sentence LDA (vSLDA)，一种将 LDA 的混合结构与句子嵌入相结合的球面主题模型。该模型将每个句子视为 L2 归一化嵌入，并用 von Mises-Fisher (vMF) 分布建模每个主题。在两个语料库（20 Newsgroups 和 NYT）上，vSLDA 在细粒度分类任务中优于八种基线模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统 LDA 基于词袋假设，无法利用词与词之间的语义相似性。现有研究通过引入词嵌入（如 GTLR44 LDA）来捕捉语义信息，但尚未有研究将这一思想扩展到句子级别的嵌入，同时保持 LDA 仍然无法使用的sentence embedding 机制。此外，全协方差高斯分布在高维嵌入空间中存在计算成本高、协方差估计不稳定等问题。

Method: vSLDA 保留了 LDA 的文档-主题混合结构，将观察单元从单词改为句子。每个句子由预训练句子编码器编码为 L2 归一化嵌入。每个主题由一个 vMF 分布建模，其均值为方向向量 μ_k，参数为浓度参数 κ_k。文档-主题分布 θ_d 从狄利克雷分布中采样，句子-主题分配 z_di 从多项分布中采样。参数通过随机近似 EM（SAEM）算法估计，使用马尔可夫链 E 步。vMF 分布的使用使得每主题参数数量和每次迭代成本与嵌入维度 M 呈线性关系，而非全协方差高斯分布的二次方关系。

Result: 在 20 Newsgroups 和 NYT 两个语料库上，vSLDA 在 30 个实验条件中的 27 个中获得了最佳的细粒度分类准确率。vSLDA 的优势随着主题数量的增加而扩大，在整个语料库上，从 K=100 开始持续优于所有基线。vSLDA 在主题质量（一致性与多样性的乘积）上也领先大多数条件。此外，分析表明 GSLDA 的劣势主要源于其协方差结构：当各维度匹配缺血（即观测数量相对于嵌入维度不足）时，全协方差高斯分布会面临 predictive 性能下降的问题。相比之下，各向同性高斯重拟合（最接近 vMF 似然的形式）可达到与 vSLDA 相当的准确率。

Conclusion: vSLDA 是一种实用的句子嵌入主题模型，将预训练句子编码器的嵌入与 LDA 的文档-主题混合结构相结合。该模型在主题共享大量词汇的场景中表现出优势，例如当文档集合广泛涉及一个主题及其子主题时。vSLDA 适用于需要从语义角度子主题集合的应用场景，并提供了一个有前景的未来研究方向。

Abstract: Latent Dirichlet Allocation (LDA) and models derived from it remain widely used topic models. LDA observes each document as a bag-of-words and models each topic by a categorical distribution over the vocabulary, so that it uses neither the internal structure of the document nor the similarity in meaning between words. Earlier work has responded to this limitation in two ways: many models have introduced embeddings, and some have assigned topics to sentences rather than to words. Their combination, a topic model that observes sentence embeddings, remains little explored. We propose vMF Sentence LDA (vSLDA), which keeps the admixture structure of LDA, observes each sentence as its L2-normalized embedding and models each topic by a von Mises-Fisher (vMF) distribution, which matches the cosine geometry of sentence embeddings. Its per-topic parameter count and per-iteration cost are linear in the embedding dimension, versus quadratic for the full-covariance Gaussian distribution in the existing model over sentence embeddings. We evaluate vSLDA where the limitation is expected to matter most, among topics that share much of their vocabulary: the topics that subdivide the one subject of a collection, and the narrow topics that result when a corpus is divided into a large number of topics. On two corpora, vSLDA attains the best mean rank against eight baselines when the fine categories within each coarse category are classified from the document-topic distributions. On the whole corpus, its advantage appears or widens as the number of topics grows. Weighting the word frequencies of each sentence by its topic posterior yields expected topic-word counts of the same form as those of LDA, so that the standard topic coherence and diversity measures apply to models that assign topics to sentences. On their product, topic quality, vSLDA leads in most within-category conditions of both corpora.

</details>

*Hsin-Ling Hsu,Min-Yu Chen,Nai-Chia Chen,Yan-Ru Chen,Yi-Ling Chang,Fang Yu*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: FORGE是一个针对生成式大语言模型的定向行为修复框架，通过解耦缺陷定位、权重编辑和行为验证三个阶段，将原本限于分类或知识编辑任务的修复范式（约束优化和零空间投影）引入生成式LLM的偏见与毒性修复。核心创新在于"候选分类桥接"机制，将局部化的有毒生成转化为可被不同编辑后端消费的优化目标。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生成式LLM从预训练中继承了人口统计偏见和毒性生成等不良行为，这些缺陷仅在部署后出现且仅影响少数输入。现有的三类权重级修复方法各有根本局限：梯度微调缺乏逐样本保证且在少量缺陷样本下不稳定；模型编辑假设显式的知识替换而非行为纠正；约束优化修复基本仅限于具有唯一目标输出的判别模型。迫切需要一个能同时保证逐实例正确性、行为保留和缺陷消除的框架。

Method: 1) **三阶段解耦架构**：定位（前缀毒性扫描+留一法归因）→ 编辑（可插拔后端）→ 验证（试验-提交-回滚）。2) **候选分类桥接机制**：在定位位置将top-K候选按实际毒性分为抑制集𝒯⁻和可接受集𝒯⁺，将行为缺陷转化为明确的修复目标。3) **两个后端实例**：FORGE-QP在lm_head上做低秩约束二次优化（秩r=4），提供精确逐样本边界证书；FORGE-NS在中后层MLP做零空间投影编辑，提供分布级隐式保护。4) **四级约束系统**：抑制约束+局部/全局/跨样本保留约束。

Result: 在5个开源LLM（GPT-2、Llama-3.2-1B/3B、Qwen2.5-1.5B/3B）上：1) **偏见抑制70.4%–99.5%，毒性抑制70.5%–93.7%**，PPL代价仅≤21%；2) **远超梯度基线**：Full FT虽能大幅降偏见但PPL暴涨407%–29620%，LoRA在Llama-1B上甚至出现偏见上升；3) **架构互补**：FORGE-NS在Llama/GPT-2领先（+94.1%–99.5%），FORGE-QP在Qwen领先（+87.9%），因果探针证实这与毒性信号在不同架构中的集中层深相关；4) **低资源稳定性**：训练集从1到42样本扫描时，两种FORGE后端均稳定收敛，而LoRA和Full FT持续震荡；5) **优于注意力剪枝**：在GPT-2上FORGE-NS偏见抑制+94.1% vs AP的+73.9%，PPL代价仅+3.1% vs +19.2%；6) **QP可行性高**：所有配置下每个修复样本都能找到可行解，平均每次样本1.89次求解，94.1%通过验证。

Conclusion: FORGE是首个将生成式LLM的行为修复分解为定位-编辑-验证的解耦框架，其核心贡献是"候选分类桥接"机制，使原本限于分类的约束优化和限于知识替换的模型编辑都能在生成任务上运行。框架提供两层保证：后端无关的框架级行为证书（每次提交保证句级毒性不增）和QP后端的精确逐样本边界证书。两个后端在5个LLM上均稳定优于梯度微调和剪枝方法，其跨架构的互补性能可通过毒性信号集中层深的因果探针解释，且在极少缺陷样本下保持稳定修复，为实际部署中的快速缺陷修复提供了可靠路径。未来方向包括扩展对同类型缺陷的验证覆盖、自动架构感知的后端选择，以及将验证式可追溯修复推广到偏见与毒性之外的行为缺陷。

Abstract: Generative large language models (LLMs) inherit undesirable behaviors from pre-training, including demographic bias and toxic generation, that often emerge only after deployment and affect a small subset of inputs. A repair should eliminate the identified defect, preserve the model's overall functionality and, ideally, provide correctness guarantees. Existing approaches address this only partially: gradient-based fine-tuning lacks per-instance guarantees and becomes unstable with few defect samples; model editing assumes explicit knowledge replacement rather than behavioral correction; and constraint-based repair is largely restricted to discriminative models with unique target outputs. We present FORGE, a framework for targeted behavioral repair of generative language models that separates defect localization, weight editing, and behavioral verification into independent stages. Its core is a repair abstraction that converts localized defective generation into explicit optimization objectives, enabling verification-oriented repair techniques to operate on autoregressive generation. FORGE is editing-mechanism agnostic: we instantiate it with (1) a constraint-based quadratic optimization method that provides per-sample repair certificates and (2) a null-space projection editor that minimizes interference with the original model distribution, both under the same localization and verification protocol. On five open-source LLMs, FORGE consistently achieves larger reductions in bias and toxicity than gradient-based fine-tuning with minor perplexity degradation. The two backends exhibit complementary performance across architectures, which a lightweight causal probe traces to where toxicity-related signals concentrate. FORGE also remains effective with only a handful of defective examples, where conventional fine-tuning often oscillates or fails to converge.

</details>


### [52] [Lend Me Your Eyes: Instruction-Aware Text Embeddings via Attention Relay](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05564)
*Yiyuan Luo,Vaggos Chatziafratis*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种无需训练的方法"Attention Relay"，通过将指令调优LLM在回答位置上的注意力权重传递给指令无关的嵌入模型的池化过程，使后者获得指令感知能力。该方法在6个LLM和10个嵌入模型的几乎所有组合上均有效。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前指令感知嵌入模型需要大量指令配对的对比学习数据训练，而指令调优LLM天然具备指令跟随能力但其隐藏状态并非为相似度比较而设计。两种模型存在互补性：LLM知道文本的哪些部分与问题相关，而嵌入模型知道如何表征这些部分。本文旨在探索能否将LLM的指令跟随能力无需训练地传递给嵌入模型。

Method: 核心方法Attention Relay包含三个步骤：(1) 在LLM的"回答位置"（最后一个token）提取跨头求和并归一化的注意力权重作为"阅读权重"；(2) 通过字符级映射将LLM分词权重传递到嵌入模型的分词空间；(3) 将LLM的权重与嵌入模型自身池化权重相乘（r'_i ∝ r_i · ŵ_i^β），其中β=1。文中还推导了等价的logit偏置形式（含质量保持偏置和平坦偏置两种变体），并通过等式5中的常数c保持每个注意力头在文本上的注意力质量不变。

Result: 在NYT、IntentEmotion、FewRel、FewNerd、FewEvent和InstructSTSB六个数据集上，Attention Relay使几乎所有LLM-嵌入模型组合获得显著提升：NYT上提升+8.7到+12.8点V-measure，IE上提升+25.3到+57.8分。基础检查点（未指令调优）的权重增益明显小于其指令调优版本，证实增益主要来源于指令调优。消融实验表明：增益来源于被LLM权重最高的词（去除前10%词几乎丧失全部增益）；在文本显式提及问题关注内容时增益更大；模型后半层的注意力权重最有效。该方法计算开销小（Qwen3-1.7B每文本仅4.6ms，嵌入端额外增加最多0.3ms）。

Conclusion: Attention Relay是一种无需训练的通用方法，可将指令调优LLM的指令跟随能力传递给任意指令无关的嵌入模型。其核心优势在于：仅传递权重而非向量，因此无需学习映射即可跨模型工作；嵌入模型保持其训练空间的表示能力；LLM提供"哪些部分重要"的选择信号。该方法在各种分词器、规模和池化类型的嵌入模型上均有效。局限性在于：只能选择文本中已有的内容（无法添加新知识）、仅适用于softmax注意力机制（不适用于稀疏或线性注意力）、目前仅在文本上验证（视觉等多模态扩展是未来方向）。

Abstract: Text embedding models trained with contrastive learning learn to follow task instructions from instruction-paired data, while instruction-tuned LLMs already know how to follow them. We show that this instruction-following ability can carry over from an LLM to a Transformer-based embedder without any training. We propose Attention Relay, which passes the attention weights an LLM produces to the embedder's own attention. Across six instruction-tuned LLMs from the Qwen3, Llama 3.1 and OLMo 3 families and ten widely used embedding models that differ in tokenizer, size and pooling type, Attention Relay makes nearly every combination instruction-aware. Experiments that break the method down into its parts show that the LLM's attention weights track the instruction in its later layers and come largely from instruction tuning. They also show that relaying these weights selects which content in the text matters: it makes the aspect of the text that the instruction asks about dominant in the embedding, or restores that aspect where averaging had diluted it.

TL;DR: 本文提出PFLM（Prior-Fitted Language Model），一个仅在合成的非语言先验样本上预训练的3亿参数字节级Transformer。它从未见过任何真实语言，但在推理时能以冻结权重从上下文推断自然语言、数字序列及确定性序列，实现了"学会学习一种语言"的能力。

  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现代大语言模型虽规模庞大但需要数万亿token训练，与人类儿童仅需数千万词即可习得语言形成六个数量级的差距。论文认为根本原因在于：人类拥有对"语言可能是什么"的进化先验——这个先验足够宽以容纳所有语言，又足够窄以使单个语言可学；而语言模型缺乏这种先验，所有关于语言的知识都必须从语料中提取。受Prior-Fitted Networks启发，作者希望赋予模型一个关于"可能语言家族"的先验，使其学会在上下文中获取语言，而非记忆任何具体语言。

Abstract: We present the Prior-Fitted Language Model (PFLM), a 300M-parameter byte-level transformer pretrained only on samples from a synthetic non-linguistic prior. Every training sequence is generated by a recurrent structural causal model drawn fresh from a distribution over such models. The model never sees the same language twice during training, so the only way to predict the continuation is to infer the language from the prefix. Samples from this prior share the statistical signatures of natural text: Zipfian frequencies, slow entropy-rate convergence, and long-range dependence. On Wikipedia in six languages, bits per byte fall from the uniform eight to between 0.9 and 2.4 at one million bytes of context. Given numerals instead of text, PFLM learns to count, to compare magnitudes, and to add approximately. It predicts deterministic sequences like Rudin-Shapiro or the prime indicator, and it compresses six non-text domains, from source code to speech, below gzip and PPMd. The model has not learned a language. It has learned to learn one.

### [56] [SOL: Measuring Gaps between Text Distributions by Double Sliced Wasserstein Metrics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06513)
*Gregor Kornhardt,Moritz Piening,Jannis Chemseddine,Gabriele Steidl*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出 SOL（Sliced Optimal Transport for Language），一种基于双重切片 Wasserstein 距离的文本分布度量方法，用于评估非自回归生成模型（包括扩散语言模型）与真实数据分布之间的差距。SOL 将每个文本表示为 Transformer 上下文隐藏状态的经验测度，再通过双重切片 Wasserstein 距离比较这些测度的分布。在参考 Transformer 满足单射性时，SOL 是严格的度量。实验证明，SOL 能检测模式坍缩、保持数值稳定，并与人类判断相关性优于 MAUVE。作者用 SOL 在 OpenWebText 上重新评估了多种自回归与扩散语言模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前文本生成评估协议存在严重缺陷：自回归模型可用困惑度评估，但扩散与流模型只能获得似然上界（ELBO），其紧致性因噪声类型不同不可比；生成式困惑度（Gen. PPL）与词熵是逐序列平均，无法检测模式坍缩，且不参考真实数据分布；现有替代品 MAUVE 不是度量、对样本数与聚类数敏感、对序列位置有偏倚。因此需要一种仅需样本、稳定性好且真正度量分布距离的评估指标，特别适用于扩散类非自回归语言模型。

Method: SOL 包含三个核心步骤：(1) 用固定的参考 Transformer 将每个文本序列映射为其上下文隐藏状态的均匀经验测度（token cloud）；(2) 通过两次切片操作将该"测度之上的测度"问题化简为一维 Wasserstein 距离——第一次将 token cloud 沿方向 ξ 投影到实数，第二次用分位数函数将其映入 L²([0,1])，再用 RBF 高斯过程采样的方向 g 切片；(3) 对所有切片对取 Wasserstein 距离的期望，得到双重切片 Wasserstein 距离（DSW），再乘以 √d 作为 SOL 度量。理论上证明了在 Transformer 单射假设下 SOL 是严格度量，并推导了关于样本量与切片数的收敛率 O(n^{-1/4} + L_ξ^{-1/4} + L_g^{-1/4})。

Result: 实验从多个维度验证 SOL：(1) 模式坍缩测试中 SOL 急剧上升，而 Gen. PPL 与词熵几乎不变；(2) SOL 在生成长度、模型规模、采样温度、词序扰动、模式增删等受控扰动下均表现合理；(4) 与 Bradley-Terry 人类排名相比，SOL 的最差 Spearman 相关性优于 MAUVE，尤其以 Dream 双向编码器效果最佳；(5) 估计量对样本数（约 5000）和切片数（1024-8192）已稳定，且计算开销极小（5000 样本 DSW 仅约 1 秒）。在 OpenWebText 大规模基准测试中，Soft-Masked + ReMDM-loop（SOL=18.966）优于自回归基线（22.207），且发现 Gen. PPL 更优并不等价于分布拟合更好。推荐 Dream-7B 作为参考编码器配合 L_ξ=L_g=8192、5000 样本使用。

Conclusion: SOL 是一种基于样本的文本分布度量方法，仅需样本即可统一比较自回归、离散扩散、连续扩散与流模型。它能检测现有指标遗漏的分布性失败（如模式坍缩），具有稳定的有限样本估计，对序列位置更平衡，与人类判断一致性优于 MAUVE。建议采用双向 Transformer Dream 作为参考编码器以消除因果模型的位置偏差，为现代语言模型（特别是扩散类模型）的评估提供了缺失的关键工具。

Abstract: Evaluating text generation requires measuring how well the generated distribution matches the data distribution. For autoregressive models, this is done by the perplexity. Diffusion and flow-based language models can only provide a likelihood bound, whose tightness differs between model families. Sample-based substitutes such as generative perplexity with entropy do not consider the distribution fit. We propose SOL, a distance between text distributions. Each sequence is represented by the empirical measure of its hidden states under a fixed transformer and the distributions of these measures are compared by the double sliced Wasserstein distance. We prove that SOL is a metric if the transformer is injective. Experiments show that SOL detects distributional failures, recovers expected model trends, and provides stable sample-based estimates. We put forward SOL to fill the gap in the current evaluation protocol used for non auto-regressive models. As a first step we use SOL to re-evaluate a variety of models trained on OpenWebText.

### [57] [Representation-Space MMD for Diffusion Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06648)
*Ilya Drobyshevskiy,Ilia Sudakov,Maksim Semenov,Denis Kuznedelev,Maksim Ignatov,Pavel Temirchev,Nikita Balagansky,Viacheslav Meshchaninov,Nikita Gushchin,Dmitry Baranchuk*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: We introduce a post-training method for diffusion language models (DLMs) that minimizes Maximum Mean Discrepancy (MMD) between generated and reference distributions in the feature space of a frozen pretrained DLM. To estimate MMD, we retain contextual features at individual token positions, obtaining multiple observations per sequence from a single extractor pass. We optimize this objective using policy gradients for discrete models and direct differentiation through generated latents for continuous models. In both cases, computing the loss directly from these features enables efficient post-training without full sampling trajectories or jointly trained auxiliary models. Experiments show lower generative perplexity at comparable entropy on OpenWebText and better accuracy-computation trade-offs on GSM8K. On 16B DMax-LLaDA2.0 models with hybrid masked-uniform diffusion, we increase decoding parallelism with similar or higher accuracy on math and code benchmarks.

### [58] [ufakzeka-karar: An Open Turkish Typed-Decision Model with Order-Invariant Option Scoring](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06744)
*Sait Furkan Teke*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: ufakzeka-karar is an open Turkish decision model with 182,494,466 parameters. Given a Turkish text and questions of a fixed answer type (a choice, a level on an ordered scale, or yes or no), it returns a temperature-scaled probability for every option and an expected error that serves as a "not sure" signal, without generating text and in one CPU forward pass for up to ten options. Built on the lab's ufakzeka-1-base, its head scores each option blind to the others at shared positions, so the answer does not depend on option order. A sequential head trained with shuffled options was about as accurate but changed 2.3 to 2.8 percent of its answers when only the option order changed; REINFORCE lost 10.2 points (0.102) of macro F1 to cross-entropy. On the open set of HakemBench v1.0 (4,275 questions, 7 tracks) the released model ranks 7th of 16 rows with a composite of 0.660 (95% interval 0.642 to 0.677). Temperature scaling lowers calibration error (smooth ECE) on the development set but raises it on held-out support questions, from 0.027 to 0.045 for the first scored run, which never trained on them; the released model later trained on them, so its 0.036 to 0.064 is not an unseen-question test. The released model is the last of three runs scored on HakemBench, and its numbers are not blind. The second run's new training data was aimed at the first run's errors on the full test set in guardrails, moderation and customer support, and the released run was trained after the second run's guardrail results on the full test set were read, under a protocol fixed in writing before any of its data, code or runs. All its numbers come after these readings; its guardrail, moderation and customer support numbers carry the flag "shaped by reading the test results". With every model scored on the other four tracks only, its composite is 0.678, 6th of 16. Weights and code are under Apache-2.0.

### [59] [Evidence and Intervention: A Coupled Active-Inference Extension of Rational Speech Act Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.04347)
*Yonghyeon Gwon,Elliot Murphy,Chun Kee Chung*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: Identical utterance choices can arise from different communicative causes, and identical interpretations can leave different traces in what a listener learns. Rational Speech Act (RSA) models treat interpretation as inference over speaker meaning, but standard one-shot RSA does not intrinsically distinguish these causal update targets. We develop a coupled active-inference model of dialogue in which a listener's likelihood for an utterance is the policy distribution attributed to the speaker, placing the speaker's expected free energy within the listener's variational free energy. Each utterance is therefore both evidence about and an intervention on a partner. The model separates four updates that RSA approaches typically collapse: inference about the partner's current pragmatic state; learning of partner-specific parameters; prospective evaluation of clarification or repair; and a policy prior shaped by habit and a context-sensitive price of time. Under one-step, exact-inference restrictions, the model recovers the RSA speaker and listener, with RSA as the restricted single-turn limit of the coupled process. Outside these restrictions, the updates obey distinct rules and timescales, predicting which adaptations persist, remain partner-specific, or transfer. Worked examples show audience design reversing after clarification, self-confirming misunderstanding in which both interlocutors have low free energy while disagreeing about reference, and rational closing before uncertainty is resolved. Consistent with critiques of equating natural language with communication, the model treats communication as a downstream use of linguistic structure and recasts production and interpretation as coupled inference: speaking is both an intervention on a partner and an epistemic action that samples evidence for the speaker's model of that partner.

### [60] [When Evidence Changes: Evaluating Memory Repair and Re-reading in Language-Model Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03902)
*Wenhui Chu*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: When documents supporting an agent's derived facts are revoked or replaced, should it repair memory or re-read current evidence? We introduce an evidence-revision evaluation on medication- and problem-list tasks from public ICU records. Under revocation, replacement and control events, we compare full and source-filtered re-reading with caching, rebuilding and graph-local repair across two 7B models. Memory is supplied in full without retrieval, and costs include ingest, revision and every use. On short records, local repair uses 5-10$\times$ fewer revision tokens than rebuilding, yet every memory pipeline costs at least twice full re-reading in held-out conditions. In a small pre-specified development sweep, adding task-ineligible documents extended records to about 10,000 tokens; at that length, memory's mean cumulative cost fell below full re-reading's after 2-14 uses, partly through truncated extraction, while source-filtered re-reading remained cheapest. In the replacement study, none of the four primary confirmatory tests reached statistical significance. These results show why the cost of agent memory after evidence revision must be assessed against source-filtered re-reading over the full pipeline.

### [61] [General Decision Models: Benchmarking and Insights Beyond Jev](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03935)
*Feiyu Duan,Jiayu Lin,Jia Wang,Jun Xiang,Jialiang Wu,Xinnong Zhang,Hanqi Yan,Siyuan Wang,Zhongyu Wei*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: General decision models, such as Jev, have recently emerged as efficient alternatives to LLMs for structured judgment and selection. But what kinds of decisions can these models reliably make, and how does their behavior change when individual decisions are composed into larger systems? To study this, we introduce JEVal, a bilingual benchmark comprising 11,257 instances from 36 datasets across 10 application domains, and evaluate 25 model configurations spanning general decision models and generative LLMs. Our results show that (1) general decision models are most competitive when decisions can be resolved from available evidence, but weaken when they require specialist knowledge or faithful uncertainty estimation: they can often identify the most likely outcome while substantially overstating its probability. (2) In more dynamic and realistic systems involving long-horizon, multi-step interactions, the advantages of fast local decision making are offset by reliability failures at the system level. on $\tau$-bench, faster local decisions reduce median episode time but lower task success as decision errors accumulate over long trajectories. (3) In large-scale social simulation, decision models approach strong generative LLMs on individual response prediction at substantially lower inference cost, yet remain weaker in user profiling and exhibit larger aggregate estimation errors and systematic bias. Finally, we propose InnerJev-4B and InnerJev-27B, which internalize an open-weight LLM's own reasoning into a single-pass first-token decision through Reasoning-to-Readout Self-Distillation, with InnerJev-27B performing on par with Jev on JEVal while answering a typical query in about 0.1 s.

### [62] [BAIBAICHUCHU at the NTCIR-19 FinArg-3 Task: When Is Maximum Possible Profit Predictable from Investor Text?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03962)
*Zong-Han Bai,Po-Yen Chu*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: The BAIBAICHUCHU team participated in the Social Media Subtask of NTCIR-19 FinArg-3, ranking Chinese investor posts by Maximum Possible Profit (MPP). A three-track ensemble of lexical features, a FinArg-2-pre-finetuned MacBERT ranker, and an LLM judge reaches 0.734 in post-grouped development evaluation, but our best official run scores 0.517. All twelve submitted runs lie between 0.4598 and 0.5402, and our 26 unanimous three-track pairs score 0.500. A post-hoc audit finds that the submitted judge applied a long-only rule to bearish posts although MPP is stance-aware. Correcting it changes 28 of 87 official predictions without changing accuracy, yet lowers development accuracy from 0.680 to 0.622: a regime-specific semantic shortcut improved validation fit. We decompose ranking into directional text, volatility and horizon, and pairwise margin. A running-extremum model predicts $\sigma\sqrt{T}$ scaling, observed ex post in 502 price-aligned posts from a separate July 2026 collection. Pre-posting volatility scaled by the post-specific observation horizon, $\sigma_{\mathrm{pre},20}\sqrt{N_i}$, is associated with a later truncated-horizon MPP proxy (Spearman $\rho=0.320$; ticker-cluster 95% CI [0.133,0.466]) and correctly orders 61.4% of unequal-outcome pairs. Transferred text is nearly uncorrelated with the July outcome ($\rho=0.055$) and adds little conditional on this score and stance. Development reliability rises from about 0.60 to 0.93 as the labeled MPP gap widens. An earlier ERAI result of 0.6207 rules out universal unpredictability as a simple explanation. Evaluation should jointly consider text, market regime, historical volatility, horizon, and pair composition.

### [63] [Do Language Models Need a Trainable Input Embedding Table? Fixed Minimal Token Codes at 1.7B-Class Scale](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.04002)
*A. Bochkov*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: A trainable input embedding table assigns each vocabulary item an independently adjustable vector. We investigate whether this token-specific parameterization is required for substantial language-modeling capability, or whether a shared Transformer can learn from fixed token identities. We compare three decoder-only language models trained from scratch with the same tokenizer, contextual backbone, untied output-head architecture, and training recipe, with a target budget of 100 billion prediction tokens per model. Their input interfaces are a learned table, canonical 16-bit token-ID codes, and one fixed invertible recoding over GF(2). The fixed codes are repeated to model width without an additional trainable input projection. Both fixed-code models acquire substantial capabilities: canonical codes achieve 52.40\% HellaSwag normalized accuracy, 70.51\% PIQA accuracy, and 42.75\% LAMBADA accuracy. The learned-input control performs better on several evaluations, including HellaSwag and LAMBADA, so these results establish viability rather than performance parity. The fixed interfaces remove 100.7 million trainable parameters, yielding 1.711B-parameter models, but parameter reduction is not the central result. These single-run experiments distinguish architectural necessity from empirical utility: independently trainable token-specific input vectors are not required for the observed capabilities. A fixed identity interface also provides a controlled setting for studying representation learning downstream of an immutable input, without establishing where particular capabilities are localized.

### [64] [IdeaScientist: Orchestrating Agents for Grounded Scientific Ideation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.04074)
*Jiarui Liu,Renjie Tao,Yiwei Liao,Chuanyang Jin,Kai Sun,Xiao Yang,Xinyuan Zhang,Xilun Chen,Zhuangqun Huang,Lechen Zhang,Yongjin Yang,Yinghui He,Weihao Xuan,Rakesh Wanga,Anuj Kumar,Mona T. Diab,Wen-tau Yih,Xin Luna Dong*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: Despite rapid progress in automating scientific research, generating promising and well grounded research solutions remains a central challenge. We isolate research ideation as a standalone task and build our solution on the intuition that a challenge in one field can often be addressed by a mechanism that solved an analogous challenge in another. Accordingly, we introduce IdeaScientist, which decomposes ideation into gap finding, innovation, and report writing, and trains each role with reinforcement learning. These roles identify limitations in related work, draw solution intuitions from analogous problem settings, and develop those intuitions into complete research proposals. To facilitate discovery of insights across domains, we construct the Svalbard Idea Vault, a corpus of 2.77M decomposed research ideas for retrieval, training, and temporally controlled evaluation. Our evaluation restricts access to literature available before a cutoff date and assesses how closely proposed directions align with those later explored in 15K papers authored by human researchers. On Qwen3.6-27B, IdeaScientist outperforms the strongest open-source autoresearch baseline by 14.0%, driven mainly by gains in novelty. On this 27B open backbone, IdeaScientist even outperforms Claude Code SDK with Claude-4.8-Opus and Codex SDK with GPT-5.4, by up to 5.9%.

### [65] [LongSocialBench: Do Long-Context LLMs Understand Online Discussion Threads?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.04118)
*Xinyi Liu,Rinat Khaziev,Dilek Hakkani-Tür,Tarek F. Abdelzaher*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: Long-context LLMs can now ingest entire online discussion threads, but understanding their social discourse requires more than reading a long document: models must track parent-reply relations, turning points, scoped subtrees, cross-branch contrasts, and participant trajectories. To test this structure-aware social reasoning, we introduce LongSocialBench, a benchmark of 1,462 verified human-authored multiple-choice items drawn from 94 complete Hacker News, Stack Exchange, and Reddit r/ChangeMyView episodes, with a median length of approximately 73K tokens. Each item pairs a complete serialized discussion and reply structure with a four-option question, requiring models to recover structured social evidence. Released items are verified for answerability, option uniqueness, and evidence grounding. Across 18 models and 29 evaluation settings, current long-context workflows remain far below human performance. The best individual result comes from Claude-Opus-4.7, which reaches 63.0% when prompted to eliminate incorrect options before answering, compared with 72.4% for independent human readers. Averaged across all 18 models, the full-context Baseline scores 43.9%. Supplying the gold evidence scope raises this to 55.0%, showing that substantial errors remain even after the relevant thread region is identified. LongSocialBench shows that the missing capability is not context access or prompting alone, but social understanding over structured reply trees.

### [66] [Copying Before Suppression: What Drives a Below-Chance Dip During Language Model Training?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.04119)
*Tejas Dahiya,Cole Blondin*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: Mechanistic interpretability usually studies fully trained models, yet the computations that drive a behaviour can change while the model is still learning the task. On the Indirect Object Identification task, a model should continue with the name mentioned once rather than the name mentioned twice. Pythia models pass through an early training window in which they prefer the repeated name, so accuracy in a choice between the two names falls below one half while language-model loss on a fixed text sample keeps decreasing across the same window. The window reflects a temporary imbalance between two computations. We identify one cause of the wrong preference by selecting a set of attention heads that write the repeated name, on prompts separate from those used for causal evaluation, keeping that selection fixed, and then replacing each head's final-token output with its average output on a separate set of non-repeated-name prompts. This improves the correct-minus-repeated logit difference in a separately trained 160M model and in the official 160M, 410M, and 1B models. At 160M, the head that lowers the repeated name in the mature model shows little of its mature behaviour at this point. It directs less than one percent of its attention to the repeated mention, and its output makes almost no direct contribution to lowering that name's logit. Both properties grow over the interval in which behaviour recovers. Across the 160M, 410M, and 1B models, transplanting the corresponding head's mature parameters into the early checkpoint recovers 35 to 68 percent of the total improvement in the correct-minus-repeated logit difference seen by the end of training. Related early-to-late reversals appear at further Pythia scales, in two independently trained GPT-2 models, and in OLMo. A mature circuit can therefore conceal a transient causal configuration that shaped behaviour earlier in training.

Abstract: Mechanistic interpretability usually studies fully trained models, yet the computations that drive a behaviour can change while the model is still learning the task. On the Indirect Object Identification task, a model should continue with the name mentioned once rather than the name mentioned twice. Pythia models pass through an early training window in which they prefer the repeated name, so accuracy in a choice between the two names falls below one half while language-model loss on a fixed text sample keeps decreasing across the same window. The window reflects a temporary imbalance between two computations. We identify one cause of the wrong preference by selecting a set of attention heads that write the repeated name, on prompts separate from those used for causal evaluation, keeping that selection fixed, and then replacing each head's final-token output with its average output on a separate set of non-repeated-name prompts. This improves the correct-minus-repeated logit difference in a separately trained 160M model and in the official 160M, 410M, and 1B models. At 160M, the head that lowers the repeated name in the mature model shows little of its mature behaviour at this point. It directs less than one percent of its attention to the repeated mention, and its output makes almost no direct contribution to lowering that name's logit. Both properties grow over the interval in which behaviour recovers. Across the 160M, 410M, and 1B models, transplanting the corresponding head's mature parameters into the early checkpoint recovers 35 to 68 percent of the total improvement in the correct-minus-repeated logit difference seen by the end of training. Related early-to-late reversals appear at further Pythia scales, in two independently trained GPT-2 models, and in OLMo. A mature circuit can therefore conceal a transient causal configuration that shaped behaviour earlier in training.

### [67] [Can LLMs Separate Pasted Artifacts from User Speech? Absorption at Unmarked Prompt Seams](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.04210)
*Sugam Panthi,Muhaiminul Yeamin,Rabab Abdelfattah*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: Large language models (LLMs) receive each user message as plain text, even when it combines text from different sources. For example, a user may paste text into a prompt and keep typing a comment directly below it. We study absorption: a phenomenon where the model treats a trailing user comment as part of the pasted text, returning it inside the edited text. This happens even though the user did not intend the comment to become part of that text. Existing instruction-data separation benchmarks tell the model which text is instruction and which is data, then test whether it obeys that separation. They do not test harmless user speech following an unmarked paste. We introduce SEAM, a controlled benchmark of 300 editing examples. Each example is tested under six matched conditions that vary how the boundary between pasted text and later user speech is expressed. Across 20 models, absorption at a bare newline ranges from 7.7% to 66.7%. Adding a blank line does not significantly reduce absorption in any model, while boundary markers reduce it in 19 of 20 models. Comments that fit the pasted text, such as a code comment typed after code, are absorbed significantly more often in 17 of 20 models. Models often fail to separate pasted material from later user speech, and explicit boundaries reduce but do not remove this failure.

### [68] [Evaluating Modeling Approaches for Experience-Level Classification in Job Description](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.04304)
*Celia Liang,Eddie Wu,Shiqi Wang,Yonah You*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: This paper investigates the task of predicting job experience levels in recruitment texts, aiming to automatically identify the qualifications required for positions. Unlike traditional text classification, recruitment texts typically possess explicit internal structures, with different paragraphs playing disproportionate roles in conveying experience clues. To address this, we propose a structure-aware Section-Aware BERT approach that segments and encodes key paragraphs (titles, responsibilities, requirements) for integrated modeling, building upon rule-based systems and classical baselines TF-IDF. Simultaneously, we evaluate large language models under both few-shot and fine-tuning settings on the same dataset to compare the capability boundaries of different modeling paradigms. Experimental results demonstrate that explicitly leveraging text structure significantly improves experience level prediction performance, particularly in scenarios with ambiguous job titles. Further error analysis reveals systemic challenges in this task, including confusion between Entry and Senior levels and the blurred boundaries of Mid-level positions. This research provides an effective modeling approach and analytical framework for understanding structured recruitment texts.

### [69] [Boundaries Agree, Labels Do Not: Intra-Annotator Dynamics as a Kind of Training Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.04370)
*Marharyta Shvets*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: Data quality now matters as much as compute for training language models. Much training data comes from human annotation of text, and interpretive annotation has no ground truth that could settle what is "accurate". Two lines of work respond to this. One combines annotators into a "ground truth" and measures how well they agree with each other; the other treats their disagreement as a signal. Both compare different people at one point in time. We measure something else: how well one reader reproduces their own reading of the same text over time. One expert human reader and three LLM families segmented three Sumerian myths and labelled the causal function of each segment with one of seven states. Across runs months apart, the human cut the text in much the same places but named the segments differently, in every myth. The models show no such consistent pattern: their gap between the two layers is positive in some myths and negative in others, and its size varies. The human's label changes are not random: the runs go through much the same functions but start them one step apart, while model runs start them at the same places. We argue that this pattern is a usable measure of data quality and a contamination check: a "human" annotation whose labels are as stable as its boundaries, and whose functions start in sync, looks like a model's.

### [70] [Ideological Stance Detection in a Low-Resource Language: Polarization in Bangladeshi Public vs Private University Discourse on Social Media](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.04401)
*Safaruzzaman Shovo,Monowar Islam,Asif Hossain,Sameya Akhter,Md. Shamsul Islam*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: Public vs. private universities is a debatable issue, and it creates polarization on social media in Bangladesh. Debate on quality, jobs, and prestige is passionate among the students, parents, and graduates, the majority of whom speak Bengali, a low-resource language. To measure this polarization, this paper introduces a manually annotated dataset of 4,060 Bengali comments labeled as Pro-Public, Pro-Private, or Neutral. We evaluated the quality of our annotations by Fleiss's Kappa agreement that was 0.89, corresponding to a high agreement among annotators. The classical ML (SVM, Random Forest, XGBoost), BiLSTM network, hybrid BanglaBERT+XGBoost models and the state-of-the-art zero-shot LLMs (Claude Sonnet 4, DeepSeek-V3.1, Llama 4 Maverick, Kimi K2 Thinking, Qwen3-235B Thinking) models are evaluated. The accuracy of BanglaBERT+XGBoost is 91.81% and macro F1 score is 91.70%, which is higher than all the supervised baselines. The zero-shot Llama 4 Maverick Thinking achieves a macro F1 of 0.931 (overall accuracy of 93.31%) without any fine-tuning. All machine learning (ML), deep machine learning (DL) and transformer models were outperformed by the zero-shot Llama 4 Maverick model. Polarization also is evident, in some ways more clearly in the Pro-Private comments, which emphasize modern facilities and timely graduation, versus the Pro-Public comments, which emphasize affordability and government jobs. Our findings open new directions for analyzing social media polarization in low-resource languages.
