For the majority of the co-active PR pairs (underlying the vast majority of which are intra-agent authored), both PRs were authored by the same agent, while only 0.5% of co-active pairs were cross-agent, and occurred in only 122 out of 2807 total repositories examined (or approximately 4.3%). Additionally, we replayed actual three way git merges on 747 unique co-active pairs (one per repository), and computed the percentage of textual conflict encountered during the merge operation to combine the two PRs in each pair. We observed that the percentage of textual conflict encountered was significantly higher for cross-agent pairs compared to intra-agent pairs: 41.7% vs. 19.8%, respectively, with non-overlapping 95% confidence intervals. Lastly, we developed a classification system based on the detection of conflict reported by git, and determined that the majority of conflicts resulted from modifications to source code files (84.4% of conflicted files) and not dependency manifest files; further, nearly 42% of conflicts we observed were structural (i.e., modify/delete or add/add).

</details>


### [160] [Using Process Mining to Generate AI Agents from Software Engineering Process Records](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.04948)
*Saimir Bala,Fabiana Fournier,Lior Limonad,Andreas Metzger*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文提出 pm4aa 管道，通过对象中心过程挖掘（OCPM）、命令式过程挖掘（BPMN）和声明式过程挖掘（DECLARE）从软件仓库事件日志中自动发现项目特定的 AI 代理角色，并基于 LangGraph 生成可执行的代理规范与实现。以 Commitizen 开源项目为案例进行验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在软件工程（SE）中集成 AI 代理时面临核心挑战：如何为混合人机团队设计粒度合适的代理角色。粗粒度代理过于复杂，微粒度代理协调开销大，且现有框架依赖预定义的固定角色结构，无法适应项目特定特征和流程变化。

Method: pm4aa 是一个多步骤生成管道：(1) 使用 PyStack't 从 GitHub 仓库提取 OCEL 2.0 事件日志；(2) 通过 Conventional Commits 规范解析提交信息，映射为任务类型和语义类；(4) 基于行为画像（活动分布、提交数量、任务类多样性）使用基于规则的分类器为每个贡献者分配唯一角色；(5) 按角色分割日志，得到子日志；(6) 对每个角色进行过程挖掘——OC-DFG（对象中心直接跟随图）捕获任务范围和对象交互；BPMN 通过 Inductive Miner 提取命令式过程模型；DECLARE 通过 DeclareMiner 提取行为约束作为执行护栏；(7) 使用 GPT-4-mini 基于过程画像生成业务导向的角色描述；(8) 通过 IBM BOB（提示驱动合成）将挖掘结果转化为 LangGraph 代理代码，生成共享类型状态、提示模板和路由逻辑的可执行代理工作流。

Result: 在 Commitizen 案例中（21,488 事件，589 用户，跨越 8 年），成功识别出 8 个角色（issue_reporter、contributor、quality_engineer、technical_writer、feature_developer、maintainer、bot、devops_engineer）。最终生成 5 个 LangGraph 代理（issue_reporter_agent、bot_workflow_agent、implementation_agent、quality_agent、technical_writer_agent，其中 implementation_agent 合并了 feature developer、contributor、maintainer、DevOps engineer）。10 人用户研究显示：知识模式（C1）、操作清晰度（C3）、人类参与度（C5）得分高（中位数 4），问责性（C4）中等（中位数 3），自主性（C2）较低（中位数 2），表明人类对代理自主行动边界的理解存在显著差距。

Conclusion: pm4aa 证明了从仓库事件日志自动生成项目特定 AI 代理规范和实现的潜力，初始冒烟测试显示问题路由一致，探索性用户研究表明生成的规范与人类期望具有较好的对齐度。自主性边界（C2）是最大的人机对齐差距。未来工作包括：在更多样化仓库（含无结构化提交的项目）上评估、引入从业工程师作为受支持端点、将硬分区角色分配扩展为重叠角色成员关系，并利用 IDE 遥测和 CI/CD 日志丰富事件日志以支持更细粒度的代理规范。

Abstract: Integrating AI agents into Software Engineering (SE) raises an important challenge: how can we specify and realize AI agents that work effectively alongside humans in hybrid SE teams? Determining the right granularity and separation of concerns for such agents is non-trivial. Coarse-grained agents may introduce unmanageable complexity, whereas micro-agents may create severe coordination overhead. Moreover, existing multi-agent SE frameworks typically rely on predefined role structures and do not account for project-specific characteristics or process adaptations. We address this by combining object-centric, imperative, and declarative process mining. Using event logs extracted from software repositories, our approach discovers project-specific agent roles using a predefined SE role vocabulary grounded in repository behavior and generates matching agent specifications and implementations. As proof-of-concept, we applied our approach to a well-established open-source project. We performed functional tests and an exploratory user study to determine how well the generated AI agent specifications are aligned with human expectations.

</details>


### [161] [RETRACE: From Entangled Repair Histories to Reusable Experience for CI Repair](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.04658)
*Rabeya Khatun Muna,Muhammad Ahasanuzzaman,Nakhla Rafi,Yisen Xu,Jinqiu Yang,Tse-Hsun Chen*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: RETRACE 是一个从纠缠的 CI 修复历史中重建问题级修复经验的框架，通过端点视图（从通过版本的最终变更反向推理）和开发视图（沿提交历史正向追踪修复演化）的双向变更归因，并结合 CI 执行证据进行调和，将重建的经验表示为具体修复、上下文策略、可迁移模式三个抽象层次，在新 CI 失败时检索相关经验以指导修复。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 LLM 智能体复用历史经验时通常假设问题与解决方案已对齐，但软件历史（尤其是 PR）很少天然提供这种对齐——一个 PR 可能包含多个 CI 问题、失败尝试、回退编辑及无关变更，难以确定哪些变更解决了哪个问题。论文旨在解决"问题-修复归因"这一关键难题，使历史 CI 修复可作为可复用的修复经验。

Method: 方法包含三个核心阶段：(1) 组织 CI 执行证据，将原始日志与工作流对齐，提取失败、验证状态和依赖关系；(2) 双向变更归因——端点视图从累积补丁 Δ_i 反向推理每个变更可能解决的 CI 问题，开发视图沿提交序列 C_i 正向追踪变更的引入、修改与移除，并通过 LLM 分类（equivalent/complementary/conflicting/distinct）进行调和；(3) 将每条重建记录抽象为三层——L1 具体修复经验、L2 上下文修复策略、L3 可迁移修复模式。新 CI 失败时，对每个原子问题独立检索三层经验，利用目标 CI 证据和当前仓库状态过滤后，按依赖顺序进行顺序修复与验证。

Result: 在 CI-Repair-Bench（565 个 PR 级修复实例、101 个仓库、12 类失败）上，RETRACE 将 mini-SWE-agent 的 Pass@1 从 19.6% 提升至 31.9%（MiniMax-M2.5）、从 23.3% 提升至 32.8%（DeepSeek-V4-Flash）；在 200 实例子集上将 Codex 从 15.5% 提升至 27.5%，均显著优于无经验和 Historical-Plan 基准。消融实验表明：完整双向重建优于任一单视图（如 MiniMax-M2.5：Full 31.9% vs w/o Endpoint 28.4% vs w/o Development 27.2%）；三层抽象逐层提升 Pass@1（L1: 26.0% → L1+L2: 28.0% → L1+L2+L3: 30.5%）。

Conclusion: RETRACE 验证了从纠缠 PR 历史中重建问题级修复经验的有效性：通过端点视图与开发视图的双向归因和 CI 证据调和，结合三级抽象表示，可显著提升 LLM 智能体在 CI 修复任务中的成功率。论文将"从历史中学习"重新定义为构建、抽象与复用经验记录而非更新模型参数，为 CI 修复乃至更广泛的从噪声历史中学习提供了新范式。

Abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents increasingly reuse prior experience, but most approaches assume that problems and solutions are already aligned. Software histories rarely provide this alignment: a pull request (PR) may contain multiple continuous integration (CI) problems, failed attempts, reverted edits, and unrelated changes, obscuring which changes resolve each problem. We present RETRACE, a framework for reconstructing problem-level repair experience from such histories. RETRACE combines an endpoint view that reasons backward from changes retained in the passing revision with a development view that traces repair evolution forward through commit history. CI execution evidence reconciles the two views, and the recovered experience is represented at three abstraction levels, from concrete fixes to transferable repair patterns. For new failures, RETRACE retrieves relevant problem-level experience to guide repair. On CI-REPAIR-BENCH, comprising 565 PR-level repairs from 101 repositories across 12 failure categories, RETRACE improves mini-SWE-agent Pass@1 from 19.6% to 31.9% with MiniMax-M2.5 and from 23.3% to 32.8% with DeepSeek-V4-Flash. On a matched subset, Codex improves from 15.5% to 27.5%. Combining both views consistently outperforms either alone, showing that recovering problem-change alignment enables historical CI repairs to serve as reusable repair experience.

</details>


### [162] [Towards Automatically Pruning Logging Code with Coding Agents: How Far Are We?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.04716)
*He Yang Yuan,Haonan Zhang,Xin Wang,An Ran Chen,Kisub Kim,Zishuo Ding,Zhenhao Li*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本研究首次系统性地探讨了日志代码移除（logging removal）这一软件维护任务，从开发者实际移除日志的实践中提炼出10种移除模式和11种移除原因，构建了包含387个真实案例的LogRem数据集，并评估了四个编码代理（coding agents）在该任务上的表现。结果显示虽然95.6%-100%的输出能通过有效性检查，但仅11.1%-19.6%能完全匹配真实修改的范围，揭示了当前编码代理在精确界定移除范围与保留必要代码方面仍存在显著不足。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 日志代码对调试、监控和软件维护至关重要，但过多的日志会带来噪声、运行时开销并模糊诊断信息。现有研究广泛关注日志代码的生成和修改，而日志移除这一同样重要的维护任务却相对缺乏研究。该研究旨在填补这一空白，理解开发者如何在真实软件变更中移除日志代码，以及编码代理能否胜任该任务。

Method: 1. 从Python和Java代码库中提取并人工验证日志移除案例；2. 归纳出10种移除模式和11种移除原因；3. 构建LogRem数据集（387个真实案例），涵盖直接日志语句移除、日志基础设施移除和日志替换三类；4. 在多种模型设置下评估四个编码代理；5. 将代理输出与真实开发者接受的变更进行对比，分析在移除完整性、保留无关代码等方面的差异；6. 分析不同提示信息（commit消息、开发者讨论、分类法指导）对性能对齐和运行成本的影响。

Result: 研究发现：(1) 95.6%-100%的代理输出通过了有效性检查，但仅11.1%-19.6%的输出能在保留无关代码的同时移除与真实修改一致的日志代码；(2) 代理的失败模式包括遗漏移除、多余移除和编辑无关代码，不同日志移除类别间表现差异显著；(3) 执行成本差异较大，但更高的成本并不稳定地带来更好的对齐效果；(4) commit消息和开发者讨论对提升对齐度贡献最大，而分类法指导能持续降低运行时间。

Conclusion: 该研究确立了日志移除作为一项独立的软件维护任务，证明了可靠的自动化取决于精确确定移除范围同时保留必要代码。当前编码代理在该任务上仍存在显著局限，未来需要进一步研究如何提升代理在范围界定和代码保留方面的能力。该研究是首个从该视角审视日志代码移除的工作。

Abstract: Logging code supports debugging, monitoring, and software maintenance, but excessive logging can add noise, impose runtime overhead, and obscure diagnostic information. While prior research has extensively studied logging code generation and modification, logging removal remains comparatively underexplored. In this paper, we study developer logging removal practices and explore the use of coding agents for this task. We extract and manually validate logging removal cases from Python and Java repositories and derive 10 removal patterns and 11 removal reasons that characterize how and why logging code was removed in real-world software changes. We further construct LogRem, a dataset of 387 real-world cases covering direct logging statement removal, logging infrastructure removal, and logging replacement. We evaluate four coding agents with multiple model settings and compare their outputs with accepted real-world changes. Although 95.6% to 100.0% of outputs pass validity checks, only 11.1% to 19.6% remove the same logging code as the corresponding real-world change while preserving unrelated code. Agents differ through missed removals, extra removals, and unrelated code edits, with substantial variation across logging removal categories and trajectories. Execution cost varies widely, but higher cost does not consistently yield closer alignment. Commit messages and developer discussions provide the largest alignment gains, while taxonomy guidance consistently reduces runtime. Overall, our study establishes logging removal as a distinct software maintenance task and shows that reliable automation depends on accurately determining removal scope while preserving necessary code. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first study to examine logging code removal from this perspective.

</details>


### [163] [Complex Agents, Shallow Tests: Demystifying and Enhancing Test Adequacy of Agent Harness in the Wild](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.04921)
*Yifan Xiong,Jingyi Ge,Zhenpeng Chen,Yiling Lou*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 该论文首次对真实世界LLM智能体系统中"智能体框架代码"（agent harness）的测试充分性进行系统性实证研究，并提出首个面向框架的测试生成技术HarnessTester。研究发现LLM依赖型框架代码（LDH）测试覆盖严重不足（行/分支覆盖率不足50%，变异分数仅33.60%），并提出通过"智能体-框架契约"支持来生成契约忠实（contract-faithful）的测试。HarnessTester在覆盖率和变异分数上显著优于现有通用测试生成技术，并发现了122个真实框架缺陷（88个为先前未知，69个已被开发者确认）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM智能体系统由概率性骨干LLM与周围框架（harness）组成，框架负责执行环境、上下文管理、工具调用等关键功能。随着框架日益复杂，框架实现缺陷带来严重可靠性问题。然而，智能体开发者对框架代码的测试充分性尚未被系统研究，传统基准测试仅评估端到端任务成功率（黑盒视角），缺乏对内部框架实现的白盒测试充分性分析。

Method: 1) 实证研究：分析10个大规模开源智能体系统（涵盖OpenHands、OpenClaw、Aider等），通过跨过程数据流分析提取LLM依赖型框架代码（LDH），使用行/分支覆盖率和变异分数评估测试充分性，并从组件意图、判断模式、LLM值形式三个维度对700个LDH分支谓词进行语义分类。
2) HarnessTester技术：基于LLM驱动的覆盖引导测试生成范式，增强两项机制：a) 智能体-框架契约指导（prompt级原则，确保维护正确的运行时表示、跨组件调用契约、契约忠实的测试替身）；b) 智能体-框架契约上下文检索器（按需检索相关代码上下文）。
3) 评估：与CoverUp、TestTailor、Qodo Cover、TestPilot 2等四个SOTA通用测试生成技术对比，并构建包含250个历史LDH缺陷的H-Bench基准。

Result: 实证研究：平均项目行/分支覆盖率仅49.48%/36.84%，LDH代码覆盖率仅44.27%/41.18%，变异分数仅33.60%。49.86%的LDH分支谓词完全未被覆盖，工具调用处理覆盖最好（38.18%全覆盖），智能体编排控制覆盖最差（仅14.29%全覆盖）。
HarnessTester：相比最强基线，LDH行/分支覆盖率增益提升75.95%/84.76%，变异分数增益提升69.89%。在H-Bench上检测出43个历史缺陷（最佳基线仅2个），发现122个真实缺陷（88个先前未知，69个已被开发者确认，1个获CVE编号）。契约支持组件贡献显著（消融实验中移除后增益降低约96%）。

Conclusion: 真实世界智能体框架代码测试充分性严重不足，特别是LLM依赖型框架代码。当前通用测试生成技术因缺乏对智能体-框架契约的感知，难以构造跨组件契约忠实的测试设置。HarnessTester通过显式的契约支持和上下文检索，能够显著提升测试覆盖率和缺陷检测能力，并在实际智能体系统中发现了大量先前未知的可靠性缺陷，证明了面向框架的测试生成技术对保障智能体系统可靠性具有重要实践价值。

Abstract: LLM-based agentic systems are emerging as a new software paradigm. Modern agents are typically composed of backbone LLMs and a surrounding harness that serves as the operational software infrastructure for agent execution. As agent harnesses grow increasingly complex, agents suffer from diverse harness implementation bugs, raising substantial reliability concerns. In this work, we conduct the first empirical study to systematically investigate the test adequacy of harness in real-world agentic systems. Our analysis reveals that agent harness remains substantially undertested. In particular, LLM-dependent harness (LDH) code, despite its critical role in processing LLM outputs and governing agent behavior, receives limited testing attention, with less than half of its lines and branches covered by existing tests. Motivated by these findings, we further propose HarnessTester, the first harness-oriented test generation technique that incorporates explicit agent-harness contract support to construct contract-faithful test setups and extensively exercise LDH code. Our evaluation shows that HarnessTester substantially outperforms state-of-the-art general-purpose test generation techniques in achieving 75.95%/84.76% larger line/branch coverage gains and 69.89% larger mutation-score gains. Furthermore, HarnessTester detects 122 real-world harness bugs in widely-used agentic systems (e.g., OpenClaw), among which, 88 bugs are previously-unknown bugs and 69 bugs have been confirmed by agent developers. These results highlight the practical effectiveness of HarnessTester in improving test adequacy and assuring the reliability of real-world agentic systems.

</details>


### [164] [Assembling Insights for Agentic Machine Learning Engineering Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.04927)
*Bihui Jin,Yinxi Li,Kaiyuan Wang,Pengyu Nie*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文系统研究了从相关机器学习工程（MLE）任务中提取的洞察（insights）如何影响智能体MLE系统。提出了MLE-InsightBench基准（160个Kaggle竞赛，12个领域）和MLE-InsightForge洞察组装系统，组装三类洞察并以技能或剧本方式注入，实验证明洞察使归一化私有测试分数提升123.9%，且三种洞察互补、跨LLM泛化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有智能体MLE系统在收集和注入来自相关任务的洞察时较为随意（ad hoc），且评估中未控制洞察来源，存在数据泄露风险，威胁结论的有效性。不同系统使用不同的洞察来源、表示和注入方式，且消融研究通常移除整个洞察源，无法揭示哪些洞察类型有效及如何注入。

Method: （1）构建MLE-InsightBench：从Kaggle收集160个高质量竞赛，按描述嵌入聚类成12个领域，每个领域留出一个作为目标任务，其余148个作为源任务（要求因果非后代关系）；采用私有测试分级防泄露。（2）设计MLE-InsightForge：基于ReAct的智能体读取源竞赛的描述、获奖方案和writeup，组装三类洞察——12个领域洞察（领域级最佳实践）、148个竞赛洞察（获奖方案决策）、16个改进洞察（通用调试与优化策略）；每条洞察有触发–动作格式和原始来源证据。（3）以两种模式注入——技能模式（按需检索）和剧本模式（初始上下文注入）；基于ReAct的解决方案树MLE求解智能体在固定预算（12小时、250步、1 GPU）下评估。

Result: （1）总体效果：洞察使归一化私有测试分数提升123.9%（Full-skill）和122.8%（Full-playbook），12个目标任务中Full-skill在11个上显著提升。（2）洞察类型贡献：三种洞察互补——领域洞察单独提升96.9%，竞赛洞察101.4%，改进洞察102.1%，但均低于三者组合（122.8%）；单个类型显著提升的任务数较少（8-9 vs 11），且任务间最佳类型不同。（3）注入模式比较：技能与剧本效果相近（0.676 vs 0.673），但技能输入token增量7.7%，剧本25.2%，技能更具成本效益；GPT-6.1-Sol后端主动检索技能，效果更好。（4）跨LLM泛化：洞察对GPT-6.1-Sol仍提升80.3%（Full-skill）、61.9%，在Image Matching 2025上将均值mAA提升至金牌阈值之上。（5）案例分析：Energy Behavior of Prosumers任务中洞察使私有测试MAE从234.15降至57.12。

Conclusion: 研究证明将洞察组装作为智能体MLE系统的显式组件、并在基准中控制信息源是必要且有益的。三类洞察互补，技能模式更具成本效益，洞察收益可跨模型泛化。建议未来智能体MLE系统将洞察来源与评估方法作为一等公民对待，以实现公平可比的评测。

Abstract: Agentic machine learning engineering (MLE) is an emerging AI4SE application for complex ML tasks and a step toward recursive self-improvement of AI systems. Recent agentic MLE systems show the value of leveraging insights from related MLE tasks: some systems condition code generation on expert domain knowledge, which is implicitly curated from peer MLE tasks; some systems have a loop of solving an MLE task, gathering memory to benefit future tasks. However, insight collection and injection remain ad hoc, and existing evaluations often do not control insight sources, making data leakage a threat to validity. To close these gaps, we systematically study how insights from related MLE tasks affect agentic MLE systems, and how their impact depends on insight type and injection method. We introduce MLE-InsightBench, a benchmark of 160 Kaggle competitions across 12 domains. To prevent leakage, one competition per domain is held out as the target, while the remaining 148 serve as sources only when they cannot have been influenced by the target task, such as through later editions or reused solutions. We also develop MLE-InsightForge, an insight assembly agent that explores source competitions, top human solutions, and writeups to construct three insight types: 12 domain insights summarizing best practices, 148 competition insights describing winning solutions, and 16 improvement insights capturing generic debugging and optimization strategies. These insights are injected either as on-demand skills or as an upfront playbook. In our evaluation, the extracted insights improve the normalized private-test score by 123.9% over a no-insight baseline. Controlled experiments further show that the three insight types are complementary; the better injection mode (skill vs. playbook) varies by tasks, with skills more cost-effective overall; and the gains generalize across backend LLMs.

</details>


### [165] [TeleGen: Improving LLM-Based Web Application Generation via Runtime Telemetry](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.04981)
*Yujia Luo,Haonan Zhang,Jiasi Shen,Zishuo Ding,Weiyi Shang*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: TeleGen是一个面向LLM生成Web应用的"可观测性增强"修复框架。它在生成的v1应用副本中插入轻量日志，在浏览器任务执行期间收集运行时遥测，再由压缩Agent将原始遥测日志精简成"遥测简报"，用于指导修复Agent修改干净的v1源码生成v2。在WebGen-Bench和Web-Bench上均取得实质性改进。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的generate-execute-repair流水线在LLM生成Web应用时，只能向修复Agent提供任务通过/失败的最终结果或表层错误信息，缺失了浏览器动作与最终结果之间的运行时行为证据，导致交互级失败难以定位和诊断。

Method: 采用四阶段流水线：(1) 编码Agent根据自然语言规约生成v1应用；(2) 遥测插桩Agent在v1副本中插入轻量日志，不修改功能行为；(3) 任务执行器在插桩后的应用上运行，收集原始遥测日志，并由压缩Agent生成精简易遥测简报；(4) 修复Agent基于干净v1源码、任务反馈和遥测简报生成v2。

Result: 在WebGen-Bench上，任务成功率从无遥测修复的67.7%提升至76.2%（+8.5个百分点，p=1.35e-5）；在Web-Bench上，累积Pass@2从21.7%提升至29.8%（+8.1个百分点，p=4.49e-10）。消融实验表明原始遥测日志本身带来7.11pp增益，压缩为简报后进一步提升至8.50pp并降低token成本。失败类型分布显示遥测对导航、表单工作流、设计/样式、认证/会话等"隐藏执行路径"类失败最为有效。在DeepSeek-V4-Pro、Qwen3.5-Plus、Gemini-3-Flash-Preview等不同模型下均观察到一致的提升趋势。

Conclusion: 使LLM生成的Web应用具备运行时可观测性，能将原本不透明的浏览器级失败转化为可操作的修复证据。遥测简报在有效性与成本之间取得了良好平衡，是提升LLM驱动代码修复质量的一条实用路径。

Abstract: Large language models can generate runnable web applications from natural-language requirements, but many generated applications still fail interactive tasks. Existing generate-execute-repair pipelines execute the generated application and use task outcomes or error messages to guide code revision. However, this feedback often misses the runtime behavior between a browser action and the final task outcome, making interaction-level failures difficult to diagnose. Therefore, we propose TeleGen, an observability-enhanced framework for LLM-based web application generation. TeleGen instruments generated applications, collects runtime telemetry during task execution, and compresses raw telemetry logs into concise briefs for repair. We evaluate TeleGen on WebGen-Bench and Web-Bench. On WebGen-Bench, TeleGen improves task success from 67.7% with repair without telemetry to 76.2%, an increase of 8.5 percentage points. On Web-Bench, it improves cumulative Pass@2 from 21.7% to 29.8%. Ablation results show that runtime telemetry provides a useful diagnostic signal, while telemetry briefs make this signal more effective and less costly to use. Further analysis shows that telemetry is especially helpful for failures involving hidden execution paths, such as navigation, form workflows, and frontend-backend coordination.

</details>


### [166] [StateWise: Diagnosing and Repairing Persistent Operational State Before Agent Actions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05241)
*Yongyuan Peng,Zhou Feng,Tongying Wu,Jiahao Chen,Yuan Su,Chunyi Zhou,Tianyu Du,Shouling Ji*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: StateWise 是一个用于在 LLM 编码智能体执行动作前诊断和修复持久化操作状态（persistent operational state）的框架。它通过反事实重规划识别决策关键记录，通过分层解析器验证其当前有效性，并通过类型化证据绑定进行有作用域的持久化修复，从而在持久化记忆被环境或需求变更失效时恢复任务正确性与操作安全性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM 编码智能体依赖持久化操作记忆作为后续动作的依据。环境和需求的变更会使这些记录失效，而现有的动作审查、来源追踪和澄清机制往往只阻止当前错误操作，无法修正底层的持久化状态，导致错误记录在后续任务中被反复重用，引发任务失败或不安全修改。论文通过审计真实编码智能体轨迹，发现了 40 个候选失败链，证实了"持久状态诱导的动作失败"这一恢复缺口。

Method: StateWise 由三个阶段组成：(1) 归因（Attribution）：使用受限的反事实重规划（counterfactual replanning），在固定其他规划输入的条件下，逐一干预候选记录并比较规划差异，结合类型与作用域绑定识别决策关键记录；(2) 解析（Resolution）：分层解析器对每个被归因的记录进行可靠性检查（类型、作用域、来源权威性、新鲜度、冲突证据），对机器可观测事实进行只读验证，对开发者意图进行定向澄清，并将每个记录分类为有效（valid）、有缺陷（defective）或未解决（unresolved）；(3) 修复与动作控制（Repair and Action Control）：通过类型化证据绑定（typed evidence grounding）将有缺陷的记录在已建立的作用域内进行持久化修复并保留修复谱系（repair lineage），随后从修复后的状态重规划，并由独立的状态-动作检查（state–action check）评估修订后的提案后再执行。形式化定义包括持久状态诱导动作失败的条件、可接受恢复的数学要求（作用域内更新、作用域外不变、动作安全约束），以及跨任务复用和接口条件迁移的框架。

Result: 在 150 个可执行编码智能体案例的主评估中，持久状态被破坏时 StateWise 达到 93.3% 的整体正确率（OC），基线智能体仅为 38.7%，且未观察到任何不安全动作（UAR=0）。在错误目标值的设置下也取得 88.0% OC，无不安全动作。具体结果：移除目标记忆仅使 OC 从 38.7% 提升到 45.3%；裸审批（OC=36.0%）和带理由审批（OC=40.7%）等基线策略虽避免了不安全动作但完成任务率低；CRITIC（OC=48.0%, UAR=28.0%）、Safety Sentry（OC=很低，UAR=4.7%）等基线方法效果有限；MemLineage 与 Ask-or-Assume 等在跨任务序列中后续任务完成率仅 1.0%–6.2%。组件消融显示，移除 Resolution 使 OC 下降 78.7 个百分点，移除持久修复下降 76.7 个百分点，移除归因下降 53.3 个百分点，移除类型化绑定下降 27.3 个百分点。在四个规划模型（GPT-5.6-sol、DeepSeek v4 Pro、Qwen 3.7 Max、Claude Fable 5）上 OC 范围为 80.0%–94.4%，均无安全违规。32 个四任务序列测试中，StateWise 的 AFS（All-Future Safe）达 90.6%，与正确记忆参考水平（87.5%）相当，而基线方法 AFS 均不超过 3.1%。在 106 个未见配置案例上达到 93.4% OC 和 92.6% AC，无不安全动作，验证了跨仓库、工具操作和状态类型的迁移能力。

Conclusion: 论文将持久化状态恢复纳入智能体可靠执行的组成部分。StateWise 通过在动作-记录依赖性、当前有效性证据和有作用域的持久修复之间建立对应关系，将动作触发的验证转化为可复用的状态维护。其核心贡献在于：明确了"持久状态诱导动作失败"的形式化条件，提出了预动作恢复框架弥补了仅阻止操作而不修正底层前提的缺口，并通过全面的实证评估证明该框架在恢复正确性、跨任务持久性、跨模型与跨接口迁移性方面的有效性。未来工作需要更长周期的部署研究、多记录交互、独立人类标注、冲突修正以及跨外部服务和协作智能体的扩展。

Abstract: LLM agents combine reasoning, tool use, and persistent memory to support work across tasks by reusing stored operational records as premises for later actions. However, environmental or requirement changes can invalidate these records, while existing action review, provenance tracking, and clarification mechanisms may leave the underlying persistent state uncorrected. Our audit of coding-agent trajectories identifies candidate failure chains in which invalid records are reused, leading to task failures and unsafe modifications. We propose StateWise, a framework for diagnosing and repairing persistent operational state before action execution. StateWise uses record-level counterfactual replanning to identify decision-critical records, then establishes their current validity through reliability checks, read-only verification of machine-observable facts, and targeted clarification of developer-owned intent. Typed evidence grounding binds evidence to specific records and scopes, enabling persistent corrections with repair lineage. The agent then replans from the repaired state, followed by an independent state-action check before execution. We evaluate StateWise on 150 executable coding-agent cases across diverse runtime environments, workspace configurations, and repository settings, complemented by cross-model evaluations. Under corrupted persistent state, StateWise achieves 93.3% overall correctness, compared with 38.7% for the baseline agent, with no unsafe actions. Component ablations, multi-task experiments, and transfer evaluations further demonstrate effective recovery, persistent corrections, and transferability across repositories and tool interfaces.

</details>


### [167] [UndoBench: Separating Task Competence from Recovery Capability in Tool-Using AI Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05622)
*Dolly Sah,Tanmay Sah,Harshul Jain,Tanya Sah*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: UndoBench是一个针对工具调用AI智能体的基准测试，通过配对对照试验将"任务能力"与"故障恢复能力"解耦，发现现有智能体在分布式系统丢失确认（lost-ACK）场景下存在严重的副作用重复问题，且恢复能力具有阶段依赖性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有智能体基准（如SWE-bench、ToolBench、WebArena）几乎只在无扰动的标称条件下评估智能体，将基线规划能力与运行期故障恢复混为一谈，未能捕捉分布式系统中"已提交但确认丢失"等分布式危害导致的副作用重复（如重复扣款）。

Method: 构建36个企业工作流+36个故障场景的UndoBench，采用相同随机种子下的配对反事实试验，配合线级（wire-level）效果历史与环境状态双预言机；定义CRSR（条件恢复成功率）、DER（重复效果率）等指标；评估12个TEST工作流上2个开源模型（Llama-3.1-8B/3.2-3B）、2个框架（Direct Tool Calling/LangGraph）、3种恢复范式（Naive Retry/Idempotency/EvoUndo），共5,760次执行/2,880次配对试验（POST_MUTATION_PRE_ACK丢失确认窗口），并扩展至商用API模型（Gemini 3.8 Flash、GLM-5.2 MaaS）及其他执行边界（PRE_MUTATION、DURING_MUTATION）。

Result: 在主要研究中，标称任务能力达83.54%，但条件恢复成功率（CRSR）骤降至46.72%，无确认重试在53.33%的试验中产生重复外部副作用；幂等性（Idempotency）相对朴素重试带来+10.72 pp描述性提升，但因多数端点不支持去重而未达统计显著；零权限EvoUndo-RB1与朴素重试几近持平。商用API模型扩展复现了能力-恢复分离现象（Gemini CRSR仅21.08%，DER达65.62%）。多边界分析表明：PRE_MUTATION阶段各方法表现相近且无重复效果；DURING_MUTATION阶段朴素重试、每调用幂等与零权限日志均崩溃（0% CRSR）；POST_MUTATION_PRE_ACK阶段验证-重试与服务端幂等性显著改善安全性。全范围服务端幂等干预（B₂-K）将CRSR提升至97.24%，DER归零。

Conclusion: 标称任务完成率严重高估了工具调用智能体的运行可靠性；恢复不是单线性级能力，而是随外部变更生命周期演变的阶段依赖型系统属性；评估必须解耦任务能力与恢复能力，并通过线级效果监控与状态预言机检测重复副作用；服务端幂等性与验证-重试是降低POST_MUTATION丢失确认风险的有效机制。

Abstract: Tool-using AI agents are increasingly deployed across enterprise software systems, yet widely used benchmarks primarily evaluate nominal task completion, conflating baseline planning competence with operational fault recovery. We introduce UndoBench, a benchmark spanning 36 base workflows and 36 fault scenarios across 8 enterprise domains, decoupling task competence from recovery capability via counterfactual paired trials under identical seeds alongside wire-level effect-history and environment-state oracles. On 12 held-out TEST workflows across two open-weight models, two frameworks, and three recovery paradigms (5,760 executions / 2,880 paired trials) in the frozen lost-acknowledgment study, nominal competence reached 83.54% while conditional recovery success rate (CRSR) fell to 46.72%, with naive retry producing duplicate external effects in 53.33% of trials. Extensions to commercial API models reproduced this competence-recovery separation. Evaluations across complementary execution boundaries show that recovery is phase-dependent: before mutation, methods perform similarly without duplicate effects among capable trials; during partial mutation, naive retry, per-call idempotency, and zero-privilege journaling collapse on the evaluated composite workflows; after commit but before acknowledgment, verification and server-side idempotency substantially improve safety. These findings demonstrate that evaluating nominal completion alone masks critical, phase-dependent recovery vulnerabilities in autonomous agents.

</details>


### [168] [AgentSpy: Making AI Agent Behavior Observable](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06001)
*Christoph Bühler,Matteo Biagiola,Luca Di Grazia,Guido Salvaneschi*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: AgentSpy 是一个通过系统级监控（系统调用和网络流量）从外部观察 AI 智能体行为的框架，在隔离的 microVM 环境中运行智能体及其所有子进程，并基于监控结果提供两类确定性分析：可靠性分析（衡量义务，如是否遵循技能指导）和安全分析（检查禁令，如是否访问私钥），无需依赖智能体自身报告。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于 LLM 的 AI 智能体在用户权限下执行 shell 命令、读写文件、访问网络，但其执行过程难以理解：测试仅断言结果，智能体轨迹仅记录其自报内容，可能遗漏子进程行为，导致最终结果正确但实际行为偏离任务（如执行无关活动、未使用开发者指导、甚至触发安全违规）。现有方法（基于结果的测试、静态分析、轨迹分析）均无法提供完整、确定性且独立于智能体的运行时观测。

Method: AgentSpy 由三个组件构成：(1) Orchestrator 根据声明式 execution kind 配置并启动隔离的 Firecracker microVM 环境；(2) Execution Manager 在环境内配置依赖、设置监控、运行 agent（codex CLI）并收集运行产物；(3) Analysis Runner 基于产物进行分析。可靠性分析利用 auditd+laurel+Zeek 记录系统调用与网络流量，提取执行过的命令、访问的文件、联系的主机三类资源，构建星形图（star graph），通过加权 Jaccard 相似度和技能覆盖率（skill coverage）指标来刻画智能体行为。安全分析使用 Falco eBPF 驱动，对系统调用应用四类确定性规则：(1) 读取凭证/密钥；(2) 在工作区外修改/删除文件；(3) 从不可信位置运行程序并提权；(4) 连接不可信域名。

Result: 可靠性分析（RQ1）：在 SkillsBench 的 77 个任务 × 3 个 LLM（gpt-5.6-terra、deepseek-v4-flash、glm-5.3-flash）上各运行 3 次，相同任务的重复执行集在 92.2% 的比较中比混入另一任务执行集的相似度更高，文件资源类型的判别力最强。RQ2：在 88 个全部通过测试的任务-模型对中，手工检查发现 18.2% 的任务存在与任务无关的活动（主要为未请求的网络访问 8 项、环境探索 5 项、测试文件读取 6 项），17.0% 在未使用技能指导的情况下得出结果，两评估者 Cohen's κ 达 0.96/0.92。安全分析（RQ3）：在 Skill-Inject 基准的 5 类攻击上运行 50 次，精确率 1.00，召回率 0.78，成功检测 5 类中的 4 类（数据泄露、销毁、拒绝服务、恶意软件），对良性任务无误报，仅漏报 backdoor 类攻击（因修改 git remote 未触发网络边界）。效率（RQ4）：对 12 组对比任务，监控工具开启与否的运行时间无显著差异（p ≥ 0.16，效应量小至中等）。

Conclusion: AgentSpy 通过系统级监控弥补了智能体轨迹分析的不足：基于确定性规则而非 LLM-as-judge，提供完整、独立于智能体的行为证据，能揭示通过测试但偏离任务意图的行为，并有效检测技能注入攻击，同时不引入显著的运行时开销。两类分析（义务/禁令）彼此互补，无法相互替代，框架可扩展以支持更多分析器。

Abstract: AI agents built on large language models (LLMs) run shell commands, read and write files, and reach the network, typically with their user's privileges. However, what an agent does during an execution is difficult to understand: tests assert on the result, and the agent's trajectory records only what the agent reports about itself, which may omit behavior executed by its subprocesses. We present AgentSpy, an approach that observes an agent from outside the agent. AgentSpy runs the agent in an isolated environment, configured by a declarative specification, and records the system calls and network traffic of the agent and of every process it executes. Based on this monitoring, AgentSpy supports two families of analyses: conformance analyses, which measure obligations, i.e., what an agent execution should do, and safety analyses, which check prohibitions, i.e., what an agent execution must never do. We instantiate one analysis of each family. The reliability analysis uses rules to summarize each run by the environment resources the agent uses: the commands it executed, the files it accessed, and the hosts it contacted. The security analysis applies deterministic rules to the system calls of an execution. For reliability, we evaluated AgentSpy on 77 tasks with the codex harness and three recent LLMs, executing each task three times. Sets of repeated runs of the same task are more similar than sets that include runs of another task in 92.2% of the comparisons. Among tasks for which all three runs pass outcome-based tests, the agent performs task-unrelated activities in 18% of the cases, reads the grading files in 7%, and does not use the developers' guidance in 17%. For security, the generic rules of AgentSpy detect four of five attack categories we considered, with no false positives across 50 runs.

</details>


### [169] [Correct Code, Broken Contributions? SWE-CC: Benchmarking Repository Policy Compliance for Coding Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06193)
*Hai Dang Truong,Rayner Goh,Thanh Le-Cong,Yintong Huo*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文提出 SWE-CC，首个评估自主编码智能体在 GitHub 仓库治理政策（含代码风格、Git 规范、测试工作流等）下合规性的基准。它从 12 个开源仓库的贡献文档中提炼出 823 条机器可检查的原子策略，覆盖智能体的运行时行为与最终交付物。在 SWE-bench Verified 衍生的 500 个端到端任务上对 4 个 LLM × 2 个智能体框架进行评估，发现即便生成功能正确的补丁，智能体仍违反 43.1% 的适用策略，且近半数违规仅能在轨迹审计中检出，揭示功能正确与真正可合并贡献之间的鸿沟。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 SWE-bench 等基准仅以单元测试评判智能体补丁的功能正确性，忽视了成熟开源项目通过贡献指南规定的代码风格、提交规范、测试流程与文档标准等仓库级策略。实践中已有智能体在代码冻结期误删数据库等严重事件，且不合规的 AI 提交给维护者带来大量额外审核负担。因此，亟需一个能同时审计智能体运行时轨迹与最终交付物的策略合规基准，以弥合"高分通过测试"与"高质量可合并 PR"之间的鸿沟。

Method: 方法包括半自动化构建流水线与合规审计机制两部分。(1) 流水线分 5 步：定位贡献指南 → LLM 抽取原子策略（前件+后件）→ 按"可检验、贡献者职责、强制性"过滤 → 将每条策略编译为轻量确定性 checker 函数（含 precondition 和 post_condition，并配套满足/违反/不适用三类合成测试）→ 经 Claude Opus 5 自动审查与人工盲审验证。(2) 审计机制对智能体的完整执行轨迹 τ=(t1,...,tN) 与最终输出 C 同时执行所有 checker，输出 0/1/⊥（违反/通过/不适用）。(3) 提出两个互补指标：触发率（策略被激活的比例）和合规率（被触发策略中通过的比例），并新增 Native（提供文档 URL 由智能体自行检索）与 Consolidated（将策略文件挂载到环境）两种策略提供设置。

Result: 在 500 个任务 × 4 个 LLM（GPT-5.6 Luna、Gemini 3.7 Flash、DeepSeek V4 Flash、Kimi K2.5）× 2 个框架（mini-SWE-agent、OpenHands）× 2 种设置共 8000 次运行上：(1) 即便最强的 DeepSeek V4 Flash+OpenHands 在 Native 下合规率仅 63.8%、Consolidated 下仅 71.2%，平均违反 43.1% 适用策略；(2) 50.3% 的违规发生在中间执行步骤（如未运行测试即提交），仅靠最终补丁审计无法检出；(3) Native 设置下智能体平均仅在 28.9% 的执行中尝试获取策略文档，仅 12.6% 成功检索到文本；(5) 提供 Consolidated 策略后合规率平均提升 8.75%，但 GPT-5.6 Luna 在功能解决率上反而下降约 1-2 个百分点；(6) AI 协助贡献政策合规率最低（Native 仅 15.3%），智能体普遍遗漏强制披露要求。人工核查的 150 个 checker 接受率达 87.2%，Cohen's κ=0.72，证明流水线保真度高。

Conclusion: SWE-CC 证明当前自主编码智能体在仓库级策略合规方面存在系统性缺陷：功能正确并不等同于真实可用。半数违规发生在执行轨迹中，表明未来智能体不仅需要写对代码，还需主动发现、推理并贯穿整个工作流遵守仓库治理规范。提升 OpenHands 可识别同时需要在两条路径：(a) 强化策略检索能力（如智能体在 Native 下近 71.1% 未检索文档)，CLAUDE.md 能提高触发率；(b) 增强直接策略推理能力，即便策略完全注入上下文，仍有近 30% 违规此类基准将随仓库、模型与框架持续扩展，倡导在报告功能正确性之外同步报告合规率，以推动安全、可部署、对齐真实开发者规范的自主软件工程师。

Abstract: Autonomous coding agents now resolve a substantial share of real-world GitHub issues. However, passing functional tests differs fundamentally from producing a high-quality contribution acceptable for merging. Mature open-source projects publish repository-specific contribution policies, spanning style, git, testing workflows, to ensure code quality and long-term maintainability. Because existing benchmarks evaluate patches solely on unit tests, agent compliance with repository governance remains unknown. In this paper, we introduce SWE-CC, a benchmark evaluating code and process compliance in autonomous software engineering. We develop a semi-automated pipeline that converts developer documentation across 12 open-source repositories into 823 machine-checkable atomic policies. SWE-CC introduces two features: 1) lightweight, deterministic checker functions that represent each policy, 2) a comprehensive auditing mechanism that inspects both agent runtime behaviors and final deliverables. We evaluate the compliance of agent workflows in 500 end-to-end software contribution tasks extended from SWE-bench Verified. Our evaluation of four LLMs under two agent scaffolds shows that modern agents suffer from coding compliance issues: although agents produce functionally correct patches, they still violate 43.1 percent of applicable project policies, with nearly half of all violations occurring during intermediate execution steps. These results show that functional correctness does not guarantee real-world readiness, highlighting that future software engineering agents must reliably conform to repository governance to enable safe and trustworthy deployment.

</details>


### [170] [Choosing an energy-efficient software architecture for building system diagnostic support](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06444)
*Roxane Koitz-Hristov,Franz Wotawa*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文针对建筑HVAC系统的故障检测与诊断（FDD）软件，提出了一种综合考虑诊断性能（检测率、误报率）与软件自身计算能耗的能量消耗模型（ECM与EECM），并在仿真实验中比较了基于规则、基于模型、传统机器学习和决策树的大型语言模型四类架构。结果表明，不存在普遍最优的能效FDD架构；办公建筑中微调LLM净节能最大，单户住宅中推理频率会影响方法排序。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 建筑领域占全球能耗约30%，相当部分能耗损失源于未修复故障。FDD软件虽能通过检测故障节能，但其本身的创建与运行也消耗能源并产生碳排放。现有研究多孤立讨论软件能耗或诊断精度，缺少将二者结合以评估FDD软件整体生态足迹的模型与方法。

Method: 1. 建立ECM：基于建筑能耗强度、面积、HVAC占比及故障能耗占比，结合诊断的真阳性率TPR和假阳性率FPR，量化诊断后建筑HVAC年能耗。2. 建立EECM：在ECM基础上增加训练能耗与单次推理能耗，考虑LLM的效用因子U。3. 从Chen等综述及多源文献中提取规则、模型、ML（DT、RF、LR、SVM、MLP）和LLM（含微调）等方法的TPR/FPR范围与训练/推理能耗值。4. 在R中通过蒙特卡洛仿真（100万实例）开展六组实验，覆盖不同建筑面积、训练次数、推理频率及单户住宅场景。

Result: 1. 办公建筑中，软件训练与推理能耗相对HVAC自身能耗可忽略，方法排序主要取决于TPR/FPR：微调LLM节能约19.7%–20%，MBD/RF/DT/MLP/SVM约11%–12%，RB、未微调LLM最低（约5%–7%）。2. 单户住宅因HVAC总能耗显著降低，软件能耗影响显现：RF、SVM在每分钟高频推理下更优；当推理间隔≥2分钟时，微调LLM重回最优。3. 推理频率变化能改变方法排名，但训练次数影响极小。4. 总体上，最优架构取决于诊断性能、训练/推理能耗与建筑规模三者的权衡。

Conclusion: 不存在普遍能效最高的FDD软件架构。微调Transformer方法在多数场景下提供最大净节能，尤其在建筑规模较大时；计算高效的ML方法（如RF）在小建筑或高频推理下具优势。未来工作需基于统一基准采集诊断性能与能耗数据，并将模型应用于真实建筑数据以验证实用性。

Abstract: Around 30\% of global energy expenditure can be attributed to the building sector, where a large portion of energy-consumption could be avoided by repairing existing faults. Fault detection and diagnosis (FDD) software addresses this issue; however, its creation and operation also have an environmental impact. The magnitude of this impact is influenced by the diagnosis architecture, as different architectures and methods have different energy demands. Yet, simply considering the energy consumed by the software itself is not sufficient to assess its overall environmental impact, since the diagnostic performance, e.g., number of detected faults or number of faults missed, also contributes to its ecological footprint. In this paper, we propose an energy-consumption model that considers FDD performance and energy spend directly by the diagnosis software. In an initial experiment, we compare several FDD architecture families, i.e., rule-based, model-based, classical machine learning, and large-language-model-based, in simulation using performance and energy-consumption values collected from prior literature. The results show that considering the computational energy and accuracy of FDD can change the relative benefit of the different approaches. Computationally efficient machine learning methods, such as random forest, provide the largest net savings on smaller buildings, whereas more resource-intensive approaches, such as fine-tuned large language models, become advantageous as building size increases. Our findings suggest that overall energy efficiency depends not only on the computational demand of the FDD software, but also on its diagnostic performance and the scale of the building.

</details>


### [171] [Smells and Refactorings for Software Environmental Sustainability: A Systematic Literature Review](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03838)
*Ornela Danushi,Flavio Sampirisi,Jacopo Soldani,Stefano Forti,Antonio Brogi*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文是一篇系统文献综述（SLR），旨在识别影响软件环境可持续性的"绿色坏味"（green smells），并将其映射到相应的重构技术，以减轻软件对生态环境的负面影响。研究分析了截至2026年3月发表的66篇主要研究，归纳出20种绿色坏味和33种重构方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: ICT行业目前约占全球碳排放量的2%，且呈上升趋势。现有文献多关注硬件层面的能效改进，而忽视了软件本身的结构性低效问题。这些被称为"绿色坏味"的软件设计或开发中的不良决策，会在整个软件生命周期中持续增加能源消耗。然而，相关知识分散在大量文献中，开发者难以系统性地识别和解决此类问题。因此，亟需一份系统化的坏味-重构映射表，为开发者和研究者提供实用指导。

Method: 采用系统文献综述（SLR）方法，遵循软件工程领域的既定指南。使用PICO框架设计搜索字符串，结合三个关键词组（软件、环境可持续性、坏味/重构），在ACM Digital Library、IEEE Xplore、Scopus、Web of Science和SpringerLink五大数据库中检索。初步检索到697篇候选文献，经去重后剩594篇；通过标题与摘要筛选（纳入/排除标准）缩减至136篇；全文筛选后保留32篇；再通过反向雪球采样补充77篇，最终筛选后纳入66篇主要研究。筛选过程采用两位作者独立评估、第三位作者解决分歧的方式，并通过Krippendorff-α系数衡量评分者间一致性。最终通过主题编码法对文献进行迭代分类，归纳坏味与重构。

Result: 研究产出了一个包含20种绿色坏味和33种对应重构方法的分类目录。20种绿色坏味按出现频次排序为：低效数据结构、多职责类、过度循环、持久资源使用、繁重图形、低效传输、过度封装、冗余代码、过高事件频率、过度间接、过度委派、长函数、重复计算、低效并行、错误变量类型、低效算法、低效第三方API、单功能运行、解释型编程语言、无用递归。每种坏味均关联至少一种重构技术，例如"低效数据结构"对应"使用优化的数据结构"，"过度委派"对应"减少委派"等。同时给出了每篇研究文献与各类坏味的对应分类表。

Conclusion: 该研究证实了学术界对绿色坏味问题的关注。所构建的坏味-重构目录对实践者具有实用价值，可直接融入日常开发工作流；同时也为研究者指明了未来方向，包括构建决策支持工具（如基于ATAM树或决策模型），帮助开发者在考虑环境影响的同时权衡与其他软件质量属性（如可维护性、性能）的关系，并探索绿色坏味的自动检测以及重构的（半）自动化实施方法。本研究是与Le Goaër工作最接近的，但首次将绿色坏味与重构的目录拓展为领域无关的通用视角。

Abstract: Context: The environmental impact of ICT is constantly growing. Enhancing its environmental sustainability requires dealing with energy-hungry software systems, by possibly reducing their footprint. Objective: To better frame the problem and its persistent nature, software can be viewed as carrying structural inefficiencies regardless of how advanced its functionality may be. Identifying these inefficiencies as "green smells" provides a basis for refactoring code to mitigate its ecological impact. We aim at identifying well-known green smells impacting environmental sustainable software and map them to corresponding refactoring aimed at reducing the impact therein. Method: In this article, we conduct a systematic literature review on the articles that discuss green smells and their possible refactorings. We analyse and classify 66 primary studies published up to March 2026. Results: We identify 20 smells impacting environmental sustainability of software. Each smell is associated with one or more refactoring techniques known to mitigate their negative effects on the environmental sustainability of software. Conclusions: The literature witnesses the interest in resolving the green smells affecting software systems. The catalogued green smells and the corresponding refactorings can provide pragmatic value for practitioners in their daily development workflows, while also offering researchers a starting point to establish new research directions in sustainable software engineering.

</details>


### [172] [Characterizing Open-Source Video Games from a Software Engineering Perspective](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03953)
*Henrique Mandelli Canella,Yohan Duarte,Cristiano Politowski,Vinicius Durelli,Andre Takeshi Endo*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 这是一篇对491个itch.io平台开源视频游戏项目进行软件工程特征化分析的实证研究。研究从游戏类型、玩家评分、仓库活跃度、实现特性（引擎与资产）以及测试实践五个维度展开，主要发现：开源游戏集中在Puzzle/Action/Platformer类型；Godot和Unity是最常用的引擎；2D图像类资源占主导；仅7.33%的项目包含自动化测试；有测试的项目提交率为无测试项目的3.34倍，但测试与玩家评分无显著相关。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 游戏产业规模巨大（2023年达930亿美元），但游戏软件工程领域缺乏基于实际代码库的实证研究。开源游戏提供了商业项目无法获得的开发制品（代码、issue、PR、构建脚本、测试等），是补充现有调查研究和可重复实证分析的重要语料。本研究旨在填补这一空白，对开源视频游戏进行全面的软件工程特征刻画。

Method: 多阶段方法论：①以Di Sipio等人(2025)的10,548个itch.io项目数据集为起点；②通过Levenshtein距离模糊匹配验证项目名与GitHub URL映射；④通过GitHub API收集仓库元数据（commits、stars、forks、contributors、issues等）；⑤通过匹配特征文件/目录自动检测引擎（Unity的ProjectSettings、Godot的project.godot、GameMaker的.yyp等）；⑥按扩展名统计资产（图像、3D模型、音频、字体、着色器、tilemap）；⑦通过关键词匹配（test、spec、__tests__等）检测测试套件并人工核验；⑧用本地LLM（gpt-oss:20b）从Markdown文档中提取测试指南；⑨采用负二项GLM和OLS回归分析测试与活跃度、评分的关系。最终经过人工质量筛选，从547→500→491个项目。

Result: ①类型分布：Puzzle(103)、Action(97)、Platformer(69)占大头；58.9%无评分，有评分的项目平均分普遍>4.0；②仓库活跃度严重右偏：平均commits 333.38，但79个项目≤5 commits；超过300个项目无issue记录；③引擎分布：Godot(24.4%)和Unity(17.1%)主导，47%未检测到标准引擎；④资产以2D图像为主（均值152.39），3D模型很少（均值6.82）；⑤测试实践：仅36个项目(7.33%)含自动化测试，14.05%提及bug报告，8.15%记录测试实践，4.28%提供贡献者测试指导；⑥回归分析：有测试的项目提交率为无测试的3.34倍（p<0.001），但测试与玩家评分无显著关联（β=-0.09, p=0.545）。

Conclusion: 开源视频游戏生态呈现"Kei Games"特征——小型团队聚焦有限范围、依赖Godot/Unity、追求创意而非工程严谨性。测试虽稀缺但与持续开发活跃度相关，提示轻量级测试可支撑项目可持续维护；但测试与玩家感知质量无关，表明玩家更看重体验性因素（玩法、节奏、艺术）而非后端稳定性。研究贡献包括491项目元数据集、对实现/测试模式的分析以及测试与活跃度/评分的量化关系，为后续工具开发（如引擎特定测试运行器、资产感知回归检查、隐私保护崩溃报告）和小团队软件工程实践改进提供基线参考。

Abstract: Video games hold a prominent role in the entertainment industry, which constitutes a multibillion-dollar global market. Within this ecosystem, independent studios, small teams, and solo developers operate with constrained budgets while making their games available through platforms such as this http URL , where many projects are also available as open-source. Where even if the project is fully released, other developers can still have access to the development process through the source code, helping other developers to develop their own games. These open-source games also constitute a valuable corpus for empirical software engineering research, offering transparent access to development artifacts that are typically inaccessible in commercial projects. This study characterizes open-source video games from a Software Engineering standpoint, focusing on their genres, popularity, repository activity, implementation characteristics, and testing practices. To this end, we extracted metadata from 491 video games from this http URL , published as open-source projects in GitHub. The results indicate that open-source games predominantly fall within limited genres (Puzzle, Action, and Platformer), that player ratings, when available, tend to be high, bringing a perception that the community receives well those kind of games, that repositories are largely dormant or minimally maintained, that the majority of these projects adopt either Godot or Unity as their game engine, and that documentation of testing-related practices is seldom included. The results offer insights into the development of open-source video games and may contribute to advancing software engineering practices and tools designed for small teams and independent game developers.

</details>


### [173] [How Do Coding Agents Optimize Software and Report Performance Validation? A Large-Scale Empirical Study of Open-Source Pull Requests](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03969)
*Huiyun Peng,Ricardo Calvo,Kelechi G. Kalu,James C. Davis*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文对2,260个性能优化PR（1,130个由AI编码代理提交，1,130个由人类提交）进行了大规模实证研究，比较了两者在采用结果、优化策略、验证实践和报告的性能指标方面的差异。研究发现代理PR采用率较低但优化策略与人类相似，验证报告率相当但代理更依赖静态推理，且两组中约一半报告验证的PR未提供可提取的量化性能指标。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着自主AI编码代理开始向开源项目提交性能优化PR，亟需了解这些代理是否遵循既定的优化实践，以及其声称的性能改进是否得到充分验证。现有研究对此缺乏大规模实证分析。

Method: 基于AIDev数据集扩展至2026年6月，构建1,130个代理PR与1,130个人类PR的1:1平衡样本。使用SysLLMatic目录（59种模式）的优化模式分类、三模型多数投票的验证证据分类、正则表达式的性能指标提取，以及卡方检验、Mann-Whitney U检验、逻辑回归和置换检验等统计方法进行比较分析。

Result: 代理PR合并率较低（54.4% vs 73.3%），但合并时间更短。两组优化策略分布相似（V=0.088），均覆盖44/43种模式。验证报告率相近（82.3% vs 80.6%），但代理更依赖静态推理（51.4% vs 39.3%），人类更依赖基准测试（57.2% vs 46.1%）；代理的基准使用随时间增加至与人类持平。仅约一半报告验证的PR提供可提取的量化指标（代理50.9%，人类52.4%），缓存/缓冲PR中仅17.7%同时报告运行时收益与不利的内存影响。人类对代码异味重构的验证和指标报告率低于资源定向优化，而代理无此差异。

Conclusion: 代理与人类的优化策略已趋同，但支持性证据仍不充分。核心挑战从生成合理优化转向证明其有效性。未来应建立量化、多维度的评估基础设施和审查标准，衡量预期效果和相关代价，而非仅以验证存在与否为充分条件。

Abstract: Software performance optimization requires identifying bottlenecks and improvement opportunities, and empirically evaluating the effects and trade-offs across performance objectives. Autonomous AI coding agents submit performance-oriented pull requests (PRs) to open-source projects, yet it remains unclear whether these changes reflect established optimization practices and adequately substantiate their claimed value. Extending our MSR 2026 Mining Challenge pilot study of 407 performance PRs, we analyze a sample of 1,130 agentic and 1,130 human-authored performance PRs collected through June 2026. We compare adoption outcomes and patch characteristics between the two groups, and examine their optimization practices and validation behaviors. The results show that agentic PRs are merged less often than human-authored PRs (54.4% vs. 73.3%), but the two groups use similar optimization strategies and report validation at comparable rates. Agentic PRs rely more on static reasoning and less on benchmarks (46.1% vs. 57.2%), although benchmark use converges by the end of the study period. Agentic PRs also report validation for code-smell refactorings as often as for resource-targeting changes, whereas human-authored PRs do so less often. Across both groups, about half of validated PRs report no quantitative performance metric, and relevant trade-offs are rarely quantified. Agentic optimization practice has become increasingly similar to human practice, but the supporting evidence remains incomplete. Establishing whether agent-proposed optimizations are supported by rigorous, quantitative, and multidimensional evidence remains an important challenge. These findings motivate evaluation infrastructure and review criteria that measure intended effects and relevant costs rather than treating the presence of validation alone as sufficient.

</details>


### [174] [World Requirement Model: Learning Requirement-Change Consequences from Typed Artifact Graphs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.04445)
*Yuanpeng He,Lijian Li,Dongming Jin,Huanyao Zhang,Fangjing Li,Linyu Li,Chung-ju Huang,Tianxiang Zhan,Qingsong Wen,Wenpin Jiao*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: WRM 提出将需求工程上下文编码为类型化工件图，通过关系感知注意力与类型传播预测需求变更的影响、冲突、违规和缺陷风险。在合成数据上，WRM 在影响排序 MAP 上比最强基线提升 16.2%，最低四分位提升 32.4%，但存在选择偏差、回滚能力有限等问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 需求变更可能级联影响相关利益相关者、约束、组件和测试。工程师需要将这些工件的工程关系与文本内容结合，预测变更后果以辅助评审决策。现有方法（NLP 分类、规则传播、LLM 提示）在表达类型化工件关系与共享后果评分方面存在不足。

Method: WRM 将需求世界建模为类型化有向多重图（8 类节点、10 类关系），使用 Qwen2.5 + LoRA 编码文本，经关系偏置图注意力与后果传播层（CPL）进行类型化聚合，再通过利益相关者接地头（SGCH）产生决策条件表示。共享读出头分别对影响、冲突、违规和缺陷风险评分；辅助目标包括后继邻接重建与潜在预测对齐（类似 I-JEPA）。提出候选闭包、动作-标签对齐、选择分离三项评估契约，并证明候选集上限与下尾加权命题。

Result: 在 28 个评分案例上，WRM 影响 MAP 为 0.724，优于哈希文本 MLP 的 0.623（相对提升 16.2%，配对差 0.101，95% CI [0.044, 0.159]）；最低四分位均值提升 32.4%，等域权重 MAP 提升 13.3%。四个扩展语料设置中 MAP 提升 15.6%–29.1%。但候选覆盖分析显示平均可达 AP 上限为 0.894，56 个测试冲突全部含排除端点（冲突召回为 0），276/282 后继图为空，线性影响头在固定世界下无法跨决策重排工件。作者明确指出检查点基于评分案例选择、骨架网络不匹配，结果仅刻画选定系统。

Conclusion: WRM 在类型化工件上下文下的共享后果评分上具备优势，可作为更强的上下文优先级排序工具，支持工程审查中的可解释工件标识。但完整需求世界预测仍需候选闭包、对齐决策、独立评估与动作敏感读出头；工业场景下尚需验证排序增益能否转化为审查效率提升。作者发布包含数据快照、对比结果、分析脚本的复现包，但完整神经复现需原始检查点与闭源模型访问。

Abstract: Requirement changes can affect connected stakeholders, constraints, components, and tests. We present World Requirement Model (WRM), which encodes this engineering context as a typed artifact graph and predicts consequences at shared artifact identifiers. Relation-aware attention and typed propagation contextualize nodes; world and decision representations support learned dynamics. Shared readouts score impact, conflict, violation, and defect risk; auxiliary objectives supervise successor adjacency and latent prediction. On 28 scored cases from 282 synthetic cases in six domains, WRM obtains impact mean average precision (MAP) of 0.724 versus 0.623 for a hashed-text multilayer perceptron (MLP), a 16.2\% relative gain and paired difference of 0.101 (conditional 95\% interval [0.044,0.159]). Lowest-quarter mean AP improves by 32.4\%, and equal-domain MAP by 13.3\%. Four 47-case comparisons on an expanded corpus show MAP gains of 15.6--29.1\% and higher means on all five reported metrics. The recorded advantage thus extends across score summaries and annotation/training settings. Checkpoints were selected on scored cases, and backbones are unmatched, so these results characterize selected systems. Our analysis establishes candidate-coverage bounds and shows that the current linear impact head cannot rerank a fixed world's artifacts across decisions. WRM contributes an artifact-addressed world-model formulation, comparative evidence for contextual consequence scoring, and explicit conditions for evaluating requirement-world prediction.

</details>


### [175] [Noise-Resilient Testing of Quantum Programs Based on Output Dominance](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.04461)
*Yuechen Li,Yige Yang,Tao Yue*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: Qomino提出了一种基于输出支配性的量子软件测试方法，无需噪声估计或缓解阶段，通过状态分解、Hoeffding置信决策和有界重试机制，从含噪样本中直接判定测试结果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有噪声感知QST方法需额外执行、校准或预训练模型来估计/缓解噪声，成本高且依赖后端信息；需要一种不恢复理想输出、直接从含噪观测中产生可靠判定的方法。

Method: Qomino包含三个组件：(1)基于二划分搜索的自动状态分解，将规格状态分成可分离子系统以构建更小规模的逆操作；(2)支配性分析——比较预期比特串与最强竞争者，结合Hoeffding不等式给出confident_pass/fail/inconclusive三类临时决策；(3)有界重试机制——预算内按几何调度增加采样次数以解决inconclusive决策。

Result: 在6个Qiskit程序、30个受控bug变体、6个模拟噪声后端的1500个电路上：FullCom组整体准确率85.65%，PartCom组99.95%，显著优于6个基线（统计类Chi2/JSDiv、量子专用QOPS/DOSS/Inverse、基于学习的QOIN）；运行时间低于量子专用与学习方法；消融实验证实三大组件均不可或缺；重试分析表明19.87%–34.13%测试触发重试，保守的fail回退比incon2pass减少47.51%–100%准确率损失。

Conclusion: Qomino是一种面向噪声后端的实用QST方法，通过支配性引导的工作流在无需噪声估计/缓解前提下取得更可靠的测试结果，且执行成本适中；未来工作包括扩展更大电路与更多程序、研究超参数敏感性以及针对电路特性自适应调整支配强度γ。

Abstract: Quantum software testing (QST) is a central quality-assurance activity for checking whether quantum programs conform to their specifications. In the noisy intermediate-scale quantum (NISQ) era, gate, decoherence, and measurement errors distort observed outputs, making it difficult to distinguish program defects from noise. The existing noise-aware QST literature typically mitigates or models noise before applying a test oracle. However, these strategies can incur substantial cost and depend on calibration data, model training, or backend-specific information, limiting their applicability. We present Qomino, a dominance-guided QST approach for judging tests from noisy samples without a separate noise-estimation or mitigation phase. The approach combines decomposition-aware inverse construction, comparison of the expected outcome with the strongest observed competitor, and bounded retries for inconclusive decisions. We evaluate Qomino on 30 controlled buggy variants from six Qiskit programs and six simulated noisy backends, comparing it with six baselines spanning statistical, quantum-specific, and learning-based methods. Qomino achieves 85.65% accuracy over all six programs and 99.95% in the restricted two-program evaluation, significantly outperforming the corresponding baselines. Across the evaluated programs and backends under the stated settings, Qomino is faster than the compared quantum-specific and learning-based methods. Ablation and retry analyses support the contributions of its main components.

</details>


### [176] [DreamTest: World-Model Surrogates for Search-Based Testing of Deep Reinforcement Learning Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.04494)
*Qinghua Xu,Guancheng Wang,Boxi Yu,Liting Lin,Lionel Briand*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文提出DreamTest,一种基于世界模型的代理模型,通过适应循环状态空间模型(RSSM)从DRL智能体的训练日志中学习智能体行为和环境动力学。给定候选配置,DreamTest生成想象中的rollout来预测失败,无需对每个候选执行模拟器。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 深度强化学习(DRL)智能体在信息物理系统(CPS)部署前需要进行测试以发现失败,但每次执行成本高昂。现有代理模型将系统视为黑盒,直接从配置预测通过/失败结果,无法利用训练过程中已有的逐步交互记录。本文认为应建模测试的展开过程,通过模拟想象的剧集来估计失败。

Method: 1. 数据收集:从DRL训练日志中获取每个episode的配置c、观测o、动作a、奖励r、终止标志d和结果y。2. 训练:适应RSSM,包括配置嵌入、初始化网络、循环状态空间模型和五个预测头(观测解码器、奖励模型、动作模型、完成模型、失败分类器),使用KL正则化和潜在超调训练。3. 推理:给定候选配置c,生成K个并行想象rollout,通过终止概率加权的失败预测计算失败分数s(c)。

Result: 在Parking、Humanoid和DonkeyCar三个基准测试中:DreamTest的平均AUPRC分别超过最强基线97%、12%和39%;在5个分布外测试集上增益达145%、29%和44%。在相同的模拟器验证预算下,最佳的"DreamTest+搜索"组合平均多发现29%、22%和79%的新颖失败。在k=2-40的聚类中,DreamTest发现的失败覆盖最多的行为聚类。消融研究证实了想象rollout和终止加权评分规则的贡献。

Conclusion: DreamTest是首个用于DRL智能体测试的世界模型代理模型,验证了从训练日志中学习世界模型并通过想象剧集评分配置的有效性。未来工作将探索新颖性感知搜索、查询真实策略而非行为克隆副本,以及将想象剧集转化为可读失败报告。

Abstract: Testing deep reinforcement learning (DRL) agents in cyber-physical systems aims to uncover diverse failures before deployment, but each execution can be expensive. Surrogate-assisted testing reduces this cost by learning to predict which test configurations are likely to fail. Prior surrogates treat the system as a black box and predict pass or fail outcomes directly; we instead model how a test unfolds and estimate failure from an imagined episode. We introduce DreamTest, a world-model surrogate for testing DRL agents. DreamTest adapts a recurrent state-space model to learn agent behaviour and environment dynamics from the agent's training log. Given a candidate configuration, imagined rollouts produce a failure score that guides search without executing every candidate in a simulator or real system. We evaluate DreamTest for failure prediction, test generation, and failure diversity on Parking, Humanoid, and DonkeyCar. Mean area under the precision-recall curve (AUPRC) exceeds the strongest baseline by 97%, 12%, and 39%, respectively, and gains on five out-of-distribution test sets reach 145%, 29%, and 44%. Under the same simulator-validation budget, the best "DreamTest + search" combinations find 29%, 22%, and 79% more novel failures on average. Across clusterings with k = 2-40, failures generated with DreamTest cover the most behavioural clusters for almost all k, indicating that DreamTest consistently discovers behaviourally diverse failures.

</details>


### [177] [Practical Runtime Enforcement of First-Order Temporal Requirements](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.04611)
*François Hublet,David Basin,Srđan Krstić*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文提出EnfFlash，一种高效的运行时强制执行工具，通过将Metric First-Order Temporal Logic (MFOTL)公式编译为命令式语言EF的程序来强制执行复杂的一阶时序需求（含provisions和义务）。在标准基准测试中延迟比现有技术EnfGuard低3-44倍，在LLM代理安全策略上低20-5,570倍，并能在Web应用中以1-15ms的开销强制执行400行GDPR规范。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现代系统需遵守日益复杂的合规需求，涉及对系统过去行为（provisions）和未来行为义务（obligations）的时序一阶约束。现有MFOTL强制执行工具（如EnfGuard、WhyEnf）虽支持复杂的provisions和obligations，但延迟高（秒级），不适合交互式和实时应用；而非时序访问控制（如Dogwood）仅支持provisions；临时专用强制执行器扩展性差。因此需要一个同时具备：声明式时序一阶规范、反应式和主动式强制执行、足够低延迟的工具。

Method: 方法包含三阶段——（a）设计领域特定语言EF用于编码主动式追逃行为，包括事件抑制、致因、窗口表（fixed）、延迟表、聚合算子、固定下垂计算（fixed-point），并证明其形式语义和复杂度上界（O(L·K_max·N_max^w)）。（b）提出从MFOTL到EF的编译过程：let规范化、将子公式置于let绑定后、守卫提取、重写规则生成强制执行子句，并使用Event Dependency Graph (EDG)检测cause-suppress冲突、Data-Flow Graph (DFG)判定终止性。（c）用类型系统刻画EF-MFOTL可强制执行片段，在lemGuard定理和Theorem B.3中证明类型性与成功编译的等价性。所有核心引理和定理在Lean 4中形式化验证。

Result: EnfFlash实现包含7k LOC OCaml编译器和4k LOC Rust解释器。四个研究问题评估——（RQ1表达性）支持EnfGuard基准全部40个策略（39个在超时内完成）和三个应用部署（GDPRSocial 400行GDPR规范、EventManager访问控制、LLM银行代理10个策略B1-B10）。（RQ2延迟）在20个EnfFlash和EnfGuard均处理的策略中，17个延迟低3-44倍；LLM代理策略延迟比EnfGuard低20-5,570倍，比Dogwood低1.8-16倍；平均每事件延迟0.08-3.8ms。（RQ3 Web应用开销）GDPRSocial页面查看开销1-15ms，不随数据量增长；EventManager上在4/6视图上快于Cedar，在'view events'和'view profile'上比Cedar快88-123倍；LLM代理防止143个提示注入攻击中的142个且无误报。

Conclusion: EnfFlash是首个为一阶时序provisions和obligations提供实用级性能的强制执行器，比之前最优技术快一到两个数量级。即使部署非常大的策略（如Web应用中的400行MFOTL公式），强制执行也仅引入1-15ms开销。这些结果表明一阶运行时强制执行工具已成为临时框架的成熟替代方案，包括在快速发展的代理安全领域。核心结果在Lean 4中形式化验证。

Abstract: Runtime enforcers observe a system's behavior and exert control over it to ensure that the system always adheres to its requirements. Many natural requirements not only formulate restrictions on the system's present behavior, but also impose obligations on its future behavior; for instance, agentic security may require personal data collected during a run to be erased by some deadline. In an ever-growing compliance landscape, real-world systems may be subject to hundreds of such requirements. However, existing enforcement mechanisms supporting complex policies are often too slow for production software; instead, developers may resort to non-temporal access control mechanisms and ad-hoc instrumentation, but these scale poorly with requirement complexity. To address this problem, we introduce an efficient algorithm and tool for enforcing complex temporal requirements and demonstrate its performance. Specifically, we identify a fragment of Metric First-Order Temporal Logic (MFOTL) that can be enforced with low runtime complexity while supporting a rich family of practically relevant requirements, including obligations. We then design an enforcement algorithm for this fragment and implement it in EnfFlash, a novel tool that enforces requirements with latency up to 44x lower than EnfGuard, the previous state-of-the-art enforcer, on standard benchmarks, and up to three orders of magnitude lower on security policies for LLM agents. This performance is achieved by compiling requirements into imperative programs that we efficiently interpret. We evaluate EnfFlash both standalone, on existing benchmarks, and integrated in web applications as an enforcement backend. We demonstrate that it can enforce a substantial 400-line MFOTL formula specifying the GDPR on a social network while adding under 15 ms to each page view, which is sufficient for most interactive and real-time applications.

</details>


### [178] [When Talk Isn't Code: Comparing LLM Agents That Simulate and Develop Software](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.04639)
*Xiang Li,Aichun Huang,Mingming Zhang,Zheli Liu*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文首次系统比较了LLM在两种模式下的网络安全协议实现能力：模拟模式（S-mode，模型在对话中扮演协议实现）和开发模式（D-mode，模型编写实际程序并接受攻击），并以知识探测（knowledge probe）为基线。研究发现，模型能口头说出安全检查但代码中却缺失，模拟模式可作为有效初筛但不能替代真实代码测试，安全需求必须明确书面化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM既被用于模拟网络协议（如蜜罐），也被用于编写协议实现代码。现有研究分别评估这两种用途，但从未在同一模型上比较"模型说什么"与"模型写什么"的一致性。初步实验显示存在严重的过度报告问题：模型在知识探测或对话中声称具备某项安全检查，但其生成的代码却缺乏该检查。

Method: 构建自动化测试框架（Python实现），统一规范、攻击套件（51个用例）和测试预言机。评估15个LLM在4个协议（DNS解析、IP分片重组、HTTP转发、防火墙规则匹配）上的表现。S-mode设置4个上下文级别（P0-P3），D-mode设置3个级别（D0-D2），知识探测提出开放式问题。共进行9,360次S-mode用例运行和8,661次D-mode用例评估，涉及641个生成程序。测试预言机通过安全参考实现验证（变异分析），确保每个V用例只检测其目标检查。D-mode程序在网络隔离沙箱中运行。

Result: 主要发现：(1) 在完整安全规范下，防火墙、HTTP和分片重组的中位攻击成功率在两种模式下均≤4%，但DNS在S-mode为13%、D-mode为15%；(2) 知识探测不能预测程序——13/14的模型能说出0x20检查，但42个程序全部缺失该检查；(3) 在规范中补充缺失的0x20要求后，攻击成功率从100%降至34%，且不影响其他检查（对照检查不变）；(4) 删除一条已声明的规则会导致程序整体变弱（跨检查退化）；(5) S-mode作为筛选测试的敏感性0.824、特异性0.959，但会过度报告D-mode缺失的检查、低估D-mode具有的检查，两种模式以相反方向误导；(6) 通过功能测试的程序仍可被利用（Kimi-2.6的D1分片重组程序全部通过公开测试但8/9攻击成功）。

Conclusion: S-mode是有用的初筛工具（标记82%真实DNS漏洞，对96%安全案例不误报），但不能替代D-mode测试。知识探测完全无法替代代码评估。核心启示：(1) 必须评估智能体构建的程序而非仅其对话内容；(2) 安全需求必须明确书面化，即使模型能口头复述；(3) 功能测试不能保证安全性，对抗性测试应纳入CI；(5) 应验证预言机与安全参考实现的一致性。研究边界：仅适用于网络协议实现，结论不直接推广到其他类型软件。

Abstract: LLMs are used both to simulate network protocol implementations, as honeypots do, and to write them. Prior work evaluates the two uses separately, from a model's answers or conversations in one case and from its generated code in the other. We observe that a knowledge probe (asking the model which security checks an implementation needs) and a conversation can credit security checks that the generated program lacks, but no study has compared them with the code the same model writes. To fill this gap, we present the first such comparison between simulation mode (S-mode), where the model plays the implementation in a conversation, and development mode (D-mode), where the model writes the program and the program is attacked, with a knowledge probe as a baseline. We design and implement a harness that judges all three with one attack suite and one oracle, and evaluate 15 LLMs on four protocol implementations. We find that with the full security specification, the median model's attack success is at most 4\% on reassembly, HTTP, and firewall implementations in both modes, but 13\% in S-mode and 15\% in D-mode on DNS. In D-mode, adding the missing DNS requirement to the specification cuts that attack from 100\% to 34\% and changes only that check, whereas deleting a stated rule weakens the program on other checks too. Asking the model beforehand does not predict which checks a program has, since 13 of the 14 models that write a DNS resolver name the check, yet all 42 programs lack it. S-mode is a useful first filter, flagging 82\% of the real DNS vulnerabilities and leaving 96\% of the safe cases unflagged. It errs in both directions, over-reporting security checks that D-mode does not implement and under-reporting checks that D-mode does. S-mode can screen but not replace D-mode testing, and security requirements should be written down even when a model can recite them.

</details>


### [179] [Back to the Future: Regressing Readability Features from LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.04641)
*Tairan Wang,Earl T. Barr*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文提出 BTTF 模型，通过将线性回归与基于预训练模型的"测量仪器式"特征（传统代码度量、嵌入语义组织、因果 LM 可预测性）相结合，实现了可解释且与人类判断高度对齐的代码可读性评估，在六个公开基准和受控可读性降级实验中均达到最优性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着 LLM 驱动的编码智能体快速普及，可读代码既便于人类审查智能体输出，也有助于智能体在有限上下文窗口中维护代码。然而现有可读性模型在不同标注设置下与人类判断的一致性较差，且特征方向常常与理论预期不一致。本文试图解决的核心问题是：如何在保持与人类判断一致性的同时，提供特征级可解释性。

Method: BTTF 采用"老派"线性回归（Ridge 回归，α=200）作为预测层，结合"新派"信息论特征，共 11 个可解释特征：(1) 四个传统代码度量（运算符密度、决策密度、表达式-字面量密度、最长行长）；(2) 两个嵌入空间特征（计算与控制模式数量、标识符嵌入离散度），使用 5 种嵌入模型通过 OPTICS/HDBSCAN/K-means/层次聚类等自适应聚类方法获得；(3) 五个因果 LM 可预测性特征（字面量尾部 surprisal、标识符起始 surprisal、赋值右侧 surprisal、声明 surprisal 变化、短标识符上下文依赖），通过 3 种因果代码 LM 的 teacher-forced 概率计算 bits-per-byte 度量。特征选择通过 L1 逻辑回归的稳定性选择（200 轮 bootstrap）在 15 个预训练模型组合上进行共识排序，取前 11 个稳定特征。

Result: BTTF 在六个公开人类评级基准（Buse、Scalabrino、Dorn、Schnappinger、JetBrains、MBJP）共 1100 个样本上，池化 10 折交叉验证和留一数据集出（LODO）评估的平均 Spearman 相关分别为 0.631 和 0.638，较最强基线平均提升 0.094 和 0.101（p ≤ 0.0032）。在 13 种可读性降级变换（涉及生产代码 Java/Python 各 100 个类、2800 个样本）上，BTTF 的正确响应率为 Java 93.8%、Python 87.6%，在本地模型中最优，仅落后最强云端 LLM（GPT-6.1 Sol）1.7% 和 5.1 个百分点。在所有 15 个预训练模型组合中，11 个特征的标准化 Ridge 系数方向 100% 匹配理论预期（165 个独立拟合系数均无符号翻转），绝对跨度均小于 0.019。特征家族消融显示三个家族互补：去除传统特征导致最大基准性能下降（0.176/0.163），去除因果 LM 特征导致最大响应率下降（Java -20.2%，Python -14.7%）。

Conclusion: BTTF 证明代码可读性建模不必在预测强度和可解释性之间权衡。将预训练模型用作测量仪器而非端到端判断器，BTTF 实现了与人类判断对齐的最新性能（SOA），并拥有稳定的可解释特征方向，支持开发者反馈、面向可读性的后训练以及自动化代码改进。代码、模型配置和交互式结果查看器已在 GitHub 公开。

Abstract: Code readability supports software understanding, review, and maintenance. As AI coding agents become more widely used, readable code helps both humans review agent-generated output and agents maintain code within limited context windows. Yet existing readability models do not consistently agree with human judgements across datasets. We introduce BTTF (Back To The Future), pairing linear regression with information-theoretic features. Rather than using language models as black-box judges, BTTF uses them as measurement instruments. It combines traditional code measurements, embedding-based semantic organisation, and causal-LM predictability to capture source structure, semantic coherence, and contextual surprise. We evaluate BTTF on five publicly available human-rated readability benchmarks and our manually annotated MBJP development set, totalling 1,100 samples. BTTF improves average Spearman correlation over the strongest baseline by up to 0.101. Across 13 controlled readability-reducing transformations on production code, it achieves response rates of 93.8% in Java and 87.6% in Python, outperforming Dorn by 14% and 19.2%. It performs best among local models and trails the strongest cloud-LLM response by 1.7% in Java and 5.1% in Python. The direct-LLM baselines require an average of 1,083 prompt tokens per evaluation while remaining opaque. BTTF combines state-of-the-art benchmark performance and strong transformation robustness with feature-granular interpretability: every feature coefficient matches its theoretical directional effect across all evaluated model configurations.

</details>


### [180] [Asymmetric Repository Lineage Modeling and Verifier-Guided Coordination in Concurrent AI Coding Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.04779)
*Arjun Subramanian,George Xu,Nithilan Karthik*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文研究并发AI编码智能体（concurrent AI coding agents）的协调问题，提出"属性范围验证契约"（property-scoped verification contract），将可观察代理信号、学习风险评分与可执行检查器（git merge-tree）严格分离。核心发现是47.3%的文本合并冲突发生在"作者文件集不相交"的情况下，这是由三方合并语义与PR diff代理之间的错配导致；引入决策时分支谱系（lineage）特征可将持有集（held-out）AUROC从0.694提升至0.902。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当多个编码智能体在同一代码库上并发工作时，简单的文件重叠代理与真实的合并冲突之间存在错配：作者文件不相交的PR对仍可能因三方合并语义而冲突。仅依靠廉价代理进行协调会忽略这一系统性差距，需要一个明确分离代理、预测器和权威检查器的验证框架。

Method: 1) 提出属性范围验证契约，明确分离可观察代理（O）、可执行检查器（V，git merge-tree）和启发式评分（s）；2) 构建MergeGym三轨基准：T1开放时范围预测、T2重放条件冲突解决、T3在线调度；3) 在715对分层谱系集（含167个冲突，79个零重叠冲突）上评估12特征逻辑回归（Lineage-LR）、未调优随机森林和谱系并集规则；4) 通过补丁重构验证三方合并解释；5) 在97个代码库流上进行冻结标签调度模拟。

Result: 主要结果：(1) 47.3%（79/167）的文本冲突发生在零作者文件重叠的PR对上；(2) 谱系并集规则AUROC达0.877，Lineage-LR达0.882（PR-AUC 0.661），未调优随机森林达0.902（PR-AUC 0.701）；(3) 在33.3%持有集重放预算下，LR和RF分别恢复81.2%和82.9%的冲突；(4) 48/79零重叠冲突经补丁重构后全部变干净（31个不具结论性）；(5) T3调度门在阈值0.20下以65.0% makespan膨胀实现91.7%中位去重叠；(6) 本地git merge-tree重放中位仅0.02秒，因此本文不主张对纯文本检查的净节省。

Conclusion: 核心结论是"启发式应调度保证，而非冒充保证"。当检查器廉价时应全量验证；当更强验证链昂贵或受限时，预测仅用于排序工作而将可执行后端保留为权威。谱系状态对持有集优先级排序具有显著价值，但Lineage-LR并非该信息约束下的最强预测器（RF更优）。所有经验保证仅限于文本可合并性或明确陈述的冻结标签调度目标，不构成构建、测试、语义或规范层面的安全声明。

Abstract: Concurrent AI coding agents create a coordination problem in which cheap signals may prioritize work, but only an executable checker can establish the property being claimed. We study this separation through a property-scoped verification contract and MERGEGYM, a three-track benchmark for open-time scope forecasting, replay- conditioned conflict resolution, and scheduling. On a stratified 715-pair lineage set (167 textual conflicts), 79 conflicts (47.3%) occur despite disjoint authored file sets. This is an operationally important proxy mismatch expected from three-way merge: authored PR diffs are measured against PR-specific bases, whereas the checker compares both heads to their common merge base. A standalone lineage-union rule reaches held-out AUROC 0.877; a 12-feature logistic model reaches 0.882 [0.845, 0.917] with PR-AUC 0.661, and an untuned random forest on the same decision-time features reaches 0.902 [0.875, 0.928] with PR-AUC 0.701. At a 33.3% held-out replay budget, the logistic and random-forest models recover 81.2% and 82.9% of conflicts, respectively. Patch reconstruction succeeds for 48/79 zero- overlap conflicts and all 48 become clean; the other 31 cases are inconclusive, so this check validates the expected three-way-merge explanation rather than claiming a new Git mechanism. In T1, a zero-shot LLM reaches AUC 0.704 and LLM-plus- metadata fusion 0.740. In T3, a decision-time gate de-overlaps a median 91.7% of labeled scope collisions at 65.0% makespan inflation under frozen-label replay. Because local git merge-tree replay is already cheap in our logs (median 0.02 s), we do not claim that lineage triage saves this checker alone: when exact replay is cheap, verify everything. All empirical guarantees in this paper remain limited to textual mergeability or the explicitly stated frozen-label scheduling target.

</details>


### [181] [Agent Skill Evolution: How Revisions Affect Coding Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.04832)
*Jiajie Wang,Yutong Zhao,Tianlin Li,Huashan Chen,Jinfu Chen,Kebin Peng,Sen He*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 这是一篇关于LLM编码代理中Agent Skill（SKILL.md文件）演化的大规模实证研究，分析了3159个Skill的2608个首尾版本对，通过396个探针和80个沙盒任务，在21个模型上评估了规则变更对代理效能和成本的影响。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有研究多在单一版本上评估Agent Skill，但Skill作为仓库文件会被持续修订，其演化对代理行为的影响尚不清楚。此外，Skill通常与harness配置文件（如CLAUDE.md、AGENTS.md）协同演化，这种协同关系也未被系统研究。

Method: 研究分为三个阶段：(1) 从SkillMD-138K快照中重构3159个Skill的修订历史，构建2608个首尾版本对，分析其内容变化和harness配置变更；(2) 从版本对中提取"指令"（directives）——新增或删除的命名具体命令、路径或标识符的规则行，构建396个探针；(3) 在none/old/new三种条件下，在16个开源权重模型和5个闭源模型上进行单步回答测试，并在4个agent（含mini-SWE-agent沙盒）上进行多步执行测试。使用字符串检查、动作追踪和盲人评判三级评估，并控制实验（如仅添加规则行、添加不相关文本、仅命名token等）。

Result: 主要发现：(1) 55%的修订改变了规则或流程，修订Skill的提交比同等大小的其他提交更频繁地变更harness配置文件；(2) 在16个开源模型上，新增规则使单步回答合规率平均提升+0.41；在4个agent上，所需动作执行率提升+0.23（+0.16至+0.36），3个被盲评的agent最终正确率提升+0.10（+0.06至+0.14）；(3) 增益主要来自命名旧Skill未提及的命令或路径的规则；(4) 按需加载场景下，4个agent保留约51%的动作增益，3个开源模型保留约38%；(5) 修订使单步输入tokens增加18-19%，但对agent episode无明显成本增加，而加载Skill正文使episode tokens增加50%；(6) 在控制实验中，陈述规则比仅命名其token多带来+0.15的合规率提升。

Conclusion: Agent Skill的演化（尤其是新增具体规则）能有效改变编码代理的行为，规则变更的增益主要来自新增的命令或路径信息，且跨模型世代效果相似。修订本身的token成本可控，但加载Skill正文成本较高。维护者的实践建议是：当规则提供Skill缺乏的信息时添加规则，删除前需验证代理不应再遵循该规则，并按最小目标模型尺寸设计Skill长度。

Abstract: Agent Skills, the this http URL files that tell an LLM coding agent how a project works, are revised like code, yet what a revision does to the agent is unknown. From 2,608 first/last revision pairs of 3,159 Skills, we characterize how Skills evolve and how they change together with the configuration of the agent's harness. We then focus on rule changes, revisions that add or remove a rule we can check automatically, such as "run allium check". We measure their effect on 21 models in single answers and on four agents in a sandbox, and their cost on 20 of these models and the four agents. Most revisions (55%) change a rule or procedure, and commits that revise a Skill change harness files such as this http URL more often than other commits of the same size. Across 16 open-weight models, an added rule raises compliance in a single answer by +0.41 on average. Across the four agents, the rate at which the agent takes the required action rises by +0.23 on average (+0.16 to +0.36), and for the three agents that blind judges assessed, final correctness rises by +0.10 on average (+0.06 to +0.14). The gain comes mainly from rules that name a command or path the old Skill did not mention. Real tools load a Skill's body only when the agent decides it needs it. In that setting the four agents keep about half of the action gain on average (51%), and the three open models about 38%. A revision adds 18-19% input tokens to a single answer and no detectable cost to an agent episode, while loading a Skill's body raises the tokens of an episode by 50% on average.

</details>


### [182] [CARET: Training-Free Test-Time Scaling for Repository-Level Code Completion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.04837)
*Jiajie Wang,Yutong Zhao,Kebin Peng,Sen He,Qing Guo,Tianlin Li*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: CARET是一种无需训练的仓库级代码补全方法，通过联合优化RAG管线的检索（R）和生成（G）两个阶段，在接近单次推理开销下显著优于贪心解码和self-consistency@10基线。其核心包括：基于样本一致性的级联路由在多检索上下文间择优、采样阶段缓存长前缀以降低成本、以及利用光标右侧代码的逆向上下文似然（RCV）选择器筛选候选。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有仓库级代码补全研究主要聚焦检索阶段（R），假设生成阶段（G）的单次贪心解码已足够。作者通过动机研究发现：(1) 不同检索家族解决的任务集高度不重合，无单一检索策略恒优；(2) 采样池内已大量包含正确答案（与最佳oracle差距达+18.4 EM），但单次贪心解码未利用该空间；(3) 多数投票是弱选择器，需要更强信号来挑选答案。因此需要联合优化两个阶段。

Method: CARET包含三个核心组件：(a) RAG: 准备两个互补的基上下文（结构化融合上下文与词汇BM25上下文），级联路由基于主上下文样本一致性a1，若a1<τ则在备用上下文采样N=10，按路一致性a达标（τ=0.2）后选用a较大的池；(b) 生成-采样：缓存共享的检索前缀，N=10条短续写仅解码一次（prefix caching），保持开销接近单次生成（约1.1倍）；(c) RCV选择器：a≥θ（0.8）时直接输出众数候选，否则对去重后的候选计算P_M(X̃_r|X̃_l|λ⊕c_i)（逆向上下文似然），以0.75*reverse-likelihood + 0.25*vote的混合得分选优。三个成本控制机制：高一致性跳过取消分集独立打分，仅去重候选进行评分，级联路由仅在主上下文不一致时调用备用上下文。整个流程无需训练、标签或额外模型，DeepSeek-Coder-1.3B同时充当生成器与选择器。

Result: 在CrossCodeEval、RepoEval-Line、RepoEval-API三个数据集与六个代码模型（1.1B–7B，四个家族）共18个组合上，CARET均达到最优非oracle结果：平均+10.8 EM超过贪心解码，+5.3 EM超过self-consistency@10；DeepSeek-Coder-6.7B在RepoEval-API/Line上分别达到47.74/43.88 EM。token级计算约为单次生成的1.45倍（低于RepoCoder的~2倍），wall-clock随模型规模在1.3–2.9倍间变化。1.3B模型+CARET在RepoEval-Line/API上以约1.5倍计算击败5倍大的6.7B模型单次pass。统计检验（McNemar与配对bootstrap）显示增益在三个基准上均显著（p<1e-4）。消融实验验证RCV选择器贡献最大（占vote-to-oracle空间的16%/50%/49%），路由与采样各自带来稳定增益，成本节省机制近无损。

Conclusion: CARET证明：在仓库级代码补全中，将少量推理预算同时分配到检索路由和生成选择阶段，比单独优化检索阶段能获得更高准确率；样本一致性和逆向上下文似然是两项免费且有效的信号。方法训练无关、模型无关（跨四个家族六个规模均有效），且保持接近单次推理开销，为实际IDE场景的部署可行性提供支撑。未来方向涉及跨语言扩展、函数级粒度补全以及学习型路由信号。

Abstract: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) dominates repository-level code completion: it retrieves cross-file context (R), then decodes one greedy completion (G). Existing work mainly focuses on retrieval and stops there. We argue both stages can be improved together, with generation in particular gaining from test-time scaling. We present CARET, a training-free method. For R, CARET routes among retrieval contexts using the agreement among its own samples, cascading to an alternative context when the samples scatter. For G, it samples candidates over a cached prompt prefix, so the long retrieved context is encoded once rather than once per sample. It then selects the final completion by reverse-context likelihood: a correct completion makes the code after the cursor more probable, so the same model grades its own candidates by reading ahead. Across CrossCodeEval, RepoEval-Line, and RepoEval-API with six code models (1.1B to 7B, four families), CARET improves exact match in all 18 combinations by 10.8 points on average over greedy decoding and 5.3 over self-consistency@10. Token-level compute stays near 1.45 times one generation (measured wall-clock 1.3-2.9 times, growing with generator size). Improving retrieval and generation together yields more accurate code than improving retrieval alone, at a budget that stays close to a single pass.

</details>


### [183] [LLM-Based Test Generation: Information Sources, Generation Strategies, and Quality Evidence](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05001)
*Yunhao Liang,Chengguang Gan,Ruixuan Ying,Hanjun Wei,Zhe Cui,Shiwen Ni*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文是一篇系统性叙述综述，基于95篇精选文献（截至2026年9月29日），围绕四个维度——测试目标与产物、训练与生成阶段的信息访问、生成与学习机制、评估证据——梳理了基于大语言模型（LLM）的测试生成研究。研究区分了多种产物类型（场景、可执行测试、oracle、生成基础设施）和信息访问的差异化配置，强调将测试构建（artifact construction）与证据构建（evidence construction）分开看待，提出独立oracle评估、预算感知生成、仓库规模评估及测试维护等未来研究方向。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前LLM测试生成研究产出多样化（场景、可执行测试、断言、交互序列、模糊测试基础设施），但不同方法的可比性存在根本问题：相同的通过测试在不同情境中意义不同。现有综述已覆盖广泛，但作者认为需要一个统一的分析视角，将测试产物的生成过程与用于证明其质量的证据联系起来，以解决"什么信息产生测试、什么证据证明该测试可用于评估软件"的比较难题。

Method: 本文采用结构化叙述综合方法（structured narrative synthesis），围绕四个正交维度构建分析框架——（1）测试目标与产物；（2）信息访问的训练/生成/最终评估三阶段；（3）生成与学习机制（提示、检索、反馈、agents、学习目标）；（4）评估证据。通过对95篇文献（含四类设置（单元/需求测试、oracle、API/GUI、模糊测试））的定性解读，深入比较合成测试配置；并提出RejectLegal和DetectFault作为独立oracle评估推荐指标。文献检索采用公开网络搜索、arXiv、出版页面及现有综述的参考文献追溯，通过主题相关查询补充35篇记录。

Result: 本文提出了一个将测试生成分为"工件构建"与"证据构建"两个问题的分析框架。主要发现包括——（1）执行反馈可提高可执行性但同时影响oracle独立性；（2）规范来源和训练时的参考监督对比较结论至关重要；（3）下游代码选择增益与测试正确性是不同性质的问题。框架还揭示了：覆盖率的测试通过与执行成功率并不等同于规范符合性；oracle代理中的一致性可能保留共同错误；修复过程中可能存在"自我修复陷阱"（如DCAware报告）；从有缺陷代码生成的文档仍保留实现派生性。研究进一步组织benchmark家族，使其与所支持的声明相匹配，并提出具体研究问题。

Conclusion: LLM测试生成涵盖场景、可执行测试、oracle和可复用模糊基础设施。综合将可执行构建与oracle论证分离：覆盖、参考一致性、补丁判别、独立检测与合法行为接受度提供互补证据。将信息访问、证据来源和成本明确化有助于更可解释的比较，并指导针对跨仓库（repos）、对抗者和软件变更的实用性生成器研究。未来研究方向包括独立oracle评估、预算感知生成、仓库规模评估及测试维护，并需解决数据污染、可比性、成本报告和框架细节记录等有效性威胁。

Abstract: Large language models are increasingly used to generate test scenarios, executable test suites, assertions, interaction sequences, and fuzzing infrastructure. These artifacts serve different purposes and rely on different sources of information about correct behavior. A test that increases implementation coverage, a test that agrees with a reference program, and a test that detects a requirements violation therefore provide distinct kinds of evidence. We present a structured narrative survey that connects the generation process to the evidence used to justify test quality. Drawing on 95 curated source records through 29 September 2026, we organize the field along four dimensions: testing objectives and artifacts, information available during training and generation, generation and learning mechanisms, and evaluation evidence. We synthesize work on unit and requirements-based testing, test oracles, API and GUI testing, fuzzing, and learned test generators. The resulting framework explains how execution feedback can improve executability while also affecting the independence of an oracle, why specification provenance and training-time reference supervision matter for comparisons, and how downstream code-selection gains differ from test correctness. We use these distinctions to organize benchmarks and derive a research agenda for independent oracle assessment, budget-aware generation, repository-scale evaluation, and test maintenance.

</details>


### [184] [Rethinking Tool Design for Agentic RCA: A Controlled Empirical Study](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05009)
*Yu Luo,Rongchen Gao,Zhenhui Zhou,Changchang Liu,Yuliang You,Yongqian Sun,Shenglin Zhang,Qiuai Fu,Shijie Wang,Dan Pei*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文针对LLM Agent在微服务根因分析（RCA）中的工具设计问题，开展了一项受控实证研究。作者提出三级工具抽象层次（L1指标访问、L2证据分析、L3诊断方法）和L0参考设置（Python通用接口），实现24个结构化工具，并在三个微服务系统（Online Boutique、Sock Shop、Train Ticket）的375个故障案例上，使用4个Qwen模型评估了8种工具配置的效果，揭示了工具组合对根因定位与故障类型识别有不同影响，且效果因模型能力和系统复杂度而异。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有智能体RCA系统在工具设计上缺乏系统性的实证指导：固定预处理会形成证据瓶颈，而工具抽象层次的选择与分析负担分配之间存在权衡，且不同模型与微服务系统下的工具有效性尚未被隔离研究。本文旨在通过控制实验，系统性地研究工具抽象与组合对诊断效果的影响及其与模型能力、系统复杂度的交互作用。

Method: 1) 设计四级工具抽象层次：L0（Python通用接口）、L1（6个指标访问工具）、L2（12个证据分析工具）、L3（6个诊断方法工具）；2) 构造8种工具配置组合；3) 使用RCAEval的RE1基准（375个故障案例，覆盖3个微服务系统）；4) 评估4个Qwen模型（8B、32B、235B-A22B、Plus）在不同配置下的根因定位（AC@1）、故障类型识别（TA）、效率等指标；5) 通过轨迹分析解释性能差异。

Result: 1) L3单独使用在Qwen3.7-Plus上达到82.8%的top-1定位精度，接近L0的85.4%但耗时不到一半；2) 添加工具级别可提升故障类型识别但可能降低定位精度——L2提供的竞争性证据常使智能体放弃正确的L3候选；3) 模型能力影响工具收益：弱模型（8B）很少调用L3导致添加L3反而有害，强模型（Plus）的L0优于所有结构化配置；4) 系统复杂度影响工具排序——L2在Sock Shop上对定位有害但在Online Boutique上有益，Train Ticket（大系统）主要损害智能体自身搜索能力。

Conclusion: 工具配置对根因定位与故障类型识别有不同影响，效果因模型能力和目标系统而异。对于能力强模型，L3单独使用是定位的最具成本效益选择；添加工具级别总能改善故障类型识别但可能损害定位；弱模型应使用L1+L2而非包含L3的配置；工具设计需根据诊断目标、模型能力和目标系统综合考量。

Abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents are increasingly explored for root cause analysis (RCA) in microservice systems, yet empirical guidance on how to design and combine their tools remains limited. We conduct a controlled empirical study of tool abstraction and composition across models and microservice environments. We implement 24 structured tools for metric access (L1), evidence analysis (L2), and diagnosis (L3), alongside a Python-based reference setting (L0). Using 375 failure cases from three microservice systems, we evaluate eight configurations with Qwen3.7-Plus and compare four Qwen models on a shared subset of four configurations. Our results show that tool configurations affect root cause localization and failure type identification differently. With Qwen3.7-Plus, L3 achieves 82.8% top-1 localization accuracy compared with 85.4% for L0, while requiring less than half the time per case. Adding tool levels can improve type identification while reducing localization accuracy. Trajectory analysis reveals cases in which agents override correct diagnostic recommendations after consulting additional evidence. Model choice also changes tool benefits: adding L3 to L1+L2 improves diagnosis for three models but hurts Qwen3-8B, which rarely invokes L3. Tool configuration rankings further change across microservice systems. These findings provide an empirical foundation for designing and using RCA tools, guiding tool selection and composition according to the model, diagnostic objective, and target system.

</details>


### [185] [Characterizing Security Effects of OSS Vulnerabilities in Agent Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05036)
*Yu Ji,Yang Wei,Yutao Hu,Haojun Zhao,Yueming Wu,Deqing Zou*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文提出Oscar框架,通过结合漏洞语义、修复前后配对执行及跨层运行时溯源,分析已知OSS漏洞在Agent系统中的安全后果及其在运行时层间的最大显现边界。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有OSS漏洞分析只能确认漏洞的存在、可达性或触发,但无法判断漏洞是否在具体的Agent执行中产生安全后果,以及该后果在Agent执行栈中能传播多远。Agent安全分析从另一端出发,虽能检查Tool输出和Observation中的安全内容,但无法将这些现象追溯到具体已知OSS漏洞的执行后果,二者之间缺少连接。

Method: 三阶段工作流:①漏洞语义分析,从CVE信息和补丁中提取触发语义和补丁语义;②跨层执行图构建,在相同条件下执行漏洞版本和修复版本,构建覆盖Program、Resource、MCP、Host、Agent五个层级的成对执行图;③运行时效应分析与定位,通过配对图对比与漏洞语义约束,定位根运行时变化、重构受影响对象与状态并确定最大显现边界。

Result: 在50例独立测试集上,Oscar实现96.4% F1和96.0%准确率,优于Code Reachability、AgentFuzz、MCP-BiFlow三种基线方法;边界定位正确处理24/28例;消融实验验证补丁语义与修复版本执行均不可或缺,跨层执行图优于原始追踪和通用溯源图;在ARIS框架五种Agent Host上识别9例真实漏洞效应(4例Runtime边界,5例Observation边界),涵盖mobile-mcp、FastMCP、Requests、Mammoth、GitGit组件。

Conclusion: Oscar证明可以从执行级后果而非漏洞存在性本身来推理Agent系统中的OSS漏洞依赖性,有效连接漏洞触发的运行时变化与Agent栈中的下游显现,为Agent安全分析提供了新的跨层追溯方法。

Abstract: Software agents increasingly depend on open-source components when executing tools and interacting with external systems. Security flaws in these dependencies may therefore influence more than the software process in which they occur: their consequences can be carried through tool outputs, agent state, and information subsequently exposed to the model.
