Motivation: 现有图生成模型（如DiGress、CFM）直接在离散的节点和边变量空间进行扩散或流匹配，建模对象庞大且对置换敏感，计算成本随图规模急剧增长；而基于图级连续表示的VAE虽然高效，但单独使用生成性能差。需要一种兼具两者优点的方法：在紧凑的置换不变图级连续潜空间中进行分布建模。

Method: 1) 使用预训练的GraViti VAE编码器得到图级潜表示 z=E(G)∈R^d，固定编解码器；2) 在潜空间训练Flow Matching模型，用mini-batch OT耦合源与目标，使用Heun等ODE求解器采样；3) 有效性引导：在中间潜状态上训练时间依赖的分类器，在采样后期通过梯度引导生成有效分子；4) 属性控制：通过条件FM v_θ(z_t,t,c)和可微属性预测器 r_ω 的梯度引导精确控制logP和分子量；5) 有效性感知端点生成（VA-VFM）：基于Variational Flow Matching，将端点分布建模为高斯，通过有效性似然项训练，并在推理时用重加权的K个候选采样。

Result: 在QM9上，Latent FM有效性达98.4%（Heun, 500 NFE），VA-VFM达99.7%；在PubChem16上，Latent FM（20 NFE）FCD为0.190，显著优于DiGress的0.945和CFM-CSD的1.155，且生成时间为4.26s（vs DiGress 70.6s），VUN/T高17倍；在PubChem32上，有效性约74.5%（低于DiGress 99%），但FCD为0.868显著优于VAE采样的11.33。训练成本比CFM低约两个数量级（QM9: 27 min vs 63 h）。属性控制方面，logP的MAE从0.282降至0.154，MW从3.040降至2.578。变分潜空间比确定性AE潜空间控制更精确。

Conclusion: 该方法在潜空间中执行Flow Matching实现了高质量、高效的分子图生成，在FCD等分布保真度指标上达到先进水平，生成速度比显式基线快一个数量级；同一潜表示可无缝复用多种生成目标（无条件生成、有效性引导、属性控制），将表示学习与生成建模解耦；其局限在于PubChem32上有效性仍低于DiGress，未来可通过结构化潜空间融入化学先验进一步提升。

Abstract: Modern graph generative models typically operate directly in the discrete graph space, explicitly generating node and edge variables, which can become costly as graphs grow. In this paper, we perform generation explicitly on latent representations of entire graphs obtained from a pretrained Variational Autoencoder with high reconstruction fidelity. The generated representations, obtained through flow matching, are then decoded only at the final step. Across molecular benchmarks of increasing size, our approach achieves strong validity and FCD while offering a favorable quality-efficiency trade-off compared with state-of-the-art explicit graph generative models. One of the main advantages of this formulation is that the graph representation only needs to be learned once, after which the same one can be reused across multiple generative objectives without retraining. We demonstrate generation guided by molecular properties and further introduce validity-aware generation though a classifier learned directly in latent space. All code will be made available upon acceptance.

</details>


### [299] [Frozen Factor or Spectral Band? Disentangling Two Choices in Low-Rank LoRA](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06621)
*Adnan Slimane Ali,Ayoub Belfatmi,David Ngwe Pouth*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文通过2×2析因设计（冻结A或B × 顶部或底部奇异方向带），在低秩LoRA中分离并比较"冻结因子选择"与"频谱带选择"两个设计维度。在秩为2时，冻结输入因子A的效应显著大于切换顶部/底部奇异方向的效应；但该因子对比效应随秩增大而减弱，至秩16时与带对比效应相当。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的频谱LoRA变体（如MiCA冻结B于底部方向，PiCa冻结A于顶部方向）同时改变了因子冻结方向和频谱带选择，使得跨方法比较纠缠了两个变量。本文旨在分离这两个设计选择，并在相同优化和参数预算控制下量化各自的相对影响，澄清LoRA因子非对称性的边界条件。

Method: 采用2×2析因设计：在四个完整任务-模型对（Format/Llama-3.2-1B、OpenBookQA/Qwen2.5-1.5B、Qwen2.5-7B、Mistral-7B）上，分别冻结输入因子A或输出因子B，每个因子位于预训练权重SVD的顶部或底部r个奇异方向上。学习率独立调优。控制包括：(1)参数数量反转（B冻结秩3 vs A冻结秩2）；(2)模块组控制（仅适配MLP down或gate/up投影）；(3)随机正交基替换频谱基；(4)Oracle实验（用训练后的LoRA输出子空间作为冻结B）；(5)Warm-up诊断；(6)PEFT MiCA实现的迁移训练方案对比。进行秩扫描（2、4、8、16）追踪效应变化。报告因子对比F和带对比S的描述性统计，并执行Holm多重性审计。

Result: 在秩为2时，冻结A相对于冻结B在同带内的优势为6.6–19.0个百分点，超过任一因子内的顶部-底部带差异（至多5.2点）。所有四个完整比较中，因子对比F（8.42–15.96点）均大于绝对带对比|S|（1.02–3.46点）。B冻结相对于可比预算自由LoRA落后8–18点（五个任务-模型对）。该A冻结优势在参数数量反转控制、MLP模块组控制（八个预指定比较均通过Bonferroni校正）、随机正交输入基复制中均成立。因子对比随秩增大而减弱：OpenBookQA/Qwen2.5-1.5B上F从秩2的8.42点降至秩16的2.58点。秩16时PEFT MiCA在共享训练方案下落后可比自由LoRA 3.08点。Oracle输出子空间使B冻结性能接近自由LoRA水平。145行Holm审计将109个原阳性判定减至46个。

Conclusion: 在秩为2的LoRA适配中，"冻结哪个因子"的设计选择比"选择哪个频谱带"具有更大的效应量。A冻结（训练输出因子B）的优势在参数预算、模块分配和输入基类型等控制下保持稳健，且不局限于频谱初始化。该优势随秩增大而减弱，在秩16时与带选择效应相当。冻结B的低秩缺陷主要源于输出子空间放置而非冻结本身——训练得到的Oracle子空间可大幅恢复性能。这些结果扩展了已知的LoRA因子非对称性文献，揭示了其幅度对频谱位置、秩和训练条件的依赖。建议未来的LoRA变体比较报告因子方向、基构造、标度、调优超参数和可训练参数数量。

Abstract: Spectral variants of low-rank adaptation (LoRA) choose both a subspace and which factor to freeze. We separate these choices by freezing the input factor A or output factor B on the top or bottom singular directions of pretrained weights, with learning rates selected separately. At rank 2, the same-band advantage of freezing A is larger than either within-factor band difference on all four task-model pairs with complete comparisons. Freezing B also trails comparable-budget free LoRA by 8-18 percentage points on five pairs spanning a formatting task and OpenBookQA. The A-frozen advantage persists in a single-GPU-model replication and within individual MLP module groups, including controls with equal or greater trainable counts for B frozen, and when A is frozen on a random orthonormal basis. The factor contrast weakens with rank. On OpenBookQA / Qwen2.5-1.5B at rank 16, PEFT's MiCA implementation trails comparable-budget LoRA by 3.08 points under a shared training recipe transferred from the MiCA paper. A trained oracle output subspace largely removes the low-rank deficit; partial warm-up gains recur across three direction seeds. The factor-versus-band ordering is descriptive; an approximate multiplicity audit weakens several earlier significance claims. These results extend known factor asymmetry by showing how its magnitude depends on spectral placement, rank and training conditions.

</details>


### [300] [Differentially Private Mixing of Public Datasets Improves Private Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06636)
*Yufei Chen,Tejumade Afonja,Anvith Thudi,Nicolas Papernot*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出DP-MixMin，首个端到端私有化的预训练数据混合权重学习流程，通过差分隐私(DP)优化低维线性模型来选择多个公共数据集的混合权重，以提升下游敏感任务的私有学习性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在敏感数据上训练机器学习模型时，差分隐私(DP)训练会损害模型效用。虽然先在公共数据上预训练再在敏感数据上进行DP微调可缓解这一问题，但其效果取决于公共数据与目标任务的相关性。先前工作通常对所有公共数据集均匀混合，缺乏隐私保护下的定制化混合选择方法。

Method: 1. 将敏感数据分割为两部分：一部分用于私有学习混合权重，另一部分用于DP微调；2. 在各公共数据集上训练代理模型(分类任务用单一多类模型共享成本)；3. 使用DP-SGD的变体私有地优化MixMin凸目标，得到混合权重λ；4. 按权重λ预训练后再进行DP微调；5. 利用并行组合(parallel composition)使整个流程的隐私成本仅为两步骤中的较劣者而非相加。理论上证明私有超参数搜索需要ε=Ω(k)，而DP-SCO方法仅需ε=O(√k)。

Result: 在NIH胸部X光14类疾病分类上，使用CheXpert/MIMIC-CXR作公共源，相比均匀预训练宏AUC绝对增益+0.024~+0.037，心脏肥大类相对AUC增益+22.8%(ε=1)。Enron邮件用户级DP测试困惑度相对降低最多16%。DP-MixMin恢复的混合权重与非私有MixMin解的余弦相似度可达0.97(医学影像)和0.92(语言)，且与全量非私有版本的下游性能相当(宏AUC差异≤0.006)。隐私审计显示实际ε_LB≤0.131，低于声明的ε=1。

Conclusion: DP-MixMin是首个端到端私有化的预训练混合学习管道，在医学影像和语言建模任务上一致优于均匀预训练和随机搜索基线，在低患病率标签、紧隐私预算和用户级隐私下增益尤为显著。未来工作可扩展到表格数据等存在协变量偏移的领域，并考虑使用DP Franke-Wolfe替代DP镜像下降以利用广义线性损失的更好维度依赖。

Abstract: Many machine learning applications involve sensitive data and therefore require training under differential privacy (DP). However, DP training often degrades model utility. In some cases, first pre-training the model on "public" data before finetuning with DP on the sensitive data can reduce the drop in utility. However, the success of this depends on how relevant the selected public dataset is to the sensitive data. We introduce the first pipeline that privately learns the mixture of several public datasets to pretrain on for a given sensitive downstream task. Our key insight is that we can privately find the best mixture of multiple public datasets by privately learning a low-dimensional linear model. We tested our method on the NIH dataset for X-ray classification and the ENRON email dataset for language modeling. Applying our method to find tailored mixtures of X-ray datasets to pretrain on for diseases in the NIH ChestX-ray14 dataset, we improved macro AUC by up to 0.037 across privacy budgets compared to the baselines, with gains as large as +22.8% relative AUC on Cardiomegaly at $\epsilon=1$. For DP training on the ENRON dataset, pre-training on our mixture of The Common Pile (a collection of public-domain text datasets) decreased test perplexity by 16% relative to the baseline mixtures.

</details>


### [301] [Closing the Context Gap: Activation Alignment for Tabular In-Context Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06679)
*Yoel Zeldes*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 针对表格上下文学习（ICL）模型因上下文受限导致性能下降的问题，本文提出"激活对齐"方法：通过在合成无标签数据上训练一个轻量级线性变换，将受限学生模型的中间层激活映射到全上下文教师的对应激活，从而在不修改模型权重的前提下显著提升低上下文场景下的预测性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 表格基础模型（如 TabPFN-3、TabFM）通过上下文学习进行预测，每次推理需处理全部训练样本，计算与内存成本高昂；缩小上下文虽降低开销却严重损害性能。现有的上下文压缩（TACO）或层剪枝（TACTICL）方法均需昂贵的 GPU 训练。亟需一种轻量、模型无关的方案来弥合"上下文缩减"与"全上下文性能"之间的差距。

Method: 激活对齐（Activation Alignment）框架：(1) 使用 TabPFN 的无监督生成分布生成 N_syn=1000 条合成查询；(2) 在同一冻结模型上分别用全上下文（教师）和缩减上下文（学生）前向传播，提取指定层（第 24 层）的中间激活；(3) 训练一个线性仿射层 f_θ(h)=Wh+b 以 MSE 损失拟合学生到教师的激活差 Δh = h_teacher - h_student，预测残差而非绝对激活；(4) 推理时，在第 k 层将学生激活加上 aligner 输出 h^ = h_student + f_θ(h_student)。学生继承教师的预处理器以避免表征漂移。对 TabPFN 的 8 个 estimator 各自训练独立 aligner。训练无需 GPU，使用 AdamW 在普通硬件上秒至分钟级收敛。

Result: 在 TabArena 基准的 38 个分类数据集上对 TabPFN-3（8 estimator）和 TabFM（单 estimator）进行评估：相较未对齐基线，对齐学生胜率分别为 82.2%（TabPFN）与 79.8%（TabFM），所有上下文预算下 p<0.0001 显著。仅用 10% 训练上下文时，TabPFN 等效样本分数 E_α=0.235，TabFM 为 0.200，相当于 2–4 倍数据量的预测精度；分别恢复了教师-学生性能差距的 48.3% 与 44.7%。在 α≥0.2 时，对齐学生对全数据 XGBoost 的胜率分别为 81.1% 与 80.3%，三项平均秩最低（1.37 与 1.40）。5 个数据集出现负向增益，未能预先刻画适用条件。

Conclusion: 激活对齐以极低成本（CPU 训练、秒级收敛、单线性层、不修改骨干权重）显著提升了表格 ICL 模型在上下文受限场景下的预测性能，且与上下文压缩或检索方法正交，可组合使用。该方法表明表格基础模型的中间表征可通过简单线性映射有效地"扩展"至高数据状态，为实际部署中克服内存与上下文限制提供了实用方案。未来可扩展至回归任务、非线性 aligner、多层对齐以及跨数据集迁移以应对真正小数据场景。

Abstract: Tabular foundation models perform in-context learning (ICL) by conditioning predictions on labeled training examples provided as context. Unlike traditional models that separate training from inference, these models must process all training examples in every forward pass, making each prediction expensive. Restricting the number of training examples reduces this cost but substantially degrades performance. Instead of discarding context, we propose activation alignment, a method that leverages the full context to teach a model how to behave when seeing only a subset. This is achieved by training a lightweight linear transformation on synthetic unlabeled data to map the intermediate activations of a data-constrained "student" (using partial context) toward those of a full-context "teacher" (using all data). Training the aligner requires no GPU and converges in seconds to minutes on commodity hardware. We evaluate on 38 classification datasets from the TabArena benchmark using the leading two tabular foundation models, TabPFN-3 and TabFM. Across all context budgets, the aligned student yields broad, statistically significant improvements over the unaligned baseline for both models. In low-data regimes, alignment recovers nearly half of the teacher's predictive advantage. The method provides a practical, low-overhead approach to achieving the inference speed of compact contexts while closing a significant fraction of the performance gap to the full-context teacher.

</details>


### [302] [BRANCH-MoE: Balance-Aware Tree Routing for Large Embedding Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06725)
*Gang Fu,Adel Javanmard,MohammadHossein Bateni,Vahab Mirrokni*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出BRANCH-MoE，一种基于二叉决策树的层次化MoE路由架构，通过到达加权EMA得分锚定实现无需辅助负载均衡损失的专家均衡利用，并在UCI基准上展现出树局部性以降低跨设备通信。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统扁平路由器存在三个问题：专家利用率不均衡且无分布无关的正下界保证；专家标签是无结构的类别索引，不编码硬件拓扑信息；防止早期路由坍缩需依赖辅助负载均衡损失或外部偏置控制器，与任务目标竞争。这些限制促使作者重新设计路由架构本身。

Method: 将E个专家置于深度为log₂E的完整二叉树的叶节点，内部节点的分支概率以σ(f_j(x)-ν_j)形式计算，其中ν_j为该节点到达加权均值的EMA锚定。训练时使用当前batch的到达加权均值，推理时使用存储的EMA。掩码沿树级联传播，每个节点仅需O(1)标量状态。门控机制在top-K选择后对保留专家做重归一化(K>1时)。包含四个理论组件：锚定跟踪的噪声-滞后权衡、对数凹分布下线性路由的软质量反坍缩界、冻结路由器下专家SGD收敛率与执行频率的关系，以及前缀对齐放置下的通信局部性界。

Result: 在Criteo、Forest Covertype、HIGGS、YearPredictionMSD四个基准上与Switch softmax、DeepSeek-V3、Hash、Hash Layers及Skywork对比(E=16, top-4, 5 seeds)。BRANCH-MoE在Forest Covertype取得最低平均交叉熵(0.2372, h=8)，其他三个基准上与最强基线在种子噪声范围内无统计显著差异。在三个UCI基准上，线性节点映射下归一化树距离为0.710-0.718(随机对为0.817)，降低12-13%，而所有扁平路由器保持在随机基线的3.5%以内。Criteo上未观察到局部性效应。负载CV在UCI上为0.09-0.23，无需辅助损失。

Conclusion: BRANCH-MoE证明层次化路由可在不使用辅助负载均衡损失的情况下保持任务质量与均衡利用，同时在UCI基准上诱导支持局部化专家共激活与减少跨设备通信的树结构拓扑。但当前研究限于单层MoE，未捕获多层路由决策间的交互，未来工作将扩展理论与实验到多层架构并开发拓扑感知的分布式实现。

Abstract: Mixture-of-experts (MoE) layers increase model capacity without a proportional increase in per-example computation. However, conventional flat routers can yield imbalanced expert utilization and treat experts as an unstructured collection, whose indices carry no topological meaning. We introduce {\bf BRANCH-MoE}, a routing architecture that places \(E\) experts at the leaves of a binary decision tree of depth \(\log_2 E\). At each internal node the branching probability is centered on the arrival-weighted mean score of the traffic reaching that node. This mean is estimated using an exponential moving average, which promotes utilization of both child subtrees without an auxiliary load-balancing loss. We show that this moving-average estimate admits an explicit noise-lag trade-off. We prove that for linear node maps and log-concave arrival distributions, this mechanism prevents routing-mass collapse. We further establish that, under a frozen router, an expert's execution frequency controls its stochastic-gradient convergence rate, and that confident decisions near the root bound cross-device communication when experts are assigned to devices by tree prefix. We evaluate BRANCH-MoE against Switch softmax, DeepSeek-V3 dynamic-bias, Skywork logit-normalized, and deterministic hash routing on Criteo click-through-rate prediction, Forest Covertype, HIGGS, and YearPredictionMSD, using \(E=16\), top-\(4\) routing, and five random seeds. Our results show that hierarchical routing can preserve task quality and balanced utilization while inducing a topology that supports localized expert co-activation and reduced communication.

</details>


### [303] [MatrixFormer: A Foundation Model for Matrix Completion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06751)
*Dwaipayan Saha,Jacob Feitelberg,Kyuseong Choi,Raaz Dwivedi,Anish Agarwal*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出MatrixFormer，一种基于Transformer的矩阵补全基础模型。它直接在二维矩阵结构上应用交替轴向注意力（行内跨列、列内跨行），并在合成低秩与潜在因子矩阵上预训练。模型以零样本、相同权重的方式在因果面板数据补全、表格缺失值填补、推荐系统评分预测及语言模型基准分数补全四类任务上取得竞争性表现，运行速度较逐条预测基线提升两个数量级。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有表格基础模型（如TabImpute）将矩阵补全拆解为逐条预测，导致上下文被重复编码并丢失二维结构，计算成本随矩阵规模急剧上升。同时，矩阵补全是表格填补、面板反事实、基准分数估计等众多问题的统一形式，但缺乏一个能保留矩阵结构并零样本迁移的通用基础模型。

Method: 核心方法包括：（1）保留矩阵二维网格的cell-token表示，结合缺失值嵌入、掩码token和缺失性指示；（2）交替轴向自注意力（沿行内特征、沿列内数据点）+行列CLS边框+RoPE+RMSNorm，8层768维78M参数；（3）共享解码器输出5000-bin bar分布，预测每个缺失单元的完整分布；（4）三阶段合成预训练（base→main→size extension），使用低秩、慢尾/陡尾谱、潜在因子四类矩阵家族，并混合MCAR/MAR/MNAR缺失机制；（5）训练目标为似然+Huber点损失（蒸馏至两冻结教师）+ CRPS系CDF对齐；（7）推理时通过观测误差最小化在两个专家（MatrixFormer-Impute与MatrixFormer-RecSys）间解析求解凸混合权重构成MatrixFormer集成。

Result: 在四类任务上零样本、固定权重均表现竞争力：（1）1024×10矩阵单次前向推理中位数0.0389s，较TabImpute提速107倍；（2）因果面板补全：6个面板中5个最低归一化得分（California smoking与CPS的RMSE领先且95%置信区间不重叠）；（3）表格填补：MissBench整体NRMSE 1.580、UCI套件0.998，均为最低；（4）推荐系统：MovieLens 100K RMSE/MAE 0.8874/0.7279，Netflix small 0.8617/0.7330，均优于六种协作过滤基线；（5）LLM基准补全：MTEB、Merged、BenchPress上R²全面优于高斯条件均值估计器，Merged在k=15时R² 0.6464对比0.583。

Conclusion: MatrixFormer验证了矩阵原生、合成预训练的Transformer可作为矩阵补全的通用基础模型，在多种领域零样本迁移并具SOTA表现；其轴向注意力设计带来数量级加速。未来工作包括：将预测分布用于治疗效应区间估计、支持更大上下文长度、基于留出观测的集成权重选择。

Abstract: Matrix completion underlies problems from tabular imputation to causal inference, yet existing tabular foundation models treat it as entry-by-entry prediction, repeating context for every target and discarding the matrix's two-dimensional structure. We introduce MatrixFormer, a pre-trained matrix-native transformer that predicts a full distribution for every missing entry in a single forward pass. MatrixFormer is trained entirely on synthetic low-rank and latent-factor matrices under diverse missingness patterns. Applied zero-shot and with the same model weights, MatrixFormer achieves competitive performance on causal inference panel-data tasks, language-model benchmark-score completion, tabular imputation, and recommendation systems matrix completion. These results position MatrixFormer as a general-purpose foundation model for matrix completion.

</details>


### [304] [Sharpen Without Search: On-Policy Distillation of Sequence-Level Power Distribution](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06804)
*Erfan Baghaei Potraghloo,Seyedarmin Azizi,Arya Fayyazi,Saeid Shokoufa,Mehdi Kamal,Souvik Kundu,Massoud Pedram*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一种名为"在策略幂蒸馏"（OPPD）的训练方法，将推理阶段的幂分布采样转化为模型参数内部的"锐化"，使单次生成即可获得接近多候选采样的推理性能提升，且无需参考答案或奖励模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 语言模型即使为正确答案赋予最高概率，仍常因错误答案累积概率更高而被采样到。幂分布（将每个完整答案概率取α次幂后重归一化）能"锐化"分布、提升推理准确率，但需对每个查询采样并评分多个候选（推理成本高）。本文旨在将这一推理开销一次性转移到训练阶段，让训练后的模型单次生成即达到多候选采样的效果。

Method: OPPD使用序列蒙特卡洛（SMC）采样器：学生模型自身作为提议分布生成N个候选答案，冻结教师模型的幂分布为每个候选赋予重要性权重和训练权重；通过加权最大似然更新学生参数，损失由序列级项（核心）和KL锚定项（λ控制）组成。关键设计包括：方差最优提议分布（学生温度1/α）、Rényi散度梯度推导（Theorem 2）、分块评分（每Δ=64个token一次教师前向）以及多种实现细节（重采样后权重重归一化、早停修正等）。吸收锐化指数α_eff通过拟合log p_ϕ与log p_base的斜率来衡量。

Result: 在Qwen2.5-Math-7B上，OPPD（λ=0，温度1/α）单次生成在MATH500上达78.50%、GSM8K上达91.13%，超过已发表的64候选幂采样；温度1下相比未训练模型提升23.0（MATH500）和27.3（GSM8K）点。相同预算下对比GRPO，OPPD在MATH500/GSM8K/AIME上分别高出3.8/4.0/5.4点；在GRPO训练后继续应用OPPD可额外提升9.3点。跨模型族（Qwen3、Llama-3.1、DeepSeek）均有效；仅用数学数据训练的模型在HumanEval上提升3.5–5.3点。吸收锐化指数在1.19–2.02之间由λ控制，远高于普通在策略蒸馏的1.14。

Conclusion: OPPD成功将推理时的幂采样成本转化为模型内部锐化能力，单次生成即可恢复16候选采样94%的增益；不需要参考答案或验证器，与基于验证奖励的GRPO互补且效果更优；其吸收锐化机制主要发生在模型自身生成的答案上，为无法获取参考答案的场景提供了一种有效的训练途径。

Abstract: A language model can give a correct answer more probability than any single incorrect answer and still usually sample an incorrect one, because the incorrect answers together hold more probability. The power distribution raises each complete answer's probability to a power above one and renormalizes, shifting probability toward answers the model finds most likely (sharpening). Sampling from it improves reasoning without changing parameters, but needs many scored candidates per query. We show that a model can instead be trained to produce such answers in one generation. On-policy power distillation (OPPD) runs a sequential Monte Carlo sampler in which the model being trained generates candidates and a frozen teacher's power distribution weights them; the same probabilities weight each answer in a maximum-likelihood update. Training raises single-generation accuracy by up to 23.0 points on MATH500 and 27.3 on GSM8K over the untrained model at the same temperature, and one generation scores 2.4 and 3.5 points above published power sampling with 64 candidates, recovering 94 percent of the gain that 16 candidates give the untrained model. For context, against GRPO trained with verified rewards from the same checkpoint and budget, OPPD scores 3.8, 4.0 and 5.4 points higher on MATH500, GSM8K and AIME using no reference answers; the two are complementary, and OPPD applied after GRPO adds up to 9.3 points. Trained only on mathematics, OPPD raises HumanEval accuracy by up to 5.3 points. One loss coefficient moves the sharpening exponent the model absorbs between 1.19 and 2.02, against 1.14 for ordinary on-policy distillation, and it rises mostly on the model's own answers. Gains hold across model families and sizes, including a model already trained with verified rewards, where lowering the temperature gives nothing and OPPD adds 4.4 points on MATH500. Code: this https URL .

</details>


### [305] [Deep Learning for Sleep Heart Rate Estimation from Accelerometers: Toward Population-Scale Cardiac Insight Without Optical Sensors](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06823)
*Tanbin Islam Rohan,Pranjol Sen Gupta,Tanusree Debi,Nazmus Sakib*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出SeqSmoother，一种基于Transformer的时间校正器，仅通过腕部加速度计信号估计睡眠心率。它在保留Nightbeat优势的准确性同时，扩大了有效估计的覆盖率，并通过次谐波特征识别谐波锁定失败。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大型纵向队列研究中常包含腕部加速度计数据但缺乏光学心率传感器，需要一种从已采集的运动信号中恢复睡眠期间心率信息的方法。

Method: 方法包括：(1) SeqSmoother，基于Transformer的时间校正器，融合光谱描述符、来自Nightbeat的频率锚点以及物理启发的次谐波特征；(2) 采用13个参与者不相交的留出折进行评估；(3) 使用60秒窗口、15秒步长的匹配设置；(4) 训练标签采用ECG参考心率并赋予质量权重；(5) 次谐波比用于以AUROC评估识别谐波锁定失败的能力。

Result: 结果：(1) SeqSmoother在留出折预测中达到参与者宏平均MAE为1.60 bpm；(2) 在Nightbeat保留的匹配区间上，Nightbeat的绝对误差更低（0.615 vs 1.091 bpm）；(3) SeqSmoother在更大的合格记录范围上提供估计，产出率为72.85%；(4) 次谐波比在识别参考定义的谐波锁定候选上达到AUROC 0.972。

Conclusion: 研究揭示了学习型时间建模与质量门控信号处理之间在准确性与可用性上的权衡，同时为基于物理的方法识别加速度计心率估计中的频率追踪失败提供了实证支持。

Abstract: Large longitudinal cohorts often contain wrist accelerometry without optical heart-rate sensing, motivating recovery of cardiac information from motion signals already collected during sleep. We present SeqSmoother, a transformer-based temporal corrector for sleep heart rate (HR) estimation from wrist accelerometry. SeqSmoother combines spectral descriptors with an intermediate Nightbeat-derived frequency anchor and a physics-motivated sub-harmonic feature designed to identify harmonic frequency lock-on. All inference-time features are derived from wrist accelerometry, while ECG is used only to construct reference HR labels and training-label quality weights. We evaluate SeqSmoother using 13 participant-disjoint held-out folds and compare it with the official Nightbeat implementation under a matched 60-s window and 15-s step protocol. Across all out-of-fold predictions, SeqSmoother achieved a participant-macro MAE of 1.60 bpm. On Nightbeat-retained matched intervals, Nightbeat achieved lower absolute error than SeqSmoother (0.615 versus 1.091 bpm), while SeqSmoother provided estimates over a larger portion of the eligible recording; Nightbeat produced final estimates for 72.85% of the SeqSmoother-eligible out-of-fold grid. Separately, the proposed sub-harmonic ratio achieved an AUROC of 0.972 for identifying reference-defined harmonic lock-on candidates. These findings reveal an accuracy-availability trade-off between learned temporal modeling and quality-gated signal processing while providing empirical support for a physics-informed approach to identifying frequency-tracking failures in accelerometer-based sleep HR estimation.

</details>


### [306] [Base Models Can Reason By Taking a Cue From Training Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06851)
*Sophie L. Wang,Amil Dravid,Rulin Shao,Kevin Farhat,Sewon Min,Alexei A. Efros*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究发现基础语言模型的开头几个token（"token cues"）就能显著激活其潜在的推理能力：通过预填充如".\n\nOkay"（Olmo-3-7B）或"Alright,"（Qwen3-14B）等短开头，可使基础模型在数学推理任务上的表现接近甚至匹配RL后训练版本。RL训练本质上是在提高这些有效cue token的生成概率。进一步通过训练数据反事实干预（如将"Okay"替换为"chicken"），可以将任意词变成有效的推理cue，并将"Think duck duck goose"变得与"Think step by step"同样有效。隐藏状态分析显示不同cue激活了不同的训练数据类型（如推理轨迹）。在安全场景中，相同机制也驱动不同的拒绝/合规行为。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前对RL后训练能否真正为语言模型注入新推理能力存在争议。本研究受巴甫洛夫条件反射启发，探究基础模型是否已具备推理能力，以及仅通过微小的token级干预是否能激活这些能力，从而揭示后训练RL在推理行为中的作用机制。

Method: 1）通过beam搜索和答案一致性（熵）选择有效的双token提示（cue），无需参考答案；2）预填充（prefill）这些cue并评估基础模型在MATH-500、GSM8K、AMC、AIME、HumanEval等基准上的表现；3）进行训练数据反事实实验：在Olmo-3-7B和SmolLM3-3B的中训练数据中替换"okay"为"chicken"或"step by step"为"duck duck goose"等，然后重新训练；4）通过KL散度分析RL训练前后策略变化集中在开头位置；5）使用layer-24隐藏状态与训练文档隐藏状态的余弦相似度进行表征分析。

Result: 1）Olmo-3-7B在MATH-500上仅通过".\n\nOkay"预填充，pass@1从42%提升至78%（RL后训练为75%）；Qwen3-14B通过"Alright,"从72%提升至87%。2）RL训练的策略变化集中在响应前1-2个token位置；预填充cue后训练的前100步（Olmo）和50步（Qwen）即可达到标准RL的训练后效果。3）将训练数据中的"okay"替换为"chicken"后，"chicken"成为有效推理cue；将"step by step"替换为"duck duck goose"后，"Think duck duck goose"达到与"Think step by step"相当的推理效果。4）不同cue使隐藏状态倾向于不同类型的训练文档（如推理轨迹、解释性数学、元推理）。5）安全场景中："\n\nOkay"使模型更有选择性地拒绝有害请求；"Okay,"或"Sure,"则增加有害响应率。

Conclusion: 基础语言模型的推理能力已通过预训练获得，RL后训练主要通过提高特定开头token的生成概率来利用这些已有能力。token cues通过训练数据中的关联性形成，体现了巴甫洛夫条件反射式的学习机制。这一发现对模型安全、可解释性和训练数据设计具有重要意义：理解和控制token cues可以帮助设计更可控的语言模型。

Abstract: In this paper, we study how training data creates associations between the tokens at the start of a base model's response and the reasoning behavior that follows. First, we demonstrate that fixing particular starting token cues makes a base model's performance competitive with that of its reinforcement learning (RL)-trained counterparts on math and coding. For instance, the cue ".\n\nOkay" raises Olmo-3-7B's MATH-500 pass@1 accuracy from 42% to 78%, while "Alright," raises Qwen3-14B's from 72% to 87%. Second, RL makes these cues more likely, while fixing them recovers much of its performance gain over the base model. Third, we trace the reasoning effects of token cues to the training data. We perform causal data interventions to turn an arbitrary word, such as "chicken", into an effective reasoning cue, or remove an existing cue's effect. A similar edit makes the prompt instruction "Think duck duck goose" as effective as "Think step by step" at eliciting reasoning. We also find that the hidden state representations induced by different cues correlate with different document types from the training set. Finally, we extend our study of token cues with a case study in language model safety, finding that different cues elicit distinct refusal and compliance behaviors that correspond to different types of training data.

</details>


### [307] [Beyond Masked Sparsity: SNACK Enables Truly Sparse Neural Networks on GPU](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.04093)
*Jafar Badour,Maurice van Keulen,Elena Mocanu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: SNACK（Sparse Network Active CUDA Kernel）是一个真正稀疏的 GPU 层，通过自定义 COO 格式的 SpMM CUDA 内核 SNACK-COO，配合稀疏外积梯度和均匀连接初始化器，在小批量、高稀疏度场景下显著超越 Dense+Mask 基线，在 GPT-2 训练峰值内存上最高节省 40%，图推理延迟最高加速 4.8×。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的稀疏神经网络与动态稀疏训练（DST）实现大多通过在稠密张量上施加二元掩码来"模拟"稀疏性，稠密矩阵乘法仍在底层运行，几乎无法兑现稀疏化在计算、内存和能耗上的理论收益。现有高性能 SpMM 内核（cuSPARSE、Sputnik、FlashSparse）针对中等稀疏度与大批量进行了优化，但在 DST 训练中常见的极小批量（batch=1）和单流推理场景下表现欠佳。

Method: SNACK 由两部分构成：（1）SNACK-COO——一种自定义 COO 格式 SpMM CUDA 内核，采用 batch-to-SM 映射，将稀疏非零工作量映射到线程块网格，使 SM 利用率随非零数而非矩阵高度变化，专为小批量、高稀疏度场景优化；（2）SNACK 层——一个后端无关、可替换 nn.Linear 的真正稀疏 PyTorch 模块，权重全程以 COO 三元组存储于 GPU，结合基于 support(W) 的稀疏外积反向梯度计算（O(nnz·b)）和无须实例化稠密张量的均匀连接初始化器（Algorithm 2）。SpMM 后端可热插拔：SNACK-COO 适用于小批量场景，Sputnik/cuSPARSE/FlashSparse 适用于大批量场景。

Result: 内核层面（RTX 3070，5000×5000，95% 稀疏度，batch=1）：SNACK-COO 比 Dense+Mask 快 7×，比稠密基线快 3.5×；在 A100 上分别为 7.5× 与 3.7×。单层训练周期（10000×10000，90% 稀疏度）：SNACK 比 Dense+Mask 推理/训练快 4×/8×，能耗减少 72%，内存减少 73%；比 Dense 快 2×/3.7×。GPT-2 端到端：SNACK(Sputnik) 在 99% 稀疏度下将训练峰值内存减少 40%（1366 MB vs 2261 MB），并保持困惑度与 Dense+Mask 相当；推理时 99% 稀疏度下内存降至 579 MB，为 Dense+Mask 的不到一半。图推理（ogbn-products，GAMLP 形式，5000×5000，99% 稀疏度）：SNACK-COO 比 Dense+Mask 内存减少 2.8×、延迟减少 4.8×。跨 GPU（A100）验证了一致性结果，batch=4 时 SNACK-COO 在小尺寸占优，从 5000×5000 起 Sputnik 接管，验证了后端可插拔设计的必要性。

Conclusion: SNACK 证明了在消费级 GPU（RTX 3070 6 GB）上实现真正稀疏、非结构化、无需特定硬件支持的 PyTorch 层的可行性。它通过将稀疏 PyTorch 接口与具体 SpMM 内核解耦，使每个新内核的进步都能透明地转化为层级加速，将研究精力重新导向内核本身。局限性在于 SNACK-COO 专为 n≪m 且 η≥0.9 的 fp32 场景调优，大批量或中等稀疏度场景需切换至 Sputnik/FlashSparse 等后端；端到端收益受架构上限约束（如 GPT-2-small 在 η=0.9 时仅能稀疏化约 41% 参数）。未来工作方向包括 Tensor Core 支持（fp16/bf16）、多 GPU 稀疏感知集合通信、运行时后端调度器、稀疏注意力、MoE 路由器以及 AMD/Intel 平台移植。

Abstract: Deep neural networks continue to grow in parameter count, driving up training and inference cost on GPUs. Sparse neural networks and Dynamic Sparse Training (DST) promise to reduce these costs, but most implementations rely on binary masks over dense tensors and recover little of the theoretical compute, memory, or energy savings. We propose SNACK, a truly sparse GPU layer that stores and computes only non-zero connections. SNACK exposes a simple PyTorch API for restructuring connections and backpropagating gradients entirely in the sparse paradigm, and ships SNACK-COO, a custom COO-format SpMM CUDA kernel with a batch-to-Streaming-Multiprocessor mapping tuned for the small-batch, high-sparsity regime typical of large-model training and single-stream inference. At the kernel level, SNACK is up to 7x faster than the masked dense baseline (Dense+Mask) and competitive with cuSPARSE, Sputnik, and FlashSparse at 95% sparsity. At 90% sparsity, a single SNACK layer accelerates training by 8x and 3.7x, and inference by 4x and 2x, over Dense+Mask and fully dense layers, respectively, while using 72% less memory than dense and substantially less energy. End-to-end, SNACK reduces GPT-2 peak training memory by up to 40% and graph-style inference latency by 4.8x over Dense+Mask at 99% sparsity.

</details>


### [308] [PhaseGate: Phase-Aware CPU Retrieval Scheduling for On-Device LLMs on Unified Memory](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.04537)
*Seoyoon Yum,Sehoon Kim*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: PHASEGATE 是一种面向统一内存架构（Apple Silicon）的相位感知 CPU 检索调度策略。它利用 LLM 推理的 prefill 与 decode 阶段对内存干扰的敏感性差异（prefill 可摊销权重读取，decode 则依赖逐 token 的内存流式访问），分别为两阶段设置不同的并发上限（base-M4 上选 4→1）。在保持 p95 TTFT/TPOT 不超过无检索基线 1.25× 的约束下，该策略相对最佳可行固定并发策略（Fixed-1）将聚合检索吞吐提升 2.0×，且在 M2/M2 Pro 上复现了相同的优劣排序。相位盲控制 TimeGate 吞吐相近但 7 次运行中 0 次满足 TPOT 约束，证实了相位信号的独立价值。优势随输出长度增加、decode 占比上升而收窄。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 端侧助手在同一统一内存芯片上并发运行 GPU LLM 推理与 CPU 检索/工具任务，CPU 指针追踪与 GPU 权重流式访问竞争内存带宽。论文观察到四路并发 HNSW 检索在两台 M4 上使 p95 TPOT 上升 60–61%，而 p95 TTFT 仅上升 5.7–6.9%，即 decode 阶段对并发检索干扰显著更敏感。固定并发上限难以兼顾吞吐与延迟，因此需要一种能感知 LLM 推理相位的准入控制机制。

Method: 1) 工作负载：在 MLX-LM 0.31.3 上运行 4-bit Qwen2.5-1.5B（2 048 输入 token / 128 decode 步），同时在 CPU 端运行只读 FAISS HNSW（100 000 向量、384 维、M=32），检索队列保持非空。2) 策略：PHASEGATE 通过插桩 MLX-LM 发出 prefill/decode 事件，分别为两阶段设定并发上限 (p→d)，仅在活跃调用数低于该相位阈值时准入新调用，不抢占已在跑的调用；在预算 B=1.25× 下对多组 (p,d) 候选做三次随机校准，选吞吐最高且全部满足约束的配对（base-M4 选 4→1）。3) 对照：固定并发 Fixed-1；相位盲 TimeGate 按校准得到的相同高低阈值在墙钟上交替，但不观测相位。4) 评估：在 M4 Air、M4/M2/M2 Pro Mac mini 上对比吞吐、p95 TTFT/TPOT，扫描输出长度（64/128/512）与检索占空比（5%/25%/100%）。5) 衡量准入态开销：drain time、service time、过渡间隔 p95、pageout 监测。

Result: Base-M4（7 次配对随机重复）：Fixed-1 与 PHASEGATE 4→1 均 7/7 满足 B=1.25× 约束，吞吐分别为 0.78 kQPS 与 1.6 kQPS（2.0×）；TimeGate 4/1 0/7 满足约束、p95 TPOT 增加 60%、吞吐 1.5 kQPS，其高阈值态覆盖 23% 解码时长（PHASEGATE 仅 0.003%）。跨设备：M2 Mini 1.8×（5/5 通过），M2 Pro Mini 在更紧 B=1.10× 下 2.5×（7/7）。间歇需求（5%/25%/100% 占空）中 PHASEGATE/Fixed 比率均保持 2.0×。输出长度扫描中收益从 2.3×（64 token）降至 1.4×（512 token），对应 prefill 时间占比由 69%→21%。非抢占开销：drain p95 中位数 26.6 ms，相对阶段时长（prefill 中位 1 857 ms、decode 1 739 ms）很小；活跃调用在 1.06% 解码时长内超过 1（受 cap=4 的剩余调用延续影响）。未观测到 swap 增长或异常内存压力。

Conclusion: PHASEGATE 通过将 CPU 检索准入上限与 LLM 推理的 prefill/decode 阶段对齐，在统一内存的端侧设备上以可忽略的过渡代价（5.2 ms / 0.29% 基线 TTFT）将可检索吞吐翻倍，并严格守住两路 p95 延迟预算。相位盲 TimeGate 失败验证了相位信号本身的贡献。该方案简单、免核心亲和/优先级干预，可直接嵌入 MLX-LM。局限：仅一台 base-M4 走完整协议、一个 1.5B 4-bit 模型与 2 048 输入 token，未评估采样/自然语言生成、长非抢占任务、等待时间尾分布与在线自适应 caps。

Abstract: On-device assistants run GPU-based LLM inference alongside CPU retrieval on unified-memory systems. Under a saturated local-retrieval workload, four concurrent retrieval workers raise 95th-percentile (p95) decode latency by 60-61% on two M4 systems, whereas prefill latency rises by only 5.7-6.9%. We study LLM phase as an admission signal for independent CPU retrieval under controlled LLM workloads. PHASEGATE calibrates separate concurrency limits for prefill and decode, selecting four and one on our base-M4 configuration. Under a backlogged queue, it achieves 2.0 times the aggregate retrieval throughput of the best tested feasible fixed policy, with both p95 LLM latency metrics within 1.25 times their no-retrieval baselines in all seven held-out runs. A phase-blind control, TimeGate, uses the same two limits on a calibration-derived schedule without observing LLM phase. It achieves similar retrieval throughput but violates the output-token latency limit in every run. M2 and M2 Pro Mac minis reproduce the policy ordering, while output-length sweeps show that the advantage narrows as decode occupies more of each request.

</details>


### [309] [Measuring and Reducing Cross-Vendor Mismatch in Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05458)
*Erland Hilman Fuadi,Chong Tian,Xiaosong Ma,Qirong Ho*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文系统性地分析了大语言模型在不同GPU厂商（NVIDIA vs AMD）上推理时产生的数值不一致问题（cross-vendor mismatch），提出了五类度量指标，并通过精度提升和输出端LoRA适配两种方法尝试减少这种不匹配，发现单一精度提升策略效果有限且成本高昂，而选择性地保持残差流为FP32可低成本地恢复大部分精度增益。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着大语言模型在不同硬件环境间部署日益普遍，不同GPU厂商（即使权重和输入相同）的浮点运算实现差异会导致输出logits不一致。这种cross-vendor mismatch影响了模型的可靠性、可复现性以及下游任务（如知识蒸馏）中训练目标的一致性。先前工作主要研究框架间的差异，对底层硬件算术差异的分析不够深入，且通常仅依赖单一度量（如位级相等或生成token一致），无法全面评估不匹配的真实影响。

Method: 论文采用实证分析方法：（1）受控矩阵乘法案例研究，比较三种累加路径（vendor GEMM、有序tile kernel、标量kernel）定位差异源；（2）在NVIDIA A100与AMD MI210上运行两个稠密模型（Jais 8B、Llama-3.1-8B）与两个MoE模型（OLMoE、Qwen1.5-MoE），使用五类度量指标（位级相等、logit差异、top-K一致性、token一致性、任务准确率）；（3）测试两种干预策略：精度提升（FP32 upcasting、FP16）与输出头LoRA适配；（4）通过知识蒸馏实验检验不匹配对下游训练的影响。

Result: 主要发现：（1）不匹配根源在于vendor矩阵指令内部的累加顺序差异，8B模型少于10%的输出logits位级相同；（2）FP32 upcasting在稠密模型Jais上将logit MSE降低42.8%，但运行时间为3.15倍；（3）选择性FP32（仅MLPs保留BF16）可恢复94%的精度增益，运行时间仅1.30倍；（4）MoE模型中，FP32和FP16均降低概率误差但升高logit误差并改变专家选择；（5）输出头LoRA无效，因差异不可从隐藏状态预测；（6）AMD教师蒸馏的学生在431道MMLU题目上与NVIDIA教师学生给出不同答案；（7）FP32 on both vendors使98.4%的OLMoE响应完全相同。

Conclusion: Cross-vendor mismatch是一个普遍存在且影响深远的现象，单纯依赖单一度量指标会严重误判干预的成本与收益。FP32全精度提升对稠密模型有效但成本过高，而选择性精度策略可在低成本下恢复大部分增益。MoE模型对精度变化更敏感，专家选择变化会传播差异。输出头LoRA无法纠正差异，因其源于计算早期。在跨厂商环境中，硬件成为不可控的隐藏变量，影响知识蒸馏等下游任务。应在kernel和矩阵指令层面实现显式且共享的累加顺序以消除主要差异源，并使用多类度量指标共同评估跨厂商一致性。

Abstract: Running the same language model on different graphics processing unit (GPU) vendors can produce different logits, even when the model weights and inputs are the same. We analyze cross-vendor mismatch in two dense and two mixture-of-experts (MoE) models with five metric families, namely bitwise equality, logit differences, top-K consistency, token agreement, and task accuracy. We trace one source of the mismatch to accumulation order inside vendors' matrix instructions. Upcasting to FP32 reduces the dense model's logit error by 43% at three times the runtime, yet keeping only the MLPs in BF16 retains 94% of this gain at 1.3 times the runtime, so most of the cost of full upcasting buys little. In the MoE models, FP32 and FP16 both lower the probability error but raise the logit error and change expert selection, and FP16 fails in the dense model. An output-head low-rank adapter (LoRA) does not help either, since the final hidden state does not predict the mismatch. The mismatch also carries into training. With every seed fixed, a student distilled from a teacher running on AMD answers 431 MMLU questions differently from one distilled from the same teacher on NVIDIA. Under FP32 upcasting, bitwise equality barely changes while the output distributions move most of the way to the reference, so judging cross-vendor agreement by a single measure misreads both its cost and its gains. Code is available at this https URL .

</details>


### [310] [Disentangling Task Difficulty from Run-Level Failure in Agent Failure Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05572)
*Mohsen EsfandyariDoulabi,Lawrence Arkoh,Biruk Tadesse,Vaishvi Patel,Mehul Sharma,Marcelo d'Amorim,Wesley Assunção*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文揭示了LLM智能体失败预测领域中一个重要的评估缺陷：广泛使用的"聚合AUROC"指标主要反映的是任务间的难度差异（task difficulty），而非对当前执行轨迹是否将失败的真正判别能力（run-level failure）。通过分解pooled AUROC为within-unit和cross-unit两部分，作者证明run-level的早期判别能力在多种预测方法中普遍偏弱（AUROC约0.50-0.55），远未达到实际干预所需的0.84-0.93水平，且在固定token预算下任务级资源分配策略优于基于run-level的早停策略。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM智能体失败预测工作普遍报告较高的聚合AUROC（0.85-0.94），但这些预测器通常将来自不同任务的轨迹混合训练。作者怀疑高AUROC可能仅反映了对任务难度的区分，而非对具体某次执行是否会失败的检测。这一区分至关重要：任务级难度信息用于决定计算资源分配，而run-level预测用于决定是否干预正在进行的执行轨迹。混淆二者会导致评估误导和部署决策错误。

Method: 基于GQM框架，研究包含三个研究问题：(1) 将pooled AUROC分解为within-unit（同模型-任务对的成功与失败对比）和cross-unit（不同单元对比）两部分，利用SWE-agent、SWE-rebench、LiveClawBench和Latent Programming Horizons四个包含重复执行的基准；(2) 在可在线计算的前缀（prefix）上评估多种预测器——run-blind基线（难度oracle、TF-IDF预执行模型）、行为轨迹特征（logistic regression、gradient boosting）、复现的Automata系统、发布的EarlyEval和one-class monitor、以及C4上的hidden-state线性探针；(3) 在固定token预算下进行重放实验，比较任务级分配（round-robin、静态转移排序、Budgeted Thompson Sampling）与run-level中止策略。使用GroupKFold交叉拟合、bootstrap置信区间、within-unit置换检验进行统计分析。

Result: RQ1：超过99.93%的pooled AUROC正负样本对来自不同单元，难度oracle在C1上达到pooled AUROC 0.9454但within-task仅为0.5000；C2和C4-L的same-unit pair权重仅为3.4×10⁻⁵和6.8×10⁻⁴。RQ2：早期run-level判别普遍偏弱——Automata在1轮时within-task AUROC为0.507，EarlyEval在1步后为0.49-0.52，C4-Q隐藏状态探针平均为0.509；信号随执行深度增加而增强（C1从0.517升至0.653），且与模型能力呈负相关（ρ=-0.662）。RQ3：任务级分配在紧预算下表现优异（如C4-Q上解决162.0 vs 53.0个任务），而中止策略需要within-task AUROC达到0.84-0.93才能改善吞吐量，远高于观察到的0.50-0.55。

Conclusion: 该研究证明高聚合AUROC主要反映任务/模型层面的难度差异，而非run-level失败检测能力。当前评估方法不足以证明监测器可用于运行时干预。作者建议：报告within-unit AUROC、same-unit pair权重和pooled-within gap；仅在执行期间可获得的前缀进行检查点评估（避免基于最终长度的分数检查点泄露未来信息）；将run-level干预策略与任务级分配基线在相同计算预算下进行比较。该研究为失败预测领域建立了更严谨的评估标准，并明确了预测信号应与部署决策相匹配。

Abstract: Predicting whether an LLM agent will fail has emerged as a promising direction for supporting intervention during execution. Recent approaches report strong predictive performance, often with AUROC values between 0.85 and 0.94. However, predictors are typically trained by pooling runs from many tasks. We hypothesize that part of this performance comes from recognizing that some tasks are harder than others, rather than detecting whether a particular run is heading toward failure. This distinction matters because task-level difficulty supports decisions about where to allocate computation, while run-level prediction is needed to decide whether to intervene in an ongoing trajectory. We study benchmarks with repeated attempts of the same task by the same agent and separate cross-unit comparisons from comparisons between successful and failed runs of the same model-task unit. Across the evaluated corpora, more than 99.93% of the positive-negative pairs underlying pooled AUROC are cross-unit. Accordingly, predictors that never observe the current run can achieve high pooled performance, including a difficulty oracle with AUROC up to 0.945, while remaining at chance within task. Early run-level discrimination is consistently weak across trajectory predictors, released monitors, and hidden-state probes, although it improves later in execution and is stronger for weaker agents. Under fixed token budgets, task-level allocation outperforms abort-only strategies, while early stopping becomes beneficial only when within-task AUROC reaches about 0.84-0.93, far above the 0.50-0.55 range observed for early monitors. These results show that failure prediction should be evaluated not only by outcome accuracy, but by whether the captured signal supports the intended deployment decision.

</details>


### [311] [Technical Report on the Turba Fertilizer Machine Learning Stack in Morocco](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05949)
*Abdelghani Belgaid,Zakaria Mahmoud,Fahd Chibani,Oumnia Ennaji,Younes Boudoul,Dounia Rachid*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文介绍了Turba肥料机器学习技术栈,这是一个面向摩洛哥的三层开源可复现性架构,包括数据访问层(turba-client)、数据层(turba-data)和模型层(turba-models),专门用于特定地点的肥料推荐研究。其核心贡献是建立"溯源分离"原则,严格区分上游推荐系统输出、版本化分析快照和离线机器学习代理输出三类研究对象。首版数据集基于44,096个ESA WorldCereal位置生成132,017个作物-地点推荐场景,评估了9种回归模型族并打包了5个最优作物特定代理模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有特定地点肥料推荐系统存在三个可复现性瓶颈:推荐函数仅通过交互式界面访问、输出缺乏版本控制、训练好的近似模型无法独立加载和基准测试。摩洛哥的Fertimap等系统虽有公开接口,但底层栅格产品不可下载,无法实现独立计算复用。作者旨在通过开源技术栈解决这些科学复用障碍。

Method: 三层模块化架构:(1) turba-client提供Python API和CLI,封装上游Fertimap工作流,支持位置剖面获取、作物发现和批量推荐检索;(2) turba-data以Parquet格式分发版本化分析快照,冻结上游输出;(3) turba-models打包.joblib序列化模型工件,通过模型注册表提供可加载的离线代理。使用ESA WorldCereal获取44,096个唯一地理坐标(43,825冬谷物+271玉米),按作物工作流相容性扩展场景,在medium目标产量设置下生成132,017条记录。评估9种回归模型族(Extra Trees、LightGBM、CatBoost、Random Forest、XGBoost、线性回归、Ridge、Elastic Net、AdaBoost),采用确定性80/20分割,固定库配置不进行超参数优化,使用R²、MAE、RMSE、中位绝对误差、MAPE、sMAPE等指标。

Result: 打包5个最优作物特定代理模型:3个冬谷物模型(Barley Rainfed、Wheat Rainfed、Wheat Irrigated)使用LightGBM,R²均达0.999,MAE 0.040-0.069 kg/ha,RMSE 0.160-0.210;2个玉米模型(Maize Grain、Maize Silage)使用XGBoost,R²分别为0.987和0.994,MAE 0.385和0.478 kg/ha。研究强调这些结果衡量的是代理模型对参考推荐函数保真度,而非农艺预测性能。发现K₂O和P₂O₅目标中存在大量零值(78.83%和31.05%),使MAPE等百分比指标不稳定。还指出随机分割主要是插值测试,不能保证地理迁移性。

Conclusion: Turba技术栈通过正式区分推荐响应、版本化分析快照和离线机器学习代理三类计算对象,为摩洛哥特定地点肥料推荐研究建立了可复现基础。架构严格保持溯源分离:推荐系统输出不等于田间观测、场景扩展标签不等于真实作物身份、代理一致性不等于农艺验证。未来工作包括空间块状交叉验证、区域留出评估、时序迁移、不确定性量化、田间试验验证,以及扩展的turba-bio(土壤微生物组)和turba-gym(强化学习作物管理环境)等模块。

Abstract: Site-specific fertilizer recommendation systems adapt nutrient advice to location, soil properties, crop type, and production targets, but scientific reuse is constrained when recommendation functions remain accessible mainly through interactive interfaces, outputs are not versioned, and trained approximations cannot be independently loaded or benchmarked. This technical report presents the Turba fertilizer machine learning stack, a three-layer open-source implementation for reproducible site-specific fertilizer recommendation in Morocco. \texttt{turba-client} provides programmatic access to publicly accessible site profiles, crop-specific target-yield spaces, and N, P$_2$O$_5$, and K$_2$O recommendation workflows; \texttt{turba-data} distributes analysis-ready snapshots; and \texttt{turba-models} packages crop-specific machine learning surrogates of recommendation outputs. The architecture links upstream retrieval, versioned analytical snapshots, reproducible cross-model benchmarking, and loadable offline surrogates while preserving the distinction between recommendation-system outputs, observed agricultural data, and model-generated predictions. The first dataset was constructed from 44,096 unique ESA WorldCereal locations. Scenario expansion across supported cereal workflows generated 132,017 crop-location recommendation requests under a medium target-yield setting. The resulting 22-variable dataset spans 10 regions, 66 provinces, and 1,149 communes. Nine regression families were evaluated under a fixed deterministic 80/20 protocol, and the current release packages five best-performing crop-specific models. The machine learning task is recommendation-function emulation rather than prediction of observed crop response. The stack provides a reproducible basis for spatial and temporal validation, uncertainty estimation, field-trial comparison, and future integration with additional data.

</details>


### [312] [Bayes-Sufficient Compression Is Not Enough: How Does Communication Help Multi-Agent Systems?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03769)
*Yi Xie,Zhanke Zhou,Yi Fan,Yong Ge,Bo Han,Bo Liu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文研究多智能体LLM系统中通信消息何时对执行者的下一步决策有益，提出"接收者相对有界协调"框架，形式化地将消息效用定义为接收者增益减去协议税，并通过六项基准测试证明：贝叶斯充分压缩不一定对有界执行者可用，消息后损失可分为外部化、吸收和动作闭合三阶段，更强的发送者仅在接收者负担阈值以上才有帮助。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多智能体LLM系统在编码、网络和工具使用工作流中将工作分配给具有不对称上下文、能力和预算的智能体。通信是核心协议决策：暴露完整上下文迫使执行者在预算内重新发现相关性；短消息可直接暴露缺失目标，但也可能遗漏有用信息或以执行者难以使用的形式呈现。现有多智能体评估的聚合任务指标混淆了通信效果的不同来源，需要在接收者的下一步决策层面评估每条消息的价值。

Method: 提出"接收者相对有界协调"框架：（1）将通信效用定义为接收者增益减去协议税的身份分解（命题1）；（2）表征感知压缩定理，比较压缩消息与原始上下文的效用（定理2）；（3）证明贝叶斯充分压缩对有界执行者不一定最优（定理3），构造了严格交替标签反例；（4）三阶段瓶颈分解定理，将总损失分为外部化（发送端）、吸收（接收端摄取）和动作闭合（接收端决策）三部分（定理4）；（5）固定消息重放分离发送端和接收端损失（命题5）；（6）在单交叉条件下，更强发送者在接收者负担阈值以上才有帮助（定理6）；（7）将理论转化为推理时协议选择器，对候选动作评分并选择最优通信动作（公式5）。

Result: 六项基准测试结果：Qwen协议在ContextBench上将联合准确率从0.633提升至0.775，但在ToolSandbox上从0.889降至0.653。固定消息重放揭示了GLM-5、MiniMax-M2.5和o3等接收者在恢复正确工件后仍选择错误动作的闭合失败（闭合率57-60%）。跨模型家族扩展显示OpenAI接收者下ToolSandbox从0.803提升至1.0。发送者升级阈值线性拟合为0.638（95% CI [0.491, 0.780]），41个锚点扩展分析得到阈值0.629（95% CI [0.552, 0.706]），89.5%的非零锚点显示正到负的单交叉。推理时选择器在ContextBench上以1735标记/步达到0.737准确率，比始终发送节省46.4%标记，在ToolSandbox上达到1.000准确率，标记减少70.2%。

Conclusion: 接收者相对通信在信息损失和解码器兼容性之间与协议税和局部负担进行交换。压缩仅在税节省超过省略信息和解码器不匹配时才有收益，贝叶斯充分性不保证接收者可用性，消息后损失分为外部化、吸收和动作闭合三阶段，更强发送者仅在接收者负担阈值以上有帮助。固定消息重放暴露了恢复正确工件却选择错误动作的接收者，由此产生的选择器改进了接收者需求的自适应通信，并在所评估的通信机制上改善了准确率-成本边界。

Abstract: Multi-agent LLM systems pair a sender with broad context and an executor with a limited local view. We study when a short message improves the executor's next decision, when raw context is preferable, and when a stronger sender helps. Our framework, \emph{receiver-relative bounded coordination}, expresses message utility as receiver gain minus protocol tax. Compression beats raw context when tax savings exceed losses from omitted information and decoder mismatch. Even \emph{Bayes-sufficient} compression can fail when a bounded executor cannot use its surface form. A three-stage decomposition separates externalization, absorption, and \emph{action closure}, explaining how errors remain after the correct content reaches the receiver. Under a single-crossing condition, sender upgrades help above a receiver-burden threshold. Across six benchmarks, the same Qwen protocol raises ContextBench joint accuracy from $0.633$ to $0.775$ but lowers ToolSandbox from $0.889$ to $0.653$. Fixed-message replay reveals closure failures despite correct artifact recovery. These results guide an inference-time selector that improves the accuracy-cost frontier on the evaluated communication regimes.

</details>


### [313] [Least Squares for Time Series Forecasting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03812)
*Weiu-qiou Ciang,Yuzhou Hong,Sherry Chen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文将时间序列预测中的瓶颈表示学习形式化为两个不同的最小二乘问题（预测程序 vs. 下一潜变量程序），证明对于标量目标，预测程序等价于普通最小二乘且各向同性约束只是重新缩放，而下一潜变量程序在重复通道存在时会导致报告坐标被"驱逐"。同时指出单步训练损失与开环迭代误差是两个不同量，并提供了完整的形式化分析和合成实验验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前时间序列预测方法（如 LeNEPA）使用下一潜变量回归作为训练损失，但这与最终部署时被评估的未来观测值上的误差是不同的目标函数。当观测向量中存在冗余或重复通道时，预测损失与表示损失之间的不匹配会导致报告的预测性能被高估或完全失败。本文旨在形式化这两个目标函数之间的差异。

Method: 1. 将预测形式化为"预测程序"（Definition 1）：直接最小化解码潜变量在报告坐标 s_{t+1} 上的误差；2. 将下一潜变量学习形式化为"下一潜变量程序"（Definition 2）：最小化整个下一向量 y_{t+1} 的重建误差，然后冻结编码器再拟合头部；3. 通过三个定理分析两个程序的解：Theorem 3（标量目标忽略额外秩，等价于 OLS）、Theorem 4（各向同性是规范变换，不改变预测）、Theorem 5（下一潜变量程序是降秩回归）；4. 在合成数据（4维序列，后三坐标为相同 AR(1)）上通过法方程（而非优化器）求解以验证理论；5. 分析开环迭代的单步系数误差传播（公式 1）。

Result: 合成实验中：预测程序在秩≥1时 MSE=0.9921（匹配创新方差），权重完全集中在第一坐标；下一潜变量程序秩1时 MSE=2.7938（接近边际方差 2.794），将 0.9998 的质量放在重复的 u 块上，秩2时与预测程序一致；单步系数 0.8031 迭代的开环误差从 1 步 0.992 增至 8 步 2.700；白化与不白化预测潜变量后再拟合头部 MSE 差小于 10^{-15}，验证各向同性仅为重缩放。

Conclusion: 对于标量预测任务，应将训练损失直接放在报告坐标上（Definition 1，预测程序），额外潜变量宽度无益，各向同性约束只是规范变换；下一潜变量程序（Definition 2）适用于需要重建所有通道的表示学习，但对单一报告坐标是错配损失；单步拟合的系数 a 决定了开环误差 R_K = σ²(1-a^{2K})/(1-a²)，仅报告训练损失 R_1 而不报告 R_K 是不充分的；应在报告坐标上计算梯度，而非通过整体重建损失间接传递。

Abstract: A time-series forecast is scored on a future value of the series. A representation loss that regresses the next latent, as in LeNEPA, is a different least-squares problem on the same bottleneck. We write both programs down. The forecast program minimizes the error of a decoded latent on the coordinate that will be reported. For a scalar target and a linear decoder, every latent rank of at least one matches ordinary least squares, and an isotropy constraint is only a rescaling: after the decoder is refit, the forecast does not move. The other program fits the whole next vector at a fixed rank, then freezes the encoder and attaches a head. On a four-dimensional series whose last three coordinates are the same autoregression, that rank-1 fit puts mass $0.9998$ on the repeated coordinate and forecasts the remaining signal at the marginal variance $2.794$. The forecast program puts mass $1$ on the signal and matches the innovation variance $0.992$. Rank $2$ gives the vector fit a second direction, and the two programs agree. Iterating the fitted one-step coefficient $0.803$ raises the open-loop error from $0.992$ at one step to $2.700$ at eight steps.

</details>


### [314] [Memory-State Critic for Asymmetric Actor-Critic with Application to Vision-Based Pursuit-Evasion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03830)
*Arthur Louette,Alejandro Sánchez Roncero,Gaspard Lambrechts,Pascal Leroy,Julien Hansen,Petter Ögren,Damien Ernst*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出"记忆-状态评论家"(Memory-State Critic)，用于部分可观测马尔可夫决策过程中的非对称 actor-critic 强化学习。该方法通过复用 actor 自身的循环隐藏状态作为评论家输入（配合停止梯度），无需训练额外的循环编码器，即可获得与"历史-状态评论家"相同的无偏策略梯度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在 POMDP 中学习策略通常采用非对称 actor-critic：训练时评论家可访问真实环境状态，但执行时仅依赖观测。由于策略依赖历史信息，纯状态评论家可能产生有偏梯度；现有"历史-状态评论家"需额外循环编码器，导致训练时循环计算翻倍，并引入独立的表征学习问题。本文旨在消除评论家侧冗余的循环编码器，同时保持理论保证。

Method: 核心思想：将评论家输入从"状态 + 评论家侧编码的历史 z^c"改为"状态 + actor 自身的隐藏状态 z^a"。理论方面，通过归纳法证明：(1) 确定性循环编码器下，on-policy 时 V^π(s, z^a) = V^π(s, h)；(2) 由此导出的优势函数 A^π(s, z^a, a) 与基于历史的优势函数一致，可代入非对称策略梯度公式而保持无偏。实践中采用停止梯度，避免评论家损失影响 actor 编码器。实验平台为基于 IsaacLab 和 skrl 的视觉追逃场景（双四旋翼），对比四种评论家变体各 20 个随机种子在 5.12×10^7 步下的表现。

Result: 记忆-状态评论家在开放和有墙两种场地中均匹配或超过历史-状态评论家的最终回报，且收敛速度更快（去除了评论家侧独立的优化问题）。在有墙场地中，记忆-状态评论家略优于纯状态评论家（因为遮挡使状态无法消解历史），证明历史信息的边际价值。在开放场地中，纯状态评论家因状态近似马尔可夫且架构更简单，表现与记忆-状态评论家相当。反应式评论家（仅依赖当前观测与上一动作）无法学得有效策略，表明记忆项对恢复历史价值至关重要。终止分析显示记忆-状态评论家有墙场地捕获率最高。

Conclusion: 记忆-状态评论家是一种单编码器的非对称评论家，适用于带循环正则机制的 POMDP。它复用 actor 的隐藏状态，文本层面给出与历史-状态评论家相同的 on-policy 值函数和无偏策略梯度证明，但只需一个循环编码器。在视觉追逃任务中表现更好且更快收敛。该方法局限于对手是启发式策略的单智能体 POMDP；未来工作包括在标准 POMDP 基准上对比以及物理部署。

Abstract: In partially observable Markov decision processes, the optimal policy generally depends on the history of observations and past actions. Asymmetric actor-critic methods have become popular to learn such policies when additional information, such as the true state of the environment, is available during training. The critic, which is not needed at execution, is given access to the state. A critic conditioned on the state alone is generally ill-defined and yields biased policy gradients. Conditioning on the state and the history, the history-state critic restores both. In this paper, we show that conditioning the critic on the state and the policy's own memory, i.e., the internal representation of the history through which the policy selects its actions, is already well-defined and gives unbiased policy gradients, removing the need for a second recurrent approximator of the history. We call it the memory state critic. It follows that a critic based on the policy's memory need not backpropagate its loss into that memory, even though the memory is a lossy encoding of the history. We evaluate the memory-state critic in a vision-based pursuit-evasion environment between two quadrotors across two arena types. The pursuer is the learning agent, and the evader is sampled per episode from a fixed pool of heuristic behaviours. The results show that the memory-state critic outperforms the history-state critic and converges faster. In addition to being unbiased compared to the state-only critic, it maintains a slight edge in the wall arena, where the actor's history carries information that the privileged state alone does not.

</details>


### [315] [Where Does Jagged Competence Come From?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03831)
*Ioannis Tsiokos*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文研究神经网络中的"锯齿状能力"(jagged competence)现象——即在某些输入上表现优异却在特定输入上失败的根源。作者设计了一个包含两层结构(A和B)的可控任务，发现训练网络学习上层任务B时，仅能获得下层理论A的不完整(锯齿状)版本，且A的变形与B的失败位置直接相关。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现代AI系统普遍表现出"锯齿状能力"：平均错误率很低，但在特定输入上仍会失败。这一现象易观察却难溯因，因为在大系统中通常不知道任务需要哪些中间计算、模型是否计算、使用并保留了它们。本文旨在通过一个两层结构已知的可控任务，探究锯齿状能力的来源。

Method: 1. 任务设计：构建两层游戏任务。层A从四条记录计算五个槽位总和；层B使用第1槽总和类别和从前序棋局继承的模式(mode)预测下一棋局类别。B严格扩展A（基于"Six Birds Theory"的非因子化条件）。
2. 网络结构：小型循环网络（GRU宽度16+32，约4万参数），三个种子（0/1/2）训练20,000次更新。
3. 多版本设计：records→prediction、records+sums→prediction、records→prediction+sums等变体，改变A的监督、可用性和连接方式。
4. 五项可测量成就：可还原性(recoverability)、计算(computation)、访问(access)、保留性(preservation)、可靠预测(reliable prediction)。
5. 校准测量：探针分析、普查(24,435个棋盘)、构造历史测试(576个)、精确参考和对照实验。
6. 六个独立研究(r8-r13)逐步隔离目标噪声、访问、编码、侵蚀等因素。

Result: 1. 训练B使网络获得A的锯齿状版本：B需要的第1槽线性探针可读性达97-98%，其他槽位降至5-10%。
2. B展现典型锯齿：自然KL低于3×10⁻⁴比特，但最大全变差距离(la TV)达0.25（远超0.02阈值）。
3. 类别误读集中在第1槽分界附近（cutoff band，占57/289/87个误读）。
4. 显式训练A时仅大致正确（非精确）。
5. 连接已学A到B使误读减少1.3-17倍。
6. 同一精确A以one-hot输入(0-2误读)优于数值输入(10-317误读)。
7. 一次B更新即侵蚀精确A，除非阻断B的预测梯度。
8. 即使A精确并已送达，仍存在B的失败。

Conclusion: 1. 锯齿状能力的部分来源已定位：下层理论A的不均匀获取、访问和保留解释了上层B的部分失败，但不能解释所有失败。
2. "网络知道A"是五项独立成就的组合，每项都可能单独失败。
3. 平均错误率和探针准确率都不能单独证明任务的完整可靠实现。
4. 实践启示：评估网络能力时应逐层测量其获取、送达和保持的信息，而非仅看平均错误。
5. 局限性：单一任务族、小型架构、三个种子、固定预算；构造测试不估计自然分布频率；跨研究比较存在混淆。

Abstract: Capable systems often show jagged competence: low average error alongside failures on particular inputs. We ask where it comes from in a task built from two known layers. A lower layer A computes five per-slot sums from records; an upper layer B uses the slot-1 sum and a mode carried over from earlier boards to predict the next board's category, so B cannot be computed from the current A alone: B is a strict extension of A. We train small recurrent networks on B and measure, against exact ground truth, what they acquire of A. The central finding is that learning B gives the network a jagged version of A, measured through probe readability and supervised outputs. It is readable where B needs it (slot 1, 97-98% by a linear probe) and becomes less readable where B does not (the other slots, 5-10%); category misreads concentrate near the slot-1 cutoffs; and when A is trained explicitly it comes out only approximately right. The networks show jagged competence in B: natural KL below $3\times10^{-4}$ bits coexists with a maximum law TV of about 0.25 on constructed histories. Matched experiments show that even a good A is not enough: connecting a learned A to B cuts misreads 1.3 to 17-fold, the same exact A gives fewer misreads as one-hot inputs (0-2) than as numerical inputs (10-317), one B update makes an exact A inexact unless the B gradient is blocked, and exact A still leaves some B failures. In this task, uneven acquisition, access and preservation of the lower theory explain part of the jagged competence of a network that learns the theory built on it; some failures remain unexplained. Whether the same holds in larger systems is a test to run.

</details>


### [316] [LLM-enhanced spatio-temporal learning for grid-level docked bike sharing demand prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03834)
*Xuxilu Zhang,Francesc Soriguera*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于LLM增强的时空学习框架，用于网格级共享单车需求预测。核心创新在于将非结构化的城市事件文本通过LLM转化为具有物理可解释性的高斯衰减冲击波场，并注入到零膨胀自适应时空图卷积网络（ZI-ASTGCN）中。在Barcelona Bicing数据集上的实验验证了该方法在事件驱动场景下的优越性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的时空预测模型依赖历史流量序列和固定图结构，无法有效整合非结构化外部文本（如城市事件、新闻、交通公告），在异常社会事件扰动正常出行模式时预测精度受限。此外，细粒度网格级数据存在严重的零膨胀和重尾分布问题，传统单输出头的损失函数难以有效处理。

Method: 方法包含两大核心组件：(1) **语义冲击波机制**：使用LLM解析非结构化文本，提取每个事件的三个物理参数（强度Sₑ、空间影响半径Rₑ、时间滞后Δtₑ），构建高斯衰减时空扰动场 I_{i,t}^{(e)} = Sₑ·exp(-d²/R²)·exp(-Δt/τ)；(2) **ZI-ASTGCN网络**：在ASTGCN基础上融合静态邻接矩阵、可学习潜在图和动态空间注意力形成A_fused，通过交叉注意力融合语义特征，并采用双分支输出头（门控概率分支+条件强度回归分支），配合多任务零膨胀损失（Huber损失+BCE）联合优化，处理稀疏数据。

Result: 在Barcelona Bicing数据集（2025年4-6月，374个800m×800m网格）上的实验显示：ZI-ASTGCN在所有指标上均优于STGCN、DCRNN、GraphWaveNet基线。流入预测RMSE为3.112（vs DCRNN 3.254），MAE降低31%（1.360 vs 1.973）。消融实验中，引入LLM语义场使流入EvtRMSE从3.653降至3.359，流出EvtRMSE从3.470降至3.076。空间误差分析表明自适应图融合机制有效抑制了误差在图结构上的横向扩散。

Conclusion: 研究验证了将LLM衍生的物理可解释语义信号注入时空图卷积架构的有效性，能够在统一框架中同时处理稀疏观测和事件驱动的需求激增。局限性包括：LLM参数提取当前为离线运行，难以实时部署；未整合视频流和社交媒体等非结构化数据源；冲击波表示在不同城市形态和共享单车系统间的泛化性有待验证。

Abstract: Short-term bike-sharing demand forecasting is complicated by spatial-temporal non-stationarity and the practical difficulty of incorporating unstructured external text into numerical pipelines. Conventional approaches rely on historical flow sequences and fixed graph structures, thereby constraining their accuracy when anomalous social events perturb normal travel patterns. We propose a forecasting framework in which a Large Language Model (LLM) drives a semantic shockwave mechanism that converts free-form urban text, such as municipal event schedules, local news, and transit bulletins, into quantified spatial-temporal perturbation fields. The LLM extracts three physically interpretable parameters per event (intensity, spatial reach, and temporal lag), from which Gaussian decay fields are constructed and injected into a Zero-Inflated Adaptive Spatio-Temporal Graph Convolutional Network (ZI-ASTGCN). To handle the pronounced sparsity of grid-level measurements, the model couples a dual-branch output head with a multi-task zero-inflated loss that jointly trains a gating probability and a conditional flow intensity. Experiments on the operational Barcelona Bicing dataset show that ZI-ASTGCN outperforms established neural baselines, with particularly strong gains during high-demand periods, validating the utility of physics-grounded semantic signals in spatial-temporal mobility forecasting.

</details>


### [317] [KVE-KD: Key Visual Evidence-Guided Knowledge Distillation for Vision-Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03842)
*Jianbin Zhang,Xin Sun,Shanwen Wang,Wei Ye,Susanto Rahardja*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 KVE-KD 框架，通过教师模型动态识别任务相关的视觉 token（关键视觉证据），指导面向 VLM 的知识蒸馏，无需引入推理时开销。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 VLM 蒸馏方法对所有视觉 token 施加均匀监督或采用静态 token 选择，导致任务相关线索与背景噪声混淆，损害跨模态推理能力。固定的层数和 token 数量无法适应不同样本间融合起点和证据复杂度的差异。

Method: 1) 将最终生成前的文本 token 设为统一语义锚点 q*；2) 通过迭代移除视觉 token 后 q* 表示的余弦相似度变化，定位跨模态融合起始层 l*；3) 在 l* 层利用锚点条件注意力分布对视觉 token 排序，并以归一化熵自适应确定证据集大小 k；4) 仅对 Top-k 个关键视觉证据 token 计算 MSE 特征蒸馏损失，与反向 KL logit 蒸馏和任务损失联合优化。

Result: 以 Qwen3-VL-8B 为教师、Qwen3-VL-2B 为学生，在六个基准（MME^P、GQA、VQA^T、POPE、MMB^dev、SQA^I）上平均得分 79.6，较基线 vanilla 学生提升 3.9 点，较复现的 Align-KD 提升 1.6 点，且推理阶段零开销。消融实验验证了融合层定位与自适应证据选择各模块的贡献。

Conclusion: KVE-KD 是首个面向 VLM 蒸馏的自适应视觉 token 选择框架，能可靠适配样本特定的跨模态融合特性，使学生模型更精准地学习任务相关视觉表征。未来工作将探索特征蒸馏与关系蒸馏的结合，以及与其他模型压缩方法的协同。

Abstract: Knowledge distillation is crucial for deploying vision-language models on resource-constrained devices. However, existing methods typically impose uniform supervision across visual tokens or rely on static token selection, which confuses task-relevant cues with background noise and degrades cross-modal reasoning. To address this limitation, we propose Key Visual Evidence-guided Knowledge Distillation (KVE-KD), a framework that dynamically focuses feature distillation on task-relevant visual tokens identified by the teacher model. Specifically, KVE-KD appoints the final pre-generation textual token as a unified semantic anchor and identifies the target cross-modal fusion layer by analyzing changes in the anchor representation through iterative visual-token contribution removal. Within this layer, KVE-KD ranks visual tokens via the anchor-conditioned attention distribution and selects the most informative visual tokens as key visual evidence with normalized entropy. The key visual evidence subsequently guides focused visual feature distillation, making the student align closely with the teacher's task-relevant visual representations while suppressing irrelevant background information. Extensive experiments on six benchmarks demonstrate that KVE-KD outperforms state-of-the-art cross-modal distillation methods, with particularly pronounced gains on tasks requiring complex reasoning and fine-grained visual understanding. Importantly, these improvements are achieved without introducing any inference-time overhead. The source code is available at this https URL .

</details>


### [318] [BAT-NO: A Boundary-Condition-Aware Transformer Neural Operator for Crashworthiness Prediction of Vehicle Components](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03854)
*Haoran Li,Yingxue Zhao,Haosu Zhou,Mustapha Ziane,Pierre Culiere,Tobias Pfaff,Nan Li*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出BAT-NO（边界条件感知Transformer神经算子），用于在几何、载荷和边界条件同时变化下，对车辆B柱部件的瞬态位移场和标量耐撞性响应进行自回归预测。BAT-NO结合了循环网格消息传递与潜在网格Fourier算子（FNO）处理，并通过基于切片的全局注意力与直接边界到网格投影的混合局部-全局机制显式编码边界条件。在Shape（S）、Loading（SL）和Shape-Loading-Boundary（SLB）三个逐步扩展的B柱数据集上，BAT-NO在所有案例中均取得了最低的最终步平均节点欧几里得位移误差（MED），在最具挑战性的SLB案例中相对于次优基线降低了32.6%。经超参数调优后，验证集误差从0.451 mm降至0.269 mm，在300个未见测试样本上达到0.267 mm。基于注意力的标量解码器联合预测了6条耐撞性响应轨迹，平均相对误差为2.46%，大多数派生耐撞性指标的中位数误差低于3%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有部件级耐撞性代理模型通常在单一固定边界条件下训练，限制了其对实际装配中边界条件变化的泛化能力。在车辆装配中，相邻结构的变化会通过连接区域以边界条件变化的形式传递到组件层面，而固定边界条件下训练的代理模型难以捕捉这种装配级影响。因此需要一种能够在几何、载荷和边界条件同时变化的扩展设计空间中工作的代理模型。

Method: BAT-NO整合了以下关键技术：1) GNO风格的网格到潜在网格核投影（k近邻网络）；3) 边界条件感知切片通路——基于物理注意力的切片特征，使用Transolver风格的切片自注意力和Perceiver风格的切片到网格交叉注意力，将全局交互信息传递到潜在网格；4) 直接边界到网格投影——通过距离softmax权重将节点级边界条件特征直接插值到潜在网格，保留局部空间结构；5) FNO层在融合后的潜在网格上进行全局频谱处理；6) GNO网格到网格核投影将处理后的网格特征重建回原始网格；7) 门控循环机制（门控循环网格）在自回归展开中传递时间步间的隐式状态；8) 基于交叉注意力的标量解码器（网格查询或网格查询变体）联合预测位移场和6条标量响应轨迹（内能、三个弹簧反力、接触力、侵入量）。训练采用调度采样策略，最大预测反馈概率为0.75。

Result: 在B柱侧撞有限元仿真框架下，系统评估了BAT-NO与MGN、ReGUNet、DeepONet、FNO、GNO、GINO、Transolver和UPT等8个基线模型。三个数据集分别包含形状变化（S）、形状+载荷变化（SL）和形状+载荷+边界条件变化（SLB），各使用100个训练样本和100个训练+50个验证样本。BAT-NO在所有三个案例中均取得最低的平均最终步MED：Case S为0.1318 mm（相对次优降低18.2%），Case SL为0.1742 mm，Case SLB为0.4510 mm（相对次优降低32.6%）。消融实验验证了切片通路（-8.2%）、预投影消息传递（-5.9%）、循环机制（-8.5%）和直接边界投影（-14.6%）各自的贡献。超参数调优后SLB验证误差从0.451降至0.267 mm，在300个独立测试样本上达到0.267 mm。标量响应平均相对轨迹误差为2.46%，10个派生耐撞性指标中7个低于3%。标量解码器可移植到ReGUNet、GINO和Transolver等其他代理架构。

Conclusion: BAT-NO通过显式的局部和全局边界条件表示，有效提升了几何、载荷和边界条件同时变化的扩展部件级设计空间中的耐撞性预测精度。切片注意力通路和直接边界到网格投影提供了互补的全局和局部边界条件描述。基于注意力的标量解码器具有良好的架构灵活性，可应用于多种代理模型。该方法的局限性在于仅基于单一部件级侧撞配置，未来工作应扩展到其他车辆部件和更大装配，纳入材料、接头和接触行为的更广泛变化，并提高潜在网格与注意力操作的效率以适应更高分辨率网格和更复杂的碰撞场景。

Abstract: High-fidelity finite-element simulations provide accurate crashworthiness predictions, but their cost limits iterative design exploration. Deep learning surrogates can reduce this cost, but many component-level models are developed under a single prescribed boundary condition, limiting generalisation to boundary variations. This work proposes a Boundary-Condition-Aware Transformer Neural Operator (BAT-NO) for autoregressive prediction of transient displacement fields and scalar crashworthiness responses under variations in geometry and boundary conditions. A B-pillar simulation framework evaluates generalisation across variations in geometry, impact position and velocity, and support stiffness. BAT-NO combines recurrent mesh processing with latent-grid Fourier operator processing. Boundary-condition information is transferred to the latent grid through a hybrid local--global mechanism. Slice-based attention models interactions among physically related regions, while direct boundary-to-grid projection preserves local spatial structure. Across the validation sets for the shape-only, shape-and-loading, and shape-loading-boundary cases, BAT-NO achieves the lowest mean final-step mean nodal Euclidean displacement error among the evaluated baselines. In the most challenging case, it reduces the mean error by 32.6% relative to the second-best model. Hyperparameter tuning reduces the validation error from 0.451 to 0.269 mm, with a comparable error of 0.267 mm on 300 unseen test simulations sampled within the investigated design space. An attention-based scalar decoder jointly predicts six response trajectories with a mean relative error of 2.46%. Most derived crashworthiness indicators have median errors below 3%. These results show that explicit local and global boundary-condition representations improve crashworthiness prediction over expanded component-level design spaces.

</details>


### [319] [Reinforcement Learning on the Discrete Composition Channel of a Crystal Generator: Validated Gains and Reward Hacking](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03880)
*Pawan Prakash,Philipp Höllmer,Addis Fuhr,Peter Hirschfeld,P. Ganesh,Stefano Martiniani,Richard Hennig*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出OMatGRPO，首次将GRPO直接应用于晶体生成器的离散流匹配组合通道，通过精确的逐事件似然将原子类型选择作为策略的原生离散动作，使LeMat-GenBench基准测试中mSUN（亚稳态、唯一且新颖结构）产率从13.4%提升至45.5%。同时记录了五种奖励黑客（reward hacking）模式，发现并修复了单元素重打包漏洞，呼吁社区基准应按参考相数分层报告结果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有晶体生成模型仅通过训练目标隐式学习稳定性分布，无法直接针对特定设计目标进行优化。此前对扩散/流模型的强化学习方法未将原子类型转换作为独立的离散策略动作，而是冻结、连续化或从潜空间解码，导致对决定化学组成的组合决策缺乏直接控制。此外，社区广泛使用的mSUN指标存在被单元素重打包结构欺骗的缺陷。

Method: 方法包含三个核心部分：(1) GRPO作用于组合通道——推导了掩码离散流匹配下组合通道的精确似然比，使每个原子的元素分配成为策略动作，无需近似；(2) 多层奖励栈（公式5）——结合FIRE弛豫后的UMA势能、凸包距离稳定性项、新颖性/唯一性创造项、组合去重折扣和MMD多样性奖励；(3) 显式防护措施——包括稀疏参考相（<12）的弃权路由、单元素结构惩罚地板以及深度低于-0.1 eV/atom的不可信稳定性值地板。训练在MP-20预训练的OMatG模型上进行，使用4组×16个回滚、64步时间网格、AdamW优化器、750次回滚迭代。

Result: mSUN从预训练模型的13.4%（336/2500）提升至45.5%（1138/2500），为3.4倍增益。最佳对照组（best-of-N和冻结组合控制）分别仅达7.7%和9.8%。DFT抽查确认67个可信层亚稳态声明中63个成立（MAE=0.016 eV/atom）。奖励可迁移：植入Chemeleon2管道使其mSUN从36.6%升至43.7%。同时揭示五种奖励黑客模式：(1)位移优化→近静止结构；(2)生成能→坍缩至深束缚氟化物；(3)无界凸包距离→追逐虚假深能；(4)稀疏参考二元O/F化合物漂移；(5)单元素重打包占据mSUN集的53.5%。论文按参考相数分层报告所有结果，论证稀疏层mSUN应视为候选而非发现。

Conclusion: 本文首次实现了对晶体生成器组合通道的直接强化学习，证明通过精确似然比更新离散原子类型作为策略动作是可行的。奖励设计需多层防护，单元素重打包漏洞在所有mSUN社区实现中均存在，揭示了基准指标的缺陷。主张所有稳定性声明应按参考凸包的相数分层报告，稀疏层mSUN应解读为候选而非确定发现。建议未来基准应自动报告参考相数，并对稀疏候选补算缺失竞争相的DFT。代码与模型已开源。

Abstract: Inverse materials design is a long-standing goal of computational materials discovery. Generative models for crystalline materials are typically trained to match the distribution of a structure database, while nothing in their training objective points them at specific design goals such as targeted properties. We use group-relative policy optimization (GRPO) to align a generative model based on stochastic interpolants and discrete flow matching with general black-box reward functions through reinforcement learning. Atom types are generated by a discrete flow and the policy gradient of our generalization of GRPO directly acts on the likelihoods of the atom-type transitions, which differentiates our work from previous reinforcement-learning approaches for diffusion and flow-based generative models of crystalline materials. We introduce a reward function that raises the yield of metastable, unique and novel structures (mSUN) from 13.4% for the pretrained model to 45.5% for the reinforced model, as evaluated by a community benchmark. Our reward also improves the performance of a reinforcement learning framework for crystalline materials based on latent denoising diffusion models. At the same time, we find that directly reinforcing atom-type transition likelihoods enables reward exploitation that has to be prevented with explicit guards. The same analysis also exposes a gap in the community metric. Single-element structures in distinct packings are counted as metastable, unique and novel materials and inflate mSUN without yielding any new compounds. A stability claim is only as good as its reference hull. We report every result split by the number of reference phases behind it and argue that benchmarks should do the same.

</details>


### [320] [AdaEva: Accelerating LLM-Driven Algorithm Design with Adaptive Partial Evaluation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03896)
*Tai Nguyen,Fei Liu,Phong Le,Carola Doerr,Nguyen Dang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: AdaEva是一个即插即用的自适应部分评估框架，通过逐次减半（AdaEva-S）和统计竞赛（AdaEva-R）两种机制，在LLM驱动的算法设计中逐步增加候选算法的评估实例数并提前淘汰弱者，在不修改底层LLM4AD流程的前提下显著提升了搜索效率和泛化性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM驱动的算法设计（LLM4AD）中，候选算法的评估通常需要在大量训练实例上执行，计算开销巨大且成为瓶颈。标准的全实例评估对所有候选一视同仁，忽略了不同候选之间竞争力的差异，导致评估预算被低效利用。

Method: 将候选评估建模为实例级的自适应资源分配问题，提出AdaEva框架，仅替换LLM4AD流程中的评估阶段。两种实例化：(1) AdaEva-S基于逐次减半，逐步增大评估深度并按固定比例淘汰；(2) AdaEva-R基于迭代竞赛，使用Friedman检验加Conover事后检验依据统计证据淘汰劣质候选。该框架不改生成、选择或提示机制，且无需先验的实例难度知识。

Result: 在三种代表性LLM4AD框架（EoH、HiFo-Prompt、LLaMEA）、多个LLM骨干（Devstral、Qwen2.5-Coder、Gemini-3.1-Flash-Lite）、组合优化（OBP、TSP、FSSP）和连续黑盒优化（BBOB）领域的实验中，在匹配评估预算下AdaEva在14种框架-基准-LLM组合中均取得最佳或近最佳的保留集排名，评估的候选数量达到全实例评估的2.5至10.1倍，且在不同基准上自适应选择不同的评估深度，展现了良好的鲁棒性和泛化能力。

Conclusion: AdaEva通过自适应部分评估，有效平衡了LLM4AD中搜索广度与评估深度的权衡，无需先验调参即可在多种设置下获得一致的搜索效率和更好的保留集泛化性能，但AdaEva-S与AdaEva-R之间的相对优劣因设置而异，且在BBOB等异质性更高的基准上对参数更敏感，未来工作包括自适应选择分配策略及联合优化评估与其他LLM4AD组件。

Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly used for automated algorithm design. However the computational cost of evaluating the generated algorithms can be excessive. We consider the common LLM-driven automated algorithm design (LLM4AD) setting in which a candidate algorithm is evaluated by aggregating its performance over a shared set of training instances. This instance-wise structure raises a natural question: must every candidate be evaluated on the entire instance set before deciding whether it remains competitive? Taking inspiration from algorithm configuration, we introduce AdaEva, a drop-in adaptive partial-evaluation framework that progressively evaluates candidates on larger subsets of the same instance pool and eliminates unpromising candidates as evidence accumulates. Importantly, AdaEva leaves the underlying LLM4AD procedure and per-instance evaluator unchanged and requires no prior knowledge about instance difficulty. We instantiate this idea using successive halving (AdaEva-S) and statistical racing (AdaEva-R), and evaluate both mechanisms across three representative LLM4AD frameworks, multiple LLM backbones, and optimization domains spanning combinatorial and continuous black-box optimization. Under matched evaluation budgets, AdaEva more reliably balances evaluation effort across candidates than fixed partial-evaluation strategies, yielding strong search efficiency and anytime performance together with improved held-out generalization across the evaluated settings.

</details>


### [321] [COVER: Learning to Accept More in Selective Sleep Staging](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03911)
*Yukai Song,Yangfan Deng,Jijun Yin,Zhi-Hong Mao,Jingtong Hu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出COVER框架，通过辅助信息驱动的误差学习与固定尺度覆盖度优化，在睡眠分期级联模型的第一阶段选择性预测任务中，在固定5%接受风险约束下显著提升了主分类器可保留预测的覆盖度（50.4%），优于MSP、SELE、DuoF等基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统睡眠分期方法对所有EEG epoch应用相同模型，造成计算浪费；级联模型可让初级分类器接受可靠预测并将困难样本推迟给更强模型。研究第一阶段选择性预测问题：在固定风险预算下最大化主分类器预测的接受覆盖度。面临两大挑战：(1)接受信号——MSP置信度因校准问题排序能力有限；(2)训练目标——BCE对所有epoch平等加权，而任务效用仅取决于被接受的epoch。

Method: COVER两步法：(i)辅助信息驱动的初级误差学习——构建37维风险向量（14维主模型输出+14维辅助RF输出+9维分歧特征），用主体加权BCE训练逻辑回归评分器替代MSP，主标签不变；(ii)固定尺度覆盖度优化（FixedScale）——以软门控近似硬决策，将BCE初始化锚定到单位标准差尺度，用SLSQP求解平滑约束优化问题，直接最大化接受风险约束下的覆盖度。三阶段数据划分（FIT/CERT/OUTER），实证规则锁定，无有限样本保证。

Result: 在Sleep-EDF-20数据集（20受试者，5%风险目标）上：辅助信息误差学习使覆盖度从MSP的31.5%提升至48.8%；相同接受量下错误数从1467降至867；FixedScale进一步覆盖度提升1.65pp，达50.4%（4.53%风险），优于DuoF（43.6%）、SELE（49.3%）、BCEAnchor等8种评分器。接受集集中在Wake/N2/N3（>97%准确率），N1和REM贡献大部分错误。嵌套开发证实FixedScale-1较BCE初始化有1.65pp覆盖度提升（95% CI [+0.47, +2.52]）。

Conclusion: COVER首次将辅助信息初级误差学习与固定尺度覆盖度优化结合用于选择性睡眠分期，在固定主分类器下实现更高的接受覆盖度，为级联睡眠分期的可靠性感知计算分配提供了基础。局限包括：单中心20人队列、单一架构、FixedScale在预设分析后指定、嵌套开发复用冻结组件输出、CERT仅支持实证规则选择无逐主体风险保证。未来需冻结完整评分选择流程并在未接触受试者上验证，结合下游模型评估端到端计算节省。

Abstract: Traditional sleep-staging methods apply the same model to every EEG epoch. Such uniform deployment expends computation on epochs that a smaller model could handle reliably, motivating cascades in which a primary classifier accepts its reliable predictions and defers the remainder to a more capable model. In this paper, we study the first stage of such a cascade: maximizing the coverage of fixed primary predictions subject to a prescribed accepted-risk target. We propose COVER (COVerage-oriented Error Ranking), which integrates two key innovations: (i) auxiliary-informed primary-error learning, which replaces maximum softmax probability (MSP) with a learned error score while preserving the primary labels, and (ii) fixed-scale scorer refinement, which builds on this score to directly maximize coverage under an empirical accepted-risk constraint rather than error-prediction accuracy over all epochs. We evaluate COVER on Sleep-EDF-20 at a 5% accepted-risk target, with subjects held out from all fitting and selection. Auxiliary-informed error learning raises mean subject coverage from 31.5% for MSP to 48.8% at similar subject-equal risk. At equal acceptance volume, with MSP accepting the same number of epochs as the learned scorer in each subject (20,639 in total), errors fall from 1,467 to 867. Fixed-scale refinement then adds 1.7 percentage points of coverage over its initialization in nested development, and COVER attains the highest mean coverage among eight evaluated scorers, 50.4% at 4.5% subject-equal risk, above the selective-ranking baseline SELE (49.3%) and the probability-fusion comparator DuoF (43.6%). To the best of our knowledge, this is the first work to combine auxiliary-informed primary-error learning with fixed-scale coverage refinement for selective sleep staging, offering a basis for reliability-aware allocation of computation in cascaded sleep staging.

</details>


### [322] [TreeWalker: Partial Evaluation for Grouped Tree-Ensemble Inference](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03939)
*Durmus Karatay,Richard Newman*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: TreeWalker将在线部分求值技术应用于树集成模型（如GBDT）的分组推理，通过识别组内共享的常量特征和变化特征，将每棵树的遍历次数从G次减少到1次，并使用行位掩码在变化分裂处分区，从而显著加速分组预测任务。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 许多实际推理任务（如离散时间生存模型、会话级CTR预测、场景分析）需要对共享大部分特征值的行组进行评估，但现有方法将每行独立处理，重复执行共享的常量特征前缀计算，造成冗余。论文旨在利用这种输入侧相关性来加速推理。

Method: 采用递归部分求值方法，将常量特征视为静态输入、变化特征视为动态输入，通过行位掩码（u32/u64/u128）跟踪活跃行，在常量分裂处O(1)前进，在变化分裂处分区掩码并跳过空子树。实现包含四项优化：未分割快捷方式、重路径DFS、单调早期终止和谓词预计算。提出了结构化工作分解定理，将每棵树的工作分解为常量投影子树大小|G|、G次叶节点写入和谓词掩码配置成本Q。

Result: 在Intel平台上，TreeWalker在参考配置（T=500, L=8）下比行独立遍历快2.5-3.2倍，在生存数据集上G=128时达6.8-7.8倍加速；在场景分析基准的所有16种配置上均更快。Arm平台上加速比Intel高约1.4倍。跟踪求值器的渐近加速比为1/(1-ρ̄_G)=(d+1)/(d_v+1)，实验验证在G=128时跟踪比率在5%以内符合预测。f64输出与treelite GTIL一致；f32模型使用f64累加比原生f32更接近Kahan补偿参考。

Conclusion: TreeWalker通过部分求值有效利用分组输入中的特征共享，在多种分组推理任务上实现显著加速，且可与现有的每访问和每遍历优化方法正交组合。未来的工作包括随机森林测量、层次化子分组、内部核组合以及跨请求的谓词共享。

Abstract: Many inference workloads evaluate a trained tree ensemble on row groups that share feature values: discrete-time survival models expand each patient into $G$ time steps, click-through-rate models score every item in a search session, and scenario analyses vary a few inputs while holding the rest fixed. Standard inference treats each row independently and repeats the shared work $G$ times. We present TreeWalker, which applies partial evaluation to grouped inference: constant features are static, varying features dynamic. It walks each tree once per group, partitions a row bitmask at varying splits, and skips empty subtrees. Training is unchanged: TreeWalker reads standard LightGBM and XGBoost models. We prove a structural work decomposition: per-tree work splits into the constant-projected subtree size $|T_c|$, $G$ leaf writes, and a predicate-mask provisioning cost $Q$. For the trace evaluator, per-row work approaches a $(d_v+1)/(d+1)$ fraction of a row-independent walk as $G \to \infty$. On Intel, TreeWalker is 2.5-3.2$\times$ faster than a row-independent traversal at the reference configuration ($T=500$, $L=8$) and 6.8-7.8$\times$ faster at $G=128$ on the survival datasets, with larger gains on Arm. On a scenario-analysis benchmark it is faster in all 16 configurations on both architectures. For f64 models, outputs match treelite's GTIL up to summation order; for f32 models, f64 accumulation is closer to a Kahan-compensated reference than native f32 on 99.98% of rows and never farther.

</details>


### [323] [DePICT: Decision-Preserving Interface for Constrained Downstream Tasks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03945)
*Utkarsh Grover,Ravi Ranjan,Agoritsa Polyzou,Wyatt T. Mackey,J. Morris Chang,Leonardo Bobadilla,Xiaomin Lin*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: DePICT提出了一种基于KKT灵敏度的"决策保留接口"构造方法，通过求解线性化主动约束KKT系统计算原始上下文方向对约束最优解的局部灵敏度，识别并移除那些虽在符号上参与优化问题但实际上不影响最优决策的方向（称为"不可约"方向）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的特征选择方法基于预测效用或统计相关性进行选择，但一个特征可能在优化问题中符号性出现却对最终决策毫无影响。该研究旨在回答一个更基本的问题：哪些原始上下文方向真正能够改变下游约束优化问题的最优解？这对于降低传感、通信和处理成本具有重要意义。

Method: DePICT方法包含四个核心步骤：(1) 对每个代表性上下文，求解下游约束优化问题并恢复原始-对偶解及主动约束集；(2) 通过求解线性化主动约束KKT系统（维度为n_θ+|A|的鞍点矩阵）计算解灵敏度Jacobian J(c) = ∂θ*(c)/∂c；(3) 使用几何分解 J(c) = P⊥G_A - ΦC_A 计算Jacobian的列范数作为每个上下文坐标的得分；(4) 通过聚合代表性上下文间的得分（均值）构造最终的Top-m决策保留接口。理论层面，作者基于LICQ、SOSC和严格互补性等正则性假设，推导出原始坐标j不可约的充要条件：(C_A)_{·j}=0 且 (G_A)_{·j} ∈ range(A_A^T)，即该方向不移动主动边界且其稳定性扰动落在约束法向量空间内（可被乘子吸收）。

Result: 在控制性背包和最短路径基准测试中，DePICT精确恢复了Oracle接口（F1=1.000），并将线性预测器的遗憾从最强基线的0.475降至0.009。在Layer-2湮灭诊断中，DePICT对Layer-2干扰变量实现了零假包含率（相比之下互信息的FPR为0.700，FD排序和PFMM为0.500）。在Warcraft和FF25等边缘场景基准测试中也表现出良好的迁移能力。在运行时方面，当优化器维度固定时，DePICT对上下文维度的依赖性较弱（n_1从200增至2000时，运行时间仅约5.2-5.4秒，而LASSO从1.79秒增至29.17秒）。在稳定性方面，对于m=60的接口预算，即使扰动幅度ε=5×10^-2，Jaccard重叠仍保持在0.979以上。

Conclusion: DePICT将接口选择从经验性的预处理选择转化为下游优化问题的结构性质。研究表明，符号性参与（如出现在目标函数或约束中）并不等同于优化器相关性，存在两层"间隙"：Layer-1间隙（符号出现但不进入主动KKT灵敏度系统）和Layer-2间隙（进入主动KKT系统但被乘子调整吸收）。关键理论保证是：如果一个不可约方向被接口丢弃，则任何通过该接口的可微下游决策映射都无法匹配Oracle决策映射在该方向上的一阶响应，这构成了不可修复的结构性一阶偏差。局限性方面，理论保证依赖于稳定的主动约束集和KKT正则性条件，非光滑、离散和主动约束变化的情形留待未来工作。

Abstract: A constrained optimization problem may involve a parameter in its objective and active constraints, yet the final decision may remain insensitive to small changes in that parameter. This raises a fundamental question: which inputs does a decision making system truly depend on? Building on this question, we introduce DePICT, a procedure for constructing decision preserving interfaces by ranking context directions according to the optimizer's solution sensitivity and aggregating them across an operating regime. We study this problem in a high dimensional setting where primitive context parameterizes a constrained task and the downstream agent observes only a selected subset of context directions. For locally regular constrained programs, we derive a Karush Kuhn Tucker (KKT) based characterization of when a context direction is optimizer relevant. Our analysis shows that appearing in the active optimization problem does not necessarily imply that a variable affects the final decision. Some context directions can alter the KKT conditions while leaving the optimal solution unchanged because their effect is absorbed by the dual variables. DePICT is designed to remove exactly these directions. In a controlled diagnosis, it recovers the decision relevant interface exactly and reduces linear predictor regret to 0.009, compared with 0.475 for the strongest competing baseline.

</details>


### [324] [Synthesizing Physics Formulae with Transformers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03947)
*Shuwei Wang,Vadim Bulitko,Michael Youngblood,Ramon Lawrence,William Yeoh,Shinichi Nakagawa,Matthew R. G. Brown,Yu Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种用于物理公式符号回归的Transformer方法，通过对训练公式进行简化和一致性排序整形，使合成的公式在训练范围外具有更好的外推能力，同时通过噪声微调增强鲁棒性。该Transformer在约10秒内合成公式，在一分钟以内的预算下，跨任务外推性能优于所有对比方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于Transformer的符号回归方法虽快但易过拟合训练输入范围，外推能力差，限制了在实际科学发现中的使用。需要一种既能快速合成又能泛化到未见输入范围的方法。

Method: 训练一个编码器-解码器Transformer（~1.45亿参数），输入是数据点，输出是公式。核心创新在于训练数据整形——将随机生成的公式通过sum-of-products归一化简化为等价但更紧凑、排序一致的规范形式作为训练目标，去除传统方法在每个加法位置放置可拟合常数的仿射变换。推理时使用beam search、分治策略（D&C，基于二阶导数的可分性检测）和D&C回归算法。最后在含噪声数据上做进一步训练以增强鲁棒性。

Result: 在SRBench（99个Feynman公式）和LLM-SRBench LSR-Transform（111个公式）上，无噪声时以约11秒/公式的速度合成，外推性能（ρ₁₂₈ = 0.57 SRBench，0.45 LSR-Transform）优于所有预算在一分钟内对比方法，包括PySR(1m)、E2E、TPSR、PhyE2E和LLM方法。PySR (30m)和AI Feynman仅在多一到两个数量级时间预算时才超过其性能。在噪声水平ϵ=0.01下优势保持。在LSR-Synth（输入范围远离训练分布的129个公式）上表现不佳，但通过反标准化（unscaled变体）可将性能从17%提升到57%（分布内）。消融研究表明，简化贡献最大，仿射变换去除次之。

Conclusion: 通过将训练目标整形为紧凑一致的公式形式，公式Transformer能生成具有物理公式般结构的简洁模型，在快速合成的设定下显著提升外推能力，使得合成公式可作为真正的预测模型而非仅仅是数据压缩器。未来的工作包括支持更多变量、训练输入范围随机化跨越多个数量级。

Abstract: Finding a compact formula that fits a set of input-output pairs and predicts outputs on unseen inputs is a fundamental problem in science. Symbolic regression automates the search for such formulae: search-based methods explore the space of possible formulae directly, while transformers pre-trained on synthetic data produce formulae of comparable quality substantially faster. Existing transformers, however, are prone to overfitting --- they find formulae that fit the training data well but do not extrapolate to input ranges unseen during training. We address this by shaping the set of formulae used to train a transformer, and show that the resulting formulae extrapolate substantially better. Fine-tuning the transformer on data with noise-corrupted target values further makes the synthesized formulae robust to noise in the observations. On SRBench and LLM-SRBench our transformer synthesizes a formula in about ten seconds and extrapolates better than all evaluated methods at a comparable budget. Search-based methods surpass our accuracy only when given one to three orders of magnitude more time.

</details>


### [325] [Evolving LLM-Generated Features for Interpretable Classification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03951)
*Jack Butler,Zainab Afolabi,Nikita Kozodoi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一种进化式框架，利用LLM迭代发现自然语言二元特征（rubrics），结合透明线性分类器（逻辑回归）实现可审计、可解释的分类。该方法在三个数据集上优于单次生成的rubrics（平均+2.9 pp），并在信用风信贷风险任务上暴露出仅50.7%的零样本LLM分类器存在严重的单类偏差问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM作为分类器时决策过程不透明，难以应用于信贷、医疗等受监管领域。现有LLM生成可解释特征的方法（如Singh et al., 2023; Balek et al., 2024）仅生成静态特征集，无法根据训练误差自适应调整。

Method: 三部分组成：（1）特征生成LLM提出二元自然语言特征；（2）评估LLM对文本逐样本提取二元特征值；（3）逻辑回归分类器。进化过程迭代T轮，反馈信号包括分类误差、逐类激活率、特征消融分数（ablation scores）。保留top-k重要特征、替换低效特征、拒绝已尝试的rubric。

Result: 三个数据集结果：AG News（进化特征81.3% vs 零样本LLM 89.7%）、GoEmotions（41.0% vs 38.7%）、HELOC（69.0% vs 50.7%）。HELOC上零样本LLM呈现77-85% at_risk单类偏差，接近随机水平。进化特征在GoEmotions和HELOC上同时优于零样本LLM并提供完全可解释的决策逻辑。多数增益在前5次接受的rubric中实现，建议T=5-10。训练需约5000次LLM调用，但推理仅需1次（与零样本LLM相同）。

Conclusion: 进化式特征发现在标签边界不直观或LLM缺乏领域推理能力时最有效。核心贡献：（1）提出进化式FR框架并展示+2.9 pp平均提升；（2）揭示聚合准确率可隐藏系统性单类偏差，AUC（如HELOC 50.7%）需逐类审计才能发现。局限性：二元特征构成信息瓶颈，仅使用Claude Haiku 4.5单模型。
