Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used as classifiers, yet they operate as opaque systems whose decisions are difficult to interpret, which complicates their use in regulated domains such as credit scoring or medical diagnosis. We propose an evolutionary framework that iteratively discovers natural language feature definitions (rubrics) for interpretable classification. An LLM generates candidate binary features, evaluates each sample against them, and the resulting vectors can be used to train a transparent classifier such as logistic regression. The feature set evolves over multiple iterations guided by classification errors, per-class activation rates, and feature ablation scores. We evaluate across three benchmarks, including a credit risk dataset representative of regulated domains, comparing single-shot LLM rubrics, evolved rubrics, and direct zero-shot LLM classification. Evolved features improve over single-shot rubrics by +2.9 pp on average and outperform zero-shot LLM classification on two of three tasks, while providing fully auditable decision logic. On the credit risk task, the zero-shot LLM performs at chance (50.7%) with a strong bias toward a single class, whereas evolved features achieve balanced, interpretable predictions. Crucially, this failure is invisible in aggregate accuracy and surfaces only under per-class auditing. Analysis reveals that evolution is most effective when label boundaries cannot be inferred from category names alone or when the LLM lacks reliable domain-specific reasoning.

</details>


### [326] [One-Step Curvature Probes Miss the Fitting Operator: Retained Capacity and Terminal Null-Space Correction for Continual Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03952)
*Abu Sa-Adat Mohamed Moon-Im Al Ahsan,Ibne Farabi Shihab,Md Najmus Swaqeeb*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出了一个将曲率视为机器遗忘中"解码器状态"的精确缓存-更新前沿理论框架，核心是将部署前的状态M与请求后的传输B分离开来，并通过率失真分析和凸几何推导得到了强凸优化下遗忘接口的精确信息论刻画。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 机器遗忘领域缺乏对"部署后什么状态存活、删除请求揭示什么"的精确操作化区分；现有的影响函数、Newton遗忘等方法隐含了曲率信息的价值，但缺乏严格的接口声明和信息论量化。该论文旨在从信息论角度精确回答：给定声明的任务相关状态和请求内容，遗忘目标的信息量下界是多少？

Method: 采用序列化的状态-传输接口（M为预请求状态，B为请求后传输），使用率失真函数和单次覆盖数推导强凸目标下的极小极大目标球几何；通过Ridge回归的Woodbury下更新代数给出精确实现；用条件覆盖数和高斯设计的中心极限定理补充典型数据标度律；实验涵盖Ridge接口验证、部分曲率系数、自然数据不区分性测试、高斯设计审计和非凸状态审计。

Result: 主要结果包括：定理3.1证明了参数加删除梯度在强凸目标下产生d维相容目标球；推论3.2显示s维精确曲率块精确消除s维高率描述长度；定理3.3揭示请求盲目状态下状态维度p_r=rd-r(r-1)/2大于单请求维度d。实验验证了(d-s)系数（最大相对偏差0.8%）、高斯设计的√k请求增长、m^{-3/2}曲率波动标度律；自然数据集上6.8%-19.6%的传输减少需1.6×-129×的状态开销；非凸审计在MLP和ResNet-18上验证了状态-传输分离的操作性。

Conclusion: 该论文将曲率明确定价为解码器状态而非免费压缩，在强凸设定下精确刻画了遗忘接口的信息论前沿；曲率存储显著增加状态成本（1.6×至129×），仅当未来请求序列足够长时（交叉点25至2181次请求）才在累积开销上优于纯参数存储；不同接口（值暴露vs标识符唯一）和请求时序（已知vs未知未来请求）导致本质不同的状态-传输权衡，且这些结论是接口相关的而非通用算法排名。

Abstract: A one-step curvature probe evaluates an initial direction, whereas continual learners are judged after reaching comparable new-task fit. In an overparameterized linearization, projected gradient descent converges to $\Delta_P=PJ^\top(JPJ^\top)^{-1}r$, and its squared-displacement inflation is exactly the reciprocal of the retained fitting capacity $c_P(r)$. More generally, the terminal old-task quadratic ratio factorizes as $1/[c_P(r)G_{\rm end}(P,r)]$, where $G_{\rm end}$ compares curvature along endpoint directions. In the rank-one case, $G_{\rm end}$ equals the one-step probe gain; for multiple outputs, the two gains can differ. The terminal quadratic also separates into a curvature-optimal fitting floor and an algorithm-dependent null-space excess, motivating terminal null-space correction, which preserves linearized new-task outputs on its Jacobian batch. Controlled checks validate the local quadratic and show that projection can greatly reduce matched-norm curvature while barely changing terminal forgetting. Across common-threshold configurations, projection yields the larger signed old-task loss change in 73/99 matched pairs, retained fitting capacity falls with rank, and fixed-rank comparisons separate terminal forgetting even when probe gain is approximately matched. On Permuted MNIST and Split CIFAR-100, terminal correction decreases signed old-task loss in 166/180 method--dataset--seed pairs under the all-seed intention-to-correct analysis; because acceptance and outcome reporting use the same held-out split, this result is descriptive and test-conditioned. Overall, terminal cost depends jointly on retained fitting capacity, endpoint-direction curvature, and the null-space component selected by optimization.

</details>


### [327] [Probabilistic Algorithms for Ising Machines from Optimization to Generative AI](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03972)
*Corentin Delacour,Xiuqi Zhang,Abdelrahman S. Abdelrahman,Saleh Bunaiyan,Kyle Lee,Shuvro Chowdhury,Kerem Y. Camsari*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 这是一篇关于概率算法与Ising机（Ising machine）协同设计的综述论文，重点讨论如何将具有理论保证的MCMC算法（如模拟退火、并行回火、聚类平均场、变分采样等）映射到专用概率硬件上，并探索Ising机与生成式AI之间的双向促进关系。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Ising机作为求解难解组合优化和采样问题的硬件加速器已显示出巨大潜力，但其实际应用受限于算法与硬件的协同设计。现有许多物理驱动的Ising实现缺乏详细平衡和收敛保证，限制了其应用范围。文章倡导自顶向下的算法优先视角，将具有可证明保证的原理性方法移植到多样化硬件平台上，并探讨硬件能力如何反哺算法创新（类似于量子计算中算法与硬件协同演化的轨迹）。

Method: 论文采用综述形式，按算法复杂度的递进组织内容：(1)基础模拟退火（SA）及其硬件实现（p-bit、CIM、OIM、模拟分岔、SQA）；(2)并行回火（PT）包括二维扩展（2D-PT）以原生编码硬约束；(3)聚类平均场理论（CMFT）通过混合CPU-加速器架构突破单芯片容量限制；(4)变分方法（PAOA作为QAOA的经典类比、神经量子态NQS、正概率与符号问题）；(5)与生成式AI的协同（Transformer增强PT的TAPT、SANTA随机注意力机制）。方法上强调概率比特（p-bit）作为桥梁，通过MCMC满足详细平衡来保证采样正确性。

Result: 论文系统梳理了概率算法在Ising硬件上的实现现状与前沿进展，主要结果包括：(1)2D-PT通过并行化能量和可行性景观，可对Wishart实例图稀疏化获得数量级加速，对64节点SK自旋玻璃实现250倍加速，对128节点MIMO实现10倍以上解码加速；(2)CMFT在L=22（10648自旋）超大规模问题上超越单FPGA容量限制并实现更陡的残差能量衰减；(3)PAOA作为变分框架可恢复SA作为特例，并扩展到非平衡轨迹；(4)TAPT（Transformer增强PT）在3D自旋玻璃和整数分解等NP难实例上加速基态搜索，且单一IsingFormer模型可在半素数分解实例族中迁移；(5)SANTA随机注意力在32k token上下文LLM解码中实现最高1.5倍注意力核加速，解决KV-cache带宽瓶颈；(6)符号问题界定了概率Ising机的能力边界——正概率采样无法重现涉及振幅干涉的量子优势。

Conclusion: 论文得出结论：(1)算法与硬件的双向流动是概率计算领域未来发展的核心机遇；(2)自顶向下、算法优先的思维方式能产生更丰富的工具集（如2D-PT原生编码约束、CMFT将芯片容量限制转化为特征）；(3)硬件驱动的算法创新（如PAOA、随机注意力）代表了重要趋势，随着Ising机规模和速度提升，将开启当前在传统硬件上不实用的新算法可能性；(4)该领域正处在与早期量子计算类似的拐点，需要持续投资于具有可证明保证的算法作为硬件优化的基础。

Abstract: Ising machines have emerged as promising hardware accelerators for intractable optimization and sampling problems, yet their practical impact increasingly hinges on the co-design of algorithms and hardware, where algorithmic demands shape new architectures and new hardware capabilities inspire entirely new algorithms. In this Review, we survey probabilistic algorithms designed for portability across diverse Ising platforms, advocating a top-down perspective that prioritizes principled methods with provable guarantees. We cover foundational methods such as simulated annealing and parallel tempering, including two-dimensional extensions that natively encode hard constraints, and examine approaches that expand the scale of solvable problems from cluster mean-field methods to variational samplers. We highlight the Probabilistic Approximate Optimization Algorithm (PAOA), a classical analog of QAOA that emerged directly from probabilistic hardware development, and explore how generative AI and Ising machines might reinforce each other: learned models propose global moves to accelerate optimization, while probabilistic techniques improve inference in large language models. Much as quantum computing has seen algorithms co-evolve with hardware, probabilistic and Ising computing stand at a similar inflection point. We outline a co-design framework for accelerating the capabilities and adoption of next-generation Ising machines.

</details>


### [328] [Learning Latent Protein Languages for Autoregressive Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03978)
*Mahdi Pourmirzaei,Farzaneh Esmaili,Amir Ziashahabi,Mohammadreza Pourmirzaei,Dong Xu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出两种学习到的蛋白质隐式语言（PLL用于序列侧，SLL用于结构侧），通过将氨基酸符号和骨架坐标替换为富含语义的离散token，使标准自回归Transformer在蛋白质序列与结构生成任务上具备更优的扩展性和更低的低复杂度漂移。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有自回归Transformer在蛋白质序列与结构生成上明显弱于非自回归方法（如离散扩散、flow-matching），原因部分在于目标表示：氨基酸token仅编码残基身份而无上下文语义，原始三维坐标在离散框架中难以直接建模。因此作者将问题定位为表征问题，而非目标函数或架构设计问题。

Method: 1) PLL：在冻结的ESM-2 150M编码器上构建VQ-RAE风格的两阶段分词器，先做ESM-2隐层重建，再训练解码器从离散code恢复氨基酸，得到4096状态的上下文token空间。2) SLL：在GCP-VQVAE Lite架构上添加三类辅助监督——逆折叠、pLDDT置信度、ESM-2表征重建，由监督PST性能选取最优组合。3) 在PLL、SLL、原始氨基酸三种token流上分别预训练decoder-only自回归Transformer（PLLM/SLLM），保持next-token目标不变。4) 序列到结构任务中，使用E1编码序列上下文，DeepConf风格的隐式置信度做推理时候选筛选。

Result: 1) 缩放性：PLLM拟合计算-损失幂律指数α=0.038，约为氨基酸模型（α=0.020）的1.9倍；SLLM α=0.049。2) 无条件序列生成：PLLM将低于1.5bit复杂度阈值的样本比例降低54%（相对氨基酸模型），在T=0.6–1.0时最匹配UniRef50的熵和长度分布。3) SLL分词器在监督PST上功能位点AUROC提升24.2%、理化Spearman提升35.0%；用于序列到结构预测时最佳验证困惑度降低34%。4) 骨架生成：SLLM在多样性（最高聚类率0.9175）和新颖性上优于多数生成器，但自一致性scTM=0.5390落后于La-Proteina等专用模型。5) 序列到结构推理时缩放：长蛋白隐式token采样比MSA-AlphaFold2快约1000倍；DeepConf选择器在CAMEO-2024上将TM-score从0.725提升到0.754（k=256），oracle上界为0.825。6) PLL在UniRef50验证集上达到99.81%的氨基酸恢复率，SLL平均TM-score 0.9456、RMSD 1.4722 Å（接近AIDO且结构解码速度更快）。

Conclusion: 学习到的隐式蛋白质语言为自回归Transformer在蛋白质生成中的应用提供了有前景的基底：PLLM展现更陡的计算缩放趋势并显著减少低复杂度漂移，SLL改进了自回归结构目标的预测性并支持结构生成与序列到结构推理。骨架生成的自一致性仍是局限；未来工作包括PLL-SLL联合多模态预训练、多链复合体扩展以及与连续目标或ESM-2蒸馏等替代用法的对比。

Abstract: Autoregressive transformers remain comparatively weak for protein sequence and structure generation. We study the role of target representation: amino acid tokens encode residue identities without explicit contextual semantics, while backbone coordinates require a discrete representation in our framework. We introduce two learned latent protein languages. Protein Latent Language (PLL) maps sequences to a 4,096-state contextual alphabet built on a frozen ESM-2 encoder, with one token per residue. Structure Latent Language (SLL) adapts GCP-VQVAE Lite with auxiliary sequence and confidence supervision while retaining decoding to backbone coordinates. We separately pretrain autoregressive transformer models on PLL and SLL tokens using next-token prediction, yielding PLLM and SLLM. Under matched downstream sequence training, PLLM has a fitted compute-scaling exponent of 0.038 versus 0.020 for the amino acid autoregressive model. In unconditional sequence generation, PLLM reduces the fraction of samples below a heuristic 1.5-bit residue-composition entropy threshold by 54% relative to the amino acid model across sampling temperatures. For sequence-to-structure prediction, replacing the original GCP-VQVAE Lite tokenizer with SLL reduces best validation perplexity by 34% under matched training. For long proteins, latent-token sampling is approximately 1,000 times faster than MSA-based AlphaFold2 in our measurements. In backbone generation, SLLM compares favorably with other generative models on diversity and novelty. We also observe early signs that using SLLM's internal token confidence for inference-time sampling can improve sequence-to-structure prediction quality beyond a single decoded sample. These results position learned latent protein languages as a promising substrate for autoregressive transformer scaling and inference-time sampling in protein generation.

</details>


### [329] [$\tilde{O}(\sqrt{T})$ Regret and Polylogarithmic Constraint Violation for COCO](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03983)
*Dhruv Sarkar,Abhishek Sinha*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究带约束的在线凸优化（COCO），提出一种连续Hedge结合消除的算法，在保持接近最优的 $\tilde{O}(\sqrt{T})$ 遗憾的同时，将累积约束违反（CCV）从之前的 $\tilde{O}(\sqrt{T})$ 改进到 $O(\log^2 T)$ 的多对数量级。关键技术是利用对数凹分布的Grünbaum不等式保证违反约束时消除常数比例的Hedge概率质量，并通过自适应学习率与耦合存活体积的势函数将其转化为CCV界。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在存在对抗性时变约束的在线决策场景中（如AI安全、资源分配、公平性等问题），学习者必须兼顾性能（最小遗憾）和可行性（累积约束违反最小化）。现有算法在COCO（带对抗性凸约束的在线凸优化）设定下能达到 $O(\sqrt{T})$ 遗憾和 $\tilde{O}(\sqrt{T})$ CCV，但CCV的多项式增长在高维、长时间场景中不可接受。核心问题是能否在保持接近最优遗憾的同时，将CCV降至多对数级别，突破此trade-off。

Method: 提出"连续Hedge与消除"算法（Algorithm 1）：维护连续决策集上基于指数权重的对数凹概率密度（连续Hedge），在每轮玩密度均值；观察到约束违反时利用Grünbaum不等式——违反约束的均值必有常数比例（≥$1/e$）的Hedge概率质量落在被消除的区域；引入"存活集合"（Kontrunen）与δ-松弛约束保证存在非零体积的比较集合；设计自适应学习率方案（违反时按因子 $(1+0.1/(d\log T))^{-1}$ 减小）与耦合存活体积与学习率的对数势函数 $\Psi_t = \log(\mu(K_{t-1})/e^{-H}) + H\log(1+GDT\eta_t)$；势函数每轮违反下降常数，最终将违反轮数限制在 $O(\log^2 T)$。遗憾分析通过调节势函数关系式将 $\log q_t$ 项与学习率变化耦合。

Result: 主要定理（Theorem 1）：算法1达到 $\text{Regret}_T = O(GD\sqrt{dT\log T})$ 和 $\text{CCV}_T = O(GDd\log^2 T)$，无需强凸性、Slater条件或光滑性等额外假设。遗憾界最优至 $\sqrt{\log T}$ 因子，CCV界最优至 $(\log T)^{1+2/(d+1)}$ 因子（与Sarkar and Sinha (2026) 的 $\Omega((\log T)^{(d-1)/(d+1)}/\ln\ln T)$ 下界匹配）。显著改进了Table 1中所列所有相关算法的多项式CCV界。

Conclusion: 成功打破COCO问题中"遗憾与CCV"的trade-off，无需线性松弛约束即可达到 $O(\sqrt{T\log T})$ 遗憾和 $O(\log^2 T)$ CCV。核心贡献：(1) 连续消除原理——违反均值通过几何论证（Grünbaum不等式）消除常数比例Hedge概率质量；(2) 自适应学习率与耦合势函数——将概率质量的减少统一转化为进展数与风险界；(3) 替代基于投影的方法，采用内点策略（均值），对数凹测度的对称性是改进算法的核心。算法本质依赖决策集上的精确积分；未来方向是基于对数凹采样（Lovász and Vempala, 2004）的有效实现。

Abstract: We study constrained online convex optimization with adversarial convex losses and constraints ($\mathsf{COCO}$). At each round \(t\in[T]\), a learner selects \(x_t\) from a \(d\)-dimensional convex decision set \(\mathcal X\), after which an adaptive adversary reveals a convex cost function \(f_t\) and constraint function \(g_t\). Consequently, the learner incurs cost \(f_t(x_t)\) and constraint violation \(\max\{0,g_t(x_t)\}\), and aims to simultaneously minimize regret and cumulative constraint violation ($\mathsf{CCV}$) over the entire horizon. Existing algorithms achieve \(O(\sqrt{T})\) regret and \(\widetilde O(\sqrt{T})\) $\mathsf{CCV}$. We show that an online policy can achieve \(O(\sqrt{T\log T})\) regret and \(O(\log^2 T)\) $\mathsf{CCV}$, reducing the $\mathsf{CCV}$ from polynomial to polylogarithmic while retaining near-optimal regret. Our approach combines continuous Hedge with elimination on shrinking feasible sets. The key observation is that whenever the mean of the Hedge distribution violates a constraint, Grünbaum's inequality guarantees that a constant fraction of the Hedge probability mass is eliminated. We use an adaptive learning-rate schedule and a potential function coupling the surviving volume with the learning rate to convert this probability-mass reduction into a bound of \(O(\log^2 T)\) on the $\mathsf{CCV}$.

</details>


### [330] [LD-EnFF: Latent-Dynamics Ensemble Flow Filtering for Data Assimilation with Sparse Observations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.04034)
*Ziyu Tian,Kaichen Shen,Wenbo Hao,Phillip Si,Peng Chen,Wei Zhu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: LD-EnFF是一种用于高维非线性、稀疏观测数据同化的序列贝叶斯滤波框架，通过在紧凑潜空间中联合执行预报传播和滤波更新，并结合基于流的滤波与学习的观测模型，在多个基准测试中显著优于现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 高维非线性动力学中重复前向模拟计算成本高，而稀疏观测仅提供有限的全局状态信息，使得现有数据同化方法在高维系统中面临精度与效率的双重挑战。

Method: 1) 使用参数化条件的LDNet（潜态动力学网络）在增广潜态空间中进行集合预报传播；2) 通过变分自编码器（VAE）观测编码器与前向 y⋆ 算子构建潜态空间的状态依赖局部高斯似然，融合物理观测误差与编码器不确定性；3) 在增广潜态空间中应用基于流匹配的集合流滤波器（EnFF-OT / EnFF-F2P）进行序列分析，联合更新潜态状态与不确定参数（如雷诺数、强迫参数）。

Result: 在Kolmogorov流（150×150网格，0.44%观测）、海啸建模（150×150网格，0.44%观测）和大气建模PlanetSWE（512×256×3≈393,216维，0.1%观测）三个基准上，LD-EnFF-OT均取得最低的最终全态RelRMSE（分别为约5.74%、6.53%、4.42%），优于LD-IEnKF、LDNet+LSTM EnSF、匹配基线及全空间EnFF方法，并在早期阶段实现更快的误差下降。

Conclusion: LD-EnFF通过将潜态动力学、显式前向潜态-观测模型与训练自由的流滤波相结合，有效避免了在线同化过程中全状态数值模拟与全场重构，并在多个复杂基准上一致优于现有数据同化算法；未来工作将研究端到端同化感知训练、替代EnFF引导近似以及更高维参数空间。

Abstract: Data assimilation combines model forecasts with noisy, incomplete observations to estimate the evolving state of a dynamical system. Existing methods face two compounding challenges: high-dimensional nonlinear dynamics make repeated forward simulation computationally expensive, while sparse observations provide limited direct information about the full state. To address these challenges, we propose the Latent-Dynamics Ensemble Flow Filter (LD-EnFF), a sequential Bayesian filtering framework that performs both forecast propagation and filtering updates in a compact latent space. LD-EnFF combines a latent dynamics surrogate for ensemble propagation with a variational autoencoder (VAE)-based observation model that evaluates a state-dependent observation likelihood in latent space. At each assimilation step, an ensemble filtering update based on flow matching uses the forecast ensemble and this likelihood to generate posterior samples, jointly updating latent states and uncertain parameters. This design avoids repeated full-state simulation during forecasting and full-field reconstruction during likelihood evaluation. LD-EnFF substantially outperforms a broad range of data assimilation algorithms on benchmarks spanning Kolmogorov flow, tsunami propagation, and atmospheric modeling, all featuring complex dynamics and sparse, noisy observations.

</details>


### [331] [Protecting Sensitive Data in Image Synthesis via PAC-Private Adaptation for Diffusion Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.04038)
*Boming Miao,Tao Zhang,Netanel Raviv,Murat Kantarcioglu,Bradley A. Malin,Yevgeniy Vorobeychik*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出了一种基于PAC-隐私的扩散模型适配框架，通过学习紧凑的数据依赖组件（LoRA或Textual Inversion）并校准各向异性高斯噪声，在单次后处理扰动下实现重建隐私（RP），在相同隐私保证下显著提升少样本概念个性化及全数据集图像合成的实用性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有合成数据生成方法面临隐私与效用权衡困境：扩散模型易受重建攻击威胁，而基于差分隐私（DP-SGD）的训练方法因梯度裁剪与噪声注入导致严重效用损失。根本原因在于DP通过限制输出对单个记录的敏感度间接关联重建隐私（RP），存在间接性，导致过度的效用损失。

Method: 1. 提出基于PAC-隐私的扩散模型适配框架，直接针对重建隐私定义；2. 采用LoRA或Textual Inversion学习紧凑的数据依赖扩散模型组件以实现高维可扩展性；3. 通过重复机制输出的协方差校准各向异性高斯噪声；4. 仅在优化后对所学组件施加单次扰动，避免梯度更新间的隐私组合累积。

Result: 在少样本概念个性化与全数据集图像合成任务上的评估表明，在相同重建隐私水平下，该方法在主体身份保持、生成质量及下游分类准确率方面均优于基于DP的方法。

Conclusion: PAC-隐私因直接对应重建隐私定义，可显著降低隐私保护中的效用损失；通过将适配过程解耦为组件学习与单次噪声扰动，该框架为扩散模型合成数据提供了比DP更优的隐私-效用权衡方案。

Abstract: Synthetic data are increasingly used as an alternative to sharing sensitive records. However, synthetic data generation does not guarantee privacy, as diffusion models trained or adapted on sensitive data remain susceptible to reconstruction attacks. Moreover, while approaches that use differential privacy (DP), such as DP-SGD, achieve provably private diffusion model training, the repeated gradient clipping and noise injection they require result in significant utility loss. An important limitation of DP-based privacy is that, although it has a provable relationship to reconstruction privacy (RP), that relationship is indirect. RP is defined in terms of limiting how much an adversary's posterior distribution over sensitive data differs from the prior, whereas DP provides guarantees by bounding the sensitivity of outputs to changes in individual records. This indirection is an important source of the utility loss. To address this, we propose a PAC-private diffusion model adaptation to achieve reconstruction privacy. Since PAC-privacy is defined directly with respect to posterior advantage over the prior, it directly implicates RP. To obtain scalable PAC privatization in high dimensions, we first learn a compact data-dependent diffusion model component using LoRA or Textual Inversion, and then calibrate anisotropic Gaussian noise from the covariance of repeated mechanism outputs. Unlike DP-SGD, our method perturbs the learned component only once after optimization, thereby avoiding privacy composition across gradient updates. We evaluate the framework on few-shot concept personalization and full-dataset image synthesis, and show that the proposed approach better preserves subject identity, generation quality, and downstream classification accuracy than DP while achieving the same reconstruction privacy.

</details>


### [332] [On architectural choices for interpretability and thermodynamic consistency in Physically Recurrent Neural Networks in the low-data regime](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.04067)
*M. A. Maia,K. A. Meyer,A. M. C. M. van Gils,I. B. C. M. Rocha,F. P. van der Meer*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文针对Physically Recurrent Neural Networks (PRNN) 的解码器架构展开系统研究，提出稀疏化约束、权重归一化约束以及伴随编码器-解码器结构，在低数据场景下同时提升模型可解释性、训练数据效率及热力学一致性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在计算均匀化（FE²）多尺度模拟中，传统全连接解码器虽表达能力强但缺乏物理可解释性，且在小训练集下泛化能力差；同时，纯数据驱动模型难以保证热力学一致性（如Hill-Mandel原理与非负耗散），无法直接建立潜在空间与真实微观状态的对应关系。因此，如何通过架构设计在低数据条件下兼顾精度、可解释性与物理一致性成为核心问题。

Method: 1. 提出三种解码器连接方式：Dense（全连接）、Component（仅匹配分量连接）、Point（同一点所有分量共享权重）；2. 引入权重归一化约束（sum-to-one），将权重类比为体积积分权重，无需额外超参数即可正则化；3. 提出Thermodynamically Consistent（TC）架构：令编码器与解码器满足伴随关系 D_j^T = E_j，结合正权重 w_j，保证Hill-Mandel能量一致性及非负耗散；4. 基于Normalized component架构探索多任务联合学习，联合预测均匀化应力与基体最大静水应力，无需新增参数。

Result: 1. 稀疏化与归一化显著改善低数据下的泛化能力：Normalized component 架构下，应力分布与真实基体微观场匹配误差最低（均值应力误差约10%）；2. TC与Normalized TC架构仅需单条训练曲线即可将均匀化应力预测误差控制在10%以下，并天然保证非负耗散；3. 联合多任务学习在中等规模材料层（≥10个虚拟材料点）下，两个任务性能均可与单任务模型持平甚至更优，总误差低至6 MPa（约7-10%）；4. 存在可解释性与精度的权衡：TC架构精度最高但潜在空间对应性较差，Normalized component则在精度与微观应力场匹配间取得平衡。

Conclusion: 研究表明，基于物理先验的架构选择（稀疏化、归一化、伴随结构）能够同时提升PRNN的数据效率、可解释性与热力学一致性。TC架构为数据极度匮乏场景提供了具备物理保证的解决方案，而稀疏归一化架构则为挖掘潜在空间微观信息、构建多任务模型提供了有效途径。两种改进相互补充，共同验证了“物理驱动的架构设计”在科学机器学习中的重要价值。

Abstract: In this paper, we unravel the effect of different decoder architectures on the interpretability of the latent space of the Physically Recurrent Neural Network. Particular emphasis is given to a new weight normalization constraint, which acts as a regularization technique and enables robust training in the low-data regime. A brief visual exploration illustrates how these changes impact the latent space and how the fictitious stress can align with the true state of the RVE without explicit training. Reaping the benefits of a meaningful latent space, a case study illustrates how information from the microscopic level can be retrieved and incorporated into a multi-task approach that does not require extra parameters or larger training sets. Another key contribution shows that a specific architectural choice can naturally lead to a thermodynamically consistent formulation. By enforcing an adjoint encoder-decoder structure with positive scalar contributions, this modification ensures energy consistency across scales and non-negative dissipation, leading to even lower training requirements. This alternative completes the study on interpretability, inductive bias, and thermodynamic consistency, and demonstrates that data efficiency can be improved with careful architectural choices rooted in the underlying physics.

</details>


### [333] [Articulatory Entrainment and Coordination Complexity in Spontaneous Autistic and Non-autistic Dialogue](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.04071)
*Thanushi Withanage,Carol Espy-Wilson,Elizabeth Redcay,Desi Jones,Noah Sasson*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出了一个基于声学-发音反演和协调复杂度指标的非侵入式、说话者无关框架，用于量化自发性二元对话中的发音协同（包括非自闭症、自闭症及混合神经类型配对）。研究发现非自闭症配对的协调复杂度和协同效应随时间增强，自闭症配对呈现中等效应，混合配对最弱；更强的发音协同与更高的自评对话成功度相关。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 先前关于语音协同（articulatory entrainment）的研究多依赖任务驱动、音素级分析以及侵入式测量手段（如电磁发音记录仪、超声），难以捕捉自发性对话中真实的发音协调动态，尤其是自闭症人群的相关机制尚不清楚。理解自闭症-非自闭症互动中的协调模式对于揭示有效沟通机制、避免将神经多样性差异简单框定为"缺陷"具有重要意义。

Method: 采用两个数据集：CANDOR（1381对非自闭症-非自闭症远程对话，基于AQ量表筛选）和UTD（62对面谈对话，包含18对AT-AT、31对AT-NA、13对NA-NA）。技术流程包括：(1) 音频预处理（降噪、静音去除、分割为40秒或3秒片段）；(2) 声学-发音反演提取6个声道变量（唇开度、唇突出、舌尖/舌体收缩程度与位置）；(3) 构造成对互相关的发音协调特征矩阵（ACF），计算90维特征值谱；(4) 通过加权几何衰减分数ω(α=0.51)对特征值谱降维；(5) 将每段对话分为两半，定义方向性偏差d₁、d₂并组合为有符号协同得分e（基于初始间距归一化）。

Result: (1) CANDOR中NA-NA配对的ω值从第一半到第二半显著下降（0.3552→0.3352，F(1,1380)=170.54, p<.001），按四分位分析显示协调复杂度在对话前7分钟内即显著增加；(2) UTD数据集中NA-NA配对协调复杂度持续增加至更复杂，AT-AT配对维持平稳，而混合配对在对话后趋于更简单协调；(3) NA-NA配对协同得分e>0的比例最高（多数高PCS对话落入e>0区间），AT-AT次之，AT-NA混合配对协同最弱甚至出现分歧；(4) 更高的发音协同与自评对话成功度正相关。

Conclusion: 该框架将发音协同建模为动态运动行为而非仅声学信号，揭示协调复杂度增长是有效社交互动的标志。同神经类型配对随对话进展趋向更复杂协调，反映互动舒适度提升；而混合神经类型配对则表现为持续或增强的发音努力，可能为提高言语清晰度和相互可懂度的适应策略（与Lindblom的次/超发音理论一致）。研究强调发音协调可作为互动对齐和交际效能的量化指标，未来将扩展至自闭症儿童及多参与者/任务型场景。

Abstract: Articulatory entrainment, the adaptation of vocal tract coordination to facilitate interaction remains underexplored in spontaneous dialogue, particularly among autistic speakers. Many prior studies have utilized task-based, phoneme-level analyses with invasive measurement techniques. Here, we introduce a speaker-independent framework to quantify articulatory entrainment in spontaneous dyadic conversations among autistic and non-autistic adults using acoustic-to-articulatory inversion and coordination complexity metrics. We examine temporal changes in articulatory coordination across interaction. Non-autistic dyads exhibit increasing coordination complexity and stronger entrainment over time, autistic dyads show moderate effects, and mixed dyads demonstrate the least alignment. Greater articulatory entrainment correlates with higher self-reported conversational success, indicating increase in coordination complexity as a marker of effective social interaction.

</details>


### [334] [Pareto-Dominant Clarification: Post-Training Coding LLMs via PPO-Lagrangian Budget Constraints](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.04089)
*Abhinav Rajput,Acey Vogelstein*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文将多轮代码澄清任务建模为受约束马尔可夫决策过程(CMDP),使用 PPO-Lagrangian 对 Qwen2.5-Coder-7B-Instruct 进行后训练,在期望问题预算约束下同时优化 pass@1。结果表明基线的澄清行为存在帕累托无效率,预算约束策略能以更少的提问获得更高的准确率,且学到的策略会自动把预算分配到更难的题目上。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有代码智能体在面对模糊任务规范时,既可以选择提问澄清也可以直接作答,但"提问次数 vs. 准确率"存在显式权衡。已有工作要么不施加可强制执行的澄清预算,要么使用需要逐个预算调参的惩罚项方法,缺乏一种统一的端到端训练框架。

Method: 把 ask-vs-answer 的决策建模为 CMDP,以 pass@1 为奖励、原子问题数为成本 C_q、回合数为成本 C_t。用 PPO-Lagrangian(LoRA 微调 Qwen2.5-Coder-7B-Instruct,三个 GAE 流 + 双白化,同时做 primal-dual 更新)在七个预算水平上训练 10 个策略。在 HumanEvalComm 上用 GPT-4o-mini 模拟用户进行评估。

Result: 得到一条对数形的帕累托前沿:在 d₁=0.75 时策略同时实现更高 pass@1(+5.8%~+7.1%, p<0.01)和更低提问率(0.719/0.782 vs 基线 0.856, p<0.01),Pareto-占优于基线;d₁=0.5 时问题数约为基线一半而准确率不显著下降。约束激活后策略会在多退化难题上问得更多,整体上把预算分配到更需要澄清的地方;且即便双方都恰好问一次,训练策略仍显著优于基线(+7.1%, p<0.001),说明收益来自提问质量与代码质量的共同提升。

Conclusion: 通过 CMDP+PPO-Lagrangian 端到端后训练,可以在单次训练范式内同时提升准确率与澄清效率,且模型隐式学到非均匀的预算分配与更好的提问/编码能力;同时存在一个对数形的预算阈值,超过后再增加澄清的边际收益不再为正,提示无约束交互式 LLM 系统可能系统性低效地使用澄清。

Abstract: Coding agents operating under ambiguous instructions or user prompts must decide whether to ask clarifying questions or attempt a solution directly. While clarification from the user may improve the correctness of the agent's solution, each back-and-forth interaction incurs user and system costs, forming an explicit accuracy vs. efficiency tradeoff. Existing works study clarification behavior but do not train policies under enforceable clarification budgets; penalty-based approaches typically require separate coefficient tuning swept across all clarification budget levels. We formulate clarification as a Constrained Markov Decision Process (CMDP) and post-train Qwen2.5-Coder-7B-Instruct with PPO-Lagrangian to optimize coding accuracy, subject to an expected question-budget constraint. Evaluated on HumanEvalComm with a GPT-4o-mini oracle simulator, the resulting policies reveal that untuned clarification behavior is Pareto-inefficient: budget-constrained policies can simultaneously achieve higher accuracy and lower clarification rates than the baseline model. Across budget levels, we observe a log-shaped Pareto frontier with diminishing returns to additional clarification. Gains arise not from simply asking more questions overall, but from improved question targeting and better code generation under ambiguity. Without explicit supervision, trained policies learn to allocate clarification budget non-uniformly, asking more frequently on tougher (multi-degradation) tasks. These results suggest that unconstrained interactive LLM systems may systematically use clarification inefficiently.

</details>


### [335] [Progressive Multi-Ancestor Bit-Depth Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.04100)
*Adil Mubashir Chaudhry,Osama Ahmad,Zubair Khalid,Murtaza Taj*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出PMABD（Progressive Multi-Ancestor Bit-Depth Distillation），一种用于超低比特量化（INT4/INT2）的统一框架，通过渐进式多阶段压缩与多代教师知识蒸馏，缓解直接FP32→低比特量化中的训练不稳定和精度骤降问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有方法直接将FP32模型转换为INT4等超低比特表示并同时蒸馏到小模型，存在训练不稳定和预测性能急剧下降的问题；传统渐进量化虽改善结果，但性能随精度降低单调衰减，难以恢复精度。

Method: PMABD采用渐进式循环框架，构建一个不断增长的"祖先教师模型池"。每阶段训练一个目标精度的新学生，由池中所有更高精度的祖先教师共同监督（logit蒸馏使用KL散度，特征蒸馏使用RKD+AT，叠加QAT正则化）。损失由交叉熵、logit蒸馏、特征对齐和量化正则四项加权组成。引入基于饱和度的早停准则（精度饱和时终止），logit权重采用余弦退火加floor调度，量化使用LSQ+伪量化器。

Result: 在CIFAR-10/100（ResNet-20/32/18）和Tiny-ImageNet（MobileNetV2）上超越现有SOTA：ResNet-32/CIFAR-100 W4A4达71.87%（+0.22%），ResNet-18/CIFAR-100 W2A2达77.70%（+1.06%）。损失景观可视化显示PMABD收敛于更平坦的极小值，消融实验表明每加入一个中间精度教师，学生精度单调提升。

Conclusion: PMABD通过多代祖先知识迁移显著提升超低比特量化的训练稳定性与最终精度，是一种架构无关的统一压缩框架，适用于边缘设备部署。

Abstract: Model compression strategies are widely employed to reduce memory footprint and network complexity, particularly for devices with constrained computational, memory, and energy resources. Prior works that rely on simultaneous conversion from floating-point high-precision (FP32) to integer low-precision (INT4) representations and distillation into smaller models suffer from unstable training and drastic degradation of prediction performance. To address these limitations, we propose a unified framework, known as \textbf{P}rogressive \textbf{M}ulti-\textbf{A}ncestor \textbf{B}it-depth \textbf{D}istillation (PMABD), that progressively compresses the network while transferring knowledge through a growing pool of higher-precision ancestor teachers. PMABD generates a sequence of intermediate teachers that each learn from all higher-precision ancestors and jointly supervise the final target student. This multi-ancestor, multi-stage design stabilizes ultra-low-bit quantization by lowering quantization noise profiles across training and ensuring stable quantization. Experiments on CIFAR-10/100 with ResNet-20/32/18, and Tiny-ImageNet with MobileNetV2 show that PMABD outperforms state-of-the-art compression frameworks, results in 1.06$\%$ increase in performance of W2A2 (ResNet-18/CIFAR-100) student model. We show that a saturation-based stopping criterion contributes to improve the performance of our final student.

</details>


### [336] [Physics is the Best Teacher: Consistency Learning for Time-Invariant Operators of Chaotic Dynamics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.04108)
*Lufang Chiang,Jiachen Yao,Thomas Y.L. Lin,Anima Anandkumar*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于一致性学习的时间不变演化算子，用于混沌动力学的长期高效预测。核心思想是学习一个能在单次评估中跨越任意时间跨度的演化算子，并通过三种一致性条件（Eulerian、Lagrangian、Semigroup）将其与底层物理动力学联系起来。实验在五个混沌系统上进行，结果表明使用物理方程作为"教师"进行蒸馏（即"物理蒸馏"）优于自蒸馏和仅用轨迹数据训练，且所需评估次数仅为自回归方法的十分之一。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 混沌系统的长期行为预测是科学计算的核心任务，但现有方法（数值求解器或自回归模型）需要逐步推进小步长，计算成本高昂。现有方法要么依赖逐步数值积分，要么依赖固定步长的自回归模型，导致长跨度模拟代价过高。此外，仅拟合轨迹数据无法保证学到的算子在所有时间跨度上都遵循统一的动力学规律。论文旨在通过学习时间不变演化算子，一次评估即可跨越任意时间跨度，并利用一致性条件将物理信息嵌入学习过程。

Method: 方法核心是将问题转化为学习自治系统的时间不变演化算子 ψ(u, Δt) = u + Δt·v̄_θ(u, Δt)，其中 v̄_θ 是学习到的平均速度场。论文推导了三种一致性条件：(1) Eulerian 形式——在起点处计算速度场导数；(2) Lagrangian 形式——在终点处计算速度场；(3) Semigroup 性质——任意时间区间可分解为两段子跳跃的复合。这些条件允许"教师"选择：自蒸馏（使用模型自身在零时刻的边界速度）或物理蒸馏（使用已知的控制方程 ℱ 作为速度源）。训练采用平方残差作为一致性损失，与轨迹数据损失加权组合，使用 stop-gradient 保证训练稳定性。

Result: 在 Lorenz、Chen、Rössler、Thomas、Halvorsen 五个混沌系统上的实验表明：(1) 物理蒸馏在五个系统中均优于自蒸馏和纯数据方法，短期轨迹精度提升约 1.6 倍（5Tλ）和 3 倍（1Tλ），长期统计指标也更优；(2) Eulerian-phys 在大多数情况下优于 Lagrangian-phys；(3) 学到的演化算子仅需 100 次函数评估（NFE），即可达到 AR 基线 1000 次 NFE 和 CFO 基线 4000 次 NFE 的精度水平；(4) 时间外推能力（训练半段、外推到整段）优于依赖绝对时间条件的基线；(5) 实际墙钟时间约 45ms，远快于 AR（约 400ms）和 CFO（约 1650ms）。

Conclusion: 论文证明了对时间不变演化算子施加一致性条件是有效的学习策略，且物理方程作为"教师"优于模型自身。在五个混沌系统上的实验验证了该方法在精度和计算效率上的优势，为混沌动力学的长期模拟提供了一条高效路径。论文同时承认未充分探究 Eulerian 与 Lagrangian 两种微分形式之间的本质区别，留作未来工作。

Abstract: Accelerating the prediction of long-term behavior in chaotic systems is crucial in scientific computing. However, existing methods rely on numerical solvers or autoregressive models that advance one small step at a time, which makes long horizons expensive. We instead view this problem as learning the system's time-invariant evolution operator, which jumps the state across a large time span in a single evaluation. To this end, we derive the consistency equations a time-invariant operator must satisfy, with differential and compositional objectives in physical time. These equations also connect the learned operator to the physics-prescribed instant dynamics, enabling physics embedding in consistency learning. Across five chaotic systems, we find that physics-distilled consistency makes both short-term trajectories and long-term statistics more accurate. The learned operator survives temporal extrapolation and requires one-tenth as many evaluations as autoregressive rollout, offering an efficient route to long-term simulation of chaotic dynamics.

</details>


### [337] [Sharp Convergence and Sample Complexity of Policy Mirror Descent for Average-Reward MDPs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.04117)
*Enes Arda,Atilla Eryilmaz*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文针对遍历平均奖励MDP中的策略镜像下降（PMD），建立了围绕单一主递归的有限时间、有限样本理论。在精确、非精确表格和线性函数近似更新下证明了线性收敛率（精确PMD甚至具有超线性收敛），并给出了表格（依赖|S||A|）和LFA（依赖d）设置的t³ₘᵢₓ/ε²端到端样本复杂度。LFA样本复杂度将已知最佳的t⁵ₘᵢₓ混合时间依赖改进至t³ₘᵢₓ，并通过匹配的信息论下界证明了评论器的t³ₘᵢₓ/ε²样本复杂度在两种设置中均不可改进。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 折扣MDP中的PMD已有成熟的有限时间理论，但平均奖励设置（许多控制应用的更自然目标）的研究较少。现有方法通常通过让γ↑1分析折扣代理，但折扣有限时间保证通常以H_γ的多项式为尺度，导致平均奖励极限下界爆炸。需要为平均奖励MPDP独立开发直接理论。

Method: 核心是主收敛引理（Lemma 3.7），通过单步Lyapunov递推Ψ_{t+1} ≤ (1-1/χ̄)Ψ_t + (χ̄A_t + B_t)/χ̄统一处理PMD及其评论器。将优化机制（步长调度、失配系数χ̄）与评论器误差结构（A_bar, B_bar）解耦，分别在两种设置中实例化：(1) 表格设置使用均匀评论器误差界和具有burn-in截止τ的尾部均值估计ρ̂的截断中心化回报估计器；(2) LFA设置使用Averaged SGD在单轨迹上学习线性评论器，避免|S||A|因子并需要更弱的预言机。下界证明分别使用Le Cam两点归约（表格）和Assouad归约（LFA）。

Result: 理论结果：(1) 主递归对任意评论器有效，其特化对精确、非精确表格和LFA更新产生线性收敛，精确PMD有超线性收敛率（Corollary 4.3）；(2) 表格样本复杂度Õ(χ̄³|S||A|t³ₘᵢₓ/ε²)，高概率末次迭代保证（Theorem 4.8）；(3) LFA样本复杂度Õ(dt³ₘᵢₓχ̄³/ε²)，单轨迹下期望保证（Theorem 5.11），改进了之前最优的t⁵ₘᵢₓ至t³ₘᵢₓ；(4) 通过Le Cam和Assouad归约证明评论器的t³ₘᵢₓ/ε²样本复杂度在两种设置中均不可改进（Propositions 4.7, 5.9）。在随机DirtM模型、访问控制队列、5×5网格世界和Jack租车四个MDP上随机80次的实验验证中，经验证χ_t/χ̄₋在20-40次迭代内坍缩10-1000倍。

Conclusion: 本文为遍历平均奖励MDP中的策略镜像下降提供了完整的有限时间、有限样本理论。核心贡献是主递归引理，它将优化机制（步长调度、失配系数）与评论器误差结构分离，证明了在精确、非精确表格和LFA更新下的线性收敛，并在LFA设置中将样本复杂度的混合时间依赖从t⁵ₘᵢₓ改进到t³ₘᵢₓ，匹配了信息论下界。主递归的两部分结构（瞬态χ̄阶段与渐近χ阶段）的实证验证表明：渐近χ阶段的χ̄≪χ，在实践中仅需短暂预热即可进入，是操作上相关的阶段。未来的有趣方向包括高概率LFA、多链扩展和遗憾保证。

Abstract: Policy mirror descent (PMD) has a mature finite-time theory in discounted Markov decision processes (MDPs), but less is known in the average-reward setting, a more natural objective for many control applications. We give a finite-time, finite-sample analysis of PMD in ergodic average-reward MDPs built around a single master recursion that governs convergence for any critic, without external regularization. Its specializations yield linear rates for exact, inexact-tabular, and linear function approximation (LFA) updates, with a superlinear regime for exact PMD. We complement these convergence results with end-to-end sample complexities of order $t_{\mathrm{mix}}^3/\varepsilon^2$ in both tabular ($|S||A|$-dependent) and LFA ($d$-dependent) settings. Our LFA sample complexity sharpens the prior best $t_{\mathrm{mix}}^5$ mixing dependence to $t_{\mathrm{mix}}^3$, and matching information-theoretic lower bounds establish that the critic's $t_{\mathrm{mix}}^3/\varepsilon^2$ sample complexity is unimprovable in both settings.

</details>


### [338] [Dynamic Harness Search: Building Multi-Agent Systems Per-Query via Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.04137)
*Som Sagar,Shasha Li,Hejie Cui,Ransalu Senanayake,Sercan Ö. Arık*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: SHIFT（Searching Harnesses In Forward-pass Trees）提出了一种面向查询的智能体系统（harness）自动构建框架。其核心是一个小型本地大模型"架构师"（architect），它在搜索过程中仅通过本地推理预测智能体编排方案的效用（兼顾准确率与执行成本），而无需在搜索循环内实际执行候选方案。蒙特卡洛树搜索（MCTS）利用这些预测为每个查询在线构建最优的智能体图谱（agent graph），从而显著提升多智能体系统在多个基准测试上的准确率与效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 不同的查询任务需要不同复杂度的智能体系统（如简单检索 vs. 多步计算与验证）。然而，智能体各组件（角色、指令、工具）的价值只有在实际执行后才能观测到，导致现有的固定工作流或离线优化方法难以针对单个查询进行自适应调整，且成本高昂。

Method: 1. **Harness 形式化**：将智能体系统建模为有向图（节点=智能体，边=通信流），并定义修改图结构的离散动作（添加智能体、追加指令、授权工具）。<br>2. **架构师模型**：基于冻结的 Gemma 2-2B 主干网络，通过 LoRA 适配器和线性层预测动作策略（policy）和效用价值（value）。<br>3. **免执行的 MCTS**：状态转移确定性已知，搜索过程完全依靠架构师的本地推理来评估候选图谱；只有在最终选定的图谱上才调用执行器（Gemini 3.5 Flash）。<br>4. **训练机制**：结合策略交叉熵、价值二元交叉熵和排名对比损失（pairwise ranking loss），从执行结果中学习预测准确率与成本的综合效用。

Result: 在涵盖数学、代码、文档问答及通用助理的 6 个基准测试（共 9,193 个任务）上，SHIFT 的 SHIFT-search 模式达到了 79.9% 的平均准确率，比最强的基线（Trace）高出 7.2 个百分点，尤其在长程工具密集型任务（OfficeQA、GAIA）上提升显著（+30.0% 和 +15.0%）。SHIFT-value 模式以更低的执行成本（比最强基线少 32% 的 token）超越了所有基线的平均准确率。在 MATH-500 上，仅用 GSM8K 训练的架构师无需微调即可迁移并提升难度最高题目的准确率。

Conclusion: 将执行过程移出搜索循环是构建自适应多智能体系统的有效途径。通过学习预测执行效用，小型本地架构师能指导大模型在不到一秒的时间内为每个查询定制出兼顾准确率与成本的最优智能体图谱。联合优化结构、指令和工具带来的增益远大于单独优化其中一项，且模型能跨任务难度进行泛化。

Abstract: Agent harnesses specify the roles, instructions, tools, and communication structure used to solve a task, and the right harness depends on the query. Because the value of each design choice is observable only through execution, tailoring a harness to each query has required either executing alternatives at inference time or costly manual design. We introduce SHIFT, which moves execution out of the per-query search loop. A local LLM architect learns a policy over harness-building actions from search, and a value function that predicts, from measured executions, a utility balancing accuracy against execution cost. For each query, Monte Carlo tree search uses these predictions to construct a harness. Across 9,193 tasks in six benchmarks, from math to document and general-assistant tasks, with a Gemini 3.5 Flash executor, SHIFT attains the highest mean accuracy, about 80%, outperforming 17 baselines that span prompting, prompt optimization, and workflow search, and exceeding the strongest baseline by 7.2 percentage points. A cheaper mode of SHIFT also attains a higher mean accuracy than every baseline while using 32% fewer execution tokens than the strongest baseline. We further show that choosing structure, instructions, and tools jointly beats choosing only instructions or only tools by up to 9.1 percentage points, and that learned value selection identifies more accurate harnesses with lower execution cost from candidate pools.

</details>


### [339] [ExpertMuon-Compass: Alignment-Guided Step Sizes for Mixture-of-Experts Training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.04140)
*Omatharv Bharat Vaidya,Ashwin Vinod,Pedram Akbarian,Aditya Sai Ellendula,Connor T. Jerzak,Nhat Ho*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出ExpertMuon-Compass(Compass)，一种针对混合专家(MoE)模型训练的Muon优化器变体。它通过两个基于对齐的标量因子——家族因子和标量半径——来自适应调整每个专家的步长，保持Muon的正交化方向不变。在FineWeb-Edu预训练中表现优于或匹配Muon、NorMuon等基线，尤其在专家数据分布随训练变化时(如多语言块状数据)效果显著。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: MoE模型中每个专家处理的数据子集在训练过程中不断变化，但Muon等优化器使用共享学习率，对所有专家施加大小相近的更新，即使某些专家的更新与当前梯度对齐较差。这导致在分布变化场景(如持续学习或多语言语料)下，专家步长与梯度对齐不一致。

Method: Compass在Muon正交化更新基础上引入两个标量因子：(1)家族因子c_e：比较专家正交化更新与梯度的余弦相似度与同层其他专家的余弦相似度，低于均值的专家步长更小；(2)标量半径α_e：将专家矩阵各行与梯度的对齐聚合成单个标量步长乘数，保持更新方向不变。两因子平均归一化为1。还提供了两个因子的扰动界理论证明。

Result: 在FineWeb-Edu 8.2M至1.05B token的MoE预训练中：(1)8.2M token时Compass(N/N)在width 1024下优于NorMuon(6/8种子胜，p=0.031)；(2)65.5M token时匹配NorMuon权重衰减后Compass表现最佳(WikiText-2损失5.80)；(3)在语言块状数据顺序下，Compass在所有8种语言上均优于Nesterov Muon(14/16种子胜，p=0.0012)。专家负载保持平衡，路由器分配更果断。

Conclusion: Compass通过基于对齐的自适应步长调整，为MoE训练中的专家矩阵提供了一种有效的优化策略。它在数据分布变化场景下优势最为明显，证明了专家步长应随训练过程中数据变化而调整的重要性。该方法可附加到NorMuon等其他Muon变体上，计算开销仅增加4-7%。

Abstract: Mixture-of-experts (MoE) language models send each token to a few experts, so each expert is trained on a different part of the data, and this part changes during training. With a shared learning rate, Muon applies updates of roughly the same size to expert matrices of the same shape, even when an expert's update is poorly aligned with its current gradient. We here propose ExpertMuon-Compass (Compass), which multiplies the Muon step of each expert by two factors. A family factor compares the cosine between the expert's orthogonalized update and its gradient with the same cosine for the other experts in its layer. A scalar radius aggregates the alignment between corresponding rows of the update and gradient into one step-length multiplier. Compass keeps the update direction and the momentum buffer of Muon. In pretraining on FineWeb-Edu, Compass with Nesterov momentum on all matrices performs as well as or better than Muon, NorMuon, and other optimizers, with weight decay matched to NorMuon in the longer runs. Adding its factors to NorMuon gives the same or a lower loss than NorMuon. Compass is the most effective when the data seen by each expert varies during training, for example, as when the languages of a multilingual corpus arrive in separate blocks. With Compass, the expert load stays balanced, and the router assigns tokens to experts more decisively. We also prove a perturbation bound for the two factors.

</details>


### [340] [Ideal Paths for Approximating Logistic Gradient Descent Trajectories at Large Initialization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.04142)
*Junjie Xiao,Huiwen Jia*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究大初始化条件下全批量Logistic梯度下降（GD）的训练轨迹几何刻画。通过构造"理想路径"（两阶段：负边界修正+最小边界增长），证明在显式两阶段时间重参数化下，归一化GD轨迹一致收敛于该理想路径，并据此推导峰值评估损失和累积训练损失的渐近公式。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现代训练常从预训练模型初始化，仅靠隐式偏置的极限方向无法描述中间训练行为（中间可能产生显著的评估损失峰值），需要刻画GD轨迹的中间几何行为。

Method: 在严格线性可分数据上，对初始化w_0=Ru_0+e_R（R→∞，||e_R‖/R→0）的全批量固定步长logistic GD进行几何分析。构造两阶段"理想路径"：阶段1用总负边界H的次梯度流（最小范数投影规则）进行负边界修正；阶段2用最小边界样本特征向量凸包的最小范数点作为速度进行最小边界增长。通过两阶段时间重参数化（阶段1为ηk/R，阶段2为η·ΣQ(w_j)/R），证明归一化GD轨迹在每个固定参数区间上一致收敛到该路径，误差为O(||e_R||/R+R^{-1/2})，在平滑性步长条件下改进为O(||e_R||/R+log(2+R)/R)。基于此推导路径泛函子（评估损失峰值、累积训练损失）的渐近极限，并通过受控几何和手写数字图像特征上的数值实验验证。

Result: 1) 构造了由最小范数投影规则确定的有限几何"理想路径"，包含两阶段；2) 证明GD轨迹除以R在两阶段重参数化下按期望一致收敛到理想路径，误差O(||e_R||/R+R^{-1/2})，光滑步长下为O(||e_R||/R+log(2+R)/R)；3) 评估损失峰值可随R线性增长，即使两端点损失趋于零；4) 累积训练损失修正阶段按R^2归一化收敛，最小边界增长阶段按R归一化收敛；5) 在受控样本、手写数字特征（digits 5/6任务，初始方向来自digits 3/8最大边界分离器）上验证，R从5增至80时路径误差降低、峰值和累积损失预测吻合。

Conclusion: 理想路径为大初始化logistic GD训练提供了有限几何描述，将负边界修正与最小边界增长联系起来。收敛界将该几何结构与实际固定步GD在两阶段参数的每个固定窗口上相连。该结构及其与GD时间的关系产生了评估损失峰值和累积训练损失的领先阶极限。这些极限可由加权数据和极限初始位置直接计算。

Abstract: Modern training on a new task often starts from a previously trained model rather than from scratch, raising the question of how this initialization affects the subsequent training trajectory. Classical implicit-bias results characterize the direction selected by prolonged training, but this direction alone does not provide information regarding the intermediate behavior. We address this question through a geometric approximation of full-batch logistic gradient descent (GD) trajectories on strictly linearly separable data, with large initialization of scale $R$ motivated by prior training. From any limiting normalized initial position, we use minimum-norm projection rules to construct a unique continuous ideal path consisting of finitely many linear segments. The path has two stages: negative-margin correction followed by minimum-margin growth. We prove that, after an explicit two-stage time reparameterization, the fixed-step GD trajectory divided by $R$ converges uniformly to this path on every fixed parameter interval as $R\to\infty$. Further, our quantitative error bounds account for initialization perturbations and the transition between stages. This approximation provides asymptotic formulas for peak evaluation loss and cumulative training loss. In particular, peak evaluation loss can grow linearly in $R$ even when both endpoint losses tend to zero. The cumulative losses in the correction and margin-growth stages, normalized by $R^2$ and $R$, respectively, converge to explicit limits. Experiments on controlled geometries and fixed image features complement our theoretical results.

</details>


### [341] [Consideration Circuits: Depth Separation and Universality Beyond a Single Softmax](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.04143)
*Junjie Xiao,Huiwen Jia*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出"考虑电路"(Consideration Circuits, CC)，一种由多步MNL单元构成的有向无环图特征选择模型，推广了经典的单softmax选择模型。研究证明：(1)深度从2增至3可将逼近compromise任务所需的taste向量范数从Θ(log(1/ε)/ε)降至Θ(log(1/ε))的最优阶；(2)刻画了深度3下逼近任意决策表的充要几何条件（局部暴露(E)和平移分离(T)），深度4在含非单菜单的菜单族上达到最优对数范数；(3)实验表明，参数少于600的树形电路在4个固定池基准和Expedia时序划分上取得最佳测试NLL，并可作为输出头提升所有测试编码器在Expedia和Trivago上的表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 经典及深度特征选择模型大多对选项评分后施加单一softmax，无法充分捕捉多阶段考虑-选择的认知机制以及违反随机效用规则性的上下文效应（如诱饵效应）。本文旨在引入一个可微、支持任意深度的多阶段选择模型，并通过理论分析阐明深度增加所带来的表达力增益。

Method: 提出考虑电路(CC)：由源单元和内部单元构成的有向无环图。源单元对菜单选项施加MNL分布并计算概率加权特征摘要；内部单元通过MNL权重（前驱摘要的函数）合并前驱的选择分布，并传递加权和摘要至后继。sink给出最终选择概率。深度2实现可微的"考虑-再选择"，更深引入更多考虑阶段。理论方法：(1)在三选项compromise任务上证明深度2与深度3之间taste向量范数的尖锐分离；(2)证明(E)局部暴露和(T)平移分离两个几何条件是所有深度下逼近任意确定选择表的必要条件；(3)在深度3下构造通用拓扑，在深度4下达到最优对数范数；(4)构造60点48菜单的可加实例，证明深度3固定拓扑存在超对数范数下界。实验使用Adam训练，评价多个固定池基准（SFwork/SFshop/Swissmetro/ModeCanada）和酒店选择时序数据集（Expedia/Trivago）。

Result: 理论结果：(1)三选项compromise任务中，N₂*(ε)=Θ(log(1/ε)/ε)，N₃*(ε)=Θ(log(1/ε))；深度2下界对任意宽度和路由偏置成立，五节点深度3电路达到对数率；(2)对任意N，存在仅依赖N的深度3通用拓扑G_N^(3)，对所有可加实例的任意确定选择表至任意精度ε可逼近；(3)深度4通用拓扑G_F^(4)对含非单菜单的菜单族达到最优O(log(1/ε))范数。实验结果：(1)固定池基准上，参数98-566的树形电路在SFwork(0.8209)、SFshop(1.5644)、Swissmetro(0.7267)、ModeCanada(0.5590)四个数据集上均取得最低平均测试NLL；(2)深度实验显示深度从2到3带来最大增益（Expedia降低0.0109-0.0160，Trivago继续随深度降低）；(3)在Expedia时序划分上，Tree63(503参数)取得最低测试NLL 2.5983，优于所有深度基线；(4)作为输出头，Tree63降低了所有六个测试编码器在Expedia和Trivago上的测试NLL，最佳结果TCN+Tree63在Trivago上达2.4013；(5)在Expedia上观察到，TCNet和DeepHalo缩小至1.5k参数仍高于MNL基线，说明结构而非参数数量是关键。

Conclusion: 考虑电路(CC)将"考虑-再选择"扩展为可微的多阶段过程，由MNL单元组成。通过理论证明了深度2到3之间的尖锐范数分离，刻画了深度3下逼近任意决策表的充要几何条件，并在深度4下达到最优对数范数。紧凑的CC在四个固定池基准和Expedia时序划分上以不到600个参数优于评估的经典模型。作为输出头，CC在所有测试编码器和两个酒店选择数据集上均降低了测试NLL，证明了多阶段选择相较单一MNL层的价值。

Abstract: Most feature-based choice models, classical and deep, score items and apply a single softmax. We introduce consideration circuits (CC), feature-based models of multi-stage choice defined by directed acyclic graphs of multinomial logit (MNL) units. Source units assign probabilities to menu items, and internal units combine predecessor distributions using MNL weights computed from their probability-weighted feature summaries. On a three-item compromise task with fixed non-collinear features, menu-independent random-utility models (RUM), including a single MNL unit, suffer an error bounded away from zero. For CC, in contrast, we establish a sharp depth--norm separation: increasing depth from $2$ to $3$ reduces the optimal maximum taste-vector norm for error $\epsilon$ from $\Theta(\log(1/\epsilon)/\epsilon)$ to $\Theta(\log(1/\epsilon))$. The depth-$2$ lower bound holds for arbitrary width and menu-independent routing biases, while a five-node depth-$3$ circuit with zero routing biases attains the logarithmic rate. More generally, we characterize two geometric conditions that are necessary and sufficient for approximating arbitrary deterministic choice tables on finite menu families. Under these conditions, depth $3$ suffices, while depth $4$ achieves optimal logarithmic norm scaling whenever the family contains a non-singleton menu. In experiments, standalone tree circuits with fewer than $600$ parameters attain the lowest mean test negative log-likelihood (NLL) among the evaluated models on four fixed-pool benchmarks and the Expedia temporal split. As output heads, CC generalize the linear MNL readout and lower mean test NLL for every tested encoder on Expedia and Trivago.

</details>


### [342] [You May Be Running the Wrong Inception Crop](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.04147)
*Jason Chuan-Chih Chou*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文发现 TensorFlow/JAX 生态系统中广泛使用的 Inception crop 实现存在十年未被察觉的 bug，导致其实际采样分布为 f(A)∝1/√A（偏向小裁剪），而非 PyTorch 所遵循的原始均匀分布。通过在 ImageNet-1k 上训练 522 个 ViT-S/16 模型，作者提出三条结论：(1) 训练预算越高，所需数据增强越强；(2) Inception crop 的增强强度由 crop scale 分布的下尾决定；(3) 训练预算越高，模型显著性图越稀疏，与增强无关。论文还提出 Beta crop 作为缓解方案，其较软的下界能在不同训练预算下取得更稳定的性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 作者在复现 Beyer et al. (2022a) 的 ViT 训练结果时，追踪到 TensorFlow 中 Inception crop 实现与原始描述及 PyTorch 实现存在分布差异，但该差异十年来未被察觉。鉴于 Inception crop 是深度视觉模型训练的事实标准裁剪增强方法，且 TensorFlow/JAX 生态（BIG Vision 等）广泛依赖此实现，作者认为有必要系统评估这一实现差异对模型性能的影响，以及 crop scale 分布和训练预算之间的交互作用。

Method: 作者对比了 TensorFlow 的 sample_distorted_bounding_box() 和 PyTorch RandomResizedCrop 的算法差异（前者对裁剪高度 h 均匀采样，导致 f(A)∝1/√A 的分布且非等变于图像转置；后者对面积 a 均匀采样）。在 ImageNet-1k 上训练 522 个 Simple ViT-S/16 模型（来自 Beyer et al. 2022a），覆盖 5 个训练预算（30/60/90/150/300 epoch）、6 个 crop scale 下界 a_min∈{0.025,...,0.25}，以及 Beta crop 的三组参数扫描（正偏、负偏、匹配强度）。还用 Scion 优化器做了 72 个模型的验证。显著性分析使用 rectified gradient、Grad-CAM 和 LRP 三种方法的熵度量。评估采用原始标签和 ReaL 多标签。

Result: 主要结果包括：(1) 最佳 crop scale 下界随训练预算增加而减小（如 30ep 时 a_min≥0.25，300ep 时 a_min≤0.05），说明高预算需要更强增强；(2) 在大多数设置下，TensorFlow Inception crop 由于正偏分布不如 PyTorch 版本（即使在统一增强强度度量下也通常较差）；(3) Beta crop（匹配强度实验，a_min=0，β=1，α 调整）在多数设置下匹配或超过 PyTorch Inception crop，因其更软的下界在不同预算间妥协更少；(4) 90 轮 + Scion 优化器达到 78.78±0.09% 原始标签精度；(5) 显著性熵（梯度、Grad-CAM、LRP 三种度量）随训练预算增加而下降，与 crop 分布或权重衰减无关。

Conclusion: 论文得出三个核心结论：(1) 最佳增强强度依赖于训练预算，预算越高需要越强增强；(2) Inception crop 的增强强度由 crop scale 分布的下尾决定（最 5.3% 的小裁剪决定性能）；(3) 训练预算越高，模型显著性越稀疏。基于结论 2 提出的 Beta crop（匹配强度）以更软的下界实现跨训练预算的更优权衡。论文建议 TensorFlow/JAX 社区修复或替换其 Inception crop 实现，并在跨生态比较结果时保持谨慎。理论上，强增强可能通过延迟对有限训练样本的记忆来帮助泛化；这对模型规模与训练 epoch 数之间的权衡有潜在影响（如训练更大模型更少 epoch 配合更弱增强）。

Abstract: A decade after its inception, Inception crop has become the standard crop-based data augmentation method for training deep vision models. Not only is its practice of uniformly sampling crop scale and aspect ratio widely adopted, but also its lower and upper bounds, with the scale lower bound being the sole exception that is sometimes tuned. It is therefore surprising that the standard implementation in the TensorFlow / JAX ecosystem samples crop scale with probability density function $f(A) \propto \frac{1}{\sqrt{A}}$ unlike the PyTorch counterpart, which follows the original description. Motivated by this discovery, we train 522 ViT-S/16 models on the ImageNet-1k dataset with various training budgets and crop scale distributions. We reach $78.78\pm0.09$ top-1 val. accuracy with 90 epochs of training budget and find that 1. Higher training budget requires stronger augmentation; 2. Lower tail of the distribution of the crop scale determines the augmentation strength of Inception crop; 3. Models trained with higher training budget exhibit sparser saliency, regardless of the crop scale distribution or weight decay. Based on 2. we revisit the performance of Beta crop, whose softer cutoff allows it to optimize model performance across training budgets with less compromise. We replicate 1. and 3. with Scion optimizer in addition to AdamW, suggesting that the results may be general.

</details>


### [343] [Principled Top-$k$ Selection for Language Models with Hybrid Gradients](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.04162)
*Xuchen Gong,Junfei Sun,Tian Li*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一种用于训练top-k选择模块（如RAG中的文档选择和MoE中的专家路由）的有原则性方法，通过在子集层面构建替代目标并推导出包含策略梯度（探索）和监督梯度（利用）的混合梯度信号，在多个应用上优于现有启发式方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有top-k选择模块的训练依赖启发式方法，存在梯度信号弱、探索-利用权衡次优、缺乏明确建模选择过程的原则性目标等问题。随着候选池规模m的增长（如MoE专家数量增多、RAG文档池扩大），搜索空间O(m^k)急剧扩大，选择难度增加。

Method: 1）提出子集层面的替代目标：在k元子集分布π_θ(·|x)上求期望的损失上界（当损失凸且聚合函数一致时成立）；2）推导混合梯度，通过对数导数技巧得到策略梯度（用leave-one-out批次损失作为基线减少方差）和监督梯度的无偏组合，引入超参数λ调节偏差-方差权衡（λ→0低方差有偏，λ→1无偏高方差）；3）采用Plackett序列无放回采样定义子集分布；4）扩展至多层MoE场景；5）证明O(1/√T)收敛率，并给出最优λ的理论值。

Result: 理论：在温和假设下证明算法以O(1/√T)速率收敛到替代目标和真实目标的驻点，最优λ⋆(T)依赖σ²_P和R_max。实验：1）合成回归（h=128,k=3,m∈{64,128,256,512}）：在m=512时top-1选择准确率达47.6%，优于监督基线（11.9%）和SparseMixer（27.0%）；2）RAG（Wikitext-103、NQ、TriviaQA，m∈{8,16,32}）：Llama-3.2-3B在NQ m=32上达到36.1% EM，比REPLUG好1.5%；3）MoE（m∈{8,16,32,64,128}）：单层m=128时PPL降至71.84，优于监督基线（74.39）和确定性top-k（85.82）。

Conclusion: 该工作将top-k选择问题形式化为子集分布上的随机优化，提出了有原则性的目标和算法，混合梯度机制有效改善了选择模块的探索-利用权衡。局限性：λ的选取仍依赖问题，需网格搜索；实验规模相对有限。

Abstract: Selecting the best $k$ items out of $m$ candidates is a critical component of modern large language model systems, such as document selection in Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) and expert routing in Mixture-of-Experts (MoEs). However, training these selection modules remains challenging due to weak gradient signals and suboptimal exploration-exploitation tradeoffs. Furthermore, prior works often rely on heuristics, lacking principled objectives and approaches that explicitly model and solve the top-$k$ selection problem. In this work, we propose a principled objective for training selection modules, whose gradient naturally provides richer training signals in a hybrid form---containing a supervised-gradient component and a policy-gradient component. We show that the selection problem becomes harder as $m$ increases, and our algorithm converges at rate $O(1/\sqrt{T})$, with the optimal upper bound achieved by balancing between bias and variance. Practically, we apply our method to a set of tasks involving top-$k$ selection, including synthetic regression problems, RAG, and MoE systems, showing that our method outperforms the baselines in next-token prediction perplexity and QA accuracy.

</details>


### [344] [PaLoRA: Paced Low-Rank Adaptation for Continual Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.04226)
*Yuxuan Li,Fanhu Zeng,Hao Tang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: PaLoRA是一种用于持续学习的LoRA方法，它从理论上推导出最优梯度步长应随历史知识的有效秩自适应增长的调度律（pacing law），并通过自适应SVD压缩历史更新、空空间投影以及秩感知的梯度缩放来实现，在长周期50任务ImageNet-A和ImageNet-R基准上比现有最佳方法提升约4%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LoRA持续学习方法普遍依赖固定的小学习率作为启发式约束梯度幅度，但缺乏理论指导来解释为何约束有效，以及随着任务累积该约束应如何演化。作者发现即使在方向约束（如零空间投影）下，有限精度更新仍会沿多个方向泄露到历史知识子空间，且随着有效秩增长，累积遗忘加剧，因此固定约束强度本质上是不最优的。

Method: 1）在单层线性模型、各向异性泄露（$\mathbb{E}[\epsilon_i^2]=\eta^2\gamma_i^2/s^2$）与局部二次旧任务敏感度假设下，推导每步遗忘（$E[\Delta\mathcal{L}_{t-1}]=\eta^2 R\Gamma^2/(2s^2)$，二次衰减）与新任务进度（$\Delta\mathcal{L}_t\approx-\eta G^2/s$，线性衰减）的不对称权衡，并在给定遗忘预算下得到最优调度律 $s^*=\sqrt{R/c}$；2）提出PaLoRA框架，包括：自适应SVD截断（基于能量阈值$\tau=0.99$）获得有效秩$R$；将新任务梯度投影到历史零空间；按$\sqrt{R/C}$缩放$B_t$梯度（$C=4$）；3）加入基于易正三元组损失的辅助正则化项补偿塑性。

Result: 在CIFAR-100、ImageNet-R、ImageNet-A上以10/20/25/50任务划分评测（5随机种子），PaLoRA在所有设置下均取得最高最终精度与平均精度：在ImageNet-R 50任务上比LoRA-DRS提升4.09个百分点（76.56% vs 72.47%），ImageNet-A 50任务上提升3.99个百分点（60.90% vs 56.91%），CIFAR-100 50任务达88.96%；BWT在多数情况下为最优或近最优；消融实验验证指数$\alpha=0.5$最优且$\sqrt{R/C}$形式稳定；与SD-LoRA和PiSSA等LoRA变体兼容；额外开销小（每任务仅增加约0.08秒SVD压缩）。

Conclusion: 作者证明固定梯度缩放启发式在LoRA持续学习中本质上是不最优的，并推导了秩感知调度律$s^*=\sqrt{R/c}$，在预算约束模型下具有Pareto最优性。基于此提出PaLoRA，通过自适应SVD压缩、零空间投影与秩相关梯度缩放在三类基准上稳定优于现有方法，在长周期设置中增益尤为显著。理论限于单层线性假设，深ViT上的应用为近似缩放原则；未来可拓展至生成模型、LLM/MLLM及非LoRA场景下的累积知识度量。

Abstract: LoRA-based continual learning methods mitigate catastrophic forgetting through various mechanisms, yet nearly all complement these with small learning rates as a heuristic to restrict gradient scaling magnitude. Such fixed heuristics lack theoretical guidance on how the strength of this restriction should evolve as tasks accumulate. We reveal that even under directional constraints such as nullspace projection, finite-precision updates inevitably leak into the subspace of accumulated prior knowledge along multiple directions. While small learning rates attenuate such leakage, they cannot prevent the accumulated forgetting from intensifying as the effective rank of historical knowledge grows. We show that the optimal magnitude restriction should adaptively increase with this effective rank to balance stability and plasticity, i.e., preservation of previous knowledge and acquisition of new task information. Under an anisotropic leakage model, we derive a pacing law $s^*=\sqrt{R/c}$ that characterizes the optimal scaling of gradient steps, i.e., the magnitude restriction itself, where $R$ is the effective rank of past updates. Based on this insight, we propose PaLoRA, which compresses historical knowledge via adaptive SVD truncation, projects gradients onto the nullspace of prior tasks, and applies rank-aware adaptive pacing. Experiments demonstrate consistent improvements over prior methods, with particularly strong performance in long-horizon settings, achieving substantial gains of 4% accuracy on challenging 50-task ImageNet-A and ImageNet-R benchmarks.

</details>


### [345] [Stochastic Adaptive Fourier Decomposition for Operator Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.04241)
*Pengqing Shi,Liming Zhang,Tao Qian,Stephen Tierney,Jie Yin,Junbin Gao*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: SAFDNO提出了一种用输入自适应Takenaka-Malmquist正交系统替代固定Fourier基的谱算子学习方法，通过神经网络极点预测器分摊极点选择过程，在9个PDE基准测试中（尤其DLazcy、Burgers和Navier-Stokes）实现SOTA性能，并展现出更强的零样本超分辨率能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: FNO使用固定Fourier基和硬性频率截断，限制了对非周期、局部化和细尺度解结构的建模能力。需要一种输入自适应的谱表示方法来解决这些限制。

Method: 用数据驱动的Takenaka-Malmquist正交系统替代固定Fourier基，通过基于交叉注意力的神经网络极点预测器分摊极点选择，使用SIREN网络实现自适应谱系数的滤波，在Hardy空间中进行解析信号的谱分解。

Result: 在9个PDE基准测试中的6个规则网格问题上达到最佳性能，Darry（0.0054）、Navier-Stokes（0.0684）、Burgers（5.79e-3）提升显著；在零样本超分辨率上表现更强且参数更少（0.44M vs FNO的0.70M），展示了输入自适应有理基表示的优势。

Conclusion: 输入自适应TM系统是固定谱表示的有前途的替代方案，能有效建模PDE解中的局部化、非平稳和细尺度结构，并具有更稳健的零样本超分辨率性能。

Abstract: Fourier Neural Operators (FNOs) offer an efficient paradigm for solving partial differential equations (PDEs). However, FNOs rely on a fixed Fourier basis and hard frequency truncation, which inherently limit their ability to model non-periodic, localized, and fine-scale solution structures. We propose the Stochastic Adaptive Fourier Decomposition Neural Operator (SAFDNO), a spectral neural operator that replaces predefined Fourier modes with an adaptive Takenaka-Malmquist (TM) orthonormal system derived from the theory of Stochastic Adaptive Fourier Decomposition (SAFD). Instead of performing an expensive greedy pole search in classical SAFD, SAFDNO amortizes stochastic pole selection through a neural pole predictor and constructs the adaptive TM system directly from latent features. The resulting operator performs learned filtering on coefficients of analytic branches in the Hardy space with respect to the input-adaptive TM system, preserving the global receptive field of spectral operators while providing a more flexible representation than using fixed spectral bases. Across nine PDE benchmark problems, SAFDNO achieves the best performance on all six regular-grid problems among strong neural operator baselines, with especially notable gains on Darcy, Burgers, and Navier-Stokes, where fixed Fourier modes are often less effective at modeling localized oscillations, sharp transitions, and multiscale structures. SAFDNO also exhibits stronger zero-shot super-resolution performance and shows less performance degradation when deployed on finer discretizations. These results suggest that the input-adaptive TM system provides a promising alternative to fixed spectral representations for neural operator learning.

</details>


### [346] [Optimizer Geometry Sets the Pace: Spectral Learning Dynamics in Matrix Factorization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.04249)
*Mahalakshmi Sabanayagam,Simon Lucey*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文在深度矩阵分解（平衡对齐）设定下，系统推导了GD、SignGD、Muon、累积Shampoo和K-FAC五种优化器的奇异模态出生（birth）、饱和（saturation）和衰减（decay）三阶段幂律规律，揭示了优化器几何与深度共同决定谱学习偏好的机制。核心发现是：快速学习弱模态与快速清除不支持模态可共存于同一优化器中，否定了一种简单的"低秩偏好排序"。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现代基础模型广泛使用Muon、SOAP等谱优化器和K-FAC等曲率方法，在大规模训练中表现出色。然而，GD的隐式偏差分析表明欧氏几何会抑制弱奇异模态的增长从而促进低秩解。谱归一化和曲率修正正是为削弱这种各向异性而设计，由此引出一个核心问题：当这些优化器削弱或消除GD的谱偏好时，深度诱导的低秩偏好究竟是被保留、弱化，还是被替换为全新的模态选择机制？更一般地，何时优化器仅加速共同的学习轨迹，何时又改变了哪些谱成分出现、持续或消失？

Method: 在深度矩阵分解的全观测设定下，于平衡对齐流形上采用三种显式假设（平衡初始化、目标对齐、兼容优化器状态），将多层线性网络的有效矩阵动力学简化为各奇异模态的标量ODE σ̇ = −Lσᵗ·z(σ, S(σ))。由此统一推导各类优化器的相位律（出生/衰减指数α_b, α_d和饱和指数γ），并通过精确的首积分（如累积Shampoo的d(σ) = d₀ + ν(σ)恒等式）消去优化器状态。理论结果在控制性矩阵分解与欠定线性回归实验中通过局部斜率回归验证。

Result: GD保留深度相关的出生障碍（α_b = p，p=2−2/L），弱模态呈多项式延迟，零目标模态仅渐近消失；SignGD与理想Muon均退化为标量符号规则σ̇ = −Lσᵗ sign(σ−μ)，在有限时间内完成出生、衰减与饱和（α_b = α_d = q < 1，γ = 0线性饱和），Muon因谱归一化实现各模态几乎同步的谱时钟；Adam存在由稳定化参数ε控制的GD↔SignGD交叉（ε控制阈值σ_d^A ≍ ε^{1/(q+1)}）；累积Shampoo呈现两阶段行为——初始GD相位（α_b = p）后接历史自适应相位（α_b = p−1，target-independent catch-up），且累积梯度使先前活跃模态更难清除（decay tail指数仍为p+1）；K-FAC的加性阻尼λ_KF定义谱移动阈值σ_KF^b = λ_KF^{1/p}，无阻尼时σ̇ = L(μ−σ)消除分解障碍并保留目标排序，正阻尼则在该阈值以下恢复GD相位律。关键反直觉发现：Muon在加速弱模态出现的同时也在有限时间内消除零目标模态，因此"快速出现弱分量"与"快速清除不支持分量"可共存；累积Shampoo的饱和阶段甚至可能反转GD的模态收敛顺序（β ∝ μ^{−2/L}）。

Conclusion: 优化器几何、累积状态、阻尼与深度不应被视为单纯的数值或加速手段，而是直接决定哪些谱成分何时出现、持续与消失的归纳偏置控制参数。因此不能用单一从强到弱的低秩偏好排序来概括优化器；评估优化器时应同时考虑其加速、抑制或保留的谱成分，而非仅看训练损失。理论框架为理解和测试更快优化器如何改变中间模型的复杂度提供了基础。

Abstract: Recent successes of matrix- and curvature-based optimizers have renewed interest in how update geometry shapes learning. These methods normalize or precondition updates, changing how different components progress during training. In deep matrix factorization, the geometry that slows gradient descent (GD) favors low-rank solutions by delaying the emergence of small singular modes. This raises the question of what remains of that spectral bias when normalization or curvature correction weakens or removes the slowdown. We study how optimizer geometry and depth jointly govern this behavior through a common framework for singular mode dynamics. Under explicit balance and alignment assumptions, we derive birth, saturation, and decay laws for Euclidean GD, coordinate-wise updates of SignGD and an instantaneous Adam approximation, spectral updates of Muon and cumulative Shampoo, and a block curvature model of K-FAC. The resulting picture is not a simple ordering from stronger to weaker low-rank bias. To highlight, SignGD and ideal Muon eliminate the divergent birth barrier and drive unsupported modes to zero in finite time. Cumulative Shampoo initially retains GD's depth-dependent barrier, then accumulated gradients produce a catch-up phase while making previously active modes increasingly persistent. Undamped K-FAC cancels the factorization-induced slowdown while preserving the ordering of the target singular values, whereas positive damping introduces a spectral threshold below which the slow GD phase laws reappear. These results give normalization, accumulated state, damping, and depth a direct interpretation as controls determining when modes emerge, persist, and disappear during training.

</details>


### [347] [A Hand-Checkable Proof That Two Hidden ReLU Layers Compute the Maximum of Six Numbers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.04256)
*Dimitrios Myrisiotis*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文针对六输入最大函数 MAX_6，给出了一个基于六边形结构的显式恒等式及完整的手工可验证解析证明，并由此构造出隐藏层宽度分别为 17 和 41 的零偏置 ReLU 网络。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: ReLU 网络深度下界是深度学习理论的核心问题，最大函数是标准测试用例。此前已知两个隐藏层足以计算最多 12 个输入的最大值，但已有证明均依赖计算机辅助验证。本文旨在为六输入情形提供一个自包含的、可手工验证的解析证明，给出结构性解释。

Method: 利用六边形的旋转与反射对称性，将六个输入坐标置于六边形顶点上。定义了 39 个线性形式（分为三族：距离为二的边差、六对配对、以及对角门），构成恒等式 12·MAX_6 = 2∑μ_i + Σs_k|F_k|。证明方法：首先通过旋转将最大坐标置于顶点 0；然后利用三角形 {v-1, v, v+1} 上的局部关系和三角分情况讨论，证明对角门在各顶点的聚合量相互抵消；最后合并 S_Θ 与聚合量得到所需等式。所有步骤均可手工核验，不需要枚举输入的排列顺序。

Result: 主要结果：（1）证明了六边形恒等式（定理 3.2），给出了 39 个线性形式的精确表达式和分情况验证；（2）构造出架构为 6→17→41→1 的零偏置 ReLU 网络（推论 4.2），所有权重均为 1/6 的整数倍，可计算 MAX_6；（3）通过重复输入，该网络亦可计算 n=1 至 6 的 MAX_n；（4）所得网络具有显式的权重矩阵。

Conclusion: 本文为 MAX_6 的双隐藏层深度界提供了首个手工可验证的解析证明，揭示了六边形局部对称结构在此问题中的核心作用。所得恒等式和网络均为显式构造，权重规整有理数。该方法推广到 n≥7 的情形仍是公开问题，可能需要更高阶多边形结构。

Abstract: Exactly computing the maximum function is a standard test case for studying depth in ReLU networks. Two hidden layers are known to suffice for up to twelve inputs through computer-assisted constructions. For six real inputs, we give an explicit hexagon identity whose local structure yields a self-contained analytical proof of this depth bound. The identity was found by computer-assisted search; we prove it through explicit cancellations that can be checked entirely by hand, without executing a verification program. The identity also yields an explicit network with hidden widths $17$ and $41$, zero biases, and rational weights.

</details>


### [348] [Cross-Trait Transfer in Subliminal Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.04260)
*Xingyu Zhao,Yiqiao Zhong*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究语言模型间的"潜意识学习"（subliminal learning）现象中的跨特质迁移：教师模型的某个特质如何影响学生对其他特质的偏好。作者引入有向特质迁移矩阵，系统分析了聚类结构、相关诊断指标以及训练动态。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 潜意识学习是AI安全的重要问题：训练数据在语义层面无关，但仍可能传递隐藏的行为特质。现有研究仅评估"同特质"传递，忽略了教师特质可能引发学生对相似特质的偏好。本研究旨在揭示跨特质迁移的统计结构，以更全面地理解隐藏偏好的传递机制。

Method: 1. 定义有向特质迁移矩阵 SL(z,z')，量化教师特质 z 下学生答案 z' 的对数概率增益。2. 在5个模型、5类载体、4种训练目标下进行扫描实验。3. 提出6个诊断指标（外部输出分布3个+内部表征3个），评估其与迁移矩阵的相关性。4. 分析训练动态中有效秩与聚类结构的发展。5. 通过多特质实验研究对立/对齐特质对的相互作用。

Result: 1. 特质迁移矩阵显示跨模型、载体、训练目标的一致聚类结构（如颜色按色相分组），组内迁移显著强于组间（Δ>0，霍姆校正p<0.013）。2. 75.3%的教师条件下，竞争对手特质（多为同组内）的增益超过教师特质本身。3. 指标中，提示-特质向量引导（Metric 4）相关性最高（r=0.35-0.81），载体漂移相似性（Metric 1）次之。4. 训练动态呈现从广域共享变化到特质特异性分化的进程，有效秩从1.09增至4.74。6. 多特质实验中，对立特质对产生更大的恢复差距（5.38 vs 3.05 nats），58%的对立对出现一上一下的恢复模式。

Conclusion: 跨特质迁移揭示了潜意识学习中广泛存在的聚类结构，且这种结构可部分由输出分布和表征指标捕获。训练过程中迁移从广域共享逐步分化为特质特异性，对立特质的相互作用促进了分化。该研究提供了关于隐藏偏好如何传递的更全面视角，但也存在若干局限性：仅在同基础模型下研究、指标与传递的关系主要是相关性而非因果、载体空间限制。

Abstract: Subliminal learning is a phenomenon where a student language model acquires a teacher model's behavioral traits by training on semantically unrelated outputs. It is a subtle statistical phenomenon as trait transmission relies on weak statistical patterns in the generated data. To understand trait transmission between teacher-student pairs, we study cross-trait transfer: how data generated under one teacher trait changes the student's preferences of other traits. To this end, we introduce a directed trait-transfer matrix that quantifies these effects using log-probability gains for student answers. We find that the trait-transfer matrix reveals clusters of related traits, with students sometimes developing preferences for traits similar, but not identical, to the teacher's trait. Such cross-trait structure can be partially captured by output distribution metrics and representation-based metrics. Further, we analyze trait development and interaction: learning dynamics shows a progression from broad shared shifts toward more trait-specific transfer, and multi-trait experiments suggest that opposed traits can enhance such differentiation. Together, our findings reveal salient statistical structures over trait transfer and competition, thus providing a broader view of how hidden preferences are transmitted in subliminal learning.

</details>


### [349] [Adaptive Bregman Alternating Projections for Feasible Gromov-Wasserstein Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.04264)
*Aoran Zhang,César A. Uribe*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出Adaptive KL-BAPG（A-KL-BAPG）算法，通过有限固定惩罚预热阶段与受保护的递增惩罚阶段相结合，利用Sinkhorn启发的射影直径保护机制，消除固定惩罚Bregman交替投影梯度（BAPG）求解Gromov-Wasserstein（GW）问题时持续存在的可行性间隙。理论上证明了该算法在每次迭代中回溯有限终止、可行性间隙渐近消失、加权平方修正残差的最佳迭代O(1/log N)界，并在支撑正则性条件下保证了原GW问题平稳累积点的存在性。实验上在合成与真实图对齐、异构域自适应任务中验证了方法在精度、目标值、可行性和平稳性上的均衡优势。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Gromov-Wasserstein（GW）问题是非凸二次规划且含耦合边际约束，现有固定惩罚BAPG方法速度快但存在持续的O(1/ρ)可行性间隙，单纯增大惩罚会导致步长过快收缩或产生病态缩放。因此需要一种能同时控制惩罚增长、累积步长进展和射影几何的算法，以在保持BAPG计算效率的同时实现严格可行性并收敛到原问题平稳点。

Method: 方法采用两阶段策略：第一阶段为有限长度的固定惩罚ρ₀预热，执行标准KL-BAPG的交替行/列归一化更新；第二阶段进入受保护的递增惩罚尾部，每步提出延时幂次步长ᾱₜ=α₀((k₀+1)/(t+k₀+1))^β，通过回溯缩减步长直至满足射影直径保护条件Δ(w̃)≤Δ₀+a·log(t+2)。该保护基于Hilbert射影度量与Sinkhorn缩放收缩理论，保证每次迭代回溯有限终止，且累积KL非对称误差绝对可和。

Result: 理论结果证明：尾部迭代满足lim inf‖Rₜ‖_{Mₜ}=0且边际可行性间隙渐近消失；加权平方修正残差最佳迭代满足O(1/log N)界；在支撑非退化假设下，存在原GW问题的平稳累积点。实验上：合成图对齐中A-KL-BAPG匹配KL-BAPG精度（0.966）同时将可行性间隙降低99%、平稳性残差降低98%；真实图对齐（ENZYMES、PROTEINS）精度相当，可行性间隙降低62%、平稳性残差降低27-28%；HAR70+域自适应任务精度匹配KL-BAPG，可行性间隙降低99%、平稳性残差降低85%。

Conclusion: A-KL-BAPG成功消除了固定惩罚BAPG的持续可行性间隙，同时保留了其低廉的交替更新和GPU友好的矩阵缩放结构。理论保证首次为原始GW问题（而非松弛问题）提供了平稳性结论。实验证明该方法在图对齐和异构域自适应中实现了精度、目标值、可行性和平稳性的最佳平衡。未来工作包括将子序列收敛加强为全序列收敛、弱化支撑正则性条件以及降低保护机制的计算成本。

Abstract: The Gromov-Wasserstein (GW) problem compares structured distributions without requiring a shared feature space or known correspondences, but its nonconvex objective and coupled marginal constraints make computation challenging. Bregman alternating projected gradient (BAPG) uses inexpensive alternating row and column updates, yet its fixed-penalty relaxation leaves a persistent feasibility gap. We propose Adaptive KL-BAPG (A-KL-BAPG), which combines a finite fixed-penalty burn-in with a guarded increasing-penalty phase. At each tail iteration, the method reuses BAPG's alternating updates and backtracks a delayed-power step until a Sinkhorn-inspired projective-diameter safeguard is satisfied. We prove finite termination of the backtracking at each iteration and show that the feasibility gap vanishes asymptotically. We further establish a best-iterate $O(1/\log N)$ bound for the weighted squared corrected residual and, under a support regularity condition, the existence of a stationary accumulation point for the original GW problem. This distinguishes A-KL-BAPG from fixed-penalty BAPG, whose stationarity guarantees are given for the relaxed problem. Experiments show that A-KL-BAPG achieves a favorable balance of accuracy, objective value, feasibility, and stationarity relative to BAPG variants, projection-based methods, and task-specific baselines. For synthetic and real graph alignment problems, it closely matches the accuracy and objective value of fixed-penalty KL-BAPG while reducing the marginal feasibility gap by 62-99% and the projected stationarity residual by 28-98%. Heterogeneous domain adaptation experiments show a similar pattern: A-KL-BAPG maintains comparable target accuracy and objective values while achieving better feasibility and stationarity than fixed-penalty KL-BAPG.

</details>


### [350] [Self-Reflection Fine-Tuning: Enhancing Agent Security against Prompt Injection Attacks from Failure Experience](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.04269)
*Zixuan Wang,Hao Li,Fengyu Gao,G. Edward Suh,Yi Zeng,Yevgeniy Vorobeychik,Ning Zhang,Chaowei Xiao*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出Self-Reflection Fine-Tuning (SRFT)框架，通过让LLM智能体从自身在对抗环境下的失败经验中学习(而非被动模仿专家行为)来增强对提示注入攻击的鲁棒性。核心方法是在被注入攻击污染的轨迹上采样智能体的失败动作，由专家模型生成结构化的三段式自反思推理(目标总结、注入识别、安全动作分析)，再通过监督微调让智能体内化这种反思能力。基于Llama-3.1-8B和Qwen3-8B的SR-Agent在AgentDojo上将ASR从7.59%降至1.26%，并在RL-Hammer自适应攻击下显著优于Meta-SecAlign等SOTA方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有针对提示注入的模型层防御方法(如StruQ、SecAlign、Meta-SecAlign)主要依赖静态专家数据集，通过模仿专家行为或偏好优化进行训练，本质上是被动的模式匹配与抑制。这种范式存在根本局限：智能体仅暴露于有限的预定义攻击模式，缺乏从自身失败中学习和发现新攻击模式的能力，因此难以泛化到多样化、自适应的攻击策略。强化学习虽能解决此问题，但在长时序智能体任务中训练成本过高。本文旨在设计一种能让智能体从自身失败经验中反思学习、并对未见过的自适应攻击具备鲁棒性的训练框架。

Method: SRFT框架包含四个阶段：(1) 注入数据合成——使用专家LLM(Claude Sonnet 4.6)针对可用工具集生成可执行的恶意注入任务，利用750个触发模板(20个来自StruQ，730个来自TaskTracker)以0.5概率随机插入到干净专家轨迹的工具观察中，构造受攻击轨迹(共3698条轨迹、22339步，覆盖TOUCAN的5个平台)；(2) 原始动作采样——让目标智能体在被攻击上下文中采样N个候选动作，收集包含不安全行为的失败案例；(3) 失败模式自反思——由专家LLM基于对话历史、注入真值、专家动作和采样候选动作生成三段式反思推理(上下文与原始目标总结、提示注入识别与恶意意图分析、最优动作与不安全候选的反事实对比及后果分析)；(4) 监督微调——使用LoRA(rank=64, α=96, 约55M参数)在Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct和Qwen3-8B/4B上以学习率5e-6、3 epoch联合优化反思链C_i和最优动作a_i，损失函数分解为反思生成项和动作生成项。

Result: 在AgentDojo上，SR-Agent-Llama将总体ASR从7.59%降至1.26%，同时良性效用从27.84%提升至37.11%，效用-安全权衡得分从115.49提升至127.82，优于Meta-SecAlign-8B(118.12)；在Qwen3-8B上ASR从16.97%降至1.05%，Qwen3-4B上ASR从10.85%降至0.84，验证了跨模型家族的泛化性。在MMLU、MMLU-Pro、IFEval、BBH四项通用基准上SR-Agent保持了与基模型相当的能力，未以通用能力换取安全性。在RL-Hammer自适应攻击下，SR-Agent-Qwen3-8B的最终ASR仅17.0%(峰值21.5%)，而未防御基线为59.5%，Meta-SecAlign高达69.5%。在AgentDyn动态环境(含合法第三方指令的开放任务)中SR-Agent在良性效用(10.00 vs 5.00)和ASR(1.96% vs 5.54%)上均优于Meta-SecAlign。训练时消融实验表明，去除失败经验分析组件使ASR从17.0%飙升至65.0%，去除整个反思推理使ASR达60.0%，证明失败感知的反思监督是关键信号；测试时消融显示关闭推理模式使ASR从1.05%升至14.33%，表明显式推理在推理阶段同样关键。推理开销分析显示SR-Agent的思维token均值(369.94)甚至低于基线Qwen3-8B(451.70)。

Conclusion: SRFT将提示注入防御从被动的专家模仿转变为基于失败经验的经验驱动学习范式，通过结构化自反思推理使智能体能够识别恶意指令、推理其后果并保持与原始用户目标的对齐。该方法在静态和自适应攻击下均显著优于现有SOTA防御，且不牺牲通用能力和任务效用，为构建鲁棒且可部署的LLM智能体安全防御提供了实用路径。未来工作可将此范式扩展到计算机使用智能体和网页智能体等更广泛的环境中。

Abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents are increasingly deployed in tool-augmented environments, but their reliance on external inputs makes them highly vulnerable to prompt injection attacks that can hijack task objectives. Existing safety alignment methods rely on static expert trajectories or preference optimization, limiting their ability to generalize to adaptive attack patterns. In this work, we propose Self-Reflection Fine-Tuning (SRFT), a training framework that enables agents to improve robustness by learning from their own failure experiences under adversarial conditions. Instead of passively imitating expert behaviors, SRFT exposes the agent to compromised trajectories constructed via injected attacks, and leverages an expert model to generate structured self-reflection reasoning that contrasts unsafe and optimal actions. This reflective supervision teaches the agent to identify malicious instructions, reason about their consequences, and maintain alignment with the original user intent. We instantiate this framework in SR-Agent, built on Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct and Qwen3-8B, and evaluate it on both static and adaptive prompt injection benchmarks. Experimental results show that SRFT substantially reduces attack success rates while preserving task performance, and demonstrates strong generalization under adaptive attacks. These findings suggest that learning from failure via self-reflection is a promising direction for building robust and secure LLM agents. Our code is released at this https URL .

</details>


### [351] [Integrated Imputation-Classification for Supervised Learning with Missing Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.04273)
*Yue Liu,Ben Liang,Ali Tizghadam,Ilijc Albanese*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出IICN框架，通过将插补器与(n+1)类判别器进行对抗联合训练，在MCAR假设下理论证明其全局最优实现贝叶斯最优分类，并在多类数据集上验证优越性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统"先插补后分类"管线存在根本缺陷：插补目标与下游分类目标不对齐，高质量的插补未必带来分类性能提升，且无法表征决策规则的最优性。需要一种端到端方法直接优化预测目标。

Method: 提出集成插补与分类网络（IICN）：生成器G基于观测值和潜在编码填补缺失特征，(n+1)类判别器D在前n个真实类别基础上增加一个"插补"类，构成极小极大对抗目标。设计两阶段交替训练策略防止判别器退化为平凡插补检测器。

Result: 在FashionMNIST、CIFAR-10和具有自然缺失的UCI表格数据上的实验表明，IICN在严重缺失率下显著优于经典管线及生成式基线（GAIN、SupMIWAE、LAC），决策边界最接近贝叶斯最优。

Conclusion: IICN通过类感知对抗公式统一了缺失数据下的插补与分类，理论保证其在MCAR假设下精确实现边际化并收敛至贝叶斯最优分类器，为预测对齐的缺失数据学习提供了likelihood-free的解决方案。

Abstract: We study supervised classification problems with missing feature values. Existing approaches often decouple imputation from classification, producing imputations that may be plausible but uninformative for prediction. Instead, we propose the Integrated Imputation and Classification Network (IICN), which jointly trains an imputer and an ${(n{+}1)}$-classdiscriminator adversarially with a single class supervised classification objective, where the discriminator learns to distinguish among the $n$ true classes and an additional ``imputed" class. We prove that at the global optimum, the imputer and discriminator together implement marginalization over missing coordinates and yield a Bayes-optimal classifier. We evaluate IICN on FashionMNIST, CIFAR-10, and tabular datasets with naturally occurring missingness. IICN outperforms classical impute-then-classify pipelines and recent generative baselines, showing strong robustness and accuracy in challenging settings.

</details>


### [352] [Do RUL explanations hold up? Faithfulness and stability of attributions on C-MAPSS](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.04278)
*Manh Hien Nguyen,Ngoc Thanh Nguyen,Isabella Mendoza Cortes,Tam Khuat,Thanh Pham,Nhat Quang Tran,Ushik Shrestha Khwakhali,Loan Do*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文针对NASA C-MAPSS数据集上深度RUL（剩余使用寿命）预测模型的归因图（热力图）解释可靠性进行系统评估，提出在向维护工程师交付解释时，应优先使用遮挡法或集成梯度法，并配合删除曲线作为诊断依据，而不宜将Transformer注意力权重当作传感器级诊断工具。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前C-MAPSS上的深度RUL模型普遍附带归因热力图作为可解释性输出，但XAI-for-PdM（预测性维护中的可解释AI）文献中对归因图的忠实性（faithfulness）和稳定性（stability）评估仍不充分。一个视觉上"看起来合理"的热力图，并不等于工程师可据此采取维护行动的可信解释。论文的动机是填补这一评估缺口。

Method: 1. 在官方FD001/FD003划分上训练三种标准架构（1D CNN、LSTM、小型Transformer编码器），使用125周期分段RUL上限和PHM08非对称评分，并在FD002/FD004六工况子集上对LSTM做补充检验。
2. 附加三种归因方法：Integrated Gradients（IG）、3×1时间-传感器块遮挡法（occlusion）、Transformer最后一层自注意力。
3. 设计四维可靠性评估：删除/插入忠实性测试、σ=0.05输入噪声下的Spearman秩稳定性、不同训练种子间的归因一致性、RUL分箱内的余弦一致性。
4. 另以AI4I 2020表格数据集的XGBoost特征重要性作为二级验证。

Result: 1. 预测精度：LSTM在两个子集上最可靠（FD001 RMSE=15.54、FD003 RMSE=13.67），Transformer接近，CNN较弱。
2. 忠实性：在FD001上删除20%顶部归因单元时，IG使RUL变化约35.79周期，遮挡约35.26周期，Transformer注意力仅12.61周期；IG与遮挡在LSTM上忠实性相当。
3. 稳定性：三种方法在5%输入噪声下Spearman ρ均≈0.98，看似稳定。
4. 种子一致性：IG的跨种子Spearman ρ=0.634，遮挡ρ=0.559，仅中等程度一致——表明抗传感器抖动稳定性≠抗重训练稳定性。
5. FD002/FD004上遮挡删除效果仍优于IG（FD002: 60.8 vs 41.5；FD004: 51.6 vs 35.1），忠实性排名未反转。
6. AI4I数据集上XGBoost特征重要性呈现相同的删除模式。

Conclusion: 对于面向维护工程师的C-MAPSS类RUL报告，建议优先采用遮挡法或集成梯度法，并应同时公开删除曲线作为诊断证据；Transformer原始注意力权重仅可作为时间分布可视化，不应用于指认具体传感器。预测精度仅是前提条件，归因可靠性表才是核心结论。该研究不构成机翼部署认证依据。

Abstract: Deep remaining-useful-life (RUL) models on NASA C-MAPSS are now routine, and so are heatmaps that colour sensors and timesteps. A heatmap that looks mechanical is not the same as an explanation an engineer can act on. We train three standard architectures - a 1D CNN, an LSTM, and a small Transformer encoder - on the official FD001 and FD003 splits with the piecewise RUL cap of 125 cycles and the official PHM08 asymmetric score. We then attach three attribution maps (Integrated Gradients, occlusion, last-layer attention) and evaluate them with the checks the XAI-for-PdM literature still under-reports: deletion/insertion faithfulness, Spearman stability under sensor-scale noise, agreement across training seeds, and cosine consistency inside RUL bins. Prediction error is a prerequisite, not the claim. The headline is which explanation method moves the RUL output when its top cells are removed, and which map survives a 5% input perturbation. Integrated Gradients and occlusion are similarly faithful on the LSTM; Transformer attention is cheap and temporally smooth but weakly faithful. All three maps are almost unchanged under 5% input noise, yet IG/occlusion agree only moderately across two LSTM seeds - stability to sensor jitter is not the same as stability to retraining. A secondary tabular check on the AI4I 2020 failure dataset shows the same deletion pattern for tree importances. We recommend occlusion or IG for any C-MAPSS-style report that will be read by a maintenance engineer, and we treat raw attention weights as a visualisation only.

</details>


### [353] [Modeling Deletion Requests in Machine Unlearning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.04310)
*Christian Cianfarani,Aloni Cohen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究机器遗忘中用户的删除请求行为如何影响模型性能，定义了"适应性"和"集体性"两类请求者行为，并基于随机优化理论证明不同行为请求者之间存在理论性能差距，最后利用数据估值方法设计有效的删除请求者并在计算机视觉任务上进行实验验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的机器遗忘研究大多假设删除请求是均匀随机采样的，但实际上用户的删除请求受到个人意愿、特征、社交圈和数据本身的影响并非随机。作者希望理解不同类型的请求者行为如何影响遗忘后模型的性能表现。

Method: 1. 定义两种请求者属性：适应性（能否根据先前模型更新做出决策）和集体性（能否协调行动）；2. 构建一个简化的学习设置，将最优删除请求者问题归约为（相关随机）背包问题；3. 理论证明集体与个体、自适应与非自适应请求者之间的性能差距；4. 基于Shapley值设计请求者（及其自适应/个体变体），并与基于损失、基于成员推断攻击（MIA）的请求者及随机基线进行比较；5. 在CIFAR-10数据集上使用ResNet18进行实验，比较Retrain、Relabel和SCRUB三种遗忘算法下的表现。

Result: 1. 集体请求者与非集体请求者之间存在至少1.5倍的集体性差距；2. 个体请求者中自适应与非自适应之间存在约1.064倍的适应性差距；3. 集体请求者的适应性差距为1；4. 实验中，Shapley请求者优于随机请求者（测试准确率从约88%降至81.6%），自适应Shapley请求者表现最强（降至62.7%）；5. 个体Shapley请求者甚至劣于随机请求者，归因于高方差估计；6. 不同遗忘算法下请求者效果差异显著：SCRUB对自适应请求具有较强抵抗力，而Retrain和Relabel则受影响较大。

Conclusion: 用户删除请求的适应性（能否响应模型更新）和集体性（能否协调行动）显著影响机器遗忘后模型的性能。集体性带来的性能差距大于适应性，且通过数据估值技术（如Shapley值）可以设计出显著优于随机请求的有效删除请求者。然而，遗忘算法的选择会调节这些效应——某些近似遗忘算法（如SCRUB）对自适应请求具有更强的抵抗能力。删除请求可被视为一种"数据罢工"行为，理解最坏情况下的请求者有助于设定机器遗忘方法的实际限制。

Abstract: Machine unlearning is seen as a promising approach to enable users to exercise the "right to erasure" in the context of AI models. We ask how users might influence the behavior of models when exercising this right. We define two types of behaviors that users might adopt when requesting the deletion of their data: adaptivity and collectivity. Drawing connections between the goals of users in this context and results in stochastic optimization, we demonstrate theoretical gaps between the potential effects of groups of users who do and do not display these behaviors. We then show how techniques from data valuation might be used to design deletion requesters that can significantly alter model behavior in realistic settings. In experiments on computer vision tasks, we demonstrate the differential effects of different models of user behavior and attempt to isolate the impacts of adaptivity and collectivity.

</details>


### [354] [LyapuFlow: Controlling Generative Flows with Lyapunov Feedback for Inverse Problems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.04326)
*Minseon Gwak,Hans Hao-Hsun Hsu,Danielle C. Maddix,N. Benjamin Erichson*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: LyapuFlow 是一种基于 Lyapunov 反馈控制的测试时约束生成方法，用于在预训练流模型采样过程中施加硬约束。它在每个采样步预测终端样本并评估约束违反，通过最小范数控制满足 Lyapunov 下降条件，并借助反馈信赖域防止控制过度干预。该方法在数据空间（PDE 物理约束）和潜在空间（图像逆问题）均取得领先效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 预训练流模型常用于科学和视觉任务的生成任务。然而，现有测试时约束施加方法（投影、后验采样、轨迹迭代优化）各有局限：投影会过度牺牲保真度，后验引导对引导尺度敏感，轨迹优化计算昂贵。本文寻求一种统一、自适应且保持生成先验保真度的控制机制。
