We compare each skill-conditioned attempt with the solo attempt on the same variant under matched per-attempt budgets, scoring correctness and end-to-end runtime. Across six models and both directions, paired lift over solo attempts ranges from -19% to +29%. Four models gain in both directions, yet regressions occur on 16% to 45% of problems in every model and direction. Outcomes follow the source attempt's result relative to the target's solo attempt rather than source success alone, improving in 71% of comparisons when the source stands above and regressing in 54% when it stands below. MetaKernelBench complements implementation-quality metrics by measuring same-problem cross-DSL kernel knowledge transfer.

</details>


### [411] [Calibrated Weak Supervision for Post-Harvest Burned-Cropland Mapping Under Label Scarcity](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05040)
*Raunak Bhagate,Maitri Polisetty,R I Minu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文针对印度旁遮普邦秸秆焚烧后的精细分辨率过火农田制图难题，提出了一种校准化的弱监督框架。研究通过Sentinel-2光谱变化、VIIRS火点上下文生成三类严格度递增的伪标签，结合五类特征集与多种分类器，在区域保持交叉验证下系统评估模型表现，并利用MODIS MCD64A1进行外部阈值校准。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 农业秸秆焚烧过火面积小且破碎、可靠人工标签稀缺，而粗分辨率MODIS产品难以刻画细小火点；现有弱监督方法存在伪标签噪声大、循环性使用烧伤指数、空间泄漏导致泛化高估等问题，需要一种可校准、可区域外推的精细制图框架。

Method: 采用Sentinel-2两期合成（前期9-10月，后期10-11月）作为主光学输入，结合VIIRS活跃火点上下文构建弱正/弱负样本，设计三种严格度递增的伪标签配方（moderate/strict/very-strict）；排除NBR/dNBR作为分类器输入以避免循环性；评估线性、树模型、Boosting与神经网络共七类分类器；以区域保持5折嵌套交叉验证（3种子）评估内部性能；用MODIS MCD64A1进行区域级外部阈值校准，并测试向Haryana零样本迁移、跨年稳定性（2023 vs 2024）及Sentinel-1融合。

Result: 最严格伪标签+MLP+全光学特征集为名义最优（mean κ=0.395，AUC=0.753），但与RF/XGBoost/LightGBM无显著差异；内部验证阈值0.30不适用于全区部署，经外部校准后阈值取0.60：区域R²=0.636，过火面积比1.005，与火点数Spearman ρ=0.779，但像素级MODIS一致性较低（F1=0.205）；Haryana零样本迁移表现良好（mean κ=0.641）；跨年稳定性差（2023 κ=0.662 vs 2024 κ=0.393）；Sentinel-1简单拼接未带来增益。

Conclusion: 该框架支持区域尺度焚烧负担评估与热点筛查，但不适合精确田块边界提取或时间稳定的年度制图。核心方法论启示在于：伪标签配方设计、空间诚实评估与部署阈值校准必须作为统一证据链而非独立后处理步骤；标签正确性需以独立人工参考加以验证后才能进一步推断。

Abstract: Mapping post-harvest burned cropland is difficult when fires are small and fragmented and reliable labels are scarce. We developed a calibrated weak-supervision framework for Punjab, India, using Sentinel-2 spectral change, VIIRS active-fire context, and MODIS MCD64A1 as a coarse external calibration and agreement reference. Three pseudo-label recipes, five feature representations, and linear, tree-based, boosted, and neural classifiers were evaluated using nested district-held-out cross-validation over three seeds and five folds. NBR and dNBR were excluded from classifier inputs. The best configuration used the very-strict recipe, a multilayer perceptron, and the full optical feature set (mean Cohen's kappa 0.395, AUROC 0.753, F1 0.747, balanced accuracy 0.703); Random Forest, XGBoost, and LightGBM were practically tied. Higher agreement with held-out pseudo-labels did not establish improved label correctness or independent burned-area accuracy. For deployment, a Random Forest with the very-strict recipe and full optical features was retained. An externally calibrated threshold of 0.60 yielded district-level MODIS agreement of R-squared 0.636, a mapped-to-MODIS burned-area ratio of 1.005, and Spearman correlation of 0.779 with district fire counts. Pixel-level MODIS agreement remained modest (F1 0.205, kappa 0.093). Zero-shot transfer to Haryana was promising (mean kappa 0.641), but Punjab cross-year stability was weak, and Sentinel-1/Sentinel-2 feature concatenation did not improve the optical baseline. Optical observations ended before the seasonal fire context, limiting coverage of late burns. The framework supports district-scale burden assessment and hotspot screening, with limited support for exact scar boundaries or temporally stable annual mapping.

</details>


### [412] [Revealing After Overwriting: An Exponential POMDP OPE Lower Bound under History-Dependent Logging](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05063)
*Youyu Luo,Pengzhan Zhou,Zhida Qin,Jia Wang,Zuotao Fu,Yu Liu,Chao Chen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文针对POMDP离策略评估(OPE)中一个长期悬而未决的开放性问题给出了否定回答：当日志策略具有历史依赖性时，即使在精确可实现性、有界动作重叠、有界历史覆盖和有界观测揭示条件下，多步揭示仍无法保证多项式样本复杂度。作者为此构造了一族POMDP下界(所需轨迹数Ω(4^{H-1}))，同时提出了两种恢复策略：(1)使用在每个历史下都成立的低成本公共值表示；(2)在重置前进行预算受控的读出与重置后校准相结合的方案可使样本复杂度独立于H。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Zhang & Jiang (2025)按行为策略记忆性与揭示方式组织POMDP OPE表格,其模型理论覆盖了无记忆日志情形,但对"历史依赖行为策略+多步揭示"组合留下了开放性,认为可能是难解的。本论文旨在回答这一开放问题,刻画该情形下样本复杂度的根本障碍,并给出可行的恢复路径。

Method: 核心方法包括:(1)构造"覆盖-揭示失配"反例——一个4动作、每层至多4状态的POMDP族,两个候选模型仅在第1步"保留"动作转移上不同,采用有公共记忆的已知记录器,目标保持物理位直至决策奖励。(2)测试归约法:利用行为律之间的KL散度Θ(4^{-(H-1)})与目标值差1/2,通过Pinsker不等式与Le Cam方法建立Ω(4^{H-1})样本下界。(3)理论结果:在另一公共已知观测操作特征构造(Proposition 1)中保留相同指数屏障;针对有限模型类给出基于公共值表示与二阶矩成本的多项式保证(Theorem 2);针对固定4动作连续族推导出预算-噪声权衡与被动率(Theorem 5),证明重置后校准可使样本复杂度独立于H。

Result: 主要结果包括:(1)Theorem 1:对于每个H≥3,精确可实现的两个POMDP具有4动作、每层至多4状态、已知历史依赖记录器、无记忆目标;动作重叠、历史覆盖、观测揭示均一致有界,行为律KL散度Θ(4^{-(H-1})),目标值差1/2,迫使Ω(4^{H-1})轨迹的下界。(2)Corollary 1:精确可实现性加上Zhang-Jiang假设A、C、D不能保证关于H、log|M|、ε^{-1、C_H、C_F的多项式样本界。(3)Proposition 1:共同的已知观测操作特征构造保留相同指数屏障。(4)Theorem 2:在动作与历史覆盖下,基于在每个历史都有效的低成本公共可观测值表示给出有限类OPE保证;样本界依赖其二阶矩成本多项式。(5)Theorem 3:固定四动作连续族的最小最大样本复杂度为Θ(4^{H-1}ε^{-2})。(6)Theorem 4:带已知通道预算受控读出恢复定理;最小最大轨迹复杂度为Θ(1/(I_*(b)ε^2))。(7)Theorem 5:未知传感器偏差下目标证据与校准定理;最小最大复杂度为Θ(1/(ε^2[q_H+uv/(u+v)]));当两个读出类型每轨迹都有固定正期望预算时,样本复杂度独立于H。

Conclusion: 历史依赖的日志可以解码状态但擦除存储层所保留的目标证据,这一不匹配即使在共同的已知观测揭示操作特征下也存在。在覆盖条件下,在每个历史有效的低成本公共值表示对OPE是充分的;困难对的价值方向产生了恒定的边际解码成本但指数级的历史条件成本。在固定的四动作连续族上,使用固定已知通道和单位成本的早期读取规则可以模拟任何延迟读取规则而不产生其他成本。当传感器存在未知偏差时,仅有早期读取仍需指数成本;为两种读取类型每轨迹分配固定正期望预算可将样本复杂度从与H有关变为与H无关。不包含原始位的数据因此可使早期测量对目标评估有用。

Abstract: Multi-step revealing can make off-policy evaluation tractable under memoryless logging. With history-dependent logging, state decodability and target-relevant evidence can separate. For every horizon $H\ge3$, we construct two exactly realizable POMDPs with four actions, at most four states per layer, a known logger, and a memoryless target. Action overlap, history coverage, and observation-only revealing remain bounded independently of $H$, yet the target values differ by $1/2$ and the KL divergence between the logged laws is $\Theta(4^{-(H-1)})$, forcing exponential sample complexity. Logger memory makes states distinguishable, while reset erases the model-distinguishing evidence preserved by the target. A separate construction retains this barrier with common, known observation-only revealing operators. Under action and history coverage, we give a finite-class OPE guarantee using common observable value representations that remain valid at every history. The sample bound depends polynomially on their second-moment cost. In the common-operator construction, the same value direction has constant marginal decoding cost but exponential history-conditioned cost. Finally, on a fixed four-action continuum, we derive matching passive and budgeted readout rates. With one known channel and unit read cost, early reads are optimal. With unknown sensor bias, early reads alone remain exponentially costly. Combining them with post-reset calibration gives sample complexity independent of $H$ when both read types receive fixed positive expected budgets per trajectory.

</details>


### [413] [Outcome-Guided On-Policy Self-Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05070)
*ZheXu Wang,Mao-Lin Luo,Yankun Hong,Zi-Hao Zhou,Bo Ye,Jian Zhao,Xialiang Tong,Min-Ling Zhang,Tong Wei*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出OG-OPSD方法，利用二元结果奖励动态选择KL散度（正确轨迹用FKL，错误轨迹用RKL），并通过累积平均教师熵估计前缀截断点，在多个模型和任务上稳定优于OPSD及其改进方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: On-policy自蒸馏(OPSD)提供比RLVR更密集的token级监督，但固定的散度目标在结果正确/错误轨迹上施加不恰当的奖励/惩罚，且教师在长前缀上的可靠性下降，导致训练不稳定和性能下降。

Method: 1) 将FKL与RKL的梯度表示为隐式token级优势，分析其不对称加权特性；2) 根据验证器二元结果R(y)选择散度：正确轨迹用FKL（强化教师偏好token且惩罚有界），错误轨迹用RKL（强抑制学生高估token）；3) 通过累积平均教师熵在正确/错误两组曲线间的最后交叉点估计截断点N_t，仅对错误轨迹在N_t前缀范围内蒸馏。

Result: 在Qwen3-1.7B/4B/8B数学推理任务上，OG-OPSD在AIME24/25和HMMT25上均取得最优，平均准确率分别比vanilla OPSD提升2.1/2.3/2.7点；多模态Qwen3-VL-2B在FinMME及3个OOD基准上同时提升；代码能力（LCB v5）退化幅度最小。消融实验证实FKL+RKL的outcome-guided配对和仅对错误轨迹截断均有独立贡献，N_t=100处性能峰值且对扰动稳健。

Conclusion: 粗粒度但可靠的二元结果信号可以有效指导细粒度自蒸馏监督的使用：结果引导的散度选择与基于教师熵的前缀截断相结合，使OPSD在数学、多模态推理和OOD任务上获得一致提升，并随模型规模增大而扩大优势。

Abstract: On-policy self-distillation (OPSD) provides denser token-level supervision and better computational efficiency than Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR). However, this denser supervision may introduce substantial noise and training instability. Existing improvements often rely on high-variance per-token statistics and introduce extra hyperparameters and trade-offs. Based on the advantage formulation in RLVR, we analyze the OPSD objective from the same perspective, incorporating outcome correctness signals. We find that vanilla OPSD imposes insufficient penalties and excessive rewards on incorrect trajectories because it applies a fixed divergence objective regardless of outcome correctness. Furthermore, the reliability of teacher supervision is associated with both trajectory outcome and the cumulative average teacher entropy along the rollout. Based on these observations, we propose Outcome-Guided On-Policy Self-Distillation (OG-OPSD), which dynamically adapts both the divergence objective and distillation position according to binary outcome rewards and the cumulative average teacher entropy. Extensive experiments show that OG-OPSD consistently improves the performance of vanilla OPSD and multiple strong baselines in mathematical reasoning, multimodal reasoning, and out-of-distribution tasks across Qwen3 models at 1.7B, 4B, and 8B scales, as well as Qwen3-VL-2B.

</details>


### [414] [ReDiffNet: Differential RGB-Infrared Learning for Low-Light UAV Oriented Vehicle Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05074)
*Qifan Zhang,Ziran Zhou,Ruijie Li,Jincheng Tang,Hao Wang,Qihao Qiao,Chunliu Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: ReDiffNet是一种面向低光照无人机RGB-红外定向小车辆检测的可靠性条件差分表征网络，通过信任-恢复-重建流程实现自适应多模态融合，在DroneVehicle和VEDAI数据集上取得了最优性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 低光照无人机场景下的RGB-红外车辆检测面临光照变化、头灯眩光、局部阴影和热响应退化等导致的模态可靠性空间不均问题，且小目标的弱边界、弱朝向线索和弱热响应进一步增加了检测难度。现有方法主要关注特征对齐、注意力交互或固定融合策略，缺乏对局部模态可靠性进行显式建模的机制，难以有效处理模态偏好模糊区域中的互补信息挖掘。

Method: 提出ReDiffNet网络，包含三个顺序耦合的核心模块：(1) 退化感知可靠性学习(DARL)：通过模态特定投影和Softmax归一化推断每个空间位置的相对模态可靠性分布；(2) 不确定性引导差分恢复(UGDR)：利用可靠性响应相似度构建可靠性模糊性线索，融合RGB局部细节残差和多尺度跨模态差分互补信息；(3) 可靠性条件重建(RCR)：通过可靠性加权路由和门控残差更新将保留的可信证据和恢复的差分线索整合为统一表征。训练采用定向检测损失与辅助可靠性监督损失的联合优化。

Result: 在DroneVehicle数据集上达到85.3% mAP50，超过最优对比方法4.4个百分点；在VEDAI数据集上达到73.9% mAP50。同时模型仅含10.53M参数(约为CoDAF的15.6%)，推理速度达106.9 FPS。消融实验验证了DARL、UGDR和RCR三个模块的互补贡献，以及辅助可靠性监督的有效性(带来2.20点提升)。在合成模态退化实验中，最强退化设置下性能仅下降约2.4个百分点，局部扰动下性能几乎保持不变。

Conclusion: ReDiffNet通过信任-恢复-重建的可靠性条件差分表征框架，有效解决了低光照RGB-红外融合中的空间模态可靠性不均问题，在两个公开基准上验证了其有效性和效率优势。模块化设计清晰，模型紧凑且推理速度快。未来工作将探索该框架在更广泛多模态感知任务中的扩展应用。

Abstract: Low-light UAV-based RGB-infrared oriented small-vehicle detection is important for nighttime traffic monitoring, emergency response, and urban inspection. Illumination variations, headlight glare, local shadows, and thermal-response degradation cause spatially varying modality reliability, while the small visual extent of vehicles further weakens boundaries, orientation cues, and thermal responses. Accordingly, selecting trustworthy observations based on local modality reliability while further exploiting complementary discriminative information in regions with ambiguous modality preference is key to constructing effective multimodal representations. Based on this insight, we propose ReDiffNet, a reliability-conditioned differential representation network in which modality reliability guides both evidence selection and complementary recovery. Specifically, degradation-aware reliability learning estimates relative spatial reliability, uncertainty-guided differential recovery exploits cross-modal differences to recover complementary cues in ambiguous regions, and reliability-conditioned reconstruction integrates retained and recovered evidence into a unified representation. ReDiffNet achieves 85.3% and 73.9% mAP50 on DroneVehicle and VEDAI, respectively, supporting its effectiveness.

</details>


### [415] [How Execution Assumptions Change Short-Horizon Sharpe Rankings: Evidence from a Synthetic Trading Benchmark](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05077)
*Weicheng Xue*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究了回测中执行假设（如延迟、参与上限、点差、市场冲击）的变化是否会改变LLM交易代理与经典策略的相对排名。通过在合成价格路径上进行2,462次配对运行，发现在高波动、两资产的压缩环境下，近理想执行(E0)与默认压力执行(E1)的Kendall τ_b仅0.21（平静期0.82），种子bootstrap区间宽且不分离，说明排名变化部分来自12步Sharpe估计的噪声而非真正能力差异。论文强调执行假设应作为基准规范的一部分与回报一同报告。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM交易代理回测普遍假设订单以收盘价完全成交，忽视微观结构摩擦。若执行成本对各策略的影响近似相同，则该选择无害——但由于策略换手率差异和成本非线性，执行假设本身可能改变排名顺序。本文质疑这种"便利假设"是否可靠，并衡量其对leaderboard的影响程度。

Method: 使用TradeArena测试平台，12个策略（5个LLM信号策略+7个经典基准）在3种市场状态（calm、high-vol、jump/tail）×6种执行设置（E0近理想、E1默认压力、E2四种单轴变化+综合harsh）×10个种子下配对运行，主实验2,462次记录。采用Kendall τ_b和top-3 Jaccard度量执行层级间排名一致性；用差分中差分（DiD）相对于买入持有基准度量摩擦脆弱性；通过改变资产数（2-10）和决策周期（12-120步）做稳健性检验；同时在真实Yahoo OHLCV数据上复现7个确定性策略。

Result: 主要发现：(1) 高波动两资产板上E0-E1的τ_b=0.21（CI[0.00,0.52]），平静期为0.82（CI[0.48,0.94]），区间宽且重叠；(2) 总收益的τ_b(0.97/0.70/0.61)远高于Sharpe的(0.82/0.21/0.52)，说明噪声源于12步样本波动率估计；(3) E1下所有LLM策略排名上升2-7位，但换手率和填充率无显著差异；(4) 固定11策略板上，τ_b随资产数从2增至10而由0.24升至0.85；(5) DiD显示deepseek-v4-pro和mean-reversion在harsh设置下损失小于买入持有(q=0.005)；(6) 单个策略的填充率和滑点成本几乎不解释排名位移(R²<0.02)；(7) $30M账户下参与上限绑定但τ_b仍达0.81，说明per-trade成本与换手率主导排名变化。

Conclusion: 执行假设应作为基准规范的一部分与回报一同报告。仅靠事后扣减成本无法恢复排名（R²<0.02），必须重新运行整个板。0.21这一极端值属于短窗口、压缩资产集合的特例，不能推广为LLM相对能力差异的证据；更宽的资产集合（10资产）显示一致性更高。本文不评价LLM交易技能本身，而是揭示基准设定对结论的脆弱性，并要求未来的评估同时报告执行规则与跨设置的排名稳定性。

Abstract: Backtests of LLM trading agents often assume that every order fills at the closing price. We ask whether this choice changes only reported returns or also the order of the agents. Five prompted LLM signal policies and seven classical baselines trade the same synthetic price paths under six execution settings, from near-ideal fills to latency, spread, participation, and impact stresses. The main experiment contains $2{,}462$ runs with matched decision frequencies and paired market paths. On the compressed two-asset board, agreement between the near-ideal and default-stress rankings falls to Kendall $\tau_b=0.21$ in the high-volatility regime, compared with $0.82$ in the calm regime. The seed-bootstrap intervals, $[0.00,0.52]$ and $[0.48,0.94]$, are wide and overlap. On a fixed 11-policy board, agreement rises from 0.24 with two assets to 0.85 with ten; the two-asset point estimate differs substantially from the wider settings we tested. Rank changes are related to turnover, and comparisons with buy-and-hold also depend on how that anchor is initialized. The experiment does not compare LLM trading skill. It shows that, on a short horizon, an execution convention can become part of the benchmark's headline. Execution assumptions and rank stability should be reported alongside returns.

</details>


### [416] [Advectra: Asymmetric Latent Transport for Non-Stationary Physics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05098)
*Nodens Koren,Thomas Hofmann,Georgios Kissas*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Advectra提出了一种面向非平稳物理的输运感知型潜算子，通过正则化运动学坐标映射解耦源/目标坐标系，实现近似随动参考系下的非对称特征聚合与重建，并结合几何感知排序机制使SSM主干稳定，在对流主导PDE基准和工业设计任务上均达到最优。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有潜在神经算子（Physics-Attention等）在输入与输出之间使用固定或共享的分配矩阵，将特征投影与重建绑定在同一静止坐标图上，难以建模对流主导系统中相干结构相对于固定坐标系运动所产生的非平稳动力学，导致过度扩散与锋利结构丢失。

Method: Advectra引入（1）可学习、局部Lipschitz受约束的运动学位移映射𝒯和𝒰，对token坐标与锚点分别产生源/目标传输坐标，实现非对称特征聚合与重建；（2）源/目标图上的单位分割分配（partition-of-unity）与基于相似性核的归一化权重；（3）通过传输锚点质心的贪心最近邻遍历得到的几何感知排序，使双向SSM沿物理邻接路径进行序列建模；并与NOMAD的解码器视角对照，强调基底几何随目标图自适应变化。

Result: 在GCE-RT、NS-Tracer-PwC、FNS-KF三个对流主导PDE基准（POSEIDON）以及Airfoil、AirfRANS、ShapeNet-Car、AirCraft四个工业设计基准上，Advectra均取得全场相对L2误差、气动系数误差和Spearman秩相关性的最优；例如NS-Tracer-PwC示踪误差相对最强切片基线LaMO降低30.4%，AirCraft的U速度场相对改进37.3%；OOD（未见Reynolds数/攻角）泛化亦最佳；消融表明运输对瞬态流贡献最大，排序对3D几何贡献最大；计算开销与Transolver/LaMO相当（O(MGD)）。

Conclusion: 显式的移动坐标系结构和几何感知排序为神经算子处理非平稳、对流主导物理提供了有效归纳偏置；Advectra在保持潜在算子可扩展性的同时，在广泛PDE和工业基准上实现了一致最优性能，未来可拓展到多尺度输运、激波感知门控与守恒重建等方向。

Abstract: Many latent neural operators represent input and output fields in a stationary latent chart. In particular, common latent routing mechanisms use fixed or shared assignment weights for feature projection and reconstruction, limiting their ability to model transport-dominated systems where coherent structures move relative to fixed coordinate frames. We propose Advectra, a transport-aware latent operator that introduces a regularized kinematic coordinate map to decouple source and target coordinate systems. This yields an approximately co-moving latent reference frame and enables asymmetric feature aggregation and reconstruction. Combined with a geometry-aware ordering mechanism for state-space models, Advectra captures advective dynamics while maintaining stable global interactions. Advectra achieves the best performance among evaluated geometry-constrained and form-free baselines on advection-dominated benchmarks, including passive scalar transport in Navier--Stokes flows and Rayleigh--Taylor instability, while demonstrating strong generalization on real-world engineering tasks. These results highlight the benefit of explicit moving-frame structure in neural operators for non-stationary physics.

</details>


### [417] [METRO: Metric-Enhanced Token Routing Operator](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05100)
*Nodens Koren,Thomas Hofmann,Georgios Kissas*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出METRO（Metric-Enhanced Token Routing Operator），一种基于可学习马氏距离度量的几何感知路由机制，作为"切片-处理-反切片"架构中线性注意力路由的即插即用替代方案，通过为每个潜在切片学习各向异性局部度量张量，使感受野形成指数局部化的椭球形状，从而自然对齐物理流动特征。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有切片式神经算子（如Transolver）依赖线性点积打分进行潜空间token化：带特征归一化时等价于各向同性欧氏聚类，不带归一化时则产生无界线性决策区域。这两种情形都缺乏切片特定的各向异性局部性，导致冗余和纠缠的潜在切片，无法有效捕捉物理系统中常见的各向异性结构（如边界层、尾流）。

Method: METRO用对数高斯密度分数替代点积打分：每个潜在切片由中心μ_g和正定精度矩阵P_g参数化，路由权重正比于det(P_g)^{1/2}·exp(-½‖x_n-μ_g‖²_{P_g})。P_g采用对角参数化以保证正定性（softplus+ε）。理论上，通过编码器的Jacobian的拉回伪度量，对角潜空间精度矩阵可在物理坐标中产生有向（非对角）感受野（命题3.1）。算法上以对角形式实现，保持相对于网格分辨率N的线性复杂度O(N·G·D)。METRO为模块化组件，可替换Transformer或Mamba骨干中的切片路由。

Result: 在9个基准测试上系统评估：标准PDE基准上，M-Transolver在非规则域（Airfoil、Elasticity、Plasticity、Pipe）平均相对误差降低23.4%；工业基准AirfRANS上体积压力误差降低约50%，升力系数误差降低48.7%，表面误差降低32.2%，Spearman秩相关达0.9994；3D AirCraft上垂直速度V提升17.0%、展向速度W提升11.5%；ShapeNet-Car阻力误差降低13.4%。OOD泛化（未见Reynolds数和攻角）大幅优于基线。可视化显示切片从球形坍缩转变为流对齐椭球，Darcy流上实现空间解缠，混沌Navier-Stokes中保持局部分离。在严格参数匹配条件下，G=16的M-Transolver同时优于G=96的Transolver并更快训练。消融实验表明各向异性和二次衰减（二者共同提供度量局部性+方向性）为互补归纳偏置。

Conclusion: METRO作为一种模块化、骨干无关的升级方案，通过将切片token化重构为可学习各向异性潜空间聚类问题，有效解决了线性路由与物理系统各向异性结构之间的几何失配。在AirfRANS上物理指标平均误差降低43%，在OOD外推上设新SOTA，同时提升Transformer和SSM骨干。局限包括对角精度矩阵参数化限制了完全相关性表达、静态度量可能难以追踪瞬态结构、单一空间尺度，未来工作方向为满协方差矩阵的稳定训练、时变P_g(t)以及多尺度几何自适应集成。

Abstract: State-of-the-art neural operators scale to complex meshes via slice-and-process architectures, yet many rely on linear compatibility scores for latent tokenization. Under common feature normalization, such scores are equivalent to isotropic Euclidean clustering, while without normalization they induce unbounded linear decision regions. In both cases, they lack slice-specific anisotropic locality, which can lead to redundant and entangled latent slices. To address this, we propose Metric-Enhanced Token Routing Operator (METRO), a geometry-aware routing mechanism that replaces linear projection with a learnable Mahalanobis metric. By enabling each latent slice to learn a local anisotropic tensor, METRO shapes receptive fields into exponentially localized, oriented ellipsoids that naturally align with flow features like boundary layers and wakes. As a drop-in replacement, METRO yields consistent improvements across both Transformer and Mamba backbones. Empirically, our method achieves substantial performance gains on irregular domains, outperforming baselines on both standard PDE benchmarks and complex industrial design tasks. Finally, METRO exhibits enhanced robustness in out-of-distribution regimes across varying Reynolds numbers and geometric configurations.

</details>


### [418] [Private Component-by-Component Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05102)
*Dvir Karni,Eliad Tsfadia*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究差分隐私下可实现（realizable）设置中"逐分量"（component-by-component）学习问题。核心难点在于：逐个选择分量时，前一个分量的近似最优选择可能破坏标签样本的精确可实现性，即使该分量局部准确。作者通过 Beimel 等人的 LabelBoost 程序和两个交替蓄水池（reservoir）来恢复可实现性，从而在数据复用下实现隐私保证。对于目标隐私 ε，整体样本复杂度仅付出Õ(√k/ε) 的额外开销（相对单步分量学习的活跃样本需求）。应用方面：1）将框架与 IPConcave 算法及准凹优化器结合，给出 d 维有限网格上半空间（halfspace）学习的可实现样本复杂度 Õ((1/(εα))·min{d^{2.5} + d^{1.5}·2^{log*L}, d^{2.5}·log*L})，改进了之前 Õ((1/(εα))·min{(1/α)·d^{5.5}·log*L, d^{2.5}·2^{log*L}}) 的界；2）对于布尔组合 G(H_1,...,H_k)，将公用分量样本界上的开销从 Õ(k/ε) 降至 Õ(√k/ε)。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在差分隐私的可实现 PAC 学习中，许多概念类（如半空间、布尔组合）可以用 k 个分量表示。直观上可以顺序地选择一个分量，但隐私机制选择的分量只是近似最优——固定后，后续分量可能不再有与原始样本一致的实现，即使中间步骤本身是局部准确的。这破坏了可实现性，使后续子问题的隐私与效用保证均失效。已有工作 [Alon-Beimel-Moran-Stemmer, COLT'20] 通过重新标记（relabel）和为每个分量使用独立样本来缓解问题，但导致 k 倍样本开销。本文动机是：若能在每轮恢复精确可实现性，则可：1）将逐分量的均匀 VC 加性近似界替换为可实现版（使逆精度依赖从二次降为线性）；2）通过样本共享（subsampling amplification 与 advanced composition）将 k 个分量的乘法因子降至 √k。

Method: 1. 提出通用框架 "CarryForwardLearner"：将输入样本分成三块 W^init, W^(0), W^(1)，其中两个交替蓄水池 W^(0), W^(1) 用于跨轮传递活跃样本（active sample）。每轮从当前活跃样本的见证假设（witness）出发，调用分量预言机 A_i 选择下一分量 y_i；然后从对面的蓄水池抽取新的载体（carrier）T_i，并用 LabelBoost 过程在 C(y_≤i) 类下对 T_i 重新标记，使新活跃样本 S_i 恰好被 C(y_≤i) 实现。这一可实现性是不变式（Lemma 5.2），不依赖于预言机的效用成功。
2. 隐私分析：将两轮组合成一个 "macro-block"，利用 LabelBoost 的 "载体仅" 隐私性质（Lemma 3.17，固定载体 T 时仅 c_LB = ln(4e) 隐私代价）和 LabelBoost 对可实现输入后继的隐私引理（Lemma 3.15），证明 macro-block 在载体层面是 (ε_A + 2c_LB, 4eδ_A)-DP。再通过对每个蓄水池的子采样放大和沿 ~k/2 个 macro-block 的自适应高级组合，得到完整学习器的 (ε,δ)-DP。
3. 效用分析：利用 Beimel 等人的"全对泛化"（Theorem 3.9），将单轮的标签差异 2τ 提升为总体分布差异 20τ。通过三角不等式沿 h*, h_0, ..., h_k 串联，取 τ = α/(40k) 可保证总误差 ≤ α。
4. 半空间应用：关键观察是当前缀可实现时，逐坐标的 depth 函数在有限域上准凹（Lemma A.2 / Lemma 8.3），可直接优化 depth 而无需凸化（cdepth），从而避免 (d+1) 倍的深度转换损失，并将 ρ = Θ(α/d²) 改善为 ρ = Θ(α/d)。分别用 Cohen 等人的准凹优化器（QCOpt）和 Nissim 等人的 IPConcave 实例化，得到两个不同的样本复杂度。
5. 布尔组合应用：利用 Alon 等人的重标记-学习（relabel-and-learn）构造将本地私密学习器转换为分量预言机；本文通过复用样本将开销从 Õ(k/ε) 降至 Õ(√k/ε)。

Result: 1. 通用定理（Thm 5.1）：对 VC 维 v、分量数 k 的概念类，存在 (ε,δ)-DP 的 (α,β)-PAC 学习器，样本复杂度 Õ((√k/ε)·max{kv/α, M_A(α/(40k))})，其中 M_A 是预言机在精度 Θ(α/k) 下的样本需求。
2. 半空间（Thm 8.8/8.14，d 维，d+1 个分量）：使用 IPConcave 时样本复杂度 Õ(d^{2.5}·log*L/(εα))；使用 QCOpt 时 Õ((d^{2.5} + d^{1.5}·2^{log*L})/(εα))。两者都改进了之前的 Õ(min{(1/α)·d^{5.5}·log*L, d^{2.5}·2^{log*L}}/(εα))，维度依赖从 d^{5.5} 降至 d^{2.5}，且避免了对 α 的额外 1/α 因子。
3. 布尔组合（Thm 8.19）：对 G(H_1,...,H_k)，公用分量样本界 m 上的开销从 Õ(k/ε) 改进为 Õ(√k/ε)，总样本复杂度 Õ((√k/ε)·max{(k/α)·v_*, max_i m_i(α/(80k))})，其中 v_* = max{VC(C), max_i VC(H_i)}。

Conclusion: 本文通过在每轮分量选择后用 LabelBoost 恢复精确可实现性，配合两个交替蓄水池上的子采样放大与高级组合，给出了通用的差分隐私 "逐分量学习" 框架，仅引入 Õ(√k/ε) 的样本开销。该框架统一并改进了两类应用：1）d 维有限网格半空间的差分隐私学习，维度依赖从 d^{5.5} 改善到 d^{2.5}；2）固定布尔函数下分量类的封闭性，公用样本界开销从 k/ε 降至 √k/ε。核心思想是可实现性不变式使每轮的预言机只需对可实现输入保证隐私，从而能用更紧的可实现 VC 界（O(1/τ) 而非 O(1/τ²)）。遗留问题包括：与已知下界 Ω(d·log*L)（proper）和 Ω(d + log*L)（improper）仍有多项式差距；以及该框架主要在信息论层面有效，尚未给出高效实现。

Abstract: We study differentially private learning problems in the realizable setting, where a hypothesis is specified by $k$ components. A direct iteration of private component learners is obstructed by a simple difficulty: an approximate choice of the next component may destroy exact realizability of the labeled sample, even when the next component is locally accurate. We restore realizability using the LabelBoost procedure of Beimel, Nissim, and Stemmer [SODA '15, Algorithmica '21] and recycle data through two alternating reservoirs. The resulting learner, for a target privacy $\varepsilon$, pays only $\widetilde O(\sqrt{k}/\varepsilon)$ overhead relative to the active sample requirement of a single component learning step at target accuracy $\Theta(\alpha/k)$. For learning $d$-dimensional halfspaces over a finite coordinate grid of size $L$, exact realizability makes the direct component-depth objective quasi-concave. Instantiating the framework with the IPConcave algorithm of Nissim, Tsfadia, and Yan [SODA '26] and with the quasi-concave optimizer of Cohen, Lyu, Nelson, Sarl'os, and Stemmer [STOC '23] yields a realizable sample complexity of $\widetilde{O}\left(\frac{1}{\varepsilon \alpha}\cdot \min\{d^{2.5} \log^*L, \:\: d^{2.5} + d^{1.5} 2^{\log^*L}\}\right),$ which improves on the previously known bound of $\widetilde{O}\left(\frac{1}{\varepsilon \alpha}\cdot\min\{\frac{1}{\alpha}\cdot d^{5.5}\log^*L,\:\: d^{2.5}2^{\log^*L}\}\right).$ We also apply the framework to Boolean compositions: given proper private learners for classes $H_1,\ldots,H_k$, we obtain a proper private learner for $G(H_1,\ldots,H_k)$ for any fixed Boolean function $G:\{0,1\}^k\to\{0,1\}$. Compared with the closure theorem of Alon, Beimel, Moran, and Stemmer [COLT '20], this reduces the overhead on a common component sample bound from $\widetilde O(k/\varepsilon)$ to $\widetilde O(\sqrt{k}/\varepsilon)$.

</details>


### [419] [Component-Level Evaluation of Adaptive PINN Training for CFD-Oriented Crystal Growth Simulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05127)
*Niruta Chapagain,Rohit Raj,Bertwin Kurisinkal Shine,Aditya A S*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文针对CFD导向的晶体生长模拟，比较了固定权重PINN、梯度归一化PINN（GNPINN）和基于规则的自适应控制器（AgenticPINN），并结合高斯过程代理评估了Czochralski参数扫描。研究表明自适应控制可降低PDE残差但会削弱其他物理约束（如边界条件），强调PINN评估应分别报告各损失分量和外部解误差，而非仅依赖加权总损失。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: PINN训练中，自适应方法在训练过程中动态修改PDE、边界条件和初始条件损失的权重，导致不同方法的加权总损失不可直接比较。论文质疑"更低的加权总损失是否等价于更高的物理解精度"，呼吁建立组件级别的评估范式，特别是在CFD导向的Czochralski晶体生长这一昂贵参数扫描场景下。

Method: 在匹配条件下比较三种策略：(1)固定权重基线PINN；(2)GNPINN——按梯度范数归一化后求和；(3)AgenticPINN——基于PDE与BC/IC梯度范数指数移动平均的规则控制器，30 epoch预热后每5 epoch用clipped比值更新权重，200 epoch后启用学习率衰减。两个基准问题：1D热方程（有解析解）和简化Czochralski热-流PINN。CFD代理部分采用固定RBF+白噪声核的高斯过程回归，对三组单参数扫描（热壁温度、坩埚转速、晶体转速）分别留出一组工况进行case-wise测试，按各物理场分别报告NRMSE。

Result: 热方程基准：AgenticPINN PDE残差降至8.22×10⁻⁷（约基线的1/4820）但BC/IC损失升至0.20（增大约173倍），相对L₂误差高达1.368；GNPINN相对L₂误差最低（0.054）但PDE残差较高。简化晶体生长PINN：AgenticPINN PDE残差从10⁻⁵降至10⁻⁶（≈1/8.1），BC/IC损失从10⁻⁵升至10⁻²（增大约792倍）。权重动态显示λ_PDE被推至上限10²、λ_C被压至下限10⁻²，形成10⁴的不平衡。CFD代理：温度场误差约6%（热壁扫描5.61%、坩埚转速扫描6.34%、晶体转速扫描9.58%），但晶体转速扫描下u_r误差22.95%、u_z误差41.46%，而u_θ仅2.93%。

Conclusion: 自适应权重控制可在优化层面显著降低PDE残差，却以牺牲边界/初始条件约束为代价，并在解析基准上产生更差的解场误差。PINN的加权总损失应被视为训练量而非跨方法精度度量，评估时应分别报告未加权分量损失、外部解误差及按物理场分解的代理误差。该结论对CFD代理同样适用：不同物理场和参数扫描下的预测精度差异显著，聚合指标可能掩盖场级失败。

Abstract: Physics-informed neural network (PINN) training minimizes a weighted combination of partial differential equation (PDE), boundary-condition, and initial-condition losses. Because adaptive methods modify these weights during training, their weighted total losses are not always directly comparable. We compare fixed-weight PINN, gradient-normalized PINN (GNPINN), and a rule-based adaptive controller (AgenticPINN) under matched settings on a heat-equation benchmark and a simplified Czochralski-oriented thermal-fluid problem. In the crystal-growth MLP experiment, adaptive control reduced the PDE residual from the order of $10^{-5}$ to $10^{-6}$, while the boundary-condition loss increased from the order of $10^{-5}$ to $10^{-2}$. On the heat-equation benchmark, GNPINN achieved the lowest relative $L_2$ field error (0.054), whereas AgenticPINN obtained the smallest PDE residual but a relative $L_2$ error of 1.368. Gaussian-process surrogates were additionally evaluated using case-wise holdout tests on corrected Czochralski CFD parameter sweeps. The temperature-field error for the temperature sweep was approximately 6%, whereas the axial-velocity error for the crystal-rotation sweep was approximately 42%. These findings show that adaptive control can improve equation satisfaction while weakening other physical constraints. PINN training should therefore be evaluated using separate PDE, boundary-condition, and solution-error metrics rather than weighted total loss alone.

</details>


### [420] [Hidden in the Comments: A Context-Injection Attack Surface in Code LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05139)
*Noor Munir,Francesco Quinzan,Stephen Roberts*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文揭示了代码大语言模型（Code LLM）助手中一个被忽视的攻击面：推理时上下文注入（inference-time context injection）。攻击者无需访问模型权重或训练数据，只需在不受信任的开发上下文（如代码注释、第三方依赖、共享仓库片段）中植入不安全指令，当开发者发起普通的代码补全请求时，模型可能遵循这些植入指令并生成包含可利用漏洞的代码。在十个开放权重的 Code LLM（3B–13B 参数）上、针对十类 Web 应用漏洞的评估显示：攻击条件下中危及以上漏洞生成率高达 77.4%–92.3%，而良性条件下仅为 1.7%–5.1%；基础模型与指令微调模型的遵从率无统计差异，模型规模、代码专精度与发布版本均无法解释易感性差异；后代筛选（post-generation screening）虽能降低风险但无法根除，最强筛查器仍有约三分之一漏洞漏检。研究最终呼吁采用来源感知（provenance-aware）的训练目标与指令层级防御。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有研究分别关注：①无对抗场景下 Code LLM 生成不安全代码的基线倾向；②需要访问训练/微调流水线的投毒与后门攻击；③通用 LLM 中的间接提示注入。然而存在一个尚未被系统量化的关键缺口：当攻击者仅能控制推理时上下文中的部分内容（如代码注释）时，Code LLM 助手是否会在开发者发出良性请求的过程中遵循这些植入指令，从而生成脆弱代码。开发者通常认为来自外部的内容（论坛、依赖、共享仓库）只是数据而非指令，但模型缺乏可靠的来源—指令边界，这构成了一种"混淆代理"（confused-deputy）安全风险。

Method: 采用受控双条件评估设计：①攻击条件——700 个 Python Flask 场景，每个在函数体内以 `# TODO:`、`# INSTRUCTION:` 或 `# TASK:` 注释形式植入不安全指令，覆盖 SQL 注入、XSS、命令注入、路径遍历、SSRF、XPath 注入、CORS 误配置、开放重定向、不安全反序列化、敏感信息泄露十类 CWE；②良性条件——700 个普通 Python 编码任务，无恶意指令。两者使用相同的补全模板。评估十个开放权重模型（4 基础 + 6 指令微调，含 DeepSeek、Qwen、Granite 4.0 三对兄弟配对）。使用五组件集成检测器打分（Bandit、AST 污点分析、模式检测、密钥检测、Phi-3 语义验证器），样本严重度取各发现最高等级，中危及以上计为脆弱。指标包括脆弱输出率（VR）、恶意易感性偏移（MSS）、相对易感性比（RSR）、Cohen's h，并采用双单侧检验（TOST）进行等效性检验，Δ=10 个百分点。对筛选器（Bandit、AST 污点、LLM judge、其并集）进行覆盖率与漏检率评估。

Result: ①攻击效果：所有十个模型的攻击条件下脆弱输出率为 77.4%–92.3%，良性条件仅 1.7%–5.1%；绝对差 73.8–87.9 个百分点，相对差 17–49 倍；Cohen's h 介于 1.77–2.15。②严重度：86.2%–91.0% 的脆弱攻击输出被评为高危或严重级。③一致性：基础模型均值 86.5%，指令微调模型均值 84.5%，组间差异 +2.0 个百分点，90% CI [-5.5, +9.5]，落入 Δ=10 的等效边界；三对兄弟配对中，指令微调均未增加易感性（差异分别为 +2.7、+3.7、+8.1 个百分点）。④易感性无明显关联：参数规模、代码专精度、发布版本均无法解释模型间差异；Granite-4.0-H-Micro-Base（3B，92.3%）与 CodeLlama-13B（13B，77.6%）表现接近。⑤检测器稳健性：移除模式检测器后攻击率仍达 46%–79%，远高于良性基线。⑥筛选效果：Bandit 仅捕获 21.4%，AST 污点 32.1%，LLM judge（Phi-3）71.0%（最强），三者并集仅 78.4%，约 21.6% 漏检；最强单屏仍有约 1/3 漏检。⑦注释位置不影响效果：置于文件顶部、中部、底部均能稳定诱导漏洞（Cochran's Q 不显著）。

Conclusion: 该研究将 Code LLM 助手的安全重新定位为信任边界问题：模型将上下文中指令视为同等权威，不区分开发者来源与外部来源，由此形成显著的上下文注入攻击面。鉴于所有评估模型遵从率均高且彼此无统计差异，基于拒绝或遵从的安全度量在此类模型集合中几乎没有区分价值——选择更大、更专精或更新的模型均不能降低风险。输出层筛查可在结构上缓解但无法遏制攻击，因为筛查器继承了静态分析在"对抗塑形但功能合理"的代码上的召回限制。因此，持久性防御必须前移到生成之前或生成过程中：通过来源感知的上下文准备、指令层级（instruction hierarchy）训练、以及教导模型将不可信上下文中的指令视为数据而非命令的训练目标，从根本上重建缺失的信任边界。研究的局限在于仅评估开放权重、中等规模的模型，未覆盖商业闭源助手与重度安全对齐系统，且双条件设计同时混杂了指令效应与任务类型效应，未实现完全分离的端到端攻击测量。

Abstract: Code large language model (Code LLM) assistants generate code from heterogeneous development contexts, including open files, imported modules, pasted snippets, and comments, much of which may originate from untrusted sources. We investigate whether insecure instructions embedded in such contexts can steer Code LLMs toward vulnerable code without access to model weights or training data. We evaluate ten open-weight Code LLMs spanning 3B--13B parameters, including four base and six instruction-tuned models, across ten web-application weakness classes. We compare completion tasks containing insecure instructions embedded as code comments with benign tasks without malicious instructions. Attack-condition completions contained a medium-or-higher weakness in {\bf 77.4--92.3}\% of cases, compared with {\bf 1.7--5.1}\% in the benign condition. Base and instruction-tuned models averaged 86.5\% and 84.5\% vulnerable outputs, respectively; equivalence testing and three matched model pairs indicated reductions of at most 8.1\% after instruction tuning. Susceptibility showed no clear association with model scale or specialization. Among vulnerable attack outputs, 86.2--91.0\% were rated high or critical, and the effect persisted without the pattern-based detector. Post-generation screening reduced but did not eliminate the risk, the strongest screen leaving roughly one-third undetected. These findings identify inference-time context injection as a substantial attack surface and motivate provenance-aware training objectives.

</details>


### [421] [Arithmetic Actor Heads and Training Stabilization for Out-of-Distribution Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05143)
*Yifan Zhang,Liang Zheng*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究强化学习策略在分布外（OOD）幅度偏移下的鲁棒性问题。基于软演员-评论家（SAC）和贝叶斯遗忘分段鲁棒（BAPR）框架，提出因果符号BAPR（CS-BAPR）方法族，将六种训练稳定化设置与多种演员头架构（NAU、KAN、ReLU MLP、tanh MLP）相结合。在12条公交线路的SUMO校准交通基准上进行测试，结果表明所有稳定化变体在静态、突发和振荡需求偏移（最高50×）下均优于未稳定化的BAPR实现；稳定化贡献了大部分性能增益，而演员头选择产生较小的、随场景变化的差异。理论上证明了策略输出的二次外推界，并分析了冻结Bellman算子的收缩性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在名义条件下训练的RL策略在乘客需求等外生输入超出训练范围时（即幅度外推）表现不佳。现有方法如SAC、BAPR、RE-SAC分别提供连续控制框架、变化敏感适应和批评家集成风险正则化，但缺乏对幅度外推问题的系统解决方案。算术网络层为数值外推提供了有用的归纳偏置，但线性输出层本身并不能使非线性策略在原始状态空间中变为线性。

Method: CS-BAPR方法族包含两大核心组件：(1) 六种训练稳定化设置——最小集成评论家目标、奖励尺度归一化、熵温度下限、BC锚点移除（BAPR-4种基线设置）、变化检测预热与惩罚缩放、基于回滚的单边惊奇度（BAPR-2种配方），由BOCD提供信念跟踪；(2) 四种演员头选择——NAU（含NMU启发的二次校正）、KAN、ReLU MLP、tanh MLP。理论上证明了条件策略输出外推界‖π(x_ood)−π_ref(x_ood)‖≤δ+ε‖d‖+L_err‖d‖²/2，并分析了冻结Bellman算子的γ-收缩性。

Result: 在12条公交线路的SUMO校准基准上，使用名义需求进行ID训练，在静态、突发和振荡需求偏移（最高50×）下评估：所有四种稳定化变体均改善了中位数回报。稳定化贡献了大部分增益；NAU变体在静态5×点表现最佳，其他头在多个场景中表现更好。最小集成稳定化在静态OOD上将绝对回报损失降低10.6%至19.0%。在Hopper-v4风力扰动实验中结果具有任务依赖性。

Conclusion: 证据支持以交通为重点的训练配方和条件策略输出分析。稳定化是OOD性能提升的主要驱动力，演员头选择产生较小的、随场景变化的差异。理论结果（策略输出外推界、冻结Bellman收缩）为方法提供了条件保证，但历史算术演员的整策略L_π未被认证；修订的平滑NAU变体提供了显式导数界，但尚未在报告中评估。IRMv1因果发现并未从预测误差方差选择器中得出。结论是任务依赖的，不存在普遍优越的架构。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) policies can deteriorate under out-of-distribution (OOD) magnitude shifts. Starting from soft actor-critic (SAC) and its Bayesian Amnesic Piecewise-Robust (BAPR) predecessor, we study the causal-symbolic BAPR (CS-BAPR) family. The practical method combines six training-stabilization settings with alternative actor heads: a Neural Addition Unit (NAU) with a Neural Multiplication Unit (NMU)-inspired quadratic correction, a Kolmogorov-Arnold Network (KAN), or a multilayer perceptron (MLP) with rectified linear unit (ReLU) or hyperbolic-tangent activations.

</details>


### [422] [Measuring Learned Monotone Temporal Aggregation at Matched Admissibility](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05196)
*Yew Lee Tan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出"匹配可采纳性"(matched admissibility)评估框架,在双方均保证单调性的前提下,衡量学习时间序列聚合相对于工程化特征工程的实际价值。核心发现是通过直接函数回归建立的可替代边界:学习的单调循环通道可在成员级别上以秩等价复现几何加权可分族的手工统计量(ρ≥0.996),在连续性(ρ=0.924)、时间局部化(ρ=0.628)和暴露底限(ρ=0.829)处失败,每个失败均可通过一个显式可采纳基函数修复至秩相关1.000。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在受监管的风险评分场景中,部署的单调管道(手工设计的单调时间聚合输入符号约束的梯度提升)已通过组合天然满足端到端单调性。因此,文献中标准的"约束vs.无约束"对比衡量的是错误的量——即一个部署方免费获得的保证。本文旨在构建一个在双方均固定可采纳性的评估,衡量学习时间聚合的实际价值。

Method: 1) 理论引导的单调循环架构:状态由经典风险统计量(EWMA和高水位标记)构成,带可学习的单调变换g₁、g₂和衰减α,每条流均通过构造保证单调性(包括每个MC-dropout样本)。2) 匹配可采纳性评估设计:对比学习通道与工程化网格(包括带单调约束GBM、标定单调格网等),双方均经结构验证为零违反。3) 通过直接函数回归(E11)构建可替代边界:用单基学习通道训练以MSE回归复现各目标统计量,以Spearman ρ量化跨越度。4) 涵盖八个声明(C1-C8)的实验设计,使用合成数据实现已知单调机制和精确可调参数控制。

Result: 1) C1:单调性保证在每个算子和每个MC-dropout样本下严格成立;无约束和惩罚训练的基线存在6-63%的违反率。2) C2:在稳态降阶扫描上,循环模型相对静态聚合物的差距形成倒U曲线,在α*=0.8处峰值+0.044 AUC。3) C3:跨核心机制的约束成本最差配对CI下界为-0.0017,远在-0.01的非劣性边界内。4) C7/E8:在可分族上学习通道与工程化特征可替代;基础差距最大达+0.143 AUC(暴露底限O),每个均由单一显式可采纳基函数修复至Bayes上限。5) C8:在全样本量下与受限GBM并列优于;在网格未覆盖的衰减区域(0.019 AUC)、稀缺样本下和外部稠度违约外延下展现优势。6) E11函数跨越表:可分族中每个成员均达到ρ≥0.996;连续性、时间局部化和暴露底限三个对照目标失败,每个由显式匹配基函数通道恢复至ρ=1.000。

Conclusion: 本文论证标准评估衡量的是错误的量。在匹配可采纳性下重新运行后,评估返回的是一个边界而非排行榜:学习的单调循环通道在可分族结构上与手工设计的工程化特征可替代(可替代物而非互补物),并在连续性(结构性的)、时间局部化(结构性的)和暴露底限(可学习性的)三处失败,每个失败均通过单一显式可采纳基函数修复至统计上限。预测上,学习通道在核心机制的域内分布全样本量下从未统计落后于工程化渠道,并在以下三处赢得其优势:工程化网格无法适应的衰减区域、高维对比器下的稀缺训练数据、以及训练支持外稠度违约外的压力(此时分段型树集成评分变平)。工具是一个状态由经典风险统计量构成的循环架构,通过构造在每个输入和每个MC-dropout样本下保持单调。本文提供的是评估标准、边界以及使两者可测量的工具。

Abstract: Risk regulation imposes directional constraints on scores; we adopt their strict per-input form -- the score monotone non-decreasing in every exposure input -- as a normative commitment. Deployed pipelines -- monotone hand-crafted aggregates feeding sign-constrained gradient boosting -- already satisfy it by composition, so constrained-versus-unconstrained comparisons price a guarantee the incumbent has for free. We instead hold admissibility fixed on both sides and measure what learning the aggregation is worth. Our instrument is a recurrent network whose state is classical risk statistics (an exponentially weighted moving average and a high-water mark with learned transforms), monotone by construction in every input and per MC-dropout sample. The central finding, by functional regression, is a subsumption boundary: a learned monotone channel reproduces the geometrically weighted separable family of hand-crafted statistics, one channel per member, to Spearman $\rho \ge 0.996$, approximates window statistics with measurable ceilings, and fails at consecutivity ($\rho = 0.924$) and time localization (0.628), both structural, and at the exposure floor (0.829), a learnability boundary. One explicit admissible basis repairs each failure (rank correlation 1.000). In or near the separable family, learned and engineered aggregation are substitutes, and the learned channel is never statistically behind at full sample size and specified capacity. Its advantages are incumbent-specific: a committed grid pays up to 0.019 AUC in decay regions it leaves uncovered (the learned channel stays within 0.004 of the strongest engineered consumer at every swept point); the highest-dimensional comparator degrades fastest with scarce data; and beyond the training support, grid-fed tree-ensemble scores go flat while a strictly increasing head keeps ranking. No single incumbent is dominated on all three axes.

</details>


### [423] [Cross-Time Directional Selection in Diffusion Sampling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05199)
*Dhia naouali*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种"匹配重放"（matched replay）测量方法，用于研究扩散采样中的"跨时间方向选择"现象。核心发现是：在相同的晚期潜在状态和相同扰动幅度下，由早期采样步骤塑造的方向（upstream-shaped）比新采样的各向同性高斯方向（fresh）会被后续更新更强烈地放大。在三个采样器（SiT、DiT、LightningDiT）中，中位数配对角增益比为1.14–2.35，且在原始主队列的每条轨迹中shaped增益均超过fresh增益。供体置换实验进一步表明该优势依赖于方向与接收轨迹的配对，而非仅由共享的方向各向异性解释。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准的扰动测试使用新采样的各向同性高斯噪声来评估扩散采样对扰动的敏感性，但实际采样过程中遇到的扰动已经经过早期步骤的变换。论文旨在探究：早期采样步骤产生的扰动方向是否会被后续采样器特别强烈地放大？各向同性探测平均无法回答这一问题，因为它们没有测试由轨迹自身生成的方向。

Method: 1. 匹配重放协议：对于每条轨迹，从早期步骤a传输一个居中扰动到晚期状态b，获得"上游塑造"方向u_b^(a)，将其归一化后在未扰动的z_b周围以与新采样高斯方向ξ相同的RMS幅度进行重放，两者经过相同的剩余更新F_{b:c}。
2. 角增益和RMS增益的有限半径对称测量（正负扰动）。
3. 供体重放控制：将塑造方向在不同轨迹间置换（包括类内和类间），保留方向总体但打破与接收状态的配对。
4. 端点表征敏感性实验：在z_T处以相等RMS重放，解码后测量像素RMS、DINOv2（CLS和均值patch token）以及ResNet-50特征空间的变化。
5. 在SiT-XL/2、DiT-XL/2和LightningDiT-XL/1上实验，ImageNet 256×256，引导尺度1，1024条轨迹。

Result: 1. 主结果：在所有三个采样器和所有源时间下，上游塑造方向的端点角增益均大于匹配的新鲜方向。中位数配对角增益比范围为1.14–2.35×，且在全部1024条轨迹中shaped增益均超过fresh增益。
2. 稳定性：在八倍重放半径范围内，中位数配对比变化≤0.0004；源半径审计变化<0.009%。
3. 潜在RMS增益保持shaped-over-fresh排序。
4. 供体置换：自有方向/新鲜比为1.509（SiT）和2.353（DiT），而供体/新鲜比降至约1.06–1.19；自有/供体比约1.41–2.00。
5. 端点特征响应：在SiT中，从步骤5塑造的方向在DINOv2 CLS空间产生1.264×响应比，ResNet-50空间1.135×，而像素RMS响应比接近1（1.007×）。
6. 时间关联：新鲜探测收缩的中位数交叉点为0.451，角速度峰值为0.643，Spearman相关ρ=0.622。

Conclusion: 扩散采样的晚期窗口对由早期更新塑造的方向表现出偏好性传输，这种传输比对新各向同性方向更强。该效应在角增益和潜在RMS增益中均存在，且端点处的特征空间变化也大于像素空间变化（当像素变化可比时）。优势并非仅来自共享的方向各向异性，而是依赖于方向与接收轨迹的配对，可能反映了上游和下游雅可比矩阵敏感方向之间的相关性。这对评估采样器近似（如降低精度或缓存计算）具有重要意义——需要反映上游传输的扰动来进行正确评估。

Abstract: How strongly do the remaining diffusion-sampling steps amplify a perturbation at a late latent state? Standard measurements answer this question with newly sampled isotropic noise, even though perturbations encountered during sampling have already been transformed by earlier steps. We compare these two cases directly. For each trajectory, we transport a centered perturbation from an earlier step to a late state, then replay its direction at the same magnitude as a newly sampled isotropic perturbation; both then undergo the same remaining updates. Across the samplers we study, median paired shaped-to-fresh angular-gain ratios range from $1.14$ to $2.35$. Shaped angular gain exceeds its matched fresh counterpart in every trajectory in the original main cohorts. The same pattern appears when endpoint change is measured by latent RMS. The effect also appears in perceptual feature representations: earlier-sampling directions cause larger feature changes at the endpoint, even when the corresponding pixel-space change is comparable. Permuting shaped directions across trajectories weakens the effect, including within class, indicating that the advantage depends on alignment with the receiving trajectory as well as on shared directional structure.

</details>


### [424] [Learning without Overwriting: A Theory of Self-Distillation and Supervised Fine-Tuning in Continual Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05200)
*Shinichi Uemura,Taiji Suzuki*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出了一个基于有向无环图（DAG）的理论框架，分析了大语言模型在持续推理学习中两种后训练方法——在线策略自蒸馏（OPSD/SD）和监督微调（SFT）的动态差异。核心发现是：OPSD通过仅对hint源节点进行稀疏梯度更新来避免遗忘，而SFT沿教师路径进行密集更新会导致灾难性遗忘。此外，预训练策略的多样性对于从中间状态重启推理至关重要。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 尽管在线策略自蒸馏（OPSD）在持续学习场景中展示出在获取新能力的同时保留旧知识的良好实证效果，但其背后的理论机制尚不清楚。特别是OPSD为何比SFT更不易遗忘，以及预训练策略如何影响后续性能，这些核心问题缺乏理论解释。理解这些动态对于设计可靠的大语言模型持续学习方案至关重要。

Method: 论文将大语言模型的思维链推理建模为有向无环图（DAG）上的马尔可夫搜索过程，图由聚类（等价推理状态）和聚类间转移（关键推理步骤）组成。基于此建立了完整的理论分析框架：1）单任务可学习性定理（SD的Theorem 1和SFT的Theorem 2）；2）持续学习中SD无遗忘保证（Theorem 3）和SFT灾难性遗忘上界（Theorem 4）；3）预训练多样性对中间状态重启推理能力的影响（Proposition 1）。关键引理Lemma 4证明SD梯度仅在hint源节点处非零，形成稀疏更新。最后通过合成DAG的数值实验验证理论预测。

Result: 主要结果包括：(i) Theorem 1和2证明SD和SFT在单任务学习上均有效，成功概率趋近于1；(ii) Theorem 3证明持续学习后旧任务正确率保持不变，每条正确转移的概率单调不降；(iii) Theorem 4证明SFT在持续学习中冲突路径的概率质量趋于零，旧任务保留率受冲突比例θ控制；(iv) Proposition 1证明预训练多样性不足时，罕见入口后的聚类即使在原起点达到高准确率，从中间状态重启仍可能失败。数值实验使用L=4、K=13、|V|=123的DAG，结果显示SD在所有四个任务上保持约0.980的正确率，而SFT在任务1-3上从近1降至0.0028-0.304。

Conclusion: 可靠的持续推理取决于后训练更新与预训练建立的推理结构的交互方式。论文通过CoT图模型统一分析了OPSD和SFT的动态：SD利用hint诱导的稀疏更新实现无灾难性遗忘，SFT沿教师路径的密集更新会覆盖先前获取的信息。此外，预训练覆盖度支持从中间状态的重启能力，而不仅仅是原起点的准确率。未来可研究从结果奖励（outcome reward）扩展到过程奖励（process reward）格式，以分析上下文学习能力在预训练策略中的重要性。

Abstract: On-policy self-distillation (OPSD) of large language models (LLMs) has demonstrated the ability to improve reasoning capabilities while preserving previously acquired knowledge. Despite substantial empirical success, the dynamics of OPSD in continual reasoning remain incompletely understood. Modeling LLM reasoning as search over a directed acyclic graph, we provide a unified theoretical analysis of both the dynamics of post-training---OPSD and supervised fine-tuning (SFT) in continual learning---and the impact of pre-training on subsequent performance. Our findings establish three key insights with an optimization guarantee: (i) OPSD with hints from correct outputs enables continual learning without forgetting by sparse yet effective gradient descent updates induced by the hint structure. (ii) SFT on correct reasoning paths can lead to catastrophic forgetting due to dense updates along the training paths, which overwrite the information previously acquired. (iii) Diversity in pre-training is crucial for enabling a post-trained model to reach a correct output when a rollout starts from an intermediate state. Our results, supported by theoretical analysis, show that reliable continual reasoning depends on how post-training updates interact with the reasoning structure established during pre-training.

</details>


### [425] [Ranking Bandits for Carousel Interfaces with Observable Browsing Depth](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05220)
*Takuma Yasuda,Atsuyoshi Nakamura*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文针对轮播（carousel）界面中浏览深度可直接观察的场景，提出了一种新的排序赌博机（ranking bandit）问题，并设计了三种基于已确认曝光更新统计量的算法（OD-UCB、OD-TS、OD-DMED-L），在理论分析和实验上验证了其相对于传统PBM基线的优势。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统排序赌博机（如cascade模型和PBM）将用户的检查行为视为潜在变量，无法区分"展示了但未点击"与"未展示"的情形。轮播/滚动列表界面实际上可以通过客户端事件直接观察到用户的最大浏览深度 V(t)，这一额外信号可被利用以提升推荐效率。

Method: 1. 问题形式化：每轮展示 L 个不同项目，仅根据观察到的浏览深度 V(t)（独立于展示顺序，i.i.d.）接收点击反馈，奖励为已曝光项目的点击总和。曝光仅来自确认的展示位置。 2. 提出三种算法： • OD-UCB：基于上置信界的UCB算法，分数 UCB_i(t) = θ̂_i(t-1) + √(α log t / n_i(t-1))，选分数最大的 L 个项目。 • OD-TS：基于Thompson采样的算法，对每个项目用 Beta(1,1) 先验，按后验采样值排序选 Top-L。 • OD-DMED-L：改编自DMED算法，通过队列 Q 调度探索，使用 KL 散度形式的检测条件 n_i(t-1)d(θ̂_i, θ̂_a_L) < (1+α)log(t-1)。 3. 共同子程序 GetResponse：仅对已确认曝光的项目更新 (n_i, s_i)。

Result: 1. 理论结果： • 下界：任何强一致学习器满足 lim inf E[Reg(T)]/log T ≥ Σ_{i=L+1}^K Δ_i/d(θ_i, θ_L)。 • OD-UCB 上界：当 α > 1/2 时，得到 O(log T) 有限时间上界，其主导项比 PBM-UCB 少一个因子 P_L^{-2}。 • OD-DMED-L 渐近上界：lim sup E[Reg]/log T ≤ (1+α) Σ Δ_j/d(θ_j, θ_L)，当 α↓0 时与下界重合，确立渐近最优性。 2. 实验结果： • 在三种环境（合成浅浏览、深浏览、RecGaze数据集驱动）下，OD-TS 在 T=500,000 时取得与 PBM-TS 相似的最终平均遗憾（差异在置信区间内重叠）。 • 所有提出的OD方法在最终遗憾上均优于 PBM-UCB 和 LastClick-UCB。 • 长时段 (T=10^7) 实验中，OD-DMED-L 的 Reg(t)/log t 比率向其渐近参考值收敛，验证了渐近最优性。

Conclusion: 该工作填补了轮播界面可观察浏览深度设置下排序赌博机研究的空白。提出的三种算法通过仅从确认曝光更新统计量，避免了未展示项目与负面样本的混淆，在浅浏览和深浏览环境中均取得了优于传统 PBM 基线（尤其是 PBM-UCB）的遗憾表现，并具有理论渐近最优性保证。未来工作包括放宽独立性假设、在线验证、为 OD-UCB/OD-TS 提供更紧致的有限时间分析等。

Abstract: Carousel interfaces allow a recommender system to directly observe how far a user has browsed. This signal distinguishes displayed but unclicked items from items that were never displayed, whereas conventional ranking-bandit models, including cascade and position-based models, generally treat examination as latent. We formulate a ranking-bandit problem in which a learner presents a list of $L$ items, observes the user's maximum browsing depth, and receives click feedback only for positions up to that depth. The objective is to maximize the expected number of clicks under an unknown item-attractiveness vector and a browsing-depth distribution. We propose three algorithms based on UCB, Thompson Sampling, and DMED, all of which update item statistics only from observed exposures. We derive an instance-dependent logarithmic upper bound for our UCB-based algorithm and an asymptotic upper bound for our DMED-based algorithm that coincides with the lower bound as its parameter $\alpha\downarrow 0$, establishing asymptotic optimality in this limit. Simulations in synthetic shallow- and deep-browsing environments, together with experiments parameterized from RecGaze interaction logs, show that OD-TS attains final mean regret similar to PBM-TS, while the proposed methods achieve lower final mean regret than PBM-UCB.

</details>


### [426] [Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks for Personal Context Recognition on ExtraSensory](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05250)
*Hoang-Thang Ta*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文在 ExtraSensory 数据集上系统评估了多种 Kolmogorov-Arnold 网络（KAN）变体用于多标签个人上下文识别任务，并与 MLP 和 TabM 进行了比较。实验采用五折用户划分和三随机种子设置，报告 Macro-F1、Micro-F1 及训练时间，并进行了网格大小、网格数量和数据归一化的浅层消融研究。结果表明所有 KAN 变体均显著优于 MLP，性能与 TabM 相当，但训练时间更长。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 尽管 KAN 已在人类活动识别（HAR）和可穿戴传感等任务中得到探索，但在更广泛的个人上下文识别领域（如 ExtraSensory 数据集上的多标签分类）应用尚未充分。本文旨在填补这一研究空白，为 KAN 在个人上下文识别任务上提供与 MLP 和 TabM 的统一对比基准。

Method: 方法部分详细介绍了三种基线/对比架构：（1）MLP 作为标准前馈神经网络基线；（2）TabM 基于参数高效集成，通过 k 个隐式子模型共享权重并使用轻量级乘加适配器实现多样性；（3）三种 KAN 变体：EfficientKAN（基函数 + B 样条）、FastKAN（基函数 + 径向基函数）、BSRBF-KAN（基函数 + B 样条 + RBF 组合）。实验采用 AdamW 优化器（lr=10⁻³, weight decay=10⁻⁴）、OneCycleLR 调度器、20 个 epoch、batch size 64，使用 5 折用户划分和 3 个随机种子（共 15 次运行），以验证集平衡准确率选最佳检查点。同时对网格大小、网格数量和归一化策略进行消融研究。

Result: 主要结果：（1）所有 KAN 变体和 TabM 在 Macro-F1 和 Micro-F1 上均显著优于 MLP（Wilcoxon 符号秩检验经 Holm 校正后 p_adj=0.0012）；（2）KAN 变体之间及与 TabM 之间无统计显著差异；（3）EfficientKAN 取得最高 Macro-F1（0.3112），BSRBF-KAN 取得最高 Micro-F1（0.5572），TabM 分别为 0.3107 和 0.5562；（4）TabM 相对 MLP 使 Macro-F1 提升约 10.7%、Micro-F1 提升约 12.2%，而训练时间仅增加约 2.3%；（5）FastKAN 训练时间最短（463.80s），比 EfficientKAN 少约 14.3%，比 BSRBF-KAN 少约 30.3%；（6）消融研究显示网格大小与 Macro-F1 无单调关系，BSRBF-KAN 在 grid_size=8 时最佳，EfficientKAN 在 grid_size=3 时最佳；（7）归一化能带来更高 Macro-F1，BSRBF-KAN 在 BatchNorm 下表现最佳（0.3214），FP 在 LayerNorm 下表现最佳（0.3190）。

Conclusion: 结论表明 KAN 是个人上下文识别任务的有前景的方法，其预测性能与 TabM 相当且显著优于 MLP。然而 KAN 变体通常需要更长的训练时间，计算效率仍是重要挑战。TabM 在当前实验设置中提供了预测性能与训练效率之间的最佳平衡。未来工作将在其他个人上下文识别数据集上评估 KAN、与 CNN/LSTM 等其他架构对比、深入分析 ExtraSensory 数据特征对 KAN 性能的影响，并进行更全面的超参数优化。

Abstract: Kolmogorov--Arnold Networks (KANs) have attracted increasing attention in recent years, with applications across a wide range of AI tasks. In this paper, we evaluate several KAN variants on the ExtraSensory dataset for personal context recognition and compare them with a multilayer perceptron (MLP) and TabM. We conduct the main experiments using five user folds and three random seeds per fold and report the average Macro-F1, Micro-F1, and training time. We also perform shallow ablation studies on grid size, the number of grids, and data normalization to examine their effects on KAN performance. The results show that all evaluated KAN variants significantly outperform MLP in terms of Macro-F1 and Micro-F1 and achieve performance comparable to TabM. However, KAN variants generally require more training time, while TabM provides a more favorable balance between predictive performance and training efficiency. These results suggest that KANs are promising for personal context recognition, while their computational efficiency remains an important challenge. Our source code is publicly available at: this https URL .

</details>


### [427] [Loopy: Low-Bit Quantization Framework for Looped Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05265)
*Zeyu LI,Yipu ZHANG,Jintao Chen,Xin LI,Wei ZHANG*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 Loopy，一个针对循环语言模型（Looped Language Models）的低比特训练后量化（PTQ）框架。其核心思想是：量化配置在共享循环核上的候选排序会随递归深度（recurrent depth）变化，因此应在目标部署深度上进行配置选择。为高效求解，Loopy 提出"渐进式全深度选择"（progressive full-depth selection），通过逐步将校准窗口分配给有前景的候选，同时保持目标深度执行，仅使用前向评估。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 循环语言模型通过重复执行共享循环核实现参数高效的迭代推理，但对其应用 PTQ 时，量化误差会在后续循环步中传播累积。作者观察到：(a) 通道缩放与正交旋转虽保留浮点计算，但产生的表示具有不同的量化质量；(b) 候选配置在浅层与目标深度的排序可能发生翻转（深度依赖现象）。这些现象表明应基于目标深度的最终预测损失来选择量化配置，但全候选在全部校准集上的目标深度评估代价高昂。

Method: 1) 循环深度感知目标：在目标部署深度 T 上的最终预测损失（next-token NLL）作为选择共享量化表示的准则。2) 共享量化表示参数化：候选 c = (s, p, b) 包括旋转种子 s、通道缩放幂 p 和 Hadamard 分块大小 b，变换作用于算子级别且在所有循环步中共享。3) 渐进式全深度选择：使用嵌套校准子集 D_1 ⊂ ... ⊂ D_R，借鉴 successive halving 思想，每个阶段对存活候选进行完整 T 步前向评估，按预估损失集区间保留最低 K_r+1 个候选进入下一阶段，最终阶段在完整校准集上选择最优候选。4) 理论保证：给出选择遗憾界 Reg_T ≤ max(β_τ,T + 2ε_r)，其中 Loopy 因 τ_r = T 使 β_T,T = 0，遗憾仅受窗口估计误差 ε_r 约束。5) 反例证明：构造了一个收缩性仿射映射的显式反例，表明浅层筛选可丢弃目标深度最优候选。

Result: 在 Ouro-1.4B/2.6B、Huginn-0125、Recurrent-Llama-3.2-1B 四种循环语言模型上，W4A8 与 W4A4 两种精度设置（共 8 种场景）下，Loopy 在多项指标上达到 SOTA。在 Ouro-1.4B W4A4 上，相对 SpinQuant 基线，LAMBADA 困惑度降低 36.5%。校准效率：相比全深度穷举搜索，Loopy 在 Ouro-1.4B W4A4 和 Huginn-0125 W4A8 上分别减少 4.2× 和 3.5× 端到端校准成本。KV 缓存量化：Q/K Hadamard 变换可将 W4A4 下 KV4 的相对困惑度增长从 6.56% 降至 3.41%。部署效率：NVIDIA H20 上 Loopy (offline) 在 batch 4/输入 2048 下达到 45.45 tokens/s（W4A4）和 45.83 tokens/s（W4A8），优于 QuaRot 与 SpinQuant。

Conclusion: Loopy 成功将量化选择对齐到循环语言模型的真实目标深度计算，并通过渐进式全深度评估使该选择在计算上可行。实验表明该方法在多种循环语言模型家族与精度设置下均有效，但收益程度随架构而异（Recurrent-Llama 因其预归一化结构在 W4A4 下退化较大）。研究还揭示了循环模型特有的量化现象——共享量化配置的深度依赖质量——并提供了理论分析（精确损失分解、选择遗憾界、保持最优的充分条件）与显式反例来说明深度匹配选择的重要性。

Abstract: Looped language models provide a parameter-efficient way to scale iterative test-time computation by repeatedly executing a shared recurrent core. Post-training quantization (PTQ) can reduce the memory footprint and inference cost of looped language models, but errors introduced by a quantized shared core affect subsequent cores. Among PTQ methods, channel scaling and orthogonal rotations preserve the floating-point computation while producing representations with different quantization quality. We find that quantization configuration candidate rankings can change with recurrent depth, motivating configuration selection at the target deployment depth. However, evaluating every candidate over the full calibration set at this depth is costly. We therefore propose Loopy, a PTQ framework that formulates shared-core quantization through a recurrent-depth-aware objective, selecting shared low-bit representations by their final prediction loss at the target deployment depth. Channel scaling and orthogonal rotations parameterize the candidate representations. To approximately solve this selection problem efficiently, Loopy progressively allocates calibration windows to promising candidates while preserving complete target-depth execution, using only forward evaluations. Across eight settings, Loopy achieves the state-of-the-art results among different baselines. On Ouro-1.4B under W4A4, Loopy reduces LAMBADA perplexity by 36.5% relative to SpinQuant. Our code is available at this https URL .

</details>


### [428] [A Unified Scaling Law for Time Series Foundation Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05269)
*Xilin Dai,Yiding Liu,Zewei Dong,Jiang-Ming Yang,Qiang Xu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一个统一的尺度律（Unified Scaling Law）和时间序列学习的统一理论（Unified Theory of Time Series Learning），用于理解时间序列基础模型（TSFMs）中模型容量、历史信息与预测性能之间的关系。基于18768个实验单元的广泛实验，提出了一个五参数尺度律，并通过Toto 2.0的留出验证证实其泛化能力。同时提出了全样本模型"权重积累信息"与冻结TSFM"激活提取信息"的双路径假设，并通过高斯回归分析和受控实验加以验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的时间序列尺度研究在模型多样性、容量、可用历史或预测视野方面存在局限，未能充分解决关于TSFMs可扩展性的争论。因此需要一种跨异构TSFMs的更通用、可量化的误差分析方法，以厘清在何种资源与预测条件下预训练规模能够转化为有效的预测增益。

Method: 1. **统一尺度律**：通过局部资源关系分析（容量弹性、上下文弹性、视野弹性）整合为一个简洁的五参数对数尺度律：log R = c + α·log H − γ·log L − β·log N·log L + q·(log L)²。采用稳健优化和留出验证（含Toto 2.0五点容量曲线的MAPE仅1.09%/1.50%）。2. **统一理论**：基于高斯回归分析规则识别与预测能力，提出全样本模型（权重中积累信息）与冻结TSFM（激活中提取信息）的双路径假设，并通过匹配历史比较、参数交换和激活干预实验加以验证。

Result: **尺度律结果**：在1070个Controlled点上的MAPE为10.13%，在111个Public点上为12.82%；留出Toto 2.0后在150个点上的MAPE为11.53%，其五点容量曲线在L=2048和4096的MAPE分别为1.09%和1.50%。**理论结果**：匹配历史预算下全样本模型和TSFMs均随历史延长而改善；规则识别实验中TimesFM 2.5和Chronos 2从96步到2048步条件均值MASE显著下降；参数交换在54种条件下均使预测偏向供体规则；激活干预中转移降低误差7.51%，恢复可恢复41.67%的擦除贡献。

Conclusion: 本文建立了一个具有闭式解的五参数统一尺度律，并提出了统一的时间序列学习理论，结合高斯回归分析和受控实验来理解历史信息的使用。保留（训练）与提取（推理）提供了应用历史规则的互补途径，任务特定适应可以重新平衡二者关系。这些发现支持预训练更大模型、验证输入-视野组合以及联合评估历史信息利用能力与容量，可为未来的时间序列基础模型研究提供可复用的方法论基础。

Abstract: We develop a Unified Scaling Law and a Unified Theory of Time Series Learning to understand how model capacity and historical information support forecasting. Across different lookback lengths and forecast horizons, we analyze 18,768 experimental cells from 21 checkpoints on 23 dataset-frequency tasks spanning six domains. Our empirical methodology integrates local resource relations into a parsimonious, fitted five-parameter law: capacity gains increase with history, context gains diminish toward saturation, and horizon effects enter as a common shift. Fitted without Toto 2.0, the law predicts its horizon-averaged capacity-scaling curves with mean absolute percentage errors of 1.09% and 1.50% at input lengths 2048 and 4096. To understand how history supports prediction, our learning theory uses Gaussian regression to analyze rule identification and predictive capability. We hypothesize that full-shot models learn by accumulating information in weights, while frozen time series foundation models (TSFMs) use history by extracting information through activations. Matched-history comparisons establish the predictive value of additional history. Controlled parameter exchanges and activation interventions provide evidence that history-derived rule information can be retained, reused across queries, and used to recover a contribution to long-context prediction. Together, these findings inform capacity scaling, context allocation, and the development of models that retain and apply historical rules. Code and main results are available at this https URL .

</details>


### [429] [Fast Convergence through Distributed Augmentation for Class-Imbalanced Federated Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05279)
*Arathi Nair M,J. Harshan,Anwitaman Datta*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出DAFL框架，通过建立数据增强与联邦学习收敛性之间的理论关系，将增强量作为优化变量而非启发式策略，在约束全局类别不平衡的同时联合最小化增强时间与训练时间，从而在提升少数类F1分数的同时显著降低训练时间。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 联邦学习中边缘设备常面临类不平衡问题，导致少数类性能下降。现有基于数据增强的方法将增强视为启发式策略，缺乏对增强量与收敛性关系的理论分析，导致过度增强和训练时间增加，尤其是在资源受限的电池供电设备上代价高昂。

Method: 1) 将局部-全局梯度差异分解为标签比例不平衡项（I）和条件梯度异质性项（Γ），推导出FedAvg收敛界，表明减少I可加速收敛；2) 建立标签比例不平衡度量I和全局类不平衡度量J，前者受增强影响，后者约束目标；3) 将分布式增强建模为延迟感知优化问题：最小化λ₁T_t + λ₂T_a（训练时间与增强时间的加权和），约束J(N+A)≤τ；4) 提出贪心算法分两阶段求解——阶段1强制全局平衡，阶段2进行时间感知优化。

Result: 在CIFAR-10的8类FL任务上构建6种不平衡配置（D1-D6）进行实验。DAFL在D2、D4、D5、D6（I和J均较高）上少数类F1显著优于基线（NIC、WCEL、LB、FedProx、Focal Loss），且训练时间更短。例如D2上DAFL少数类F1为0.183±0.055，训练时间188s，远优于LB的0.005±0.003和2136s。在严重不平衡D2场景下，DAFL以91轮收敛（FedProx需1740轮，Focal Loss需262轮），少数类F1达0.183（基线均低于0.025）。增强样本数与增强时间也普遍低于LB方法。

Conclusion: DAFL是首个从理论上建立数据增强量与联邦学习收敛性联系的工作，通过优化增强分配策略实现了少数类性能提升与训练时间缩短的双重目标，特别适用于严重全局类不平衡和高标签比例不平衡场景。该框架与具体增强方法解耦，可兼容任何类别保持型增强技术，适合资源受限的边缘设备部署。

Abstract: In federated learning, mitigating class imbalance is essential to improve minority-class performance. A common approach to address this problem is to augment minority-class samples to achieve local class balance. Existing approaches treat augmentation as a heuristic and do not establish how the amount of augmentation influences the convergence of federated learning, leading to excessive augmentation and increased training time. To address this limitation, we first establish the relationship between augmentation and the convergence behavior of federated learning. Leveraging this insight, we propose DAFL, a distributed augmentation framework that determines the minimum augmentation required for each client-class pair by jointly minimizing augmentation and training time while constraining global class imbalance, thereby improving minority-class F1-score. Experimental results demonstrate that DAFL consistently improves minority-class F1-score while substantially reducing training time, particularly under severe global class imbalance and high label proportion imbalance.

</details>


### [430] [Smoothed Gradient Method for Nonconvex Federated Stochastic Bilevel Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05290)
*Xinwen Zhang,Peiran Yu,Zhaosong Lu,Hongchang Gao*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种名为FedDS-BVRFO的随机双平滑梯度方法，用于求解非凸联邦随机双层优化问题。该方法通过在罚函数重构的极小极大问题中同时对原变量和对偶变量进行平滑，实现了统一的学习率尺度，并避免了显式的Hessian/Jacobian计算。在仅需下层目标满足PL条件（弱于强凸性）的假设下，该算法达到了$\tilde{O}(\kappa^{15/2}/\epsilon^5)$的收敛复杂度和$\tilde{O}(\kappa^4/\epsilon^3)$的通信复杂度，相比现有方法在条件数依赖上有显著改善。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有联邦随机双层优化方法存在三个主要局限：(1) 需要上下层变量使用不同尺度的学习率，导致超参数调节困难；(2) 大多数方法依赖下层函数的强凸性假设；(3) 收敛速率和通信复杂度对条件数$\kappa$的依赖过强。本文旨在通过引入双平滑技术来同时解决这些问题。

Method: 1. 将双层问题通过罚函数$\rho$转化为无约束极小极大问题；2. 对原变量$(x,y)$引入近端变量$p,q$进行原平滑，对偶变量$z$引入近端变量$r$进行对偶平滑，构建双平滑目标函数$F(x,y,z,p,q,r)$；3. 采用STORM风格的方差缩减梯度估计器对六个梯度分量分别维护动量变量；4. 通过周期性通信（每$\tau$步同步一次）实现联邦学习；5. 利用精心构造的Lyapunov势函数$\mathcal{P}_t$（包含平滑势函数$\Psi_t$和六个梯度估计误差项）进行分析，证明下降性。

Result: 1. 样本复杂度：$O(\kappa^{15/2}/(K\epsilon^5))$，相比FedSVRBGD-FO的$O(\kappa^{10}/\epsilon^5)$和F2BA的$O(\kappa^{12}/\epsilon^6)$有显著改善；2. 通信复杂度：$O(\kappa^4/\epsilon^3)$，相比FedSVRBGD-FO的$O(\kappa^9/\epsilon^4)$改善明显；3. 实现关于客户端数$K$的线性加速；4. 学习率统一尺度，简化超参数调节；5. 在非凸超参数优化（a9a, w8a, ijcnn1, covtype数据集）和模型剪枝（ResNet20+CIFAR10/100，80%稀疏度，Dir(0.5)非IID设置）实验上验证了算法的有效性。

Conclusion: 本文提出的FedDS-BVRFO算法是首个用于联邦双层优化的随机双平滑方法，统一了学习率尺度并放松了下层函数的强凸性假设至PL条件。理论分析显示该方法在条件数依赖上有显著改善，实验结果验证了其在联邦超参数优化和模型剪枝任务上的有效性和稳定性，为联邦双层优化提供了一个更实用和高效的解决方案。

Abstract: In recent years, federated stochastic bilevel optimization has attracted increasing attention due to its wide range of applications in machine learning. To reduce the computational overhead associated with second-order Hessian and Jacobian matrices, several first-order methods have been proposed. However, existing methods typically impose restrictive assumptions on the lower-level function, suffer from a strong dependence on the condition number in their convergence rates, and require different learning-rate scales for variables across the upper- and lower-level problems, limiting their practical applicability and complicating hyperparameter tuning. To address these challenges, we propose a stochastic doubly smoothed gradient method for nonconvex federated stochastic bilevel optimization problems, which decouples the learning rates of upper- and lower-level variables and does not require a strongly-convex lower-level loss function. We establish rigorous theoretical guarantees for the proposed algorithm, demonstrating an improved convergence rate of $O(\kappa^{15/2}/\epsilon^5)$ and a communication complexity of $O(\kappa^{4}/\epsilon^3)$, where $\kappa$ denotes the condition number and $\epsilon$ represents the solution accuracy. Notably, these bounds exhibit significantly better dependence on the condition number $\kappa$ than those of existing methods. Extensive experiments validate the effectiveness of our algorithm.

</details>


### [431] [Erased, Rerouted, or Rescaled? Post-Training and the Causal Quotient of a Language Model's Belief State](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05292)
*Weihan Li,Tianshi Zheng,Junhao Wu,Xinlei Chen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究后训练(post-training)对预训练模型已编码信息的影响，提出三种可区分的命运：擦除(erased)、重路由(rerouted)、重新缩放(rescaled)。通过隐马尔可夫世界中的精确分析，作者证明奖励仅定义决策等价性，而锚点(KL正则)和状态更新决定哪些奖励-零信息受到保护；后训练实际上选择了信念状态的"因果商"(causal quotient)。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 后训练通常被描述为"表征压缩"，但这一术语混淆了三种截然不同的信息命运：信息可能被完全擦除、被重路由（仍表征但不影响决策）、或被重新缩放（占用更少方差但仍被使用）。现有研究测量了表征变化，但无法区分这些命运。理解后训练如何影响预训练已编码但新目标不再奖励使用的区分，对语言模型的安全性和可控性具有重要意义。

Method: 方法包含理论分析和实验验证：(1) 在隐马尔可夫世界（可分离、纠缠、Mess3等）中建立精确的奖励-零核(reward-null kernel)，并定义三个可测量的坐标：表征性R（线性可恢复性）、使用性U（因果效应）、分配性A（激活方差占比）；(2) 理论证明KL锚定的RL保留参考策略在等奖励输出间的对数几率（命题2），而谱压缩既不意味着擦除也不意味着使用丧失（命题1）；(3) 在四层Transformer和两层GRU上预训练至贝叶斯最优，然后进行5000步后训练（SFT、DPO、GRPO、REINFORCE、KL-RL），并在Qwen3-1.7B/4B开源语言模型上验证。

Result: 主要结果：(1) 几乎所有目标都保留奖励-零信息——下一标记可见成分在无权重衰减的所有Transformer运行中保持≥0.9的可解码性；(2) 锚点决定使用：KL-RL、GRPO、DPO在β≥0.04时重现参考的类内对数几率（斜率γ在0.93-1.02），SFT重路由（U=0.15，R_vis=0.98），无锚点时策略梯度崩溃到每个类一个标记；(3) 真正的擦除仅在持续权重衰减下出现（50000步，R_inv降至0.001-0.012）；(4) 谱压缩与信息损失无关——172个核分配低于1/10的运行中，153个保持R≥0.9；(5) 分配有代价——冻结网络上训练新线性读出器所需步骤与保留的核方差呈-0.93秩相关；(6) 开源语言模型在后期层谱压缩16-61%下保持信念几何可解码，GRPO行为取决于锚点。

Conclusion: 后训练选择信念状态的因果商——其决策仍在作用的部分。奖励定义决策等价性，锚点和状态更新保护部分被忽略的内容，优化决定其余的命运。通常结果是重新缩放；当没有锚点时决策被重路由；擦除仅在持续压力下且无任何目标项需要该区分时发生。压缩的频谱不再是信息损失的证据，问题从"后训练是否压缩表征"转变为"它实现了信念状态的哪个因果商"。

Abstract: What happens to information a pretrained model already encodes when post-training no longer rewards using it? The common language of representation compression conflates three fates: information may be erased, rerouted away from the decision while still represented, or rescaled to occupy less variance while still represented and used. We make these fates identifiable in models whose pretraining recovers Bayesian belief states. A reward that reads only a coarse function of the hidden state defines an exact reward-null kernel. The kernel lets us separately measure whether the information remains recoverable, whether decisions causally depend on it, and how much activation variance it occupies. Theory says what is protected: KL-anchored reinforcement learning preserves the reference policy's log-odds among equally rewarded outputs, supervised and unanchored objectives carry no such constraint, and spectral compression implies neither erasure nor loss of use. In controlled worlds, post-training mostly reroutes or rescales reward-null information and leaves it decodable. Without an anchor decisions can stop using it although the representation survives, and with one they keep using it. Erasure appears only under prolonged weight decay, for distinctions that neither reward nor next-token prediction can see. Open language models show the same dissociation: in-context belief geometry stays decodable under late-layer spectral compression, and within-class behavior depends on the anchor. Post-training thus selects a causal quotient of the pretrained belief state: the reward defines decision-equivalence, the anchor and the state update protect part of what it ignores, and optimization decides whether the rest is erased, rerouted, or rescaled.

</details>


### [432] [FlexCast: Adaptive Weather Forecasting from Arbitrary Field Sets](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05296)
*Yuang Zhang,Chen Hui,Weisi Lin,Haiqi Zhu,Xiulai Wang,Sun-Yuan Kung,Feng Jiang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: FlexCast提出了一种场自适应气象预报模型，使用单一参数集为69字段ERA5注册表的任意可变基数子集生成身份对齐的预报。通过元数据条件适配器、掩码集合融合和多尺度U-Transformer实现跨场配置的统一预报。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有深度学习气象模型通常将固定的气象变量和气压层绑定到预定义的通道上，限制了模型在不同大气场配置间的可迁移性。当输入场子集变化时，固定通道模型无法有效应对。

Method: 1. 元数据条件适配器：编码变量身份、气压层、场类型，结合空间特征；2. 共享秩16投影配合元数据门控生成场特定特征；3. 掩码集合融合将可变数量场聚合为固定宽度表示；4. 多尺度U-Transformer处理融合特征；5. 身份感知查询解码器生成预报场；6. 学习标准化6小时增量并递归应用以生成更长预报时效。

Result: 在2020 ERA5测试集上：FlexCast(Full-69)在4/7/10天的nRMSE分别为0.4246/0.5626/0.6341，优于FengWu、Pangu-Weather和FuXi。匹配上下文使误差降低34.3%，不匹配上下文使误差增加124.5%。消融实验验证了元数据添加和调制模块的重要性。

Conclusion: FlexCast成功实现了跨不同场配置的统一气象预报，在较长预报时效上表现最优，同时揭示了上下文兼容性和场数量对预报精度的关键影响。

Abstract: Most deep learning weather models assign a fixed set of variables and pressure levels to predefined channels, limiting transfer across atmospheric field configurations. This dependence on a fixed field set limits the transferability of trained models across atmospheric field configurations. We propose FlexCast, a field-adaptive weather forecasting model that uses a single set of parameters to produce identity-aligned forecasts for variable-cardinality subsets drawn from a 69-field ERA5 registry. Specifically, a metadata-conditioned adapter the first encodes variable identity, pressure level, and field type and combines them with spatial features. Then, shared rank-16 projec?tions are modulated by metadata-dependent gates to produce field?specific features, while masked set fusion aggregates the available fields into a fixed-width representation. Subsequently, a multiscale U-Transformer processes the fused atmospheric features, while an identity-aware query decoder produces forecasts for the requested fields. Finally, FlexCast learns a standardized six-hour increment and applies it recursively to generate forecasts at longer lead times. Experiments on the 2020 ERA5 test set demonstrate that FlexCast operates across varying field configurations. Compatible cross-field context is associated with lower forecast errors, whereas mismatched context increases them.

</details>


### [433] [Do Neural Networks Learn Structure-Preserving Maps? A Case Study in Latent-to-Hilbert Embeddings](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05297)
*Muhammad Adnan Shahzad*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文通过控制实验研究神经网络能否学习从压缩潜空间到Hilbert空间的结构保持映射，使用8维自编码器瓶颈处理MNIST，并通过PCA基角度编码构建n比特积态目标。主要发现：映射近似线性、目标驱动、需要全部奇异方向，且核岭回归(KRR)在此设置下优于调优后的MLP。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 研究的核心动机是探讨神经网络是否能够学习保持几何结构的映射，而非仅仅拟合观测值。这在表示对齐、结构保持嵌入以及经典到量子映射等场景中具有实际意义，同时在理论上也有助于理解神经网络何时能恢复几何内容。三条相关研究脉络包括：表示相似性分析（CCA、CKA、Procrustes对齐）、核方法（特别是核岭回归KRR及其与无限宽神经网络的关系），以及量子机器学习（角度编码的量子特征空间）。

Method: 方法包含三个空间的构建：(1) 潜空间——通过约10.6万参数的小型自编码器将MNIST图像压缩到8维；(2) 目标Hilbert空间——使用n比特积态表示，通过PCA基角度编码构造，角度由潜向量在PCA方向上的投影经sigmoid变换映射到[0,π]区间；(3) 角度空间作为中间媒介。训练四种模型：线性回归、双层ReLU MLP、加入内积损失的MLP、以及RBF核的核岭回归(KRR)。评估指标包括内积保持误差(IP_err)、重构误差(MSE)和距离保持误差。在n∈{2,3,4,5}上进行实验，主要分析聚焦n=4。所有结果报告跨三个随机种子(42, 123, 7)。

Result: 四项主要发现：(1) 学到的映射近似线性——从z到真实目标角度的线性回归R²=0.98，到MLP恢复角度的线性回归R²=0.91；(2) 学到映射的主要方向与输入主方向余弦相似度仅0.002（几乎正交），但与目标诱导方向的余弦相似度达0.989（强烈对齐），表明主要方向是目标驱动而非输入驱动；(3) 该映射本质上是rank-4的——尽管奇异值谱为(5.5, 5.3, 1.3, 0.8)（两个主导、两个较小），但移除任何奇异方向都会使内积保持性能降低2.5–5.9倍，表明基于奇异值大小的秩截断不可靠；(4) 学到的子空间与用于构造目标的PCA基不一致（平均余弦仅0.31），不同随机种子在主要方向上一致（角度<6°），但在更高阶方向上发散。此外，KRR（RBF核，α=10⁻⁴，γ=0.1）以IP_err=0.0144和MSE=0.0013优于最佳MLP配置（h=512，IP_err=0.0197，MSE=0.0015），表明对于近似线性的结构保持映射，经典核方法可能更简单有效。

Conclusion: 该研究得出结论：在受控设置下，神经网络能够学习结构保持映射，但该映射具有近似线性、目标驱动、需要全部奇异方向的特性。对于近似线性的结构保持映射，经典核方法（特别是KRR）应作为强基线被优先考虑，而非更复杂的神经方法。该研究结果有助于推动关于神经网络在表示学习任务中适用边界的更广泛讨论，并建议未来工作应扩展到更大的基准（如Fashion-MNIST、CIFAR-10）以及纠缠目标编码。

Abstract: We ask whether a neural network can learn a structure-preserving map from a compressed latent space to a Hilbert-space representation. Using an 8-dimensional autoencoder bottleneck on MNIST and $n$-qubit product-state targets from PCA-based angle encoding, we report four findings. Although the target angles are generated by a nonlinear sigmoid transformation of the latent projections, the resulting mapping is well approximated by a linear function over the observed latent distribution: linear regression from $z$ to the true target angles achieves $R^{2} = 0.98$, while regression to the MLP's recovered angles achieves $R^{2} = 0.91$. The learned map's primary direction is strongly aligned with the target-induced direction, with cosine similarity $0.989$, while remaining nearly orthogonal to the input's principal direction, with cosine similarity $0.002$. The map is genuinely rank-4: removing any singular direction degrades inner-product preservation by $2.5$--$5.9\times$ despite a singular-value spectrum with two dominant and two small values. The learned subspace does not coincide with the PCA basis used to construct the target, and different random seeds recover the same primary direction but diverge in higher ranks. Finally, kernel ridge regression with an RBF kernel outperforms a tuned MLP (IP error $0.0144$ vs.\ $0.0197$), suggesting that for approximately linear structure-preserving mappings, classical kernel methods may be a simpler and more effective alternative.

</details>


### [434] [ASCENT: Online Test-Time Training of Long-Horizon Agents via Self-Distillation of Verified Experience](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05303)
*Haodong Lu,Dong Gong*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 ASCENT 方法，通过将已验证的成功轨迹中的"后见之明"作为特权信息，让冻结的初始 LLM 教师预测下一 token 分布，再将这些全词表软标签蒸馏到持续更新的 LoRA 快权重中，实现在部署阶段对长视野智能体进行在线测试时训练（OaTTT），无需外部参考解、额外训练阶段或记忆检索。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 已部署的 LLM 智能体在持续接收相关任务流时，其执行轨迹是天然的改进资源；但现有方法要么依赖上下文适应（冻结策略执行能力受限、检索依赖强），要么依赖多次尝试或预部署训练。直接在单次尝试轨迹上进行模仿或强化会导致策略崩溃：策略漂移加剧、有效行为丧失、任务成功率低于基线。需要一种能够在单次通过任务流、单次尝试条件下稳定更新 LLM 权重的方法。

Method: 提出在线智能体测试时训练协议（OaTTT）：每个任务只尝试一次，使用验证结果（成功/失败）作为唯一学习信号，权重更新跨任务保留。ASCENT 的核心是 OPSD（On-Policy Self-Distillation）的在线变体：将已验证轨迹中的推理-动作内容构造为特权信息 z_i（可选地通过移除无效动作记录进行过滤），冻结的初始模型 p_θ₀ 作为教师，在学生前缀位置以给定的后见预测全词表分布 q_{i,t,j}；学生通过最小化前向 KL 散度 D_KL(q || p^φ) 来拟合这些软标签，使用 LoRA 快权重（rank=16, scale=32）持续更新。在两次 AdamW 优化步骤后（学习率 1.5e-4）丢弃轨迹。理论分析刻画了验证器选择对轨迹的重加权以及蒸馏总体目标（即学生前缀处条件教师分布的均值 q̄(·|c)）。

Result: 在 ALFWorld、AppWorld 和 WebShop 三个基准上，使用 Qwen3.5-4B 和 9B 两个规模进行评估。ALFWorld seen 流上，ASCENT 在 4B/9B 上分别达到 69.5%/77.4% 平均成功率，比最强在线对比方法高出约 6-10 个百分点；WebShop 上严格成功率从基线 17.8% 提升至 41.9%（4B），且平均轮次从 39.5 降至 17.8。在 ALFWorld 不可见场景中，冻结迁移达到 62.7%/88.8%，继续 OaTTT 可进一步提升至 78.6%/90.0%。跨场景迁移和继续训练均显著优于在线上下文适应基线。在两个规模上，ASCENT 减少了平均对话轮数（4B: 64%, 9B: 67% 的共享成功任务上更短），并在情境与参数协同演化上表现出与 ACE/MemP 的互补性。

Conclusion: ASCENT 证明了部署中的智能体可以在不进行单独训练阶段或记忆检索的情况下，将自身已验证的执行经验整合到策略权重中。直接对单次尝试轨迹进行模仿或强化会因策略漂移和分布集中而导致不稳定；冻结教师进行在线自蒸馏在多次更新间保持稳定目标，全词表分布匹配允许后见信息提升替代动作的概率。存在的限制包括：需要完整词表分布（仅适用于开源权重模型）、仅依赖回合级稀疏验证、各回合权重相等。未来工作方向包括近似更细粒度的回合级信用，以及隔离教师特权信息对学生生成 token 的部分重建效应。

Abstract: A large language model (LLM) agent solves long-horizon tasks through many reasoning-action turns, with one verification signal at termination. Deployed agents face streams of related tasks, making their trajectories a natural resource for improvement. In-context adaptation agents store reflections, memories, or skills as text, so reuse depends on retrieving the right experience and on a frozen policy executing it. We study Online Agentic Test-Time Training (OaTTT), which trains the LLM's weights on its own execution trajectories during deployment. The agent executes each task once, in one pass over the stream, and the executed trajectory with its verification result is the only learning signal for weight updates that persist across tasks. Directly imitating or reinforcing the generated tokens of this single attempt destabilizes the policy. We introduce ASCENT (Agentic Self-distillation for Cross-task EvolutioN at Test-time), which instead self-distills verified experience. A stable version of the LLM, its frozen initial copy, receives the verified trajectory as privileged information and predicts next-token distributions along it with this hindsight. Distilling them into persistent LoRA fast weights updates the agent for later tasks, without an external reference solution or stronger teacher. By further removing invalid-action turns, ASCENT distills enhanced privileged experience for more efficient execution. We characterize its population target and the limits of sparse outcome selection. Across ALFWorld, WebShop, and AppWorld at varied model scales, ASCENT improves task success and interaction efficiency as experience accumulates, outperforms online adaptation methods, and transfers to held-out scenes, showing that an agent can consolidate verified experience into its weights without a separate training phase or memory retrieval. Project page: this https URL

</details>


### [435] [Robust Parameter-Efficient LLM Adaptation on Analog Hardware](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05318)
*Jindan Li,Zhaoxian Wu,Tianyi Chen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种面向模拟存内计算（AIMC）硬件的大语言模型（LLM）参数高效适配方法。该方法基于LoRA（低秩适配），冻结预训练权重，仅训练LoRA权重以适应下游任务和硬件非理想性。针对前向/反向MVM计算中的噪声，采用输入重塑（input reshaping）策略：基础路径使用函数保持的重缩放（base-path rescaling），LoRA路径使用异常通道分离（outlier-channel splitting）将持久大值通道路由到受保护的完美I/O路径。针对有限电导态带来的编程分辨率限制，采用更新累积（update accumulation）保留低于阈值的更新。该方法在Llama-3.2-1B-Instruct、Llama-3-8B和Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct上，使用Muon和AdamW优化器均验证有效。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 模拟存内计算（AIMC）虽能高效执行LLM中的矩阵-向量乘法（MVM），但有限DAC精度、输入噪声和有限电导态会降低模型精度。完全硬件感知重训练开销巨大，促使研究者探索参数高效微调（PEFT）方案。然而，LoRA等PEFT方法部署到模拟硬件时，训练过程本身的前向/反向MVM和物理权重编程都会受到模拟非理想性的影响，亟需一种对模拟硬件非理想性鲁棒的参数高效适配方法。

Method: 方法包含三大核心技术：(1) 模拟LoRA计算框架——冻结预训练基础权重存储于模拟阵列，仅训练低秩LoRA权重A和B，两者均通过非理想模拟MVM执行；(2) 输入重塑——一次性预微调校准识别持久大值通道，对基础路径采用函数保持的对角重缩放矩阵D（权重与输入联合重缩放保持理想计算不变），对LoRA路径采用异常通道分离（将校准出的离群通道路由至受保护的完美I/O模拟路径，降低剩余通道的DAC量化范围）；(3) 更新路径稳定化——数字小批量聚合（digital mini-batch aggregation）在优化器步进前累积梯度，更新累积保留小于电导步长Δw_min的更新直至可编程为整数脉冲。整体方法与优化器无关（兼容Muon和AdamW）。

Result: 主要结果：(1) QA任务——Llama-3-8B在7-bit DAC、噪声0.02、100电导态设置下，加入重塑+UA后F1/EM从Muon的24.49/18.36提升至43.55/35.35；Llama-3.2-1B-Instruct从19.21/12.89提升至25.24/17.97；完美I/O设置下重塑增益大幅缩小（验证其针对输入扰动的针对性）；(2) 指令微调——Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct在OpenThoughts上，8种噪声设置下重塑均降低NLL（Muon和AdamW）；(3) 消融——基础路径重缩放贡献大部分增益，异常通道分离进一步提升；N=20极端设置下两组件仍有效；(4) 训练时与仅评估时重塑对比——训练+评估联合使用优于仅评估；(5) 噪声压缩诊断——基础路径重缩放输出噪声能量比约0.22-0.33，异常通道分离输入噪声方差比约0.61-0.82。

Conclusion: 本文提出的模拟LoRA适配方法通过输入重塑（基础路径重缩放+异常通道分离）和更新累积，有效缓解了AIMC硬件上有限DAC精度、输入噪声和有限电导态编程对LLM适配的影响，方法优化器无关，在多种模型（Llama-3-8B、Llama-3.2-1B-Instruct、Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct）和任务（QA、指令微调）上均展示出一致的NLL改进和F1/EM提升。局限：仅基于AIHWKit仿真，未测量物理设备行为、端到端延迟、能耗、编程成本和通信开销；部分压力测试为点估计。物理验证、更广泛设备覆盖和系统级评估是未来工作。

Abstract: Analog in-memory computing is a promising platform for on-device execution of large language models because it performs matrix--vector multiplications (MVMs) in memory and in parallel, reducing data movement. However, limited digital-to-analog converter precision, input noise, and finite conductance states can degrade model accuracy, while full-model retraining to address these effects can be costly. We develop an optimizer-agnostic, parameter-efficient adaptation method based on Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA), keeping the pretrained weights stored on analog arrays fixed while training the LoRA weights to adapt to downstream tasks and hardware non-idealities. Reliable adaptation requires handling errors in both forward and backward MVMs and physical weight updates. We use input reshaping to reduce input-induced MVM errors and update accumulation to retain small updates before programming them to finite-state analog devices. Across Llama-3.2-1B-Instruct and Llama-3-8B with both Muon and AdamW, input reshaping improves analog LoRA fine-tuning under noisy MVM computation. Update accumulation separately preserves sub-threshold updates and substantially improves adaptation under finite-resolution programming, including configurations with as few as 20 conductance states. Additional experiments show consistent held-out negative log-likelihood improvements across noisy analog settings.

</details>


### [436] [When Does Longer Reasoning Help? Predicting Mathematical Reasoning Through Discovery and Execution](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05322)
*Adib Hasan,Lay Jain,Thanic Nur Samin*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了Discovery–Execution（DE）框架，通过将策略发现与条件执行分离，利用短期预算的独立尝试与oracle-sketch条件运行，估计不同计算分配下的数学推理扩展曲线。实验在AOBench（含35道2026年奥赛题）与IMO-ProofBench Advanced的22道非几何题上评估四个模型，发现GPT系列执行接近饱和，SG几何外推即可预测；而Claude Opus 4.8从额外计算中获得显著执行增益，纳入执行测量大幅降低预测RMSE。R-DE的继续或重启策略亦获得低于模型特定回顾最佳固定动作的平均遗憾。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 测试时计算可提升数学推理能力，但能否用短期预算运行预测更长推理在更多计算下的表现尚不明确。两个成功率相同的求解器可能因瓶颈不同（策略发现或策略执行）对额外计算的响应迥异，因此需要将两者分离以预测扩展曲线。

Method: 将证明完成建模为策略发现（A）与条件执行（E）的卷积：s(K)=Σ p(k)·ε(K−k+1)。假设发现服从几何分布，从Parallel-8独立尝试估计q̂，从Oracle-Execution估计ε̂。提出DE与正则化版本R-DE（用Beta-Dirichlet先验拟合57题共享参数），对比SG、R-SG、SCT三种基线预测器，并用于继续/重启策略决策。引入AOBench（含人工审核参考证明与≤25字策略草图）。评估指标为各检查点累计解题数量的RMSE。

Result: 在N=1和N=2下，R-DE在Claude Opus 4.8上将RMSE从SG的7.16/9.16降至2.87/2.96，95%配对bootstrap区间显著大于零；对GPT-5.4与GPT-5.5（执行接近饱和），SG与R-SG已足够准确。Opus子集分析显示DE在执行未饱和子集上提升最显著（5.50→1.86）。继续/重启方面，R-DE平均遗憾1.50，低于最佳固定动作的1.79，always continue的4.30与always restart的2.13。跨问题迁移实验中Opus的R-DE从5.04降至3.40（加入测试oracle测量）。

Conclusion: 条件执行的测量为更长推理提供了短期成功率无法完全捕获的预测信息；DE框架在执行饱和时退化为几何缩放，在执行依赖额外计算时显著优于几何外推；R-DE的继续/重启决策可作为低遗憾的计算分配策略。局限性包括Muse模型首块成功率在不同分配间转移失败、57题样本与每题仅三条oracle轨迹限制精度、以及DE为预测性分解而非内部推理机制解释。

Abstract: Test-time compute can improve mathematical reasoning, but can short-budget runs predict how mathematical reasoning scales with additional compute? We introduce a Discovery--Execution (DE) framework that predicts the aggregate held-out scaling curves through a convolution of strategy discovery and conditional execution. From independent short-budget attempts and oracle-sketch-conditioned runs, the framework estimates cumulative success along held-out reasoning trajectories under alternate compute allocations. We evaluate four models on 35 fresh Olympiad problems and non-geometry problems from IMO-ProofBench Advanced. Under the DE framework, near-saturated execution predicts geometric scaling, as observed for the GPT models. For Claude Opus 4.8, incorporating measured execution substantially improves held-out forecasts over geometric extrapolation across one- and two-arm allocations. As a secondary application, regularized DE (R-DE) decisions to continue or restart yield lower average regret than the best model-specific retrospective policy. Together, these results show that measuring conditional execution provides information about longer reasoning that short-budget success rates do not always capture.

</details>


### [437] [Understanding the Weight Averaging Mechanism in LLM Training for Post-Training Quantization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05329)
*Hanzhang Wang,Tianqi Shen,Zonglin Liu,Junze He,Difan Zou,Ziye Ma*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文为LLM预训练中的权重平均机制建立了理论框架，用于指导预训练到后训练量化（PTQ）的过渡。作者将权重平均分解为时间滞后（temporal lag）与空间噪声（spatial noise）的权衡，推导出LNWA核族，并证明量化精度决定了两者间的最优平衡点。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 权重平均在经验上能改善预训练到PTQ的过渡效果，但缺乏理论理解，导致其增益不一致且脆弱。不同平均策略在高低精度PTQ下的性能排名可能反转，盲目应用无法保证改进，亟需统一的理论指导。

Method: 将每个保留权重分解为潜在均值μ_t（跨随机训练运行的期望）和零均值空间噪声ε_t。将权重平均后的偏离分解为时间滞后（牺牲训练进度）与空间噪声（随机波动的方差）的竞争权衡。通过在固定滞后预算下最小化保留噪声，导出LNWA核族的帕累托前沿闭式解。利用简化的GPTQ模型（含三角抖动舍入），将重建误差精确分解为量化前误差P_0和量化贡献γ_b·Q。证明：(1) 固定精度下存在有限噪声容忍区间τ_b，超出后误差增大；(2) 存在精度阈值b_crit，低于此值时偏好更少空间噪声，高于此值时偏好更少时间滞后。

Result: 理论结果：(1) LNWA核族参数化滞后-噪声权衡的完整帕累托前沿，包含LAWA、Stable端点及WMA等经典核作为特例；(2) 在固定精度下，滞后减少可补偿噪声增加直至阈值τ_b；(3) 精度阈值b_crit标记从去噪偏好到减滞后偏好的反转。实验在OPT-125M/350M/1.3B模型上，使用GPTQ和AWQ在W2/W3/W4下验证：NLL随LNWA系数先降后升（容忍-退化模式）；W2下PPL与系数正相关，W4下负相关（精度依赖偏好反转）；LNWA在OPT-1.3B上平均PPL低于两种LR衰减调度。

Conclusion: 本文为预训练到量化过渡中的权重平均建立了首个统一理论框架。提出的LNWA核族为不同PTQ条件下的平均策略选择提供了原则性指导，揭示了量化精度决定滞后-噪声最优平衡的本质机制，并通过LLM实验得到验证。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are typically pretrained in high precision but increasingly deployed with low-precision post-training quantization (PTQ). Recent studies have shown that using weight averaging during pretraining can improve PTQ performance compared with learning-rate decay, suggesting that it might provide a simple way to improve the pretraining-to-quantization transition. But the mechanism behind weight averaging remains insufficiently explained. This leads to inconsistent and fragile performance gains, thereby preventing practitioners from applying such a technique confidently. As a response, we formulate weight averaging as a trade-off between retaining training progress and improving robustness under perturbation. We further derive a continuous family of averaging kernels that unifies conventional strategies and achieves the Pareto frontier between the two competing goals. Critically, a theoretical framework for performing weight averaging under PTQ is developed.
