TL;DR: StagQ是一种用于大语言模型(LLM)权重量化的多精度格式，通过2位分组仿射基底加上1位精炼平面的二元步长调度实现。每个支持的精度都是一个可读前缀，由跨所有精度共享的元数据解码，无需逐权重查找。稀疏侧记录在网格拟合前后填充，保存网格服务最差的少数权重。在Llama-3.1-8B、Phi-4和OLMo-2-7B上，在2位精度时比最强的多精度基线MMLU高出3.1到7.0分；在3位精度时在Llama-3.1-8B上领先；在NVIDIA A100 GPU上批量为一的矩阵-向量乘法中，其内核在大多数形状-精度情况下比两个基线内核更快。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大型语言模型(LLM)在不同部署场景中需要多种权重精度运行点。传统的量化方法为每个精度存储单独的检查点，需要重复量化、验证和存储操作。多精度格式允许从一个数据流中提供所有精度，其中前缀是可读的较低精度代码，避免了存储多个副本的需求。本文旨在设计一种满足LLM权重路径约束的多精度嵌入式量化格式。

Method: StagQ框架由两部分组成：(1)稀疏侧记录P，用于存储被两个守卫(网格拟合前的预网格守卫和网格拟合后的后网格守卫)排除的极端权重；(2)主流，使用分组仿射2位基底(每个分组4级)，然后在二元步长调度上添加有符号的1位精炼平面t_k = s/2^(k-1)。数字映射φ_k(b) = 2b-1将存储位转换为数字。基础项和仿射解码仅使用每组存储的一对(lo, s)，不需逐权重查找。通过将基础和精炼平面字段在精度M处连接成一个普通整数u_M = q·2^(M-2) + Σb_k·2^(M-k)，然后应用仿射映射W_hat^(M) = lo_M + s_M·u_M来实现多精度解码，其中lo_M和s_M从存储的(lo, s)对导出。

Result: 在Llama-3.1-8B、Phi-4和OLMo-2-7B三个密集模型上评估StagQ-XXS和StagQ-XS两种配置。在2位精度时，StagQ-XXS在所有三个模型上以略低的逻辑速率领先最强多精度基线(MMLU提升3.1-7.0分)。在3位精度时，在Llama-3.1-8B上领先，在Phi-4上以更高速率领先，在OLMo-2-7B上持平。在4位精度时，以更高速率与所有三个模型持平。在A100 GPU上的批一矩阵-向量乘积中，StagQ内核在27个形状-精度情况中的23-24个比基线内核更快。端到端解码路径在18个比较中有14个更快。

Conclusion: StagQ能够从一个可读前缀的主流行中提供每个精度，通过一个仿射映射解码，无需逐权重查找。两个守卫将少量网格服务最差的权重保留在稀疏侧记录中。在Llama-3.1-8B、Phi-4和OLMo-2-7B上，StagQ-XXS在2位MMLU上以略低的逻辑速率领先最强多精度基线。在3位时在Llama-3.1-8B上领先，在Phi-4上以更高速率领先，在OLMo-2-7B上持平。从4位起，在MMLU上以更高速率与Any-Precision LLM持平。在合成权重上，矩阵-向量内核在大多数形状-精度情况下比两个基线内核更快。未来工作将扩展到更大模型和专家混合模型，并将内核投入生产服务。

Abstract: Serving a large language model (LLM) across a fleet of deployments requires several weight-precision operating points. Multi-precision formats serve them all from one stream whose prefixes are valid lower-precision codes, instead of storing multiple copies. We present StagQ, a multi-precision weight format whose main stream is a 2-bit group-wise affine base followed by a configurable number of 1-bit refinement planes on a dyadic step schedule. Every supported precision is a readable prefix, decoded by an affine map derived from metadata shared across all precisions, with no per-weight lookup. A sparse side record, filled both before and after the grid is fitted, holds out the few weights the grid serves worst. We report two configurations of the encoder. At two bits the cheaper one leads the strongest multi-precision baseline on Llama-3.1-8B, Phi-4, and OLMo-2-7B by 3.1 to 7.0 MMLU points, at a slightly lower logical rate. At three bits it leads on Llama-3.1-8B, leads on Phi-4 at a higher rate, and ties on OLMo-2-7B. At four bits it ties on all three, at a higher rate. In a batch-one matrix-vector product on an NVIDIA A100 GPU, timed on synthetic weights, our kernel is faster than the two baseline kernels in most shape-precision cases.

</details>


### [495] [Langevin Flow Maps: Efficient Molecular Dynamics and Transition Path Sampling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05998)
*Sam McCallum,Niklas Rindtorff,Alexander Tong,James Foster*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出Langevin Flow Maps（朗之万流映射），通过机器学习同时学习力场与随机朗之万积分器，实现大时间步长分子动力学模拟，准确恢复系统动态特性，速度比现有机器学习力场快一个数量级，并展示了对多种分子的可迁移性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统分子动力学需要小至飞秒级时间步来积分朗之万方程，难以高效估计长时间尺度的集合性质与转变动力学；现有机器学习力场虽加速了力场预测，但仍受限于小时间步。亟需一种能直接学习大时间步朗之万积分器的方法，以跨越时间尺度差距。

Method: 提出Langevin Flow Maps方法，将机器学习力场扩展为同时学习随机朗之万积分器（流映射），使模型在一次前向传播中跨越多个时间步进行状态更新，并在多样化分子数据集上训练以获得可迁移性。

Result: 实验表明，Langevin Flow Maps可使用大时间步长进行模拟，准确再现系统动态性质（如时间相关函数、转变速率等），运行速度比当前机器学习力场快约一个数量级，并在多种分子体系上展现出良好的迁移能力。

Conclusion: Langevin Flow Maps通过端到端学习力场与朗之万积分器，为跨时间尺度分子动力学模拟提供了一条可行路径，是构建可迁移、大时间步、机器学习驱动的分子模拟器的重要一步。

Abstract: Molecular dynamics simulations proceed by integrating the Langevin equations over many small femtosecond timesteps. This poses a challenge for estimating ensemble properties and transition dynamics that occur on much longer timescales. We introduce Langevin Flow Maps, which extend machine-learned force-fields to additionally learn the stochastic Langevin integrator. We show that Langevin Flow Maps enable large-timestep molecular dynamics and recover accurate dynamical properties of the system, while running an order of magnitude faster than current machine-learned force fields. Further, by training on a diverse molecular dataset, we demonstrate a path towards transferable Langevin Flow Maps.

</details>


### [496] [Learning While Scheduling Jobs under Context-Dependent Service Rates: An Anytime Rate-Optimal Algorithm](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06006)
*Seoungbin Bae,Dabeen Lee*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究上下文排队老虎机(CQB)中调度与学习联合问题，提出WISE算法(Widest Interval Selection with Elimination)，在每次足够大的时间t处实现率最优的Õ(t^{-1/2})队列长度遗憾，无需已知时间范围，且仅需容量松弛假设而非逐上下文松弛，无需协方差下界假设。同时给出了两个新的下界，并验证了在违反逐上下文松弛的场景下WISE仍能保持较小的遗憾。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有关于上下文排队老虎机的遗憾保证存在三个局限：(1)遗憾衰减率次优或需要已知固定时间范围；(2)需要逐上下文松弛(context-wise slack)条件，即对每个上下文最佳服务率均严格大于到达率；(3)需要特征协方差矩阵最小特征值严格为正。这些条件在云服务和LLM服务的实际场景中过于严格，亟需在更弱假设下实现任意时间(horizon-free)、率最优的学习-调度算法。

Method: 1)提出WISE算法：利用正则化逻辑回归最大似然估计维护置信区间，淘汰不可能最优的作业-服务器对，在保留候选中选择最宽置信区间；2)使用基于椭圆势计数的分析方法，通过工作负载势函数(workload potential)替代队列长度进行分析，在容量松弛下保证负漂移；3)将误差控制分为粗学习(基于区间计数的非空区间长度控制)和细学习(基于空轮次后到达作业的不确定性控制)两个阶段；4)对下界进行精化，明确到达率、特征维度d和服务器数量K对遗憾的影响。

Result: 上界：WISE实现R_t ≤ C_1 ε^{-9/2} p̄^{-4} β_t log²t √(λd log(e/λ)/t)，对充分大的t成立，率最优为Õ(t^{-1/2})且无需已知t。下界：精化的Ω(min{λ, min{d,log K}√(λ/t)})下界；新的Ω(ε^{-2} min{1, min{d,log K}/√t})下界量化了容量松弛减小对遗憾增长的影响。仿真显示WISE在9种设置中5种获得最小遗憾，且在违反逐上下文松弛的场景下仍保持小遗憾。

Conclusion: 本文首次在上下文排队老虎机中实现了无需已知时间范围、率最优Õ(t^{-1/2})的队列长度遗憾保证，且仅需容量松弛和逻辑边界性假设，无需协方差下界。WISE算法通过工作负载势函数和椭圆势计数的组合分析，克服了逐上下文松弛要求的局限，并通过淘汰-最宽区间选择规则高效平衡探索与利用。两个新的下界从不同维度(到达率依赖和容量松弛依赖)确认了上界的率最优性。实验验证了理论结果在实际场景中的有效性。

Abstract: We study contextual queueing bandits, where a learner schedules jobs while learning unknown service rates modeled by logistic functions of job-server features. Performance is measured by queue length regret, the expected excess queue length at round $t$ relative to an oracle that knows the service rates. Existing decaying-regret guarantees either have a suboptimal decay rate or require a known fixed horizon. They also assume context-wise slack and a strictly positive minimum eigenvalue of the feature covariance. In this paper, we propose WISE (Widest Interval Selection with Elimination), achieving rate-optimal $\widetilde{\mathcal O}(t^{-1/2})$ queue length regret at every sufficiently large time without knowing the horizon. We assume capacity slack, meaning that expected incoming workload under best-server service is below service capacity, and impose no covariance lower bound. Our analysis uses a workload potential measuring the expected service attempts needed by waiting jobs on their best servers. Its drift on nonempty rounds combines a negative term ensured by capacity slack with errors from suboptimal service choices. Then an elliptical potential count bounds how often WISE selects wide confidence intervals, thereby limiting the number of rounds with large service errors. We also sharpen the arrival-rate dependence of an existing lower bound and make its dependence on feature dimension and server count explicit. We prove another lower bound that quantifies the increase in regret as the normalized capacity slack decreases; to our knowledge, this is the first such lower bound for CQB. Simulations show small regret even when context-wise slack fails.

</details>


### [497] [Ultrasound Operator Guidance Using World Modeling and Retrieval Based Action Planning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06008)
*Noortje I.P. Schueler,Hans van Gorp,Ruud J.G. van Sloun*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出了一种基于检索的非参数潜在转移模型，将超声操作员引导问题建模为世界模型中的多步规划与检索任务。该方法使用V-JEPA 2.1编码器将超声观察映射到潜在空间，通过向量检索相似历史状态并复用真实记录的探针运动作为非参数转移算子，结合滚动时域规划为操作员提供六自由度探针运动指令。在颈动脉超声任务上，回顾性测试达到86%的目标视图到达率，前瞻性实时CPU部署也达到83%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 超声图像质量高度依赖操作员经验，而合格超声医师的供给远跟不上检查需求增长。现有引导方法多为单步动作预测或单步前向模型规划，无法对多步后果进行评估，在具有类间相似性和类内变异性的颈动脉等场景中表现有限。本文认为超声引导应被视为在已学习世界表征中的多步规划问题，而非单步动作预测。

Method: 方法核心包括三部分：(1) 基于V-JEPA 2.1微调的超声视频编码器f_θ将四帧超声片段映射为潜在状态z，并使用辅助视图分类、逆动力学、前向动力学三个训练期头塑造表征；另有独立的专用视图分类器ψ用于目标概率计算。(2) 非参数检索式潜在转移算子Γ_D：从历史数据库中检索当前潜在状态的K=10个余弦相似最近邻作为锚点，根据自适应帧步长沿同一采集序列的前向或后向真实转移采样，并将目标视图概率较高的方向作为后继状态，附带真实记录的SE(3)相对探针运动作为动作。(3) 滚动时域规划：以H=6为规划深度，递归应用Γ_D生成候选轨迹树，按车道(lane)分组并以N_lane=5为上限进行周期性剪枝；最终以综合代价J(τ)=λ_traj·J_traj+λ_mom·J_mom+λ_xstep·J_xstep选择最优轨迹，仅执行其首步动作，并随新观察重复规划。

Result: 数据集来自48名志愿者共247,827帧带6-DoF追踪位姿的颈动脉超声序列，按受试者划分为训练31/验证4/测试13。(1) 潜在空间分析：V-JEPA 2.1编码器在视图分类线性探测上取得0.81的平衡准确率，优于EchoJEPA(0.75)和ImageJEPA(0.52)；Top-10检索纯度0.69也最高；旋转动力学相关性最强(Pearson 0.41, Spearman 0.47)。T-SNE显示按视图聚类但不按受试者聚类。(2) 回顾性闭合循环导航：在所有测试志愿者和目标视图上，方法达到86%成功率，显著优于UltraSeP式单步动作预测(52%)和Cardiac Copilot式单步规划(43%)基线，且在最具挑战的纵向ICA和ECA视图上优势最大；运动平滑性也更好。(3) 消融实验：单步贪心规划仅76%成功率；多步规划在H=6时达到92%且回溯率最低；去除任一代价项都会降低性能；跨采集数据库检索优于单采集固定步长回放。(4) 患者特异帧导航：以余弦距离替代目标视图概率，79%成功率，中位平移误差0.65 cm、中位旋转误差4.5°。(5) 前瞻性可行性研究：3名新志愿者使用CPU蒸馏模型(规划深度H=3，MobileNetV3-Small+小型Transformer余弦相似度0.97)实时运行，方法达到83%目标视图可达率，优于Cardiac Copilot式基线72%。

Conclusion: 该工作验证了将超声操作员引导建模为在已学习世界模型中的多步滚动时域规划的有效性，使用检索而非参数化动力学作为前向转移算子，能够组合不同采集的局部兼容运动以生成数据库中不存在的轨迹。该框架对颈动脉等具有高类内变异和类间相似性的场景特别有效，并天然支持导航到任意可编码的潜在目标帧（包括患者特异性既往帧），可用于纵向可重复成像。局限性包括回顾性评估需将预测位姿投影到最近记录帧、单设备采集、单操作员前瞻研究，以及如何向操作员直观传达六自由度连续运动指导等。框架本身与模态无关，有望推广至心脏等其他超声引导任务。

Abstract: Ultrasound is widely used, but acquisition quality is heavily dependent on the operator's knowledge and expertise. With demand for examinations outpacing the supply of trained sonographers, operator-guidance systems aim to close this gap by instructing a less trained user how to move the probe toward a target view. In this paper, we propose a retrieval-induced latent transition model for ultrasound acquisition dynamics, formulating ultrasound operator guidance as multi-step planning and retrieval in a world model. Using a V-JEPA 2.1 backbone, observations are first encoded into a latent space where anatomically related views lie close together. We then retrieve similar views from a reference database containing encoded latent states and corresponding probe positions and orientations. Rather than learning a parametric transition function, we directly use physically executed transitions from the database to establish our nonparametric, retrieval-induced transition model that supports receding-horizon planning. At deployment, guidance is generated from the live ultrasound image feed alone, without any probe tracking hardware. Applied to carotid ultrasound, the proposed planner reaches the target view in 86% of retrospective closed-loop episodes, versus 52% and 43% for representative baselines, outperforming both on every target view, including the challenging longitudinal internal and external carotid artery views. A prospective feasibility study on unseen volunteers, run in real time on a CPU using distillation, reaches 83% target-view reachability. Because planning is driven by proximity to any encodable goal latent, the same world model can navigate back to any previously acquired, patient-specific frame, supporting reproducible longitudinal imaging for e.g. perioperative or follow-up monitoring.

</details>


### [498] [Spectral Geometry of Attention: From Information Routing to Uncertainty](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06012)
*Giulio Viganò,Simone Melzi,Maks Ovsjanikov*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出Token Difference Operator (TDO)框架，将注意力头视为Hilbert空间之间的函数映射，通过内禀概率几何区分汇点效应与路由能力，并基于此设计单次前向的不确定性估计器SAUQ。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的欧几里得谱分析方法受注意力汇点（attention sinks）系统性偏置的影响，将质量集中与真实路由能力混为一谈；同时，概率型不确定性估计在远距离任务中会在logits之前压缩任务相关差异。需要一个统一的算子理论框架来分离这些现象并支持长上下文场景下的不确定性量化。

Method: 将每个注意力头视为加权Hilbert空间 L²(μ)→L²(π) 之间的函数映射，定义Token Difference Operator D_{μ,π} = Ω_μ⁻¹ Aᵀ Ω_π A，证明其在欧氏几何下受sink偏置（σ₁≥1），而在内禀概率几何 π=1/n·1、μ=Aᵀπ 下变为非膨胀算子（λ₁=1对应常数函数）。由此得到均值-路由分解 AV=𝟏m+AV_c，并将谱熵H(output)与中心化谱衰减 λ_2(D_{μ,π}) 关联。基于此构建SAUQ：用归一化参与比 PR(D_{μ,π}) 作为单次前向路由信号，嵌入RAUQ的递归框架。

Result: 在LLaMA-3.1-8B上，PR(D_{μ,π}) 及中心化版本相对sink score的相关性显著低于原始注意力和欧氏谱基线，而与头部输出谱熵 H(AV) 的相关性更高；SAUQ在SAMSum和XSum上取得最佳均值PRR（0.5069），超越所有单次前向与基于样本的基线；在QA任务上具竞争力但非最优。Qwen2.5-7B上呈现类似的、与模型相关的结果。长上下文XSum中四分位输入长度下增益递增（+0.025→+0.170）。

Conclusion: TDO在单一算子理论框架内统一解释汇点、路由崩溃与输出维度；内禀概率几何将平凡常数模与受控中心模分离。SAUQ作为上游路由信号，在长程任务上补充概率型估计器；分析仍为单头单步，扩展到表征演化的完整动力学与跨头交互是自然的下一步。

Abstract: In this work, we study transformer attention through the lens of spectral geometry and operator theory. We view each attention head as a functional map between Hilbert spaces of functions on the token sequence and derive a Token Difference Operator, whose spectral structure controls how token-space information is routed to the output. We show that standard Euclidean spectra are structurally biased by sinks, conflating mass concentration with genuine routing capacity. By recasting token space in the intrinsic probability geometry induced by attention, the token difference spectrum disentangles sink effects from routing capacity and provides a spectral description of the dimensionality of the head output. This yields a unified framework for analyzing attention maps, explaining sinks, routing collapse, and output dimensionality within a single operator-theoretic framework. In practice, by grounding attention heuristics in spectral geometry, we develop a novel attention-based uncertainty estimator that complements probability-based scores, with the largest gains on long-context inputs.

</details>


### [499] [Joint Precision Neural Networks: Task-Aware Dependency and Predictive Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06023)
*Andrea Cavallo,Samuel Rey,Antonio G. Marques,Elvin Isufi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出Precision Neural Networks-Joint (PNN-Joint)框架，通过交替优化联合估计稀疏精度矩阵和图神经网络权重，以解决任务感知的图推断问题。同时提出了更广泛的Precision Neural Networks (PNNs)类别，作为基于精度矩阵的图卷积网络。论文建立了PNNs与PCA和VNNs之间的谱连接，证明了有限样本误差下的稳定性，并在合成数据、神经影像和运动传感器数据集上验证了其优越性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的协方差矩阵方法（PCA、VNNs）捕获直接和间接相关性，导致图结构密集且包含虚假连接。精度矩阵虽能显式编码条件独立性，但有限样本估计不稳定，且正则化估计器（如graphical lasso）与下游任务无关。现有联合图与GNN学习方法依赖启发式惩罚，缺乏对真实图的收敛保证，且未基于数据的基本统计矩。

Method: 核心方法包含三个层面：(1) Precision Neural Networks (PNNs)：将精度矩阵作为图移位算子的图卷积GNN类别；(2) PNN-Joint框架：通过引入辅助变量Θ̃并采用罚函数法松弛，联合最小化任务损失与graphical lasso惩罚，通过三步交替优化（更新Θ、更新Θ̃、更新网络权重w）求解；(3) 理论分析：基于Lipschitz精度滤波器，建立稳定性界，证明精度矩阵估计收敛到真实矩阵的速率依赖稀疏度S和偏差项。

Result: 理论结果：(1) 基于样本精度的PF扰动为O_P(PN/√T ‖x‖)；(2) 基于GL的PF扰动为O_P(P/√T · √((N+S)logN) ‖x‖)，在高维下优于样本估计；(3) PNN-Joint的精度估计误差为O_P(√((N+S)logN/T) + γξ/(1-α))；(4) 完整PNN架构的扰动按层数L和特征维度F放大。实验结果：在合成数据上PNN-Joint持续获得最低NMSE并更好地恢复精度矩阵；在6个真实数据集（ADNI1/2、PPMI、ABIDE、MHEALTH、REALDISP）上PNN-Joint在所有数据集上排名最佳或第二；在低数据场景下表现出显著的鲁棒性；学到的图在REALDISP上展示了任务感知可解释性（上肢vs下肢任务对应不同传感器连接）。

Conclusion: PNN-Joint通过交替优化成功地将下游任务目标与精度矩阵估计相结合，弥合了严格统计估计与任务感知深度学习之间的差距。PNNs扩展了图信号处理工具箱，以精度矩阵作为图移位算子，理论上具有有限的样本稳定性保证。框架在合成与真实数据上表现出优越的预测性能、数据稀缺场景下的鲁棒性以及与领域逻辑一致的图结构可解释性。未来工作包括通过随机化或草图精度估计器扩展到大规模维度，并将PNN框架扩展到条件依赖结构随时间演化的时序场景。

Abstract: Exploiting meaningful latent structures from data to solve downstream tasks is a fundamental challenge in signal processing and machine learning. While Principal Component Analysis (PCA) and coVariance Neural Networks (VNNs) successfully leverage the covariance matrix to process data, they inherently capture both direct and indirect correlations. The precision matrix (inverse covariance) overcomes this by explicitly encoding conditional independencies, making it largely studied in graphical lasso and graph topology identification. However, finite-sample precision estimates are notoriously unstable, and regularized estimators remain task-agnostic. In this work, our principal contribution is tackling the challenging problem of task-aware graph inference. We propose Precision Neural Networks-Joint (PNN-Joint), a framework that jointly estimates a sparse, statistically grounded precision matrix alongside graph neural network weights via an alternating optimization scheme. As a foundational framework to support this, we introduce Precision Neural Networks (PNNs), a broader class of graph convolutional networks operating on precision estimators, and establish their spectral connections to PCA and VNNs alongside their stability to finite-sample errors. Extensive empirical evaluations on synthetic data, as well as real-world neuroimaging and motion sensor datasets, demonstrate that PNN-Joint yields highly interpretable task-aware graphs, exhibits remarkable robustness in low-data regimes, and consistently achieves the best or second-best performance among competitors on real-world tasks.

</details>


### [500] [GO-Based Clustering for Learning Cluster-Level Causal Gene Regulatory Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06042)
*Azlaan Mustafa Samad,Wei Zhang,Adèle H Ribeiro*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 GO4CD 算法，利用基因本体论（GO）层次结构和功能注释将基因分组为具有生物学意义的簇，以解决基因调控网络（GRN）中集群级因果发现所需的可接受划分（admissible partition）难题。GO4CD 通过共享生物过程的基因共参与性构造簇，并通过真路径规则沿本体层次传播注释以实现多粒度划分，再结合 SCC 收缩消除簇级有向环。实验表明 GO4CD 在 E.coli 子网络上产生不可接受划分的比例仅为 18.1%，远低于语义相似度基线（65.3%–82.3%），且与 CLOC 算法结合后能显著提升骨架恢复精度并大幅降低条件独立性测试开销。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基因调控网络（GRN）的因果发现受限于高维度和密集连接，单基因级别的因果推断计算上不可行。将基因分组为功能模块可提高可处理性和可解释性，但现有集群级因果发现方法（如 CLOC）依赖预先给定的"可接受划分"，即簇间图必须无环。构造这样的生物学有意义且可接受的划分是一个未解决的开放问题，因为基因级 DAG 的无环性无法保证簇级无环性。

Method: GO4CD 算法：(1) 选定本体深度 d，提取该深度生物过程（BP）术语及其参与者基因集合；(2) 利用真路径规则将基因注释从深层传播到浅层祖先术语；(3) 通过共参与性构建"术语完整划分"（term-integral partition），即每个术语的参与者基因属于同一簇；(4) 利用 GO 中的调节关系（regulates）和注释边（acts_upstream_of）构建簇 GO 图；(5) 通过迭代收缩强连通分量（SCC）消除有向环。将 GO4CD 与 CLOC 算法集成，使用广义协方差测度（GCM）作为多元条件独立性测试方法。

Result: 在 RegulonDB 的 35 个 E.coli 子网络（50-1000 基因，5 个重复）上的 288 个实例评估中：GO4CD 仅在 18.1% 的实例上产生不可接受划分，而 Resnik/Lin/Wang 基线分别为 65.3%-82.3%。随机控制实验证实优势来自 GO 的基因分组而非簇大小分布。在 Oracle 模式下，GO4CD 在 11 个粒度箱中有 10 个获得最低 SHD，方向反转率仅 0.2%（基线为 10.0%-11.4%）。在基因表达数据上，GO4CD 在 24 个实例上的骨架恢复精度均优于基线，CI 测试调用量少 1.3-2.4 倍。所有不可接受实例均源于 GO 知识缺失（缺失注释或未记录边）。

Conclusion: GO4CD 有效弥合了 GRN 因果发现的抽象鸿沟，通过 GO 知识构造的划分在生物学上有意义且更可能满足因果发现的可接受性要求。未来工作将探索使用神经符号方法学习划分并应用于约束因果发现。

Abstract: Discovery of causal relationships in high-dimensional Gene Regulatory Networks (GRN) is computationally challenging and often difficult to interpret due to dense connections. Therefore, grouping genes together into functional modules can improve tractability and biological interpretability. However, existing cluster level causal discovery methods assume access to a predefined admissible partitions, requiring the graph over clusters to be acyclic. Constructing such partitions is therefore challenging. In this work, we introduce GO-based Clustering for Causal Discovery (GO4CD), an algorithm that uses Gene Ontology (GO) to construct biologically meaningful gene partitions at multiple levels of granularity, while favoring those more likely to be admissible for causal discovery. GO4CD groups together genes participating in a shared biological process, and propagates gene annotations through the ontology hierarchy to achieve different granularity of partitions. Furthermore, we integrate GO4CD with Causal Learning over Clusters (CLOC) algorithm and evaluate recovery of true Markov equivalence class both with an oracle of conditional independencies and on simulated gene expression data using multivariate conditional independence tests. We evaluate GO4CD on multiple this http URL regulatory subnetworks and find that it is inadmissible in 18.1% of the cases, compared with 65.3-82.3% for the semantic-similarity baselines. Our results indicate that GO4CD is substantially better suited to learning causal GRNs defined over biologically meaningful gene clusters.

</details>


### [501] [Pay to Learn, Share to Earn: Incentivized Federated Multi-Player Bandits](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06062)
*Pavamana K J,Chandramani Singh*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文针对联邦多玩家多臂老虎机（Federated Multi-Player MAB）问题，提出了一种激励感知的协作框架。在该框架中，自利玩家因向服务器共享本地观测而获得奖励，同时在向服务器购买信息时需支付成本。作者设计了基于UCB的Buying-UCB算法，将购买成本纳入探索-利用权衡决策中。理论上证明了群组遗憾和购买成本的上界，并刻画了完全协作联邦学习与完全独立学习之间的权衡，实验验证了不同协作与定价机制下的有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有联邦老虎机框架通常假设玩家愿意无偿共享观测，但实际中自利玩家需要明确激励才会参与协作，否则会产生搭便车行为，减缓整体学习进程。因此需要设计一种将激励机制融入学习过程的算法，使玩家在协作收益与信息购买成本之间做出理性决策。

Method: 1. 系统建模：构建激励感知的联邦MAB框架，玩家共享观测获得奖励S，购买信息支付成本B，以累积效用最大化为目标。2. 算法设计（Buying-UCB）：玩家为每条臂维护UCB索引，基于"有效观测数"（本地观测+已购买的他者观测）计算；引入置信集C_{p,t}(α)筛选最优性未确定的臂；购买条件为置信区间缩减比 ≥ √(B+1)，等价于新增他者观测数 ≥ B·N_{p,k}(t)。3. 理论分析：基于Hoeffding不等式与Type-I/Type-II决策分类，推导群组遗憾和购买成本上界。

Result: 1. 群组遗憾上界为 O(N·min{M, B+1}·log T + MNB log log T)，其中min{M, B+1}项刻画协作程度。2. 个体购买成本上界为 O(B log T)，最优臂购买复杂度 O(log T)，次优臂 O(log log T)。3. 当B→∞时退化为独立学习的O(M log T)；当B=0时达到完全联邦协作的O(log T)。4. 服务器利润关于B非单调，存在最优中间价格，随玩家数M增大而提高（实验中M=20时B≈10，M=50时B≈45）。5. 实验验证了Buying-UCB在不同购买成本和玩家数下均优于独立UCB基线。

Conclusion: 该工作成功将经济激励机制融入联邦多玩家老虎机问题，提出的Buying-UCB算法在协作收益与信息成本之间实现自适应权衡，理论上完整刻画了从完全协作到完全独立的光谱过渡，为实际联邦决策系统提供了兼顾效率与激励相容的解决方案。

Abstract: Federated multi-player multi-armed bandit problems model collaborative sequential decision-making where multiple players interact with a common bandit environment and share information through a central server to accelerate learning. Existing federated bandit frameworks typically assume that all players willingly share their local observations with the server. However, this assumption is often unrealistic in practical settings where players are self-interested and may not participate in collaboration without explicit incentives. To address this challenge, we propose an incentive-aware federated bandit framework in which players receive rewards for sharing information with the server and incur costs when buying information from the server. We develop a UCB-based algorithm, termed Buying-UCB, that balances individual exploration and collaborative learning by incorporating both sharing incentives and information acquisition costs into the learning process. We theoretically analyze the proposed algorithm and derive upper bounds on the group regret and buying cost. Our analysis further characterizes the trade-off between fully collaborative federated learning and completely independent learning. Extensive numerical experiments validate the theoretical findings and demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed framework under different collaboration and pricing regimes.

</details>


### [502] [Rethinking Least-Core Computation in Contextual-Distractor Games](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06087)
*Hiroshi Kera,Toshinori Yamauchi,Sai Ganesh Nagarajan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文重新审视最小核心（least-core）计算在上下文干扰物（contextual-distractor）博弈中的归因问题，指出选择器（selector）选择和联盟采样对归因结果有显著影响。提出了熵最小核心（ELC），一种平滑近似方法，其唯一最小化解随温度收敛到核仁（nucleolus），兼具高精度与计算效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 最小核心作为Shapley值的替代方案，能识别在罕见高价值上下文中造成重大伤害的"上下文干扰物"。然而最小核心分配通常不唯一，不同选择器会产生不同的解释。现有工作多使用最小范数选择器作为默认标准，且常依赖联盟采样加速，但这些选择对干扰物识别的影响未被充分研究。此外，核仁选择器虽更符合最小核心思想，但计算昂贵。

Method: 提出熵最小核心（ELC）：用log-sum-exp函数替代最小核心LP中的硬最大化目标，得到一个凸可微的平滑近似。对于每个温度η>0，ELC有唯一最小化解，通过投影梯度下降（结合Nesterov加速）求解，可利用GPU加速。通过退火策略（从η=1到0.002的九个阶段）逐步逼近核仁。理论上证明了ELC路径在η→0⁺时收敛到核仁（基于Alvarez 2000的指数惩罚定理）。

Result: 在合成博弈中：ELC在最小核心值精度上达到10⁻³量级；在准确性匹配核仁方面比逐次LP核仁求解器更快。在上下文干扰物游戏中：使用全联盟时，ELC和最小范数选择器均达到完美的干扰物识别平均精度，但ELC在按危害程度排序干扰物方面更准确。联盟采样会显著降低干扰物识别能力，但对有用玩家的识别影响较小。在训练数据估值任务中，ELC在几乎所有对比中优于最小范数最小核心和Shapley值。GPU加速在较大规模问题上效果显著（n=24时GPU ELC全部完成而CPU ELC全部超时）。

Conclusion: 选择器选择对最小核心归因至关重要，核仁是识别上下文干扰物的最有效选择器。联盟采样会损害干扰物识别能力。ELC提供了一种计算上可行的核仁近似方法，同时作为其自身的选择器（区别于最小范数选择器）。ELC在测试游戏中与最小范数选择器在识别精度上匹配，但在按危害排序方面更优，且计算效率高于逐次LP核仁求解器，具有GPU加速潜力。未来工作方向包括：设计保留干扰物识别能力的采样方法，以及探索受益于上下文干扰物识别的具体应用任务。

Abstract: Game-theoretic attribution explains a model by assigning credit to its features or training examples. The least core has attracted interest as an alternative to Shapley-style averaging because it can expose players that cause substantial harm in rare, high-value contexts. However, least-core allocations are generally nonunique, and the choice of allocation can affect the resulting explanation. In this study, we investigate how payoff selection and coalition sampling affect least-core attribution. Our experiments show that selector choice matters for distinguishing useful and harmful contributions, and that sampling can degrade harmful-player identification across the tested selectors even when useful players remain well identified. These observations motivate efficient computation with all coalition constraints and a well-defined selector. We introduce entropic least core (ELC), a smooth approximation whose unique minimizer follows a continuous path along the temperature to the nucleolus, a classical refinement of the least core. Our experiments show that ELC approximates the nucleolus faster than an LP-based nucleolus solver while retaining small payoff errors, with further GPU acceleration at larger problem sizes. In the tested full-coalition contextual-distractor games, ELC matches the minimum-norm selector in identification accuracy and more accurately ranks distractors by harm.

</details>


### [503] [Lossy Compression of PDE Training Inputs: Field Reconstruction Error Does Not Order the Cost to a Trained Operator](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06095)
*Huy Hoang Le*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文证明PDE算子学习训练中，输入场的传统"场重建误差"作为压缩容差标准并不可靠。原因是解算子会衰减输入扰动，该衰减量（传输因子κ）在不同PDE家族间跨越两个数量级以上，使得从场统计设定的容差无法预测训练后算子的实际精度。作者提出了一种"探针"方法，仅需一次全精度训练，通过前向传播测量传输因子，用以低成本排序数据集与压缩率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着算子学习基准（如PDEBench）达到TB级别，对输入场进行有损压缩成为节省存储的迫切需求。然而，率失真理论仅描述存储字段所需的比特数，并未告知从业者"在压缩数据上训练的算子精度如何"。而传统上用场重建误差作为压缩容差标准可能因为忽略解算子的平滑特性而严重误判下游性能。

Method: 核心方法是"探针"（probe）：训练一个全精度算子，然后将压缩输入通过该算子做前向传播，测量输出位移相对于输入扰动的比例——即传输因子 κ。该传输因子通过一次全精度训练即可获得整个率曲线。结合算子自身误差 ε₀，构造估计函数 cost̂ = √(1+(T/ε₀)²) 作为下游成本的预测器。该方法基于间接源编码理论（Wolf-Ziv），并辅以理论验证与七种机否证实验。

Result: 在104个跨家族比较中，场重建误差逆转了36个比较（35%），而探针仅逆转12个（12%），分离具有统计显著性与稳定性。即使使用相对L²目标训练（与基准方法一致），探针仍表现更佳（11 vs 20次逆转）。传输因子在六个PDE家族间跨越160倍量级，从对流的0.97-1.12到强反应-扩散的0.007-0.030。然而，探针的量值不跨编解码器或架构转移：内部DCT编解码器最坏ρ为2.85×，跨编解码器时可达4.77×。该论文预注册38个假设验证，15个未通过。作者明确否定场误差是测量噪声造成的解释：需要2.38 log单位噪声才能解释观察，但内部一致性数据仅允许0.16。

Conclusion: 场重建误差作为跨数据集的算子学习训练输入接受标准是不可靠的。算子学习研究中的传输因子（衰减量）是一个更稳定的对象——其家族级中位数排序在三种训练目标下保持不变。对于存储管理者而言，实际建议是：(1) 逐数据集而非逐档案设置容差；(2) 在选择容差前测量传输特性；(3) 检查预算是否更应花在精度还是样本上。在某些PDE家族（如对流）上，预算花在精度上比花在样本上更佳，这推翻了一味推荐压缩的默认假设。

Abstract: Operator-learning benchmarks are stored at full precision and have grown to terabyte scale. Rate-distortion theory says how many bits the stored field needs, while a practitioner needs to know how accurate an operator trained on the compressed data will be. We show that the first does not determine the second, and measure why, compressing the input fields while targets and test inputs stay at full precision. A solution operator attenuates a perturbation of its input. Pushing a compressed field through a surrogate already trained at full precision measures how much of the perturbation that surrogate transmits. The fraction is consistent with the smoothing behaviour of the underlying equation, and it spans more than two orders of magnitude across PDE families. Field reconstruction error is computed before the attenuation and cannot see it. For operators trained with mean squared error it inverts 36 of 104 cost comparisons across datasets, where a probe built from the same forward passes inverts 12. Two families that PDEBench stores with identical initial conditions differ threefold downstream at identical field error. Under the relative-L2 objective of the reference recipe the separation narrows, while the ordering of the family-level median transmission factors is unchanged. After one full-precision training run, the probe evaluates an entire rate curve by forward passes alone. It ranks datasets and rates consistently across the codecs and architectures we test, while its magnitude does not transfer between them.

</details>


### [504] [Flash-OPD: Fast On-Policy Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06105)
*Wei Chen,Junle Chen,Yitong Yang,Zhaoyang Xu,Jiaxin Lin,Yuxuan Liang,Xiaofang Zhou,Kai Wang,Rui Chen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出Flash-OPD，一种用于加速on-policy蒸馏（OPD）训练的框架。它通过在生成过程中进行自适应的逐轨迹边界验证（而非预先设定或周期性调整共享的rollout长度），解决了teacher-student兼容性在不同轨迹间差异显著的问题。实验证明，Flash-OPD在保持或提升准确率的同时，相比标准OPD实现了2.2×至7.5×的加速。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: On-policy distillation (OPD) 通过在学生生成的轨迹上提供密集的教师监督，缓解了训练-推理不匹配问题，并成为大语言模型后训练的重要组成部分。然而，生成长轨迹并对其进行评估带来了高昂的训练成本。现有加速方法（如通过开环调度或闭环自适应来控制rollout长度）都面临一个核心问题：它们对整个批次施加一个共享的rollout长度，而不同轨迹的teacher-student兼容性差异巨大，导致统一的horizon难以匹配异构的可靠长度——过短会截断有用监督，过长则浪费计算。

Method: Flash-OPD 将OPD加速从“horizon控制”转变为“自适应的逐轨迹边界验证”。其核心洞察是：轨迹的可靠性边界（usable length）在采样前未知，但可以从已观察到的前缀中精确判断是否已达到。方法定义：将teacher-student top-k重叠低于阈值（η）视为“低兼容性事件”，并将累积事件数首次达到预算B的位置定义为可靠性边界。算法交替进行：(i) 生成至验证点（使用prefix caching避免重解码）；(ii) 教师验证并更新精确累计计数；(iii) 若累计计数≥B或达到长度上限则停止，否则基于最近窗口内的事件率估计λ̂来调度下一个验证位置。关键分离：估计的事件率仅用于安排何时验证，而停止决策始终依赖于精确的累计计数，从而防止估计误差导致过早终止。

Result: 在多种数据集（DAPO-Math-17K）和四组不同的teacher-student配置（DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen系列、Qwen3系列）下，Flash-OPD相比标准OPD实现了2.2×–7.5×的加速，同时保持或提高了准确性。具体而言：(1) 在Qwen3-1.7B-Base/Qwen3-4B设置下达到7.14×加速，在Qwen3-4B-Base/Qwen3-4B设置下达到7.52×加速并伴随显著准确率提升（40.09→40.37, 8.59→8.90, 15.85→19.20）；(2) 在域外迁移测试中，Qwen3-4B-Base设置下平均提升+5.84分；(3) 在跨代际迁移（R1-1.5B←Qwen3-4B）中达到8.71×加速且准确率匹配（28.45 vs 28.34）；(4) 随教师规模从4B扩展到32B，每步时间增长仅为26.5s（vs OPD的100.6s），展现了良好的可扩展性；(5) 对超参数η、B、ρ的扰动表现出鲁棒性。

Conclusion: Flash-OPD通过从"horizon控制"转向"边界验证"，有效解决了OPD中batch级共享rollout长度与轨迹级可靠性边界之间的粒度不匹配问题。该方法在保持监督完整性的同时显著降低计算开销，且具有跨教师规模、跨模型家族和跨域的良好迁移性。理论分析证明了停止保证（不会在真实边界之前终止），复杂性分析表明验证轮次为对数量级。未来工作将扩展到多教师在线策略蒸馏和智能体任务。

Abstract: On-policy distillation (OPD) provides dense teacher supervision on student-generated trajectories, but generating and evaluating long rollouts incurs substantial training cost. Existing acceleration methods reduce this cost through open-loop rollout schedules or closed-loop horizon adaptation. However, supervision compatibility can vary substantially across trajectories, making a single rollout horizon difficult to match their heterogeneous reliable lengths: an overly short horizon may truncate useful supervision, while an overly long one wastes computation beyond reliable regions. Our key insight is that the trajectory-specific reliability boundary need not be predicted before generation. By viewing reliability as the first-passage of accumulated low teacher--student compatibility events, the boundary is inherently unknown before sampling, yet whether it has been reached can be determined exactly from the observed prefix. Building on this insight, we propose *Flash-OPD*, which shifts from rollout-horizon control to adaptive trajectory-level boundary verification. *Flash-OPD* interleaves cached generation with teacher verification and independently stops each trajectory according to its observed compatibility events. To reduce verification overhead, the recent event rate is used only to schedule the next verification point, while the actual stopping decision always relies on the exact cumulative count. This separation prevents estimation errors from causing premature termination while enabling efficient verification during generation. Extensive experiments across diverse datasets and teacher--student settings show that *Flash-OPD* achieves $2.2\times$--$7.5\times$ speedups over standard OPD while maintaining or improving accuracy.

</details>


### [505] [ORCA: The Annealed Spectral Conditioning Optimizer for Faster, Better LLM Training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06116)
*Yuanshi Liu,Boyuan Jiang,Liang Hou,Xin Tao,Pengfei Wan,Zhouchen Lin,Cong Fang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: ORCA（Orthogonal Regularization, Cooled After）是一种用于大语言模型训练的极简优化器干预方法，通过在训练早期施加短暂但较强的软正交正则化，随后完全释放，使权重在早期受益于更宽的谱结构，后期则可自由适应任务。在LLaMA、Qwen3和细粒度MoE等架构（130M至8B参数）上，ORCA比Muon获得更低的最终验证损失，且开销极小。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现代LLM优化器如Muon倾向于产生较高有效秩的权重矩阵，但进一步施加谱控制带来的收益有限。作者发现这背后存在张力：集中的谱会抑制耦合权重矩阵中的梯度方向、减慢优化；而在整个训练中维持约束则会限制任务适应性并抬高可达损失下界。因此需要一种"先塑形再释放"的策略，平衡路径侧加速与终点侧表达力。

Method: ORCA在Muon基础上增加一个软正交正则项 R_orth(W) = (1/4)‖WW⊤ − I‖_F²，其梯度倾向于将奇异值推向一致，从而提高有效秩。该项仅在训练前 τ=25% 步数内以强度 γ=1 激活，到达切换点后硬性移除，恢复标准Muon更新。算法仅增加两次矩阵乘法（相比Muon的24次Newton-Schulz迭代增加约8.3%），释放后无额外开销。方法可推广到其他早期谱干预（如DiagSVD、Pion-start）。

Result: 在LLaMA 130M–1.3B（25B–100B tokens）、Qwen3 160M–0.6B、MoE 0.8B–8B（25B–100B tokens）上，ORCA一致降低最终验证损失，相对Muon降低约0.019–0.04，与Muon相对Adam的增益相当或更大。LLaMA 1.3B上ORCA以60k步达到Muon 100k步的损失（1.66× token效率）。下游任务（ARC、HellaSwag、PIQA、WinoGrande）全面优于Muon。四随机种子验证稳定性更好（方差降低约一个数量级）。消融证实：早期窗口 [0, 0.25T) 最优；保留的高有效秩与最终增益呈剂量-响应关系；WSD与余弦调度下均有效；收益不依赖释放时携带的优化器状态。

Conclusion: ORCA展示了"塑形-释放"原则的有效性：早期短暂的正交正则能塑造优化轨迹并留下持续效益，而后续释放则让谱自由适应任务。这揭示了一个时间设计原则——谱控制应在早期塑形而非持续约束。文章希望这种"先塑形后释放"的视角能启发未来优化器设计。

Abstract: Modern LLM optimizers such as Muon often produce weight matrices with higher effective rank than Adam, yet further spectral control has delivered only modest gains. We identify a tension behind this result: concentrated spectra can suppress gradient directions in coupled weight matrices and slow optimization, while constraints maintained throughout training can limit task-specific adaptation and raise the attainable loss floor. We introduce ORCA (Orthogonal Regularization, Cooled After), a minimal optimizer intervention that applies strong but temporary soft orthogonality regularization early in training, then removes it. This allows the weights to benefit from a broader spectrum early on and adapt freely afterward. Across LLaMA, Qwen3, and fine-grained mixture-of-experts models ranging from 130M to 8B parameters, ORCA achieves lower final validation loss than Muon. Its loss reduction relative to Muon matches or exceeds Muon's reduction relative to Adam. Ablations support the early-shaping, later-release design. Further, ORCA requires no architectural changes and adds minimal overhead.

</details>


### [506] [Mind the Drift: Diagonal Linear Networks Under Large Learning Rates](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06120)
*Aniket Sanyal,Tom Jacobs,Rebekka Burkholz*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文针对对角线性网络中大学习率训练的动力学行为,系统分析了"漂移(Drift)"与"增益(Gain)"两种隐式偏差的竞争机制,揭示了大学习率不仅会损害稀疏解的恢复,反而可通过调控隐式偏差来获得更稀疏、更尖锐的解。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在大学习率下,神经网络的训练轨迹远离经典的梯度流行为,进入"稳定性边缘"(Edge of Stability, EoS)阶段。然而,离散化效应对模型选择(尤其是稀疏解恢复)的影响机制尚不清晰。Even等人(2023)已研究过"增益(Gain)",但对隐式正则器中参考点偏移的作用未深入探讨。本文旨在填补这一空白,系统研究大学习率下影响稀疏解恢复的隐式偏差。

Method: 1. 在对角线性网络框架下,显式分解隐式正则器为双曲熵势函数(由Gain控制曲率)与线性修正项(由Drift控制方向偏好)。
2. 定义Drift增量d(z),证明累积漂移与累积增益的竞争关系(Gain-Drift分解,命题2.3)。
3. 推导出新的稀疏恢复定理(定理2.4),使用NSP(零空间性质)条件给出L1误差界。
4. 分别在渐进锐化阶段(引理2.5)和EoS振荡阶段(引理2.6)刻画Drift与Gain的不同累积行为。
5. 构造最小化的二维/三维示例,解析追踪Gain与Drift的符号反转。
6. 设计"增益控制(GC)"方案(定义3.1),通过修正权重更新使Gain在坐标间重新分配,从而逆转支持坐标的相对惩罚。
7. 给出GC方案在适当步长下的收敛性证明(定理3.4及附录C.3)。
8. 实验验证:在无噪声稀疏回归和DeiT-Small+ImageNet(注意力Q-K奇异值)上测试。

Result: 1. **理论发现**:Gain与Drift在EoS的不同阶段呈现竞争行为——在渐进锐化阶段两者均累积,但Drift可使优化偏向稀疏尖锐解;在振荡阶段Drift饱和、Gain继续累积,后者会持续惩罚支持坐标,破坏稀疏性。
2. **稀疏恢复界**:‖β̂-β⋆‖₁ ≤ (1+c)A_{S^c}·sinh(cR_S + ‖D_{S^c}‖∞),其中R_S由目标β⋆、有效初始化和Drift共同决定。
3. **示例分析**:在3维示例中,不同残差区间(GainDir)产生不同的稀疏/密集偏好方向;两种隐式偏差在两个极点处方向反转。
4. **GC方案效果**:在(n,d)=(48,768)、4-稀疏教师的无噪声回归中,GC显著优于GD和SGD,即使在EoS振荡区也能恢复稀疏教师;学习率为0.35时,GC恢复误差远低于(S)GD。
5. **探索性实验**:在DeiT-Small+ImageNet(Muon优化器)上,Q-K矩阵的累积Drift在早期快速累积后趋于平稳,而Gain持续增长;Drift更大的运行配置获得更低的有效秩,提示该机制可能推广到现代架构。

Conclusion: 本文识别并形式化了"漂移(Drift)"这一被忽视的离散化效应量,证明其与已知的"增益(Gain)"共同决定大学习率下梯度下降的隐式偏差。两者在不同训练阶段呈现此消彼长的竞争关系:渐进锐化阶段Drift可抵消Gain对支持坐标的惩罚,有利于稀疏恢复;EoS振荡阶段Drift饱和、Gain独占累积,倾向于密集平坦解。基于这一洞察,作者提出的"增益控制(GC)"方案能够主动重新分配Gain,从而在大学习率下实现更稀疏的恢复。该工作揭示了大学习率并不必然损害稀疏性,反而可作为调控模型选择的工具;初步的Q-K奇异值实验为将该理论延伸至现代Transformer训练提供了支持。

Abstract: Large learning rates can qualitatively change the trajectory of neural network training, often pushing optimization into regimes far from classical gradient-flow behavior. The Edge of Stability (EoS) offers a valuable lens on the dynamics such learning rates induce. We study corresponding dynamics in diagonal linear networks, where we uncover a competition between two distinct implicit biases that jointly determine the sparsity of the recovered solution in regression settings. Complementary to the Gain, which captures the average discretization error accumulated by Gradient Descent relative to Gradient Flow, we derive a closely associated but overlooked quantity: the Drift. Under large learning rates, it describes an imbalance between different discretization errors and represents a systematic shift in the optimization trajectory. While the Gain grows monotonically in certain regimes, and can bias towards denser, flatter interpolators, the impact of the Drift depends on its alignment with potential solutions, which can either counteract or reinforce the effect of the Gain. Consequently, its behavior drives model selection, particularly during early training epochs. To validate our theoretical insights, we introduce an intervention that actively steers the Gain to recover sharper, sparser solutions. Thus, our analysis reveals that large learning rates do not universally hinder the recovery of sparse solutions. On the contrary, they can be harnessed to control the implicit bias of training.

</details>


### [507] [Integrating Survival-Based Aging Models with Data-Driven RUL Prognostics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06128)
*Abhishek Srinivasan,Juan Carlos Andresen,Sepideh Pashami,Anders Holst*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种概率融合框架，将基于磨损的生存模型（Weibull）与基于传感器数据的深度学习模型（1D-CNN）通过失效概率分布进行融合，用于更可靠的剩余使用寿命（RUL）预测。在N-CMAPSS数据集上的实验表明，融合模型在点估计精度、排序一致性（C-index）和预测区间校准方面均优于单一模型，并能根据各组件的相对不确定性自适应地在两种信息源之间切换。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 预测性维护需要可靠的RUL估计，但现有的两类主流方法——基于累积磨损的寿命模型和基于瞬时传感器信号的数据驱动模型——各自只能捕捉退化过程的部分信息，尚未被有效整合。论文旨在通过显式的结构假设和概率融合机制，弥合可靠性工程中的生存分析方法与PHM领域的数据驱动RUL预测之间的鸿沟。

Method: 1. 结构假设：建立图模型 W→H→{F, S}，即累积磨损W影响隐健康状态H，H同时决定失效F和传感器观测S；假设H与F确定性等价，且W与S在给定H时条件独立。2. 概率推导：在该假设下应用贝叶斯规则推导出融合规则 P(F|W,S) ∝ P(F|W)·P(F|S)/P(F)。3. 组件实现：磨损组件采用参数化Weibull生存模型（最大似然估计），传感器组件采用1D-CNN估计RUL均值μ̂(S)，再用独立密集网络以Huber损失估计异方差不确定性σ̂(μ̂(S))，构成截断高斯分布；基线分布P(F)采用MTBF倒数作为常危险率的指数分布。4. 融合：在剩余寿命网格上对三者乘积进行数值归一化得到融合失效密度。

Result: 在N-CMAPSS的DS01、DS03、DS04三个子集上（10次重复实验），融合模型的RMSE在三组数据集上均最低（如DS04: 9.24 vs Weibull 9.26 vs 1D-CNN 17.33），NIPW最优（区间更窄且校准良好），C-index与最优单一模型相当。误差分析显示，融合模型在寿命早期由Weibull主导，接近失效时逐渐转向1D-CNN预测；消融实验（人为缩放传感器标准差）证实融合行为由相对预测不确定性驱动，符合公式(1)的概率机制。

Conclusion: 该工作提供了一个模型无关的概率融合机制，可将工业场景中已有的生存分析实践与先进的数据驱动RUL模型有机结合。融合框架在准确性、排序一致性和区间锐度/校准之间取得良好平衡，并能依据不确定性自然实现寿命周期内的自适应切换，为从传统可靠性方法向AI驱动的预测性维护渐进过渡提供了结构化路径。未来工作需在真实工业数据上验证、处理假设违反情况（如EOH与物理退化的不对应、W与S的条件独立性不成立）以及检验不确定性校准质量。

Abstract: Predictive maintenance requires reliable remaining useful life (RUL) estimation. Existing methods mainly follow two paradigms: wear-based aging models that capture cumulative degradation and sensor-driven data models that reflect instantaneous health conditions, each providing only partial information. In this work, we propose a probabilistic fusion framework that integrates wear-based and sensor-based prognostic components through failure probability distributions. Based on explicit structural assumptions linking wear, latent health, sensor observations, and failure, we derive a principled combination rule that enables uncertainty-aware integration with adaptive weighting of the components. Experimentally, we assess this combination rule by learning the wear-based component using a parametric survival model and the sensor-based component using a 1D convolutional neural network (1D-CNN) with a post-hoc uncertainty model. Evaluation on multiple N-CMAPSS datasets demonstrates that the fused model improves point accuracy, preserves the C-index, and produces narrower yet well-calibrated prediction intervals compared to either component alone. The results highlight the complementary roles of wear-based survival model and sensor-based deep learning model, and show that their probabilistic integration provides a structured pathway toward more robust and consistent prognostics over the life-time.

</details>


### [508] [Co-Optimizing Graph Sparsification and Approximate Computing for Energy-Efficient FPGA-Based GCN Inference](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06138)
*Nathaniel Kaye Mellor,Shreejith Shanker,George Floros*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一种面向边缘FPGA平台的GCN推理加速器，联合优化图稀疏化（DSpar）、8位定点量化和近似乘法器。核心发现是近似乘法的有效性受聚合深度（即图中节点平均度）支配——图稀疏化通过降低聚合深度提升了近似乘法器的可行性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: GCN部署在资源受限的边缘设备上面临稀疏邻接矩阵带来的不规则访存和计算瓶颈。现有FPGA加速器主要针对稀疏访存模式优化，但图稀疏化与近似算术的协同优化尚未被探索。

Method: 基于AMD Kria KV260 FPGA，使用Vitis HLS实现两阶段流水线架构：(1) 采用64×64分块、k→i→j执行顺序和DATAFLOW指令的GEMM引擎完成稠密特征变换；(2) 基于CSR格式的SpMM引擎完成邻域聚合。离线使用DSpar按节点度感知概率p_e ∝ 1/d_u + 1/d_v移除边；近似乘法器（来自EvoApproxLib的1KV8/1L2J/1L2N三种变体）仅替换第一层SpMM阶段的乘法运算，保留累加器宽度。

Result: 在Cora（平均度4.9）、LastFM Asia（8.3）、Amazon Photo（32.1）三个数据集上：(1) Amazon Photo取得最高9.88×加速比，保持86.6%准确率（FP32基线88.9%）；(2) Cora获得1.52×加速，准确率78.3%；(3) 资源占用16.2% LUT、8.9% FF、28.1% BRAM、23.2% DSP，总功耗0.668W；(4) 验证了"图越稠密，近似乘法对精度越敏感，稀疏化恢复效果越显著"的假设。

Conclusion: 图稀疏化与近似计算是互补技术，二者协同可在保持分类精度的前提下显著提升边缘FPGA上GCN推理的能效，为图级与算术级近似联合设计提供了可行路径。

Abstract: Graph Convolutional Networks (GCNs) have emerged as a powerful framework for learning from graph-structured data, yet their deployment on resource-constrained edge platforms remains challenging due to the computational and memory demands of sparse graph aggregation. This work presents an FPGA-based GCN accelerator that combines DSpar graph sparsification, 8-bit quantization, and approximate multipliers on the AMD Kria KV260. Evaluated on Cora, LastFM Asia, and Amazon Photo, the design explores the interaction between sparsification and approximation across graphs with widely varying densities. Results show that the effectiveness of approximate arithmetic is governed by accumulation depth within GCN computations. Approximate multipliers are most effective when applied to sparse aggregation operations, while graph sparsification further improves their viability by reducing aggregation depth. The combined approach achieves up to 9.88$\times$ speedup while maintaining 86.6\% classification accuracy on Amazon Photo, and 1.52$\times$ speedup with 77.0\% accuracy on Cora, with total power consumption below 1 W. These results demonstrate that graph sparsification and approximate computing are complementary techniques whose co-optimization enables efficient low-power GCN inference on edge FPGA platforms.

</details>


### [509] [TIGER: Time-Series Classification with In-Context-Learning Gated Ensemble of Representations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06156)
*Johann Faouzi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: TIGER 是一种时间序列分类算法，通过将三个通用分类器（Ridge、Extra Trees、朴素贝叶斯）应用于四个表示家族（卷积、间隔、shapelet、字典）生成的十二个基础学习器进行堆叠，并使用自适应元分类规则（基于每类训练样本数在加权硬多数投票与 TabICLv2 表格基础模型之间选择）。在 UCR 档案的 142 个数据集基准测试中，TIGER 在准确率、平衡准确率和 F1 分数上均显著优于包括 HIVE-COTE 2.0 在内的五种对比算法，同时速度约为 HC2 的 7.2 倍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前时间序列分类的最先进水平由集成方法占据，尤其是 HIVE-COTE 2.0 (HC2)。然而 HC2 存在两个显著局限：(1) 每个表示家族都配有专门定制的分类器，使得集成难以扩展且聚合步骤复杂；(2) 其组合规则 CAWPE 是固定的、非自适应的，无法根据每个数据集实际的标注数据量进行调整。本研究旨在设计一种更简洁、自适应的集成架构，验证将通用分类器与表格基础模型作为自适应元分类器相结合的可行性。

Method: TIGER 采用三层堆叠集成架构：(1) 特征提取——使用四个家族的最新快速算法（KG-MTP、QUANT、RDST、WEASEL 2.0）提取特征，超参数保持默认；(2) 基础分类——对每个家族应用同一组三个通用分类器（Ridge、Extra Trees、对应变体的朴素贝叶斯），共生成 12 个基础学习器，使用自适应 K 折交叉验证生成折外预测；(3) 元分类（聚合）——采用自适应规则，根据每类平均训练样本数与阈值τ的比较，在加权硬多数投票（样本少时）和 TabICLv2 表格基础模型（样本多时）之间自动选择。该阈值τ=60.63 通过 20 个开发数据集调优得出。

Result: 在 142 个 UCR 数据集基准（30 次重采样）上：TIGER 在准确率（0.884，第 1）、平衡准确率（0.863，第 1）和 F1 分数（0.863，第 1）上均排名第一；对五个对比算法（HC2、KG-MTP、QUANT、RDST、WEASEL 2.0）均达到统计显著优势（Wilcoxon 检验）。在排除开发集的 122 个数据集子集上结论保持一致。运行时方面，TIGER 比 HC2 快约 7.2 倍（中位数 145.4 秒 vs 834.7 秒）。消融研究表明：自适应元分类规则优于任一单独使用；τ 阈值在完整基准上泛化良好；不同折外估计器中 K 折 CV 在 11/12 个（家族，学习器）对中最诚实且最快；TabICLv2 的 ECOC 多类包装在开发集上仅带来约 0.3 个准确率点的提升，但代价是约 5 倍的运行时间。已探索并放弃的替代方案包括直接将 TabICLv2 拟合到每个家族的原始或降维特征上。

Conclusion: TIGER 是一种高精度的时间序列分类算法，它摆脱了 HIVE-COTE 2.0 等先前集成方法中为每个表示家族定制分类器的设计，转而采用通用基础分类器组合和自适应元分类阶段（必要时使用表格基础模型）。其单阈值超参数（τ=60.63）通过仅 20 个数据集开发子集调优得出，能够泛化到完整评估基准。局限包括：(1) 依赖外部表格基础模型 TabICLv2；(2) 自适应规则仅基于单一标量统计量（每类训练样本数），未能利用类别数等更多信息；(3) 对存在单实例类别的三个数据集处理不一致；(4) 仅评估了单变量时间序列，未涵盖多变量或外生回归任务。论文认为使用表格基础模型作为自适应元分类层是未来集成设计（包括时间序列分类及其他领域）一个有前景的方向。

Abstract: A representation family is a distinct way of extracting features from time series. Ensemble algorithms that combine several representation families remain the most accurate approach to time series classification. Current state-of-the-art ensembles, most notably HIVE-COTE~2.0, pair a bespoke classification algorithm with each representation family and combine their predictions using a fixed, non-adaptive rule. We present TIGER (Time-series classification with In-context-learning Gated Ensemble of Representations), which instead applies the same small portfolio of three general-purpose classifiers (Ridge, Extra Trees, and Naive Bayes) to four representations from four distinct families, stacking the resulting twelve base learners' predictions into a meta-feature matrix. The final prediction is produced by an adaptive meta-classification rule that chooses, independently for each data set, between a weighted hard majority vote and TabICLv2, a pretrained tabular foundation model used in-context as a meta-classifier, based on the mean number of training samples available per class. On a 142-data-set benchmark drawn from the UCR time series classification archive, TIGER obtains the best mean accuracy, balanced accuracy, and F1-score among six compared algorithms, including HIVE-COTE~2.0, and significantly outperforms each of the other five individually. TIGER's adaptive rule also meaningfully outperforms either of its two constituent meta-classification methods used alone, and its single hyperparameter, tuned using only a twenty-data-set development subset, is shown to generalize to the full evaluation benchmark. We further characterize TIGER's design through an extensive set of ablation experiments and report the design alternatives that we investigated and ultimately discarded.

</details>


### [510] [Two-Point Local Optimality in $k$-Means via Boundary-Point Screening](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06182)
*Wenlong Lyu,Xujie Xiao,Yuheng Jia*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出BPS-2PLS算法，通过边界点筛选实现k-means的两点局部最优性，将候选集规模降至对数级别，在12个基准测试中10个取得最低WCSS。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Lloyd算法和D-local方法仅提供较弱的局部最优保证，对初始化敏感。需要更强保证且高效的两点局部最优搜索方法。

Method: 引入r点局部最优性层次；证明D-local最优处所有改进的两点移动必须连通且仅涉及边界点；提出基于安全筛选原理的BPS-2PLS，使用线上包络构建样本证书，保留必要候选集。

Result: 在12个基准测试中10个取得最低WCSS；筛选保留0.10%–2.81%样本；候选集规模m=O_P(log n)；筛选搜索成本O_P(n log n)；两点最优保证严格强于D-local。

Conclusion: BPS-2PLS有效实现两点局部最优性，理论保证与实验验证均支持其作为k-means局部搜索的有效工具；可作为启发式方法的精炼组件。

Abstract: Lloyd's algorithm and the discrete local (D-local) optimization method (Li et al., 2025) for $k$-means provide only weak local-optimality guarantees, and their solution quality remains sensitive to initialization. In this paper, we introduce $r$-point local optimality, under which no reassignment of at most $r$ samples decreases the objective function, and focus on $r=2$. The main computational obstacle is the $\mathcal{O}(n^2(k^2+d))$ cost of exhaustive two-point certification for $n$ samples in $d$ dimensions and $k$ clusters. To address this challenge, we prove that (i) every improving two-point move of a D-local optimum must involve a cluster shared by both reassignments, and (ii) only certificate-defined boundary points can participate in an improving pair. Exploiting this structure, we propose Boundary-Point-Screened Two-Point Local Search (BPS-2PLS), which terminates at a two-point local optimum. For fixed $k,d$ and nonvanishing cluster occupancy, the number $m$ of retained candidates satisfies $m=\mathcal{O}_{\mathbb{P}}(\log n)$ under i.i.d. sampling from a bounded-support distribution with bounded density or from a Gaussian mixture. Across twelve benchmarks, BPS-2PLS attains the lowest available mean WCSS on ten. In a subsampling study, screening retains 0.10% to 2.81% of samples on average at the largest tested sizes. The code is available at this https URL .

</details>


### [511] [Loss-Invariant Projections as Passive Probes of Learned Representations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06195)
*Akshay Chandrasekhar,Pavlo Melnyk*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出"被动探针"(passive probes)——固定、未训练、与属性无关的标量投影——用于分析神经网络学习过程中表征的变化。通过对 S² 预测任务中存在的损失不变量进行推导，引出了一般化的随机投影观测器框架，并定义了"严格被动探针"（投影到最终读出层的零空间）。在表面法向估计、CIFAR-100 分类与图像修复三个任务上的实验表明：被动可访问性在不同任务中表现出不同模式——回归任务中随训练增长，分类任务中基本不变；且与学习型线性探针所测量的可恢复性可以独立演化。该方法能够区分表征几何变化与任务难度对固定观测器的可访问性变化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 学习型探针（learned probes）的性能既反映表征本身，也反映适应目标属性的观测器，这使得难以将表征变化与观测器适应分离。本文寻求一种不随训练改变的"被动"观测方式，从而纯粹地观察表征相对于固定观测器的演化。动机来自 S² 预测中向量参数化与 Hermitian 参数化之间存在的损失不变量（trace 坐标），提示可利用固定投影来观察表征的隐藏结构。

Method: 1. 被动探针 q_j(x) = a_j^T h(x)，其中 a_j 采样自各向同性高斯分布并固定不变（∂L/∂a_j=0）。2. 严格被动探针：将 h(x) 和 a_j 投影到最终读出层 W 的零空间（I - P_W），再归一化内积，得到对任务读出不变的标量。3. 分析指标包括：线性核对齐 A_K、高斯非线性核对齐 A_G、Pearson²、|Spearman| 相关、校准 R²。4. 在 NYUv2 表面法向估计、CIFAR-100 分类（ViT）、CIFAR-100 图像修复（ViT）上对 256 个固定探针沿训练轨迹评估，每任务 5 个独立种子。5. 与学习型 ridge 探针对比。

Result: 1. 三个任务呈现截然不同的被动可访问性演化模式：表面法向估计（余弦损失）和图像修复（L₂ 损失）这两个回归任务中，A_K、A_G、Pearson²、|Spearman|、校准 R² 均有正向训练增量；而 CIFAR-100 分类（交叉熵损失）中所有被动可访问性指标在训练前后基本不变。2. 与学习型 ridge 探针对比显示：分类任务中学习可恢复性大幅提升，但被动可访问性几乎不变，呈现最显著分离；回归任务中两者均增长但幅度不同。3. 控制实验（raw/unit/orth/strict 四种构造）证实任务级模式稳健。4. 校准 R² 对分箱数 B∈{5,10,20,40} 不敏感。结论：线性可恢复性与被动可访问性在训练中可独立演化，刻画了表征的可分离经验性质。

Conclusion: 被动探针提供了一种分析学习表征的互补框架：与学习型探针不同，它通过固定不变的观测器隔离了表征相对于外部参考的变化。S² 上的损失不变量揭示了读出零空间可作为有意义的观测域。在表面法向估计、分类和图像修复中的对比表明，任务难度对被动观测器的可访问性取决于训练设置：L₂ 类回归损失任务显示出强烈的训练期增长，而交叉熵分类则几乎没有变化。被动可访问性与学习型可恢复性可以独立演化，从而可对表征的组织提供互补证据。未来工作需进一步厘清任务、损失函数与架构如何分别贡献于这些差异。

Abstract: Learned feature representations in neural networks often contain structure beyond that directly used by the final task output. We study this structure using $\textit{passive probes}$ that apply fixed, untrained, property-independent projections to representations as they evolve during training. We motivate this approach through the task of prediction on $S^2$ where equivalent vector and Hermitian parameterizations reveal an additional loss-invariant trace coordinate. This motivates a general construction in which fixed random projections serve as observers of learned features. Because the observer is loss-invariant and independent of the property being studied, changes in accessibility reflect changes in the representation relative to the fixed observer rather than adaptation of the observer itself. We show that ensembles of passive probes can directly reflect task-relevant information such as target alignment. Under our constructions, the accessibility of eventual difficulty evolves differently across tasks. It increases during training in the regression tasks of surface-normal estimation and image inpainting but remains near its initial level in image classification. Comparisons with learned linear probes further show that recoverability and passive accessibility can evolve differently during training. Together, these results show how passive probes can separately characterize changes in representation geometry and the accessibility of eventual task difficulty.

</details>


### [512] [Structured Representation Learning for Behavior Cloning: How can we learn to safely control a nuclear power plant?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06211)
*Perceval Beja-Battais,Alain Grosset{ê}te,Nicolas Vayatis*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究在压水堆（PWR）负荷跟踪任务中，基于行为克隆模仿非线性模型预测控制（NMPC）专家策略的问题。提出了一种按时间尺度分离潜空间的结构化架构，相比共享嵌入基线在长时域展开中提高了精度和可行性，但独立部署仍存在不可行轨迹；将该方法用作 NMPC 优化器的 warmstart，可恢复完全可行性并接近最优成本，同时减少约 15% 的计算时间。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 工业控制中学习模型通常以整体精度衡量，但组件级精度并不能保证嵌入系统后的安全性。需要研究学习型控制器在高安全约束工业系统（PWR 负荷跟踪）中独立部署的可行性，以及如何弥补精度与系统级安全之间的差距。

Method: 1. 采用行为克隆（behavior cloning）框架，模仿专家 NMPC 控制策略。2. 提出结构化架构：将不同时间尺度的系统变量编码到各自独立的潜空间中（反映物理分解），然后在乘积潜空间上训练控制器模仿专家。3. 通过长时域展开评估准确性和可行性，并进行灵敏度分析以检验表示的可解释性。4. 将学习模型用作 NMPC 优化器的 warmstart，而非独立部署。

Result: 1. 分离嵌入架构在长时域展开中相比共享嵌入基线，同时改善了精度和可行性。2. 灵敏度分析表明所学表示与系统物理一致，具有可解释性。3. 独立部署时无论何种架构仍有百分之几的轨迹不可行。4. 用作 NMPC warmstart 时：恢复完全可行性，成本接近最优，计算时间相对专家控制器减少约 15%，对于突变工况减少更多。

Conclusion: 组件级精度不足以保证嵌入式学习控制器的系统级安全性；按物理时间尺度分离的潜空间结构能改善学习型控制器的性能和可解释性，但不能消除独立部署的不可行风险。将学习模型作为 NMPC 的 warmstart 是实用方案，可在保持安全性和接近最优性能的同时显著降低计算负担。

Abstract: Learned models for industrial control are usually judged by aggregate accuracy, but accuracy at the component level does not guarantee safety once it is embedded in the system it is meant to serve. We study this gap on a behavior-cloning task: imitating an expert Nonlinear Model Predictive Control (NMPC) policy for load-following of a Pressurized Water Reactor (PWR), an industrial system with tight safety constraints. We propose a structured architecture encoding variables from each timescale into separate latent spaces, reflecting the physical decomposition of the system, before training a controller to imitate the expert on the product latent space. On long-horizon rollouts, separated embeddings improve both accuracy and feasibility compared with a shared-embedding baseline. Sensitivity analysis further shows that our model yields interpretable representations aligned with the system's physics. However, standalone deployment still leaves several percent of trajectories infeasible regardless of the architecture. Using our method to warmstart the NMPC optimizer rather than acting standalone, we recover full feasibility and near-optimal cost while still cutting computation time by $\sim$15% relative to the expert controller, and even more for abrupt operating changes.

</details>


### [513] [Sampling Allocation of LinUCB: Optimal Design Limits in the Small-Gap Regime](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06213)
*Yujie Liu,Vincent Y. F. Tan,Yunbei Xu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究LinUCB算法在"小差距"（small-gap）线性bandit问题中的采样分配行为。在奖励差距为 O(n^{-1/2}) 的最坏情形设定下，证明了LinUCB的（宏观）经验抽样分布收敛到D-最优设计集合，从而将遗憾驱动的在线学习与信息高效的最优实验设计联系起来。基于此结果，作者进一步给出了LinUCB渐近遗憾的精细常数刻画，以及在自适应采样数据下正则化最小二乘估计量的 √n 渐近正态性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 经典线性bandit分析主要关注累积遗憾最小化，但未能刻画算法的采样分配机制（如何在动作空间上自适应分配样本）。在小差距设定（差距 ∝ n^{-1/2}，对应最坏情形下界）中，LinUCB虽具有近最优遗憾，但其采样行为长期未被理解。本文旨在填补这一空白。

Method: 采用三角阵列（triangular-array）渐近框架，在小差距条件下研究LinUCB的经验抽样分布。技术上，借鉴统计力学的"平均场"观点：将个体的自适应选择视为微观动力学，将经验抽样分布视为宏观状态量。证明分为四步：（1）对正则化最小二乘估计量的预测误差建立关于时间和动作一致的高概率一致界；（2）证明在小差距下，经过一段可忽略的初始窗口后，LinUCB的选择规则退化为近似的方差最大化（approximate variance maximization），即近似Fedorov–Wynn过程；（3）建立新的关于三角阵列的近似Fedorov–Wynn收敛定理，证明近似方差最大化驱动经验抽样分布趋向D-最优设计；（4）证明初始窗口的影响可忽略，从而得出主定理。

Result: 主要结果包括：（i）定理1（小差距下LinUCB的最优设计极限）：在span(A)=ℝ^d及小差距假设下，LinUCB的经验抽样分布 π_n^{(n)} 在Wasserstein距离下依概率收敛到D-最优设计集合 P_D；若D-最优设计唯一，则弱收敛到该设计。（ii）推论1与命题1（精细渐近遗憾）：在小差距特例 θ_⋆^{(n)} = θ_0/√n 下，R_n/√n 依概率收敛到 D-最优设计下平均缩放差距 Δ(a) 的积分；在布尔超立方动作集上得到 R_n ~ C_d(θ_0)√n，其中 C_d(θ_0) ∈ [d/4, 3d/4]，与 Dani 等人 (2007) 的 Ω(d√n) 下界匹配。（iii）定理2（自适应采样下的统计推断）：正则化最小二乘估计量满足 √n(θ̂_n - θ_⋆) ⇒ N(0, σ_η² (M⋆)^{-1})，即标准 √n 渐近正态性。这一结果与Fan等人 (2025) 在固定差距下正交方向收敛率退化为 n^{1/4} 的结果形成对比，说明小差距下采样分配在信息效率上更优。

Conclusion: 本文建立了小差距线性bandit设定下LinUCB采样分配与最优实验设计之间的理论联系：尽管LinUCB是为遗憾最小化设计的，其长期采样行为在统计上等价于构造D-最优设计。进而，本文给出了该算法在小差距下遗憾主项的精确常数，并为基于LinUCB自适应数据的奖励参数统计推断提供了渐近有效性保证。开放问题包括：非唯一D-最优设计情形下确定具体收敛的设计，以及将分析扩展到跨越小差距/临界差距/固定差距的完整相变图景。

Abstract: We study the sampling allocation of LinUCB in the small-gap regime, where the reward gaps are of order at most $n^{-1/2}$ over the decision horizon $n$. This scaling captures the hard instances underlying worst-case regret lower bounds, for which LinUCB is known to be near optimal up to logarithmic factors in $n$. Using a mean-field perspective, we characterize this allocation through the empirical sampling distribution, a macroscopic object that averages the effect of adaptive decisions over the horizon, and identify its limit as $n\to\infty$. We establish that in this regime, the empirical sampling distribution induced by LinUCB converges to the set of D-optimal designs. This central result reveals that, in the small-gap regime, LinUCB not only achieves near optimal minimax regret but also allocates samples in a way that is asymptotically efficient for learning the reward parameter, thereby connecting regret-driven online learning with information-efficient experimental design. Building on the optimal design limit, we obtain two useful consequences. First, we refine the asymptotic regret analysis of LinUCB in the small-gap regime by characterizing its leading-order constant in the limit. Second, we show that, despite LinUCB's adaptive sampling strategy, the regularized least-squares estimator satisfies a central-limit-type theorem in the small-gap regime, thereby enabling valid statistical inference for the reward parameter.

</details>


### [514] [LeAVJEPA: A Minimalist Architecture for Audio-Visual Self-Supervised Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06226)
*Benjamin Robson,Santeri Mentu,Wenshuai Zhao,Arno Solin*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: LeAVJEPA是一个极简的音视频自监督学习架构，使用单一共享早期融合Vision Transformer，基于LeJEPA的无坍缩目标函数训练，通过模态丢弃（modality dropout）实现隐式跨模态对齐，无需教师编码器、预测器、对比损失或重构解码器。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有音视频自监督学习方法依赖多种复杂组件（EMA教师编码器、预测器、重构解码器、对比损失），研究旨在探索是否可以用极简架构实现有效的音视频表征学习，并将单模态LeJEPA理论扩展到多模态场景。

Method: 1）单一早期融合ViT处理音频、视频和音视频联合输入；2）模态丢弃创建局部视图（音频仅或视频仅），视为同一事件的另一种视角；3）全局视图定义联合中心嵌入z̄；4）不变性损失将局部视图拉向联合中心；5）SIGReg正则化器将嵌入分布匹配各向同性高斯分布，防止表征坍缩。

Result: AudioSet-20K上达到36.0 mAP（冻结评估），ESC-50上达到91.3%准确率；VGGSound微调后达到61.1%准确率；支持零样本音视频检索；消融实验证实模态丢弃是跨模态对齐的关键机制。

Conclusion: 模态特定的部分视图设计对于学习有用的音视频表征至关重要，证明了无需专用跨模态预测器、重构解码器或教师网络即可实现有效的对齐和迁移，为未来多模态模型提供了简单可扩展的基础。

Abstract: Prior audio-visual self-supervised learning methods rely on mechanisms such as EMA target encoders, prediction heads, reconstruction decoders, and contrastive losses. We introduce LeAVJEPA, the first audio-visual encoder trained under LeJEPA's collapse-free objective. A single early-fusion Vision Transformer processes audio, video, and joint audio-video inputs. Modality dropout treats a missing modality as another view of the same event, making cross-modal alignment implicit in the objective. The model aligns global embeddings with modality-specific local embeddings, and SIGReg prevents representational collapse. A controlled ablation identifies modality dropout as the key mechanism for audio-visual alignment. Despite the architectural simplicity, LeAVJEPA reaches 36.0 mAP on AudioSet-20K and 91.3% accuracy on ESC-50 under frozen evaluation. After fine-tuning, it reaches 61.1% accuracy on VGGSound, and its embeddings support zero-shot audio-visual retrieval.

</details>


### [515] [Parameter Estimation in Machining Dynamics with Regenerative Delay and Nonsmooth Friction using Physics-Informed Neural Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06230)
*Meiyazhagan Jaganathan,Vikram Pakrashi,Aasifa Rounak*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出多域扩展物理信息神经网络(XPINN)框架求解非光滑时滞微分方程(DDE)，通过将时间域按特征时滞的整数倍分区并逐步训练冻结子网络，应用于含再生效应和非光滑摩擦的机械加工动力学模型，实现了优于通用PINN的解重构与参数估计能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 机械加工中的颤振振动涉及再生时滞和非光滑摩擦效应，由时滞微分方程描述。传统PINN在处理大时滞、非光滑性及非恒定历史函数时存在困难，难以准确重构解并识别参数，亟需更可靠的计算框架用于此类DDE的参数辨识。

Method: 开发多域扩展物理信息神经网络(XPINN)：将时间域按特征时滞的整数倍划分为子域，对每个子域训练子网络并在后续训练中冻结已学习参数，形成渐进训练策略。提出逆问题版本I-XPINN用于参数辨识，使用含高斯测量噪声的参考数据进行验证，与通用PINN(SPINN)进行对比。

Result: 多域XPINN在DDE解重构和参数估计方面优于SPINN；在扩展时间域和非恒定历史函数条件下表现尤为突出；I-XPINN对高斯测量噪声具有鲁棒性，物理信息约束能有效引导网络恢复真实动力学行为。

Conclusion: 该框架首次证明多域XPINN能够可靠求解具有非光滑性和大时滞的DDE，适用于机械加工颤振动力学等复杂系统的参数辨识，为此类逆问题提供了新的有效方法。

Abstract: A multi-domain eXtended Physics-Informed Neural Network (XPINN) framework is developed for nonsmooth Delay Differential Equations (DDEs). This is the first implementation to demonstrate the efficacy of partitioning the temporal domain into subdomains of integer multiples of the characteristic time delay and progressively training the associated subnetworks while freezing previously learned parameters. The efficacy of the proposed framework is demonstrated using a machining dynamics model that incorporates both regenerative and nonsmooth frictional effects. Results demonstrate that the proposed multi-domain XPINN framework leads to better solution reconstruction in DDEs and improved parameter estimation compared to a generic PINN (SPINN) formulation. The proposed method works particularly well for extended temporal domains and non-constant history functions. The robustness of inverse XPINN (I-XPINN) is also assessed using reference data contaminated with Gaussian measurement noise. Results indicate that I-XPINN remains resilient to measurement noise and the physics-informed constraints guide the network toward accurately recovering the underlying dynamics. This demonstrates, for the first time, the potential of the proposed framework for reliable parameter identification in DDEs characterised by nonsmoothness and large time delays.

</details>


### [516] [Certification-Enhanced Generalization Bounds](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06238)
*Leo Elmecker-Plakolm,Matthew Wicker*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种将形式化方法（特别是可达性分析）与算法稳定性理论相结合的新框架，以推导紧致且可证明可靠的泛化边界。通过将稳定性概念重新表述为可验证的形式规约，并引入一种新颖的浓度不等式来桥接样本特异性证书与分布泛化保证，该方法在保持计算可行性的同时（仅需常数次算法运行）显著优于现有可计算方法，并在多个基准测试和大型语言模型微调场景中得到验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 经典的算法稳定性泛化边界依赖于严格的分析性假设（如损失函数的有界性、Lipschitz连续性等），这些假设在现代深度学习模型中往往难以满足或导致边界过于松弛而失去实际意义。虽然已有数值近似方法可以收紧边界，但它们牺牲了理论上的可靠性。形式化方法虽然在神经网络验证领域取得了显著进展，但尚未被充分利用于推导分布式的泛化边界保证。

Method: 该方法包含三个核心组件：(a) 引入数据集特异性（dataset-specific）稳定性概念，使其可通过形式化验证（如抽象梯度训练 AGT）进行计算；(b) 通过借用差分隐私中"平滑敏感性"的思想，定义 β-平滑数据集特异性敏感性，并证明其对数具有 Lipschitz 连续性；(c) 提出新的浓度不等式（结合 McDiarmid 和 Hoeffding 技术），将样本特异性证书提升为关于训练数据分布的高概率泛化边界。此外，还设计了一种高效的算法（Algorithm 1），利用可达集的单调包含性，只需常数次参数域计算即可得到有效的边界。

Result: 该框架在多个实验场景中显著优于现有可计算泛化边界：(1) 在合成 halfmoons 数据集上，边界比硬 HRS 解析界更紧，与（不可靠的）数值近似方法具有竞争力；(2) 在 MNIST 和 ImageNet 图像分类任务中（包括 ResNet-18 特征提取之上的 MLP 头），边界随训练步骤和模型架构的扩展保持良好的紧致性；(3) 在微调 Gemma、Qwen、Llama 等大型语言模型的分类头进行仇恨言论检测时，仍能提供可靠且紧致的边界。所有实验仅需常数次（约 2 秒）算法运行即可获得边界。

Conclusion: 该工作证明了形式化方法不仅可用于神经网络的事后验证，还能作为产生严格且实用的现代学习算法泛化保证的基本机制。核心思想——利用验证技术计算泛化间隙——不局限于算法稳定性，未来可自然扩展到 PAC-Bayes 或信息理论边界，并可从期望间隙推广到实现间隙的界定。主要局限性在于 AGT 的过近似效应会随模型深度增加而加剧，可能导致边界变松弛。

Abstract: We investigate the use of formal methods to provide tight and sound generalization bounds for learning algorithms. By casting the traditional notion of algorithmic stability as a specification to be verified, we demonstrate that recent advances in reachability analysis can yield provable bounds on the generalization of a given model and algorithm on a sample dataset. As sample-specific algorithmic stability is insufficient to bound the usual distributional notion of generalization, we develop a novel concentration inequality to connect the sample-specific results of formal certification algorithms to the required distributional analysis for bounding the expected generalization gap. The resulting framework enables the analysis of prior generalization bounds to extend far beyond their original restrictive assumptions. Our approach computes sound bounds on the expected generalization gap in a constant number of algorithm runs without making any analytical assumptions on the algorithm; to achieve non-vacuous bounds we only require that the certified reachable parameter set is bounded --- a condition that we do not assume but formally verify. In practice, we demonstrate that our framework provides formal generalization guarantees that are orders of magnitude tighter than alternative sound computational approaches at scales ranging from toy datasets to fine-tuning classification heads on top of modern large language models. While we implement certification-enhanced versions of several well-known stability results, future extensions of our approach will enable tighter bounds and enhanced practical adoption across the spectrum of modern generalization bounds.

</details>


### [517] [RoSA: Rotational Sparse Adaptation for Memory-Efficient Fine-Tuning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06243)
*Muhammad Azeem Lodhi,Chao Zhou,Rebekka Burkholz*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: RoSA提出了一种旋转稀疏适应框架，通过冻结输入侧前缀并在剩余层中轮换可训练块，按时间分配内存预算而非固定训练子空间，显著降低LLM微调内存同时保持性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大语言模型全参数微调受限于优化器状态和激活值的内存开销;现有PEFT方法通过限制可训练子空间来减少内存,但这种容量受限的方案无法充分利用模型的适应能力。需要一种与现有PEFT正交的内存节省机制,以更充分地利用内存预算。

Method: RoSA(Rotational Sparse Adaptation):(1)冻结输入嵌入和早期Transformer层(Layers 0-7);(2)保持输出侧锚点(最后一层+输出头)始终激活;(3)将剩余层(Layers 8-30)划分为K个连续组,每epoch轮换一个组与锚点共同作为活动集;(4)在活动块内使用NanoAdam稀疏优化器,仅维护ρ比例参数的优化器状态;(5)周期性地刷新基于权重幅度的稀疏掩码。优化器状态采用"冷启动"策略,组被重新访问时重新初始化。

Result: 在Llama-2-7B上:峰值VRAM从全参数微调的78.5 GiB降至34.9 GiB,平均准确率达79.61%(接近全参数微调的79.99%);训练时间6.5小时。通用性:迁移至Qwen-2.5-3B(Mistral-v0.1-7B),分别将VRAM从22.48 GiB降至14.37 GiB、从45.30 GiB降至33.28 GiB;在GSM8K任务上同样有效。组合性:可与DoRA、LoRA组合进一步降低其内存占用(RoSA-DoRA在Qwen-2.5-3B上仅用12.87 GiB)。核心区域消融显示仅在Layers 8-23旋转效果与全方案几乎相同(79.56% vs 79.61%)。在匹配内存下比LISA高出8.45个百分点。

Conclusion: RoSA是一种与PEFT正交的内存高效微调框架,通过利用Transformer的深度结构和层间梯度异质性,在固定内存预算下按时间分配不同层的更新。冻结前缀不仅节省优化器状态,还缩短反向传播路径(后期迭代提速达27%)。该方法可与密集优化、稀疏优化或适配器风格方法组合,为共享计算环境中的LLM微调提供了实用的内存-精度权衡方案。主要局限在于需要额外的调度超参数,且未实现激活缓存优化。

Abstract: Parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) reduces the cost of adapting foundation models by focusing training on a small parameter subset. Complementary to this idea, we introduce RoSA (Rotational Sparse Adaptation), which narrows adaptation to a subset of layers at a time. RoSA freezes lower layers close to the input throughout training and rotates a trainable block over later layers, progressively increasing the number of frozen layers close to the input. This design reduces optimizer-state memory, shortens backpropagation, and even forward propagation if activations at the last frozen layer are cached. Because RoSA is orthogonal to the choice of trainable parameterization, it can be combined with PEFT methods or sparse optimizers within each active block. Experiments across multiple LLM architectures and tasks show that RoSA reduces peak memory while maintaining strong fine-tuning performance.

</details>


### [518] [Constrained Goal-directed Planar Graph Generation with Grammar-based Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06244)
*Nicolas Hochuli,Lorenzo Miele,Kristina Shea,Tino Stankovic*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出一种基于参数化图文法与安全强化学习的数据集无关方法，用于在硬结构与几何可行性约束下进行目标导向的平面图嵌入生成，将生成过程建模为约束马尔可夫决策过程，并通过CMA-ES监督的可微动作投影保障约束满足。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有平面图生成器在硬结构/几何可行性约束下缺乏目标导向控制：经典生成器不支持多目标优化，深度生成模型依赖数据集且通过软约束/后处理保证可行性，难以精确控制节点数与嵌入。

Method: 1) 参数化图文法（7条重写规则，DAG结构+边界节点机制）定义状态与动作空间；2) 构造为约束MDP，PPO训练Actor-Critic策略；3) 设计可微动作投影（tanh仿射流）将采样动作映射至状态相关安全集，由CMA-ES监督生成训练目标；4) 约束分为拓扑约束（拒绝采样）与几何约束（投影+CMA-ES回退）分别处理。

Result: 在四个基准（弹性电网、城市路网、强连通网格、40三角形图）上，所提方法均满足全部约束并取得最优综合奖励（0.76/0.94/0.65/0.98），优于House of Graphs、Delaunay、GDSS、DiGress、MuDiff等10种基线；动作投影将约束违反降低15倍；支持最多150节点图生成。

Conclusion: 该框架首次实现目标导向的嵌入平面图生成与硬约束联合强制执行，可精确控制节点数并直接构造可行嵌入；局限在于文法规则集的组合空间限制了可扩展性，且无法生成规则集表达范围外的图，未来可通过分层强化学习与扩展文法覆盖解决。

Abstract: Planar graphs are central to applications across science and engineering, yet existing generators provide limited support for goal-directed generation under hard structural and geometric feasibility constraints. We propose a dataset-free method for generating planar graph embeddings by combining parametric graph grammars with safe reinforcement learning to optimize generic task-specific objectives while satisfying constraints during construction. We formulate the generation process as a constrained Markov decision process, where the graph grammar defines the state and action spaces. We further introduce an action projection that maps sampled actions toward state-dependent safe sets, improving constraint satisfaction during training. In contrast to classical graph generators and deep generative models, which typically offer limited goal-directed control or rely on weak constraint satisfaction, our method constructs feasible planar graph embeddings directly during generation. We also introduce a benchmark suite for constrained and goal-directed planar graph generation, together with classical and deep generative baselines. Across all benchmark tasks, our method consistently outperforms baselines while satisfying the formulated constraints.

</details>


### [519] [Generative World Models Enable Predictive Control of Laser Melt Pool Dynamics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06250)
*Yiyang Yan,Markus Bambach,Mohamadreza Afrasiabi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于生成式潜空间动力学的世界模型（World Model），用于激光熔池的预测与控制。该模型将温度场和相场编码为有限标量量化（FSQ）的离散潜变量，并通过流匹配（flow-matching）的转换器进行时间演化。由于潜空间动力学可微分，可直接作为预测控制模型，通过梯度优化激光功率与扫描速度来调节熔池深度，并将该优化过程蒸馏为单次前向传播的摊销策略，从而为熔池时序控制提供了一种计算可行的概念验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在激光增材制造（如LPBF）中，熔池几何直接影响缺陷形成（未熔合、匙孔气孔、飞溅等），但高精度热流仿真耗时过长（分钟到小时级），无法用于在线控制；现有层级或矢量级控制无法在单个扫描矢量内部进行亚毫秒级调节；缺乏能够结合递归三维滚动、可微动作梯度与部分观测的替代模型。

Method: 1. 分支式FSQ自编码器：将温度场与相场编码为"形态+幅度"结构的离散潜变量；2. 流匹配潜空间动力学：使用DiT（扩散变换器）参数化的动作条件转换器，以4步欧拉采样推进潜变量；3. 预训练策略：先在恒定激光参数下训练，再在时变参数下微调；4. 两种控制器：(a) 基于梯度的滚动时域MPC（直接反向传播通过冻结WM），(b) 短时域Actor-Critic（SHAC）摊销策略（单次前向推理）；5. 所有受控轨迹都在OpenFOAM高保真CFD求解器中重新仿真验证。

Result: 生成式流匹配转换器在递归滚动下优于确定性ViT和Transolver基线（深度CRPS降低 2.0-5.0 μm，体积CRPS降低约33%）；80%以上深度预测误差在一个体素（10 μm）以内；MPC和RL均能将平均熔池深度控制在50 μm目标附近并抑制完全穿透；摊销策略每个控制间隔仅需12.16 ms，比MPC（约1.69 s/间隔）快约140倍；但两者仍比实时慢约240倍和3.4×10⁴倍；CFD重仿真证实WM在控制诱导的状态-动作分布下仍保持有效，但MPC存在轻微模型利用偏差。

Conclusion: 本文证明了具有生成式潜空间动力学的世界模型可在硅内实现毫秒尺度的熔池预测控制，跨越了高保真热流仿真与控制之间的速度差距；Finset为激光增材制造中的在线逐矢量控制提供了概念验证基础，但仍需测量条件编码器、跨材料机器验证及与物理过程的校准，才能实现真正机器集成；其"准稳态预训练+瞬态微调+生成式转换+CFD重仿真验证"的框架可推广至其他昂贵的多相态制造过程。

Abstract: World models, which learn how environments respond to actions, are emerging as a powerful paradigm for planning through imagined futures, transforming decision-making across games, robotics and autonomous driving. Bringing this capability to manufacturing could enable process decisions on timescales inaccessible to high-fidelity simulation. Here we introduce a generative world model for localized highly dynamic laser melt pool that predicts evolution from histories of temperature and phase morphology under candidate actions. Its generative latent dynamics capture the effects of unresolved melt flow, enabling more accurate recursive rollouts than deterministic regressors under transient laser inputs. Because the learned dynamics are differentiable, the model can serve directly as a predictive control plant. Gradients through imagined futures optimize laser schedules that regulate melt-pool depth over previously unseen geometry, path, initialization. We further distil this optimization into an amortized policy that produces control actions in a single forward pass, providing a proof of concept for real deployment on machines.

</details>


### [520] [Lipschitz Thinking: Ten Years of Certifiable-by-Design Robust Neural Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06252)
*Fabio Brau,Giorgio Piras,Maura Pintor,Battista Biggio*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 这是一篇关于Lipschitz约束神经网络及其在可认证鲁棒性方面应用的教程综述，系统回顾了过去十年间将Lipschitz有界层融入深度模型的三大方法（正则化、参数化、流形优化），并讨论了与其他领域（如随机平滑、GAN、差分隐私等）的联系。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 深度神经网络在实际部署中容易受到对抗样本的攻击，传统的对抗训练等启发式防御无法提供严格的鲁棒性保证。Lipschitz性质直接度量网络对输入扰动的敏感度，通过显式控制Lipschitz常数，可以为预测提供单次前向传播即可得到的确定性鲁棒性证书，弥合经验鲁棒性与形式化设计保证之间的差距。

Method: 文章系统梳理了构建1-Lipschitz神经网络的三类方法：(1) Lipschitz by Regularization（如Parseval Networks，通过在损失中加入正交性惩罚项）；(2) Lipschitz by Parameterization（如Cayley、SOC、BCOP等参数化映射Φ:Θ→𝓛(d)，将无约束参数映射到谱范数≤1的矩阵，含核参数化和频域谱参数化两子类）；(3) Lipschitz by Manifold Optimization（如projUNN，将权重初始化并维持在正交流形𝓞(d)上，通过Riemannian梯度和收缩映射更新）。同时介绍了Lipschitz感知的训练损失（铰链损失、Lipschitz交叉熵、GloRo、EMMA等）以及GroupSort、残差连接等保持表达力的结构。

Result: 文章给出了Lipschitz分类器的通用证书定理（Theorem 1）：证书半径等于得分函数边际除以L·√2，前向传播一次即可获得。综述表明Lipschitz有界网络能够在设计上提供确定的鲁棒性保证，优于概率保证的随机平滑方法和计算昂贵的形式化验证；扩散模型生成数据可使CRA提升约8%，但与训练样本数呈对数关系；还揭示了浮点精度下谱范数下估计会虚增证书半径的隐患。

Conclusion: Lipschitz控制是提供可设计稳定性保证的通用框架。其核心归结为两个任务：构建具有已知Lipschitz常数的网络，以及训练产生大边际的模型。文章指出了开放方向：Transformer中注意力机制的Lipschitz化、卷积核上的流形优化、向量值函数的通用逼近性、证书在浮点实现下的健全性，以及Lipschitz约束在差分隐私、Wasserstein GAN、虚拟模拟音频等领域的更广泛应用。

Abstract: The Lipschitz property of a deep neural network provides a direct measure of its sensitivity to input perturbations and, when explicitly controlled, offers a principled way to limit the propagation of errors and improve robustness. Over the past decade, Lipschitz-bounded layers have been incorporated into increasingly expressive and high-performing deep models, narrowing the gap between empirical robustness and formal, by-design guarantees of stability. This article introduces the fundamental concepts underlying Lipschitz-bounded neural networks, explaining the principles behind Lipschitz-constrained layers, the mechanisms used to enforce their bounds, and how they yield robustness certificates at the cost of a single forward pass. The tutorial concludes by discussing emerging and open directions, highlighting Lipschitz control as a general framework for offering guaranteed, by-design stability.

</details>


### [521] [SimAuthor: Harnessing Foundation Models for Persistent Scientific Simulator Authoring](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06257)
*Yishan Wang,Ran Piao,Mathias Funk,Aaqib Saeed*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出SimAuthor，一个面向科学模拟器编写的持续性编辑框架。核心思想是在弱经验反馈（无精确验证器、仅有少量真实观测）下，让基础模型以"修订可执行模拟器"而非"采样最优输出"为目标进行累积式代码优化。其在六个生物医学信号任务上系统优于独立采样、PUCT分数搜索与文本策略优化等基线，并能泛化到未见录音、独立预训练表示及下游ECG分类任务。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基础模型具备生成科学代码的能力，但科学模拟器编写存在以下核心难点：(1) 无唯一正确实现，缺乏精确验证器；(2) 仅能依赖有限真实观测进行分布层面的弱反馈比较；(3) 目标对象是可执行模拟器程序本身，而非其采样输出。已有工作要么从零生成代码（无法累积），要么仅在策略空间优化（未继承可执行性器）。本文试图填补"以可执行模拟器为持续编辑对象"这一空白。

Method: SimAuthor由三个核心组件构成：(1) 搜索编排器：采用flat-pool PUCT在候选池中选择父节点；(2) 细化器：将科学蓝图、当前程序代码、结构化差异报告（而非仅标量分数）和视觉对比作为上下文，由基础模型生成子程序；(3) 机制库：当修订使分数提升超过δ时，将差异蒸馏为命名机制条目，供后续尝试复用。评估器按模态固定（音频用MFCC+ZCR重叠，PPG用节律-形态统计量相似度，ECG用冻结ECGFounder嵌入的能量距离）。科学蓝图在接触任何数据前由基础模型一次生成，作为稳定的领域先验。

Result: 在固定100次尝试预算下，SimAuthor在6个任务中的5个取得最高终点分数S_max，全面优于PUCT分数搜索（控制搜索编排，仅改变反馈信息量），并在多数任务上优于文本策略优化。AF任务例外，Text-Opt更强（其评估器暴露的生理节律统计量更适合策略级调整）。在未见录音、独立预训练表示（OPERA-CE、PaPaGei-S）以及下游ECG分类（LQT/WPW的OOD AUPRC分别从.633→.747、.691→.804）上增益均保持。结构化差异报告对最终结果贡献最大（移除后S_max下降.063–.405），机制库主要提升搜索效率。修订审计显示111/138次修订改变了程序结构，占据86.1%的得分净增益，证实进步来自模拟器结构的演化而非仅参数调优。增大独立采样至token匹配预算（380次）仍不能缩小差距。

Conclusion: 本文确立"科学模拟器编写"作为基础模型的一项可行应用。在弱经验反馈设置下，持续以可执行模拟器为编辑中心——结合结构化差异反馈与机制记忆——可将基础模型的先验知识逐步转化为更高质量的可执行科学模型。该范式不局限于生物医学，可推广至任何可将模拟器输出与观测对比的领域。未来方向包括纳入专家设计特征与生理约束、扩展到物理系统与工业传感、以及将编写后的模拟器用于基于模拟的推断和数字孪生等外延用途。

Abstract: Foundation models can generate scientific code, but authoring a scientific simulator (an executable program encoding hypotheses about how mechanisms generate observable signals) requires iterative refinement. Scientific adequacy rarely admits a unique implementation or exact test, so simulators must instead be judged against limited real observations. We study this setting as scientific simulator authoring under weak empirical feedback, where distributional comparisons between simulated and real signals guide revision, and the target is the simulator itself rather than only its generated samples. We introduce SimAuthor, a persistent authoring harness that retains and revises executable simulators, separates scalar search scores from structured discrepancy feedback, and accumulates reusable implementation mechanisms. We evaluate SimAuthor on six biomedical tasks spanning cardiac and respiratory audio, photoplethysmography (PPG), and electrocardiography (ECG). Under a fixed 100-attempt budget, SimAuthor outperforms PUCT score search on all six tasks, generally outperforms textual-strategy optimization, and achieves the highest endpoint score on five of six. The authored simulators also improve on unseen recordings, transfer to independent pretrained representations, and yield substantial out-of-distribution gains in downstream ECG classification. Finally, 111 of 138 audited revisions alter program structure and account for 86.1% of the signed score improvement. These results suggest that persistent revision can progressively convert foundation-model knowledge into better executable scientific simulators from limited empirical evidence.

</details>


### [522] [OCL-PDE: A Generative Framework for PDE Inverse Problems with Observation-Complementary Latents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06259)
*Ding Yang,Chuqi Chen,Chang Ma,Yang Xiang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 OCL-PDE 框架，通过学习观测互补的潜变量（observation-complementary latent），结合物理感知自编码器与条件 Flow Matching，解决 PDE 反问题中细尺度细节难以恢复的难题。该方法在 Allen-Cahn 反向恢复和 Darcy 系数反演任务上均取得优于基线的重建精度与细节恢复能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: PDE 反问题通常是不适定的，观测可能粗化、稀疏或含噪，且耗散演化会抹去初态信息，导致不同场产生相似观测，细尺度结构难以恢复。现有生成式方法或学习低维潜变量表示，但未确保潜变量专门用于补充观测以恢复细尺度细节，亟需专门为观测条件重建设计的潜变量表示。

Method: OCL-PDE 框架包含两个阶段：(1) 物理感知自编码器（AE），编码器有响应预测分支与潜变量分支，解码器有观测基础预测路径与潜变量修正路径，通过门控机制融合；训练采用响应监督损失、重建损失、弱形式 PDE 物理损失（CSRBF 测试函数）和 KL 正则。(2) 条件 Flow Matching 在冻结 AE 上学习从高斯噪声生成潜变量，条件为观测；采用空间 FiLM 调制与自注意力。推理时对 K 个独立高斯源采样并聚合。

Result: 在三个任务上验证：(1) Allen-Cahn 反向恢复：初始场相对 L2 误差 0.05897，优于 PINO (0.18496)、No-Z 消融 (0.09827)，推理仅 0.92s/场；(2) GRF Darcy 连续系数反演（粗观测）：50% clean anchor 覆盖率下，1% 噪声误差降低 34.9%，3% 噪声误差降低 54.6%；(3) 二元 Darcy 系数反演（稀疏观测）：5% 观测率下硬像素误差 2.36%，比 PINO (5.07%) 低 53.5%，推理 0.34s/场。消融实验证实潜变量确实捕获观测路径之外的补充信息，y 决定相分布，z 提供相内细尺度结构。

Conclusion: OCL-PDE 通过专门设计的观测互补潜变量表示，结合物理感知 AE 与条件 Flow Matching，在 PDE 反问题上显著提升了重建精度与细尺度细节恢复能力，且推理效率高。未来工作将扩展至热源分布恢复与边界条件辨识等任务。

Abstract: Partial differential equation (PDE) inverse problems are often ill-posed, making fine-scale details difficult to recover. We address this problem by introducing a learned observation-complementary latent representation that preserves reconstruction-relevant information and is combined with the observation to reconstruct the unknown field. Building on this representation, we propose OCL-PDE, a generative framework that encourages the observation to guide large-scale structure and the latent to supply complementary fine-scale details. OCL-PDE is built on a physics-aware autoencoder (AE) and conditional Flow Matching, supporting inverse reconstruction as well as forward PDE prediction. Experiments demonstrate improved reconstruction accuracy and fine-detail recovery compared with the evaluated baselines.

</details>


### [523] [What May an Agent Change About Itself? A Containment Floor for Self-Configuring Agent Runtimes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06274)
*Sajib Hossain,Moeen Uddin Mahmud*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究智能体运行时中允许智能体编辑自身配置所带来的安全隐患，提出并实现"包含性底线"(containment floor)机制：将配置字段分为能力(Capability)、范围(Scope)、门控(Gate)三类，智能体只能修改能力字段，禁止修改范围和门控字段。实验证明，无保护时模型会在普通请求中主动放宽自身限制，提示词禁令仅能阻止使用相同词汇的请求，而写入层强制机制能阻止全部受保护的写入。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 智能体运行时普遍允许智能体通过配置工具修改自身配置，但部分字段决定了智能体的安全边界（如可写目录、允许的发送方、网络监听地址、认证令牌、风险写入阻断开关等）。若智能体能修改这些边界字段，单一普通请求即可扩大其权限范围。此前的工作（如AIRGuard、PORTICO等）控制智能体的行为，但未覆盖智能体通过配置工具修改自身限制这一路径。

Method: 1. 提出三分类规则：能力字段(允许智能体修改)、范围字段(决定智能体在哪里活动、谁能触达)、门控字段(控制执行机制本身)，后两类禁止智能体修改。2. 在config_set工具中实现"包含性底线"——通过精确路径匹配、键名深度匹配、值匹配来拒绝受保护字段的写入。3. 在已部署的运行时中设计六类实验臂：无保护、字段名提示词禁令、效果描述提示词禁令、两者结合、底线机制、生产版。4. 使用两类模型（gpt-5.6前沿模型与llama3.2:3b小模型），十八个请求（间接、直接、控制各六个），分别统计"尝试受保护写入"与"实际执行受保护写入"两个指标。5. 对底线机制进行绕过路径搜索（无模型测试十七种候选写入+有模型测试十七种针对性请求）。

Result: 1. 无保护时：前沿模型在72个普通请求中有25个保存了受保护值（35%），常发生在请求未指名字段时（如wifi请求从不字段名但修改了server.host）。2. 提示词禁令效果与措辞相关：列字段名的提示完全阻止直接请求（0/36对比17/36，p=1.3×10⁻⁶），但不阻止间接请求（10/36对比8/36，p=0.79）；描述禁止效果的提示则效果相反。3. 底线机制：在167个受保护写入尝试中，成功保存0个（其中65次被模型尝试）；Floor与Shipped两臂之间无显著差异。4. 绕过路径搜索：发现一条路径——启用shell工具可直接重写清单文件绕过底线；此路径已在底线范围声明中明确排除。

Conclusion: 智能体能编辑自身配置即可改变本应约束它的限制。需按字段决定智能体可修改的内容：能力归智能体，活动范围、触达范围与门控机制归更高权限方。实验表明：无阻止时模型会越界；提示词禁令仅阻止使用禁令同词汇的请求；在写入点进行检查可阻止所有受保护写入。允许智能体或元智能体配置运行时的开发者应为每个字段明确此边界，并在工具而非提示词中强制执行。论文也坦承了局限性：仅两个模型、样本量小且相关、单次实验、绕过路径需加载时检查或禁止shell等额外措施。

Abstract: Many agent runtimes give the agent a tool for editing its own configuration. Some of that configuration grants abilities, such as enabling a tool. Other parts set the agent's limits: which directories it may write to, who may send it messages, which network address it listens on, how callers authenticate, and the gate that blocks risky writes. If the agent can edit those limits, a single ordinary request can widen them. We study this in a deployed, model-agnostic runtime. We propose a rule: the agent may change fields that grant abilities, and may never change fields that set its limits. We enforce the rule as a containment floor inside the configuration tool and measure what happens with and without it. Without the floor, a frontier model wrote a protected value on 25 of 72 ordinary requests that gave it permission to change settings, often when the request never named the field. Prohibitions written in the system prompt failed in a predictable way.
