A prompt that listed the protected field names stopped every request that used those names (0 of 36 saved, against 17 of 36 with no prompt) and did not stop the requests that only described the goal (10 of 36 saved, against 8 of 36). A prompt that described the forbidden effects did the reverse. With the floor, 0 of 167 protected writes were saved, although the models attempted a protected write in 65 of those cases. A search for other routes through the tool found only one, a pinned shell, which the floor's scope statement already excludes. The study covers two models and a single agent. We state what that does and does not support.

</details>


### [524] [dIon: Fragmentation-Based Invariance for Self-Supervised Learning of Tandem Mass Spectra](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06282)
*Alfred Nilsson,Joel Lapin,Samuel H. Payne,Mathias Wilhelm,Lukas Käll*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出dIon，一种基于"碎片化不变性"的自监督学习方法，将DINO框架适配到肽段串联质谱（MS/MS）数据，无需肽段序列标签即可学习有用的表示。该方法通过前体条件混合任务和前体隐藏部分视图任务两个潜在预测目标，在MassIVE-KB和Kingdoms测试集上显著提升了从头测序精度，并学习到强大的肽段相似性几何。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 肽段串联质谱数据中仅有少数光谱带有数据库搜索分配的肽段标签，而自监督学习可以利用全部光谱。现有自监督方法（如图像裁剪的对比学习方法）不能直接迁移到无序集合结构的质谱数据，需要一种利用质谱测量过程内在物理关系（碎片离子与前体性质之间的联系）的自监督不变性。

Method: 1. 编码器：15块Transformer，宽度1024，约127M参数；峰值通过正弦编码m/z和强度，前体信息编码为单独token。2. 双潜在预测目标：(a) 前体条件混合任务——学生网络看到两光谱合并的视图，利用前体信息识别目标源；(b) 前体隐藏部分视图任务——学生网络看到部分峰值且前体被屏蔽，需从片段离子恢复表示。3. 借鉴DINO自蒸馏框架，使用Sinkhorn-Knopp平衡和EMA教师网络。

Result: dIon在Kingdoms测试集从头测序精度提升2.3-8.4个百分点，超越Casanovo和InstaNovo等全监督SOTA模型；在无标签情况下，冻结的dIon表示在肽段检索和配对判别上优于其他学习方法；在10%标签的监督微调下，dIon初始化在所有基准测试和指标上均达到最优。机制探测证实两个预测任务均按预期工作，消融实验证明完整目标表现最佳。

Conclusion: 基于测量过程结构设计视图构建的自监督学习方法可成功迁移到新模态。对于肽段串联质谱，"碎片化不变性"利用了前体与片段离子之间的物理联系，无需肽段标签。dIon是首个证明自监督预训练可在从头测序任务上超越匹配训练基线的模型，其学到的全局和密集表示可有效迁移至多个下游任务。

Abstract: We introduce a novel invariance for peptide tandem mass spectrometry data, unlocking self-supervised representation learning that improves de novo sequencing of peptides. This invariance exploits the physical relationship between precursor properties (mass and charge) and fragment-ion evidence, without requiring peptide sequence labels. We introduce dIon, which adapts the DINO framework with two latent prediction tasks, both recovering a clean teacher representation: one from a spectrum mixture, using the precursor as a selection query, and one from a partial spectrum with the precursor withheld. The first associates precursor information with fragment-ion evidence; the second prevents representational collapse onto that information alone. Mechanistic probes support both effects, and ablations show that the full objective performs best. Under identical end-to-end training, dIon initialization improves de novo peptide precision over training from scratch by 5.5 and 8.4 percentage points on the held-out MassIVE-KB and Kingdoms test sets, and by 2.3 and 4.8 percentage points with a larger supervised training corpus. The resulting models surpass fully supervised state-of-the-art de novo sequencing models on the diverse, multi-species Kingdoms corpus under the same greedy-decoding protocol. Without peptide labels, dIon learns strong native peptide-similarity geometry compared with other learned models; with limited peptide-supervised adaptation, it achieves the best retrieval and pair-discrimination performance across all representation benchmarks.

</details>


### [525] [Trajectory-Guided Tokenization of Complex CSI for Wi-Fi Sensing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06288)
*Ziyi Wang,Kenuo Xu,Jichu Jiang,Yumeng Yang,Zheng Chen,Xiaofei Bai,Muge Chen,Xuyang Chen,Jinglei He,Jannik Hammel Nielsen,Stefan Schmid*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了Trajectory-Guided Tokenization (TGT)，一种用于Wi-Fi CSI感知的新型tokenization方法。TGT通过正交Helmert变换将复值CSI的短时序patch分解为局部中心和中心化轨迹坐标，并结合非对称交叉注意力机制（Key仅由中心化轨迹生成，Value保留全部坐标），将子载波聚合为紧凑的连续token。在自采集数据集、EHUNAM和Widar3.0上分别取得92.83%、90.44%和72.14%的平均准确率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Wi-Fi CSI是用于存在检测和手势识别的高维复值时间序列。现有的CSI表示学习方法（如CSI-JEPA仅用幅度、WiFi-JEPA联合幅度与去噪相位）在跨域泛化方面存在局限，且未能明确区分"用于指导子载波聚合的信息"与"用于保留预测内容的信息"。作者观察到不同采集条件下局部中心会偏移，因此需要一种对中心偏移鲁棒的tokenization方法。

Method: 1) 复轨迹分解：对每个子载波的时间patch，使用正交Helmert矩阵将其分解为局部复均值（中心）和中心化轨迹坐标（对比向量），保持信息的无损可逆表示。2) 中心化轨迹Key生成：Key MLP仅从标准化的中心化轨迹坐标学习，并加入子载波正弦位置编码。3) 非对称频率路由（AFR）：K个可学习query通过交叉注意力将所有子载波聚合为K个频率槽，Value保留中心+轨迹的完整坐标。4) 天线链路均值池化+线性投影，输出每个时间patch的D维token。5) 与下游后端（Transformer、BiGRU、ResNet18、TokenMLP）端到端联合从头训练。

Result: 在自采集跨房间存在检测数据集上，TGT+TokenMLP取得92.83%平均准确率（最佳前端-后端组合），优于ConvPatch+TokenMLP的86.65%；在EHUNAM上取得90.44%，远超最佳基线AP-Patch的74.23%；在Widar3.0跨房间手势识别上以ResNet18取得72.14%。消融实验表明：无Helmert变换时性能急剧下降（64.93%/70.69%/60.02%）；Key中包含中心信息（w/ Key Center）和Value中去掉中心信息（w/o V Center）均导致性能下降，验证了"Key与Value分离"设计的重要性。

Conclusion: TGT通过将"用于指导聚合"的信息（中心化轨迹）与"用于保留预测内容"的信息（中心+轨迹）解耦，实现了对局部中心偏移的鲁棒性，在跨域存在检测和手势识别任务上均达到最优。消融实验支持Helmert分解和非对称注意力设计的有效性，表明聚合引导信息与预测保留信息应当分开处理。

Abstract: Wi-Fi channel state information (CSI) enables contactless presence detection and gesture recognition. Its high-dimensional complex-valued time series require input representations that preserve informative temporal variations during compression. We propose Trajectory-Guided Tokenization (TGT), which combines complex trajectory decomposition with asymmetric attention to construct compact continuous tokens. For each antenna link and subcarrier, an orthonormal Helmert transform decomposes short, ordered temporal patches into local-center and centered-trajectory coordinates. Keys are learned from the centered-trajectory coordinates, while values retain both components. Learnable queries aggregate subcarriers into frequency slots, which are fused into temporal tokens. Trained jointly from scratch, TGT with TokenMLP achieves the highest mean accuracy of 92.83% among all evaluated frontend-backend combinations on the self-collected dataset. Experiments on EHUNAM and Widar further support the applicability of TGT to cross-domain presence detection and gesture recognition.

</details>


### [526] [SPDAlign: Interpretable Riemannian Alignment for EEG Forward Modeling Shifts](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06315)
*Shanglin Li,Shiwen Chu,Okan Koç,Chenyu Liu,Qibin Zhao,Motoaki Kawanabe,Mitsuo Kawato,Yi Ding*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: SPDAlign是一个用于EEG跨被试无监督领域自适应的可解释黎曼对齐框架，通过SPD流形上的均值对齐和基于Wasserstein Procrustes的旋转对齐来缓解由被试特异前向模型（如头部几何）引起的分布偏移。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: EEG-BCI因数据非平稳性（跨会话、跨被试）存在严重分布偏移，导致模型泛化差；现有黎曼对齐方法多为启发式、缺乏理论依据，且需要目标域标签或仅限单源单目标设置。

Method: 基于EEG线性生成模型（信号=前向矩阵×潜在源+噪声），通过极分解将域间偏移分解为平移与旋转；理论证明SPD流形上的均值匹配+全局正交变换即可恢复域不变的潜在表示log(E_i)。源域训练阶段用Orthogonal Procrustes（利用标签构造类约束对应），目标域推理阶段用Wasserstein Procrustes（无标签，通过最优传输推断对应关系），并端到端联合优化特征提取器、对齐模块与线性分类器。

Result: 在4个公开EEG数据集（运动想象、心理负荷、心理压力、驾驶疲劳）上，SPDAlign在3个任务上达到SOTA，接近使用目标标签的Oracle上界；模拟显示其对旋转偏移、信噪比、样本量和标签偏移均具鲁棒性；消融实验证实旋转对齐至关重要（p=0.02）；框架保持全局线性，可解释地识别θ频段、额叶-顶叶区域等符合神经科学先验的生物标志物。

Conclusion: SPDAlign首次为EEG前向建模偏移提供了理论驱动的无监督多源多目标对齐方案，在性能、可解释性和理论支撑三方面取得平衡；局限性在于特征分解带来的高维计算成本，未来工作包括更鲁棒的旋转估计与在线BCI扩展。

Abstract: Electroencephalography (EEG) based brain-computer interfaces enable direct brain-to-device communication for applications such as rehabilitation and communication. However, their practical utility is often limited as the non-stationary nature of the EEG data introduces distribution shifts across domains (e.g., sessions and subjects). Adapting machine learning models to be invariant to these shifts in an unsupervised way, without using costly labeled calibration data, would drastically improve the utility of EEG data. In this work, we use a classic generative model of EEG to study distribution shifts introduced by the domain-specific forward process, which is associated with factors such as head geometry. We theoretically show that such distribution shifts can be recovered solely through linear transformations on the Symmetric Positive Definite manifold. Building on this insight, we propose SPDAlign, an interpretable framework for promoting domain-invariant EEG learning. SPDAlign first aligns the domain-specific means and corrects global rotations across domains using a recent optimal transport technique called Wasserstein Procrustes. We systematically study the proposed approach through simulations and demonstrate its competitive performance on extensive public EEG datasets. Additionally, SPDAlign is a globally linear framework and is intrinsically interpretable, so that the framework can identify frequency ranges of interest, determine the spatial patterns reflecting source-sensor relationships, and address cross-subject variability.

</details>


### [527] [Dynamic Minimax Regret Optimization for Robust LLM Post-Training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06329)
*Chengbo Zang,Haoyu Dong,Mehmet Kerem Turkcan,Gil Zussman,Zoran Kostic,Javad Ghaderi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出DUCB-OGD算法，将Discounted UCB采样器与Online Gradient Descent优化器耦合，用于在瞬时小批量bandit反馈下实现LLM后训练的组分布鲁棒优化。算法无需历史重放或辅助模型评估，仅维护O(K)标量状态，对K个数据源、T步训练实现Õ(K^{1/4}T^{3/4})的动态minimax遗憾（在该反馈模型下对未折扣目标最优至对数因子）。在SFT、DPO、GRPO三类后训练目标上的实验表明，该方法在多数设置中取得最高的最小源精度，计算开销可忽略。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现代LLM后训练依赖异构数据源（不同领域、任务、偏好分布、难度），平均损失最小化无法保证最差源的鲁棒性。标准GDRO是静态视角，无法捕捉训练过程中最差源的动态变化；现有方法要么计算昂贵（历史重放），要么需要额外的专家模型，难以集成到标准训练管线。需要在仅利用瞬时小批量反馈的约束下实现动态最差源跟踪。

Method: 将训练建模为采样器-优化器二人博弈：采样器通过bandit反馈在K个数据源间选择，优化器用所选源的小批量梯度更新参数。采样器采用Discounted UCB（DUCB），维护每个源的指数移动平均（EMA）损失估计和基于折扣有效样本量的置信半径，不重放历史数据。优化器采用Online Gradient Descent（OGD）。实现中采用高斯扰动版的DUCB（使选择变为非退化类别分布）、双重EMA平滑以及强制探索，以稳定训练。理论分析引入(ρ,γ)-折扣动态minimax遗憾，将其分解为优化遗憾（OGD部分）和动态bandit遗憾（DUCB部分）。

Result: 理论结果：当学习率η=K^{-1/4}T^{-3/4}、折扣因子β=1-K^{-1/2}T^{-1/2}时，DUCB-OGD的期望(ρ,γ)-折扣动态minimax遗憾为Õ(K^{1/4}T^{3/4})，对未折扣目标（ρ=γ=1）通过构造硬实例证明该速率最优至对数因子。实验结果：在Qwen2.5、Qwen3、Llama3、GLM4等多个模型族的SFT（GSM8k+IFEval）、DPO（HelpSteer3）、GRPO（Reasoning/CommonsenseQA）六类主要设置中，DUCB-OGD在五类取得最高最小源精度；Qwen2.5-3B三随机种子DPO最小精度提升2.57±1.04个百分点；每步运行时间21.94±1.14秒，与均匀采样的21.90±1.29秒相当。

Conclusion: DUCB-OGD在瞬时小批量bandit反馈下实现LLM后训练的动态组分布鲁棒优化，理论遗憾最优且实践计算开销可忽略。在最差源鲁棒性为首要目标、源难度随训练变化、仅有瞬时反馈可用的场景中尤为适用。权衡点：最差源与平均性能之间存在取舍，优化遗憾分析不覆盖非凸损失景观；实验限于0.5B–9B模型和源数较少的数据集，更大模型和更复杂分布需进一步研究。

Abstract: Modern LLM training increasingly relies on heterogeneous data sources spanning different domains, tasks, preference distributions, and difficulty levels. We study dynamic minimax regret for group-distributionally robust LLM post-training under instantaneous mini-batch-only bandit feedback. The framework views the training as a two-player sampler-optimizer process: a sampler adaptively selects among data sources using bandit feedback, while an optimizer updates the model parameters using stochastic gradients from the selected source. We focus on the practically restrictive setting where source losses evolve with model training but historical data are not re-evaluated, requiring the sampler to track instantaneous worst-sources from stale partial feedback. We propose DUCB-OGD, a simple and scalable algorithm that couples a Discounted Upper-Confidence-Bound sampler with an Online Gradient Descent optimizer. The sampler maintains exponential moving average loss estimates and confidence radii based on discounted effective sample sizes, avoiding costly re-evaluation of past data or intrusive changes to standard training pipelines. For $K$ data sources and $T$ training steps, we prove that DUCB-OGD achieves a dynamic minimax regret of $\tilde{O}(K^{1/4}T^{3/4})$, which is optimal up to logarithmic factors for the undiscounted objective under our feedback model. Extensive experiments across supervised fine-tuning, preference optimization, and reinforcement learning show that DUCB-OGD integrates seamlessly into modern LLM training pipelines and improves worst-group robustness with negligible computational overhead compared with standard sampling baselines.

</details>


### [528] [Stability-Shaped Deep Graph Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06344)
*Junyou Zhu,Langzhou He,Fenying Cai,Christian Nauck,Ping Xiong,Chao Gao,Philip S. Yu,Klaus-Robert Müller,Jürgen Kurths,Frank Hellmann*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出SDGL（Stability-Shaped Deep Graph Learning），通过主稳定性函数（master stability function, MSF）将GNN深度传播中的过平滑问题重新表述为同步流形附近的模式稳定性问题，并基于此设计两种深度架构：SDGL-DI（诱导扩散不稳定性以促进图模式形成）和SDGL-NC（保持近临界稳定传播），在节点和图级分类基准上取得一致提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 深度GNN虽扩大感受野，但易产生过平滑——节点表征趋于一致而丧失判别力。现有动力学分析多绑定特定架构，缺乏跨模型、跨图的统一理论框架。核心问题在于过平滑并非嵌入绝对值问题，而是同步偏差的衰减速率问题，需要可迁移的设计准则。

Method: 1. 理论框架：将层深度视为"时间"，层更新视为图耦合动力学，把过平滑刻画为同步流形 $\mathcal{S}=\{\mathbf{1}\otimes\mathbf{h}\}$ 附近非同步偏差的指数衰减。在同步平衡点 $\mathbf{h}^\star$ 处线性化并对图算子 $\mathbf{G}$ 做谱分解，得到主稳定性函数 $\Lambda(\mu)=\max\Re(\mathrm{eig}(\mathbf{J}-\mu\mathbf{C}))$，将 $nq$ 维耦合系统解耦为 $n$ 个独立的 $q$ 维子系统（Theorem IV.2）。定义三种MSF区制：(I) 耗散型（扩散导致过平滑），(II) 扩散诱发（DI）不稳定型（带限放大，形成图灵型图样），(III) 近临界（NC）稳定型（弱收缩、深度稳定）。2. 架构设计：统一两层反应-扩散模板 $\mathbf{R}^{\ell+1}=\mathbf{R}^{\ell}+\Delta t(f_R+C_R\mathbf{G}\mathbf{R}^{\ell})$，输出拼接 $[\mathbf{R}^L\|\mathbf{F}^L]$。SDGL-DI采用Schnakenberg型激活子-抑制子反应，$\mathbf{J}$ 行列式为正使 $\det(\mathbf{J}-\mu\mathbf{C})<0$ 在 $(\mu_-,\mu_+)$ 带内成立，实现区制II；SDGL-NC采用捕食者-猎物反应，局部Jacobian特征值为纯虚数 $\pm i\sqrt{\alpha_j\gamma_j}$，扩散偏移使 $\rho(T_\text{NC}(\mu_k))\in[1-\varepsilon_\text{MSF},1)$（Theorem V.1），实现区制III。

Result: 1. 同质图基准（Cora、CiteSeer、PubMed、Coauthor-CS、Computers、Photo）：SDGL-NC在Cora(84.03%)、Coauthor-CS(95.68%)、Photo(95.33%)上最佳，SDGL-DI在Computers(90.94%)最佳；2. 异质图基准（Actor、Squirrel、Chameleon）：两个变体均最优，SDGL-NC在Squirrel(42.47%)和Chameleon(61.62%)上领先；3. 图分类FakeNewsNet：SDGL-DI在PolitiFact(Acc=0.921, F1=0.914)和GossipCop(Acc=0.970, F1=0.970)上均最佳；4. 深度扩展性：在Photo和Chameleon上30–60层时GCN/GAT性能骤降，SDGL保持稳定；5. Dirichlet能量演化证实三种区制行为（GCN快速衰减、SDGL-DI放大后饱和、SDGL-NC近常数）；6. 60层时SDGL参数仅0.255M，约为GCN的1/4、GAT的1/242。

Conclusion: SDGL将过平滑重新定义为同步流形附近的模式稳定性准则，通过主稳定性分解将图拓扑与局部非线性解耦，得到可跨架构、跨图迁移的稳定性曲线。基于此设计的SDGL-DI（图样形成）与SDGL-NC（近临界传播）在同质/异质节点分类和长程图分类上均实现一致的深度扩展性与精度提升，并辅以Dirichlet能量、谱增益和网格动力学诊断验证了理论预测。稳定性形塑（stability shaping）为深度GNN传播提供了原理化且可迁移的设计原则。

Abstract: In deep graph neural networks, increasing depth enlarges the receptive field but often leads to over-smoothing, where node representations tend to align. We develop a unified, mode-wise stability framework for deep GNN propagation that provides a principled characterization of over-smoothing. By interpreting layer depth as time and layer updates as graph-coupled dynamics, over-smoothing can be understood as an undesirable dynamical synchronization of features, for which the master stability curve provides a theoretical tool to assess the stability of synchrony. Guided by this theory, we further propose Stability-Shaped Deep Graph Learning (SDGL) to mitigate over-smoothing in deep GNNs. SDGL has two complementary instantiations: one induces controlled Turing instability to replace synchronization with spatial pattern formation, and the other maintains stable near-critical propagation. Experiments on diverse node- and graph-level benchmarks demonstrate the improved depth scaling and consistent accuracy gains over strong baselines, including graphs exhibiting long-range dependencies.

</details>


### [529] [Multimodal Deep Survival Analysis for Sinkhole Susceptibility](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06365)
*Lucas Yuan,Minhee Kim,Zihan Li,Chunli Dai,Sanduni S. Disanayaka Mudiyanselage,Ming Ye,Kani Fu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种多模态深度生存分析框架，用于佛罗里达州岩溶塌陷易发性评估。该框架将Cox比例风险筛选模型扩展到包含表格、栅格和时间序列（年降水量）的异构多模态地理空间输入，并通过右删失处理避免将未报告地点错误标记为负样本。佛罗里达州案例研究表明，多模态融合显著提升了预测性能，模型能够生成具有绝对概率意义的全州易发性分布图。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 岩溶塌陷易发性预测面临两大核心挑战：（1）缺乏报告的地点不能简单视为真负样本，因为存在报告偏差，未报告可能源于监测缺失而非无风险；（2）影响塌陷的因素跨越多种数据模态（表格地质属性、栅格水力特征、时间序列降水），需要统一框架进行融合。传统二元分类方法存在标签不准确和静态风险图缺失时间维度的问题。

Method: 提出多模态DeepSurv（深度生存）框架：（1）三模态专用编码器——表格用MLP、栅格用CNN、时间序列用RNN；（2）融合模块拼接后线性投影，Hazard MLP输出对数相对风险；（3）通过Cox偏似然损失（含Breslow ties处理）训练，端到端优化；（4）Breslow估计器估计基线累积风险函数；（6）存活函数生成K年生存概率；（7）等温回归（PAV单调公式）在验证集上进行后验单调校准，生成具有绝对意义的10年概率。删失机制：站点年份样本在事件年之前为删失，仅事件年窗口标记为正事件。

Result: 在佛罗里达州案例研究中（6,302站点，557,946样本，10年观测+10年预测滑动窗口）：（1）随机划分下多模态模型C-index达0.780，ROC-AUC达0.899，ECE仅0.0008；（2）更具泛化意义的县级（地质单元）划分下C-index为0.703，ROC-AUC为0.899，ECE为0.0011；（3）融合多模态将Lift从仅时间序列的4.4×提升至7.1×（随机）/6.9×（县级），验证集确认塌陷点得分远高于背景；（4）预训练无显著增益；（5）全州易发性图显示高风险集中在中西部岩溶带，与确认塌陷分布吻合。

Conclusion: 多模态融合与生存分析公式均对预测性能有贡献，其中等温校准是最稳健的贡献，使预测具有绝对概率意义。在空间不重叠划分下仍保持可靠判别能力，表明模型真正捕获了易感性而非记忆位置。未来工作包括跨重复县级划分方差分析以及将该工具扩展为决策支持系统应用于岩溶区。

Abstract: Sinkholes are a widespread geohazard in karst terrain. In Florida, soluble carbonate bedrock, shallow groundwater, and intense rainfall combine to make subsidence both common and spatially heterogeneous. Predicting where and when sinkholes will occur is difficult for two reasons. First, locations without reported sinkholes cannot be directly labeled or sampled as true negative locations. Second, the potential factors governing sinkhole risk span heterogeneous data modalities and therefore require careful integration within a unified modeling framework. We address both problems with our proposed model, a multimodal Cox proportional hazards framework for sinkhole susceptibility. Our contributions are threefold. First, we extend the proportional-hazards formulation to heterogeneous multimodal input through modality-specific encoders and a cross-modal fusion layer. Second, we treat unreported locations as right-censored rather than negative, avoiding hard-negative labeling and yielding continuous, time-aware susceptibility from the predicted survival function. Third, a statewide Florida case study with spatially blocked validation and ablation studies quantifies the benefit of multimodal integration. A Florida case study demonstrates that the proposed method effectively ranks sinkhole risk and produces a statewide susceptibility map that captures spatial variations in sinkhole occurrence.

</details>


### [530] [Learning Pareto Stationary Fronts via Single-Pass Backpropagation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06397)
*Elina Rojin Celik,Marcos Medeiros Raimundo,Isabel Valera*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: MOSEL提出了一种用于深度神经网络后验多目标优化的框架，通过双层优化的Stackelberg博弈重构，在单次前向-反向传播中恢复完整的Pareto平稳前沿，计算成本与标准单目标训练相当。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的多目标优化方法（如标量化方法或先验Pareto前沿学习方法）无法在保证Pareto平稳性的同时实现可扩展性，或者需要针对每个偏好重新训练，限制了在公平性-准确性、多任务学习等场景中的应用。

Method: 将后验多目标优化问题重构为双层优化问题，利用神经网络的模块化结构将表示学习网络与偏好对齐网络解耦；通过将双层优化转化为Stackelberg博弈，利用时间尺度分离实现单次前向-反向传播即可同时更新两层参数；偏好向量从Dirichlet分布中采样，通过FiLM层注入偏好对齐网络。

Result: 在强冲突设置（公平性-准确性，包括Adult、COMPAS、Default、FairFace数据集）上，MOSEL在超体积和Pareto最优解数量上均优于或匹配COSMOS基线；在弱冲突设置（多任务学习，包括Multi-MNIST、Multi-Fashion、CelebA等）上，MOSEL收敛至更接近乌托邦点的解，性能优于专用MTL方法（PCGrad、MGDA、GradNorm、FAMO、NashMTL），且计算开销与单目标训练相当。

Conclusion: MOSEL是首个在深度神经网络中实现可扩展Pareto平稳前沿学习的框架，通过Stackelberg博弈和模块化解耦实现了计算效率与理论保证的兼顾；随机偏好采样还隐式正则化了表示学习网络，使其倾向于学习跨目标共享的特征；该方法在公平性、多任务学习等领域具有广泛应用潜力。

Abstract: We propose MOSEL (Multi-Objective Stackelberg Efficient Learning), a framework for a posteriori multi-objective optimization (MOO) in deep neural networks that recovers a full front of Pareto stationary solutions at the computational cost of standard single-objective training. MOSEL reformulates the problem as a bilevel optimization problem that leverages network modularity to decouple representation learning from objective-preference alignment. Casting the bilevel optimization problem as a Stackelberg game enables solving the original a posteriori MOO problem in a single forward-backward pass. As a result, MOSEL matches the time and memory efficiency of standard single-objective training while enabling scalable Pareto stationary front learning. Empirically, MOSEL uncovers diverse and optimal Pareto frontiers in strongly conflicting settings (e.g., fairness-accuracy). Remarkably, even in weakly conflicting regimes such as multi-task learning, it consistently converges to solutions closer to the utopia point, outperforming both standard single-objective training and specialized multi-task learning methods. These results highlight the broader potential of a posteriori MOO learning as a pathway to efficiently learn more diverse and robust representations, ultimately improving generalization.

</details>


### [531] [FlashCart: Fast Cartesian Tensor Products for Equivariant Interatomic Potentials](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06409)
*Viktor Zaverkin,Payman Goodarzi,Sergey V. Sukhomlinov,Davit Hovhannisyan,Roland Aydin,Martin H. Müser,Mathias Niepert*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: FlashCart提出基于笛卡尔不可约张量的等变机器学习原子间势框架，通过符号生成GPU内核和定宽关联阶梯，使高阶等变关联在计算上变得可负担，在精度-效率前沿上超越现有最优MLIPs。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 机器学习原子间势(MLIP)的评估成本限制了等变架构所能表示的局部关联复杂度和可达精度。高阶关联能提升精度，但传统球张量表示的代价过高。需要一种方法使高阶等变关联变得可负担，同时保持精度优势。

Method: 1) 在独立笛卡尔分量(2l+1个)上表达张量积及其导数，通过符号简化和微分生成融合的GPU Triton内核；2) 递归构建等变特征的关联阶梯，每步使用通道对角笛卡尔积后接线性混合，将宽度压缩固定为d，使计算成本随增相关阶数线性增长；3) 使用接收者排序的边缘卷积内核，在前向传播中避免原子加法，实现VJP和VJP-of-VJP的高效微分。

Result: 在SPICE-MACE-OFF数据集上，FlashCart在精度-效率前沿上超越现有最优MLIPs：5.6M参数模型达到0.072 meV/atom能量MAE和1.99 meV/Å力MAE，比189M参数的PET-L快约10倍，且参数量少33倍。在内核层面，VJP-of-VJP平均比cuEquivariance快1.9倍、比OpenEquivariance快3.1倍。提高相关阶数比提高宽度、深度或张量秩更有效地改善精度-效率权衡。

Conclusion: FlashCart结合符号笛卡尔张量积与生成GPU内核，以定宽关联阶梯实现了精度-效率权衡的显著改进，在多样性、生化、催化表面和分子动力学基准测试中展现出与最先进模型相当的精度，为通用等变原子间势提供了一种高效架构。其主要约束是固定通道宽度和受增强张量秩限制了关联表达能力。

Abstract: Machine-learned interatomic potentials extend atomistic simulations beyond the length- and timescales accessible to electronic-structure methods. However, the computational cost of equivariant architectures limits the local correlations they can represent in practice and therefore their achievable accuracy. Here we introduce FlashCart, which makes higher-order correlations affordable by combining generated GPU kernels with an architecture that recursively builds equivariant features and compresses them to a fixed width at each step. We express tensor products in independent Cartesian components and symbolically simplify them and their derivatives, producing fused kernels that often outperform optimized spherical counterparts. We then show that increasing correlation order improves accuracy more efficiently than increasing width, depth, or tensor rank. On SPICE-MACE-OFF, FlashCart models advance the measured accuracy-efficiency frontier: a model with $5.6$ million parameters achieves lower energy and force errors and $10\times$ faster inference than a transformer with $189$ million parameters.

</details>


### [532] [Training-Free Transformer Merging via Sequential Local Operator Alignment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06415)
*Akansh Maurya,Ya-Wei Eileen Lin,Stefanie Jegelka,Sebastian U Stich,Rotem Mulayoff*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出Sequential Local Operator Alignment (SLOA)，一种无需训练的Transformer模型合并方法，通过对齐局部功能算子（QK与VO复合算子）并沿部分合并模型的实际执行路径进行顺序合并，消除逐层独立合并带来的功能耦合偏差与误差累积，并支持秩扩展以提升多任务容量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有无需训练的模型合并方法通常在独立参数张量或独立激活空间上操作，忽略了Transformer中注意力机制的QK与VO算子由复合矩阵构成这一功能耦合结构，导致独立合并W_Q/W_K或W_V/W_O会破坏共享的注意力计算；此外，先合并的组件会改变后续组件接收的激活分布，使后续合并建立在与原始执行路径不匹配的激活假设上。

Method: 方法核心：1) 定义局部功能算子：LayerNorm仿射参数、线性映射W、QK复合算子W_Q W_K^⊤/√d_k、VO复合算子W_V W_O；2) 行为匹配损失：在部分合并模型的局部输入上，合并算子应复现任务特定算子在原始任务模型输入上的输出；3) 数据相关的算子空间正则化：使用校准激活的协方差作为度量，仅在数据激活的方向上施加Mahalanobis距离约束；4) 顺序合并策略：按o_1≺o_2≺…≺o_M的拓扑序逐个合并，每个算子在已合并上游的真实激活下求解，使每步合并具有误差校正性；6) 秩容量控制：合并后通过SVD在选定秩r处分解回有效的W_Q/W_K/W_V/W_O，r=d_k保持架构，r>d_k实现秩扩展。QK使用双侧度量Λ⊗Λ处理双线性行为。所有局部目标在固定校准状态时关于算子线性，因此是二次规划且闭式可解。

Result: 在多个模态与规模上验证：ViT-B/32合并8/14/20任务时，SLOA (r=64) 平均准确率达84.89/81.94/80.06%，r=128进一步提升至85.50/82.61/81.03%，相对最强基线RegMean++的差距随任务数从0.6扩大到5.5个百分点；RoBERTa合并7个GLUE任务时平均得分0.7906 (r=64) / 0.7979 (r=128)，超过RegMean++约7.7-8.4点；LoRA-LLaMA-2-7B合并数学/代码/指令三类专家时，SLOA-VO在r=384下达49.19平均分，超过所有基线得分。融合时间约180s（20个ViT-B/16任务，r=128），推理成本在r=64与所有基线相同。

Conclusion: SLOA将Transformer合并重构为一系列局部算子级回归问题，通过对齐QK/VO复合算子、沿部分合并路径顺序执行、数据相关的算子正则化以及秩容量控制，无需训练即可在多任务合并上取得SOTA，且优势随任务数增加而扩大。局限性：需要小规模无标签校准集；计算开销高于无数据方法；顺序过程为贪心而非端到端；秩扩展会增加推理时显存与延迟。未来可结合无数据合并、扩展至旋转位置编码架构、自动化逐头秩选择。

Abstract: Training-free model merging aims to combine multiple fine-tuned models into a single model without further optimization on labeled data. Yet, in transformers, independently merging individual layers can affect a shared attention computation because the query-key and value-output operators depend on composed matrices, overlooking the functional structure. Moreover, when merging earlier components, downstream components receive different activations than they do in the original model, thus, the merged and original execution paths no longer match. In this paper, we introduce Sequential Local Operator Alignment, a training-free method that merges transformers along the execution path of the partially merged model. Our method uses calibration data to estimate the local behavior of each functional component, aligns operators sequentially under the intermediate activation of the partially merged model, and subsequently factorizes the merged operators back into valid transformer parameters. We empirically show that this sequential step reduces error accumulation across layers. Furthermore, the proposed operator factorization step enables rank expansion, providing a principled mechanism for increasing multi-task capacity. We demonstrate that our approach generalizes across modalities, model scales, and varying numbers of tasks, from CLIP and RoBERTa to billion-parameter LLMs, and further extends naturally to the merging of LoRA-fine-tuned models. The results indicate improvements over strong merging baselines without requiring rank expansion, while optional expansion provides a further accuracy-inference-cost trade-off. Project link: this https URL

</details>


### [533] [Efficient Secure Federated Learning via Information-Theoretically Secure Key Distribution: A Medical Imaging Case Study](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06420)
*Ivan Donà,Hans H. Brunner,Álvaro Troyano Olivas,Chi-Hang Fred Fung,Momtchil Peev,Giovanni Iacca*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出一种基于信息论安全(QKD)密钥分发的联邦学习框架，通过冻结骨干网络、知识蒸馏和量化技术，将每轮密钥消耗降低约35倍，实现在真实量子密钥测试床上胸部X光分类的可持续联邦训练，同时保持预测精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 联邦学习中传统的安全聚合依赖经典公钥密码体制建立共享密钥，仅具有计算安全性，面临量子计算威胁；而基于物理的信息论安全(ITS)密钥分发（QKD）虽然提供无条件安全保证，但密钥生成速率有限且存储寿命有限，导致与未压缩医学影像模型（如ResNet-50约2560万参数）所需的大量密钥材料不匹配，造成密钥缓冲区耗尽，无法支持可持续的多轮训练。现有量子安全联邦学习工作要么未解决持续密钥消耗问题，要么未在真实量子密钥测试床上评估，要么局限于模拟。

Method: 框架包含两部分：(1) 量子安全环形加性掩码——在环形拓扑中，每个客户端从其两个邻居获取QKD密钥，对量化参数施加加性和减性掩码，掩码在服务器求和时精确抵消，实现O(n)而非O(n²)的量子链路；(2) 三阶段压缩流水线——冻结预训练骨干（MobileNetV3-Small，分类头仅约229K参数）、使用CheXpert微调的教师进行知识蒸馏得到约90K参数的紧凑学生分类头、对传输参数进行32/16/8位定点量化。实验在六客户端环形拓扑的CV-QKD真实测试床上进行，使用NIH ChestX-ray14数据集，模拟IID和非IID（Dirichlet α=0.1）划分，训练50轮。

Result: 8位量化学生头将每轮密钥消耗从3.2MB降至90KB（约35倍缩减），AUROC从教师基线0.762降至0.732（IID）和0.712（非IID），每链路约150KB/4min的密钥预算下实现可持续训练（盈余60KB），而非压缩基线在约33轮后耗尽100MB缓冲区。非IID场景下AUROC仅下降约0.01-0.02，证明对标签偏斜的鲁棒性。所有屏蔽配置的聚合结果与无屏蔽基线完全一致，验证了掩码精确抵消。

Conclusion: 该框架证明了在真实量子密钥硬件上将QKD与联邦学习结合的可行性，通过系统性的模型压缩有效缓解了量子密钥生成速率与联邦学习负载大小之间的根本矛盾。存在三个主要局限：环形拓扑要求所有客户端每轮全部在线（无掉线弹性）、合谋抵抗性弱于全连接配对掩码、仅在单一数据集和架构族上验证。未来工作将集中于集成掉线弹性机制、扩展到更多医学影像模态和骨干架构。

Abstract: Federated Learning (FL) enables collaborative training of models across institutions without centralizing sensitive data, making it well-suited for privacy-concerned applications, such as medical imaging. To protect FL model updates during secure aggregation, additive masking is commonly employed. However, its underlying classical key establishment is only computationally secure. On the other hand, physics-based Information-Theoretically Secure (ITS) key exchange introduces practical constraints: finite key generation rates and time-limited storage severely limit throughput and sustained training of uncompressed models. In this work, we address this bottleneck by developing an FL framework that integrates frozen backbones, knowledge distillation, and quantization. These techniques reduce communication payload and, consequently, key material consumption. Moving beyond simulation, we benchmark this framework on a real physics-based key distribution testbed involving a chest X-ray classification application. Our results show that key usage can be reduced by $\sim$35$\times$ while maintaining predictive accuracy. This prevents buffer depletion and key expiration, enabling sustainable FL training under physical key generation constraints.

</details>


### [534] [HeuFouFT: Task-Guided Metaheuristic Coordinate Search for Fourier Fine-Tuning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06437)
*Ruiheng Wang,Yubo Hou,Yakun Zhu,Tianle Shen,Tao Wan,Zengchang Qin*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出HeuFouFT框架，使用任务驱动的元启发式搜索（GA-SA、PSO、CS）结合Random Forest代理模型，在频域中自适应选择傅里叶微调的频率坐标。在GPT-2-Medium和E2E数据集上，使用37.6%更少的可训练频谱系数，在五个NLG指标上均优于固定采样方法和LoRA；PSO变体在四个指标上超越LoCA。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的FourierFT使用均匀采样或高斯带通采样等固定、任务无关的规则来选择频率坐标，无法将有限的频谱预算分配到对下游任务最重要的频率区域。LoRA学习到的ΔW频谱能量高度集中，与均匀/带通采样重叠度低，亟需任务驱动的坐标选择方法。

Method: HeuFouFT框架：(1) 构建10×10分块的启发式强度图（HI），通过轻量级微调评估各频域块的任务表现；(2) 使用Random Forest代理模型（R²=0.86）过滤每代候选，仅保留前30%进入代理微调；(3) 三种元启发式优化器在该先验上搜索层共享的频率坐标集E——GA-SA（遗传算法+模拟退火，Metropolis接受准则）、PSO（粒子群优化，sigmoid离散位移）和CS（布谷鸟搜索，Lévy飞行）；(4) 搜索完成后固定E，仅微调n个实系数c。

Result: 在GPT-2-Medium+E2E上：PSO在BLEU(70.9)、NIST(8.78)、METEOR(41.8)、CIDEr(1.71)四项指标上超越所有基线（含LoCA）；CS在ROUGE-L(68.9)上最优；三种变体均优于随机均匀、高斯带通FourierFT和LoRA。可训练参数仅0.03M（比FourierFT/LoCA少37.6%），最终微调FLOPs仅为Full FT的15-18%。三种优化器产生不同频谱分布但性能相近，说明收益主要来自任务驱动搜索本身。搜索阶段总耗时约12小时（单A100 80GB），RF代理模型降低69%计算成本。

Conclusion: 任务引导的频域坐标搜索能比固定采样更有效地分配有限的频谱适应容量。块级任务先验与元启发式优化结合的代理辅助框架是参数高效微调中频域方法的关键改进方向，搜索成本可一次性分摊。

Abstract: We introduce Heuristic-Guided Fourier Fine-Tuning (HeuFouFT), a task-guided framework for selecting trainable frequency coordinates in Fourier fine-tuning. Existing uniform and Gaussian band-pass schemes allocate a limited spectral budget through fixed, task-agnostic rules. HeuFouFT instead searches for coordinates using downstream performance. A coarse intensity map from lightweight block-level probes initializes three metaheuristic optimizers: Genetic Algorithm with Simulated Annealing (GA-SA), Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO), and Cuckoo Search (CS). During search, a Random Forest filters each population so that only the top 30% of candidates proceed to proxy fine-tuning. On E2E with GPT-2-Medium, all three variants outperform random-uniform FourierFT, Gaussian band-pass FourierFT, and LoRA across five metrics. PSO further outperforms LoCA, the best-performing baseline, on four metrics while using 37.6% fewer trainable spectral coefficients. Once coordinates are selected, HeuFouFT requires only 15--18% FLOPs of Full FT. These results show that task-guided search allocates limited spectral capacity more effectively than fixed sampling. Our code is publicly available.

</details>


### [535] [Time-series Foundation Models for Predictive Control: The Role of Excitation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06447)
*Mazen Amria,Jasper Hoffmann,Philipp Bordne,Anna Rothenhäusler,Lilli Frison,Harald Taxt Walnum,Sebastien Gros,Joschka Bödecker*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究时间序列基础模型(TSFM)用于模型预测控制(MPC)时的关键问题：低预测误差并不保证模型能正确捕捉系统对控制干预的响应。以住宅热泵控制为测试平台，发现TSFM需要推理上下文中包含充分的控制激励才能识别输入-响应关系；微调和多尺度特征可减少但无法消除这一需求。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有TSFM在零样本预测任务上表现优异，理论上可替代MPC中针对特定系统的模型辨识。然而，预测准确性仅衡量在数据生成策略下的观测拟合，不等同于模型能正确预测替代控制输入下的系统响应（即干预响应）。这一差距在建筑能源管理中尤为关键，因为建筑热动力学复杂且部分可观测，专门模型辨识成本高昂。需要系统评估TSFM是否真正捕获了控制相关的输入-输出关系。

Method: (1) 使用i4b模拟器生成191栋单户住宅的热泵控制时间序列数据，覆盖7个欧洲国家、跨度约一个数量级的热损失；(2) 提出"响应增益"指标——通过匹配探针集（共享上下文、初始状态和天气，仅控制序列不同），用最小二乘系数衡量模型对控制干预的响应保真度；(3) 评估零样本和微调（LoRA）Chronos-2模型在不同上下文长度和激励幅度（APRBS信号，振幅1.5/6/24 K）下的表现；(4) 引入多尺度EWMA控制特征（30分钟/2小时/8小时）；(5) 使用iCEM规划器在17栋测试建筑上进行闭环评估。

Result: (1) 零样本Chronos-2在不激励上下文下名义预测准确但对控制偏移干预无响应（响应增益≈0）；激励上下文中可恢复输入-响应关系（增益→1）；(2) 仅增加上下文长度而不增加激励不能提升增益；(3) 在激励数据上的微调显著改善增益，尤其在短上下文时，EWMA特征可在一日上下文下大幅恢复响应；(4) 微调不能完全替代激励：无激励操作下增益仍远低于1；(5) 闭环实验中Chronos-2可改善控制目标，激励上下文配合EWMA特征效果最佳；(6) 逐窗线性估计器在有足够数据时仍具竞争力。

Conclusion: TSFM能恢复控制相关的输入-输出关系，但前提是推理上下文包含充分的独立控制激励。名义预测准确率无法揭示这一能力，需配合干预响应指标评估。在激励数据上微调和多尺度特征可大幅减少所需的上下文长度和激励幅度，但无法完全消除对目标系统中信息性控制变化的需求。上下文是TSFM控制中的核心设计变量。

Abstract: Deploying model predictive control (MPC) requires constructing or identifying a predictive model for each target system. Time-series foundation models (TSFMs) offer an attractive option thanks to strong zero-shot forecasting capabilities across systems. However, low forecast error does not guarantee that a TSFM captures the system's response to the alternative actions considered by the controller. We study this gap using residential heat-pump control as a test bed, measuring the agreement between predicted and ground-truth effects of control interventions. Importantly, we find that TSFMs can recover the system's input-response relationship when the context contains sufficient independent control excitation. Common fine-tuning pipelines and feature smoothing reduce, but do not eliminate, the need for in-context excitation. Our results indicate that current TSFMs used for predictive control require sufficiently informative control variation in the inference context. Initial closed-loop results show promise for shorter context windows.

</details>


### [536] [EMG-FM-Bench: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Foundation Model Transfer and Adaptation on Electromyography](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06450)
*Tianhao Wu,Xu Wu,Amirmohammad Radmehr,Jiawei Yu,Yi Wu,Phuc Nguyen,Jian Liu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: EMG-FM-Bench 是一个系统化基准测试，旨在评估时间序列基础模型在 EMG 信号上的迁移与适配能力。它整合了 20 个公开数据集（超 100 万 EMG 片段）和 9 个预训练基础模型，围绕四个研究问题展开评估：冻结与微调的比较、预训练带来的收益、跨用户泛化能力以及在不同 EMG 任务间的一致性。结果表明预训练并非普遍有益，其效果高度依赖具体模型架构与数据集。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 尽管时间序列和生理信号基础模型日益增多，但它们在下游任务（特别是 EMG，因信号分布因用户、传感器、硬件和任务而异）中的迁移性仍未得到充分理解。现有 EMG 评估工作主要关注任务特定模型的跨用户鲁棒性，缺乏对通用预训练时间序列模型在 EMG 上迁移与适配行为的系统性评估框架。

Method: EMG-FM-Bench 统一了 20 个公共 EMG 数据集，涵盖上肢手势识别（15 个）、下肢运动分类（4 个）和连续序列解码（emg2qwerty，1 个），共超 100 万窗口。所有信号被重采样至 1000 Hz 统一网格，使用 3 秒非重叠窗口。评估了 9 个预训练模型配置（涵盖 MOMENT、Chronos-2、TimesFM、Lag-Llama、PatchTST、BRANT、UniTS 七个家族，参数从 ~1M 到 500M+）。围绕四个研究问题（RQ1-RQ4）设置了六种评估协议：线性探测、全微调、从头训练、零校准留存用户、LOSO、五样本适配。额外引入 BiLSTM 作为常规监督参考。

Result: 主要发现包括：(1) 全微调在大多数（79.5%）模型-数据集对上提升准确率（平均+13.3个百分点），但效果高度依赖模型，Chronos-2 系列在全部 19 个数据集上均有提升，而 MOMENT-B 平均下降 5.4 个点。(2) 预训练并非普遍有益：仅 62% 的情况下预训练优于从头训练，平均仅+3.3 个百分点；Chronos-2 系列获益最大（+16 点），而 MOMENT-B、PatchTST、Lag-Llama 微调后反而劣于从头训练。(3) 跨用户泛化显著下降（平均-14.9 个 F1 点），五样本适配在 70.2% 的情况下有改善但仅部分恢复。(4) 模型在上肢与下肢分类任务间表现高度一致（ρ=0.97），与连续解码（emg2qwerty）的相关性也较强（ρ=0.78-0.85）。Chronos-2-B 在所有任务中表现最优（emg2qwerty CER=19.7%）。模型规模与预训练收益并非正相关；BiLSTM 参考模型（2.4M 参数）从头训练时与多数 Transformer 骨干具有竞争力。

Conclusion: 研究为 EMG 基础模型开发提供了四点实践启示：(1) 冻结评估仅能识别宏观性能层级，不足以选择用于全适配的骨干；(2) 强大的微调性能本身不能证明预训练有用，需架构匹配的从头训练对照；(3) 跨用户评估应报告受试者级别变异性和 macro-F1，因有限校准仅提供部分且依赖任务的恢复；(4) 模型性能在不同 EMG 任务间保持强一致性，但上肢-下肢分类间的相关性高于与连续解码间的相关性。EMG-FM-Bench 提供了一个诊断框架，用于判断预训练时间序列表示何时迁移至 EMG、增益从何而来，以及这些增益是否能跨评估机制和任务泛化。代码、数据集与预处理流程已公开发布以确保可复现性。

Abstract: Foundation models (FMs) are increasingly being developed for general time series and physiological signals, yet their transferability to downstream physiological tasks remains poorly understood. This question is particularly challenging for electromyography (EMG), where signal distributions vary substantially across users, sensing configurations, acquisition hardware, and downstream tasks. We introduce EMG-FM-Bench, a systematic benchmark for studying foundation-model transfer and adaptation on EMG. EMG-FM-Bench unifies 20 public datasets with over 1 million EMG segments and evaluates nine pretrained foundation models across four questions: how pretrained models perform when frozen or fully fine-tuned, how much pretraining helps compared with training the same model from scratch, how well models generalize to new users with limited labeled data, and how performance changes across different EMG tasks. Across the benchmark, linear probing provides useful information about pretrained representations, but full fine-tuning can substantially change downstream EMG performance. Comparing each pretrained model with the same model trained from scratch shows that the benefit of pretraining varies substantially across models and is not universal. Performance decreases when models are evaluated on new users, while five-shot adaptation improves macro-F1 in 70.2% of evaluated model-dataset combinations but recovers only part of the lost performance. Model performance is highly consistent between upper- and lower-limb classification and remains strongly correlated with continuous EMG-to-text decoding. Together, these results provide a systematic view of when pretrained time-series models transfer effectively to EMG and how their performance depends on fine-tuning, user variation, and downstream task.

</details>


### [537] [FairProp: Fair Node Representation Learning via Differentiable Propagation Layers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06484)
*Emmanouil Kariotakis,Aritra Konar*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: FairProp 是一种针对图神经网络（GNN）的公平节点表示学习方法，通过将公平性约束直接融入到 APPNP 的凸平滑问题中，在传播过程中执行可微的公平投影，从而在节点分类、链接预测和节点回归三个下游任务上同时实现组公平性与高预测效用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: GNN 的消息传递机制会放大图中因敏感属性同质性而产生的拓扑偏差，导致下游任务（如信贷评分、累犯预测、推荐系统）出现群体性歧视。现有公平感知 GNN 存在以下局限：(1) 预处理方法需求解组合优化问题，且无法显式控制效用-公平权衡；(2) 多数方法仅针对节点分类，且理论分析仅约束预测前的表示而非实际部署的预测；(3) 缺乏对链接预测和节点回归任务的公平性边界分析；(4) 现有公平化策略多为对抗式或非凸正则化，缺乏收敛性保证。

Method: 1. **任务级偏差分析**：针对节点分类、链接预测、节点回归三类任务，推导了人口学统计均等差距（demographic parity gap）的上界，将其表达为最终节点表示的组均值分离度 δ 与组内协方差 C_k 的函数。节点分类边界严格优于 FairGAT；链接预测边界首次针对部署的 sigmoid 激活预测（而非预激活代理）；节点回归首次给出此类边界。2. **FairProp 架构**：在 APPNP 的凸平滑目标中嵌入：(a) 组均值约束（凸集 X_0 或松弛的板集 X_δ）；(b) 组内方差正则化项 λ·tr(H⊤MH)。将投影梯度下降展开为层结构，每层由一次 APPNP 传播步加一个闭式投影构成。3. **闭式可微投影**：精确均值均衡投影 P 为对称正交投影，向后传播与前向相同；松弛板投影在 K=2 时为 ReLU 型层，K>2 时用 Dykstra 算法配合隐式微分。4. **收敛性证明**：证明了 ρ=‖T_{η,λ}‖₂<1 条件下，迭代线性收敛到唯一公平最优点 H*。

Result: **节点分类**：在 Credit/Recidivism/Pokec-z/Pokec-n 数据集上，FairProp 在所有数据集上 ΔDP 最低（0.2–3.5 vs 0.7–18.4），准确率仅下降最多 0.4%。**链接预测**：在 Cora/Citeseer/Pubmed 上，ΔDP 降至 0.003（降幅 7–27×），AUC 保留 backbone 的 98% 以上。**节点回归**：在 GermanCredit/Pokec-z/Pokec-n 上，ΔMG 严格为 0（因无激活函数，边界不含方差项）。**方差消融**：增大 λ 可将链接预测差距进一步降至 0，但 AUC 崩塌。FairProp 在所有任务上均取得最优的公平-效用权衡。

Conclusion: FairProp 通过将公平约束作为投影嵌入 GNN 传播步骤的凸优化问题，提供了首个跨节点分类、链接预测和节点回归的统一公平节点表示学习框架，并具备：(1) 严格的统计均等差距理论上界；(3) 线性收敛保证；(3) 闭式可微投影支持端到端训练。实验表明，仅使用精确组均值均衡投影即足以在多数任务上取得接近零的公平差距，效用损失极小。该框架可推广到其他展开型 GNN 架构及其他公平性概念（如等机会或个体公平）。

Abstract: Graph neural networks (GNNs) are the standard tool for node representation learning and are increasingly used in high-stakes settings. Their message-passing backbone, however, can amplify topological bias, raising fairness concerns. We study group fairness at the level of downstream predictions for node classification, link prediction, and node regression, and bound the demographic parity gap for an arbitrary number of sensitive groups. Our node classification bound is provably no looser than the closest prior result. For link prediction, ours is the first bound on the parity gap of the deployed sigmoid-activated prediction rather than a pre-activation proxy, and for node regression we provide the first such bound. Across all three tasks, the analysis identifies two distinct sources of bias: the separation between group means and the within-group covariance of the final representations. Building on this insight, we embed fairness into propagation itself by augmenting the convex smoothing problem underlying APPNP with a convex group-mean constraint and a within-group covariance regularizer. Unfolding projected gradient descent on this problem yields FairProp, whose layers pair a propagation step with a closed-form projection and which provably converges linearly to the unique fair optimum. Experiments on three tasks show that FairProp, even with exact group-mean equalization alone, provides a strong inductive bias that achieves excellent fairness-utility trade-offs against strong baselines.

</details>


### [538] [Improving Proactive AI Assistance with Hierarchical Procedural Understanding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06505)
*Jin-Seop Lee,TaeYeon Won,SeongJun Jung,JungHoon Kim,Boyang Albert Li,Jin-Young Park,Jaehong Yoon,Jee-Hyong Lee*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了 ProactiveCoach 套件，包括用于训练的 ProactiveCoach-Instruct、用于评估的 ProactiveCoachBench，以及一种结合轻量级路由器的微调 VLM 主动指导系统，旨在通过层次化程序理解解决现有主动 AI 辅助系统在任务进度识别和指导粒度自适应方面的局限性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有主动 AI 辅助数据集要么局限于基于检测的主动理解，要么仅提供固定粒度的程序指导。这导致模型难以在流式设置中判断指导事件的完成情况，也无法根据用户的专业能力和请求变化灵活调整指导粒度。论文旨在通过引入层次化结构指导（阶段、步骤、动作三级）来解决这些核心能力的不足。

Method: 方法包含三个核心部分：(1) ProactiveCoach-Instruct 和 ProactiveCoachBench：通过程序数据筛选、程序层次构建、主动指导生成三阶段流程，构建具有 phase-step-action 层次结构的指导数据集和评估基准；(2) ProactiveCoach 层次指导学习方法：在单一视觉语言模型中联合学习三级主动指导，采用 SFT 训练并对响应-静默转换进行监督加权；(3) 自适应指导系统：将微调的 VLM 与轻量级路由器解耦，VLM 生成多级指导，路由器根据用户请求选择展示粒度，无需重新微调指导模型。

Result: 实验结果：(1) 层次化监督相比固定粒度监督，在多个骨干网络上一致提升整体性能，最高提升达 9.6%p；(2) 阶段-步骤-动作三级联合监督优于仅步骤监督或部分层次组合；(4) 自适应指导系统在四个指导粒度转换任务中，相比上下文自适应基线平均提升 57.1%p；(3) 微调后的模型在 ProactiveCoachBench 和 EgoProactive 验证集上均优于多种基线模型（Gemini 3 Flash、Claude Haiku 4.5、GPT-5.4 mini、ProAssist、VideoLLM-Online、MMDuet2、VideoChat3、VideoChat-R1.5、InternVL3、VideoLLaMA3、LLaVA-Video 等），人类质量评审总体得分 4.27。

Conclusion: 论文证明层次化程序理解能有效提升主动 AI 辅助能力，所提出的数据集、训练方法和自适应系统为该方向奠定了基础。然而仍存在一些局限性：评估使用真实对话历史而非模型自生成输出，未涉及用户专业能力的自动推断以及多有效执行顺序的支持，未来工作可扩展至长期任务跟踪、个性化指导和多执行顺序处理。

Abstract: Proactive AI assistants continuously observe a user's activity and decide whether to provide new guidance or remain silent. They should provide appropriate guidance for the task, determine when to provide the next guidance based on task progress, and adjust the guidance level to the user's expertise and needs. Supporting these capabilities requires training and evaluation data that reflect procedural structure and capture how guidance should adapt to task progress and user needs. However, existing datasets either focus on detection-based proactive understanding or provide procedural guidance at a fixed granularity. Fixed-granularity guidance provides limited information about fine-grained progress and broader procedural context, making it difficult to determine completion and adapt guidance granularity. To address these limitations, we introduce the ProactiveCoach suite, comprising ProactiveCoach-Instruct for training, ProactiveCoachBench for evaluation, and fine-tuned VLMs with an adaptive guidance system. ProactiveCoach-Instruct provides hierarchically structured guidance at the phase, step, and action levels for learning task progress and procedural context. ProactiveCoachBench evaluates whether models provide appropriate guidance at the right time across different guidance levels and adapt when the requested level changes. We fine-tune pretrained VLMs on ProactiveCoach-Instruct and demonstrate its effectiveness across backbones. Compared with fixed-granularity supervision, hierarchical supervision improves overall performance across backbones by up to 9.6%p. We further build an adaptive guidance system by combining our fine-tuned model with a lightweight guidance router. Without additional fine-tuning, our system outperforms the in-context adaptation baseline by 57.1%p across four guidance-level transitions. Our project page is available at this https URL .

</details>


### [539] [Xaurora: Generative Weather Forecasting with Denoising Stochastic Interpolants from a Foundation Model Prior](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06509)
*Eliot Walt,Miltiadis Kofinas,Nikolaj Mücke,Efstratios Gavves,Dim Coumou*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Xaurora 提出基于随机插值的去噪参数化（DSI），结合回放缓冲器和概率 SDE-rollout 训练，将确定性大气基础模型 Aurora 转化为高效生成式集合预报模型；仅增加 0.64% 参数即达到接近 SOTA 的全球集合预报性能，13 分钟生成 15 天预报。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有大气基础模型（如 Aurora）多为确定性模型，无法生成大集合进行不确定性量化、极端天气风险评估和长程预报；且从零训练生成式模型计算开销过大。需要一种能高效扩展确定性基础模型为概率集合预报模型的方法。

Method: 1) 提出去噪随机插值（DSI）：x1-预测参数化，warm-start 时保留先验能力；2) 提出 SDE-rollout 回放缓冲器训练算法：将物理时间与 SDE 伪时间 rollout 融合，扩展 Aurora 的回放缓冲器至嵌套 rollout；3) 单反向传播 fair CRPS 损失：仅对一个成员反向传播，降低计算成本；4) 架构上对 Aurora 做最小改动（增加 τ 嵌入和 X_τ 嵌入，LoRA 微调 Swin Transformer，零初始化保证 Dθ_init ≡ Gφ）。

Result: 在 WeatherBench2（2022 测试集）上评估：1) 集合均值 uRMSE 在多数预报时效上优于 Aurora-S，超出 3 天后优于 Aurora-L，7–12 天后接近并优于 Aurora-O；2) CRPS 与 IFS ENS、GenCast-O 等业务系统接近；3) 仅 13 分钟生成 15 天预报（单 A100），比 GenCast/ATLAS 快约一个数量级；4) 训练成本仅为 Aurora 1.5 的约 1/20 GPU 小时；5) DSI 参数化显著优于 B-预测、W-预测（后者训练发散）和 x1-DDPM。

Conclusion: 该工作证明确定性大气基础模型可被高效扩展为更强概率模型；DSI 在高维像素空间中从确定性先验 warm-start 时具有独特优势；概率 SDE-rollout 训练算法使嵌套 rollout 训练在可接受计算成本下成为可能；残余 noise floor（高频谱平坦化）是当前主要局限，未来方向包括学习与去噪器协同优化的扩散项和变量相关的空间相关随机场。

Abstract: Deep learning has revolutionised weather forecasting in recent years, especially through atmospheric foundation models, which offer competitive skill for a fraction of the computational costs of classic physics-based models. However, most existing foundation models are deterministic, limiting the generation of large ensembles for accurate uncertainty quantification, extreme weather risk assessment, and long-range weather forecasting. Furthermore, these models incur a large, often prohibitive, computational overhead to train from scratch. To address these shortcomings, we turn a pretrained deterministic prior model, namely the Aurora foundation model, into a generative ensemble-prediction model. To that end, we introduce a novel generative method, Denoising Stochastic Interpolants, combined with a replay buffer for Stochastic Differential Equation (SDE) rollout, enabling probabilistic training of SDE trajectories. Our stochastic foundation model, Xaurora, is finetuned from the small Aurora version, yet it approaches the state-of-the-art on global ensemble metrics and is competitive with the large version of Aurora. Our method is parameter and sample efficient, and generates skilful 15-day forecasts in 13 minutes. Our results demonstrate that deterministic foundation models can be efficiently extended into even stronger stochastic models.

</details>


### [540] [Conditional Flow Matching for Single-Neuron Electrophysiology: Capturing Multimodal Responses Across Stimuli](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06520)
*Cameron Schofield,Luca Ghafourpour,Philip H. Wong,Costas A. Anastassiou,Richard E. Turner*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出条件流匹配框架,将单神经元电生理建模为条件生成任务,直接学习给定输入电流下膜电位的分布 p(V|I),可恢复阈值附近及高电流下多模态响应,而确定性代理(如 NOBLE)则失败。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有生物物理详细模型需数万 CPU 小时生成参数集合,且机器学习代理(如神经算子 NOBLE)只能对单刺激输出单一确定性响应,无法刻画同一细胞在同一电流下真实存在的试验间变异性与分叉附近的多模态分布。

Method: 使用 Conditional Flow Matching(CFM)学习一个以输入电流 I 为条件的速度场 u_t^θ(X_t|I);采用线性条件路径 p0=N(0,I_T),Xt=(1-t)X0+tX1,目标速度为常数 X1-X0;速度场用一维 U-Net 参数化(5 个分辨率、瓶颈处双向扩张卷积),电流在每层注入,流时间用正弦嵌入;使用 L2 损失、AdamW 训练 200 epoch,推理时采用 20 步中点积分(40 次网络评估)。

Result: 在两个人类皮层中间神经元(PVALB、VIP)的 HoF 集合上,生成响应在电生理特征分布、放电时间结构、F-I 关系上与 PDE 仿真及真实实验记录高度吻合(解释方差多数 >95%);阈值附近正确恢复 firing/non-firing 双模态,去极化阻滞附近正确恢复低/高发放双模态,而 NOBLE 在阈值附近抑制发放并向更高电流偏移;批量推理较数值求解器提速约 42×;在时变刺激训练后可泛化到未见刺激族。

Conclusion: 条件流匹配为单神经元电生理提供了一条可扩展的生成式替代路径,能直接刻画 p(V|I) 的多模态与时间结构,适合作为大规模电路建模的代理;未来方向包括从单神经元扩展到耦合群体,以及通过蒸馏进一步降低推理成本以逼近确定性代理的速度。

Abstract: Neurons of the brain exhibit a rich repertoire of electrophysiology dynamics with the same repeated stimulus eliciting very different voltage responses from the same cell. One common approach in biophysically detailed models is to capture this variability through ensembles of deterministic parametrizations, at a cost of hundreds of thousands of CPU hours. Existing machine learning surrogates inherit the same limitation, where a stimulus is mapped to a single voltage response. We address this challenge by learning a conditional generative model for single-neuron electrophysiology, using flow matching with a velocity field conditioned on the input current. On biophysically detailed models of two human cortical interneuron types, the generated responses closely reproduce the electrophysiological feature distributions, spike-time structure, and excitability profiles, even matching the experimental recordings from the corresponding human cortical neurons. Near the firing threshold, firing and non-firing responses coexist at the same stimulus amplitude, and at high amplitudes, ensembles may split into low- and high-firing modes near depolarization block. We show that our model recovers both modes in each case, while a neural operator baseline suppresses spiking near threshold and blurs the gap between modes at depolarization block.

</details>


### [541] [WaveGSSM: Graph Wave State Space Models for Propagating Spatio-Temporal Patterns](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06540)
*Junyou Zhu,Fenying Cai,Ping Xiong,Christian Nauck,Langzhou He,Chao Gao,Jürgen Kurths,Frank Hellmann*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: WaveGSSM是一种用于时空图预测的二阶图状态空间模型，通过显式建模节点运动状态（速度），在四个时序图基准和全球天气预报任务上均取得最优性能，特别是在中等预报时长下能更好地保持大尺度大气环流模式。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的时空图模型采用"空间-时间"分解架构（GNN编码快照+RNN/SSM连接时序），但无法显式表示图上模式的传播运动。作者通过合成实验和模态分析证明，对于传播型过程，相同的当前场在具有不同近期变化率时会演化出不同的未来，因此运动信息必须是预测状态的一部分。

Method: WaveGSSM是受波动动力学启发的图状态空间模型。每个节点维护两个耦合的潜在状态：模式状态U_t（当前潜在模式）和运动状态V_t（时间变化率）。图波转换通过图交互更新运动状态，再用更新后的运动状态推进模式状态，将空间传播和时间演化耦合在单次转换中。采用半隐式欧拉离散化保证数值稳定性，并通过L个堆叠的图波块与残差结构形成完整架构。支持固定网格（天气）和演化图（时序节点分类）两种设置。

Result: 在DBLP-3、Brain、Reddit、DBLP-10四个时序图节点分类基准上，WaveGSSM在所有八项指标上均取得最佳平均性能。在ERA5全球天气预报任务中，相比骨干匹配的GraphCast基线，1-5天位势高度RMSE平均降低20.2%；在波活动最强的预报中，第7天异常相关增益最大；第7天z500在纬向波数4-9区间保留68%的ERA5变率。消融实验证实移除运动状态持续传递会使时序分类F1降低1.81%-3.36%，天气预报RMSE增加2.63%。

Conclusion: 将模式与运动状态显式联合编码在图波转换中，能更有效地学习图上的传播动力学。WaveGSSM不仅在通用时序图任务上有竞争力，更在中等预报时长下显著改善了大尺度模式的位置准确性，支持将显式运动表示作为时空图学习的有用状态空间原则。

Abstract: Spatio-temporal graph models typically encode each snapshot with a GNN and then connect the resulting representations through a temporal module. This space-then-time design is effective, yet it does not explicitly represent how a pattern moves across the graph. We show empirically that, for a propagating process, the same present field can lead to different futures when its recent rate of change differs, motivating an explicit representation of motion in the predictive state. We introduce WaveGSSM, a second-order graph state-space model that maintains two coupled latent states at each node, one for the current pattern and one for its temporal rate of change. A graph-wave transition updates the motion state through graph interactions and uses it to advance the pattern state, coupling spatial propagation and temporal evolution within a single rollout. We evaluate WaveGSSM on four temporal-graph benchmarks and global weather forecasting. It consistently achieves the best mean performance across the temporal-graph benchmarks and reduces the geopotential RMSE by 20.2% on average for 1- to 5-day weather forecasts relative to a backbone-matched snapshot model, while better preserving large-scale atmospheric patterns.

</details>


### [542] [A Fine-Grained Analysis of the LoRA Fine-Tuning Landscape with Implications for Data Selection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06542)
*Bowen Zhang,Changrui Fang,Xinsong Ma,Jiaye Teng,Ziye Ma*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文针对LoRA微调中适配器秩选择这一核心实践问题，发展了一套基于LoRA-RIP常数（数据相关的限制等距度量）的精细化景观理论。核心结果表明，足够的秩过参数化（由LoRA-RIP常数显式决定）能消除虚假局部极小值，将现有RIP保证从经典的1/3区间推广到更广范围。基于此，论文提出了固定秩预算下的数据选择原则（潜在空间覆盖与预训练softmax饱和度），并在语言和视觉任务上验证了秩与数据质量作为耦合资源共同影响LoRA微调效率与可靠性的论断。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LoRA已成为参数高效微调的标准方法，但适配器秩的选择仍是一个未解决的实践问题：秩过小会导致优化景观病态，秩过大会牺牲效率。现有理论分析或在限制性假设下成立，或依赖局部线性化，无法有效指导实际中的秩选择。本文旨在弥合这一理论与实践之间的鸿沟。

Method: 1. 构建平衡的LoRA目标函数（含因子平衡正则项），将其与核范数正则化的矩阵空间优化等价化；2. 引入LoRA-RIP常数（基于交叉熵Hessian在低秩方向上的限制强凸/强光滑常数比值）；3. 利用负证书策略（分解提升误差为切向与法向分量，结合一阶与二阶平稳性条件）证明：当r/r⋆超过(2δ/(1-δ))²时，不存在虚假局部极小值；4. 将LoRA-RIP分解为数据侧度量（覆盖率上下界、softmax加权强度、非线性残差），推导基于潜在空间覆盖和softmax饱和度的数据选择原则。

Result: 理论结果：在r/r⋆ > (2δ_k^LoRA/(1-δ_k^LoRA))²条件下，标准LoRA的每个二阶稳定点都是全局最优，且该保证覆盖了超过1/3的LoRA-RIP值范围。实验结果：MNLI上秩从4增至256使验证交叉熵从0.850降至0.775；梯度覆盖平衡采样在所有测试秩上均优于长尾采样（最高+1.94百分点）；中等饱和度带在多个秩上一致优于简单带。DeBERTa-v3和QNLI上的跨骨干/跨数据集实验验证了结论的普适性。景观诊断显示高秩达到更低损失状态且具有更有利的二阶几何。

Conclusion: 本文建立了适配器秩与数据诱导优化几何之间的显式联系，证明了秩与数据质量是应联合考虑的两个耦合资源，为更高效可靠的LoRA微调提供了原则性指导。理论保证从经典1/3区间扩展到更广范围，数据选择原则（潜在空间覆盖与softmax饱和度）为固定秩预算下的数据筛选提供了具体准则。未来工作方向包括缩小充分条件与必要条件之间的差距，以及将理论扩展到多层联合适配和大规模生成式微调。

Abstract: Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) has become a standard approach for parameter-efficient fine-tuning, yet a fundamental practical question remains unresolved: how should the adapter rank be chosen? An overly small rank may lead to a poorly conditioned optimization landscape, whereas an unnecessarily large rank sacrifices the efficiency that motivates LoRA in the first place. Existing theoretical analyses provide only limited guidance on this trade-off, and their guarantees are typically established under restrictive theoretical settings. We address this gap by developing a substantially sharper landscape theory for LoRA, building on modern results from nonconvex low-rank matrix sensing. Our central insight is that the appropriate adapter rank should depend on the quality of the data-induced optimization geometry, rather than on the model alone. To formalize this connection, we introduce LoRA-RIP, a data-dependent restricted-isometry metric that characterizes the conditioning of the cross-entropy (CE) objective along LoRA-relevant low-rank directions. We prove that sufficient rank over-parameterization, with the required rank explicitly determined by the LoRA-RIP constant, eliminates spurious local minima, thereby extending existing RIP-based guarantees beyond the classical 1/3 regime. This characterization further enables principled data selection under a fixed rank budget. Experiments across language and vision tasks support these theoretical predictions, showing that rank and data quality are two coupled resources that should be jointly considered for more efficient and reliable LoRA fine-tuning.

</details>


### [543] [Empirical Variational Autoencoder](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06545)
*Kaede Shiohara*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出Empirical Variational Autoencoder (EVA)，一种用于连续值序列生成的通用框架。EVA基于VAE的ELBO，通过一个额外的单线性层从训练数据中自回归学习潜在先验，显著缓解了传统VAE中先验与后验之间的分布差距问题，实现了高效的序列生成。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统VAE使用固定的标准高斯先验，与后验分布之间存在显著差距，导致采样质量受限。这一问题在将VAE作为独立生成模型（而非压缩态和分词器）使用时尤为突出。此外，连续值序列的自回归生成由于直接回归损失（如MSE）无法建模多模态分布而面临挑战。现有方法（GMM头、扩散头）要么表达能力受限，要么推理效率低下。

Method: EVA的核心方法是在VAE基础上，用自回归学习的经验先验替代固定标准高斯先验。具体而言：1）使用因果解码器；2）引入额外的"预测器"网络（通过单线性层实现，可与解码器共享主干）来建模自回归潜在先验 $p_\omega(z_t|z_{1:t-1})$；3）优化重新分解的EVA ELBO目标，将KL散度分解到每个时间步；4）支持条件生成（如类别条件）和无分类器引导（CFG）。在推理时，通过祖先采样在潜在空间自回归生成序列。

Result: 在ImageNet 256×256上，EVA-B达到FID 7.68和IS 178.60，与反演AF分支（如AR-Diffusion的321M参数版本，FID 5.44）质量接近但推理速度快约10倍。在VGGSound上达到FID 0.64。EVA-L（更大骨干）将FID进一步降至6.04。控制变量显示：1）非自回归预测器可显著提升采样质量；2）EVA在保持重建保真度（rFID）的同时大幅提升生成质量；3）潜在空间可视化显示EVA学习到了语义结构化的表示；支持图像补全任务。

Conclusion: EVA成功证明了通过简单的单线性层从数据中学习自回归潜在先验，可以有效缓解VAE中先验-后验失配问题，使VAE重新成为高效的独立连续序列生成模型。该方法在图像（FID 7.68）和音频生成任务上取得了与扩散自回归基线相当的生成质量，同时推理速度显著更快。未来工作包括设计专门利用2D空间结构的自回归先验，以及在更大规模的任务（如文本到文图、TTS）上验证。

Abstract: We present Empirical Variational Autoencoder, a general generative framework for continuous-valued (i.e., non-vector-quantized) sequences. EVA is based on the evidence lower bound of the Variational Autoencoder (VAE) but learns autoregressive latent priors empirically from training data, which can be implemented only by an additional single linear layer on top of VAEs. By replacing the conventional standard-Gaussian constraint with the self-predicted priors, EVA significantly alleviates the latent distribution gap between prior and posterior which is typically observed in conventional VAEs, and leads to high-fidelity ancestral sampling for sequential data generation. Extensive experiments on image and sound synthesis demonstrate that EVA achieves competitive generation quality with autoregressive diffusion baselines despite its much faster inference time.

</details>


### [544] [LinearPFN: Amortized Variable Selection for Linear Models with Interactions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06580)
*Louis Schiekiera,Max Zimmer,Christophe Roux,Manuel Arnold,Sebastian Pokutta,Fritz Günther*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: LinearPFN是一个预训练的Transformer网络，通过单次前向传播摊销贝叶斯spike-and-slab回归中包含主效应和成对交互作用的线性模型变量选择推理，在真实社会科学数据集上的选择精度优于五种经典基线方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Spike-and-slab贝叶斯变量选择因其精确成本随候选效应数量呈指数增长而难以扩展；现有近似方法（如MCMC）需要针对每个数据集重新运行且可能无法收敛，因此需要一种摊销推理方法以实现快速、一次性的变量选择。

Method: 基于nanoTabPFN架构的Transformer（31.5M参数），在从显式定义的共轭spike-and-slab先验采样的合成数据集上进行预训练。包含三个读取头——选择头（返回后验包含概率，训练采用BCE损失）、系数头（返回后验均值系数，训练采用MSE损失）、回归头（返回后验预测分布，训练采用NLL损失），并采用结合"先组合后求平均"和"先求平均后组合"摘要来编码交互作用。

Result: 在10,000个真实社会科学预测矩阵（结合先验生成的结果）上，LinearPFN的选择AUC/数据集为0.96，F₁/数据集为0.77，均超过lasso、稳定性选择、SuSiE、glinternet和hierNet五种基线方法；GPU上前向传播仅需0.03秒，相比CPU线程上的MCMC采样器（57.43秒）有显著加速；在p≤5时可与精确后验结果进行验证，其PIP的AUC差距仅为-0.0026；在偏离先验假设（固定大小系数、众多大型交互、重尾噪声）的测试变体中，LinearPFN仍保持最高的AUC和F₁。

Conclusion: LinearPFN是首个用于贝叶斯变量选择的预训练网络，实现了包含交互作用的贝叶斯模型平均的一次性前向传播；尽管存在对单一先验的依赖以及在CPU上运行较慢等局限性，但该方法通过摊销推理使变量选择在实际应用中更加高效可行。

Abstract: Spike-and-slab regression is a standard Bayesian formulation of variable selection: it returns a posterior distribution over which candidate effects are active rather than a single selected subset, so that every candidate effect carries an inclusion probability. Its cost grows exponentially with the number of candidate effects, so the posterior can be enumerated exactly only when the number of predictors is small. Beyond that reach, the posterior has to be approximated, typically by Markov chain Monte Carlo over the model space, which requires a fresh run for every dataset and, within a fixed budget of steps, may fail to converge. We present LinearPFN, a prior-data fitted transformer network that amortizes spike-and-slab inference for linear models with main effects and pairwise interactions. The network is pretrained once on synthetic datasets, drawn from an explicitly specified prior, and a single forward pass over a new dataset returns posterior inclusion probabilities, posterior-mean coefficients and posterior predictive distributions with no per-dataset fitting. The prior is conjugate by design, so that the posterior for each fixed set of active effects has a closed form, and wherever the exact posterior is still computable by enumeration we verify the network's outputs against it. On real predictor matrices from published social-science datasets, with outcomes drawn from the prior so that the true active set is known, LinearPFN attains a higher per-dataset selection AUC and a higher F1 under the median probability model rule than five classical baselines. The lead holds when the coefficients, the interactions or the noise depart from the prior. Code: this https URL . Trained model: this https URL .

</details>


### [545] [Separators Make Carry Propagation Learnable:The Geometry of Latent Carry in a Multiplication Transformer](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06605)
*Sama Satariyan,Raphael Cousin,G{é}rard Biau*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本研究从头训练小型Llama风格Transformer模型完成4×4乘法任务，发现输入格式（数字间插入分隔符空格）对性能至关重要，可将精确匹配准确率从1%提升至89%；模型内部使用残差流中的环形角度编码进位信息，并揭示了输出位置的进位链学习顺序及因果可解释性机制。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有Transformer在多位数乘法中表现不佳，先前可解释性研究表明其依赖输入范围启发式而非显式进位计算；本文旨在探究架构相同但训练数据格式不同时，模型如何发展出可解释的算术算法。

Method: 从零训练小型Llama风格Transformer完成4×4乘法（无思维链）；系统比较无分隔符与空格分隔符输入格式；通过分析训练动力学、激活修补（activation patching）和残差流几何结构，研究进位表示的形成与因果使用。

Result: 1. 分隔符使准确率从1%跃升至89%；2. 输出位置按进位链顺序学习，中位数（依赖最长）最后学习；3. 每个数字的预测槽位将进位编码为残差流中的环形角度；4. 激活修补显示进位状态在第4块后被因果使用（传递率高达84%）；5. 剩余错误几乎都是差一错误，与进位或循环数字码的小误差一致。

Conclusion: 简单的输入格式变化（插入分隔符）可使Transformer涌现出结构化、可解释的进位算法，其在残差流中使用环形几何编码计算状态，且这种中间表示在模型深层被因果使用。

Abstract: Transformers asked to multiply multi-digit numbers in a single forward pass often fail, and interpretability studies of pretrained language models find arithmetic solved by input-range heuristics rather than by an explicit carry. We train small Llama-style transformers from scratch on 4x4 multiplication without chain of thought and find that the input format is decisive: inserting a space token between digits raises exact-match accuracy from 1% to 89%. Output positions are learned in carry-chain order, with the middle digits, which have the longest-range dependencies, learned last. Inside the model, the separator token that predicts each digit (its prediction slot) encodes the carry-in as an angle on a ring in the residual stream; examples with more distinct carry values fill more of the ring. Activation patching between examples matched on the column sum shows that this state is causally used before the last layer: patching the prediction slot alone transfers the source carry in up to 84% of cases after block 4 for one middle column of our best model, while for other columns the carry is first assembled at the neighboring answer slot before reaching its own. Remaining errors are almost always off by one, consistent with a small error on the carry or on the circular digit code.

</details>


### [546] [Beyond the Model: The Critical Role of Data Filtering in Clinical Machine Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06640)
*Noah Subedar,Colin Campbell,Wenjing Zhang,Dan Perri,Sarah Culgin,Andrew Hamilton-Wright*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文指出临床机器学习中的数据过滤决策并非中性的预处理步骤，而会显著改变数据分布和下游任务难度。作者开发了一个可解释的数据过滤工具箱，系统评估了11种过滤策略在MIMIC-III/IV和eICU数据集上对两个二分类任务（ICU住院时长和院内死亡）的影响，并提出基于质心偏差分析与McNemar检验的诊断方法以检测过滤是否改变了问题本身。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 临床ML研究通常依赖预处理和过滤流水线，但这些决策会改变数据集的统计结构，可能人为降低或增加预测任务的复杂性。现有工作缺乏系统方法来判断特定过滤选择何时从"数据清洗"跨越到"数据扭曲"，且基准流水线（如MIMIC-Extract）侧重标准化而非表征其预处理选择对任务难度的影响。

Method: 1) 数据集：MIMIC-III/IV、eICU中提取首24小时、7项生命体征的多变量时间序列；2) 11种过滤策略：7种生命体征生理范围异常值过滤、KNN(k=3)缺失值填充、长缺失段(≥10连续)、长间隔(≥2连续空行)、高无效数据(≥10%)及全生命体征联合过滤；3) 模型：Random Forest(300棵树)，5种聚合方法(均值/中位数/标准差/MAD/最大偏差)，分层5折交叉验证，4个随机种子；4) 评估指标：Accuracy、Macro F1、McNemar检验、每类质心偏差分析；5) 开发开源可解释过滤工具箱。

Result: 1) 过滤确实重塑数据分布：异常值过滤改变质心(尤其心率和血氧饱和度)，记录级过滤系统性移除监测不规律的重症患者记录；2) 过滤可使任务人为变易：高无效数据过滤虽产生生理上不合理的质心偏移，却通过拉大类间距离提高了死亡预测性能；3) 同一过滤对不同任务影响不同(如全生命体征过滤对死亡预测有帮助但可能轻微降低ICU预测)；4) 与MIMIC-Extract在标准配置下性能相当，但后者难以审计各过滤步骤的具体影响。

Conclusion: 数据过滤应被视为科学方法的一部分而非例行预处理，需明确报告、分析其对数据分布和任务难度的影响。建议优先考虑生理有效性而非基准性能边际增益；基于质心偏差与McNemar检验的诊断工作流可帮助研究者区分合理清洗与问题扭曲。研究局限：仅依赖小时级扁平化聚合(平滑了亚小时波动和MNAR模式)，仅测试单一分类器、两项任务和7项生命体征。

Abstract: Machine learning (ML) studies using clinical data often rely on preprocessing and filtering pipelines before model development. The filtering decisions made in these pipelines can alter the dataset's statistical structure and may artificially reduce or increase the complexity of the prediction task. We argue that filtering choices should be treated as part of the scientific method rather than as a routine preprocessing step. We further discuss the need for explainable and transparent preprocessing pipelines that allow researchers to understand why specific filtering choices are made and how these choices affect the resulting data distribution and model performance. All of the source code for this work is available on GitHub.

</details>


### [547] [Considering Context: When World Models Need Context Encoders](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06651)
*Oleg Smirnov,Sofiane Ennadir,John Pertoft,Bjartur Hjaltason,Sara Karimi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了"预测充分性"(predictive sufficiency)框架，用形式化的信息论工具量化在模型强化学习中上下文编码机制的必要性。基于访问分布诱导下的贝叶斯单步预测优势，框架将预测差距分解为可从历史恢复的部分、需要真实上下文的残差，以及有限模型引入的误差，并在不同识别难度的环境中验证了该准则。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在基于模型的强化学习中，环境动力学的潜在变化（如机器人的质量或地面摩擦）会降低下一状态预测的准确性，进而损害策略。现有的上下文感知方法通常假设智能体无法从自身经验中恢复潜在上下文信息而需外部提供，但这一假设缺乏形式化检验。本文旨在回答一个先验问题：上下文机制究竟还能补充多少信息？

Method: 1. 提出"预测充分性"概念：量化在策略π诱导的访问分布下，揭示上下文θ为预测器带来的贝叶斯单步对数损失优势。2. 分解预测裕量(ℐ_emp)为：历史可恢复部分(ℐ_M - ℐ_H) + 需要上下文的残差(ℐ_hist) + 有限模型误差。3. 按条件集所能达到的预测风险对上下文感知算法分类：无记忆(ℐ_M)、转移窗口(≥ℐ_H)、循环(≥ℐ_H)、跨回合链(≥ℐ_H+)、真实上下文(ℐ_O)。4. 通过MiniGrid-Wind/Resistance和Point-Mass-Attractor控制诊断验证框架。5. 在CARL DMC Walker（可识别/困难设置）和RWRL Walker（漂移设置）上进行实验验证四个预测（P1-P4）。

Result: 在可识别设置中，预测裕量在所有评估的访问分布下崩溃（即使上下文仍以R²≥0.93可从状态解码），验证P1和P4。在困难设置中，裕量持续存在且不同方法间有差异，但回报保持在基线2%以内，验证P2。在非i.i.d.漂移设置中，中等漂移率下转移窗口代理将启动瞬态降低约10%，高漂移率下链式潜变量代理降低约12%，验证P3。诊断表明，结构性变化（ℐ_struct）与预测裕量（ℐ_emp）可在Wind和Point-Mass-Attractor上分离，但在Resistance上保持接近。

Conclusion: 上下文机制的价值由设置的信息结构决定，而非仅由其设计意图或MDP类别决定。当贝叶斯预测裕量为零时，同一访问下的任何预测增益反映的是有限模型误差的减少。同一任务在不同先验下可产生高于零或接近零的裕量，建议在基准构建中报告估计的预测裕量而非仅报告MDP类别。该框架提供了一种实用的准则，可在不使用参考策略的情况下从普通训练代理处评估，从而指导实践者选择适当的上下文机制。

Abstract: Methods for generalization in model-based reinforcement learning typically assume that an agent cannot recover the latent context governing the environment dynamics from its own experience, and therefore supplies it externally. We formalize and test this assumption with \emph{predictive sufficiency}, which quantifies what access to the context adds to next-step prediction under the visitation distribution an agent induces, and separates that quantity into a history-recoverable part, a residual requiring the true context, and the deficit added by a finite model. We classify context-aware algorithms by the predictive risk their conditioning set can target and demonstrate across environments of increasing identification difficulty that the headroom does not follow the MDP class. The same task under different priors leaves predictive headroom in one setting and nothing distinguishable from zero in another, where the agent's behavior implicitly identifies the context and any benefit of such a mechanism cannot be attributed to missing information. Where headroom persists, the learned state exposes it only partially, and adding the true context still lowers the risk. Our contribution is a practical criterion for matching contextual mechanisms to the information available to them, estimated from the ordinary trained agent without a reference policy.

</details>


### [548] [The Birkhoff Geometry of Manifold-Constrained Hyper-Connections: Two Channels, Vertex Viscosity, and Sinkhorn as a Retraction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06653)
*Xiaoyu Li,Zhizhou Sha,Chiwun Yang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文为流形约束超连接(mHC)在Birkhoff多面体上建立了完整的几何理论。其核心是揭示了一个关键量——混合器的第二大奇异值σ₂如何统一控制信号传播、顶点附近的学习速度以及Sinkhorn投影的代价。主要结果包括：(1)双重随机混合器将信号流分解为均值通道(等价于残差网络)和差分通道(每层按σ₂收缩),因此额外宽度是一个衰减记忆,记忆深度为1/(1-σ₂)层,且非负混合器中仅排列矩阵不收缩;(2)Sinkhorn-logit映射构成全局图表,其logit梯度恰好是Fisher-Rao梯度,从而直通更新精确等价于熵镜像下降和Sinkhorn收缩的黎曼梯度下降;(3)在logit梯度流下,对数似然与顶点接近度ε呈线性关系,接近和离开顶点仅以1/t速率,而Fisher-Rao流以指数速率移动;(4)Sinkhorn的局部收敛因子为σ₂²,因此固定迭代预算限制了可以记忆深度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 深度Seek-V4等大规模Transformer采用mHC架构,但现有工作多为架构设计或经验研究,Xie et al.(2026)的论文中没有定理。需要解释两个经验观察:(1)30、60、90层的复合混合器几乎都是均匀矩阵;(2)20次Sinkhorn扫描后,反向增益漂移至约1.6。更一般地,需要回答:双重随机约束带来了什么?代价是什么?logit上的梯度下降如何在多面体上移动?

Method: 在Birkhoff多面体(双重随机矩阵集)上建立完整的几何理论框架。具体方法包括:(1)利用正交投影Q=I-J/n将信号流分解为均值通道(1方向)和差分通道(1⊥方向);(2)证明Sinkhorn-logit映射Φ(W)=SK(exp W)是B_n°的全局光滑图表,其微分dΦ_W是Fisher-Rao度量的逆;(3)使用Fisher-Rao度量g_H(ξ,ζ) = Σξᵢⱼζᵢⱼ/Hᵢⱼ和逆张量A_H=Π_H∘(H⊙·);(4)采用Doeblin分裂和加权最小二乘拟合的尖锐点态约束来分析顶点附近的引力解。注意Lewis(2n-1)权重加性拟合的尖锐常数为(2n-1)。

Result: 证明了四个核心定理:(1)定理3.1-3.2和推论3.3——双重随机混合器将均值与差分解耦,差分通道按σ₂(H)≤1-n·δ(H)每层收缩,记忆深度τ=1/(1-σ₂);(2)定理4.3——logit梯度流遵循平方Fisher-Rao度量,而直通更新精确等价于熵镜像下降和带Sinkhorn收缩的黎曼梯度下降;(3)定理5.3-5.4和推论5.6——logit梯度流的|d/dt log Hᵢⱼ|≤4n³G·ε(H),顶点接近度按1/t变化,而Fisher-Rao流按指数速率e^{±2nGt}变化;n=2时的命题(5.5)展示了尖锐的多项式vs指数对比;(4)命题6.1-6.2——Sinkhorn局部收敛因子为σ₂²,有限预算限制可以记忆深度,反向增益漂移∥H_{L:l}∥₂≤e^{Σeᵢ/2}。命题3.4表明非负无收缩混合器只能是排列。所有数值实验(n=4)确认预测的速率。

Conclusion: 双重随机约束使mHC的流均值成为单位增益的残差网络(适用于任意混合器和深度)。差分通道按σ₂每层收缩,因此额外宽度是O(τ)层的衰减记忆。logit参数化在顶点处引入引力(以1/t速率接近),而直通更新(精确镜像下降)以指数速率移动。Sinkhorn投影长记忆深度混合器的速度最慢,因此固定扫描预算限制了记忆深度。作为解,O(1)(n)群具有无收缩流变和一致连接性,可以用于保持均值恒等残差的塌陷自由设计;但一般正交设计通过耦合均值和差分来增加灵活性。理论为mHC设计提供了原则性的理解,并指导未来训练诊断和架构改进。

Abstract: Hyper-connections widen the residual stream of a Transformer to $n$ parallel streams. Their manifold-constrained version (mHC) mixes the streams at each layer with a doubly stochastic matrix, which it computes by Sinkhorn normalization of exponentiated logits. We give a geometric theory of this design on the Birkhoff polytope. First, a doubly stochastic mixer splits the stream into a mean channel, on which mHC is exactly a residual network, and a difference channel, which each layer contracts by its second singular value $\sigma_2 \le 1 - n \min_{ij} H_{ij}$. Thus the extra width is a fading memory with a horizon of $1/(1-\sigma_2)$ layers, and among nonnegative mixers only the permutations do not collapse. Second, the Sinkhorn-logit map is a global chart, and its logit gradient is exactly the Fisher-Rao gradient. Thus logit gradient flow follows a squared Fisher-Rao metric, and the straight-through update is exactly entropic mirror descent. Third, under logit gradient flow the logarithm of each entry moves at a rate of at most $4n^3\|\nabla f\|_\infty \varepsilon$, where $\varepsilon$ is the distance to the nearest permutation. Thus gradient flow approaches and leaves the vertices only at rate $1/t$, but mirror descent moves at an exponential rate. Fourth, the local convergence factor of Sinkhorn is $\sigma_2^2$, so a fixed iteration budget limits the horizon. Experiments confirm the predicted rates.

</details>


### [549] [TrustmeWatcher: An Application for Workplace Micro-Sensing and Explainable Well-Being Feedback](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06657)
*Chengyu Yu,Leon Jacopo Costa,Zoja Anžur,Mohan Li,Gašper Slapničar,Daniil Kirilenko,Martin Gjoreski,Mitja Luštrek,Marc Langheinrich*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文介绍了 TrustmeWatcher 应用程序,这是 TRUST-ME 项目开发的工作场所福祉监测工具,集成了计算机活动追踪、自我报告收集、本地 AI 预测、可解释 AI (XAI) 反馈和隐私控制功能。该应用基于 17 名参与者的纵向研究数据(2025 年 7 月至 2026 年 3 月),使用 ActivityWatch 收集活动数据,通过 StreamDeck 设备进行实时评估,预测六项状态分数(效价、唤醒度、休息度、压力管理、生产力、参与度)及总体幸福感分数。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 工作场所感知研究结合长期行为追踪和自我报告,但数据收集工具与结果展示界面往往分离。此外,工作场所监控可能侵犯隐私和自主性,如何在利用感知技术提升员工福祉的同时保护隐私成为核心挑战。TRUST-ME 项目旨在研究感知和 AI 如何在保护隐私的前提下支持知识工作者。

Method: 系统架构:三层结构——底层复用 ActivityWatch 的 OS 级监听器(记录应用使用、键盘鼠标活动),中层为 TrustmeWatcher 本地后端(整合活动历史、同步问卷响应、隐私控制、本地推理),上层为仪表盘界面。数据流程:9 项 Likert 量表问卷采集状态(情绪、情绪强度、疲倦、工作热情、工作沉浸度、身体舒适度、社交体验、工作压力、生产力);7 个回归器预测 6 项状态分数及总体幸福感;25 维特征向量描述过去 60 分钟及 24 小时/7 天上下文的活动状态;每个目标的特征表示在每位参与者训练数据上进行标准化。可解释 AI:反事实解释通过零和搜索在五分类活动类别(个人分心、媒体、沟通、开发、写作研究)之间重新分配五分钟时间块,找到最接近用户选定目标分数的活动分配。

Result: 研究覆盖 17 名参与者,收集时间为 2025 年 7 月至 2026 年 3 月,每位参与者覆盖 10-28 个工作日(中位数 18)。模型评估:在参与者内测试中,所提模型验证 MSE 为 0.85,测试 MSE 为 0.78,优于随机基线(5.9/5.8)、全局均值基线(1.4/1.3)和个人均值基线(1.0/0.85)。系统部署了完整的应用程序,集成了活动审查、学习数据收集、隐私控制、本地预测和面向参与者的 XAI 评估界面。

Conclusion: TrustmeWatcher 成功集成了从 17 名参与者记录中开发的模型,涵盖了计算机活动审查、自我报告、隐私控制、本地预测和反事实解释功能,为第二阶段研究中的解释使用、信任和隐私选择的纵向评估提供了基础设施。未来工作需要分析重复的参与者交互以评估解释理解力、信任校准和模型场景的解释,同时认识到计算机活动无法涵盖会议和离屏工作,且应用分类无法确定意图。

Abstract: Workplace sensing studies combine long-running behaviour traces with self-reports, yet the tools that collect those data often sit apart from the interface that returns results. We present TrustmeWatcher, the application built for the TRUST-ME project to connect this work. TrustmeWatcher reuses ActivityWatch's OS-level watchers for computer-activity collection and adds its own application layer. It turns the collected traces into an interactive screen-time dashboard, synchronizes responses from short questionnaires completed on the StreamDeck, and presents questionnaires alongside video highlights. Activity records and self-reports are aligned into labelled records for model development. The scope of this paper is limited to ActivityWatch data as model input. Artificial intelligence (AI) uses these activity records to predict six normalized state scores and an overall well-being score. The trained model runs locally, and the dashboard presents its predictions in semantic bands. Explainable artificial intelligence (XAI) helps users understand how recorded activity contributed to a prediction. Privacy Control lets users pause or resume the camera and eye tracker used by the study. We describe the workflow, its user-device and sensing-setup boundaries, and its use with records from 17 participants. The result is a deployed application and study workflow that integrates activity review, study data collection, privacy control, local prediction, and a participant-facing interface for XAI evaluation.

</details>


### [550] [What Matters for Latent Reasoning with Flow Matching](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06666)
*Yassine Ouali,Adrian Bulat,Georgios Tzimiropoulos*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出FLaRe（Flow-based Latent Reasoning），一种基于流匹配（flow matching）的潜空间推理方法，通过系统性的消融实验确定了训练的关键设计选择。该方法在算术基准测试上优于先前的潜推理方法，并在五项核心要求（有用性、多样性、可解释性、可优化性、高效性）上均取得提升，同时达到显式思维链97%的准确率，仅需其四分之一的延迟。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 显式思维链（CoT）存在成本随推理长度线性增长、浪费于冗余措辞、以及早期token一旦生成即固定难以探索替代路径等三大局限。现有潜推理方法要么从问题中学习捷径、要么将显式CoT蒸馏进权重、要么逐token模仿显式CoT，均难以同时满足有效潜思维的五项核心要求。

Method: FLaRe采用两阶段流程：(1) VAE将符号化CoT编码为小尺寸潜码（8×512），采用对偶解码路径（同时支持符号化与自然语言重建）并通过token替换、潜噪声与潜dropout增强平滑性；(2) 共享LLM作为流模型，学习从高斯噪声到潜码的速度场，并在时间分布偏向噪声处集中训练（logit-normal分布）。答案读取器以50/50混合加噪码与模型自身单步估计端点作为输入；阶段2在仅含答案的新问题上进行自训练，验证自身rollout并对通过完整rollout反向传播的答案损失进行端到端训练。

Result: FLaRe在Llama-3.2-1B规模上GSM8K直接准确率达到59.1%（阶段2），领先所有潜推理基线；在五项要求上均优于Coconut、CODI、PCCoT；阶段2在两个Euler步下达到显式CoT 97%准确率，速度快3.9倍；在三个模型规模（0.5B/1B/3B）上均优于或接近最佳基线KaVa。

Conclusion: 本文系统性地揭示了潜空间流匹配在推理任务中有效的关键训练选择，提出了简单可复现的FLaRe配方，定义了评估潜推理方法的五项要求及对应探针，证明了基于流匹配的潜推理方法能够在保持准确率的同时显著降低推理延迟，为高效潜推理研究提供了明确的设计指南。

Abstract: Latent reasoning lets a large language model (LLM) think in a continuous space and verbalize only the answer. We argue that an effective latent thought must meet five requirements: it should be useful, helping produce the correct answer rather than merely changing it, diverse, so that resampling yields different reasoning trajectories, explainable, so that a decoded chain of thought (CoT) reflects reasoning the answer actually follows, refinable with more inference compute, and efficient, costing less than an explicit CoT at comparable accuracy. Current methods rarely meet these requirements: they learn shortcuts from the question, distill the explicit CoT into their weights, or imitate it one token at a time. We focus on flow matching in a learned latent space, the family we argue is best placed to meet them, and identify the training choices that make it work. The result is Flow-based Latent Reasoning (FLaRe), a simple recipe covering what the latent space encodes and how to shape it, where to train the flow, how to read out the answer, and a final stage of training on the model's own verified thoughts. A probe for each requirement shows that FLaRe improves on prior latent methods in all five. It also compares favorably with them on arithmetic benchmarks, while reaching 97% of the accuracy of explicit CoT at a quarter of its latency.

</details>


### [551] [Learning What to Imitate: Entropy-Aware Distribution Mixing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06671)
*Juan Garcia Giraldo,Matteo Santelmo,Eduard Durech,Imanol Schlag,Valentina Pyatkin,Antoine Bosselut*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出Entropy-Aware Mixing（熵感知混合），一种token级别的蒸馏策略，通过学生预测熵动态调整学生与教师分布的插值系数，以缓解小语言模型在模仿教师推理轨迹时产生的"自信冲突"问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 小语言模型从强教师蒸馏推理轨迹时，常被迫模仿那些学生认为低概率的token（即使处于低熵的自信状态），导致泛化能力下降和灾难性遗忘。这种"自信冲突"在低熵状态下用大梯度覆盖学生已学表征，损害通用能力。现有方法或对损失进行重加权、或使用固定的小插值系数，均未根本解决问题。

Method: 1. **目标分布构造**：在每个token上对学生分布π_θ和教师分布π_te进行混合，包括凸混合（ConMix，线性插值）和几何混合（GeoMix，几何平均）。
2. **熵门控机制**：使用学生预测的top-K归一化熵H̃_t作为不确定性信号，通过单调函数f(H̃_t)映射得到插值系数α_t。低熵时混合目标接近学生（保留自信行为），高熵时偏向教师（注入指导）。
3. **两种训练范式**：
   - 离线：通过推测解码从混合分布采样生成静态轨迹，再做SFT。
   - 在线：以混合分布为目标分布，采用on-policy forward-KL目标。
4. **熵调度策略**：离线使用凹函数f(x)=x^{1/4}（更早引入教师影响），在线使用凸函数f(x)=x²（教师集中在高熵状态）。

Result: 1. **离线蒸馏**（Qwen3-1.7B，MATH）：GeoMix-SFT在数学推理上平均Avg@64比教师基线提升+1.05，Pass@8/64比学生生成基线分别提升+1.22/+2.76；同时在HellaSwag、IFEval、MMLU上更好地保留通用能力。
2. **在线蒸馏**（Qwen3-1.7B-Base）：GeoMix-FKL在所有数学基准上获得最强平均性能（Avg@64 36.91，Pass@8 56.34，Pass@64 70.17），并优于固定系数Skew-KL。
3. **泛化性**：在Qwen3-0.6B、LFM2.5-350M、Granite-3.2-2B-Instruct等不同规模/家族模型上均验证有效；代码生成（LeetCode）任务上也成立；AMiD广义混合家族（β∈{-5,-3,0}）中同样带来提升。
4. **机制分析**：混合采样轨迹的困惑度介于纯学生与纯教师之间，消除了低熵状态下的低概率token尾；GeoMix通过幂运算压缩极端密度比，提升优化稳定性。

Conclusion: Entropy-Aware Mixing通过让学生预测熵动态控制学生-教师分布的插值，在token级别缓解了自信冲突问题，在离线与在线蒸馏两种范式下均优于固定教师监督，并能更好地保持通用能力。最优熵调度依赖于训练来源：离线轨迹生成适合凹调度（整体教师影响更大），在线训练适合线性或凸调度（教师集中在高熵状态）。未来工作包括设计可学习的插值调度、结合验证器判断何时需要教师覆盖，以及跨家族学生-教师对的分析。

Abstract: Small language models are often post-trained as students on reasoning traces from stronger teacher models to efficiently learn new skills. However, token-level imitation on traces that lie far outside the student's expected distribution often produces \textit{confident conflicts}, whereby the student is required to imitate a continuation that it deems unlikely (i.e., low-probability) despite being confident in a different continuation (i.e., in a low-entropy state). To mitigate the degradation in generalisation and catastrophic forgetting caused by these conflicts, we propose \textbf{Entropy-Aware Mixing}: a dynamic per-token interpolation of the student and teacher distributions, gated by the student's predictive entropy. We implement both convex and geometric interpolations for both offline trace generation (via speculative decoding, then SFT) and on-policy forward-KL distillation. Our results show that entropy-aware mixing stabilises distillation, improving in-distribution and out-of-distribution math reasoning while better preserving general capabilities than fixed-teacher supervision. Nonetheless, the optimal entropy schedule depends on the training source, with offline-generated traces favouring concave schedules (greater overall teacher influence) and on-policy training favouring linear or convex schedules (teacher concentrated in high-entropy states).

</details>


### [552] [Detecting Nighttime Anomalies from NASA Black Marble Using a Generalized Spatio-Temporally Robust Framework of Machine Leaning Ensembles](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06674)
*Srija Chakraborty*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于机器学习的夜间异常检测框架，利用NASA Black Marble产品的M波段（热辐射）和DNB（光辐射）信号进行联合建模，构建了一套时空鲁棒、可泛化的异常检测器集成系统，能够跨区域、季节、异常类别（火灾、火山、燃气燃烧）及陆地和海洋进行检测，并通过多检测器投票生成不同置信度的检测集合。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的夜间异常检测方法主要依赖热红外波段，对弱信号的敏感度有限；且以往基于机器学习的检测方法（如局部背景建模）局限于特定区域（如Eagle Ford Shale），缺乏跨地理空间和季节的扩展能力。标签数据稀缺也制约了监督学习方法的应用。

Method: 方法采用两步迭代框架：(1) 第一步利用自编码器（AE）和变分自编码器（VAE）进行无监督背景建模，通过重建误差检测异常；同时使用高斯混合模型对DNB进行聚类提取光辐射异常。(2) 第二步利用第一步的检测结果作为自生成标签，训练对比学习模型（基于对比损失ℰ_c和三元组损失ℰ_t的Siamese网络）以及全连接神经网络（FCNN），联合使用M波段和DNB进行二分类；同时构建基于M-11波段百分位（T_10）和M-11+DNB（T_10·L_2）的基线检测器。共形成五个检测器，通过投票方式（至少两个检测器一致）生成高置信度集合，仅DNB的检测形成中等置信度集合。利用World Settlement Footprint (WSF)等辅助层过滤城市、陆地水体等背景干扰。

Result: 结果显示，联合使用M波段和DNB相比单波段方法显著提高了检测率并减少了误报。与VIIRS NightFire (VNF)产品对比，联合AE/VAE检测在多个区域的重叠率达84-96%；DNB-only检测揭示了被热波段忽略的燃气燃烧信号，并通过空间共址分析得到Landsat合成图像的佐证。五个检测器集成在跨年份、跨季节和未见区域（Permian盆地、美国西部火灾、基拉韦厄火山）的测试中均表现出强泛化能力。ℰ_c（对比学习模型）在所有区域和事件类型中均表现最佳（重叠率≥0.95），其次为T_10和FCNN；三元组模型在燃气燃烧（仅M-10/M-11有信号）上表现欠佳。

Conclusion: 本文提出的时空鲁棒的机器学习集成框架首次在Black Marble TOA数据上实现了夜间异常的泛化检测，提升了真实检测率和弱信号检测能力，同时减少虚假检测。该方法具有跨区域、跨季节、跨类别和陆海通用的可扩展性，适用于自然灾害监测和能源开采监管。局限性在于缺乏地面真值标签（通过多模型一致性作为置信度代理）、当前为二分类框架（未来可基于波段偏差进行多分类扩展），且三元组模型对特定波段依赖过强。未来工作可探索分割模型、空间卷积层、Few-shot标注和半监督方法。

Abstract: Nighttime lights from NASA's Black Marble product suite capture thermal and light emission signals from anomalous events including fires, volcanic eruptions, and gas flaring. Existing detection approaches rely primarily on thermal bands, limiting sensitivity to weaker signals. We propose a novel machine learning framework that jointly models Black Marble M-band and Day/Night Band (DNB) signals to derive a generalized, spatio-temporally robust ensemble of anomaly detectors. The framework iteratively builds detectors that scale across regions, seasons, anomaly classes, and extends over land and ocean. Detection sets at varying confidence levels are derived based on relevant bands and detector agreement. The approach improves true detection rate while reducing spurious detections and results demonstrate strong generalizability with applications in natural hazard monitoring and energy extraction.

</details>


### [553] [Improved Convergence of Large Stepsize Gradient Descent for Logistic Regression](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06675)
*Xiaochuan Gong,Ang Li*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文针对线性可分数据的逻辑回归问题，研究使用大步长常数步长的梯度下降法（GD），证明了在任意维度下GD达到损失ε仅需$O(\ln^p(1/\epsilon))$步，将原先$\widetilde{O}(1/\sqrt{\epsilon})$的多项式复杂度提升为多项式对数复杂度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
