### [582] [ModelLakeFishing: Efficient Retrieval over Million-Scale Model Lakes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.04904)
*Xiaoyang Liu,Zhengyuan Dong,Renée J. Miller*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 提出 ModelLakeFishing 框架，在包含 300 万模型的"模型湖"中，通过关系感知图编码器与 HNSW 近似最近邻索引实现高效的模型检索，在稀疏关系证据条件下以极低延迟恢复高质量候选模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 开放模型湖（如 Hugging Face）包含数百万可复用模型，但针对新数据集逐一评估每个模型代价过高。现有方法（迁移性估计器、TransferGraph、ModelLens 等）要么需要对每个候选模型执行推理，要么需对每个查询-候选对打分，无法支持百万规模下的索引式候选发现。核心挑战在于：观测到的性能记录极其稀疏（92% 模型无记录），且异构证据（性能记录、元数据、模型谱系、数据集相似度）难以直接蒸馏为可索引的向量空间。

Method: 1）构建异构证据图：节点为模型与数据集-任务对，五种有向关系（观测性能及其反向、模型谱系及其反向、数据集相似度）。2）关系感知 GraphSAGE 编码器独立计算模型与查询嵌入（共享输出头使二者位于同一空间），检索分数为内积。3）联合训练损失：局部排序（RankNet）+ 模型对比 + 全局采样 softmax 竞争。5）HNSW 内积索引离线索引所有模型嵌入；查询时检索 Top-1000 候选，再用仅用训练侧证据的同任务先验重排序，返回 Top-10。提出基于"数据集根"（dataset root）的防泄露划分协议。

Result: 在 3,016,439 模型、247,803 性能对的湖上，三次根感知划分下：平均 eligible-query gold@10 = 29.68%（将观测最优模型列入 Top-10 的查询占比），保留了穷举打分基线 gold@10 的 93.47%；查询检索 + 重排序延迟中位数 0.747 ms、P95 1.102 ms（远低于穷举扫描的 5.73 ms）。消融显示：去除全局竞争损失则全部指标归零（说明跨湖负采样关键），去除任务先验使 gold@10 由 33% 降至 12%（先验主要改善池内排序而非检索本身），HNSW 近似搜索仅损失 <0.1 个百分点。

Conclusion: 稀疏关系证据可被蒸馏为可索引的 ANN 检索向量空间，支持百万规模模型湖的高效检索，无需在目标数据集上执行任何候选模型；检索与重排序分离设计使绝大部分质量损失源于将候选池限制为 1000，而非近似搜索本身。任务级历史先验是在检索后提升排序质量的主导信号。局限在于评估衡量的是对历史观测模型的恢复，真正的最优模型可能未被观测到；与需逐对打分的 TransferGraph、ModelLens 在匹配子集上的完整对比仍是待开展的工作。

Abstract: Open model lakes may contain millions of reusable models, making it costly to identify suitable models for a new dataset. We present ModelLakeFishing, a model-retrieval framework for queries specifying a target dataset, prediction task, and evaluation metric. It consolidates metadata and historical evaluations into a model-dataset-task evidence graph, learns model and query embeddings with a relation-aware graph encoder, and indexes model embeddings using Hierarchical Navigable Small World (HNSW) search. At query time, HNSW retrieves 1,000 candidates without scoring every model, after which a training-side task prior reranks candidates for the requested metric and returns the top 10. We evaluate on a lake of 3,016,439 models and 247,803 observed model-dataset performance pairs using three root-aware splits that hold test performance edges out of representation learning and retrieval. ModelLakeFishing achieves a mean eligible-query gold@10 of 0.2968, recovering the observed-best model in the top 10 for 29.68% of eligible queries and retaining 93.47% of the gold@10 of an exhaustive baseline using the same scoring and reranking procedure. Given precomputed query embeddings, retrieval and reranking take 0.747 ms median and 1.102 ms at the 95th percentile. These results demonstrate efficient retrieval over million-model lakes from sparse relational evidence.

</details>


### [583] [Orchestrating Specialized Agents for Trustworthy Enterprise RAG](https://arxiv.org/abs/2601.18267)
*Xincheng You,Qi Sun,Neha Bora,Huayi Li,Shubham Goel,Kang Li,Sean Culatana*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: ADORE是一个面向高风险企业决策场景的智能体RAG框架，通过中心编排器协调多个专业Agent（澄清、规划、执行、报告生成、Web搜索），核心创新在于以结构化Memory Bank作为生成的硬约束，结合证据覆盖率驱动的检索-反思循环和长上下文打包策略，实现可追溯、可审计的长篇报告生成。在DeepResearch Bench上以52.65分排名第一，在DeepConsult上对商业系统取得77.2%的胜率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有线性"检索-然后-生成"RAG流程在企业高风险决策场景中存在三类失败模式：(1) 提示词模糊导致冷启动错误；(2) 工作流刚性导致早期检索失误向下游传导；(3) 长上下文存在"迷失中段"效应且缺乏自纠错循环。这些问题在长篇报告生成中尤为突出，亟需深度综合、严格可追溯性和对不完整提示的恢复机制。

Method: 采用中心编排器（Orchestrator）+ 专业Agent集（Steering/Planning/Execution/Report Generation/WebSearch）的中心辐射型架构。三个核心技术贡献：(1) Memory-locked synthesis——报告生成受限于结构化Memory Bank（Claim-Evidence Graph），按段落限定可采纳证据集合，实现声明-证据显式链接；(2) Evidence-coverage-guided execution——基于段落级证据覆盖率审计的检索-反思循环，触发定向补充检索，并以证据覆盖率为收敛停止条件；(3) Section-packed long-context grounding——按段落打包相关证据、剪枝冗余内容、保持引用的压缩，使长篇综合生成在上下文限制内可行。执行流程包括：澄清→规划→迭代检索（Self-Evolution Engine演化查询）→大纲更新→证据驱动停止→最终报告生成。

Result: DeepResearch Bench（100个PhD级研究任务，参考型评估）：ADORE以52.65排名第一（Tavily Research 52.44、ThinkDepthAI 52.43次之），四个RACE维度（Comprehensiveness 52.22、Insight 54.37、Instruction Following 51.11、Readability 52.18）均领先。内部企业基准测试：RACE总分64.11（基准50.0代表人类水平），质量提升14.11%。DeepConsult（参考型偏好评估）：ADORE胜率77.21%，平局18.38%，败率4.41%，综合得分7.03排名第一，显著优于ChatGPT Deep Research、WebWeaver系列、Gemini-2.5-pro、Claude Research等基线系统。

Conclusion: ADORE通过将Memory Bank从软参考转变为生成硬约束，并以证据覆盖率审计驱动迭代检索而非固定迭代次数，突破了传统RAG线性管道的局限性，实现了可追溯、章节级证据扎根的长篇企业报告生成。框架在公共基准和内部测试上均取得SOTA，验证了基于证据的编排策略对企业深度研究任务的有效性。未来工作将聚焦于决策可操作性（提议决策选项与权衡）、细粒度引用准确性指标与自动审计、多模态综合（证据对齐的图表可视化）等方向。

Abstract: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) shows promise for enterprise knowledge work, yet it often underperforms in high-stakes decision settings that require deep synthesis, strict traceability, and recovery from underspecified prompts. One-pass retrieval-and-write pipelines frequently yield shallow summaries, inconsistent grounding, and weak mechanisms for completeness verification. We introduce ADORE (Adaptive Deep Orchestration for Research in Enterprise), an agentic framework that replaces linear retrieval with iterative, user-steered investigation coordinated by a central orchestrator and a set of specialized agents. ADORE's key insight is that a structured Memory Bank (a curated evidence store with explicit claim-evidence linkage and section-level admissible evidence) enables traceable report generation and systematic checks for evidence completeness. Our contributions are threefold: (1) Memory-locked synthesis - report generation is constrained to a structured Memory Bank (Claim-Evidence Graph) with section-level admissible evidence, enabling traceable claims and grounded citations; (2) Evidence-coverage-guided execution - a retrieval-reflection loop audits section-level evidence coverage to trigger targeted follow-up retrieval and terminates via an evidence-driven stopping criterion; (3) Section-packed long-context grounding - section-level packing, pruning, and citation-preserving compression make long-form synthesis feasible under context limits. Across our evaluation suite, ADORE ranks first on DeepResearch Bench (52.65) and achieves the highest head-to-head preference win rate on DeepConsult (77.2%) against commercial systems.

</details>


### [584] [Beyond Semantic Similarity: Performance and Costs of Agentic Retrieval for Complex Tasks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05750)
*Reza Esfandiarpoor,Radek Osmulski,Yauhen Babakhin,Gabriel de Souza P. Moreira,Oliver Holworthy,Jie He,Ronay Ak,Jiarui Cai,Ryan Chesler,Bo Liu,Even Oldridge*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 本文研究了智能体检索（Agentic Retrieval），将LLM推理能力与密集检索器结合在ReAct循环中，以应对复杂检索任务。实验证明该方法在nDCG@10上平均提升8.7个点，且具备良好的跨领域泛化能力（ViDoRe v3和BRIGHT基准），但代价显著：平均查询耗时107.4秒、消耗约76.4万输入token和5800输出token，远高于标准检索的0.67秒。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现代信息检索系统（尤其是RAG、DeepResearch等智能体工作流）面临越来越复杂的检索任务（如数学定理检索、工具规格匹配），而标准密集检索仅依赖表面语义相似度（余弦相似度），缺乏推理与迭代探索能力，难以胜任此类任务。

Method: 提出NeMo Retriever Agent：在ReAct循环中通过JSON Schema工具调用集成LLM与密集检索器，提供三个工具——Retrieve（基于密集检索器返回top-k文档）、Think（生成推理/规划token）、Final_Results（返回排序后的最终文档列表）。系统提示包含初始检索结果以帮助LLM理解语料特征。采用线程安全的单例检索器替代MCP服务器，避免网络往返与进程管理开销；失败时回退至RRF融合多轮检索结果。

Result: 1）有效性：在ViDoRe v3上最佳代理nDCG@10达69.22（标准检索64.36），BRIGHT上达50.79（标准检索38.28），平均提升8.7点；2）泛化性：同一管道在ViDoRe v3排名第一、BRIGHT排名第二，而专用方法INF-X-Retriever跨域时性能大幅下降；3）部分弥补嵌入模型差距：代理检索将不同嵌入模型间的性能差距缩小约57%。4）成本代价：平均延迟107.4秒vs标准检索0.67秒，平均消耗764.1K输入token和5.8K输出token；Opus 4.5（136.3秒，9.2次检索调用）优于gpt-oss-120b（78.6秒，2.4次调用）。

Conclusion: 智能体检索是处理复杂检索任务的有效方案，相比标准密集检索具有显著的性能与泛化性优势，但计算成本高昂。文章呼吁未来研究聚焦于：(1)更高效的开放权重模型；(3)针对智能体检索的近似最近邻式成本控制机制；(3)任务特定基础设施优化（如并行工具调用）；以推动其在数据系统中的大规模部署。

Abstract: Modern information systems, including many agentic workflows, use dense retrieval to explore large amounts of unstructured data. However, dense retrieval relies on surface-level semantic similarity, which is insufficient for increasingly complex search applications. Here, we investigate agentic retrieval that combines the reasoning capabilities of Large Language Models (LLMs) with the efficient corpus exploration of retrievers in a ReAct agentic loop to solve complex retrieval tasks. In our experiments, we show that agentic retrieval is more effective than standard retrieval, improving nDCG@10 by 8.7 points using the same embedding model. Moreover, while specialized retrieval methods struggle on out-of-domain tasks, agentic retrieval is highly generalizable: the same pipeline achieves competitive results on both the ViDoRe v3 and BRIGHT leaderboards. However, this improvement comes at a cost. On average, agentic retrieval takes 107.4 seconds, compared to 0.67 seconds for standard retrieval, and consumes 764.1K input and 5.8K output tokens per query. In short, our study demonstrates the effectiveness of agentic retrieval in modern data systems and motivates future work on more cost-efficient retrieval agents for large-scale deployment.

</details>


### [585] [Reading the Mood: Emotion-Guided Book-to-Music Recommendation via CGANs and LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06703)
*Manousos Linardakis,Georgios Alexandridis*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: Background music that matches the mood of a text has been shown to make readers feel more immersed and improve their reading experience, motivating recommender systems that pair books with mood-matched music. In this direction, we present Sentiment Aware Generative Adversarial Network for Cross Domain Recommendation (SAGA-CDR), a two-phase cross-domain recommendation framework that personalizes music suggestions and emotionally aligns them with the book being read. In the first phase, transformer-based sentiment embeddings are constructed from user reviews and mapped across domains via a Conditional Generative Adversarial Network, whose mask-conditioned generator handles missing sentiment components and injects stochasticity for richer preference transfer. A compact rating neural network then fuses sentiment-specific interaction scores with a collaborative filtering prior to predict music ratings. In the second phase, large language models classify each book into a valence-arousal emotional quadrant, and candidate tracks are filtered to match that quadrant. Experiments on both the English Amazon and Chinese Douban datasets show that SAGA-CDR achieves the best rating prediction accuracy on Amazon (RMSE 0.98) and the lowest RMSE on Douban (0.91), with ranking performance competitive with the strongest sentiment-aware baseline, even in cross-lingual settings.

### [586] [Multimodal Dual-Encoder Retrieval for Automated ICD Coding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.04263)
*Abhinav Bohra,Anuj Bohra*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: Accurate International Classification of Diseases (ICD) coding is crucial for large-scale clinical research, documentation, and billing. There are three primary problems with current ICD prediction methods: (1) They are unable to comprehend multimodal patient data because they rely on either structured EHR data or unstructured clinical notes. (2) They also struggle with scalability to a larger amount of ICD codes (9K+ codes in ICD-9), as traditional classifiers need dense output layers and often do not generalize well to long tail rare diseases. (3) They lack transparency for clinical use. To address these challenges, this research proposes a two-stage framework that first retrieves ICD codes using a multimodal dual-encoder retrieval model, where structured and unstructured patient data are integrated through gated fusion. The second stage refines the top-k retrieved candidates with an LLM-based re-ranker that provides ranked codes with clinically relevant explanations. Our experiments show that the proposed approach improves Micro-F1 and Precision over a multimodal dual-fusion classifier baseline. These improvements demonstrate that combining a gated multimodal retrieval system with LLM-based re-ranking is a practical alternative to dense multi-label classification for automated ICD coding.

### [587] [SearchJev: A Fast and Calibrated System-1 Model for Search Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05107)
*Congfeng Cao,Lipeng Zuo,Konstantinos Papakostas,Qiwei Xu,Songwei Xu,Lun Zhou,Zhaochun Ren,Yougang Lyu,Xiaohui Yan*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: Search agents repeatedly make short decisions about relevance, evidence sufficiency, and search actions. Using generative language models for these decisions introduces latency and unreliable confidence. We present SearchJev, a fast and calibrated System-1 model that separates search decisions from System-2 reasoning and generation. Given a search state and a decision schema, SearchJev directly scores legal options without autoregressive output generation. We propose Soft-Label Learning for Calibrated Decisions (SLCD) to learn decision probabilities from uncertain supervision and calibrate their confidence. In a dual-system search agent, SearchJev handles short decisions and delegates uncertain judgments to System 2, which retains planning, query generation, and answer composition. We also introduce SearchDecision-Bench, a benchmark unifying six types of search decisions for training and evaluation. On SearchDecision-Bench, SEARCHJEV improves decision quality over same-size Qwen3.5 autoregressive models, achieves 5.2-5.3 times faster decisions, and reduces average expected calibration error by 41-74%. On BrowseComp-Plus, the dual-system agents achieve a 3.7-4.7 times speedup in active search time while improving answer accuracy from 45% to up to 54%.

### [588] [Learning Robust Personalized Prompts for LLM-Driven Sequential Recommendation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03923)
*Xiaolin Zheng,Qiyong Zhong,Jiajie Su,Xiang Chen*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: LLM-driven sequential recommendation formulates next-item prediction as autoregressive generation conditioned on natural-language prompts. However, minor wording changes in semantically equivalent prompts can cause substantial performance fluctuations, undermining robustness and requiring costly manual prompt engineering. Continuous prompt learning reduces template dependence but faces two interacting challenges: shared task-level instructions lack user-specific reasoning guidance, while gradient updates can push continuous prompts outside the LLM's effective semantic space. Injecting personalized signals can further amplify this semantic drift. To address these challenges, we propose LRPRec, a learnable prompting framework that initializes continuous instruction prompts from discrete templates and introduces two complementary mechanisms. Personalized prompt injection encodes user behavior into a preference embedding and additively injects it into shared prompts, enabling parameter-efficient user-level adaptation. A semantic drift constraint regularizes the shared prompts within a trust region around their initialization anchors to preserve semantic validity during optimization. By constraining the shared component while allowing additive personalization, LRPRec decouples stability from expressiveness. Extensive experiments on three benchmark datasets demonstrate consistent improvements over strong baselines while eliminating the need for manual tuning of background and task inference templates.

### [589] [FICO: Find-Then-Compute for Corpus-Level Spreadsheet Question Answering](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03958)
*Sandarsita Guntupalli,Lu He,Kang Li*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: Question answering over spreadsheet collections requires finding the correct workbook and computing over complete tables. We introduce Find-then-Compute (FiCo), which retrieves document summaries, disambiguates similar workbooks, and executes constrained Structured Query Language (SQL) over the selected full table. On DataBench (80 datasets, 1,810 questions), FiCo reaches 76.2% accuracy: 9.9 points above a strong TableRAG-style baseline on the same frozen workbook choices (66.3%) under the tracks' prespecified evaluators, and 63.4 points above prefix RAG (12.8%). On 508 MiMoTable questions, FiCo reaches 79.7%, versus 22.2% for prefix RAG. Giving the strong baseline the gold workbook raises it from 66.3% to 76.3%, exposing a 10.0-point source-selection cost under fixed compute. Despite 95.1% document recall and 98.5% executable SQL, only 81.3% of questions execute on the gold workbook. FiCo's advantage comes from integrating semantic source selection with exact, schema-grounded computation.

### [590] [From Valid to Useful: Post-Verification Acquisition for Recursive Self-Improving Recommendation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.04302)
*Tonmoy Hasan,Taylor Foust,Shao Tang,Leonardo Neves,Aman Gupta,Hiroto Udagawa,Helder Dias,Daniel Silva,Rohan Ramanath*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: Sequential recommenders can generate synthetic interaction sequences and retrain on the augmented corpus in a recursive self-improvement loop. To limit error accumulation, current methods verify each generated sequence remains predictive of the user's real interactions and discard those that drift away from it. Verification does not, however, determine which verified sequences should train the next model. With every verified sequence used for training, source sequences yielding more verified sequences or longer continuations have more influence, although neither quantity indicates how much those sequences will help the next model. We formulate the decision of which verified sequences are used to train the next model as \emph{post-verification acquisition} and introduce {\bf Disagreement-Aware Recursive Self-Improving Recommendation (DA-RSIR)}. DA-RSIR caps each source sequence's contribution and ranks its verified sequences by how much the model's predictions disagree over their augmented interactions. It uses a score derived from Bayesian Active Learning by Disagreement (BALD) and estimated with Monte Carlo (MC) dropout. DA-RSIR requires no extra labels, teacher model, or quality scorer. Across four datasets, three recommender models, and two metrics, it improves on the retain-all approach in all $24$ comparisons and attains the highest mean in $23$ of $24$ overall; the aggregate improvement is statistically significant on both metrics. A single DA-RSIR round exceeds the retain-all approach's best gain over five recursive rounds. These findings establish post-verification acquisition as a separate control point in recursive self-improvement, separating which sequences pass verification from which verified sequences are used to train the next model.

### [591] [Query Generation with Direct Preference Optimization for Document Expansion in E-commerce Search](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.04352)
*Kaihao Li,Feng Liu,Juexin Lin,Xunfan Cai,Zhen Yang,Tony Lee,Ciya Liao*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: Doc2Query, a popular document expansion technique, leverages sequence-to-sequence models to generate relevant queries, effectively addressing the "vocabulary mismatch" problem in information retrieval. However, these models often suffer from generating either hallucinations unrelated to the document or repetitive content already present in the document. Training sequence-to-sequence models to produce high-quality, novel, and relevant tokens remains a significant challenge. To address these issues, we introduce a novel approach, QGDPO, that employs direct preference optimization (DPO) to guide the generation process. We first fine-tune a base sequence-to-sequence model and subsequently utilize a relevance model to score its predictions. Based on these scores, we construct pairs of winning and losing predictions as relevance preferences for the DPO training. Furthermore, we enhance our pipeline by using the relevance model to filter out poor predictions, retaining only the most relevant generated content for indexing. QGDPO effectively eliminates 50% of irrelevant predictions comparing against Doc2Query baselines, while the relevance filter removes an additional 14.61%. This feature has been successfully deployed to production on this http URL for full traffic, with a substantial improvement in relevance and user engagement.

Abstract: Doc2Query, a popular document expansion technique, leverages sequence-to-sequence models to generate relevant queries, effectively addressing the "vocabulary mismatch" problem in information retrieval. However, these models often suffer from generating either hallucinations unrelated to the document or repetitive content already present in the document. Training sequence-to-sequence models to produce high-quality, novel, and relevant tokens remains a significant challenge. To address these issues, we introduce a novel approach, QGDPO, that employs direct preference optimization (DPO) to guide the generation process. We first fine-tune a base sequence-to-sequence model and subsequently utilize a relevance model to score its predictions. Based on these scores, we construct pairs of winning and losing predictions as relevance preferences for the DPO training. Furthermore, we enhance our pipeline by using the relevance model to filter out poor predictions, retaining only the most relevant generated content for indexing. QGDPO effectively eliminates 50% of irrelevant predictions comparing against Doc2Query baselines, while the relevance filter removes an additional 14.61%. This feature has been successfully deployed to production on this http URL for full traffic, with a substantial improvement in relevance and user engagement.

</details>


### [592] [Do We Still Need Gazetteers in the Era of LLMs? Chaining Retrieval with a Spatial Neuro-Symbolic Index](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05028)
*Horde-Vo Alexis,Duckham Matt,He Estrid*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: Geographic information retrieval (GeoIR) tasks require systems to interpret ambiguous toponyms for downstream applications. Traditionally, toponym resolution relies on gazetteers to provide an explicit index of place entities and spatial relationships. Recently, gazetteer-free approaches seek to reduce dependence on handcrafted searches: dense retrieval utilizes text encoders to capture rich context, moving beyond the limitations of lexical search. However, text encoders implicitly assume that learned representations can function as reliable spatial-semantic indexes. In this paper, we evaluate this assumption through a spatial-semantic indexing setup: given a contextualized toponym mention, we retrieve the corresponding gazetteer entity represented by text derived from a gazetteer knowledge graph. We benchmark five frozen text encoders under two retrieval strategies: brute-force nearest-neighbor retrieval over entity representations, and a neuro-symbolic hierarchical beam search that constrains retrieval (i.e. chaining the search with gazetteer hierarchy). Experimental results reveal a distinct coarse-versus-fine trade-off. Unconstrained dense retrieval frequently incurs catastrophic spatial errors. Conversely, hierarchical constraints improve coarse geographic grounding, but still yield limited benefit for fine-grained localization metrics: vanilla text encoders fail to capture the fine-scale spatial fidelity encoded in gazetteers. Our code is publicly available at: this https URL

### [593] [Agentic RAG Evaluation: Budget Allocation Across Questions, Trajectories, and Reads](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05034)
*Jingjie Ning,Xueqi Li,Yibo Kong*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: Evaluation budgets in agentic retrieval-augmented generation span questions, search trajectories, and repeated answers. We measure allocation precision, reading efficiency, and cost boundaries using a retrieval-feedback comparison on HotpotQA and MuSiQue. At 34.14--34.39M model tokens, broader question coverage lowers standard error by 33\% versus five reads and 12.6\% versus three trajectories. Archived nested and Q-only forecasts predict these allocations within 4.0\% and 3.5\%, respectively. Depth subsets establish no clear forecasting advantage beyond the two-trajectory audit. One-read variance penalties relative to the fitted optimum at the same token budget are 0--9.9\%, with substantial Pro uncertainty. Under recorded model fees, more questions beat more trajectories at search prices of \$0--1 per 1,000 requests; question-versus-read fee rankings remain unresolved. Temperature zero cuts answer disagreement from 14.3\% to 3.4\% while comparison precision stays similar. \par\medskip\noindent\textbf{Keywords:} Agentic RAG; Evaluation budget; Generalizability theory; Repeated sampling.

### [594] [Quality-Aware Cross-Model Computation Reuse](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05285)
*Jin Cheng,Xiangxiang Dai,Maoli Liu,Ziyi Han,Zhuohua Li,John C.S. Lui*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: An intermediate result computed by one model can be reused by other models to perform their tasks. Existing work mainly focuses on practical execution, leaving a theoretical gap in optimizing reuse decisions. This optimization faces two challenges: quality uncertainty, because the effect of reuse on task quality is uncertain across models, and coupled scheduling, because tasks need to share the cost of preparing reusable results. These challenges compound each other: quality must be learned online, but the shared preparation structure makes scheduling NP-hard even with known quality, breaking the key assumption in existing methods. We formulate cross-model computation reuse as an online decision problem and develop the Quality-Aware Reuse Scheduling (QARS) algorithm to address it. For quality uncertainty, QARS learns task-dependent reuse quality from selected, possibly delayed feedback and uses optimistic estimates to guide decisions. For coupled scheduling, it jointly chooses which results to prepare and which tasks should use them, adapting scheduling accuracy to the remaining quality uncertainty. For the considered problem, our analysis separates learning and optimization error in regret and quantifies the tradeoff between scheduling accuracy and computation. Completing the quality-aware stopping rule yields $\widetilde O(\sqrt{T})$ regret while preserving feasibility. Experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of QARS in optimizing cross-model reuse, reducing the combined cost of computation and quality loss by up to 18.0%, and mean regret by 63.9% over the strongest scheduling baseline.

### [595] [Search Engines Never Say No: How Frozen Agents React When the Retrieval Tool Refuses](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05348)
*Ramraj Chandradevan,Sayontan Ghosh,Vinoth Selvendran*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: A search tool never says no: it returns its top-k passages even when the index holds no answer, so the agent sees irrelevant text instead of a miss signal. We ask what frozen search agents do when the tool refuses instead. On an index-hole testbed (257 NQ and 300 HotpotQA questions run with and without their gold passages in a 21M-passage BM25 index), seven agents receive one of five refusal wordings. An un-announced one-sentence refusal raises abstention on unanswerable questions from 23% to 97% on average for Qwen3-8B/32B and from 28% to 57% for Claude Haiku 4.5, cutting wrong answers almost one-for-one and beating a system-prompt instruction by 51 points on average. Search-R1 ignores the refusal and fabricates retrievals; Claude Sonnet 5.5 and Opus 5.5 answer from memory (abstention +2 points) and obey a system-prompt directive instead (+16). We also found that wording matters: an explanation beats a bare token; a directive inside the observation is decisive for Haiku; a soft warning is useless. Realistic triggers, from a lightweight score-based predictor to an LLM grounding judge, fall well short of the oracle, and all land on a benefit-versus-signal-quality curve that prices any trigger by its recall at a fixed false-refusal budget: for compliant agents the bottleneck is the detector inside the tool, not the agent, and the curve tells future detector work what each point of recall is worth.

### [596] [OpticalRec: Unified Optical Vision-Language Representation for Multimodal Recommendation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05432)
*Yueqi Wang,Zitian Guo,Yupeng Hou,Yifei Wang,Kibum Kim,Zhenrui Yue,Shuo Xing,Haodong Li,Heming Xia,Renrui Zhang,Zhengzhong Tu,Julian McAuley*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: Recent advances in vision-language modeling have substantially improved multimodal encoding, retrieval and reasoning. Yet for multimodal recommendation, encoding rich item vision-language semantic interactions remains a long-standing bottleneck, which hampers accurate item representation learning and user-item matching. Mainstream approaches primarily adopt independent encoding of vision and language modality followed by rigid late fusion such as concatenation, inherently omitting native vision-language interactions and introducing cross-modal semantic distortion. To address this challenge, we propose OpticalRec, the first visual-space unified encoding paradigm for multimodal collaborative filtering, a fundamental recommendation setting. Instead of isolated modality-specific encoding, OpticalRec renders item textual metadata as visual glyphs, enabling native image-text interaction within the visual encoder - the perceptual encoding level. The resulting representations are further processed by the language decoder - the semantic encoding level, allowing OpticalRec to exploit the dual-attention mechanism of modern vision-language models that previous encoding methods omitted. OpticalRec's efficacy is theoretically supported by mutual information analysis and empirically demonstrated through superior performance across strong baselines and benchmarks. As a plug-and-play module, OpticalRec (1) introduces minimal cost, (2) is robust against rendered text font, color and layout, etc., and (3) integrates seamlessly into existing multimodal collaborative filtering models.

### [597] [SCOUT: Supply-Aware Cold-Start Proactive Query Suggestion for Travel Search](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05619)
*Hao Li,Shashank Reddy,Kedar Bellare,Ashish Jain,Stephanie Moyerman*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: Generative query suggestion, powered by Large Language Models (LLMs), has become increasingly popular in search and conversational systems to reduce user friction and guide intent formulation. Existing approaches align suggestions with user preferences (e.g., clicks or conversions). This works for open-ended applications like chatbots and personal assistants, where the result space is unconstrained or historical user free-text queries are abundant. However, applying these methods to travel search presents two limitations. First, travel search is fundamentally constrained by physical inventory; a query (e.g., "romantic beachfront villa") may yield abundant results in Bali but few in Tokyo, so aligning with user preferences is not by itself grounded in what can be offered. Second, travel platforms traditionally rely on faceted search interfaces with no free-text queries. This creates a cold-start problem: without historical query logs there is no demand-side data for alignment, and without a seed query at request time, suggestions must be generated proactively from structured context alone. To address these challenges, we propose SCOUT, a bootstrapping framework for supply-aware proactive query suggestion. SCOUT overcomes the data gap by substituting missing demand-side user feedback with supply-side system feedback. It treats the search engine as a reinforcement learning environment, deriving a dense reward from the production reranker's query-listing match scores, and optimizes the policy with Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO). SCOUT improves inventory match rate (IMR@18) by 12.3% while preserving diversity, matching a compute-intensive best-of-8 policy at zero marginal inference cost and making supply-aware suggestion deployable on a real-time travel search path.

### [598] [Generate What You Can Trust: Content Credibility in Generative Recommenders](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05670)
*Zhuo Cai,Guanghao Wu,Shoujin Wang,Peilin Zhou,Victor W. Chu*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: Generative recommendation (GR) represents items with semantic IDs (i.e., discrete token sequences) and generates target item tokens as recommendations. Despite its promising results, existing methods predominantly optimize for accuracy while neglecting the credibility of the recommendations they generate. This oversight inevitably exposes users to uncredible content (e.g., fake news) with serious societal consequences, including user distrust, reputation harm to platforms, and broader social instability. To address this critical yet underexplored challenge, we propose CreGR, the first credible GR model that jointly tackles content credibility across the two core stages of GR: tokenization and generation. In the tokenization stage, we design a new credibility-aware tokenizer that explicitly encourages the model to learn discriminative tokens respectively for credible and uncredible items, thereby disentangling credibility signals at the token level. Building on this, in the generation stage, we propose a novel accuracy-preserving and credibility-oriented generator grounded in discrete diffusion. Specifically, we introduce an asymmetric masking probability reduction strategy that selectively diminishes the contribution of tokens associated with uncredible content to the generation process, while leaving tokens encoding user preference signals unaffected so as to preserve recommendation accuracy. Experiments on three real-world datasets demonstrate the effectiveness of CreGR.

### [599] [Constraint-Aware Conversational Job Recommendation in Code-Mixed Low-Resource Settings](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05787)
*Md Arman Hossain,Mubashir Jawad,Fariha Khandaker Moon,Sonia Binte Siraj,Masfiqur Rahaman,Raihan ul Islam,Ahmed Wasif Reza,Nafis Sadeq*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: Conversational job recommendation requires jointly modeling semantic relevance, user preferences, eligibility requirements, and the noisy language used in real-world career discussions. These challenges are especially pronounced in low-resource, code-mixed settings, where strict constraint matching can incorrectly eliminate otherwise suitable jobs. We introduce JobCCC, a conversational job recommendation benchmark for Bangladesh comprising 22,410 structured job postings and 988 multi-turn career-advice dialogues derived from regional Reddit communities. Each dialogue is annotated with evolving seeker preferences and linked to a ground-truth job, and is evaluated in semantically equivalent English and Romanized Bangla--English variants. We compare sparse BM25 retrieval, multilingual dense retrieval, and their hard-constraint-filtered counterparts against Weighted Soft-Constraint-Aware Ranking (W-SCAR), our multi-criteria ranking framework that combines lexical relevance, semantic relevance, and graded utilities for experience, location, education, and salary using the Technique for Order Preference by Similarity to Ideal Solution (TOPSIS). Experiments reveal that strict filtering consistently degrades retrieval because incomplete extraction and brittle attribute matching irreversibly remove relevant jobs. W-SCAR avoids destructive pruning and achieves more balanced performance across the two language conditions, obtaining 37.37% and 38.43% Hit@10 on English and Banglish, respectively. The code and dataset are publicly available at \href{ this https URL }{GitHub} and \href{ this https URL }{Hugging Face}, respectively.

### [600] [MATE: Adaptive Long- and Short-Term User Memory for LLM-Based Recommendation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06050)
*Yu Hou*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: Large language model (LLM)-enhanced recommender systems leverage rich item semantics to support personalized recommendation. However, semantic representations alone do not determine which historical behaviors reflect persistent preferences and which mainly indicate recent interests, leaving an important aspect of user understanding unresolved. Recent advances in LLM inference show that newly available information can be used to refine the internal state during inference, thereby improving subsequent predictions. Inspired by this principle, we propose MATE (Memory Adaptation with Temporal Evidence), an adaptive user modeling framework for LLM-enhanced sequential recommendation. MATE first evaluates each newly observed interaction from two temporal perspectives: whether it is repeatedly supported by historical behaviors and whether it is consistent with recent interactions. The resulting temporal evidence controls the updates of two user-specific memories, where the long-term memory conservatively preserves persistent preferences while the short-term memory rapidly adapts to recent interests. For each recommendation, a recent-context representation dynamically determines how strongly the two memories contribute to the current user representation. During offline training, next-item prediction is jointly optimized with temporal supervision, while during online adaptation, the shared model remains fixed and only the two user memories are updated from newly observed interactions. Experiments on MovieLens-10M, Amazon Luxury Beauty, and KuaiRec show that MATE improves mean NDCG@10 over the strongest external baseline by 7.0--13.2%. Further analyses support its ability to adapt to recent interests while retaining useful information about recurring earlier preferences.

### [601] [Beyond States: Investigating the Effects of Context on User Modeling with Feature-Conditioned Markov Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06060)
*Jana Isabelle Friese,Andreas Konstantin Kruff,Timo Breuer,Philipp Schaer,Norbert Fuhr*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: User behavior simulation is widely used to evaluate interactive information retrieval systems, but classical state-based approaches (e.g., Markov models) have limited ability to incorporate contextual information relevant for decision-making. We address this limitation by introducing a feature-conditioned Markov-style user model, in which transition probabilities are modeled as functions of positional, content-based, and interaction-derived features, enabling context-aware decision making while preserving the structural simplicity and computational efficiency of state-based models. Applying a multi-level framework that assesses predictive fit and behavioral fidelity, we analyze how different sources of contextual information contribute to realistic user simulation across multiple datasets, search settings, and feature configurations. Our results show that incorporating contextual features improves the models' ability to reproduce key aspects of real user interactions, but that their effectiveness hinges on search scenario and modeling objective. Instead of a one-size-fits-all solution, effective simulation requires task- and setting-specific feature selection. Our framework provides a practical and interpretable basis for making these choices.

### [602] [Commercial Intent in Human-AI Conversations: A Corpus Audit and Architecture for Website Sales Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06205)
*Benjamin Tannenbaum*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: Conversational sales agents must distinguish questions about products from purchase commitments, preserve explicit requirements, and ground the next action in current business information. We report an aggregate census of 725,219 records in an accessible conversation table provided by Aiso and develop a reference architecture for this setting. All records have distinct non-null conversation hashes. Existing metadata labels identify 41,800 commercial records (5.76%) and 2,387 transactional records (0.33%); their union contains 44,187 records (6.09%). Within the commercial category, 54.31% are labeled English, 41.59% have recorded depth of at least two, and 13.51% have depth of at least four. Commercial-label prevalence varies from 4.87% to 6.35% across three source batches. These measurements motivate explicit separation of corpus inventory, commercial relevance, training eligibility, and observed business outcomes. The proposed architecture combines business-grounded knowledge, provenance-bearing conversation state, and a constrained next-action policy. A quality specification addresses source rights, privacy, label validation, deduplication, and training-test separation. The study is a metadata audit and technical design, not a validation of label accuracy, model training volume, or sales conversion. No raw conversation text or personal identifiers are released.

### [603] [SPRIG: Semantic-ID-enhanced Paths for Knowledge Graph-based Generative Recommendation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06590)
*Justin Hangoebl,Marta Moscati,Alessandro B. Melchiorre,Shah Nawaz,Markus Schedl*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: Recommender systems leveraging generative models often generate item identifiers directly, rather than ranking catalog items by a recommendation score. Recent work extends beyond pure sequential interaction signals by incorporating item content and structured relationships among items, with two distinct directions emerging. Semantic IDs (SIDs) enrich item representations by replacing opaque, randomly initialized embeddings with hierarchically quantized discrete codes derived from item content. Knowledge-graph (KG) path reasoning instead generates entity-relation paths that ground recommendations in structured relationships between items, attributes, and external entities, thereby enriching the relational context. These two lines have complementary limitations: SID-based models lack relational grounding, while KG-based generative recommenders still represent items as arbitrary, opaque tokens tied to large embedding tables, limiting parameter sharing and generalization. We propose SPRIG, a generative recommender that integrates content-derived SIDs into KG path reasoning. SPRIG is trained on information-rich KG paths that terminate in items represented as discrete, content-derived tokens, combining the advantages of both approaches. We evaluate SPRIG on movie and music recommendation datasets against baselines spanning sequential language models, KG-augmented methods, and SID-based approaches. Our results show that SPRIG achieves competitive performance over prior generative models while using fewer parameters and a lower compute cost. Code: this https URL

### [604] [Conjunctive Queries with Negation: Beyond Signed-Acyclicity](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03982)
*Simon Frisk,Paraschos Koutris*

Main category: cs.DB

TL;DR: 本文研究了带否定的合取查询（CQ¬）的常数延迟枚举问题，提出了新的超图宽度度量——带符号分数超树宽度（sfhw），证明其能刻画 signed-acyclicity（sfhw=1）并推广到任意宽度。基于此设计了预处理时间为 O(|I|^sfhw) 的变量消除算法，并对 k-环查询利用多变量序将预处理时间改进至 O(|I|^{3/2})。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 带否定的合取查询（CQ¬）涵盖 SQL 中的连接、差集与反连接等操作，但其在常数延迟枚举方面的复杂性远未被充分理解。此前已知 signed-acyclicity 刻画了线性预处理时间可达的查询类，但超出此范围几乎无研究。本文旨在回答：对 full CQ¬，何种宽度度量 w 能保证以 O(|I|^w) 预处理实现常数延迟枚举。

Method: （1）定义新宽度度量 signed fractional hypertree width（sfhw）：选取单一变量序 σ，对所有负原子子集 S⊆ℰ⁻ 同步考虑其正完成图 H^S=(ℓ,ε⁺∪S)，取最大分数边覆盖数。（2）提出基于单变量序的变量逐一消除算法 BuildEnumDS，为链表添加带标签与来源（provenance）的跳过链（skip link），并通过合并非包含重叠的跳过链实现常数延迟枚举。（3）对 k-环查询，通过将负边按度数 √m 划分为低/高两个子关系，使用不同变量序分别处理两个子实例，实现多变量序改进。

Result: 主要结果包括：（1）sfhw 严格推广 signed-acyclicity（sfhw=1 当且仅当 signed-acyclic）且在无否定查询上等价于 fhw；（2）任意 full CQ¬ 查询可用 O(|I|^sfhw) 预处理实现常数延迟枚举；（3）含至少一条负边的 k-环查询可通过多变量序达 O(|I|^{3/2}) 预处理时间；（4）sfhw 严格强于 β-fhw（对全负三角形查询 sfhw=2 而 β-fhw=3/2），并对一元正原子的查询 sfhw ≤ nsw。

Conclusion: 本文为带否定合取查询的常数延迟枚举建立了首个超越线性预处理时间边界的算法框架，通过引入 sfhw 宽度度量统一刻画了 signed-acyclicity 与分数超树宽度。算法核心在于利用单一共享变量序处理所有正完成图，并通过跳过链数据结构实现常数延迟。k-环查询的多变量序结果表明 sfhw 并非最优，多变量序的完整刻画（如类比于子模宽度）仍为未来工作。

Abstract: We study constant-delay enumeration for conjunctive queries with negation ($\texttt{CQ}^{\neg}$). Prior work defined \emph{signed-acyclicity}, which characterizes the class of queries where linear preprocessing time is achievable, but little has been known beyond this. We introduce a new hypergraph width measure for $\texttt{CQ}^{\neg}$, the \emph{signed fractional hypertree width} ($\textsf{sfhw}$), defined by requiring that a single variable order simultaneously handle every subset of the negative atoms. We show that $\textsf{sfhw}$ strictly generalizes signed-acyclicity (recovered when $\textsf{sfhw} = 1$) and fractional hypertree width (recovered on queries without negation). Our main algorithmic result is a variable-elimination algorithm that achieves constant-delay enumeration on input $I$ for any full $\texttt{CQ}^{\neg}$ query with preprocessing time $O(|I|^{\textsf{sfhw}})$. We further show that using multiple variable orders can improve this bound, exhibiting an $O(|I|^{3/2})$ algorithm for $k$-cycle queries with at least one negative edge.

</details>


### [605] [A Vision for a Logic-Based Workflow Formulation Framework and an Agentic Execution Pipeline for Pattern Engineering](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.04077)
*Alankrit Moses,Raghav Mittal,Gautam Das,Chengkai Li*

Main category: cs.DB

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于逻辑的类型化框架，用于表示数据中的结构化行为模式（patterns）及其操作，并将其组合成工作流。该框架借鉴Datalog的声明式结构，将每个模式表示为数学定义（M）、文本描述（T）和示例集（E）三个固定组件。模式操作被表达为查询（queries），通过指定输入和输出组件来定义，无需规定执行方式。文章同时实例化了一个基于LLM的智能体执行器（包含编排器和三个专家组件代理），并在WIPO专利数据上对两种时间模式（轨迹偏移和增长分歧）评估了三种查询：示例挖掘、示例对齐和模式归纳。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 数据分析越来越依赖从数据中提取结构性洞察（即"模式"），但目前缺乏一个系统化的框架来组织这类工作流。分析师通常需要手工设计每个工作流，且现有系统只能自动化特定的分析目标，无法以通用的、可组合的形式表示模式操作。这导致模式工程（pattern engineering）成为一项耗时且难以复用的人工活动。

Method: 方法包含两个核心部分：(1) **类型化框架**：受Datalog启发，将数据表示为(D.text, D.tab)二元组，将模式表示为P:(M, T, E)三元组。查询通过指定哪些组件作为输入（具名）、哪些作为输出（用?标记）、哪些匿名（用_标记）来定义，支持链式组合形成工作流。(2) **基于LLM的智能体执行器**：采用黑板架构，包含编排器（orchestrator）协调M-Inducer、T-Inducer、e.text-finder三个组件专家代理（以及内部的e.text-selector），通过共享黑板状态进行多步规划与执行。

Result: 在四个LLM设置（GPT-4.1、GPT-OSS-120B高/中等推理、GPT-5.6-Luna）下评估了Q1（示例挖掘）、Q2（示例对齐）、Q3（模式归纳）三种查询。结果显示：(1) GPT-5.6-Luna在面向e.text的任务（Q1、Q2）上表现最佳；(2) GPT-4.1在归纳任务（Q3的M和T）上领先；(3) 不同模型在按目标组件划分时表现差异显著；(4) 执行轨迹显示编排器经常通过引入中间组件（如M̂或T̂）来组合多步执行，并能定位失败发生的具体阶段（如选择阶段vs归纳阶段）。

Conclusion: 该框架能够表达、且执行器能够执行多种模式工程任务，跨模型后端具有可行性。框架的类型化组件结构也可作为诊断工具，用于按组件分析模型性能，从而指导模型路由、推理预算分配和专业化。未来工作需扩展至视觉等更多模态，引入e.tab专家代理，增加模式库和领域覆盖，并通过受控消融验证类型化分解的贡献。

Abstract: Organizations increasingly depend on insights drawn from data to inform consequential decisions. Many concern structural behaviors, which we call patterns. Producing them may require working with multiple pattern types, performing different operations over them, and composing those operations into workflows, an activity we call pattern engineering. No principled framework exists for organizing such workflows: analysts devise each by hand, and existing systems automate particular analytical objectives rather than representing pattern operations in a general, composable form. We introduce a typed framework that represents each pattern through a fixed set of modular components, and expresses pattern operations as queries which specify input and output components. Chaining queries composes workflows, while execution of any individual query remains unconstrained. We instantiate the framework with an LLM-based agentic executor and evaluate example-mining, example-alignment, and pattern-induction queries over two temporal patterns, using World Intellectual Property Organization (WIPO) reports and patent data. All three queries are carried out across four LLM settings, which perform differently by target component, while the traces allow us to localize errors by execution stage.

</details>


### [606] [A Fine-Grained Dichotomy for Bounded-Variable Query Evaluation: The Calculus of Relations, a Boolean Modal Logic, and One-Variable Counting Logic](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.04573)
*Yoshiki Nakamura,Yuya Uezato*

Main category: cs.DB

TL;DR: 本文针对有界变量一阶查询在稀疏关系结构上的求值问题，给出了细粒度的二分类定理。对每个固定的 k≥2、关系签名 S 以及介于 k-变量原始正 (PP^k) 和一阶 (FO^k) 之间的任何片段，在稀疏 MAX-3-SAT 假设下证明了 O(m^{k-ε}) 时间内的求值二分类。可处理情形恰好落入三类家族：(1) 三变量片段；(2) 两变量片段；(3) 一元签名上的片段。在难的一面，对每个固定的 k≥4 和 ε>0，存在 PP^k 中的一个关于单一二元关系符号的固定句子，其求值不能在 O(m^{k-ε}) 时间内完成。对于可处理情形，求值可在 2^{O(|φ|)}·m^{k-ε} 时间内完成。每个可处理的有界变量片段都约化到三种查询语言之一：(1) Tarski 的关系演算 (CoR)；(2) 一种用于稀疏模型检查的新型布尔模态逻辑 ML^⋆；(3) 单变量计数逻辑 C^1。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 有界变量一阶查询的求值复杂度在稠密设置中已有广泛研究，但在稀疏设置中缺乏完整分类。稠密设置下已知 (k,r)-超团假设下的 m^k 障碍，但稠密到稀疏的归约在稀疏设置下不保留稀疏性。Sparse MAX-q-SAT 假设是稀疏细粒度复杂性的核心假设，该工作建立稀疏 MAX-3-SAT 假设与有界变量一阶查询稀疏求值复杂度之间的完整联系，填补了理论空白。

Method: 技术方法分为三大部分：(1) 稀疏保持的硬度归约：从 Sparse MAX-(k-1)-SAT 经 OV-HyperClique 和分割列表技巧归约到 PP^k[(0,1)] 求值；将一元和二元关系编码到单一二元关系中。(2) FO^3 上界：通过投影和"保护配对"将最大元数降至 2，再利用 Tarski 关系演算 (CoR)，利用矩阵乘法实现 2^{O(|φ|)}·m^ω 时间算法。(3) FO^2 上界：设计新布尔模态逻辑 ML^⋆（无项补的差运算 ML^{¬,∩,∪,-,id} 变体），具有 O(|φ|·m) 线性时间求值算法。引入"类型"方法实现 FO^k 到 C^1 的 2^{O(|φ|)}·m 归约。

Result: 主要结果：(1) 稀疏二分类定理：当 k≤3 或签名一元时，片段可在 2^{O(|φ|)}·m^{k-ε} 时间内求值；当 k≥4 且 ar S≥2 时，假设 Sparse MAX-(k-1)-SAT 下不存在 O(m^{k-ε}) 算法。(2) FO^3：2^{O(|φ|)}·m^ω 算法。(3) FO^2：2^{O(|φ|)}·m 算法。(4) 一元：2^{O(|φ|)}·m 算法。(5) k=3 的 m^ω 障碍匹配上界。(6) 稠密设置对应二分类定理。(7) 固定模式图同态问题的 m^k 稀疏障碍。(8) CoR/ML^⋆/C^1 之间紧凑归约及无多项式翻译的障碍结果。

Conclusion: 该工作完整刻画了有界变量一阶查询在稀疏关系结构上的细粒度复杂度二分类。三个关键语言（CoR、ML^⋆、C^1）分别对应三元、二元、一元情形，形成统一且优雅的理论框架。提出的"保护配对"技术是处理嵌套量词的创新方法，新型模态逻辑 ML^⋆ 设计避免了项补导致的稠密性问题。固定句子（非 ε-依赖）的硬度结果仍为开放问题。从 PP^k 到单二元关系的稀疏保持编码、以及 OV-HyperClique 的稀疏保持归约，对未来细粒度复杂度、图同态、数据库理论均有重要影响。

Abstract: We study the fine-grained complexity of evaluating Boolean bounded-variable first-order queries over sparse relational structures. For every fixed $k \ge 2$, every relational signature, and every fragment between $k$-variable primitive positive ($\mathrm{PP}^{k}$) and first-order ($\mathrm{FO}^{k}$) logic, we prove, assuming the Sparse MAX-$3$-SAT hypothesis, a dichotomy theorem for evaluation in $O(m^{k-\varepsilon})$ time, where $m$ is the number of tuples in the input structure. The only tractable cases fall into three families: (1) three-variable fragments, (2) two-variable fragments, and (3) fragments over unary signatures. On the hard side, for every fixed $k \ge 4$ and every $\varepsilon > 0$, there is a fixed sentence $\varphi_\varepsilon$ in $\mathrm{PP}^{k}$ over a single binary relation symbol, depending on $\varepsilon$ but not on the input structure, whose evaluation cannot be performed in $O(m^{k-\varepsilon})$ time. For the tractable cases, we show that the evaluation problem can be solved in $2^{O(|\varphi|)} \cdot m^{k-\varepsilon}$ time for some $\varepsilon > 0$. Moreover, every tractable fragment reduces, with a $2^{O(|\varphi|)}$ blowup in formula size under DAG representations, to one of the following query languages: (1) Tarski's calculus of relations, (2) a new Boolean modal logic for sparse model checking, and (3) one-variable counting logic.

</details>


### [607] [Guanaco: A Global-Uniformity Algorithm for Near-Submodular-Width Conjunctive Query Evaluation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05440)
*Mahmoud Abo Khamis,Hubie Chen*

Main category: cs.DB

TL;DR: 本文提出Guanaco算法,用于合取查询求值,可在本质上达到次模宽度(submodular width)的多项式时间。对于每个布尔合取查询和任意正ε,算法运行时间为O(N^{subw(H)+ε}),且可自然推广到一般合取查询。布尔情形下,算法通过交错使用三个简单原语实现:一致性建立、全局均匀性建立(控制平均度与最大度差异的关系划分)、以及关系对的连接操作。相比PANDA和Jaguar等算法,Guanaco显著更简单,不依赖信息论、LP对偶或次概率测度等工具,但仅以输入数据库大小N为参数,尚未处理任意度约束。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 合取查询求值是数据库与理论计算机科学中的核心问题,其细粒度复杂度研究旨在刻画每个查询可达到的最小多项式时间指数。虽然已知次模宽度(submodular width)是组合算法可达到的最小已知指数上界,但现有达到该上界的算法(如PANDA、Jaguar等)较为复杂,依赖信息论、LP对偶和次概率测度等高级工具。本文旨在提出一个显著更简单的算法,同时达到次模宽度加任意小ε的运行时间,从而提供该结果的一个简单易懂的论证。

Method: 方法包含一个核心子例程Cleanup和一个主算法Guanaco。(1) Cleanup子例程:输入配置C和参数(M,ε),通过递归交替执行π-一致性建立(等价于半连接规约,利用Horn子句最小权满足赋值实现)和(M,ε)-均匀性建立(检测违反均匀性的对(S,T),将关系F_S按度数分为"轻"部分和"重"部分),最终输出一组代表C的(M,ε)-clean配置集合。证明使用势函数W^j = Σ log_M(maxdeg_{C^j}(T|S))分析递归深度上界为O(3^{|V|})。(2) Guanaco主算法:调用Cleanup后,对每个得到的(M,ε)-clean配置C',检测是否存在(M,w^+)-可实现对((S,T)满足S∪T未实现且|F_S|·maxdeg(T|S∩T) ≤ M^{w^+});若存在则连接F_S和F_T创建新关系F_{S∪T},并递归调用;否则寻找自由连通树分解并运行Yannakakis算法。关键引理(Lemma 5.2)证明:若配置C'无可实现对且为(M,ε)-clean,则存在满足特定性质的单调次模函数g,使得所有g(S)≤w的集合S都已在C'中实现,从而保证存在所需树分解。参数设置:w^+ = w(1+δ),ε = min((1-1/(1+δ))^4, 1/|V|^4),确保Cleanup势函数递减至少ε/2。

Result: 主要结果(定理5.4):固定超图H、X⊆V(H)和δ>0,对任何超图为H的输入配置C_0,Guanaco_{H,X,δ}(C_0)在O(N^{subw(H,X)+δ} + OUT)时间内正确返回Answers(C_0)↾X。在布尔情形下(X=∅),算法可简化为判定形式,只需返回yes/no。通过4-环查询示例说明:Guanaco在特定实例上达到O(N)运行时间,优于任一树分解下中间关系的Θ(N^2)大小,验证了算法的有效性。与现有算法比较:M=1的Berkholz-Schweikardt算法为O(N^{2·subw(H)+ε});PANDA为O(N^{subw(Q)}·polylog N);PANDAExpress为O(N^{subw(Q)}·log N);Jaguar为O(N^{subw(H)+ε}),Guanaco与Jaguar运行时间相同但更简单。

Conclusion: Guanaco提供了一个显著简化的算法框架,通过交错使用一致性建立、全局均匀性建立和连接三个基本原语,在次模宽度加δ的指数时间内完成合取查询求值。该算法不显式使用次模性或多拟阵引导执行过程,仅需知道次模宽度的固定值。其简洁性使其有望作为未来结合代数方法(如快速矩阵乘法)研究次模宽度相关算法的良好基础。然而,有两个开放问题:(1)能否去除指数中的额外δ>0(此弱点似乎源于"原始算法"在多拟阵空间中工作的固有局限,只有"对偶算法"如PANDA系列利用香农不等式空间绕过了此弱点);(2)能否将算法推广处理输入关系上的任意度约束(目前仅以输入数据库大小N为参数,而PANDA和Jaguar已能处理任意度约束)。

Abstract: We present Guanaco, an algorithm for performing conjunctive query evaluation where, for each Boolean conjunctive query, and positive epsilon, the algorithm achieves polynomial time with exponent equal to the submodular width plus epsilon. The algorithm and its running time generalize smoothly to general conjunctive queries. We believe the algorithm and its analysis to be notably simple, indeed, together we believe they form a highly simple argument that conjunctive query evaluation can be performed in essentially submodular width time. In the case of Boolean conjunctive queries, the algorithm is based on interleaving three simple primitives: a subroutine for establishing a form of consistency; a subroutine for establishing global uniformity, which, briefly speaking, partitions relations as needed to control discrepancies between average degree and maximum degree; and, a simple step that joins pairs of existing relations to form new relations.

</details>


### [608] [SALUS: Automated Auditing of NL-to-SQL Benchmarks through Weak Supervision of Multi-Agent Output](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05540)
*Shiyuan Zhou,Ashwin Gerard Colaco,Sainyam Galhotra,Sharad Mehrotra*

Main category: cs.DB

TL;DR: SALUS是一个自动审计NL-to-SQL基准测试集中标注错误的框架，通过多LLM代理弱监督方法检测BIRD和Spider等基准中的错误标注。系统在BIRD-Clean-xs上达到F1=0.9194，估计BIRD约有37%、Spider约有27%的标注错误率，并揭示这些错误导致排行榜排名在统计上无法可靠区分顶级系统。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 广泛使用的NL-to-SQL基准（如BIRD、Spider）存在大量标注错误，但排行榜依靠这些可能错误的"黄金"标注来评估和排名系统。当基准噪声超过竞争系统间的差距时，排行榜不再衡量其声称的内容，导致研究方向的误导和性能评估失真。现有的手动审查和半自动方法（如SQLDriller、SAPAR）要么不可扩展，要么依赖人工专家评审，无法解决根本问题。

Method: SALUS将基准审计构建为弱监督错误检测任务，包含三个核心组件：(1) 通过多个独立LLM代理生成候选SQL，提取执行、结构（AST级）和意图（NL-SQL对齐）三类互补信号形成44个标记函数；通过生成式标签模型（Snorkel）聚合噪声投票矩阵，产生高置信度伪标签用于下游训练。(2) 特征条件可靠性估计：从黄金SQL提取12维结构特征，为每个代理训练独立的可靠性模型（决策平面），学习"在何种查询类型上信任哪个代理"。(3) 集成聚合：通过可靠性加权投票、Top-k投票、堆叠元学习器或分数融合策略组合可靠性估计与原始代理判决。代理选自不同模型家族以减少相关性错误，并构建了BIRD-Clean-xs（298个任务，五类错误分类）作为人工验证的评估基准。

Result: 在BIRD-Clean-xs（298任务，166错误）上：SALUS达到F1=0.9194，显著优于多数投票（0.8895）、SAR-Agent（0.8389）、SQLDriller（0.6456）、弱标签（0.8896）和代理堆叠（0.9021）。Zero-Overlap设置下F1=0.8961仍为最强非oracle方法。在200任务随机样本上F1=0.8552。在LIMIT/DISTINCT错误集（n=71）上F1=0.9559，优于SAR-Agent（0.8992）和SQLDriller（0.7321）。配对bootstrap检验显示相对所有基线的改进均统计显著（p<0.025）。成本效率：Frontier配置每任务0.0332美元，比SQLDriller便宜1.4×、快9.8×；Legacy配置每任务0.0039美元。基准级错误率估计：BIRD开发集约37%（95% CI: [30%, 43%]），Spider开发集约27%（95% CI: [21%, 33%]）。领导者可信度分析：在37%错误率下，开发集上第一名与接下来20个系统的差距无法在95%置信度下可靠区分（阈值5.09%）。隐藏测试集与开发集的Kendall's τ=0.664高于期望值E[τ]=0.41，表明两个集合可能共享标注伪影。错误类型细分：Incorrect SQL召回率94.8%，Query Ambiguity 100%，Data Inconsistency 57.1%。消融研究显示移除任一信号源都会降低F1（结构-0.0436，执行-0.0365，意图-0.0170）。

Conclusion: SALUS确立了弱监督多代理框架作为NL-to-SQL基准审计的有效方法，其性能优于现有全自动方法且成本更低。37%的BIRD错误率表明当前NL-to-SQL排行榜在统计上无法可靠区分顶级系统，提示需要将基准审计作为发布门槛、优先审查被标记任务、维护已验证的干净子集并报告排名不确定性。弱监督架构可迁移到其他基准审计领域（如代码生成、数学推理），其中参考标注可能不可靠。自动纠错仍是一个未解决的问题——检测是必要前提但非充分条件，因为SALUS仅修复了44.0%的Incorrect SQL错误。

Abstract: Natural language to SQL (NL-to-SQL) benchmarks are foundational to progress in data analysis research, yet recent work has shown that widely-used benchmarks contain significant annotation errors. These errors silently corrupt evaluation metrics, penalize correct model output, and distort the field's understanding of state-of-the-art performance. We present SALUS, a system that automatically detects annotation errors in NL-to-SQL benchmarks. SALUS frames benchmark auditing as a weakly supervised error detection: SQL generated by multiple LLM agents drive a suite of complementary weak-labeling functions. By passing this noisy vote matrix through a generative label model, we extract high-confidence training samples without requiring human ground truth. These samples train a decision plane that maps gold SQL query features to per-agent trustworthiness, allowing SALUS to intelligently fuse reliability estimates with raw verdicts for rigorous benchmark error detection. We evaluate on BIRD-Clean-xs, a benchmark of 298 BIRD development tasks with manually verified correctness labels. SALUS achieves F1 = 0.9194, significantly outperforming the state-of-the-art baselines. Applying SALUS to the full development sets, we estimate annotation error rates of approximately 37% on BIRD and 27% on Spider.

</details>


### [609] [Protocol-Sensitive Evaluation of Log Anomaly Detection: Component Costs and Target-Access Sensitivity on HDFS and BGL](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.05807)
*Hang Xiao,Janet Sung,Zhaoyi Li,Gangzhen Qian,Chuhong Xu*

Main category: cs.DB

TL;DR: 该论文系统研究了评估协议选择对日志异常检测基准比较结论的影响，揭示了在固定检测器设置下，数据集划分方式、解析器选择、目标模板可见性以及组件级资源计量如何显著改变报告的精度排名与成本画像，强调了"分数必须附带协议字段"才能实现可解释的跨研究比较。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 公开日志异常检测基准（HDFS、BGL）虽被广泛复用，但不同研究采用不同的划分方式、预处理和可见信息设置，导致同一检测器在不同报告中的得分不可比。作者希望厘清：协议选择（而非检测器能力）在多大程度上驱动了基准结论的差异，并提供一组随分数一并报告的协议字段，使下游研究与运维团队能够进行协议感知的比较。

Method: 在统一实现下固定六种配置（Count/LR、Count/RF、Count/XGB、Sequence/LSTM、Semantic/LR、Semantic/XGB，即 Template2Vec 加权词向量）。围绕三个研究问题展开：(1) 划分协议——HDFS 采用分层随机划分与按 count-vector 分组的 group-disjoint 划分；BGL 采用随机划分与按时间顺序的 70/30 滚动划分；(2) 解析器与时间截止点敏感性——在 BGL 上用不同 Drain 相似度阈值与 Drain3 的固定 70/30 截止点，再以 50%/60%/70%/80% 为滚动起点评估下一 10%；(3) 跨系统目标目录可见性——2×2 因子设计（Word2vec 语料 source vs. union）×（IDF 来源 source vs. target），对 HDFS→BGL 与 BGL→HDFS 两个方向运行 XGBoost。指标包括 AP、F1，以及在 1% 与 5% 评审预算下的平局感知 P/R；成本按解析、表示拟合、特征变换、分类器训练与分类器推理分别计时，并报告序列化分类器大小；统一架构下用五个种子重复运行。

Result: HDFS 上随机划分将四种配置推至 AP≈1.000 的天花板；group-disjoint 划分后 Count/LR 跃居首位 (0.867±0.103)，而 LSTM 与 Semantic/XGB 仅约 0.625。BGL 上随机划分同样形成近天花板集群，但时间顺序划分下 Semantic/XGB 最高 (0.676±0.086)，Count/XGB 居次 (0.448)，LSTM 仅 0.236；离线将表示重训到完整模板目录可将该指标进一步推至 0.796。固定 70/30 截止点时，仅解析器选择就使 Semantic/XGB 的平均 AP 跨越 0.124（0.617–0.741），却未改变其对 Count/XGB 的领先；但在最早的滚动起点（50%→60%），Count/XGB 反超 Semantic/XGB（0.902 vs. 0.838）。跨系统消融中，HDFS→BGL 的 XGBoost 平均 AP 由 source-only 的 0.191 提升至 union-corpus + target-IDF 的 0.325，而 BGL→HDFS 的对应变化为 0.089→0.142，但中间单元格在两个方向上表现出方向依赖的相互作用（BGL→HDFS 的 union-corpus + source-IDF 反而跌至 0.039）。组件级画像显示 HDFS 的 Count/LR 在分类器推理阶段可达 6.77 M sessions/s，BGL 的 Semantic/XGB 也达 505 k/s，但 LSTM 训练时间约 309 秒，原始 BGL 解析增加 54 秒。

Conclusion: 协议维度——划分构造、解析器状态、模板目录可见性、评审预算与组件级成本边界——会系统性地改变六种固定配置的相对排名与资源画像。论文主张：每一个检测精度分数都应附带这些协议字段，否则跨论文基准对比容易得出错误结论；并呼吁在公开基准复现包中纳入划分索引、逐种子预测与表格生成脚本，以支持协议感知的可解释比较。

Abstract: Protocol choices can change the conclusions drawn from log anomaly detection benchmarks even when detector settings are fixed. We present a joint empirical study of split construction, representation visibility, and component costs using six fixed count, sequence, and semantic configurations on Hadoop Distributed File System (HDFS) and Blue Gene/L (BGL) logs. Random splits place several configurations near the average-precision ceiling, whereas group-disjoint HDFS and chronological BGL evaluation produce lower scores and different observed orderings. At a fixed BGL cutoff, parser choice spans 0.124 in semantic XGBoost mean average precision while preserving its lead over count XGBoost; the earliest rolling period reverses that ordering. A two-factor cross-system ablation contrasts source-only representations with offline transductive access to unlabeled target templates through the representation corpus and inverse document frequency: HDFS-to-BGL mean average precision moves from 0.191 with source-only access to 0.325 with union-corpus, target-IDF access, and the intermediate conditions reveal direction-dependent interactions in average precision and retrieval at fixed review budgets. Component-level profiling separates parsing and representation costs from classifier training, prediction, and storage. Together, these findings connect detector comparisons to the test population, preprocessing state, visible information, and measured pipeline stages, and identify the protocol fields needed alongside a score to support interpretable comparisons of log anomaly detection accuracy and resource use.

</details>


<div id='cs.AI'></div>

# cs.AI [[Back]](#toc)

### [610] [Training Numerical Intelligence via Auto-Diagnosis and Skill Discovery](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03872)
*Peter Chen,Wotao Yin*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出ADSD框架，采用"先诊断、再发现"范式，将求解器可观测行为转化为经验证的数值条件假设与可复用求解器技能，在四个数值领域上显著提升LLM生成求解器的精度、鲁棒性和泛化能力，且无需更新模型权重。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有科学代码智能体只能依据执行反馈进行试错式修改，或用宽泛关键词检索文献，无法诊断数值失败的根因并将症状对应到合适的数值技术，导致同一症状背后不同病理难以区分，限制了求解器自改进的效果。

Method: 两阶段框架：(1)自动诊断——冻结基线求解器N₀，收集其在公共测试用例上的执行轨迹，从文献中抽取"症状—条件"诊断技能并构造可执行探测器，通过分轮假设+验证池(>90%通过率)获得经验证的数值条件假设ℋ；(2)技能发现——以ℋ为指导检索文献方法，校验理论假设与N₀的兼容性，复现实验结果后将方法打包为可执行技能包，提供给同一智能体生成改进求解器B。流水线明确分离"观测行为→诊断条件→检索知识→实现技能"四个阶段。

Result: 在功率流方程(±71×误差缩减)、AC最优潮流控制(边界负荷下Qwen基线通过率从14.42%→98.36%)、刚性常微分方程(GPT通过率70.1%→90.6%)、异质扩散偏微分方程(Qwen算子调用从86.81→17.57)四个领域、三个基模型(GPT-5.5/Claude-Sonnet-5/Qwen3.8-2.4T)上均一致提升精度、鲁棒性与效率；技能可零样本迁移至未见拓扑(N1/N)、未见可行性(IF)场景；消融实验表明单纯自我修订或5轮递归自改进均无法缩小性能鸿沟，证明诊断引导是关键。

Conclusion: 诊断是将可观测求解器行为与可执行数值知识衔接的关键机制；ADSD提供了一条无需更新模型权重、面向科学计算智能体的实用自监督自改进路径，将经验证的数值条件与文献来源的可执行技能作为可复用资产累积，未来可与强化学习/语言对齐结合扩展到更广泛的领域。

Abstract: AI agents are becoming increasingly capable of generating scientific code, but generating code is not the same as improving the algorithms behind it. For numerical solvers, execution feedback can expose poor performance, but rarely reveals its underlying cause and how to address it. We introduce Auto-Diagnosis and Skill Discovery (ADSD), a framework that links numerical diagnosis to reusable solver self-improvement. ADSD follows a diagnosis-first paradigm that first explains why a solver performs poorly, then uses this diagnosis to guide the discovery of appropriate numerical methods. The resulting knowledge is packaged into reusable solver skills, turning solver improvement from trial-and-error editing into a structured process of diagnosis, discovery, and implementation. Across four challenging numerical domains--power flow equation, AC optimal power flow control, stiff ordinary differential equations, and heterogeneous diffusion PDEs--ADSD consistently improves solver accuracy, robustness, and efficiency. On GOC-500 power flow, for example, ADSD reduces mean solver error by nearly $71\times$, with improvements further transferring to unseen grid topologies and operating regimes.

</details>


### [611] [REACT: Physically and Chemically Consistent Reconstruction of Marine Active Tracers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03888)
*Wenbin Dai,Hao Zheng,Shiyu Liang,Chaofan Sun,Xueying Zhang,Hanbo Huang,Xuan Gong,Yiran Zhang,Enhui Liao*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出REACT框架，针对海洋pH重建中被动示踪剂假设与碳酸盐系统主动示踪剂特性不匹配的问题，采用"碳优先"策略：传输潜在碳状态而非pH本身，通过源模块修正非保守碳循环变化，并在碳酸盐平衡约束下解码pH，从而同时保证pH精度与化学一致性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 全球海表pH观测极度稀疏（仅覆盖0.11%网格），且pH是碳酸盐系统的主动示踪剂——预测目标是pH，但守恒量是溶解无机碳（DIC）。传统方法将pH作为被动示踪剂传输，会导致低pH误差却违反碳酸盐闭合与碳守恒。需要一种能区分保守传输与非保守碳循环源、并在底层碳状态上保证一致性的重建框架。

Method: REACT（REconstructing Active Carbonate Tracers）框架包含三大耦合组件：（1）潜在碳酸盐状态初始化（基于ViViT时空Transformer从稀疏pH、pCO2观测与辅助变量估计初始碳相关状态z₀）；（2）保守传输模块（通过源-free平流-扩散方程∂_t z + ∇·(uz) - ∇·(K_θ∇z)=0传输碳状态，保证DIC质量守恒）；（3）主动源修正与化学解码（U-Net预测非保守源修正s_t，修正后状态z̃_t经解码器G_θ在碳酸盐平衡常数K₁、K₂约束下映射为pH）。训练目标结合pH监督损失、化学闭合损失与物理守恒损失。理论证明：当化学与物理损失为零时，REACT可同时保证碳酸盐闭合与DIC质量守恒，而被动pH传输无法提供该保证（因pH到DIC的非线性映射使pH质量守恒不蕴含DIC质量守恒）。

Result: 在MOM6-COBALTv2模拟数据上，REACT在月→周与周→日跨时间尺度重建任务上全面优于7类基线（Kriging、U-Net、ViT、FNO、Marble、Prithvi WxC、AtmoRep、4DVarNet、NUTS）：pH NRMSE降低3.00%–14.7%，化学一致性误差降低18.5%–25.4%。在真实稀疏观测（WOD pH + SOCAT pCO2）上，pH NRMSE降低约7.57%，化学一致性提升约9.73%。消融实验验证：源模块将月→周pH误差从4.08×10⁻³降至5.79×10⁻⁴；质量约束将局部漂移从8.84‰降至2.26‰；化学约束将Chem.从1.94×10⁻²降至1.59×10⁻²。设计选择分析表明：12层ViViT初始化器、4层U-Net源/解码器、pCO2为最重要辅助变量。

Conclusion: REACT通过将保守PDE约束置于潜在碳状态而非pH本身，同时在解码端施加碳酸盐平衡闭合，成功解决了海洋主动示踪剂重建中预测变量与守恒量不匹配的结构性问题。该框架在pH精度与化学一致性上同时取得最优，且对真实稀疏观测具有良好泛化能力。未来可拓展至其他海洋主动示踪剂及三维碳海洋场重建。

Abstract: Reconstructing global sea surface pH from sparse observations is critical for monitoring ocean acidification and understanding marine carbon cycling. Traditional assimilation and inverse models are physically grounded but costly for large-scale reconstruction. Recent black-box and physics-guided AI models improve efficiency, but are mainly designed for passive tracers, where the reconstructed variable is also the transported inventory. In contrast, pH is an active carbonate tracer: it is the prediction target, while dissolved inorganic carbon (DIC) is the conserved carbon inventory. This mismatch can produce low pH error while violating carbonate closure and source-free carbon conservation. To address this, we introduce \textbf{REACT}, a carbon-first reconstruction framework that decouples transport, active correction, and chemical decoding. REACT transports a latent carbonate state with a conservative advection--diffusion solver, captures non-conservative carbon-cycle variations with a source module, decodes the corrected state into pH, and constrains the output through carbonate equilibrium. This design keeps pH as the target while enforcing consistency on the underlying carbon state. On simulation data, REACT reduces pH NRMSE by (14.7%) and chemical consistency error by (24.0%) over the best baseline. Cross-temporal-scale evaluations show robustness against error accumulation from coarse to fine temporal scales, and ablation studies validate the effectiveness of each component.

</details>


### [612] [Proxy Confidence: Auditing Black-Box LLM Agents with a Surrogate's Log-Probabilities](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03894)
*Yikai Zhao,Saurabh Pandey,Pradeep Kumar Misra*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出"代理置信度"(Proxy Confidence)方法，利用低成本开源代理模型并行读取黑盒LLM Agent的(上下文、模式、动作)三元组，通过其自身对数概率为工具调用和代码生成生成可信赖的置信度评分，包含四种互补读出方式(判决/Teacher Forcing/Request-PMI/工具选择竞争)。在困难编码任务中AUROC达0.825(actor自评仅0.598)，可驱动实时门控和置信度反馈两种部署模式。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 前沿LLM Agent通过聊天API部署时，存在三大盲区：(1) Actor 内部token概率被API隐藏；(2) Actor 语言化自评在最关键的"自信错误"上几乎无效；(3) 因前沿模型近确定性，自一致性(Self-Consistency)采样失效。需要一种无需访问Actor内部、训练免费、低成本的可部署审计方法。

Method: 核心是"代理置信度侧车"架构：一个小的开源可读logprox模型S，并行读取(上下文、工具模式、动作)，通过单次前向填充(预填充)输出标量置信度。四种互补读出：(1)判决P(YES) - 判别式，捕捉整体正确性；(2)Teacher Forcing (TF) - 生成式，定位错误参数值；(3)Request-PMI - 生成式，扣减先验，衡量参数值在请求中的依据度；(4)工具选择竞争 - 判别式，测试函数选择。核心原则：生成式似然定位参数值错误，判决捕捉整体错误；误差位置未知时定向融合为低遗憾默认。TF为"访问有界"(14B与32B等价)，判决为"能力有界"(需更大模型)。

Result: vs Actor自评：硬编码任务AUROC 0.825 vs 0.598(+0.213)；xLAM上对3个非A族演员提升+0.07至+0.28。vs自一致性：近确定性Actor上提升+0.14至+0.19，成本仅1/K。Mode A(选择性预测)：50%覆盖率下接受动作精度提升+0.05至+0.30。Mode B(置信度反馈)：nl2bash端到端任务成功率+0.119(p≤10⁻⁴)，AppWorld +0.137(p<10⁻⁴)；但仅在步骤错误"静默"时(如nl2bash)真正依赖读数内容，AppWorld中随机值控制同样有效。定向融合将最坏情况遗憾降至0.019(单信号策略约0.17-0.18)。

Conclusion: 代理logprox信号在三个互不相关的Actor家族(无共享权重)、多种动作类型上通用预测正确性，且在Actor自评最盲目的"自信错误"处优势最大。该方法不是通用预言机，而是随Actor错误率增长而获益增强的护栏，作用于正确性可通过读取动作脱口可判定的范围内。Mode B需配合随机值控制以区分"任何标量"与"读数内容"。其局限性包括：误差符号方向需在留出数据上拟合；判定的第二个混合的闭源前沿家族未测试；Mode B在错误已被环境暴露时失效。

Abstract: A deployed LLM agent emits tool calls, queries, and code that can be silently wrong -- by the time the error surfaces, the action has run. Frontier chat APIs hide the model's token probabilities; the agent's stated confidence barely beats chance on the mistakes that matter; and resampling does not help, since frontier models are highly repetitive, reproducing the same call across samples. We recover the missing signal from a low-cost open-weight surrogate run in parallel. It reads the same context, schema, and proposed action as the agent, then scores the call from its own log-probabilities through a family of complementary readouts: teacher forcing and request-PMI weigh the likelihood of each argument value, a discriminative verdict judges the call as a whole, and tool-choice competition tests the function against its siblings. One principle says which to trust: a generative likelihood localizes wrong argument values, while the verdict catches holistically wrong calls. When the error type is unknown, an ensemble is the low-regret default. The readout is training-free, needs no access to the agent's internals, and costs one prefill pass alongside the tool call. On difficult coding tasks it reaches AUROC 0.825 where the actor's stated confidence is near chance (0.598), and the generative readouts beat it by +0.07 to +0.28 across three further actors. Against self-consistency it gains +0.14 to +0.19 on near-deterministic actors, at 1/K the cost. The signal drives two deployment modes: a real-time gate escalating the least-trustworthy calls for review (+0.05 to +0.30 accepted-action accuracy at 50% coverage), and confidence feedback, returning the tool result with the score so the agent adapts its next step -- lifting task success on live-execution benchmarks (+0.119 and +0.137, p <= 1e-4) and beating a random-value control where step errors are silent (+0.078, p = 0.003).

</details>


### [613] [SGAnalog: An End-to-End Circuit Benchmark from Open-Source Silicon Tapeouts](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03934)
*Yueting Li,Weihang Ding*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文介绍了一个名为SGAnalog（silicon-grade analog）的端到端模拟集成电路设计基准测试，基于开源Tiny Tapeout流片项目构建，包含273个拓扑唯一的电路，覆盖原理图转网表（transcription）和器件尺寸设计（sizing）两项任务，旨在区分模型泛化能力与记忆能力，并提供可执行的仿真参考。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有模拟电路基准测试存在两方面问题：一是无法判断模型是否真正学到了可迁移的电路技能还是仅仅回忆了见过的例子；二是缺少在确定的工艺和测试条件下验证输出功能性的手段。基于教科书的图集容易被模型在预训练中接触过，而缺乏PDK和测试平台的基准无法验证电路实际工作性能。

Method: 从Tiny Tapeout的27次MPW shuttle中，使用容器化流水线（IIC-OSIC-TOOLS镜像，固定sha256）在pinned commit版本提取电路数据。每个原理图.sch文件同时导出渲染图和SPICE网表，确保图像与网表的精确结构对应。使用Weisfeiler-Lehman哈希对器件-网表二部图去重，得到273个拓扑唯一的设计。Task 1（transcription）通过图同构、structural F1和W/L精度评分；Task 2（sizing）使用ngspice在作者原始testbench中以模型/人工输出比值评分。暴露控制包括commit日期对比模型训练截止时间、去除author标签的盲化渲染、BIG-bench canary、闭书评估协议。

Result: 在7个模型（claude-fable-5, claude-opus-5, gpt-5.6-sol, gemini-3.1-pro-preview, claude-sonnet-5, gpt-5, claude-haiku-4-5）上：transcription任务最强模型claude-fable-5达到56.1%精确图同构率，6/7模型从small到medium tier断崖下降；盲化渲染使claude-opus-5的精确匹配率从51.5%降至36.4%，但structural F1不变。sizing任务上gemini-3.1-pro-preview收敛全部17个任务并达到91.2/100分；而最新的claude-opus-5和claude-fable-5分别拒绝4和14个prompt（transcribe任务中无拒绝），属于policy限制而非能力限制。两个任务产生不同的模型排序。

Conclusion: SGAnalog首次以人教版、可执行、可追溯的模拟电路构建了一个能同时评估结构识别和容量预算的端到端基准测试。两项任务暴露了不同的能力维度：transcription测试视觉读取与连接追踪，sizing测试设计知识与仿真调谐。基准测试通过commit日期、盲化渲染、闭书协议等多种机制来探测和降低暴露风险，并通过每年新shuttle提供持续更新。代码和数据以Apache-2.0发布在GitHub。

Abstract: Existing analog integrated circuit design benchmarks make two questions hard to answer: whether a model has learned transferable circuit skills rather than recalled familiar examples, and whether its output works under defined process and test conditions. We introduce a benchmark built from human-designed, open-source circuits associated with Tiny Tapeout manufacturing shuttles. The collection contains 273 topologically distinct top-level designs. Every source is retrieved at the revision recorded for its shuttle submission and processed in a fixed containerized environment. The pipeline exports each eligible schematic image and its SPICE netlist from the same source file, giving transcription an exact structural reference. Commit dates support model-specific training-cutoff analysis, while author testbenches provide the simulation context for sizing. The benchmark evaluates schematic-to-netlist transcription and device sizing. Across seven models on a fixed set of 66 transcription tasks, the strongest model reaches 56.1% exact graph isomorphism, and six of seven models drop sharply from the small to the medium tier. For one frontier model, removing author-chosen labels reduces exact matches while preserving aggregate structural F1, suggesting that labels can aid connectivity tracing. On the 17 sizing tasks, the leading model converges on all 17 proposals and reaches 91.2 out of 100 against the human reference, while the two newest Claude models refuse 4 and 11 of the same prompts they transcribe without objection; a proposal without sizes scores zero. The two tasks produce different model rankings, exposing distinct visual and design capabilities and, in one family, a policy rather than capability limit.

</details>


### [614] [MLLMs Fail to Refuse when Using Tools Agentically](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03938)
*Rikiya Takehi,Ryo Hachiuma,Shaona Ghosh,Dan Zhao,Yu-Chiang Frank Wang,Yusuke Hirota*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该研究揭示了智能体多模态大语言模型（agentic MLLMs）在使用工具（如缩放、标注、OCR、代码解释器）时，相较于非工具设置，会显著降低其拒绝有害请求的能力。通过在三个主流安全基准（MM-SafetyBench、VLSBench、HoliSafe）上对11个模型进行测试，发现工具使用使相对拒绝失败率（RFR）最多增加68.7%，且该现象在开源与闭源模型中均普遍存在。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着多模态大语言模型（MLLM）越来越多地采用智能体工具调用范式（如缩放、OCR等）来增强视觉推理能力，安全性研究主要集中在智能体特定场景（如GUI导航、内存注入攻击）上，但工具调用机制本身是否会削弱模型拒绝有害请求的能力这一基础问题尚未得到系统研究。

Method: 研究在三个多模态安全基准（MM-SafetyBench、VLSBench、HoliSafe）上对比测试了11个MLLM（包括开源与闭源模型）在无工具设置与基于ReAct的工具使用设置下的拒绝失败率（RFR），并使用GPT-5.2作为LLM评判器（与人类标注一致性达97%）。进一步通过：(1) 分析工具调用次数与RFR的相关性；(2) 在最终回答前重新注入原始请求和图像；(3) 使用"假缩放"工具控制变量；(4) 2×2提示词消融；(5) 验证原生智能体视觉系统；(6) 分析最终回答起始句的焦点分类等方法探究安全性下降的原因。

Result: 1. 工具使用使所有测试模型的RFR均上升，平均相对增加17.7%（绝对增加5.7），最高达68.7%；2. 拒绝失败率随工具调用次数增加而上升，支持"上下文稀释"假设；3. 重新注入原始请求和图像可使RFR平均降低7.6%，证实上下文稀释效应；4. 工具使用使模型更倾向于以"观察摘要"（52.3%）而非"安全声明"（10.3%）开始回答，证实"安全焦点转移"假设；5. 假缩放工具与真实缩放工具产生相似的RFR，说明问题源于工具调用行为本身而非工具输出内容；6. 提示词结构的影响很小（最多+0.5 RFR），证实安全性下降与工具使用范式本身直接相关；7. 原生智能体视觉系统（Gemini-3-Flash Agentic Vision）同样表现出+15.2的平均RFR增加，证明该问题并非外部ReAct框架的伪影。

Conclusion: 工具使用范式本身会系统性地削弱MLLM拒绝有害请求的能力，这一现象源于两个结构性机制：(1) 上下文稀释——工具观测结果的累积使原始有害意图变得不再显著；(2) 安全焦点转移——模型倾向于优先描述工具观测结果而非进行安全判断。重新注入原始请求和图像是一种简单可行的缓解方法。工具使用应被视为安全相关的设计选择，而非仅仅是能力增强机制，未来的智能体MLLM应在工具使用条件下进行评估和训练，不能假设无工具安全对齐可直接迁移到智能体场景。

Abstract: Agentic multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have recently pushed the frontier of visual reasoning by calling tools such as zooming and tagging. Despite the recent strong success of agentic MLLMs, this work uncovers a critical safety failure in the tool-use paradigm: agentic tool-using MLLMs become less capable of refusing harmful requests. Our experiments confirm that, across three popular safety benchmarks, all the top open- and closed-weight MLLMs we test exhibit significantly lower safety in tool-using settings than in non-tool settings, with a relative refusal failure rate increase of up to 68.7%. Based on analysis of 100,000+ responses, including extended experiments, we also propose two possible reasons for this safety degradation.

</details>


### [615] [Retrieval-Augmented Large Language Model Decision-Making for Autonomous Driving Guided by Chinese Philosophical Wisdom](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03948)
*Xiaojun Bi,Xiaoyuan Ma,Yiwen Sun,Tianren Huang,Chaoran Liu,Bokai Huang,Hao Yang,Baichuan Mo*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: CPW-Drive是一个基于RAG的闭环LLM自动驾驶决策框架，将儒家哲学价值引导融入驾驶决策。从131部儒家经典中提取10条驾驶相关价值原则（如仁、礼、智等），结合场景化历史案例构建知识库；并提出物理感知空间相似度检索（PSSR），基于车辆空间布局与速度外推状态检索相似历史案例。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有自动驾驶决策方法（数值优化、序列预测、LLM）鲜少显式编码社会规范和哲学伦理考量，难以在复杂交通交互中平衡安全、效率与社会礼仪。文化根基的哲学原则如何被表示为可重用的场景级驾驶示例尚未被研究。

Method: 1) 从131部儒家经典中提取40个高频关键词，由哲学博士手动筛选整合为10条驾驶相关价值原则（智、义、敬、达、仁、勇、中、礼、忠、信）；2) 构建包含135条历史驾驶案例的知识库（场景+价值原则+推理过程+动作），全部经人工审核；3) 提出PSSR，受SOAP启发，采用各向异性二维高斯密度描述车辆位置，同时考虑当前空间状态和速度外推状态（Δt=1s），通过加权相似度检索Top-3案例；4) 在Highway-env的highway-v0多车道任务上，使用DeepSeek-V4-Pro作为LLM推理引擎。

Result: 在三种交通配置（4车道密度2.0、5车道密度2.5、5车道密度3.0）下，CPW-Drive成功率分别为93.0%、86.0%、72.0%，超越最强基线8.0、22.5、25.0个百分点；碰撞自由步数（CFS）也最优，换道频率（LCF）较低，但效率分数（ES）低于最佳基线。消融实验验证了RAG、PSSR和哲学内容的贡献；PICACO第三方评估显示儒家价值契合度为4.40±0.60。平均端到端决策延迟约20秒，远未达到实时控制要求。

Conclusion: CPW-Drive证明了结构化哲学价值引导可改善闭环驾驶的安全性与稳定性，但存在效率与延迟权衡。未来工作将扩展至更多样化环境和更大知识库，并提升实时决策能力。

Abstract: Autonomous driving decision systems must balance safety, efficiency, and social norms in complex traffic interactions. Philosophical and ethical considerations have received limited attention in existing autonomous driving decision-making approaches based on numerical optimization, sequence prediction, and large language models (LLMs). We propose Chinese Philosophical Wisdom-Guided Driving (CPW-Drive), a closed-loop retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) framework that incorporates value guidance derived from Chinese philosophy into autonomous driving decision-making. Using Chinese Confucian thought as its knowledge source, CPW-Drive consolidates LLM-extracted keywords from relevant classical texts into driving-relevant value principles through manual screening and validation. It then contextualizes these principles through scenario-specific cases to form retrievable and reusable value guidance. We further propose Physics-aware Spatial Similarity Retrieval (PSSR), which compares vehicle layouts and velocity-extrapolated states to retrieve physically relevant historical cases. On Highway-env's multilane highway-driving task, CPW-Drive achieves success rates of 93.0%, 86.0%, and 72.0% across three traffic configurations. These results outperform the strongest baseline by 8.0, 22.5, and 25.0 percentage points, respectively. Across all configurations, CPW-Drive achieves the highest collision-free step count and maintains a low lane-change frequency. The results suggest that structured value guidance can improve simulated closed-loop safety and stability while introducing efficiency and latency trade-offs.

</details>


### [616] [LatentQuant: Preserving the Policy-Facing Latent Contract under NVFP4 VAE Quantization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03959)
*Ziye Deng,Lufang Chen,Shuyu Feng,Zhenwei Duan,Zicong Ye,Yu Sun,Xiaofan Li,Ruyi Gan,Hao Wang,Hao Zhang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出LatentQuant，一种用于视频VAE的NVFP4两阶段量化感知训练框架，旨在保留面向策略的潜在表征契约（policy-facing latent contract），解决联合QAT在重建质量良好但下游控制性能崩溃的问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在世界动作模型（WAM）中，预训练视频VAE的编码器潜变量被冻结的下游动作策略直接消费。传统量化以重建保真度为指标，但重建质量的保持并不保证潜表征与冻结策略的兼容性——联合QAT可在VBench上几乎无损，却使LIBERO成功率从95.5%崩溃至10.5%。该现象暴露出"重建中心"量化的根本缺陷。

Method: （1）形式化"policy-facing latent contract"：编码器输出须与高精度参考对齐，而不仅是重建保真。（2）机制分析：通过控制实验揭示解码器激活QDQ改变重建信号与解码器Jacobian，重定向传给编码器的梯度，造成持久潜变量漂移。（3）两阶段LatentQuant框架：Stage I用通道归一化的样本级对齐损失将量化编码器锚定到高精度参考；Stage II冻结对齐后的编码器，仅用组合重建损失（MSE+Sobel+LPIPS）适配解码器。（4）在NVIDIA B300上实现原生packed-NVFP4卷积后端。

Result: 在Wan2.1（LIBERO）和Wan2.2（RoboTwin）上：重建VBench-7接近FP32/BF16基线（0.7340/0.7409；0.7414/0.7436），潜变量偏差与动作偏差均小于Direct NVFP4基线，LIBERO成功率95.75% vs 95.50%，RoboTwin成功率68.8% vs 69.8%（联合QAT对应为10.5%与0%）。NVIDIA B300上NVFP4相比BF16 cuDNN取得1.17×–1.26×端到端VAE加速，模型驻留内存降低60.4%–69.4%。

Conclusion: 共享生成组件的低比特优化应以保留下游消费表征为目标，而非仅优化重建输出。LatentQuant通过在潜边界施加显式优化约束而非软惩罚，解决了联合QAT中潜表征漂移导致控制崩溃的问题，使原生NVFP4部署在保持闭环控制性能的同时获得显著加速。

Abstract: Recent world action models (WAMs) reuse pretrained video VAEs whose encoder latents directly condition downstream action policies. Quantization must therefore preserve not only reconstruction fidelity but also the policy-facing latent contract expected by the frozen policy. Direct NVFP4 leaves W4A4 quantization error uncompensated, whereas joint quantization-aware training (QAT) can recover reconstruction by moving this representation. On Wan2.1, joint QAT nearly matches FP32 VBench-7 (0.7403 versus 0.7409), yet LIBERO success collapses from 95.5% to 10.5%. Controlled decoder-only experiments show that activation quantize-dequantize operations alter the reconstruction signal and decoder Jacobian, redirecting the gradient returned to the encoder and inducing persistent latent drift. Based on this mechanism, we introduce LatentQuant, a two-stage NVFP4 QAT framework that first aligns the quantized encoder with its high-precision counterpart, then freezes it while adapting the decoder. Across Wan2.1 and Wan2.2, LatentQuant preserves near-baseline control and high reconstruction quality, achieving 95.75% success on LIBERO and 68.8% on RoboTwin.
